<script>
/* the frame-time snapshot (bench.js, written by python -m tools.dev.bench) */
(() => {
  const B = window.BENCH;
  if (!B || !B.scenes || !B.scenes.length) return;
  const el = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);
  const color = (who) => who === "ours" ? "var(--s3)" : who === "game's" ? "var(--s4)" : who === "NVIDIA DLSS" ? "var(--s7)" : "var(--line)";
  const fmt = (v, d = 1) => v == null ? "—" : Number(v).toFixed(d);
  const date = new Date(B.date + "T00:00:00Z").toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
  el("perfMeta").innerHTML = `Measured ${esc(date)} with game ${esc(B.version)} on ${esc(B.gpu || "one PC")}. Settings: ${esc(B.settings)}. `
    + `Another graphics card or other settings give other numbers: this shows where the time goes, not how fast it runs for you. `
    + `Made with <code>python -m tools.dev.bench</code>.`;
  const bars = (ol, rows) => {
    const max = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.ms), 0.001);
    ol.innerHTML = rows.map((r) => `<li><span class="nm" title="${esc(r.name)}">${esc(r.name)}</span>`
      + `<span class="track"><span class="fill" style="display:block;width:${(100 * r.ms / max).toFixed(1)}%;background:${color(r.who)}"></span></span>`
      + `<span class="v">${fmt(r.ms, 2)} ms</span></li>`).join("");
  };
  const sel = el("perfScene");
  sel.innerHTML = B.scenes.map((s, i) => `<option value="${i}">${esc(s.name)}</option>`).join("");
  const show = () => bars(el("perfPasses"), B.scenes[+sel.value].passes);
  sel.addEventListener("change", show);
  show();
  const MASK = [["as set", "Soft and contact shadows"], ["no contact shadows", "Soft shadows only"], ["no soft shadows", "Contact shadows only"], ["neither", "Neither"]];
  const m = B.shadow_mask || {};
  bars(el("perfMask"), MASK.filter(([k]) => m[k] != null).map(([k, label]) => ({ name: label, who: "ours", ms: m[k] })));
  el("perfScenes").innerHTML = B.scenes.map((s) => `<tr><td>${esc(s.name)}</td><td class="n">${fmt(s.fps)}</td>`
    + `<td class="n">${fmt(s.gpu_ms)}</td><td class="n">${fmt(s.fps_uncapped, 0)}</td></tr>`).join("");
})();
</script>
<script>
/* the theme switch: the other theme than the one showing, kept for next time */
(() => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('theme'), root = document.documentElement;
  const dark = () => root.dataset.theme ? root.dataset.theme === 'dark' : matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  const label = () => btn.setAttribute('aria-label', dark() ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode');
  label();
  const flip = () => {
    root.dataset.theme = dark() ? 'light' : 'dark';
    try { localStorage.setItem('yw4-theme', root.dataset.theme); } catch (e) {}
    label();
  };
  /* a slow cross-fade between the themes (site.css sets its length), where the browser can do one */
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (document.startViewTransition && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) document.startViewTransition(flip);
    else flip();
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
/* The code map. Two views on one SVG: all modules (a force layout, clustered by area) and the functions inside one
 * module (callers from other files on the left, this module in the middle, what it calls on the right). The state
 * lives in the address: #mod picks a module, #mod/ opens it, #mod/fn picks a function inside it. */
(() => {
const DATA = window.CODE_MAP;
const REPO = "https://github.com/ILFforever/YW4Recomp/blob/";
const GROUPS = {
  vulkan:  { label: "Vulkan & window",       slot: 1, about: "Turns the game's NVN commands into Vulkan draws; owns the window and presents frames." },
  overlay: { label: "Overlay & controls",    slot: 2, about: "The in-game overlay, settings, controls, cheats and bug reports." },
  system:  { label: "Switch system",         slot: 3, about: "The kernel, native stand-ins for the sdk (HLE) and Switch services: files, saves, input, audio." },
  passes:  { label: "Render passes",         slot: 4, about: "Our own versions of the game's passes: G-buffer, shadows, bloom, blur, anti-aliasing, widescreen." },
  core:    { label: "Start-up & CPU",        slot: 5, about: "Loads the recompiled game and starts it; CPU helpers, threads, logs." },
  nvn:     { label: "NVN graphics API",      slot: 6, about: "The Switch's graphics API, rebuilt natively, plus Tegra texture layouts." },
  upscale: { label: "Upscaling & frame gen", slot: 7, about: "FSR and DLSS upscaling and frame generation." },
  debug:   { label: "Debug & performance",   slot: 8, about: "Performance logs, profilers and trace tools for development." },
};
const GROUP_ORDER = Object.keys(GROUPS).sort((a, b) => GROUPS[a].slot - GROUPS[b].slot);
const RING = ["core", "overlay", "debug", "upscale", "passes", "nvn", "system"];
const colorOf = g => `var(--s${GROUPS[g].slot})`;
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US");
const plural = (n, w) => `${fmt(n)} ${w}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
const reduceMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const T = sel => reduceMotion ? sel : sel.transition().duration(450);
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
if (!DATA || !window.d3) { $("lede").textContent = "The code map could not load its data or its library."; return; }

// ---------- data
const nodes = DATA.nodes.map(n => ({ ...n, out: [], in: [] }));
const byId = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
const links = DATA.links.map(l => ({ ...l, s: l.source, t: l.target }));
links.forEach(l => { byId.get(l.s).out.push(l); byId.get(l.t).in.push(l); });
nodes.forEach(n => {
  n.outN = n.out.length; n.inN = n.in.length;
  n.r = 4 + Math.sqrt(n.loc) * 0.27;
  n.out.sort((a, b) => b.fnCount - a.fnCount || a.t.localeCompare(b.t));
  n.in.sort((a, b) => b.fnCount - a.fnCount || a.s.localeCompare(b.s));
});
const F = new Map(DATA.funcs.map(f => [f.k, { ...f, callers: [] }]));
F.forEach(f => f.c.forEach(k => F.get(k).callers.push(f.k)));
F.forEach(f => { f.group = byId.get(f.m).group; f.tables = f.n === "(tables)"; });
const funcsByMod = d3.group([...F.values()], f => f.m);
nodes.forEach(n => { n.fnTotal = (funcsByMod.get(n.id) || []).filter(f => !f.tables).length; });
const realFuncs = [...F.values()].filter(f => !f.tables);
const fileUrl = f => `${REPO}${DATA.commit}/${f}`;
const fnUrl = f => `${REPO}${DATA.commit}/${f.f}#L${f.l}`;

// ---------- header numbers and the areas card
const totalLoc = d3.sum(nodes, n => n.loc);
$("stModules").textContent = fmt(nodes.length);
$("stFuncs").textContent = fmt(realFuncs.length);
$("stLines").textContent = fmt(totalLoc);
const areaLoc = GROUP_ORDER.map(g => ({ g, loc: d3.sum(nodes.filter(n => n.group === g), n => n.loc), n: nodes.filter(n => n.group === g).length }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.loc - a.loc);
const maxLoc = d3.max(areaLoc, a => a.loc);
$("areaBars").innerHTML = areaLoc.map(a => `<li><span class="nm"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(a.g)}"></span>${esc(GROUPS[a.g].label)}</span>
  <span class="track" title="${fmt(a.loc)} lines in ${a.n} modules"><span class="fill" style="display:block;width:${(a.loc / maxLoc * 100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${colorOf(a.g)}"></span></span>
  <span class="v">${fmt(a.loc)}</span></li>`).join("");
$("areaSrc").textContent = `Non-blank lines, commit ${DATA.commit.slice(0, 7)} (${DATA.date}). Areas are grouped by hand.`;
$("commit").innerHTML = `Made from commit <a href="${REPO.replace("/blob/", "/tree/")}${DATA.commit}">${DATA.commit.slice(0, 7)}</a> (${esc(DATA.date)}); function links open that commit on GitHub.`;

const lede = $("lede"), hint = $("hint");
const LEDE_OVERVIEW = "Every module in runtime/, clustered by area. A line means one file uses another. Click a dot to see what it uses and what uses it; double-click it, or press Open functions, to look inside.";
const HINT_OVERVIEW = "Drag to pan · Ctrl + scroll or the buttons to zoom · double-click a dot to look inside";

// ---------- area chips
const hidden = new Set();
const chips = $("chips");
GROUP_ORDER.forEach(g => {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.type = "button"; b.className = "cm-chip"; b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); b.title = GROUPS[g].about; b.dataset.g = g;
  b.innerHTML = `<span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(g)}"></span>${esc(GROUPS[g].label)} <span class="n">${nodes.filter(n => n.group === g).length}</span>`;
  b.addEventListener("click", () => { if (hidden.has(g)) hidden.delete(g); else hidden.add(g); syncChips(); applyVisibility(); });
  chips.appendChild(b);
});
function syncChips() { [...chips.children].forEach(c => c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!hidden.has(c.dataset.g)))); }
$("findlist").innerHTML =
  nodes.map(n => n.id).sort().map(id => `<option value="${esc(id)}">`).join("") +
  realFuncs.map(f => `${f.n} (${f.m})`).sort().map(v => `<option value="${esc(v)}">`).join("");

// ---------- svg + zoom (the wheel zooms only with Ctrl, so the page still scrolls over the map)
const stage = $("stage");
const W = 1000, H = Math.max(620, Math.min(1500, Math.round(1000 * stage.clientHeight / Math.max(1, stage.clientWidth))));
const svg = d3.select("#graph").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
svg.append("defs").html(`
  <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" style="fill:var(--ink)"></path></marker>
  <marker id="arrow-in" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" style="fill:var(--accent-ink)"></path></marker>`);
const ovRoot = svg.append("g");
const fileRoot = svg.append("g").attr("class", "fileview").style("display", "none");
let view = "overview", baseK = 1, ovBaseK = 1, ovT = null;
const zoom = d3.zoom().scaleExtent([0.12, 6])
  .filter(e => e.type === "wheel" ? (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) : (!e.ctrlKey || e.type === "wheel") && !e.button)
  .on("zoom", e => {
    (view === "overview" ? ovRoot : fileRoot).attr("transform", e.transform);
    svg.classed("zoomed", e.transform.k >= baseK * 1.7);
  });
svg.call(zoom).on("dblclick.zoom", null);
svg.on("click", () => { if (view === "overview") select(null); else selectFn(null); });
$("zin").addEventListener("click", () => T(svg).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1.4));
$("zout").addEventListener("click", () => T(svg).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1 / 1.4));

const tip = $("tip");
function showTip(html) { tip.innerHTML = html; tip.hidden = false; }
function moveTip(e) {
  const b = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = e.clientX - b.left + 14, y = e.clientY - b.top + 14;
  if (x + tip.offsetWidth + 8 > b.width) x = e.clientX - b.left - 14 - tip.offsetWidth;
  if (y + tip.offsetHeight + 8 > b.height) y = e.clientY - b.top - 14 - tip.offsetHeight;
  tip.style.left = x + "px"; tip.style.top = y + "px";
}
function hideTip() { tip.hidden = true; }

// ---------- the address: #mod, #mod/, #mod/fn
let ignoreHash = null;
function setHash(h) {
  const v = h ? "#" + h : "";
  if (location.hash === v) return;
  if (h) { ignoreHash = v; location.hash = h; }
  else { try { history.pushState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {} }
}
function route(scroll) {
  const h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
  if (!h) { if (view === "file") closeFile(true); select(null, false, true); return; }
  const slash = h.indexOf("/"), m = slash < 0 ? h : h.slice(0, slash), fn = slash < 0 ? "" : h.slice(slash + 1);
  if (!byId.has(m)) return;
  if (scroll) $("map").scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });
  if (slash < 0) { if (view === "file") closeFile(true); select(m, true, true); return; }
  const key = fn ? (F.has(`${m}:${fn}`) ? `${m}:${fn}` : (F.has(fn) ? fn : null)) : null;
  if (view !== "file" || fileMod !== m) openFile(m, key, true); else selectFn(key, true, true);
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => { if (location.hash === ignoreHash) { ignoreHash = null; return; } ignoreHash = null; route(false); });
window.addEventListener("popstate", () => { if (!location.hash) route(false); });

const anchors = { vulkan: { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 } };
RING.forEach((g, i) => {
  const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * 2 * Math.PI / RING.length;
  anchors[g] = { x: W / 2 + Math.cos(a) * W * 0.36, y: H / 2 + Math.sin(a) * H * 0.37 };
});
const rand = d3.randomLcg(7);
nodes.forEach(n => { const a = anchors[n.group]; n.x = a.x + (rand() - 0.5) * 80; n.y = a.y + (rand() - 0.5) * 80; });

  .randomSource(d3.randomLcg(11))
  .force("link", d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.id).distance(60).strength(l => byId.get(l.s).group === byId.get(l.t).group ? 0.06 : 0.008))
  .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-70).distanceMax(220))
  .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => d.r + 3))
  .force("x", d3.forceX(d => anchors[d.group].x).strength(0.13))
  .force("y", d3.forceY(d => anchors[d.group].y).strength(0.13))
  .stop();
sim.tick(420);

  .attr("class", l => "link" + (l.fnCount === 0 ? " inc" : ""))

const clusterSel = ovRoot.append("g").selectAll("text").data(GROUP_ORDER).join("text").attr("class", "cluster").text(g => GROUPS[g].label);

function drawOverview() {
  linkSel.each(function (l) {
    const s = l.source, t = l.target, dx = t.x - s.x, dy = t.y - s.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    this.setAttribute("x1", s.x + dx / d * s.r); this.setAttribute("y1", s.y + dy / d * s.r);
    this.setAttribute("x2", t.x - dx / d * (t.r + 2)); this.setAttribute("y2", t.y - dy / d * (t.r + 2));
  });
  nodeSel.attr("transform", n => `translate(${n.x},${n.y})`);
  clusterSel.each(function (g) {
    const ms = nodes.filter(n => n.group === g);
    this.setAttribute("x", d3.mean(ms, n => n.x)); this.setAttribute("y", d3.min(ms, n => n.y - n.r) - 22);
  });
}
drawOverview();
sim.on("tick", drawOverview);

function fitOverview(animate) {
  const xs = d3.extent(nodes, n => n.x), ys = d3.extent(nodes, n => n.y);
  const pad = 50, k = Math.min(W / (xs[1] - xs[0] + pad * 2), H / (ys[1] - ys[0] + pad * 2 + 30), 1.4);
  ovBaseK = baseK = k;
  const t = d3.zoomIdentity.translate(W / 2, H / 2 + 10).scale(k).translate(-(xs[0] + xs[1]) / 2, -(ys[0] + ys[1]) / 2);
  (animate ? T(svg) : svg).call(zoom.transform, t);
}
fitOverview(false);

nodeSel.call(d3.drag()
  .on("start", (e, n) => { if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0.2).restart(); n.fx = n.x; n.fy = n.y; })
  .on("drag", (e, n) => { n.fx = e.x; n.fy = e.y; })
  .on("end", (e, n) => { if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0); n.fx = null; n.fy = null; }));
nodeSel.on("mouseenter", function (e, n) {

}).on("mousemove", moveTip).on("mouseleave", function () { d3.select(this).classed("hover", false); hideTip(); })
  .on("click", (e, n) => { e.stopPropagation(); select(n.id, false); })

  .on("keydown", (e, n) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && selected === n.id) { e.preventDefault(); openFile(n.id, null); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); select(n.id, false); }
  });

let selected = null;
const showInc = $("showInc");
showInc.addEventListener("change", applyVisibility);
function applyVisibility() {
  nodeSel.style("display", n => hidden.has(n.group) ? "none" : null);
  clusterSel.style("display", g => hidden.has(g) ? "none" : null);
  linkSel.style("display", l => hidden.has(l.source.group) || hidden.has(l.target.group) || (!showInc.checked && l.fnCount === 0) ? "none" : null);
  if (selected && hidden.has(byId.get(selected).group)) select(null);
}

function select(id, center, fromRoute) {
  selected = id;
  if (!id) {
    nodeSel.classed("sel", false).classed("dim", false).classed("nb", false);
    linkSel.classed("hl", false).classed("in", false).classed("dim", false).attr("marker-end", null);
    clusterSel.classed("dim", false);
    renderOverviewPanel();
    if (!fromRoute) setHash("");
    renderTable();
    return;
  }
  const n = byId.get(id);
  if (hidden.has(n.group)) { hidden.delete(n.group); syncChips(); applyVisibility(); }
  const nb = new Set([id, ...n.out.map(l => l.t), ...n.in.map(l => l.s)]);
  nodeSel.classed("sel", d => d.id === id).classed("nb", d => d.id !== id && nb.has(d.id)).classed("dim", d => !nb.has(d.id));
  linkSel.classed("hl", l => l.s === id || l.t === id).classed("in", l => l.t === id && l.s !== id)
    .classed("dim", l => l.s !== id && l.t !== id)
    .attr("marker-end", l => l.s === id ? "url(#arrow)" : l.t === id ? "url(#arrow-in)" : null);
  linkSel.filter(l => l.s === id || l.t === id).raise();
  clusterSel.classed("dim", true);
  renderModulePanel(n);
  if (!fromRoute) setHash(id);
  if (center) {
    const k = Math.max(d3.zoomTransform(svg.node()).k, ovBaseK * 1.3);
    T(svg).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity.translate(W / 2, H / 2).scale(k).translate(-n.x, -n.y));
  }
}

const panel = $("panel");
function modRow(otherId, l) {
  const o = byId.get(otherId);
  const ct = l.fnCount ? plural(l.fnCount, "function") : "#include only";
  const shown = l.fns.slice(0, 6), more = l.fnCount - shown.length;
  const fns = shown.length ? `<span class="fns">${shown.map(esc).join(", ")}${more > 0 ? ` +${more} more` : ""}</span>` : "";
  return `<li><button type="button" data-go="${esc(otherId)}"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(o.group)}"></span><span class="nm">${esc(otherId)}</span><span class="ct">${ct}</span>${fns}</button></li>`;
}
function renderModulePanel(n) {
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:grid;gap:6px">
      <span class="cm-area"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(n.group)}"></span>${esc(GROUPS[n.group].label)}</span>
      <h2>${esc(n.id)}</h2>
      <div class="cm-files">${n.files.map(f => `<a href="${fileUrl(f)}">${esc(f)}</a>`).join("")}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cm-facts"><span><b>${fmt(n.loc)}</b> lines</span><span><b>${n.fnTotal}</b> functions</span><span>uses <b>${n.outN}</b></span><span>used by <b>${n.inN}</b></span></div>
    ${n.fnTotal ? `<div class="cm-btnrow"><button class="cm-btn primary" type="button" data-open="${esc(n.id)}">Open functions (${n.fnTotal}) →</button></div>` : ""}
    ${n.blurb ? `<p>${esc(n.blurb)}</p>` : ""}
    <div><h3>Uses (${n.outN})</h3>${n.out.length ? `<ul class="cm-rel">${n.out.map(l => modRow(l.t, l)).join("")}</ul>` : `<p class="cm-empty">Uses nothing else in the runtime.</p>`}</div>
    <div><h3>Used by (${n.inN})</h3>${n.in.length ? `<ul class="cm-rel">${n.in.map(l => modRow(l.s, l)).join("")}</ul>` : `<p class="cm-empty">Nothing else in the runtime uses it.</p>`}</div>
    <div class="cm-btnrow"><button class="cm-btn" type="button" data-clear>Clear selection</button></div>`;
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
}
function renderOverviewPanel() {
  const hubs = [...nodes].sort((a, b) => b.inN - a.inN).slice(0, 8);
  const biggest = [...nodes].sort((a, b) => b.loc - a.loc).slice(0, 6);
  const row = (n, ct) => `<li><button type="button" data-go="${esc(n.id)}"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(n.group)}"></span><span class="nm">${esc(n.id)}</span><span class="ct">${ct}</span></button></li>`;
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:grid;gap:6px"><h3 style="margin:0">Nothing picked yet</h3>
    <p>Click a dot, or a module below. Lines into a dot mean other files use it; dashed lines are header includes with no function calls.</p></div>
    <div><h3>Most used</h3><ul class="cm-rel">${hubs.map(n => row(n, `used by ${n.inN}`)).join("")}</ul></div>
    <div><h3>Biggest</h3><ul class="cm-rel">${biggest.map(n => row(n, `${fmt(n.loc)} lines`)).join("")}</ul></div>
    <div><h3>Areas</h3><ul class="cm-rel">${GROUP_ORDER.map(k =>
      `<li class="about"><span class="dot" style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:${colorOf(k)}"></span><span><b>${esc(GROUPS[k].label)}</b><br><span>${esc(GROUPS[k].about)}</span></span></li>`).join("")}</ul></div>`;
}

// ======================================================================
// Inside one module

const ROW = 17, COLTOP = 78, LX = 230, RX = 830, CX = 530, CX0 = 290, CX1 = 770, VIEW_W = 1090;
let fileMod = null, fileSel = null, fileInfo = null, fNodeSel = null, fLinkSel = null, hdrSel = null, fileSim = null;

function columnRows(keys) {
  const groups = d3.groups([...keys].map(k => F.get(k)), f => f.m)
    .sort((a, b) => GROUPS[byId.get(a[0]).group].slot - GROUPS[byId.get(b[0]).group].slot || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
  const rows = []; let y = COLTOP;
  groups.forEach(([m, fs]) => {
    rows.push({ type: "hdr", m, y }); y += ROW + 2;
    fs.sort((a, b) => a.n.localeCompare(b.n)).forEach(f => { rows.push({ type: "fn", key: f.k, f, y }); y += ROW; });
    y += 10;
  });
  return { rows, h: y };
}
const fnR = f => f.tables ? 5 : Math.min(18, 3.2 + Math.sqrt(f.len) * 0.9);

function setChrome(fileView, id) {
  chips.hidden = fileView; $("crumbs").hidden = !fileView; $("incLabel").hidden = fileView;
  $("barCrumb").textContent = fileView ? `runtime/ › ${id}` : "runtime/";
  $("barCat").textContent = fileView ? "Functions" : "All modules";
}

function openFile(id, fnKey, fromRoute) {
  const mod = byId.get(id);
  if (!mod) return;
  if (view === "overview") ovT = d3.zoomTransform(svg.node());
  view = "file"; fileMod = id; fileSel = null; selected = id;
  hideTip();
  if (fileSim) fileSim.stop();
  ovRoot.style("display", "none");
  fileRoot.style("display", null).selectAll("*").remove();
  setChrome(true, id);
  lede.textContent = `The functions inside ${id}. Middle: this module, top of the file at the top. Left: functions in other files that call into it. Right: functions in other files it calls. Click a function to see its calls; click a module name on the side to go there.`;
  hint.textContent = "Drag to pan · Ctrl + scroll or the buttons to zoom";

  const inner = (funcsByMod.get(id) || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.tables - b.tables) || a.l - b.l);
  const innerSet = new Set(inner.map(f => f.k));
  const extIn = new Set(), extOut = new Set();
  inner.forEach(f => {
    f.c.forEach(k => { if (!innerSet.has(k)) extOut.add(k); });
    f.callers.forEach(k => { if (!innerSet.has(k)) extIn.add(k); });
  });
  const left = columnRows(extIn), right = columnRows(extOut);
  const n = inner.length, Hc = Math.max(420, n * 11);
  const Hf = Math.max(COLTOP + Hc + 20, left.h, right.h) + 20;

  const mid = inner.map((f, i) => {
    const hasIn = f.callers.some(k => !innerSet.has(k)), hasOut = f.c.some(k => !innerSet.has(k));
    const tx = CX + (hasIn && !hasOut ? -120 : !hasIn && hasOut ? 120 : 0);
    const y0 = COLTOP + 10 + (i + 0.5) / Math.max(1, n) * Hc;
    return { side: "mid", key: f.k, f, r: fnR(f), x: CX + (d3.randomLcg(i + 3)() - 0.5) * (CX1 - CX0 - 40), y: y0, tx, ty: y0 };
  });
  const midBy = new Map(mid.map(d => [d.key, d]));
  const inBy = new Map(), outBy = new Map(), ext = [];
  left.rows.filter(r => r.type === "fn").forEach(r => { const d = { side: "in", key: r.key, f: r.f, r: 4, x: LX, y: r.y }; inBy.set(r.key, d); ext.push(d); });
  right.rows.filter(r => r.type === "fn").forEach(r => { const d = { side: "out", key: r.key, f: r.f, r: 4, x: RX, y: r.y }; outBy.set(r.key, d); ext.push(d); });

  const edges = [], innerLinks = [];
  inner.forEach(f => f.c.forEach(k => {
    if (innerSet.has(k)) { const e = { kind: "int", a: midBy.get(f.k), b: midBy.get(k) }; edges.push(e); innerLinks.push({ source: e.a, target: e.b }); }
    else edges.push({ kind: "out", a: midBy.get(f.k), b: outBy.get(k) });
  }));
  extIn.forEach(k => F.get(k).c.forEach(c => { if (innerSet.has(c)) edges.push({ kind: "in", a: inBy.get(k), b: midBy.get(c) }); }));

  fileSim = d3.forceSimulation(mid)
    .randomSource(d3.randomLcg(5))
    .force("link", d3.forceLink(innerLinks).distance(34).strength(0.25))
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-60).distanceMax(180))
    .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => d.r + 5))
    .force("x", d3.forceX(d => d.tx).strength(0.015))
    .force("y", d3.forceY(d => d.ty).strength(0.09))
    .stop();
  const clamp = () => mid.forEach(d => {
    d.x = Math.max(CX0 + d.r, Math.min(CX1 - d.r, d.x));
    d.y = Math.max(COLTOP + d.r, Math.min(Hf - 20 - d.r, d.y));
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < 320; i++) { fileSim.tick(); clamp(); }

  const heads = fileRoot.append("g");
  heads.append("text").attr("class", "colhead").attr("x", LX + 4).attr("y", COLTOP - 36).attr("text-anchor", "end").text(`Called from other files (${extIn.size})`);
  heads.append("text").attr("class", "colhead").attr("x", CX).attr("y", COLTOP - 36).attr("text-anchor", "middle").text(`Inside ${id} (${plural(inner.filter(f => !f.tables).length, "function")})`);
  heads.append("text").attr("class", "colhead").attr("x", RX - 4).attr("y", COLTOP - 36).text(`Calls into other files (${extOut.size})`);
  heads.append("line").attr("class", "colrule").attr("x1", CX0 - 20).attr("x2", CX0 - 20).attr("y1", COLTOP - 24).attr("y2", Hf);
  heads.append("line").attr("class", "colrule").attr("x1", CX1 + 20).attr("x2", CX1 + 20).attr("y1", COLTOP - 24).attr("y2", Hf);
  if (!extIn.size) heads.append("text").attr("class", "colhead").attr("x", LX + 4).attr("y", COLTOP + 4).attr("text-anchor", "end").style("text-transform", "none").text("Nothing outside calls in");
  if (!extOut.size) heads.append("text").attr("class", "colhead").attr("x", RX - 4).attr("y", COLTOP + 4).style("text-transform", "none").text("Calls nothing outside");

  const edgePath = e => {
    if (e.kind === "int") {
      const dx = e.b.x - e.a.x, dy = e.b.y - e.a.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      return `M${e.a.x + dx / d * e.a.r},${e.a.y + dy / d * e.a.r}L${e.b.x - dx / d * (e.b.r + 2)},${e.b.y - dy / d * (e.b.r + 2)}`;
    }
    const x0 = e.kind === "in" ? LX + 5 : e.a.x + e.a.r, y0 = e.a.y;
    const x1 = e.kind === "in" ? e.b.x - e.b.r - 2 : RX - 6, y1 = e.b.y;
    const mx = (x1 - x0) * 0.5;
    return `M${x0},${y0}C${x0 + mx},${y0} ${x1 - mx},${y1} ${x1},${y1}`;
  };
  fLinkSel = fileRoot.append("g").selectAll("path").data(edges).join("path")
    .attr("class", "link").attr("stroke-width", e => e.kind === "int" ? 1 : 0.8);

  hdrSel = fileRoot.append("g").selectAll("g")
    .data([...left.rows.filter(r => r.type === "hdr").map(r => ({ ...r, side: "in" })), ...right.rows.filter(r => r.type === "hdr").map(r => ({ ...r, side: "out" }))])
    .join("g").attr("class", "hdr").attr("tabindex", 0).attr("role", "link")
    .attr("transform", r => `translate(${r.side === "in" ? LX + 4 : RX - 4},${r.y})`);
  hdrSel.append("circle").attr("r", 4.5).attr("cx", r => r.side === "in" ? 0 : 4).style("fill", r => colorOf(byId.get(r.m).group));
  hdrSel.append("text").attr("x", r => r.side === "in" ? -10 : 14).attr("dy", 4).attr("text-anchor", r => r.side === "in" ? "end" : "start")
    .html(r => r.side === "in" ? `<tspan class="open">open ‹ </tspan>${esc(r.m)}` : `${esc(r.m)}<tspan class="open"> › open</tspan>`);
  hdrSel.on("click", (e, r) => { e.stopPropagation(); openFile(r.m, null); })
    .on("keydown", (e, r) => { if (e.key === "Enter") openFile(r.m, null); });

  fNodeSel = fileRoot.append("g").selectAll("g").data([...ext, ...mid]).join("g")
    .attr("class", d => "node" + (d.side !== "mid" ? " ext" : "") + (d.f.s ? " priv" : "") + (d.f.tables ? " tables" : "") + (d.side === "mid" && (d.f.len >= 30 || d.f.tables) ? " big" : ""))
    .style("--c", d => colorOf(d.f.group))
    .attr("tabindex", d => d.side === "mid" ? 0 : -1).attr("role", "button")
    .attr("aria-label", d => `${d.f.n}, ${d.f.m}, ${d.f.len} lines`);
  fNodeSel.append("circle").attr("r", d => d.r);
  fNodeSel.append("text")
    .attr("x", d => d.side === "in" ? -9 : d.side === "out" ? 9 : 0)
    .attr("dy", d => d.side === "mid" ? -d.r - 4 : 4)
    .attr("text-anchor", d => d.side === "in" ? "end" : d.side === "out" ? "start" : "middle")
    .text(d => d.f.n);

  function drawFile() { fLinkSel.attr("d", edgePath); fNodeSel.attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`); }
  drawFile();
  fileSim.on("tick", () => { clamp(); drawFile(); });
  fNodeSel.filter(d => d.side === "mid").call(d3.drag()
    .on("start", (e, d) => { if (!e.active) fileSim.alphaTarget(0.15).restart(); d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y; })
    .on("drag", (e, d) => { d.fx = e.x; d.fy = e.y; })
    .on("end", (e, d) => { if (!e.active) fileSim.alphaTarget(0); d.fx = null; d.fy = null; }));
  fNodeSel.on("mouseenter", function (e, d) {
    d3.select(this).classed("hover", true);
    const f = d.f;
    showTip(`<b>${esc(f.n)}</b>${f.m !== id ? ` · ${esc(f.m)}` : ""}<br>${f.tables ? "names used in tables" : `${plural(f.len, "line")} · ${f.s ? "private" : "public"}`}<br>calls ${f.c.length} · called by ${f.callers.length}`);
  }).on("mousemove", moveTip).on("mouseleave", function () { d3.select(this).classed("hover", false); hideTip(); })
    .on("click", (e, d) => { e.stopPropagation(); selectFn(d.key, false); })
    .on("dblclick", (e, d) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (d.f.m !== id) openFile(d.f.m, d.key); })
    .on("keydown", (e, d) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); selectFn(d.key, false); } });

  fileInfo = { id, mod, inner, extIn, extOut, midBy };
  const kW = Math.min(1.25, W / VIEW_W), kH = H / (Hf + 40);
  const k = Math.max(Math.min(kW, kH), kW * 0.92);
  baseK = k;
  fileInfo.fits = kH >= kW * 0.92;
  svg.call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity.translate(W / 2 - CX * k, 16).scale(k));

  renderTable();
  if (fnKey && F.has(fnKey)) selectFn(fnKey, !fileInfo.fits, fromRoute);
  else { renderFilePanel(); if (!fromRoute) setHash(id + "/"); }
}

function closeFile(fromRoute) {
  if (fileSim) fileSim.stop();
  view = "overview"; fileSel = null;
  fileRoot.style("display", "none").selectAll("*").remove();
  ovRoot.style("display", null);
  setChrome(false);
  lede.textContent = LEDE_OVERVIEW; hint.textContent = HINT_OVERVIEW;
  baseK = ovBaseK;
  svg.call(zoom.transform, ovT || d3.zoomIdentity);
  const m = fileMod; fileMod = null;
  if (!fromRoute) select(m, false);
  renderTable();
}

function selectFn(key, center, fromRoute) {
  if (view !== "file") return;
  fileSel = key;
  if (!key) {
    fNodeSel.classed("sel", false).classed("dim", false).classed("nb", false);
    fLinkSel.classed("hl", false).classed("in", false).classed("dim", false).attr("marker-end", null);
    hdrSel.classed("dim", false);
    renderFilePanel();
    if (!fromRoute) setHash(fileMod + "/");
    return;
  }
  const f = F.get(key);
  const rel = new Set([key, ...f.c, ...f.callers]);
  fNodeSel.classed("sel", d => d.key === key).classed("nb", d => d.key !== key && rel.has(d.key)).classed("dim", d => !rel.has(d.key));
  const touches = e => e.a.key === key || e.b.key === key;
  fLinkSel.classed("hl", touches).classed("in", e => e.b.key === key).classed("dim", e => !touches(e))
    .attr("marker-end", e => touches(e) ? (e.b.key === key ? "url(#arrow-in)" : "url(#arrow)") : null);
  fLinkSel.filter(touches).raise();
  hdrSel.classed("dim", r => !(funcsByMod.get(r.m) || []).some(g => rel.has(g.k)));
  renderFnPanel(f);
  if (!fromRoute) setHash(`${fileMod}/${f.n}`);
  if (center) {
    const d = fileInfo.midBy.get(key) || fNodeSel.data().find(x => x.key === key);
    if (d) {
      const k = Math.max(d3.zoomTransform(svg.node()).k, baseK * 1.25);
      T(svg).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity.translate(W / 2, H / 2).scale(k).translate(-d.x, -d.y));
    }
  }
}

function fnRow(g, ct, here) {
  return `<li><button type="button" data-fn="${esc(g.k)}"><span class="dot${g.s ? " priv" : ""}" style="--c:${colorOf(g.group)};background:${colorOf(g.group)}"></span><span class="nm">${esc(g.n)}${g.m !== here ? ` <small>${esc(g.m)}</small>` : ""}</span><span class="ct">${ct}</span></button></li>`;
}
const lenText = g => g.tables ? "table" : plural(g.len, "line");
function renderFilePanel() {
  const { id, mod, inner, extIn, extOut } = fileInfo;
  const real = inner.filter(f => !f.tables), pub = real.filter(f => !f.s).length;
  const longest = [...real].sort((a, b) => b.len - a.len).slice(0, 8);
  const extCallers = f => f.callers.filter(k => F.get(k).m !== id).length;
  const entries = real.filter(f => extCallers(f) > 0).sort((a, b) => extCallers(b) - extCallers(a));
  const hubs = real.filter(f => f.callers.length).sort((a, b) => b.callers.length - a.callers.length).slice(0, 6);
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:grid;gap:6px">
      <span class="cm-area"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(mod.group)}"></span>${esc(GROUPS[mod.group].label)}</span>
      <h2>${esc(id)}</h2>
      <div class="cm-files">${mod.files.map(f => `<a href="${fileUrl(f)}">${esc(f)}</a>`).join("")}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cm-facts"><span><b>${real.length}</b> functions</span><span><b>${pub}</b> public</span><span><b>${real.length - pub}</b> private</span><span><b>${fmt(mod.loc)}</b> lines</span></div>
    ${mod.blurb ? `<p>${esc(mod.blurb)}</p>` : ""}
    <div class="cm-legend">
      <span><i style="background:${colorOf(mod.group)}"></i>Filled dot: public, other files can call it</span>
      <span><i style="box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px ${colorOf(mod.group)}"></i>Ring: private (<code>static</code>), only this file</span>
      <span><i style="background:var(--ink-2);transform:scale(.6)"></i>Bigger dot: longer function</span>
    </div>
    <div><h3>Ways in from other files (${entries.length})</h3>${entries.length ? `<ul class="cm-rel">${entries.slice(0, 8).map(f => fnRow(f, `${extCallers(f)} outside callers`, id)).join("")}</ul>` : `<p class="cm-empty">Nothing outside this module calls its functions by name.</p>`}</div>
    <div><h3>Longest</h3><ul class="cm-rel">${longest.map(f => fnRow(f, lenText(f), id)).join("")}</ul></div>
    ${hubs.length ? `<div><h3>Most called</h3><ul class="cm-rel">${hubs.map(f => fnRow(f, `called by ${f.callers.length}`, id)).join("")}</ul></div>` : ""}
    <details class="cm-more"><summary>Outline, in file order (${inner.length})</summary><ul class="cm-rel">${inner.map(f => fnRow(f, f.tables ? "table" : `line ${f.l}`, id)).join("")}</ul></details>
    <div class="cm-facts"><span>called from <b>${extIn.size}</b> outside functions</span><span>calls <b>${extOut.size}</b> outside functions</span></div>`;
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
}
function renderFnPanel(f) {
  const here = fileMod;
  const order = (a, b) => (a.m !== here) - (b.m !== here) || a.m.localeCompare(b.m) || a.n.localeCompare(b.n);
  const calls = f.c.map(k => F.get(k)).sort(order), callers = f.callers.map(k => F.get(k)).sort(order);
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:grid;gap:6px">
      <span class="cm-area"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(f.group)}"></span>${esc(f.m)} · ${esc(GROUPS[f.group].label)}</span>
      <h2>${esc(f.n)}</h2>
      <div class="cm-files"><a href="${fnUrl(f)}" title="Open on GitHub">${esc(f.f)}:${f.l}</a></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cm-facts">${f.tables ? "<span>Function names used outside any function</span>" : `<span><b>${fmt(f.len)}</b> lines</span><span><b>${f.s ? "private" : "public"}</b></span>`}<span>calls <b>${f.c.length}</b></span><span>called by <b>${f.callers.length}</b></span></div>
    ${f.d ? `<p>${esc(f.d)}</p>` : `<p class="cm-empty">No comment above this function.</p>`}
    <div class="cm-btnrow">
      ${f.m !== here ? `<button class="cm-btn primary" type="button" data-openfn="${esc(f.k)}">Open ${esc(f.m)} →</button>` : ""}
      <button class="cm-btn" type="button" data-clearfn>Back to ${esc(here)}</button>
    </div>
    <div><h3>Calls (${calls.length})</h3>${calls.length ? `<ul class="cm-rel">${calls.map(g => fnRow(g, lenText(g), here)).join("")}</ul>` : `<p class="cm-empty">Calls no other runtime function.</p>`}</div>
    <div><h3>Called by (${callers.length})</h3>${callers.length ? `<ul class="cm-rel">${callers.map(g => fnRow(g, lenText(g), here)).join("")}</ul>` : `<p class="cm-empty">${f.s ? "Nothing calls it by name." : "Nothing in the runtime calls it by name. The recompiled game, a hook table or a callback may still reach it."}</p>`}</div>`;
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
}

panel.addEventListener("click", e => {
  const t = e.target.closest("[data-go],[data-open],[data-clear],[data-fn],[data-openfn],[data-clearfn]");
  if (!t) return;
  if (t.dataset.go) select(t.dataset.go, true);
  else if (t.dataset.open) openFile(t.dataset.open, null);
  else if (t.hasAttribute("data-clear")) select(null);
  else if (t.dataset.fn) {
    const g = F.get(t.dataset.fn);
    if (view === "file" && fNodeSel.data().some(d => d.key === g.k)) selectFn(g.k, true); else openFile(g.m, g.k);
  }
  else if (t.dataset.openfn) { const g = F.get(t.dataset.openfn); openFile(g.m, g.k); }
  else if (t.hasAttribute("data-clearfn")) selectFn(null);
});
$("back").addEventListener("click", () => closeFile(false));

// ---------- search, reset
const search = $("search");
function runSearch() {
  const q = search.value.trim();
  if (!q) return;
  const m = q.match(/^(\S+) \((\w+)\)$/);
  if (m) {
    const g = F.get(`${m[2]}:${m[1]}`) || (F.get(m[1]) && F.get(m[1]).m === m[2] ? F.get(m[1]) : null);
    if (g) { openFile(g.m, g.k); return; }
  }
  const ql = q.toLowerCase();
  if (byId.has(ql)) { if (view === "file") openFile(ql, null); else select(ql, true); return; }
  if (F.has(q) && !F.get(q).tables) { openFile(F.get(q).m, q); return; }
  const mod = nodes.find(n => n.id.startsWith(ql));
  if (mod) { if (view === "file") openFile(mod.id, null); else select(mod.id, true); return; }
  const fn = realFuncs.find(f => f.n.toLowerCase().startsWith(ql)) || realFuncs.find(f => f.n.toLowerCase().includes(ql));
  if (fn) openFile(fn.m, fn.k);
}
search.addEventListener("change", runSearch);
search.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter") runSearch(); });
$("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
  search.value = "";
  if (view === "file") { T(svg).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity.translate(W / 2 - CX * baseK, 16).scale(baseK)); selectFn(null); return; }
  hidden.clear(); syncChips(); showInc.checked = true; applyVisibility(); select(null); fitOverview(true);
});

// ---------- the table: modules, or the functions of the open module
const thead = $("thead"), tbody = $("tbody"), tableTitle = $("tableTitle");
const sortState = { overview: { k: "loc", dir: -1 }, file: { k: "l", dir: 1 } };
const COLS = {
  overview: [["id", "Module"], ["group", "Area"], ["loc", "Lines", 1], ["fnTotal", "Functions", 1], ["outN", "Uses", 1], ["inN", "Used by", 1], [null, "What it is"]],
  file: [["n", "Function"], ["l", "Line", 1], ["len", "Lines", 1], ["s", "Kind"], ["cN", "Calls", 1], ["byN", "Called by", 1], [null, "Comment above it"]],
};
function renderTable() {
  const v = view, st = sortState[v];
  tableTitle.textContent = v === "overview" ? "All modules as a table" : `All functions in ${fileMod} as a table`;
  thead.innerHTML = "<tr>" + COLS[v].map(([k, label, num]) => `<th${num ? ' class="num"' : ""}>${k ? `<button type="button" data-k="${k}">${label}${st.k === k ? (st.dir > 0 ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}</button>` : label}</th>`).join("") + "</tr>";
  const cmp = val => (a, b) => { const x = val(a, st.k), y = val(b, st.k); return (x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0) * st.dir; };
  if (v === "overview") {
    const rows = [...nodes].sort(cmp((n, k) => k === "group" ? GROUPS[n.group].label : n[k]));
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(n => `<tr data-go="${esc(n.id)}" tabindex="0">
      <td class="mono">${esc(n.id)}</td>
      <td><span class="cm-area"><span class="dot" style="background:${colorOf(n.group)}"></span>${esc(GROUPS[n.group].label)}</span></td>
      <td class="num">${fmt(n.loc)}</td><td class="num">${n.fnTotal}</td><td class="num">${n.outN}</td><td class="num">${n.inN}</td>
      <td class="blurb">${esc(n.blurb)}</td></tr>`).join("");
  } else {
    const rows = [...fileInfo.inner].sort(cmp((f, k) => k === "cN" ? f.c.length : k === "byN" ? f.callers.length : f[k]));
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(f => `<tr data-fnrow="${esc(f.k)}" tabindex="0">
      <td class="mono">${esc(f.n)}</td><td class="num">${f.l}</td><td class="num">${f.len}</td><td>${f.tables ? "table" : f.s ? "private" : "public"}</td>
      <td class="num">${f.c.length}</td><td class="num">${f.callers.length}</td><td class="blurb">${esc(f.d)}</td></tr>`).join("");
  }
}
thead.addEventListener("click", e => {
  const b = e.target.closest("button[data-k]");
  if (!b) return;
  const st = sortState[view], k = b.dataset.k;
  if (st.k === k) st.dir = -st.dir; else { st.k = k; st.dir = ["id", "group", "n", "l", "s"].includes(k) ? 1 : -1; }
  renderTable();
});
function goRow(e) {
  if (e.type === "keydown" && e.key !== "Enter") return;
  const tr = e.target.closest("tr[data-go],tr[data-fnrow]");
  if (!tr) return;
  if (tr.dataset.go) select(tr.dataset.go, true); else selectFn(tr.dataset.fnrow, true);
  stage.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth", block: "center" });
}
tbody.addEventListener("click", goRow);
tbody.addEventListener("keydown", goRow);

// ---------- start
lede.textContent = LEDE_OVERVIEW; hint.textContent = HINT_OVERVIEW;
renderOverviewPanel();
renderTable();
if (location.hash) route(true);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

# Baseline: the game on an emulator (Eden v0.2.1)

Status: partial (2026-10-22). Frame rate for three screens, resource use at the name-entry screen and the opening scene; the recompiled build is still to be measured the same way.

Machine: AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS (8 cores, 16 threads), 36 GB RAM, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop (8 GB), Windows 11.
Eden settings: Vulkan, balanced accuracy, docked, scale 1x, bilinear, no AA. Game: Yo-kai Watch 4++ 2.2.0.

## Frame rate (Eden status bar)

| Screen | Game FPS | Frame time |
|---|---|---|
| Autosave notice | 30 | 33.33 ms |
| Title menu | 30 | 33.34 ms |
| Name entry | 30 | 33.34 ms |
| Opening scene (Whisper dialogue) | 30 | 34.01 ms |

The game caps itself at 30 frames/s, so a steady 33.3 ms means Eden keeps up; it says nothing about headroom.

## System resources (30 s, 1 s samples)

Name-entry screen:

| Measure | Average | Peak |
|---|---|---|
| Eden CPU | 185% of one core | 323% |
| Eden memory, total working set (includes mapped memory, see below) | 6.98 GB | 7.08 GB |
| GPU use, whole GPU | 32% | 58% |
| GPU memory, whole GPU | 3.59 GB | 3.81 GB |

Opening scene (Whisper dialogue), same method:

| Measure | Average | Peak |
|---|---|---|
| Eden CPU | 146% of one core | 170% |
| Eden memory, total working set (includes mapped memory, see below) | 6.97 GB | 6.97 GB |
| GPU use, whole GPU | 35% | 45% |
| GPU memory, whole GPU | 3.84 GB | 3.85 GB |

GPU use and GPU memory are for the whole GPU, so other programs (desktop, browser) are included.

## To do

- The recompiled build measured the same way (its own log is in `work/perf/`, see README).

## Recompiled build vs Eden, busy street (~1,480 draws), 2026-10-22

Same spot (the street by the school gate where the owner's save loads), standing still, both
running at the same time, per-process Windows counters over ~50 s. Ours after the CPU work of
2026-10-22 (FP fast paths, -O2, restrict, SSE vector maths, native memcpy, call caches).

| Measure | Eden | Recompiled build |
|---|---|---|
| CPU | 210% of one core | 111% |
| GPU, 3D engine (this process only) | 29.7% average (peak 33%) | 33.0% average (peak 35%) |
| Memory, private bytes (committed; not Task Manager's column) | 15.7 GB | 3.9 GB |
| Frames over 34.5 ms | (no per-frame log) | 0.2%, p99 33.9 ms |

Notes:
- Our GPU time per frame from timestamps is 18-19 ms here; Eden's GPU share is a little lower,
  so the renderer is now the side with more to gain (Phase 4b/4c).
- Committed private memory is not what Task Manager shows (see the memory note below); it is
  given here only because both processes were measured the same way.

## Recompiled build vs Eden, opening scene (Whisper dialogue), 2026-10-22

Both running at the same time, same scene, measured per process (Windows per-process counters, so the other program does not count). The whole-GPU figures above include everything on the GPU (desktop, browser, video), so use this table for the comparison.

| Measure | Eden | Recompiled build |
|---|---|---|
| Frame rate | 30 fps (34.01 ms) | 29.2 fps average over the run, 33.3 ms typical |
| CPU | 146% of one core (peak 170%) | 108% (peak 134%) |
| Memory, private (what Task Manager's Memory column shows) | 1.36 GB | 2.78 GB |
| GPU, 3D engine (this process only) | 8% average (peak 10%) | 16% average (peak 20%) |
| GPU time per frame (timestamps) | not available | 6.5 ms average, 11.9 ms at p95 |

Notes:
- Memory, corrected: an earlier version of this file compared Eden's 6.9 GB *working set* with our 2.9 GB. That was misleading: Eden's working set includes 5.5 GB of shared, memory-mapped pages (the emulated console's RAM mapping), which Task Manager does not count in its Memory column. Measured the way Task Manager does: Eden 1.36 GB private (7.1 GB committed, 6.9 GB working set with the mapped part), ours 2.78 GB private (3.84 GB committed). So Eden uses less private RAM than the recompiled build, which keeps the game's 2.9 GB heap as ordinary memory.
- GPU: Eden 8-10% (20 s and 60 s averages), ours 16% in one 20 s sample, 12.2% in a Task Manager snapshot. Ours is heavier but by an uncertain amount, between 1x and 2x; repeat over a longer run once the crash below is fixed.
- GPU: ours uses more GPU time than Eden for the same scene. Expected at this stage: full barriers between all work, images kept in the general layout, no pipeline cache across runs, and textures re-uploaded each frame. Optimising this is a later phase.
- Visual difference seen in the same scene: Eden's floor and Jibanyan are more saturated and brighter; ours is flatter and darker. Something in the lighting or post-processing is still missing.

## Recompiled build vs Eden, schoolyard street corner, 2026-10-26

After decisions 0028 (geometry in video memory) and 0029 (the GPU worker thread). The owner stood at the same street
corner (daytime) in both, side by side; Eden's numbers from its frame-time overlay, ours from the HUD (F3) and the
performance log of the same session.

| Measure | Eden v0.2.1 | Recompiled build |
|---|---|---|
| Frame rate | 30 fps (min 29, max 31) | 29.8 fps on the HUD; 29.9 over the whole session after loading |
| Frame time | avg 33.4 ms, min 32.0, max 80.6 | min 31.6, max 66.7 ms on the HUD; whole session (11,506 frames): avg 33.4 ms, p99 34.0, 0.2% of frames over 34.5 ms, one frame of 133 ms |
| GPU time per frame | not available | 7.4 ms |
| Game work per frame | not available | 18.5 ms (of the 33.3 ms budget) |
| CPU (30 s side by side, per process) | 308% of one core (peak 501%) | 159% (peak 174%); the HUD showed 1.7 of 16 cores |
| GPU, 3D engine, this process only | 11.6% (peak 12.9%) | 17.5% (peak 20.3%); 8.5 ms of GPU time a frame |
| Memory, private (Task Manager's column) | 1.26 GB | 2.86 GB |
| Memory, committed | 6.74 GB | 5.21 GB |
| Frame time over the same 30 s | (overlay above) | avg 33.35 ms, p99 34.1, max 50.1; game work 15.2 ms |

Notes:
- The same frame rate as Eden at the game's 30 cap, with a shorter worst frame at this spot. The session's single
  133 ms frame is not explained yet (a first-use pipeline build or an area load are the likely causes).
- The GPU is idle most of each frame (7.4 of 33 ms): room for higher resolution later.
- CPU: about half of Eden's, with much smaller peaks. GPU: about 1.5x Eden's, partly our own settings (4096 shadow
  maps where Eden draws the game's 1024, PCSS x2) and partly our translation's barriers; still 8.5 of 33 ms a frame.
- Memory: as on 2026-10-22, Task Manager's column counts our 2.9 GB game heap but not Eden's mapped console RAM;
  committed memory is lower for us.
- **At the game's own shadow settings** (F8 to 1024, F7 PCSS off; same spot, both running, 30 s): ours GPU 14.3%
  (5.5 ms a frame) vs Eden 13.2%; CPU 147% (peak 161%) vs Eden 318% (peak 604%); frame time avg 33.37 ms, p99 34.0.
  So the GPU gap above is our shadow upgrade (4096 maps + PCSS x2: ~3 ms of GPU time a frame); at equal settings
  the GPU use is about Eden's. Eden's own GPU share moved between the two samples (11.6% / 13.2%).
- Measured with a script sampling both processes once a second for 30 s (CPU time, private working set, commit, GPU
  engine counters by process id).
- The owner's slow evening and night towns (`work/testsaves/save_base_lag`..`lag4`), 20-26 fps before 0028, now run
  at 29.9 fps with 12 ms of GPU time and ~13 ms of game work a frame.

## Recompiled build vs Eden, late-game save, two places, 2026-11-17

Game 1.5.0 plus commit 6c20dc7 (after decision 0079, the GPU worker's CPU work). Both loaded the same save

| Measure | Eden | Recompiled build |

Notes:

## Recompiled build, frame pacing at the owner's settings, 2026-11-12

Not against Eden: a check for spikes before the 1.0.0 release, on the same machine. Settings: 3840×2160, DLSS as
anti-aliasing with upscaling off, DLSS frame generation, FRAME RATE 120, shadow map 4096, soft shadows ×2, contact
shadows, full-size effects, ×16 texture filtering, our own renderer's passes on. Each scene once: loaded from a save
by a replay, then every frame's time from the performance log (`work/perf/*.csv`), starting 8 s after the 3D world
first draws so loading is not counted. The first seven stand still; the walk moves through the town for about two
minutes (`work/inputs/walk.txt`).

| Scene (save) | Game frames/s | Frame time, median | 99th percentile | Worst | Spikes | Draws | GPU ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Busy spot (`save_base_busy`) | 57.0 | 17.5 ms | 20.1 ms | 35.2 ms | 1 | 415 | 14.2 |
| Slow town place 1 (`save_base_lag`) | 50.6 | 19.7 ms | 23.1 ms | 35.1 ms | 0 | 402 | 15.7 |
| Slow town place 2 (`save_base_lag2`) | 52.9 | 18.9 ms | 21.1 ms | 26.0 ms | 0 | 254 | 15.4 |
| Slow town place 3 (`save_base_lag3`) | 52.0 | 19.2 ms | 21.7 ms | 32.7 ms | 0 | 316 | 15.5 |
| Slow town place 4 (`save_base_lag4`) | 54.1 | 18.5 ms | 20.9 ms | 35.4 ms | 0 | 203 | 14.9 |
| Late game, bamboo forest (`save_base_lategame`) | 47.8 | 20.9 ms | 22.5 ms | 39.7 ms | 0 | 113 | 17.2 |
| Yo-kai World (`save_base_yokaiworld`) | 50.6 | 19.7 ms | 22.2 ms | 52.9 ms | 1 | 277 | 16.1 |
| Town walk, moving (`save_base_walk`) | 52.1 | 19.3 ms | 22.2 ms | 39.3 ms | 1 | 433 | 15.7 |

A spike here is a frame over twice the scene's median. 75 s of play per scene (135 s for the walk), about 11
minutes in all.

Notes:
- These are the game's own frames; with frame generation about twice as many are shown (roughly 96 to 114).
- Steady: in every scene the 99th percentile is within about 3 ms of the median. Three single slow frames in all
  (35, 39 and 53 ms), each one frame and not a run of them; their cause was not looked for.
- No `stall:` line (GPU-thread work over 50 ms, `YW4_STALL_MS`) during play in any scene, and no errors.
- The GPU is the limit at these settings: 14 to 17 ms of each 18 to 21 ms frame. That is the cost of native 4K with
  these shadows, and why it sits near 50 and not at the 120 cap; upscaling lifts it (README, Upscaling).
- Not covered: battles, menus, cutscenes, and entering new areas beyond the one walk. Each scene ran once.

```

    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">YW4 Recomp · fan PC port</span>
      <h1>Building from source</h1>
      <p>Build the PC version of <i>Yo-kai Watch 4++</i> yourself, from your own game files. On Windows the
        <a href="../launcher/" style="color: var(--gold)">launcher</a> does all of this for you; on Linux, this is the
        way for now.</p>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat"><b>Windows · Linux</b><span>x86-64 with a Vulkan 1.3 GPU</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b>10–15 min</b><span>to build the game, once</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b>1 line</b><span>to start it afterwards</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="links">
        <a class="btn" href="../">Home</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#windows">Windows</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#linux">Linux</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="shot">
<pre><span class="c"># once: your folders in config.local.toml, then</span>
<span class="p">$ </span>python -m tools.yw4.ingest
<span class="p">$ </span>python -m recomp.translate
<span class="p">$ </span>python -m tools.yw4.shaders
<span class="p">$ </span>python -m recomp.shader --check
<span class="p">$ </span>python -m recomp.build --run

<span class="c"># every time after that</span>
<span class="p">$ </span>./work/build/yw4</pre>
      <figcaption>The whole build, the same on Windows and Linux</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>

    <article id="before">
      <div class="bar"><span class="q">1</span><h2>Before you start</h2><span class="cat">Both</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="top">
          <div class="prose">
            <p>You need your own copy of <i>Yo-kai Watch 4++</i> with the <b>2.2.0 update</b>, the last one. The
              build checks it and stops on any other version.</p>
            <p><b>Nothing from the game is in the project.</b> The build reads your files and makes the PC
              version on your own computer; none of it is ever shared.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="spec"><dl>
            <dt>Your game</dt><dd>Yo-kai Watch 4++, update 2.2.0</dd>
            <dt>Formats</dt><dd>NSP, XCI, or extracted ExeFS + RomFS</dd>
            <dt>Graphics</dt><dd>Vulkan 1.3</dd>
            <dt>Disk</dt><dd>About 11.4 GB; 20.7 GB at most from NSP or XCI</dd>
          </dl></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article id="config">
      <div class="bar"><span class="q">2</span><h2>Your config</h2><span class="cat">Both</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="top">
          <div class="prose">
            <ol class="steps">
              <li><span><b>Get the code.</b>
<pre>git clone https://github.com/ILFforever/YW4Recomp
cd YW4Recomp</pre></span></li>
              <li><span><b>Make your config.</b> Copy <code>config.example.toml</code> to <code>config.local.toml</code>
                and fill in your folders: <code>exefs_dir</code> and <code>romfs_dir</code> for extracted files, or
                <code>base_nsp</code>, <code>update_nsp</code>, <code>hactool_exe</code> and <code>keys_dir</code>
                for NSP or XCI files (then run <code>python -m tools.yw4.extract</code> once). <code>dlc_dir</code> is your
                DLC folder, if you have it.</span></li>
              <li><span><b>Check it.</b> <code>python tools/yw4/config.py</code> prints your folders, or says what is
                missing.</span></li>
            </ol>
            <p class="note">Keep <code>work_dir</code> out of OneDrive, Dropbox and other synced folders: the build
              writes thousands of files there.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="spec"><dl>
            <dt>Config</dt><dd>config.local.toml, never committed</dd>
            <dt>Output</dt><dd>work/ (your build)</dd>
            <dt>Details</dt><dd><a href="https://github.com/ILFforever/YW4Recomp/blob/master/docs/setup.md">docs/setup.md</a></dd>
          </dl></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article id="windows">
      <div class="bar"><span class="q">3</span><h2>Windows</h2><span class="cat">Build</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="top">
          <div class="prose">
            <p>Easiest: <a href="../launcher/">the launcher</a> takes your files and does every step below for you.
              To build it yourself:</p>
            <ol class="steps">
              <li><span><b>Install the tools.</b> Python 3.11+, Git,
                <a href="https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw">llvm-mingw</a> (Clang 19 or newer) and the
                <a href="https://vulkan.lunarg.com/">Vulkan SDK</a> (for <code>glslangValidator</code>). In your
                config, set <code>[tools] cc</code> to llvm-mingw's <code>clang.exe</code>.</span></li>
              <li><span><b>Build.</b> In PowerShell, from the project folder:
<pre>python -m tools.yw4.ingest
python -m recomp.translate
python -m tools.yw4.shaders
python -m recomp.shader --check
python -m recomp.build --run</pre></span></li>
            </ol>
            <p>SDL3 comes with the build. AMD FSR, NVIDIA DLSS and Streamline are downloaded once (about 550 MB);
              <code>--no-fsr</code> and <code>--no-dlss</code> leave them out.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="spec"><dl>
            <dt>Compiler</dt><dd>llvm-mingw, Clang 19+</dd>
            <dt>Shaders</dt><dd>Vulkan SDK</dd>
            <dt>SDL3</dt><dd>Fetched by the build</dd>
            <dt>Extras</dt><dd>FSR, DLSS, frame generation, Reflex</dd>
          </dl></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article id="linux">
      <div class="bar"><span class="q">4</span><h2>Linux</h2><span class="cat">Build</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="top">
          <div class="prose">
            <ol class="steps">
              <li><span><b>Install the tools</b> from your distribution: Clang 19 or newer (or GCC 15 or newer),
                Python 3.11+, Git, pkg-config, glslang and SDL3 with its headers. For example:
<pre><span class="c"># Arch</span>
sudo pacman -S clang python git pkgconf glslang sdl3
<span class="c"># Fedora</span>
sudo dnf install clang python3 git pkgconf glslang SDL3-devel
<span class="c"># Debian 13, Ubuntu 25.04 or newer</span>
sudo apt install clang python3 git pkg-config glslang-tools libsdl3-dev</pre>
                Set <code>[tools] cc = "clang"</code> in your config (the default is gcc).</span></li>
              <li><span><b>Build</b>, from the project folder:
<pre>python3 -m tools.yw4.ingest
python3 -m recomp.translate
python3 -m tools.yw4.shaders
python3 -m recomp.shader --check
python3 -m recomp.build --run</pre></span></li>
            </ol>
            <p class="note"><b>Ubuntu 24.04</b> has no SDL3 package and an older Clang: install <code>clang-19</code>,
              build <a href="https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases">SDL3</a> with CMake into a folder of your own,
              and build and run with <code>PKG_CONFIG_PATH=&lt;folder&gt;/lib/pkgconfig</code> and
              <code>LD_LIBRARY_PATH=&lt;folder&gt;/lib</code>.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="spec"><dl>
            <dt>Compiler</dt><dd>Clang 19+ or GCC 15+</dd>
            <dt>Graphics</dt><dd>Mesa (RADV, ANV) or NVIDIA's driver</dd>
            <dt>SDL3</dt><dd>From your distribution</dd>
            <dt>Tested</dt><dd>AOSC OS, KDE Plasma (Wayland), RX 6600 XT: about 110–120 frames/s</dd>
            <dt>Not yet</dt><dd>FSR, DLSS, frame generation, Reflex</dd>
          </dl></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article id="play">
      <div class="bar"><span class="q">5</span><h2>Playing</h2><span class="cat">Every day</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="top">
          <div class="prose">
            <p>After the first build, start the game on its own, with no Python and nothing else to type:</p>
<pre>./work/build/yw4          <span class="c"># Linux</span>
.\work\build\yw4.exe      <span class="c"># Windows</span></pre>
            <ul>
              <li>The build wrote your game and DLC folders into <code>work/build/game.ini</code>, which the game
                reads when it starts with no arguments. Rebuilding updates it.</li>
              <li>Saves go to your user folder: <code>~/.local/share/YW4Recomp/save</code> on Linux,
                <code>%APPDATA%\YW4 Recomp\save</code> on Windows.</li>
              <li>After pulling new code, run <code>python -m recomp.translate</code> and
                <code>python -m recomp.build</code> again.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="spec"><dl>
            <dt>Settings</dt><dd>In the game: the in-game overlay</dd>
            <dt>Screenshots</dt><dd>F12</dd>
            <dt>Logs</dt><dd>work/logs/, send it with a bug report</dd>
            <dt>Options</dt><dd><a href="https://github.com/ILFforever/YW4Recomp/blob/master/docs/debugging.md">docs/debugging.md</a></dd>
          </dl></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  </main>
</div>

  <div class="in">

      owners. You need your own copy of the game.</span>

      How each part works: <a href="https://github.com/ILFforever/YW4Recomp/tree/master/docs/decisions">docs/decisions</a>.</span>

<script>
/* the theme switch: the other theme than the one showing, kept for next time */
(() => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('theme'), root = document.documentElement;
  const dark = () => root.dataset.theme ? root.dataset.theme === 'dark' : matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  const label = () => btn.setAttribute('aria-label', dark() ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode');
  label();
  const flip = () => {
    root.dataset.theme = dark() ? 'light' : 'dark';
    try { localStorage.setItem('yw4-theme', root.dataset.theme); } catch (e) {}
    label();
  };
  /* a slow cross-fade between the themes (site.css sets its length), where the browser can do one */
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (document.startViewTransition && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) document.startViewTransition(flip);
    else flip();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
