```py
    """(Rm, index) for integer by-element forms: halfwords use H:L:M and a 4-bit Rm."""
    size, l, mbit, h = bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 21, 21), bits(e, 20, 20), bits(e, 11, 11)
    if size == 1:
        return bits(e, 19, 16), h << 2 | l << 1 | mbit
    if size == 2:
        return mbit << 4 | bits(e, 19, 16), h << 1 | l
    return None


def _by_elem_index(e: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    kind = BY_ELEM.get((bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 15, 12)))
    if kind in ("fmul", "fmla"):
        return _elem_index(e)
    return _int_elem_index(e) if kind else None


def _by_elem_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    kind = BY_ELEM.get((bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 15, 12)))
    if kind is None or _by_elem_index(e) is None:
        return False
    if kind in ("fmul", "fmla"):
        return bool(bits(e, 30, 30)) or bits(e, 23, 22) == 2
    return True


# Advanced SIMD vector x indexed element: 0 Q U 01111 size L M Rm opcode H 0 Rn Rd
@form("simd_by_elem", 0x9F000400, 0x0F000000, valid=_by_elem_valid,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5), (_by_elem_index(e) or (0, 0))[0]))
def _simd_by_elem(e: int) -> str:
    q, size, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    kind = BY_ELEM[(bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 15, 12))]
    m, idx = _by_elem_index(e)
    if kind in ("fmul", "fmla"):
        sz = size & 1
        p, lane = FP[sz][0], LANE[2 + sz]
        srcs = {"n_": n, "m_": m}
        if kind == "fmul" and sz == 0:  # all lanes at once (runtime/include/yw4cpu.h)
            return vec(d, srcs, f"r_ = vf32_mul_elem(n_, m_.s[{idx}], {lanes(q, 2)});")
        if kind == "fmul":
            stmt = f"r_.{lane}[i] = {p}_mul(n_.{lane}[i], k_);"
        else:  # fused, one rounding per lane
            srcs["d_"] = d
            stmt = f"r_.{lane}[i] = {p}_muladd(d_.{lane}[i], n_.{lane}[i], k_);"
        return vec(d, srcs, f"{FP[sz][1]} k_ = m_.{lane}[{idx}]; " + per_lane(lanes(q, 2 + sz), stmt))
    lane, ut, st = LANE[size], UINT[size], SINT[size]
    if kind == "mul":
        return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m},
                   f"{ut} k_ = m_.{lane}[{idx}]; " + per_lane(lanes(q, size), f"r_.{lane}[i] = ({ut})((uint64_t)n_.{lane}[i] * k_);"))
    half, wl, wu, wt = 8 >> size, LANE[size + 1], UINT[size + 1], SINT[size + 1]  # SMLAL(2)
    stmt = f"r_.{wl}[i] = ({wu})(d_.{wl}[i] + ({wu})(({wt})({st})n_.{lane}[{half * q} + i] * ({wt})k_));"
    return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m, "d_": d}, f"{st} k_ = ({st})m_.{lane}[{idx}]; " + per_lane(half, stmt))


# Advanced SIMD scalar x indexed element: 01 U 11111 size L M Rm opcode H 0 Rn Rd   (FMUL only)
@form("simd_scalar_by_elem", 0xDF000400, 0x5F000000,
      valid=lambda e: not bits(e, 29, 29) and bits(e, 15, 12) == 0b1001 and _elem_index(e) is not None,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5), (_elem_index(e) or (0, 0))[0]))
def _simd_scalar_by_elem(e: int) -> str:
    size, n, d = bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    m, idx = _elem_index(e)
    sz = size & 1
    lane = LANE[2 + sz]
    return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, f"r_.{lane}[0] = {FP[sz][0]}_mul(n_.{lane}[0], m_.{lane}[{idx}]);")


# Advanced SIMD scalar three same, FABD only: 01 1 11110 1 sz 1 Rm 11010 1 Rn Rd
@form("simd_scalar_fabd", 0xFFA0FC00, 0x7EA0D400, vregs=_rd_rn_rm)
def _simd_scalar_fabd(e: int) -> str:
    sz, m, n, d = bits(e, 22, 22), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    lane = LANE[2 + sz]
    return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, f"r_.{lane}[0] = {FP[sz][0]}_sub(n_.{lane}[0], m_.{lane}[0]) & ~{sign_bit(sz)};")


# Advanced SIMD scalar pairwise, FADDP only: 01 1 11110 0 sz 11000 01101 10 Rn Rd
@form("simd_scalar_faddp", 0xFFBFFC00, 0x7E30D800, vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_scalar_faddp(e: int) -> str:
    sz, n, d = bits(e, 22, 22), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    lane = LANE[2 + sz]
    return vec(d, {"n_": n}, f"r_.{lane}[0] = {FP[sz][0]}_add(n_.{lane}[0], n_.{lane}[1]);")


# Advanced SIMD scalar two-register misc, SCVTF/UCVTF only: 01 U 11110 0 sz 10000 11101 10 Rn Rd
@form("simd_scalar_cvtf", 0xDFBFFC00, 0x5E21D800, vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_scalar_cvtf(e: int) -> str:
    u, sz, n, d = bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 22, 22), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    w = 32 << sz
    it = ("uint" if u else "int") + f"{w}_t"
    host = "float" if sz == 0 else "double"
    return vwrite(d, sz, f"bits_{FP[sz][0]}(({host})({it})ctx->v[{n}].{LANE[2 + sz]}[0])")


PERMUTE = {1: "uzp1", 2: "trn1", 3: "zip1", 5: "uzp2", 6: "trn2", 7: "zip2"}


# Advanced SIMD permute: 0 Q 001110 size 0 Rm 0 opcode 10 Rn Rd   (UZP/TRN/ZIP)
@form("simd_permute", 0xBF208C00, 0x0E000800, valid=lambda e: bits(e, 14, 12) in PERMUTE and _q_size_ok(e),
      vregs=_rd_rn_rm)
def _simd_permute(e: int) -> str:
    q, size, m, op, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 14, 12), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    lane, count = LANE[size], lanes(q, size)
    h = count // 2
    kind = PERMUTE[op]
    part = 1 if kind.endswith("2") else 0
    if kind.startswith("zip"):
        stmt = f"int j = {part * h} + i / 2; r_.{lane}[i] = (i & 1) ? m_.{lane}[j] : n_.{lane}[j];"
    elif kind.startswith("uzp"):
        stmt = f"int j = 2 * (i % {h}) + {part}; r_.{lane}[i] = i < {h} ? n_.{lane}[j] : m_.{lane}[j];"
    else:
        stmt = f"int j = (i & ~1) + {part}; r_.{lane}[i] = (i & 1) ? m_.{lane}[j] : n_.{lane}[j];"
    return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, per_lane(count, stmt))


def _tbl_vregs(e: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    n, length = bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 14, 13)
    return (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 20, 16)) + tuple((n + k) % 32 for k in range(length + 1))


# Advanced SIMD table lookup: 0 Q 001110 000 Rm 0 len op 00 Rn Rd   (TBL, TBX)
@form("simd_tbl", 0xBFE09C00, 0x0E000000, vregs=_tbl_vregs)
def _simd_tbl(e: int) -> str:
    q, m, length, tbx, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 14, 13), bits(e, 12, 12), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    regs = [(n + k) % 32 for k in range(length + 1)]
    table = " ".join(f"memcpy(t_ + {16 * k}, ctx->v[{r}].b, 16);" for k, r in enumerate(regs))
    size = 16 * len(regs)
    miss = "r_.b[i]" if tbx else "0"
    body = (f"uint8_t t_[{size}]; {table} " +
            per_lane(16 if q else 8, f"r_.b[i] = m_.b[i] < {size} ? t_[m_.b[i]] : {miss};"))
    if tbx and not q:
        body += " r_.d[1] = 0;"
    return vec(d, {"m_": m}, body, keep_d=bool(tbx))


WIDE = {0: "int16_t", 1: "int32_t", 2: "int64_t", 3: "__int128"}


def _shift_imm(e: int) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
    """(esize_log, opcode, raw) for shift-by-immediate: esize from immh's top bit."""
    immh = bits(e, 22, 19)
    if not immh:
        return None
    size = immh.bit_length() - 1
    return size, bits(e, 15, 11), bits(e, 22, 16)


# (U, opcode) -> kind. Narrowing/long forms use immh for the *narrow* element size.
SHIFT_IMM = {(0, 0x00): "sshr", (1, 0x00): "ushr", (0, 0x04): "srshr", (1, 0x04): "urshr",
             (0, 0x0A): "shl", (0, 0x14): "sshll", (1, 0x14): "ushll", (0, 0x13): "sqrshrn",
             (0, 0x10): "shrn", (0, 0x12): "sqshrn", (0, 0x1F): "fcvtzs"}


def _shift_imm_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    s = _shift_imm(e)
    if s is None:
        return False
    size, op, _ = s
    kind = SHIFT_IMM.get((bits(e, 29, 29), op))
    if kind is None:
        return False
    if kind in ("sshll", "ushll", "sqrshrn", "shrn", "sqshrn"):
        return size < 3
    if kind == "fcvtzs":
        return size == 2 or (size == 3 and bool(bits(e, 30, 30)))
    return bool(bits(e, 30, 30)) or size < 3


# Advanced SIMD shift by immediate: 0 Q U 011110 immh immb opcode 1 Rn Rd   (immh != 0)
@form("simd_shift_imm", 0x9F800400, 0x0F000400, valid=_shift_imm_valid, vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_shift_imm(e: int) -> str:
    q, u, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    size, op, raw = _shift_imm(e)
    kind = SHIFT_IMM[(u, op)]
    esize = 8 << size
    lane, ut, st = LANE[size], UINT[size], SINT[size]
    count = lanes(q, size)
    if kind in ("sshr", "ushr", "srshr", "urshr"):
        sh = 2 * esize - raw          # 1..esize
        signed = kind[0] == "s"
        wide = WIDE[size] if signed else ("unsigned __int128" if size == 3 else UINT[size + 1])
        x = f"({wide})({st})n_.{lane}[i]" if signed else f"({wide})n_.{lane}[i]"
        if kind.endswith("rshr"):
            x = f"({x} + (({wide})1 << {sh - 1}))"
        return vec(d, {"n_": n}, per_lane(count, f"r_.{lane}[i] = ({ut})({x} >> {sh});"))
    if kind == "shl":
        sh = raw - esize
        return vec(d, {"n_": n}, per_lane(count, f"r_.{lane}[i] = ({ut})(n_.{lane}[i] << {sh});"))
    if kind in ("sshll", "ushll"):  # widen the low (Q=0) or high (Q=1, SSHLL2) half, then shift
        sh = raw - esize
        half = 8 >> size
        # sign- or zero-extend, then shift as unsigned (a left shift of a negative int is UB in C)
        ext = f"({SINT[size + 1]})({st})" if kind == "sshll" else ""
        src = f"({UINT[size + 1]}){ext}n_.{lane}[{half * q} + i]"
        return vec(d, {"n_": n}, per_lane(half, f"r_.{LANE[size + 1]}[i] = ({UINT[size + 1]})({src} << {sh});"))
    if kind == "fcvtzs":  # to signed fixed point: scale by 2^fbits (exact), then convert toward zero
        fbits = 2 * esize - raw
        host = "(double)f32_of" if size == 2 else "f64_of"
        return vec(d, {"n_": n}, per_lane(count, f"r_.{lane}[i] = ({ut})yw4_to_s{esize}({host}(n_.{lane}[i]) * {float(2 ** fbits)!r}, 'z');"))
    sh = 2 * esize - raw
    half = 8 >> size
    if kind == "shrn":  # SHRN(2): truncating shift right and narrow
        return vec(d, {"n_": n}, per_lane(half, f"r_.{lane}[{half * q} + i] = ({ut})(n_.{LANE[size + 1]}[i] >> {sh});"),
                   keep_d=bool(q))
    # SQRSHRN(2) / SQSHRN(2): signed, (rounding,) saturating shift right and narrow (QC is not modelled)
    lo, hi = -(1 << (esize - 1)), (1 << (esize - 1)) - 1
    rnd = f" + ((__int128)1 << {sh - 1})" if kind == "sqrshrn" else ""
    body = per_lane(half, f"__int128 x_ = ((__int128)({SINT[size + 1]})n_.{LANE[size + 1]}[i]{rnd}) >> {sh}; "
                          f"r_.{lane}[{half * q} + i] = ({ut})({st})(x_ < {lo} ? {lo} : x_ > {hi} ? {hi} : x_);")
    return vec(d, {"n_": n}, body, keep_d=bool(q))


THREE_DIFF = {(0, 0b1100): "smull", (0, 0b1010): "smlsl", (0, 0b1000): "smlal", (1, 0b0001): "uaddw",
              (0, 0b1110): "pmull"}


def _three_diff_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    kind, size = THREE_DIFF.get((bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 15, 12))), bits(e, 23, 22)
    if kind == "pmull":
        return size in (0, 3)  # 8-bit polynomials, or 64-bit (Crypto extension)
    return kind is not None and size < 3


# Advanced SIMD three different: 0 Q U 01110 size 1 Rm opcode 00 Rn Rd
@form("simd_three_diff", 0x9F200C00, 0x0E200000, valid=_three_diff_valid, vregs=_rd_rn_rm)
def _simd_three_diff(e: int) -> str:
    q, size, m, op, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 15, 12), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    kind = THREE_DIFF[(bits(e, 29, 29), op)]
    if kind == "pmull":  # carry-less multiply of the low (Q=0) or high half
        if size == 3:
            body = (f"uint64_t a_ = n_.d[{q}], b_ = m_.d[{q}]; unsigned __int128 p_ = 0; "
                    "for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) if (b_ >> k & 1) p_ ^= (unsigned __int128)a_ << k; "
                    "r_.d[0] = (uint64_t)p_; r_.d[1] = (uint64_t)(p_ >> 64);")
            return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, body)
        stmt = (f"uint16_t a_ = n_.b[{8 * q} + i], p_ = 0; uint8_t b_ = m_.b[{8 * q} + i]; "
                "for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) if (b_ >> k & 1) p_ ^= (uint16_t)(a_ << k); r_.h[i] = p_;")
        return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, per_lane(8, stmt))
    half = 8 >> size
    lane, wl, st, wt = LANE[size], LANE[size + 1], SINT[size], SINT[size + 1]
    if kind == "uaddw":  # wide n + zero-extended half of m
        stmt = f"r_.{wl}[i] = ({UINT[size + 1]})(n_.{wl}[i] + ({UINT[size + 1]})m_.{lane}[{half * q} + i]);"
        return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, per_lane(half, stmt))
    prod = f"({wt})({st})n_.{lane}[{half * q} + i] * ({wt})({st})m_.{lane}[{half * q} + i]"
    if op == 0b1100:  # SMULL
        stmt = f"r_.{wl}[i] = ({UINT[size + 1]})({prod});"
        return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m}, per_lane(half, stmt))
    sign = "+" if kind == "smlal" else "-"
    stmt = f"r_.{wl}[i] = ({UINT[size + 1]})(d_.{wl}[i] {sign} ({UINT[size + 1]})({prod}));"  # SMLAL/SMLSL
    return vec(d, {"n_": n, "m_": m, "d_": d}, per_lane(half, stmt))


def _fp_fixed_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    sf, ftype, rmode, op, scale = bits(e, 31, 31), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 20, 19), bits(e, 18, 16), bits(e, 15, 10)
    if ftype not in FP or (not sf and scale < 32):
        return False
    return (rmode, op) in ((3, 0), (3, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3))


# Conversion between floating-point and fixed-point: sf 0 0 11110 ftype 0 rmode opcode scale Rn Rd
@form("fp_fixed", 0x7F200000, 0x1E000000, valid=_fp_fixed_valid,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0),) if bits(e, 18, 16) in (2, 3) else (bits(e, 9, 5),))
def _fp_fixed(e: int) -> str:
    sf, ftype, op, scale, n, d = bits(e, 31, 31), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 18, 16), bits(e, 15, 10), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    fbits = 64 - scale
    w = 64 if sf else 32
    if op in (0, 1):  # FCVTZS/FCVTZU: scale by 2^fbits (exact in double), then convert toward zero
        src = f"{'(double)f32_of' if ftype == 0 else 'f64_of'}({vread(n, ftype)}) * {float(2 ** fbits)!r}"
        return wr_reg(d, sf, f"({utype(sf)})yw4_to_{'u' if op else 's'}{w}({src}, 'z')") or ";"
    # SCVTF/UCVTF: integer / 2^fbits, one rounding. Dividing the rounded value by a power of two
    # is exact unless it lands in the subnormal range (|result| < 2^-126 for single).
    it = ("uint" if op == 3 else "int") + f"{w}_t"
    host = "float" if ftype == 0 else "double"
    return vwrite(d, ftype, f"bits_{FP[ftype][0]}(({host})(({host})({it}){rd_reg(n, sf)} / {float(2 ** fbits)!r}))")


# Advanced SIMD across lanes: 0 Q U 01110 size 11000 opcode 10 Rn Rd   (ADDV, SMAXV, UADDLV)
ACROSS = {(0, 0x1B): "addv", (0, 0x0A): "smaxv", (1, 0x03): "uaddlv"}


def _across_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    q, u, size, op = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 16, 12)
    return (u, op) in ACROSS and size < 3 and not (size == 2 and not q)


@form("simd_across", 0x9F3E0C00, 0x0E300800, valid=_across_valid, vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_across(e: int) -> str:
    q, u, size, op, n, d = bits(e, 30, 30), bits(e, 29, 29), bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 16, 12), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    kind = ACROSS[(u, op)]
    lane, ut, st, count = LANE[size], UINT[size], SINT[size], lanes(q, size)
    if kind == "addv":
        body = f"{ut} acc_ = 0; " + per_lane(count, f"acc_ = ({ut})(acc_ + n_.{lane}[i]);") + f" r_.{lane}[0] = acc_;"
    elif kind == "smaxv":
        body = (f"{st} acc_ = ({st})n_.{lane}[0]; " + per_lane(count, f"if (({st})n_.{lane}[i] > acc_) acc_ = ({st})n_.{lane}[i];")
                + f" r_.{lane}[0] = ({ut})acc_;")
    else:  # UADDLV: sum into a lane twice as wide
        wu = UINT[size + 1]
        body = f"{wu} acc_ = 0; " + per_lane(count, f"acc_ = ({wu})(acc_ + n_.{lane}[i]);") + f" r_.{LANE[size + 1]}[0] = acc_;"
    return vec(d, {"n_": n}, body)


# Advanced SIMD scalar pairwise, ADDP (D only): 01 0 11110 11 11000 11011 10 Rn Rd
@form("simd_scalar_addp", 0xFFFFFC00, 0x5EF1B800, vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_scalar_addp(e: int) -> str:
    return vec(bits(e, 4, 0), {"n_": bits(e, 9, 5)}, "r_.d[0] = n_.d[0] + n_.d[1];")


def _scalar_shift_valid(e: int) -> bool:
    sh = _shift_imm(e)
    return sh is not None and not bits(e, 29, 29) and sh[1] in (0x12, 0x13) and sh[0] < 3


# Advanced SIMD scalar shift by immediate, SQSHRN/SQRSHRN only: 01 U 111110 immh immb opcode 1 Rn Rd
@form("simd_scalar_shift_imm", 0xDF800400, 0x5F000400, valid=_scalar_shift_valid,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _simd_scalar_shift_imm(e: int) -> str:
    n, d = bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    size, op, raw = _shift_imm(e)
    esize = 8 << size
    sh = 2 * esize - raw
    lo, hi = -(1 << (esize - 1)), (1 << (esize - 1)) - 1
    rnd = f" + ((__int128)1 << {sh - 1})" if op == 0x13 else ""
    body = (f"__int128 x_ = ((__int128)({SINT[size + 1]})n_.{LANE[size + 1]}[0]{rnd}) >> {sh}; "
            f"r_.{LANE[size]}[0] = ({UINT[size]})({SINT[size]})(x_ < {lo} ? {lo} : x_ > {hi} ? {hi} : x_);")
    return vec(d, {"n_": n}, body)


# Crypto AES: 01001110 00 10100 opcode 10 Rn Rd   (runtime/src/crypto.c)
AES = {4: "YW4_AESE", 5: "YW4_AESD", 6: "YW4_AESMC", 7: "YW4_AESIMC"}


@form("crypto_aes", 0xFFFE0C00, 0x4E280800, valid=lambda e: bits(e, 16, 12) in AES,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _crypto_aes(e: int) -> str:
    return f"{{ v128 n_ = ctx->v[{bits(e, 9, 5)}]; yw4_aes({AES[bits(e, 16, 12)]}, &ctx->v[{bits(e, 4, 0)}], &n_); }}"


# Crypto three-register SHA: 01011110 000 Rm 0 opcode 00 Rn Rd
SHA3 = {0: "YW4_SHA1C", 1: "YW4_SHA1P", 2: "YW4_SHA1M", 3: "YW4_SHA1SU0", 4: "YW4_SHA256H", 5: "YW4_SHA256H2",
        6: "YW4_SHA256SU1"}


@form("crypto_sha3", 0xFFE08C00, 0x5E000000, valid=lambda e: bits(e, 14, 12) in SHA3, vregs=_rd_rn_rm)
def _crypto_sha3(e: int) -> str:
    m, n, d = bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    return f"{{ v128 n_ = ctx->v[{n}], m_ = ctx->v[{m}]; yw4_sha({SHA3[bits(e, 14, 12)]}, &ctx->v[{d}], &n_, &m_); }}"


# Crypto two-register SHA: 01011110 00 10100 opcode 10 Rn Rd
SHA2 = {0: "YW4_SHA1H", 1: "YW4_SHA1SU1", 2: "YW4_SHA256SU0"}


@form("crypto_sha2", 0xFFFE0C00, 0x5E280800, valid=lambda e: bits(e, 16, 12) in SHA2,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5)))
def _crypto_sha2(e: int) -> str:
    n, d = bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    return f"{{ v128 n_ = ctx->v[{n}]; yw4_sha({SHA2[bits(e, 16, 12)]}, &ctx->v[{d}], &n_, &n_); }}"


# Floating-point data-processing (3 source): 0 0 0 11111 ftype o1 Rm o0 Ra Rn Rd
#   FMADD a + n*m, FMSUB a - n*m, FNMADD -a - n*m, FNMSUB -a + n*m (fused, operands negated first)
@form("fp_dp3", 0xFF000000, 0x1F000000, valid=_ftype_ok,
      vregs=lambda e: (bits(e, 4, 0), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 14, 10)))
def _fp_dp3(e: int) -> str:
    ftype, o1, m, o0, a, n, d = (bits(e, 23, 22), bits(e, 21, 21), bits(e, 20, 16), bits(e, 15, 15),
                                 bits(e, 14, 10), bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0))
    sb = sign_bit(ftype)
    addend, op1 = vread(a, ftype), vread(n, ftype)
    if o1:
        addend = f"({addend} ^ {sb})"
    if o0 != o1:
        op1 = f"({op1} ^ {sb})"
    return vwrite(d, ftype, f"{FP[ftype][0]}_muladd({addend}, {op1}, {vread(m, ftype)})")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- SIMD structure loads/stores
#
# LD1-LD4 / ST1-ST4 (multiple structures), LD1-LD4 / ST1-ST4 (single lane), LD1R-LD4R, with
# optional post-index (Rm = 31: by the transfer size, else by Xm). Emitted as the
# pseudocode's loop, unrolled at translation time.

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Struct:
    load: bool
    q: int
    n: int
    t: int
    m: int | None        # post-index register (31 = immediate), None = no writeback
    ebytes: int
    selem: int           # registers per structure (LD2 = 2, ...)
    rpt: int             # repetitions (LD1 with 2-4 registers)
    index: int | None    # single-lane forms: the lane
    replicate: bool = False

    @property
    def regs(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        return tuple((self.t + k) % 32 for k in range(self.selem * self.rpt))

    @property
    def nbytes(self) -> int:
        if self.index is not None or self.replicate:
            return self.ebytes * self.selem
        return (16 if self.q else 8) * self.selem * self.rpt


MULTI = {0b0000: (4, 1), 0b0010: (1, 4), 0b0100: (3, 1), 0b0110: (1, 3), 0b0111: (1, 1), 0b1000: (2, 1), 0b1010: (1, 2)}


def _decode_struct(e: int) -> Struct | None:
    q, load, post, single = bits(e, 30, 30), bool(bits(e, 22, 22)), bits(e, 23, 23), bits(e, 24, 24)
    n, t = bits(e, 9, 5), bits(e, 4, 0)
    m = bits(e, 20, 16) if post else None
    if not post and bits(e, 20, 16):
        return None
    if not single:
        if bits(e, 21, 21) or bits(e, 15, 12) not in MULTI:
            return None
        size = bits(e, 11, 10)
        if size == 3 and not q and MULTI[bits(e, 15, 12)][0] != 1:
            return None  # .1d only for LD1/ST1
        selem, rpt = MULTI[bits(e, 15, 12)]
        return Struct(load, q, n, t, m, 1 << size, selem, rpt, None)
    r, opcode, s, size = bits(e, 21, 21), bits(e, 15, 13), bits(e, 12, 12), bits(e, 11, 10)
    selem = ((opcode & 1) << 1 | r) + 1
    scale = opcode >> 1
    if scale == 3:  # LDnR
        if not load or s:
            return None
        return Struct(load, q, n, t, m, 1 << size, selem, 1, None, replicate=True)
    if scale == 0:
        index = q << 3 | s << 2 | size
    elif scale == 1:
        if size & 1:
            return None
        index = q << 2 | s << 1 | size >> 1
    elif size == 0:
        index = q << 1 | s
    elif size == 1 and not s:
        scale, index = 3, q
    else:
        return None
    return Struct(load, q, n, t, m, 1 << scale, selem, 1, index)


def _struct_mem(e: int) -> MemAccess | None:
    st = _decode_struct(e)
    if st is None:
        return None
    return MemAccess(st.n, 0, "post" if st.m is not None else "offset", None, st.load, st.regs, st.ebytes, vec=True)


def _struct_emit(e: int) -> str:
    st = _decode_struct(e)
    lane = LANE[{1: 0, 2: 1, 4: 2, 8: 3}[st.ebytes]]
    w = st.ebytes * 8
    out = [f"uint64_t a = {rd_reg(st.n, 1, sp=True)};"]
    if st.load:  # build the new registers in locals: all reads come from memory
        out += [f"v128 t{k}_ = {'ctx->v[%d]' % r if st.index is not None else '{{0}}'};" for k, r in enumerate(st.regs)]
    off = 0
    if st.index is not None or st.replicate:
        for k in range(st.selem):
            if st.replicate:
                count = (16 if st.q else 8) // st.ebytes
                out.append(f"{{ uint{w}_t x_ = ld{w}(a + {off}); for (int i = 0; i < {count}; i++) t{k}_.{lane}[i] = x_; }}")
            elif st.load:
                out.append(f"t{k}_.{lane}[{st.index}] = ld{w}(a + {off});")
            else:
                out.append(f"st{w}(a + {off}, ctx->v[{st.regs[k]}].{lane}[{st.index}]);")
            off += st.ebytes
    else:
        elements = (16 if st.q else 8) // st.ebytes
        for r in range(st.rpt):
            for el in range(elements):
                for s in range(st.selem):
                    k = r + s  # register index within regs (rpt > 1 implies selem == 1 and vice versa)
                    if st.load:
                        out.append(f"t{k}_.{lane}[{el}] = ld{w}(a + {off});")
                    else:
                        out.append(f"st{w}(a + {off}, ctx->v[{st.regs[k]}].{lane}[{el}]);")
                    off += st.ebytes
    if st.load:
        out += [f"ctx->v[{r}] = t{k}_;" for k, r in enumerate(st.regs)]
    if st.m is not None:
        step = f"{st.nbytes:#x}" if st.m == 31 else rd_reg(st.m, 1)
        out.append(wr_reg(st.n, 1, f"a + {step}", sp=True))
    return "{ " + " ".join(out) + " }"


# Advanced SIMD load/store multiple structures (+ post-index): 0 Q 0011 00 P L 0|1 Rm opcode size Rn Rt
FORMS.append(Form("simd_ldst_multi", 0xBF000000, 0x0C000000, valid=lambda e: _decode_struct(e) is not None,
                  emit=_struct_emit, mem=_struct_mem))
# Advanced SIMD load/store single structure (+ post-index): 0 Q 0011 01 P L R Rm opcode S size Rn Rt
FORMS.append(Form("simd_ldst_single", 0xBF000000, 0x0D000000, valid=lambda e: _decode_struct(e) is not None,
                  emit=_struct_emit, mem=_struct_mem))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- lookup

def find_form(enc: int) -> Form | None:
    for f in FORMS:
        if enc & f.mask == f.value:
            return f
    return None


def lift(enc: int) -> str:
    f = find_form(enc)
    if f is None:
        raise LiftError(f"no form for {enc:08x}")
    if not f.valid(enc):
        raise LiftError(f"{enc:08x} is unallocated in form {f.name}")
    return f.emit(enc)
```

`recomp/overrides.toml`:

```toml
# Recompiled functions replaced by native runtime code (decision 0016).
#
# The function at the symbol's address keeps its name (s_<offset> / f_<offset>) but its
# body becomes a call to `native`, so every caller reaches the native code: direct calls,
# calls through the PLT, function pointers. Natives follow the AArch64 calling convention
# on the CPUState (arguments in x0-x7 / v0-v7, result in x0 / v0). Only symbol names live
# here, never game code. Each entry says why it is native.

# NVN, the graphics API, is implemented natively on Vulkan (decision 0005). The sdk's own
# NVN driver, which writes Maxwell GPU commands through nvdrv, never runs.
[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "nvnBootstrapLoader"
native = "yw4_nvn_BootstrapLoader"
why = "NVN's only entry point: returns our native NVN functions"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvm"
native = "yw4_nv_InitializeGraphics"
why = "nv::InitializeGraphics(memory, size) starts the sdk's GPU driver (nvdrv); our NVN needs no driver"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nv16FinalizeGraphicsEv"
native = "yw4_nv_FinalizeGraphics"
why = "the counterpart of nv::InitializeGraphics"

# nn::vi, the display: on the Switch the NVN driver presents through vi's layers and the
# Android-style "binder" buffer queue behind them. Our NVN presents itself, so the game's
# display calls only need to hand back objects and the vsync event (decision 0017).
[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi10InitializeEv"
native = "yw4_vi_Initialize"
why = "nn::vi::Initialize: connects to the display services, which our NVN doesn't use"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi8FinalizeEv"
native = "yw4_vi_Finalize"
why = "counterpart of nn::vi::Initialize"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi18OpenDefaultDisplayEPPNS0_7DisplayE"
native = "yw4_vi_OpenDefaultDisplay"
why = "a display object for the calls below"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi12CloseDisplayEPNS0_7DisplayE"
native = "yw4_vi_CloseDisplay"
why = "counterpart of OpenDefaultDisplay"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi11CreateLayerEPPNS0_5LayerEPNS0_7DisplayEii"
native = "yw4_vi_CreateLayer"
why = "a layer object: on the Switch, the compositor surface NVN's window presents to"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi12DestroyLayerEPNS0_5LayerE"
native = "yw4_vi_DestroyLayer"
why = "counterpart of CreateLayer"

[[override]]

symbol = "_ZN2nn2vi15GetNativeWindowEPPvPNS0_5LayerE"

[[override]]
module = "sdk"

native = "yw4_vi_GetDisplayVsyncEvent"
why = "the vsync event, signalled at 60 Hz by a host thread"

# Guest functions native code calls, by name (yw4_guest_symbol() in the runtime).
[[guest_symbol]]
module = "sdk"
symbol = "_ZN2nn2os33AttachReadableHandleToSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeEjbNS0_14EventClearModeE"

# nn::swkbd, the software keyboard: a library applet on the Switch, which we don't have.
# The player types the answer in the overlay's popup (names, passwords); replays answer at once (swkbd.c).
[[override]]

# The C library's memory and string basics: the recompiled versions run the ARM code word
```

`recomp/pi/funcrun.c`:

```c
// Runs whole test functions (tests/functest/) natively on the ARM64 reference machine.
//
//   funcrun <image.bin>
//
// Input line (hex):   <function offset> <a0> <a1> <a2> <a3> <inmask>
// Output line (hex):  <function offset> <x0 result> <memory changes>
//
// The image is the flat test image (code at offset 0). Arguments set in inmask are
// offsets into the scratch buffer and get its address added (testcase.h).
//
// Build on the Pi: gcc -O1 -o funcrun funcrun.c

#include <sys/mman.h>

#include "testcase.h"

typedef uint64_t (*TestFn)(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: funcrun <image.bin>\n");
        return 1;
    }
    FILE *img = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!img) {
        perror(argv[1]);
        return 1;
    }
    size_t cap = 1 << 22;
    uint8_t *base = mmap(NULL, cap, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC,
                         MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    if (base == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("mmap");
        return 1;
    }
    size_t len = fread(base, 1, cap, img);
    fclose(img);
    __builtin___clear_cache((char *)base, (char *)base + len);
    test_mem_init();
    uint64_t mem = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)test_mem;

    char line[512];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
        char *p = line;
        uint64_t off = strtoull(p, &p, 16), a[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) a[i] = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
        uint64_t inmask = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            if (inmask >> i & 1) a[i] += mem;
        uint64_t r = ((TestFn)(base + off))(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3]);
        printf("%" PRIx64 " %" PRIx64 " ", off, r);
        test_write_mem(stdout);
    }
    return 0;
}

```

`recomp/pi/harness.c`:

```c
// Golden-result harness: runs ARM64 test instructions natively on the Pi 5.
//
// Reads test cases on stdin and writes results on stdout, one line each
// (format and memory handling: testcase.h).
//
// Build on the Pi: gcc -O1 -o harness harness.c trampoline.S

#include <sys/mman.h>

#include "testcase.h"

extern const uint32_t tramp_start[], tramp_slot[], tramp_end[];

int main(void) {
    size_t len = (size_t)((const char *)tramp_end - (const char *)tramp_start);
    size_t slot = (size_t)(tramp_slot - tramp_start);
    uint32_t *page = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC,
                          MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    if (page == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("mmap");
        return 1;
    }
    memcpy(page, tramp_start, len);
    void (*run)(TestState *) = (void (*)(TestState *))page;
    test_mem_init();
    uint64_t base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)test_mem;

    TestState s;
    uint32_t enc;
    uint64_t inmask, outmask;
    while (test_read(stdin, &enc, &s, &inmask, &outmask)) {
        page[slot] = enc;
        __builtin___clear_cache((char *)page, (char *)page + len);
        test_rebase(&s, inmask, base);
        run(&s);
        test_rebase(&s, outmask, 0 - base);
        test_write(stdout, enc, &s);
    }
    return 0;
}

```

`recomp/pi/testcase.h`:

```h
/* Test-case I/O shared by the Pi harness (harness.c) and the host checker (recomp/check.py).
 *
 * Input line, all hex:   <enc> <x0> ... <x30> <sp> <nzcv> <v0> ... <v31> <fpcr> <inmask> <outmask>
 * Output line, all hex:  <enc> <x0> ... <x30> <sp> <nzcv> <v0> ... <v31> <memory changes>
 *
 * Each v register is 32 hex digits, high half first. v31 is printed as 0: the harness
 * uses it to park its own state, so SIMD tests never use v31. FPSR (cumulative exception
 * flags) is not compared; main never reads it.
 *
 * Memory: both machines have a TEST_MEM_SIZE scratch buffer filled with the same byte
 * pattern. Registers set in inmask (bit n = xn, bit 31 = SP) hold offsets into the buffer;
 * the buffer's address is added to them before the instruction runs and subtracted from
 * the registers in outmask afterwards. That way the results don't depend on where each
 * machine put its buffer. Memory changes are "<offset>:<byte>" pairs joined by commas,
 * or "-" for none; the buffer is reset after each case.
 */
#ifndef TESTCASE_H
#define TESTCASE_H

#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define TEST_MEM_SIZE 0x20000  /* must match MEM_SIZE in recomp/golden.py */

/* Layout must match trampoline.S. */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t x[31];     /* 0x000 */
    uint64_t sp;        /* 0x0F8 */
    uint64_t nzcv;      /* 0x100 */
    uint64_t pad;       /* 0x108 */
    uint64_t v[32][2];  /* 0x110  [lo, hi] */
    uint64_t fpcr;      /* 0x310 */
    uint64_t fpsr;      /* 0x318 */
    uint64_t host_sp;   /* 0x320  harness use only */
} TestState;

static uint8_t test_mem[TEST_MEM_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(64)));
static uint8_t test_mem_ref[TEST_MEM_SIZE];

static void test_mem_init(void) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < TEST_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
        uint32_t h = i * 2654435761u;
        test_mem_ref[i] = (uint8_t)(h >> 24) ^ (uint8_t)i;
    }
    memcpy(test_mem, test_mem_ref, TEST_MEM_SIZE);
}

__attribute__((unused)) static void test_rebase(TestState *s, uint64_t mask, uint64_t delta) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++)
        if (mask >> i & 1) s->x[i] += delta;
    if (mask >> 31 & 1) s->sp += delta;
}

/* Returns 0 at end of input. */
__attribute__((unused)) static int test_read(FILE *f, uint32_t *enc, TestState *s, uint64_t *inmask, uint64_t *outmask) {
    char line[4096];
    if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) return 0;
    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
    char *p = line;
    *enc = (uint32_t)strtoul(p, &p, 16);
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) s->x[i] = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    s->sp = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    s->nzcv = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        while (*p == ' ') p++;
        char hi[17] = {0};
        memcpy(hi, p, 16);
        s->v[i][1] = strtoull(hi, NULL, 16);
        s->v[i][0] = strtoull(p + 16, &p, 16);
    }
    s->fpcr = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    *inmask = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    *outmask = strtoull(p, &p, 16);
    return 1;
}

/* Prints the changed buffer bytes ("-" if none) and resets them. */
static void test_write_mem(FILE *f) {
    int any = 0;
    for (uint32_t c = 0; c < TEST_MEM_SIZE; c += 64) {
        if (!memcmp(test_mem + c, test_mem_ref + c, 64)) continue;
        for (uint32_t i = c; i < c + 64; i++) {
            if (test_mem[i] == test_mem_ref[i]) continue;
            fprintf(f, "%s%" PRIx32 ":%02x", any ? "," : "", i, test_mem[i]);
            test_mem[i] = test_mem_ref[i];
            any = 1;
        }
    }
    fprintf(f, "%s\n", any ? "" : "-");
}

__attribute__((unused)) static void test_write(FILE *f, uint32_t enc, const TestState *s) {
    fprintf(f, "%08" PRIx32, enc);
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) fprintf(f, " %" PRIx64, s->x[i]);
    fprintf(f, " %" PRIx64 " %" PRIx64, s->sp, s->nzcv);
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) fprintf(f, " %016" PRIx64 "%016" PRIx64, s->v[i][1], s->v[i][0]);
    fprintf(f, " %032x ", 0);
    test_write_mem(f);
}

#endif

```

`recomp/pi/trampoline.S`:

```S
// Run one test instruction with a full register file loaded from memory.
//
//   void run_case(TestState *s)   (s in x0)
//
// TestState layout (must match testcase.h):
//   0x000  x[31]   x0..x30
//   0x0F8  sp
//   0x100  nzcv    flags in bits 31..28
//   0x110  v[32]   v0..v31, 16 bytes each
//   0x310  fpcr
//   0x318  fpsr
//   0x320  host_sp (the harness's own SP while the test runs)
//
// The harness copies this whole routine into an executable page and patches
// the word at `slot` with the instruction under test. The test instruction
// must not branch.
//
// SP is a test register too, so the host stack is not usable while the test
// runs. The host SP is saved in the state block, and the state pointer is
// parked in v31 (d[0]; the test's x0 goes to d[1] afterwards). Tests must
// therefore never use v31; its result is not compared.

    .text
    .global tramp_start, tramp_slot, tramp_end
    .p2align 2
tramp_start:
    // Save callee-saved registers (x19-x28, d8-d15) and the frame.
    stp x29, x30, [sp, #-160]!
    stp x19, x20, [sp, #16]
    stp x21, x22, [sp, #32]
    stp x23, x24, [sp, #48]
    stp x25, x26, [sp, #64]
    stp x27, x28, [sp, #80]
    stp d8, d9, [sp, #96]
    stp d10, d11, [sp, #112]
    stp d12, d13, [sp, #128]
    stp d14, d15, [sp, #144]
    mov x1, sp
    str x1, [x0, #0x320]         // host SP
    fmov d31, x0                 // state pointer

    ldr x1, [x0, #0x100]
    msr nzcv, x1
    ldr x1, [x0, #0x310]
    msr fpcr, x1
    ldr x1, [x0, #0x318]
    msr fpsr, x1
    ldr x1, [x0, #0xF8]
    mov sp, x1
    add x1, x0, #0x110
    ldp q0, q1, [x1, #0x000]
    ldp q2, q3, [x1, #0x020]
    ldp q4, q5, [x1, #0x040]
    ldp q6, q7, [x1, #0x060]
    ldp q8, q9, [x1, #0x080]
    ldp q10, q11, [x1, #0x0A0]
    ldp q12, q13, [x1, #0x0C0]
    ldp q14, q15, [x1, #0x0E0]
    ldp q16, q17, [x1, #0x100]
    ldp q18, q19, [x1, #0x120]
    ldp q20, q21, [x1, #0x140]
    ldp q22, q23, [x1, #0x160]
    ldp q24, q25, [x1, #0x180]
    ldp q26, q27, [x1, #0x1A0]
    ldp q28, q29, [x1, #0x1C0]
    ldr q30, [x1, #0x1E0]
    ldp x1, x2, [x0, #0x08]
    ldp x3, x4, [x0, #0x18]
    ldp x5, x6, [x0, #0x28]
    ldp x7, x8, [x0, #0x38]
    ldp x9, x10, [x0, #0x48]
    ldp x11, x12, [x0, #0x58]
    ldp x13, x14, [x0, #0x68]
    ldp x15, x16, [x0, #0x78]
    ldp x17, x18, [x0, #0x88]
    ldp x19, x20, [x0, #0x98]
    ldp x21, x22, [x0, #0xA8]
    ldp x23, x24, [x0, #0xB8]
    ldp x25, x26, [x0, #0xC8]
    ldp x27, x28, [x0, #0xD8]
    ldp x29, x30, [x0, #0xE8]
    ldr x0, [x0, #0x00]          // x0 last: it was the base register

tramp_slot:
    nop                          // patched with the instruction under test

    mov v31.d[1], x0             // free x0 to hold the state pointer again
    fmov x0, d31
    stp x1, x2, [x0, #0x08]
    stp x3, x4, [x0, #0x18]
    stp x5, x6, [x0, #0x28]
    stp x7, x8, [x0, #0x38]
    stp x9, x10, [x0, #0x48]
    stp x11, x12, [x0, #0x58]
    stp x13, x14, [x0, #0x68]
    stp x15, x16, [x0, #0x78]
    stp x17, x18, [x0, #0x88]
    stp x19, x20, [x0, #0x98]
    stp x21, x22, [x0, #0xA8]
    stp x23, x24, [x0, #0xB8]
    stp x25, x26, [x0, #0xC8]
    stp x27, x28, [x0, #0xD8]
    stp x29, x30, [x0, #0xE8]
    mov x1, sp
    str x1, [x0, #0xF8]
    mrs x1, nzcv
    str x1, [x0, #0x100]
    mrs x1, fpcr
    str x1, [x0, #0x310]
    mrs x1, fpsr
    str x1, [x0, #0x318]
    add x1, x0, #0x110
    stp q0, q1, [x1, #0x000]
    stp q2, q3, [x1, #0x020]
    stp q4, q5, [x1, #0x040]
    stp q6, q7, [x1, #0x060]
    stp q8, q9, [x1, #0x080]
    stp q10, q11, [x1, #0x0A0]
    stp q12, q13, [x1, #0x0C0]
    stp q14, q15, [x1, #0x0E0]
    stp q16, q17, [x1, #0x100]
    stp q18, q19, [x1, #0x120]
    stp q20, q21, [x1, #0x140]
    stp q22, q23, [x1, #0x160]
    stp q24, q25, [x1, #0x180]
    stp q26, q27, [x1, #0x1A0]
    stp q28, q29, [x1, #0x1C0]
    str q30, [x1, #0x1E0]
    mov x1, v31.d[1]             // the test's x0 result
    str x1, [x0, #0x00]
    ldr x1, [x0, #0x320]
    mov sp, x1                   // host stack back
    mov x1, xzr
    msr fpcr, x1                 // host FP mode back (the C ABI expects the default)

    ldp d8, d9, [sp, #96]
    ldp d10, d11, [sp, #112]
    ldp d12, d13, [sp, #128]
    ldp d14, d15, [sp, #144]
    ldp x19, x20, [sp, #16]
    ldp x21, x22, [sp, #32]
    ldp x23, x24, [sp, #48]
    ldp x25, x26, [sp, #64]
    ldp x27, x28, [sp, #80]
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #160
    ret
tramp_end:

```

`recomp/shader.py`:

```py
"""Translate the game's NV_gpu_program5 assembly to GLSL for Vulkan (decision 0020).

    python -m recomp.shader [--check] [key ...]

Reads <work_dir>/shaders/asm/<key>.<stage>.asm (from `python -m tools.yw4.shaders`),
writes <work_dir>/shaders/glsl/<key>.<stage> and <key>.json (what the shader binds).
--check compiles every output with glslangValidator (Vulkan SDK) to SPIR-V.

The model follows the assembly closely, so a line of output can be traced to a line
of input (each instruction is emitted as a comment above its GLSL):

- Registers have no type in the assembly: an instruction's suffix (.F/.F32/.F16, .S,
  .U) says how it reads them. Every temporary (R, H, and the H/R condition temps) is a
  `uvec4` of raw bits; operands are reinterpreted per instruction (`uintBitsToFloat`).
  H registers are fp16 on the Switch; here they are fp32 (precision may differ).
- D registers (64-bit) only ever hold texture handles loaded with
  `LDC.U64 Dn.c, buf14[k]`. buf14 is where NVN puts bound textures' handles, so the
  handle is texture binding k/8; D registers never appear in the output.
- Constant buffers are `uvec4 d[4096]` uniform blocks addressed by byte offset (the
  assembly's `bufN[R0.x + 16]`): offsets are multiples of the load size (spec), so an
  X4 load is one array element.
- The condition code (written by `.CC` instructions) is only ever tested with NE, so
  it is kept as `bvec4 cc` = "written value != 0" for the components written.
- Control flow is structured (IF/ELSE/ENDIF, REP/ENDREP, BRK) and maps 1:1.

Vulkan interface (the runtime builds its descriptor layouts from <key>.json):
- descriptor set = stage (vertex 0, fragment 1, geometry 2; compute 0)
- constant buffer slot n -> binding n; texture slot k -> binding 16 + k;
  storage buffer n -> binding 64 + n (texture slots reach 32)
- vertex input / varying / colour output n -> location n. Varyings are vec4; integer
  data is carried as float bits (fragment inputs read as integers are `flat`).
- Push constant `yw4.pos_fix` (vertex and geometry): bit 0 (vertex) or bit 1 (geometry)
  maps the stage's clip-space z from OpenGL's [-w, w] to Vulkan's [0, w] (NVN's default
  depth mode). The runtime sets the bit of the last stage before rasterisation only. Y
  orientation is left to the viewport.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import time
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from tools.yw4 import config, progress

SET = {"vert": 0, "frag": 1, "geom": 2, "comp": 0}
TEX_BINDING, STORAGE_BINDING = 16, 64
# Soft shadows (yw4_shadow below): the shadow map's raw depth at DEPTH_BINDING + slot, the
# runtime's settings at PCSS_BINDING.
DEPTH_BINDING, PCSS_BINDING = 96, 95
# The shaders that get yw4_shadow: only the game's screen-space shadow mask (a full-screen pass
# at half resolution that shadows everything in the G-buffer). The helper is copied into every
# lookup by the driver, and in all ~200 shadow shaders that made pipeline builds take up to 25 s
# each; the other shaders keep the game's own lookups. Keys are hashes of the game's shaders.
PCSS_SHADERS = {"06d03ad703b4bee5"}
SWZ = "xyzw"
GLSL_TYPE = {"f": "vec4", "u": "uvec4", "s": "ivec4"}


class ShaderError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Operand:
    text: str
    neg: bool = False
    abs: bool = False
    swizzle: str = "xyzw"   # always 4 components (NV rule: a short swizzle repeats its last)


@dataclass
class Program:
    key: str
    stage: str
    regs: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    arrays: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)              # lmemN -> element count
    images: dict[int, str] = field(default_factory=dict)              # slot -> dim
    written_storage: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
    input_locs: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)                 # every input read
    alias: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)   # name -> (base, first index)
    cbuffers: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)            # name -> slot
    storage: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    shared: str | None = None
    shared_size: int = 0
    group_size: list[int] = field(default_factory=lambda: [1, 1, 1])
    gs: dict[str, str | int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    handles: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)             # "D0.x" -> texture slot
    textures: dict[int, str] = field(default_factory=dict)            # slot -> dim
    depth_reads: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)                # shadow map slots read via yw4_shadow
    inputs: dict[int, str] = field(default_factory=dict)              # location -> "f" / "u"
    flat_inputs: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
    outputs: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
    colors: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
    used_cbuffers: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
    cbuffer_rows: dict[int, set[int]] = field(default_factory=dict)   # slot -> 16-byte rows read by a constant address
    cbuffer_computed: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)           # slots also read at a computed address
    uses: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    body: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    depth: int = 1


def split_args(s: str) -> list[str]:
    """Split on commas outside {}, [] and ()."""
    out, cur, nest = [], "", 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch in "{[(":
            nest += 1
        elif ch in "}])":
            nest -= 1
        if ch == "," and nest == 0:
            out.append(cur.strip())
            cur = ""
        else:
            cur += ch
    if cur.strip():
        out.append(cur.strip())
    return out


def balanced(s: str) -> bool:
    depth = 0
    for ch in s:
        depth += {"(": 1, ")": -1}.get(ch, 0)
        if depth < 0:
            return False
    return depth == 0


def paren(e: str) -> str:
    """`e` safe to follow with a swizzle: names and single calls as they are, else (e)."""
    if re.fullmatch(r"[\w.\[\]]+", e):
        return e
    m = re.fullmatch(r"\w+\((.*)\)(\.[xyzw]+)?", e)
    if m and balanced(m.group(1)):
        return e
    return f"({e})"


def parse_operand(text: str) -> Operand:
    op = Operand(text)
    t = text.strip()
    if t.startswith("-"):
        op.neg, t = True, t[1:].strip()
    if t.startswith("|"):
        end = t.rindex("|")
        op.abs = True
        t = t[1:end] + t[end + 1:]
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*?)\.([xyzw]{1,4})", t)
    if m and not m.group(1).endswith(("vertex", "fragment", "result")):
        t, s = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        op.swizzle = (s + s[-1] * 4)[:4]
    op.text = t
    return op


def literal(values: list[str], typ: str) -> str:
    vals = []
    for v in values:
        v = v.strip()
        if typ == "f":
            if v.lower().startswith(("0x", "-0x")):
                raise ShaderError(f"hex literal {v} in a float operation")
            x = float(v)
            vals.append(repr(x) if "e" not in repr(x) else f"{x:.9e}")
        else:
            x = int(v, 0) if not re.search(r"[.eE]", v) or v.lower().startswith("0x") else None
            if x is None:
                raise ShaderError(f"float literal {v} in an integer operation")
            if typ == "u":
                vals.append(f"{x & 0xFFFFFFFF}u")
            else:
                x = x & 0xFFFFFFFF
                vals.append(str(x - (1 << 32) if x >= 1 << 31 else x))
    while len(vals) < 4:
        vals.append(vals[-1])
    return f"{GLSL_TYPE[typ]}({', '.join(vals)})"


def convert(expr: str, frm: str, to: str) -> str:
    if frm == to:
        return expr
    # Undo a reinterpretation instead of stacking a second one.
    inverse = {("u", "f"): "floatBitsToUint(", ("f", "u"): "uintBitsToFloat("}.get((frm, to))
    if inverse and expr.startswith(inverse) and expr.endswith(")") and balanced(expr[len(inverse):-1]):
        return expr[len(inverse):-1]
    return {("u", "f"): "uintBitsToFloat({})", ("s", "f"): "intBitsToFloat({})",
            ("f", "u"): "floatBitsToUint({})", ("f", "s"): "floatBitsToInt({})",
            ("u", "s"): "ivec4({})", ("s", "u"): "uvec4({})"}[(frm, to)].format(expr)


class Translator:
    def __init__(self, key: str, stage: str, text: str):
        self.p = Program(key, stage)
        self.lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split(";")]
        self.text = text

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- declarations
    def declare(self, ln: str) -> bool:
        p = self.p
        if ln.startswith(("!!NV", "OPTION ")) or ln == "":
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:SHORT |LONG )?TEMP (.+)", ln)
        if m:
            for r in (x.strip() for x in m.group(1).split(",")):
                a = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\[(\d+)\]", r)
                if a:
                    p.arrays[a.group(1)] = int(a.group(2))
                elif ln.startswith("LONG"):
                    if not r.startswith("D"):
                        raise ShaderError(f"LONG temp {r}")
                elif r != "T":
                    p.regs.append(r)
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"CBUFFER (\w+)\[\] = \{ program\.buffer\[(\d+)\] \}", ln)
        if m:
            p.cbuffers[m.group(1)] = int(m.group(2))
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"STORAGE (\w+)\[\] = \{ program\.storage\[(\d+)\] \}", ln)
        if m:
            p.storage[m.group(1)] = int(m.group(2))
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"SHARED (\w+)\[\] = \{ program\.sharedmem \}", ln)
        if m:
            p.shared = m.group(1)
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(FLAT )?(ATTRIB|OUTPUT) (\w+)(\[\])? = \{? ?([\w.]+)(?:\[(\d+)(?:\.\.(\d+))?\])? ?\}?", ln)
        if m:
            first = int(m.group(6) or 0)
            p.alias[m.group(3)] = (m.group(5), first)
            if m.group(1):
                p.flat_inputs.update(range(first, int(m.group(7) or first) + 1))
            return True
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(FLAT )?ATTRIB (\w+) = (\w+\.attrib)\[(\d+)\]", ln)
        if m:
            p.alias[m.group(2)] = (m.group(3), int(m.group(4)))
            if m.group(1):
                p.flat_inputs.add(int(m.group(4)))
            return True
        if ln.startswith(("GROUP_SIZE ", "SHARED_MEMORY ", "PRIMITIVE_IN ", "PRIMITIVE_OUT ", "VERTICES_OUT ")):
            w = ln.split()
            if w[0] == "GROUP_SIZE":
                p.group_size[:len(w) - 1] = [int(x) for x in w[1:]]
            elif w[0] == "SHARED_MEMORY":
                p.shared_size = int(w[1])
            else:
                p.gs[w[0]] = w[1] if w[0] != "VERTICES_OUT" else int(w[1])
            return True
        return False

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- operands
    def resolve(self, name: str) -> tuple[str, int | None]:
        """'vertex_attrib[3]' -> ('vertex.attrib', 3); 'R0' -> ('R0', None)."""
        m = re.fullmatch(r"([\w.]+?)(?:\[(\d+)\])?", name)
        if not m:
            return name, None
        base, idx = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if base in self.p.alias:
            b, first = self.p.alias[base]
            return b, first + int(idx) if idx is not None else first
        return base, int(idx) if idx is not None else None

    def read(self, op: Operand, typ: str) -> str:
        """A 4-component operand as a GLSL expression of type `typ`."""
        p, t = self.p, op.text
        swz = "." + op.swizzle
        if t.startswith("{"):
            e = literal(split_args(t[1:-1]), typ)
            e = e + swz if op.swizzle != "xyzw" else e
        else:
            e, nat = self.source(t)
            e = convert(e + swz if op.swizzle != "xyzw" else e, nat, typ)
        if op.abs:
            e = f"abs({e})"
        if op.neg:
            e = f"(-{e})"
        return e

    def source(self, t: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        p = self.p
        m = re.fullmatch(r"vertex\[(\d+)\]\.(position|attrib\[(\d+)\])", t)
        if m:
            if m.group(2) == "position":
                return "gl_in[%s].gl_Position" % m.group(1), "f"
            loc = int(m.group(3))
            p.input_locs.add(loc)
            return f"i_attr{loc}[{m.group(1)}]", "f"
        base, idx = self.resolve(t)
        if base in p.regs:
            return base, "u"
        if base in ("vertex.attrib", "fragment.attrib") or base == "vertex.position":
            loc = 0 if base == "vertex.position" else idx
            if p.stage == "geom":
                raise ShaderError(f"geometry input without vertex index: {t}")
            # Vertex inputs are declared by how they are read; varyings are always vec4 and
            # integer reads reinterpret their bits.
            p.input_locs.add(loc)
            if p.stage == "vert":
                return f"a{loc}", self.known_inputs.get(loc, "f")
            return f"i_attr{loc}", "f"
        if base == "fragment.position":
            return "gl_FragCoord", "f"
        if base == "fragment.facing":
            # +1.0 front, -1.0 back; integer reads see the float's bits (sign intact).
            return "vec4(gl_FrontFacing ? 1.0 : -1.0)", "f"
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(lmem\d+)\[(.+)\]", t)
        if m and m.group(1) in p.arrays:
            return f"{m.group(1)}[{self.array_index(m.group(2))}]", "u"
        if base == "vertex.instance":
            p.uses.add("instance")
            return "ivec4(gl_InstanceIndex - gl_BaseInstance)", "s"
        if base.startswith("invocation."):
            v = {"globalid": "gl_GlobalInvocationID", "groupid": "gl_WorkGroupID",
                 "localid": "gl_LocalInvocationID"}.get(base[11:])
            if base[11:] == "localindex":
                return "uvec4(gl_LocalInvocationIndex)", "u"
            if v:
                return f"uvec4({v}, 0u)", "u"
        raise ShaderError(f"unknown operand {t!r}")

    def attr_type(self, op: Operand, typ: str) -> None:
        """Record how a vertex input / varying is read (float or integer)."""
        if op.text.startswith("{"):
            return
        base, idx = self.resolve(op.text)
        if base in ("vertex.attrib", "fragment.attrib", "vertex.position"):
            loc = 0 if base == "vertex.position" else idx
            want = "f" if typ == "f" else "u"
            old = self.p.inputs.get(loc)
            if old and old != want and self.p.stage == "vert":
                raise ShaderError(f"vertex input {loc} read as both float and integer")
            self.p.inputs[loc] = "u" if "u" in (old, want) else "f"
            if want == "u" and self.p.stage == "frag":
                self.p.flat_inputs.add(loc)

    def operand(self, op: Operand, typ: str) -> str:
        self.attr_type(op, typ)
        return self.read(op, typ)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- destinations
    def dest(self, text: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
        """(GLSL lvalue, its type, write mask)."""
        p = self.p
        mask = "xyzw"
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*?)\.([xyzw]{1,4})", text)
        if m and not m.group(1).endswith(("result", "vertex")):
            text, mask = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(lmem\d+)\[(.+)\]", text)
        if m and m.group(1) in p.arrays:
            return f"{m.group(1)}[{self.array_index(m.group(2))}]", "u", mask
        base, idx = self.resolve(text)
        if base in p.regs:
            return base, "u", mask
        if base == "result.attrib":
            p.outputs.add(idx)
            return f"o_attr{idx}", "f", mask
        if base == "result.color":
            idx = idx or 0
            p.colors.add(idx)
            return f"o_color{idx}", "f", mask
        if base == "result.position":
            return "gl_Position", "f", mask
        if base == "result.depth":
            if mask != "z":
                raise ShaderError("result.depth written other than .z")
            return "gl_FragDepth", "f1", "x"
        raise ShaderError(f"unknown destination {text!r}")

    def emit(self, s: str) -> None:
        self.p.body.append("    " * self.p.depth + s)

    def store(self, dst: str, expr: str, typ: str, cc: bool, sat: bool = False) -> None:
        # A conditional write (`R0.z (EQ.x)`) only changes components whose test passes.
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*?)\s*\(([A-Z]{2}(?:\.[xyzw]+)?)\)", dst)
        when = None
        if m:
            dst, when = m.group(1), self.cond(m.group(2), vector=True)
            if cc:
                raise ShaderError("conditional write that also sets the condition code")
        lv, dtyp, mask = self.dest(dst)
        if sat:
            if typ != "f":
                raise ShaderError(".SAT on an integer operation")
            expr = f"clamp({expr}, 0.0, 1.0)"
        if cc:
            self.emit(f"t{typ} = {expr};")
            expr = f"t{typ}"
            zero = {"f": "vec4(0.0)", "u": "uvec4(0u)", "s": "ivec4(0)"}[typ]
        if dtyp == "f1":
            if when:
                raise ShaderError("conditional depth write")
            self.emit(f"gl_FragDepth = {paren(convert(expr, typ, 'f'))}.z;")
        elif when:
            self.emit(f"{lv}.{mask} = mix({lv}, {convert(expr, typ, dtyp)}, {when}).{mask};")
        else:
            v = convert(expr, typ, dtyp)
            self.emit(f"{lv}.{mask} = {paren(v)}.{mask};" if mask != "xyzw" else f"{lv} = {v};")
        if cc:
            self.emit(f"cc.{mask} = notEqual({expr}, {zero}).{mask};")

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- instructions
    def cbuffer_load(self, args: list[str], fmt: str, sat: bool, cc: bool) -> None:
        p = self.p
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\[(.+)\]", args[1])
        if not m or m.group(1) not in p.cbuffers:
            raise ShaderError(f"LDC from {args[1]}")
        slot = p.cbuffers[m.group(1)]
        addr = m.group(2).replace(" ", "")
        if fmt == "U64":
            if slot != 14 or not addr.isdigit() or int(addr) % 8:
                raise ShaderError(f"64-bit load not a texture handle: {args[1]}")
            p.handles[args[0]] = int(addr) // 8
            return
        if slot == 14:
            raise ShaderError("non-handle load from buf14")
        p.used_cbuffers.add(slot)
        size = {"F32": 4, "U32": 4, "S32": 4, "F32X2": 8, "U32X2": 8, "S32X2": 8,
                "F32X4": 16, "U32X4": 16, "S32X4": 16}[fmt]
        cb = f"cb{slot}.d"
        if addr.isdigit():
            n = int(addr)
            if n % size:
                raise ShaderError(f"unaligned constant load {args[1]}")
            p.cbuffer_rows.setdefault(slot, set()).add(n >> 4)
            e = {16: f"{cb}[{n >> 4}]", 8: f"{cb}[{n >> 4}].{'zwzw' if n & 8 else 'xyxy'}",
                 4: f"uvec4({cb}[{n >> 4}].{SWZ[(n >> 2) & 3]})"}[size]
        else:
            p.cbuffer_computed.add(slot)
            a = self.address(addr)
            if size == 16:
                e = f"{cb}[({a}) >> 4]"
            elif size == 8:
                e = f"yw4_ld2({cb}[({a}) >> 4], ({a}) >> 3)"
                p.uses.add("ld2")
            else:
                e = f"uvec4({cb}[({a}) >> 4][(({a}) >> 2) & 3u])"
        if sat:
            self.store(args[0], f"uintBitsToFloat({e})", "f", cc, sat=True)
        else:
            self.store(args[0], e, "u", cc)

    def array_index(self, idx: str) -> str:
        """Index of a local array (`lmem0[3]`, `lmem0[R0.x]`, `lmem0[R0.x + 1]`)."""
        idx = idx.replace(" ", "")
        if idx.isdigit():
            return idx
        m = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Z]\w*)\.([xyzw])(?:\+(\d+))?", idx)
        if not m or m.group(1) not in self.p.regs:
            raise ShaderError(f"array index {idx}")
        e = f"int({m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)})"
        return f"{e} + {m.group(3)}" if m.group(3) else e

    def address(self, addr: str) -> str:
        """'R0.x+16' -> GLSL uint expression of a byte address."""
        if addr.isdigit():
            return addr + "u"
        m = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Z]\w*)\.([xyzw])(?:\+(\d+))?", addr)
        if not m or m.group(1) not in self.p.regs:
            raise ShaderError(f"address {addr}")
        e = f"{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)}"
        return f"{e} + {m.group(3)}u" if m.group(3) else e

    def texture(self, op: str, args: list[str], typ_mod: str, sat: bool) -> None:
        p = self.p
        m = re.fullmatch(r"handle\((D\d+\.[xyzw])\)", args[2])
        if not m or m.group(1) not in p.handles:
            raise ShaderError(f"texture handle {args[2]}")
        slot, dim = p.handles[m.group(1)], args[3]
        if p.textures.get(slot, dim) != dim:
            raise ShaderError(f"texture slot {slot} used as {p.textures[slot]} and {dim}")
        p.textures[slot] = dim
        t = f"tex{slot}"
        c = parse_operand(args[1])
        if op == "TXQ":
            if dim == "CUBE" and args[0].endswith(".w"):
                self.store(args[0], f"ivec4(textureQueryLevels({t}))", "s", False)
            elif dim == "2D":
                lod = self.operand(c, "s")
                self.store(args[0], f"ivec4(textureSize({t}, {lod}.x), 0, textureQueryLevels({t}))", "s", False)
            else:
                raise ShaderError(f"TXQ {dim}")
            return
        if op == "TXF":
            ci = self.operand(c, "s")
            self.store(args[0], f"texelFetch({t}, {ci}.xy, {ci}.w)", "f", False, sat)
            return
        cf = self.operand(c, "f")
        lod_needed = op == "TXL" or p.stage != "frag"
        lod = f"{cf}.w" if op == "TXL" else "0.0"
        # Coordinates per target (NV_gpu_program4): array layer in z; shadow reference
        # in z (SHADOW2D) or w (SHADOWARRAY2D); TXL's level of detail in w.
        n = {"2D": "xy", "3D": "xyz", "CUBE": "xyz", "ARRAY2D": "xyz", "SHADOW2D": "xyz",
             "SHADOWARRAY2D": "xyzw"}.get(dim)
        if n is None:
            raise ShaderError(f"texture target {dim}")
        soft = not lod_needed and p.key in PCSS_SHADERS
        if dim == "SHADOWARRAY2D":
            if op == "TXL":
                raise ShaderError("TXL on SHADOWARRAY2D")
            if soft:
                p.depth_reads.add(slot)
                e = f"vec4(yw4_shadow({t}, {t}_depth, {cf}))"
            else:
                e = (f"vec4(textureGrad({t}, {cf}, vec2(0.0), vec2(0.0)))" if lod_needed
                     else f"vec4(texture({t}, {cf}))")
        elif dim == "SHADOW2D":
            if soft:
                p.depth_reads.add(slot)
                e = f"vec4(yw4_shadow({t}, {t}_depth, {cf}.xyz))"
            else:
                e = f"vec4(textureLod({t}, {cf}.xyz, {lod}))" if lod_needed else f"vec4(texture({t}, {cf}.xyz))"
        else:
            e = f"textureLod({t}, {cf}.{n}, {lod})" if lod_needed else f"texture({t}, {cf}.{n})"
        self.store(args[0], e, "f", False, sat)

    def image_store(self, args: list[str]) -> None:
        p = self.p
        m = re.fullmatch(r"handle\((D\d+\.[xyzw])\)", args[0])
        if not m or m.group(1) not in p.handles or args[3] != "2D":
            raise ShaderError(f"STOREIM {args}")
        slot = p.handles[m.group(1)]
        p.images[slot] = "2D"
        data = self.operand(parse_operand(args[1]), "f")
        coord = self.operand(parse_operand(args[2]), "s")
        self.emit(f"imageStore(img{slot}, {coord}.xy, {data});")

    def instruction(self, ln: str) -> None:
        p = self.p
        m = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Z0-9_]+)((?:\.[A-Z0-9]+)*)\s*(.*)", ln)
        if not m:
            raise ShaderError(f"cannot parse {ln!r}")
        op, mods, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2).split(".")[1:], m.group(3).strip()
        cc = "CC" in mods
        sat = "SAT" in mods
        tmod = next((x for x in mods if x in ("F", "F32", "F16", "S", "U", "U32", "S32", "U64",
                                               "F32X2", "F32X4", "U32X2", "U32X4", "S32X2", "S32X4")), None)
        typ = {"S": "s", "S32": "s", "U": "u", "U32": "u"}.get(tmod, "f")
        args = split_args(rest)
        self.emit(f"// {ln}")

        if op == "IF":
            self.emit(f"if ({self.cond(rest)}) {{")
            p.depth += 1
        elif op == "ELSE":
            p.depth -= 1
            self.emit("} else {")
            p.depth += 1
        elif op in ("ENDIF", "ENDREP"):
            p.depth -= 1
            self.emit("}")
        elif op == "REP":
            if not rest:
                self.emit("for (;;) {")
            else:
                n = re.fullmatch(r"\{(\d+), [^}]*\}(?:\.x)?", rest)
                if not n:
                    raise ShaderError(f"REP count {rest}")
                v = f"rep{p.depth}"
                self.emit(f"for (int {v} = 0; {v} < {n.group(1)}; {v}++) {{")
            p.depth += 1
        elif op == "BRK":
            self.emit(f"if ({self.cond(rest.strip('()'))}) break;" if rest else "break;")
        elif op == "KIL":
            self.emit(f"if ({self.cond(rest)}) discard;")
        elif op == "EMIT":
            if p.stage == "geom":
                self.emit("yw4_fix_position();")
            self.emit("EmitVertex();")
        elif op == "ENDPRIM":
            self.emit("EndPrimitive();")
        elif op == "BAR":
            self.emit("barrier();")
        elif op == "MEMBAR":
            self.emit("memoryBarrierShared();")
        elif op == "LDC":
            self.cbuffer_load(args, tmod, sat, cc)
        elif op in ("TEX", "TXL", "TXF", "TXQ"):
            self.texture(op, args, tmod, sat)
        elif op == "STOREIM":
            self.image_store(args)
        elif op in ("LDB", "STB", "LDS", "STS", "ATOMS", "ATOMB"):
            self.memory(op, mods, args)
        else:
            self.alu(op, typ, tmod, args, cc, sat)

    def cond(self, s: str, vector: bool = False) -> str:
        """A condition-code test. cc holds "value != 0", so NE is cc and EQ is !cc.
        Scalar for IF/BRK/KIL; a bvec4 for conditional writes (`R0.x (EQ.x)`)."""
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(NE|EQ)(?:\.([xyzw]{1,4}))?", s.strip())
        if not m or (not vector and (not m.group(2) or len(m.group(2)) != 1)):
            raise ShaderError(f"condition {s!r}")
        swz = m.group(2) or "xyzw"
        swz = (swz + swz[-1] * 4)[:4] if vector else swz
        return f"cc.{swz}" if m.group(1) == "NE" else f"not(cc.{swz})" if vector else f"!cc.{swz}"

    def memory(self, op: str, mods: list[str], args: list[str]) -> None:
        p = self.p
        mem = args[-1]
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\[(.+)\]", mem)
        if not m:
            raise ShaderError(f"memory operand {mem}")
        a = self.address(m.group(2).replace(" ", ""))
        if m.group(1) in p.storage:
            arr = f"sb{p.storage[m.group(1)]}.d"
        elif m.group(1) == p.shared:
            arr = "shared_mem"
        else:
            raise ShaderError(f"memory {m.group(1)}")
        elem = f"{arr}[({a}) >> 2]".replace("(0u) >> 2", "0")
        if "U32" not in mods:
            raise ShaderError(f"{op} type {mods}")
        if op in ("LDB", "LDS"):
            self.store(args[0], f"uvec4({elem})", "u", False)
        elif op in ("STB", "STS"):
            self.emit(f"{elem} = {self.operand(parse_operand(args[0]), 'u')}.x;")
        else:
            fn = {"MIN": "atomicMin", "MAX": "atomicMax", "ADD": "atomicAdd"}[mods[0]]
            if op == "ATOMB" and arr.startswith("sb"):
                p.written_storage.add(int(arr[2:arr.index(".")]))
            self.store(args[0], f"uvec4({fn}({elem}, {self.operand(parse_operand(args[1]), 'u')}.x))", "u", False)

    def alu(self, op: str, typ: str, tmod: str | None, args: list[str], cc: bool, sat: bool) -> None:
        srcs = [parse_operand(a) for a in args[1:]]

        def s(i: int, t: str = typ) -> str:
            return self.operand(srcs[i], t)

        f = typ == "f"
        plain = not sat and not srcs[0].neg and not srcs[0].abs and not srcs[0].text.startswith("{")
        if op == "MOV" and plain and (not cc or typ == "u"):
            # A plain MOV copies bits whatever its suffix: it neither converts nor tells
            # us how an input is typed. (MOV.F.CC still tests as a float, below.)
            self.store(args[0], self.read(srcs[0], "u"), "u", cc)
            return
        if op == "BFI":
            # First operand: x = field width, y = offset (seen as {8, 0}, {8, 8}, {8, 16}).
            w = s(0, "s")
            self.store(args[0], f"bitfieldInsert({s(2)}, {s(1)}, {w}.y, {w}.x)", typ, cc)
            return
        if op == "NOT":
            self.store(args[0], f"~{s(0)}", typ, cc)
            return
        if op in ("MOV", "ADD", "MUL", "MAD", "MIN", "MAX", "DIV", "AND", "OR", "SHR", "SHL"):
            e = {"MOV": lambda: s(0), "ADD": lambda: f"{s(0)} + {s(1)}", "MUL": lambda: f"{s(0)} * {s(1)}",
                 "MAD": lambda: f"fma({s(0)}, {s(1)}, {s(2)})" if f else f"{s(0)} * {s(1)} + {s(2)}",
                 "MIN": lambda: f"min({s(0)}, {s(1)})", "MAX": lambda: f"max({s(0)}, {s(1)})",
                 "DIV": lambda: f"{s(0)} / {s(1)}", "AND": lambda: f"{s(0)} & {s(1)}",
                 "OR": lambda: f"{s(0)} | {s(1)}", "SHR": lambda: f"{s(0)} >> {s(1, 'u')}",
                 "SHL": lambda: f"{s(0)} << {s(1, 'u')}"}[op]()
            if f and op in ("AND", "OR", "SHR", "SHL"):
                raise ShaderError(f"{op} on floats")
            self.store(args[0], e, typ, cc, sat)
        elif op in ("DP2", "DP3", "DP4"):
            n = {"DP2": ".xy", "DP3": ".xyz", "DP4": ""}[op]
            self.store(args[0], f"vec4(dot({s(0)}{n}, {s(1)}{n}))", "f", cc, sat)
        elif op in ("RCP", "RSQ", "EX2", "LG2", "SIN", "COS"):
            x = f"{s(0)}.x"
            e = {"RCP": f"1.0 / {x}", "RSQ": f"inversesqrt(abs({x}))", "EX2": f"exp2({x})",
                 "LG2": f"log2({x})", "SIN": f"sin({x})", "COS": f"cos({x})"}[op]
            self.store(args[0], f"vec4({e})", "f", cc, sat)
        elif op in ("FRC", "FLR", "TRUNC", "CEIL", "ROUND"):
            # ROUND: Maxwell rounds to nearest even.
            fn = {"FRC": "fract", "FLR": "floor", "TRUNC": "trunc", "CEIL": "ceil", "ROUND": "roundEven"}[op]
            e = f"{fn}({s(0, 'f')})"
            if typ == "u":
                e = f"uvec4(max({e}, 0.0))"
            elif typ == "s":
                e = f"ivec4({e})"
            self.store(args[0], e, typ, cc, sat)
        elif op == "I2F":
            self.store(args[0], f"vec4({s(0)})", "f", cc, sat)
        elif op in ("SEQ", "SNE", "SLT", "SGE", "SGT"):
            fn = {"SEQ": "equal", "SNE": "notEqual", "SLT": "lessThan", "SGE": "greaterThanEqual",
                  "SGT": "greaterThan"}[op]
            b = f"{fn}({s(0)}, {s(1)})"
            if f:
                self.store(args[0], f"vec4({b})", "f", cc, sat)
            else:
                self.store(args[0], f"mix(uvec4(0u), uvec4(0xFFFFFFFFu), {b})", "u", cc)
        elif op in ("DDX", "DDY"):
            self.store(args[0], f"{'dFdx' if op == 'DDX' else 'dFdy'}({s(0)})", "f", cc, sat)
        else:
            raise ShaderError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- whole program
    def translate(self) -> tuple[str, dict]:
        # Pass 1 learns how each vertex input is read (float or integer), which decides
        # its declared type; pass 2 emits code knowing it.
        for final in (False, True):
            known, flat = self.p.inputs, self.p.flat_inputs
            self.p = Program(self.p.key, self.p.stage)
            self.known_inputs = known if final else {}
            self.p.flat_inputs = set(flat)
            for ln in self.lines:
                if ln == "END":
                    break
                if not self.declare(ln):
                    self.instruction(ln)
            if self.p.depth != 1:
                raise ShaderError("unbalanced control flow")
        return self.glsl(), self.interface()

    def interface(self) -> dict:
        p = self.p
        return {"stage": p.stage, "set": SET[p.stage],
                "cbuffers": sorted(p.used_cbuffers),
                "cbuffer_rows": {str(k): sorted(v) for k, v in sorted(p.cbuffer_rows.items())},
                "cbuffer_computed": sorted(p.cbuffer_computed), "textures": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(p.textures.items())},
                "images": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(p.images.items())},
                "depth": {str(k): p.textures[k].removeprefix("SHADOW") for k in sorted(p.depth_reads)},
                "storage": sorted(p.storage.values()),
                "inputs": {str(k): p.inputs.get(k, "f") for k in sorted(p.input_locs)},
                "outputs": sorted(p.outputs), "colors": sorted(p.colors),
                "group_size": p.group_size if p.stage == "comp" else None}

    def glsl(self) -> str:
        p = self.p
        s = SET[p.stage]
        o = ["#version 460",
             f"// {p.key}.{p.stage}: translated from NV_gpu_program5 by recomp/shader.py (decision 0020)."
             " Derived from the game's code: never commit."]
        if p.stage == "comp":
            o.append("layout(local_size_x = %d, local_size_y = %d, local_size_z = %d) in;" % tuple(p.group_size))
        if p.stage == "geom":
            prim_in = {"TRIANGLES": "triangles", "POINTS": "points", "LINES": "lines"}[p.gs["PRIMITIVE_IN"]]
            prim_out = {"TRIANGLE_STRIP": "triangle_strip", "POINTS": "points", "LINE_STRIP": "line_strip"}[p.gs["PRIMITIVE_OUT"]]
            o += [f"layout({prim_in}) in;", f"layout({prim_out}, max_vertices = {p.gs['VERTICES_OUT']}) out;"]
        for slot in sorted(p.used_cbuffers):
            o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {slot}, std140) uniform CB{slot} {{ uvec4 d[4096]; }} cb{slot};")
        samp = {"2D": "sampler2D", "3D": "sampler3D", "CUBE": "samplerCube", "SHADOW2D": "sampler2DShadow",
                "ARRAY2D": "sampler2DArray", "SHADOWARRAY2D": "sampler2DArrayShadow"}
        for slot, dim in sorted(p.textures.items()):
            o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {TEX_BINDING + slot}) uniform {samp[dim]} tex{slot};")
        for slot in sorted(p.images):
            if slot in p.textures:
                raise ShaderError(f"slot {slot} used as texture and image")
            o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {TEX_BINDING + slot}) uniform writeonly image2D img{slot};")
        for name, n in sorted(p.storage.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]):
            o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {STORAGE_BINDING + n}, std430) buffer SB{n} {{ uint d[]; }} sb{n};")
        if p.shared:
            o.append(f"shared uint shared_mem[{max(p.shared_size, 4) // 4}];")
        # Varyings between stages: the game's attribute 31 goes at location 7. Its vertex programs write up to
        # attribute 31 (the Switch's GPU has 32 plus the position), but desktop Vulkan counts the position too:
        # location 31 and gl_Position are 132 components, over the usual limit of 128 (VUID-RuntimeSpirv-Location-
        # 06272, 3 programs). No program of the game uses attributes 7 to 13, so 7 is free in every stage; the
        # names keep the game's number. Vertex inputs (a<n>) and colour outputs are not varyings.
        moved = {31: 7}
        varyings = set(p.outputs) | (set() if p.stage == "vert" else set(p.input_locs))
        def vloc(loc: int) -> int:
            if loc in moved and moved[loc] in varyings:
                raise ShaderError(f"varying {loc} can't move to {moved[loc]}: in use")
            return moved.get(loc, loc)
        for loc in sorted(p.input_locs):
            t = p.inputs.get(loc, "f")
            if p.stage == "vert":
                o.append(f"layout(location = {loc}) in {'vec4' if t == 'f' else 'uvec4'} a{loc};")
            elif p.stage == "geom":
                o.append(f"layout(location = {vloc(loc)}) in vec4 i_attr{loc}[];")
            else:
                o.append(f"layout(location = {vloc(loc)}) {'flat ' if loc in p.flat_inputs else ''}in vec4 i_attr{loc};")
        for loc in sorted(p.outputs):
            o.append(f"layout(location = {vloc(loc)}) out vec4 o_attr{loc};")
        if p.stage == "vert":
            # Only the position: undeclared, glslang's block also holds gl_PointSize and one clip and one cull
            # distance, which no game shader writes. Those 7 built-in components on top of an output at location 30
            # (components up to 124) went over desktop Vulkan's 128 (VUID-RuntimeSpirv-Location-06272, 19 shaders).
            o.append("out gl_PerVertex { vec4 gl_Position; };")
        elif p.stage == "geom":  # the same block on both sides, or it doesn't match the vertex shader's (08746)
            o += ["in gl_PerVertex { vec4 gl_Position; } gl_in[];", "out gl_PerVertex { vec4 gl_Position; };"]
        for loc in sorted(p.colors):
            o.append(f"layout(location = {loc}) out vec4 o_color{loc};")
        if p.stage in ("vert", "geom"):
            o += ["layout(push_constant) uniform YW4 { uint pos_fix; } yw4;",
                  "void yw4_fix_position() {",
                  f"    if ((yw4.pos_fix & {1 if p.stage == 'vert' else 2}u) != 0u) "
                  "gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;",
                  "}"]
        if "ld2" in p.uses:
            o += ["uvec4 yw4_ld2(uvec4 v, uint half_index) {",
                  "    return (half_index & 1u) != 0u ? v.zwzw : v.xyxy;", "}"]
        if p.depth_reads:
            depth_samp = {"SHADOW2D": "sampler2D", "SHADOWARRAY2D": "sampler2DArray"}
            for slot in sorted(p.depth_reads):
                o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {DEPTH_BINDING + slot}) uniform "
                         f"{depth_samp[p.textures[slot]]} tex{slot}_depth;")
            o.append(f"layout(set = {s}, binding = {PCSS_BINDING}, std140) uniform YW4PCSS "
                     "{ vec4 mode; vec4 scale; vec4 tune; } yw4_pcss;")
            o += PCSS_COMMON.splitlines()
            for dim in sorted({p.textures[slot] for slot in p.depth_reads}):
                o += pcss_helper(dim).splitlines()
        o.append("void main() {")
        decl = ", ".join(f"{r} = uvec4(0u)" for r in p.regs)
        if decl:
            o.append(f"    uvec4 {decl};")
        for name, n in sorted(p.arrays.items()):
            o.append(f"    uvec4 {name}[{n}];")
        o += ["    vec4 tf; uvec4 tu; ivec4 ts;", "    bvec4 cc = bvec4(false);"]
        o += p.body
        if p.stage == "vert":
            o.append("    yw4_fix_position();")
        o.append("}")
        return "\n".join(o) + "\n"


# Soft shadows with contact hardening (PCSS), in the shaders listed in PCSS_SHADERS: their
# shadow map lookups go through yw4_shadow. Off (yw4_pcss.mode.x == 0) it is the game's lookup. On, it reads the raw
# depth around the point to find the casters in front of it (blocker search); their average
# distance from the receiver sets the filter radius: sharp at the contact, soft far from it
# (tree canopies). The game's shaders average 5 lookups a little apart with the same layer and
# reference; the first one is filtered and the rest reuse its result (yw4_seen), so the cost is
# one search + one filter per pixel and cascade. The compare taps use texture(), not
# textureGrad(.., 0, 0): on NVIDIA the latter on an array shadow map made pipeline builds ~10x
# slower (the map has one level, so both read the same texels). Casters are texels with a
# smaller depth than the reference (the maps are cleared to 1.0). The game's compare (GREATER)
# only says the result means "in shadow", not which way depth runs.
#   mode:  x on, y unused, z largest radius and search radius (0..1 map coordinates), w smallest radius
#   scale: radius per unit of depth gap, per cascade layer 0..3
#   tune:  x depth gap below which a texel isn't counted as a caster, y debug view (1 casters
#          found / 16, 2 radius / largest), z 1: one blocker search per pixel and layer (yw4_search_*),
#          w pixels per side of a block that shares one disk rotation (1: every pixel its own)
# The mask shader's lookups are a little apart with different references, so yw4_seen rarely
# matches there; with tune.z the later ones reuse the first one's search (its radius, or "no
# casters") and only filter. The search was most of the cost (decision 0025).
PCSS_COMMON = """\
const vec2 YW4_DISK[16] = vec2[16](
    vec2(-0.94201624, -0.39906216), vec2(0.94558609, -0.76890725), vec2(-0.09418410, -0.92938870),
    vec2(0.34495938, 0.29387760), vec2(-0.91588581, 0.45771432), vec2(-0.81544232, -0.87912464),
    vec2(-0.38277543, 0.27676845), vec2(0.97484398, 0.75648379), vec2(0.44323325, -0.97511554),
    vec2(0.53742981, -0.47373420), vec2(-0.26496911, -0.41893023), vec2(0.79197514, 0.19090188),
    vec2(-0.24188840, 0.99706507), vec2(-0.81409955, 0.91437590), vec2(0.19984126, 0.78641367),
    vec2(0.14383161, -0.14100790));
vec2 yw4_seen_key[2];
float yw4_seen_lit[2];
int yw4_seen_n = 0;
float yw4_search_layer = -1.0, yw4_search_r = -1.0;
mat2 yw4_pcss_rotation() {
```
