`runtime/shaders/bloom.vert`:

```vert
#version 450
// Our bloom pass (runtime/src/gpu_post.c, decision 0037): the game's full-screen quad, its corners and
// texture coordinates as the engine's vertex buffer holds them, drawn as triangles 0,1,2 and 0,2,3 the way
// the runtime draws the game's quads, so every pixel gets the same interpolated coordinate.
// Blur (pc.c[3].x = 1): the 8 tap positions of a pass, the centre twice and +-1, 2, 3 steps (pc.c[0].xy).

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[4]; } pc;
layout(location = 3) out vec4 tap0;  // centre, centre (the bright pass and composite read .xy)
layout(location = 4) out vec4 tap1;  // +1 step, -1 step
layout(location = 5) out vec4 tap2;  // +2, -2
layout(location = 6) out vec4 tap3;  // +3, -3

const vec2 POS[4] = vec2[4](vec2(-1.0, 1.0), vec2(-1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0));
const vec2 UV[4] = vec2[4](vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0), vec2(1.0, 0.0));
const int CORNER[6] = int[6](0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3);

void main() {
    int k = CORNER[gl_VertexIndex];
    vec2 uv = UV[k];
    gl_Position = vec4(POS[k], 0.0, 1.0);
    gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;  // as the runtime's position fix
    if (pc.c[3].x == 0.0) {
        tap0 = uv.xyxy, tap1 = tap2 = tap3 = vec4(0.0);
        return;
    }
    // the step's multiples as the game's program adds them: s, 2s = s + s, 3s = s + 2s
    vec4 s = pc.c[0];
    vec2 s1 = s.xy + s.zw, s2 = s.xy + s1, s3 = s.xy + s2;
    tap0 = vec4(uv + s.zw, uv - s.zw);
    tap1 = vec4(uv + s1, uv - s1);
    tap2 = vec4(uv + s2, uv - s2);
    tap3 = vec4(uv + s3, uv - s3);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/bloom_blur.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
// Bloom, step 2 (gpu_post.c, decision 0037): one blur pass, across or down: 4 pairs of taps (bloom.vert)
// with the weights pc.c[1] (centre, 1, 2, 3 steps), then pc.c[2] times the same pairs (zero in the game's
// passes, added as it does). Operation order as the game's program.

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[4]; } pc;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D src;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 tap0;
layout(location = 4) in vec4 tap1;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 tap2;
layout(location = 6) in vec4 tap3;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

void main() {
    vec4 w = pc.c[1], v = pc.c[2];
    vec4 p1 = texture(src, tap1.xy) + texture(src, tap1.zw);
    vec4 r = p1 * w.y;
    vec4 p0 = texture(src, tap0.xy) + texture(src, tap0.zw);
    r = fma(p0, vec4(w.x), r);
    vec4 p2 = texture(src, tap2.xy) + texture(src, tap2.zw);
    r = fma(p2, vec4(w.z), r);
    vec4 p3 = texture(src, tap3.xy) + texture(src, tap3.zw);
    r = fma(p3, vec4(w.w), r);
    r = fma(vec4(v.x), p0, r);
    r = fma(vec4(v.y), p1, r);
    r = fma(vec4(v.z), p2, r);
    o_color = fma(vec4(v.w), p3, r);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/bloom_bright.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
// Bloom, step 1 (gpu_post.c, decision 0037): the bright parts of the scene (in0) and of the half-size image
// in1, each over its threshold: in1 where it stands out from the scene by more than its difference allows,
// and the scene itself. pc.c[0] / c[1]: per-channel scale (rgb) and threshold (w) for in0 / in1 (renderer
// +0x800, +0x7f0). The same operations in the same order as the game's program, so the result is identical.

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[4]; } pc;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D in0;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D in1;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 tap0;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

void main() {
    vec4 a = texture(in1, tap0.xy), s = texture(in0, tap0.xy);
    vec3 d = a.rgb - s.rgb;
    float m = max(abs(d.z), max(abs(d.y), abs(d.x)));
    vec3 lit = max(fma(vec3(-m), vec3(1.5), a.rgb), vec3(0.0));
    vec4 from1 = vec4(fma(lit, pc.c[1].rgb, vec3(-pc.c[1].w)), a.w);
    vec4 from0 = vec4(fma(s.rgb, pc.c[0].rgb, vec3(-pc.c[0].w)), s.w);
    o_color = max(max(from1, from0), vec4(0.0));
}

```

`runtime/shaders/bloom_composite.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
// Bloom, step 3 (gpu_post.c, decision 0037): the three blurred levels onto the scene (blend: the scene times
// one minus our alpha, plus our colour). Each level times its brightness (pc.c[0].x, c[0].z, c[1].x,
// clamped to 0..1) is combined as a screen, 1 - (1-a)(1-b)(1-c); alpha from the brightest channel of each
// with the weights c[0].y, c[0].w, c[1].y. Operation order as the game's program.

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[4]; } pc;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D level0;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D level1;
layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform sampler2D level2;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 tap0;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

void main() {
    vec4 k0 = pc.c[0], k1 = pc.c[1];
    vec3 c = clamp(texture(level2, tap0.xy).rgb * k1.x, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 b = clamp(texture(level1, tap0.xy).rgb * k0.z, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 keep = 1.0 - b;
    float mb = max(b.z, max(b.y, b.x));
    vec3 a = clamp(texture(level0, tap0.xy).rgb * k0.x, 0.0, 1.0);
    float mc = max(c.z, max(c.y, c.x));
    keep = fma(-a, keep, keep);
    float ma = max(a.z, max(a.y, a.x));
    vec3 screen = fma(-c, keep, keep);
    float t = -ma * k0.y;
    float u = fma(-mb, k0.w, 1.0);
    u = fma(t, u, u);
    float alpha = fma(-mc * k1.y, u, u);
    o_color = vec4(1.0 - screen, 1.0 - alpha);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/detile.comp`:

```comp
// A texture level out of the game's block-linear layout (Tegra GOBs), on the GPU: one invocation per 16-byte
// piece of the level's tightly packed rows, read from the game's memory pool and written in row order, for a
// copy into the image after. The address is runtime/src/tegra.c's gob_offset: GOBs of 64 bytes x 8 rows,
// 2^bh GOBs tall and 2^bd deep per block; inside a GOB, 16-byte sectors.
#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 64) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Source { uvec4 src[]; };  // the pool, from the bound offset
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) writeonly buffer Packed { uvec4 dst[]; };

layout(push_constant) uniform Level {
    uint src_base;    // the level's start in the bound source, in 16-byte pieces
    uint dst_base;    // where its rows go, in 16-byte pieces
    uint row16;       // pieces per row
    uint rows;        // rows of blocks
    uint slices;      // depth of a 3D texture (1 otherwise)
    uint width_gobs;  // the level's width in GOBs
    uint bh, bd;      // log2 of GOBs per block in height and depth
    uint block_rows;  // block rows in a slice
} p;

void main() {
    // 2D dispatch: x up to 65535 groups
    uint id = (gl_WorkGroupID.y * gl_NumWorkGroups.x + gl_WorkGroupID.x) * 64u + gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
    if (id >= p.row16 * p.rows * p.slices) return;
    uint xb = (id % p.row16) * 16u, y = (id / p.row16) % p.rows, z = id / (p.row16 * p.rows);
    uint gob_y = y >> 3;
    uint block_size = 512u << (p.bh + p.bd);
    uint off = ((z >> p.bd) * p.block_rows + (gob_y >> p.bh)) * p.width_gobs * block_size;
    off += (xb >> 6) * block_size;
    off += (((z & ((1u << p.bd) - 1u)) << p.bh) | (gob_y & ((1u << p.bh) - 1u))) * 512u;
    uint xi = xb & 63u, yi = y & 7u;
    off += ((xi >> 5) << 8) | ((yi >> 1) << 6) | (((xi >> 4) & 1u) << 5) | ((yi & 1u) << 4);
    dst[p.dst_base + id] = src[p.src_base + (off >> 4)];
}

```

`runtime/shaders/dof.vert`:

```vert
#version 450
// Our distance blur (runtime/src/gpu_post.c, decision 0038): the game's full-screen quad, as bloom.vert, and per
// mode (pc.c[5].x) what the game's vertex programs pass on:
//   0 shrink: the texture coordinate.
//   1 blur: 8 pairs of taps, the centre twice and +-1..7 steps of pc.c[2] (each step added to the last, as the
//     game's program does), into locations 3-6 and 14-17.
//   2 composite: the centre and its 4 diagonal neighbours, pc.c[2].xy apart (one texel of the depth).

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[8]; } pc;
layout(location = 3) out vec4 t0;
layout(location = 4) out vec4 t1;
layout(location = 5) out vec4 t2;
layout(location = 6) out vec4 t3;
layout(location = 14) out vec4 t4;
layout(location = 15) out vec4 t5;
layout(location = 16) out vec4 t6;
layout(location = 17) out vec4 t7;

const vec2 POS[4] = vec2[4](vec2(-1.0, 1.0), vec2(-1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, -1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0));
const vec2 UV[4] = vec2[4](vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 1.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0), vec2(1.0, 0.0));
const int CORNER[6] = int[6](0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3);

void main() {
    int k = CORNER[gl_VertexIndex];
    vec2 uv = UV[k];
    gl_Position = vec4(POS[k], 0.0, 1.0);
    gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;  // as the runtime's position fix
    t0 = uv.xyxy, t1 = t2 = t3 = t4 = t5 = t6 = t7 = vec4(0.0);
    vec4 s = pc.c[2];
    if (pc.c[5].x == 1.0) {
        vec2 s1 = s.xy + s.zw, s2 = s.xy + s1, s3 = s.xy + s2, s4 = s.xy + s3, s5 = s.xy + s4, s6 = s.xy + s5,
             s7 = s.xy + s6;
        t0 = vec4(uv + s.zw, uv - s.zw);
        t1 = vec4(uv + s1, uv - s1);
        t2 = vec4(uv + s2, uv - s2);
        t3 = vec4(uv + s3, uv - s3);
        t4 = vec4(uv + s4, uv - s4);
        t5 = vec4(uv + s5, uv - s5);
        t6 = vec4(uv + s6, uv - s6);
        t7 = vec4(uv + s7, uv - s7);
    } else if (pc.c[5].x == 2.0) {
        t1 = vec4(uv + s.xy, fma(s.xy, vec2(1.0, -1.0), uv));
        t2 = vec4(fma(s.xy, vec2(-1.0, 1.0), uv), uv - s.xy);
    }
}

```

`runtime/shaders/dof_blur.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
// Distance blur, step 2 (gpu_post.c, decision 0038): one blur pass, across or down: 8 pairs of taps (dof.vert)
// with the Gaussian weights pc.c[3] (centre, 1-3 steps) and pc.c[4] (4-7). Each pair as the game's program sums
// it (w * the second tap, then w * the first added to that), the pairs added up in its order.

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[8]; } pc;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D src;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 t0;
layout(location = 4) in vec4 t1;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 t2;
layout(location = 6) in vec4 t3;
layout(location = 14) in vec4 t4;
layout(location = 15) in vec4 t5;
layout(location = 16) in vec4 t6;
layout(location = 17) in vec4 t7;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

vec4 pair(vec4 t, float w) {
    return fma(vec4(w), texture(src, t.xy), vec4(w) * texture(src, t.zw));
}

void main() {
    vec4 a = pc.c[3], b = pc.c[4];
    vec4 r = pair(t0, a.x) + pair(t1, a.y);
    r = r + pair(t2, a.z);
    r = r + pair(t3, a.w);
    r = r + pair(t4, b.x);
    vec4 r1 = r + pair(t5, b.y);
    vec4 r6 = pair(t6, b.z), r7 = pair(t7, b.w);
    o_color = (r1 + r6) + r7;
}

```

`runtime/shaders/dof_composite.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
// Distance blur, step 3 (gpu_post.c, decision 0038): the blurred image over the scene by depth. The depth (slot 1)
// becomes the view distance (near far / ((near - far) d + far)), then a blur amount 0..1 that grows past the
// focus: pc.c[0] = (near far, near - far, near - focus start, 1 / focus range; the panel's half setting halves
// .w), pc.c[1] = two thresholds and their reciprocals; pc.c[5].y = the camera's far distance (its camera block,
// row 3 .y). Where the centre is under the second threshold, the smallest amount of its 4 diagonal neighbours
// can take over (the edges of near objects). The scene keeps (1 - alpha); pixels that would keep almost all of
// it are discarded. Same operations in the same order as the game's program.

layout(push_constant) uniform Push { vec4 c[8]; } pc;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D blurred;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D depth;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 t0;
layout(location = 4) in vec4 t1;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 t2;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

void main() {
    vec4 c0 = pc.c[0], c1 = pc.c[1];
    float far = pc.c[5].y;
    float a = fma(c0.y, texture(depth, t0.xy).x, far);
    a = 1.0 / a;
    a = fma(c0.x, a, c0.z);
    a = clamp(a * c0.w, 0.0, 1.0);
    float amount = a;
    if (a < c1.y) {
        vec4 d = vec4(texture(depth, t1.xy).x, texture(depth, t1.zw).x, texture(depth, t2.xy).x,
                      texture(depth, t2.zw).x);
        d = fma(vec4(c0.y), d, vec4(far));
        d = vec4(1.0 / d.x, 1.0 / d.y, 1.0 / d.z, 1.0 / d.w);
        d = fma(vec4(c0.x), d, vec4(c0.z));
        d = clamp(d * c0.w, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec2 m2 = min(d.zw, d.xy);
        float m = min(m2.y, m2.x);
        float take = c1.x >= m ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        amount = fma(take, m - a, a);
    }
    vec2 past = vec2(amount >= c1.x ? 1.0 : 0.0, amount >= c1.y ? 1.0 : 0.0);
    vec2 scaled = clamp(c1.zw * vec2(amount, 1.0 - amount), 0.0, 1.0);
    float x = fma(past.x, -scaled.x, past.x);
    float z = x + scaled.x;
    float keep = fma(past.y, scaled.y - z, z);
    if (-keep < -0.999000013) discard;
    o_color = vec4(texture(blurred, t0.xy).rgb, 1.0 - keep);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/edge_upsample.frag`:

```frag
// The engine's edge-aware upsample (game program 3c94bd, with the full-screen quad 98c09b): a small image
// (texture 0) brought to full size without bleeding across edges. The small image's depth (texture 1) one
// texel left, right, up and down, and the full-size depth (texture 2) at the pixel: per axis, where the
// neighbours differ, how far the pixel's depth lies between them (0..1, else 0.5) moves the sample point by
// (2f - 1) texels. Operations in the game's order (multiplies by reciprocals, fused multiply-adds), so the
// result can match it bit for bit. docs/frame.md "Lighting stage".
#version 460

layout(set = 1, binding = 0, std140) uniform Pass {
    vec4 texel;  // xy: the small image's texel size
} pass;

layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D image;       // texture 0: the small image
layout(set = 1, binding = 17) uniform sampler2D small_depth; // texture 1
layout(set = 1, binding = 18) uniform sampler2D full_depth;  // texture 2

layout(location = 3) in vec4 uv;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_colour;

void main() {
    vec4 step = vec4(pass.texel.x, 0.0, 0.0, pass.texel.y);  // x across, w down
    vec4 before = -step + uv.xyxy;                           // (left), (up)
    vec4 after = step + uv.xyxy;                             // (right), (down)
    vec2 near = vec2(textureLod(small_depth, before.xy, 0.0).x, textureLod(small_depth, before.zw, 0.0).x);
    vec2 far = vec2(textureLod(small_depth, after.xy, 0.0).x, textureLod(small_depth, after.zw, 0.0).x);
    vec2 span = -near + far;
    vec2 edge = vec2(lessThan(vec2(0.0), abs(span)));  // 1 where the neighbours differ
    float centre = textureLod(full_depth, uv.xy, 0.0).x;
    vec2 f = clamp((-near + centre) * vec2(1.0 / span.x, 1.0 / span.y), 0.0, 1.0);
    f = fma(edge, f + -0.5, vec2(0.5));                      // 0.5 where they don't
    vec4 moved = fma(step * f.xxyy, vec4(2.0), -step);       // (2f - 1) texels
    vec2 at = (moved.zw + moved.xy) + uv.xy;
    o_colour = textureLod(image, at, 0.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/fxaa.frag`:

```frag
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
// FXAA (our own small version of the fast approximate anti-aliasing idea): where the luma of the
// neighbours says there is an edge, blend along it, two or four taps along the edge's direction; written
// back to the game's target in its linear colour.
#include "aa.glsl"
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D encoded;  // aa_encode.frag's output
layout(location = 0) in vec2 v_uv;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_color;

const float SPAN_MAX = 8.0, REDUCE_MUL = 1.0 / 8.0, REDUCE_MIN = 1.0 / 128.0;
const float EDGE_MIN = 0.0312, EDGE_REL = 0.125;  // contrast below which a texel is left alone

float luma(vec3 c) { return dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); }

vec3 at(vec2 uv) { return textureLod(encoded, uv, 0.0).rgb; }

void main() {
    vec2 px = aa.metrics.xy;
    vec3 m = at(v_uv);
    float lm = luma(m);
    float nw = luma(at(v_uv + vec2(-1.0, -1.0) * px)), ne = luma(at(v_uv + vec2(1.0, -1.0) * px));
    float sw = luma(at(v_uv + vec2(-1.0, 1.0) * px)), se = luma(at(v_uv + vec2(1.0, 1.0) * px));
    float lo = min(lm, min(min(nw, ne), min(sw, se))), hi = max(lm, max(max(nw, ne), max(sw, se)));
    if (hi - lo < max(EDGE_MIN, hi * EDGE_REL)) {
        o_color = vec4(aa_decode(m), 1.0);
        return;
    }
    // the edge runs across the steepest change of luma
    vec2 dir = vec2(-((nw + ne) - (sw + se)), (nw + sw) - (ne + se));
    float reduce = max((nw + ne + sw + se) * 0.25 * REDUCE_MUL, REDUCE_MIN);
    dir = clamp(dir / (min(abs(dir.x), abs(dir.y)) + reduce), vec2(-SPAN_MAX), vec2(SPAN_MAX)) * px;
    vec3 a = 0.5 * (at(v_uv + dir * (1.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)) + at(v_uv + dir * (2.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)));
    vec3 b = a * 0.5 + 0.25 * (at(v_uv - dir * 0.5) + at(v_uv + dir * 0.5));
    float lb = luma(b);
    o_color = vec4(aa_decode(lb < lo || lb > hi ? a : b), 1.0);  // the wider blend only if it stays in range
}

```

`runtime/shaders/game_fxaa.frag`:

```frag
// The engine's own FXAA (game program 3f9fc9, with the quad 2e3291; the anti-aliasing setting's FXAA is
// fxaa.frag): the console version of FXAA 3. Four corner samples half a texel out give the brightness
// gradient; blurs along the edge it shows of two samples (A) and four (B); B unless its brightness falls
// outside the corners' and the centre's range. Operations in the game's order, so the result can match it
// bit for bit. docs/frame.md "Lighting stage".
#version 460

layout(set = 1, binding = 0, std140) uniform Fxaa {
    vec4 a;  // xy one texel, w the longest step (in texels)
    vec4 b;  // x how much the corners' brightness shortens a step
} fxaa;

layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D scene;  // texture 0

layout(location = 3) in vec4 uv;  // xy the pixel, zw half a texel

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_colour;

// brightness weights, as the game has them (F16 constants for the corners and centre, F32 for blur B)
const vec3 luma16 = vec3(0.299072266, 0.586914063, 0.114013672);
const vec3 luma32 = vec3(0.298999995, 0.587000012, 0.114);

float luma(vec2 at) { return dot(textureLod(scene, at, 0.0).xyz, luma16); }

void main() {
    vec4 out_ = fma(uv.zwzw, vec4(1.0, -1.0, -1.0, 1.0), uv.xyxy);  // (u+z, v-w), (u-z, v+w)
    float ne = luma(out_.xy);
    float nw = luma(-uv.zw + uv.xy);
    float se = luma(uv.zw + uv.xy);
    float sw = luma(out_.zw);

    float west_east = (nw + sw) + -(ne + se);  // the game: (nw + sw) - (ne + se)
    float north = ne + nw;
    float sum = se + (sw + north);
    float north_south = -(se + sw) + north;
    float reduce = max((sum * fxaa.b.x) * 0.25, 0.0078125);
    float denom = reduce + min(abs(west_east), abs(north_south));
    vec2 dir = vec2(-north_south, west_east) / denom;
    dir = min(max(dir, vec2(-fxaa.a.w)), vec2(fxaa.a.w)) * fxaa.a.xy;

    vec3 e = textureLod(scene, fma(dir, vec2(-0.166666672), uv.xy), 0.0).xyz;
    vec3 f = textureLod(scene, fma(dir, vec2(0.166666672), uv.xy), 0.0).xyz;
    vec3 g = textureLod(scene, fma(dir, vec2(-0.5), uv.xy), 0.0).xyz;
    vec3 h = textureLod(scene, fma(dir, vec2(0.5), uv.xy), 0.0).xyz;
    vec3 two = f + e;
    vec3 four = (two + (h + g)) * 0.25;
    float four_luma = dot(four, luma32);

    float centre = luma(uv.xy);
    float lo = min(centre, min(min(ne, se), min(nw, sw)));
    float hi = max(max(max(ne, se), max(nw, sw)), centre);
    bool outside = hi < four_luma || four_luma < lo;
    o_colour = vec4(outside ? two * 0.5 : four, 1.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/gbuffer_frag.glsl`:

```glsl
// Our G-buffer fragment programs (decision 0026), included by gbuffer_*.frag: what the game's main
// G-buffer fragment programs compute, written out once, with their interface. The game has one
// program per combination of these switches, defined before the include:
//   NORMAL_MAP  the surface normal from a normal map (texture slot 1: x, y the normal, w gloss);
//               without it, the vertex normal, and slot 1's w is still the gloss
//   CUTOUT      alpha test: pixels where texture slot 0's alpha is below the material's threshold
//               (passed by the vertex program in v_uv.z) are discarded
//   PLAIN       no material at all: only the normal; target 2's w is 0
// Inputs: constant buffers 1 (view), 7 (material), 8 (scene). Outputs, three colour targets:
//   target 0: screen-space motion (this frame's position minus last frame's), depth
//   target 1: zero
//   target 2: the view-space normal packed into 0..1, and a view-dependent lighting term
// Every operation is in the game's order, with fma where the game's program fuses, so the result is
// bit-identical to it.

layout(set = 1, binding = 1, std140) uniform View { vec4 d[4096]; } view;
#ifndef PLAIN
layout(set = 1, binding = 7, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;
layout(set = 1, binding = 8, std140) uniform Scene { vec4 d[4096]; } scene;
layout(set = 1, binding = 17) uniform sampler2D normal_map;
#endif
#ifdef CUTOUT
layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D colour_map;
#endif

layout(location = 3) in vec4 v_uv;      // x, y: texture coordinates; z: the alpha test's threshold
layout(location = 4) in vec4 v_normal;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 v_world;
layout(location = 6) in vec4 v_screen;
layout(location = 14) in vec4 v_last;
#ifdef NORMAL_MAP
layout(location = 15) in vec4 v_tangent;  // w: the bitangent's sign
#endif

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_motion;
layout(location = 1) out vec4 o_zero;
layout(location = 2) out vec4 o_normal;

void main() {
#ifdef CUTOUT
    if (clamp(texture(colour_map, v_uv.xy), 0.0, 1.0).w < v_uv.z) discard;
#endif
    vec3 n = v_normal.xyz * inversesqrt(dot(v_normal.xyz, v_normal.xyz));
#ifdef NORMAL_MAP
    vec4 tex = texture(normal_map, v_uv.xy);
    vec4 t = v_tangent * inversesqrt(dot(v_tangent, v_tangent));  // all four components, as the game does
    vec3 b = fma(n.yzx, t.zxy, -(n.zxy * t.yzx)) * t.w;  // cross(n, t) x the sign

    // the normal map's x and y, scaled by the material's bump strength; z = 1
    float bump = material.d[6].y;
    vec3 d = vec3((tex.xy - 0.5) * bump * 2.0, 1.0);
    d = d * inversesqrt(dot(d, d));
    d = fma(fma(d, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5)), vec3(2.0), vec3(-1.0));  // the game packs and unpacks once
    d.xy *= bump;
    vec3 nw = fma(n, vec3(d.z), fma(t.xyz, vec3(d.x), b * d.y));
    nw *= inversesqrt(dot(nw, nw));
#else
    vec3 nw = n;
#endif

    // to view space (view rows 0-2)
    vec3 nv = vec3(dot(nw, view.d[0].xyz), dot(nw, view.d[1].xyz), dot(view.d[2].xyz, nw));
    nv *= inversesqrt(dot(nv, nv));

#ifdef PLAIN
    o_normal = vec4(fma(nv, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5)), 0.0);
#else
#ifndef NORMAL_MAP
    vec4 tex = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, texture(normal_map, v_uv.xy).w);  // only the gloss
#endif
    // view-dependent term from the eye direction (scene d0: the camera position) and the material
    vec3 eye = scene.d[0].xyz - v_world.xyz;
    eye *= inversesqrt(dot(eye, eye));
    float gloss = 1.0 - tex.w;
    float m = min(material.d[2].x, gloss);
    float range = clamp(material.d[2].y - m, 0.0, 1.0);
    float facing = clamp(fma(-dot(nw, eye) - m, 1.0 / range, 1.0 / range), 0.0, 1.0);
    float term = fma(tex.w * material.d[2].z * facing, material.d[4].z, gloss);
    o_normal = vec4(fma(nv, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5)), term * material.d[4].w);
#endif

    o_zero = vec4(0.0);
    o_motion = vec4(fma(-v_last.xy, vec2(1.0 / v_last.w), v_screen.xy * gl_FragCoord.w), gl_FragCoord.z, 0.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/gbuffer_main.vert`:

```vert
#version 460
// Our G-buffer vertex program (decision 0026): what the game's main G-buffer vertex program
// (bc358b) computes, written out. Same interface as the translated program, so it runs in its
// place with the game's state: constant buffers 1 (view), 2 (object), 3 (material) and the
// outputs its fragment programs read.

layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std140) uniform View { vec4 d[4096]; } view;
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std140) uniform Object { vec4 d[4096]; } object;
layout(set = 0, binding = 3, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;

layout(location = 0) in vec4 a_position;
layout(location = 1) in vec4 a_colour;
layout(location = 2) in vec4 a_normal;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 a_tangent;   // w: the bitangent's sign
layout(location = 4) in vec4 a_uv;

layout(location = 1) out vec4 v_colour;      // vertex colour x material colour
layout(location = 3) out vec4 v_uv;          // x, y: texture coordinates; z: material d0.w
layout(location = 4) out vec4 v_normal;      // world space
layout(location = 5) out vec4 v_world;       // world position
layout(location = 6) out vec4 v_screen;      // (clip.xy + w) / 2, clip.zw
layout(location = 14) out vec4 v_last;       // the same for last frame's position
layout(location = 15) out vec4 v_tangent;    // world space, w: sign
layout(location = 25) out vec4 v_flag;

layout(push_constant) uniform YW4 { uint pos_fix; } yw4;

void main() {
    // object rows: 0-2 world, 8-11 projection x view x world, 12-15 last frame's world;
    // view rows 32-35: last frame's projection x view
    float mirror = material.d[0].x;  // -1 mirrors the mesh in x
    vec4 p = vec4(a_position.x * mirror, a_position.yzw);

    vec4 clip = vec4(dot(p, object.d[8]), dot(p, object.d[9]), dot(p, object.d[10]), dot(object.d[11], p));
    gl_Position = clip;
    v_screen = vec4((clip.w + clip.xy) * 0.5, clip.zw);

    vec4 last_world = vec4(dot(p, object.d[12]), dot(p, object.d[13]), dot(p, object.d[14]), dot(p, object.d[15]));
    vec4 last = vec4(dot(last_world, view.d[32]), dot(last_world, view.d[33]), dot(last_world, view.d[34]),
                     dot(view.d[35], last_world));
    v_last = vec4((last.w + last.xy) * 0.5, last.zw);

    v_world = vec4(dot(p, object.d[0]), dot(p, object.d[1]), dot(p, object.d[2]), 1.0);
    vec4 t = mirror * a_tangent;
    v_tangent = vec4(dot(object.d[0].xyz, t.xyz), dot(object.d[1].xyz, t.xyz), dot(object.d[2].xyz, t.xyz), t.w);
    v_normal = vec4(dot(a_normal.xyz, object.d[0].xyz), dot(a_normal.xyz, object.d[1].xyz),
                    dot(object.d[2].xyz, a_normal.xyz), 0.0);

    vec3 uv1 = vec3(a_uv.xy, 1.0);  // through the material's 2x3 texture transform (rows 4, 5)
    v_uv = vec4(dot(uv1, material.d[4].xyz), dot(material.d[5].xyz, uv1), material.d[0].w, 0.0);
    v_colour = a_colour * material.d[1];
    v_flag = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

    if ((yw4.pos_fix & 1u) != 0u) gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;
}
```

`runtime/shaders/gbuffer_skinned.frag`:

```frag
#version 460
// Our version of the game's skinned G-buffer fragment program b0aa5d (decision 0026), the one its
// skinned vertex program b742aa feeds (characters). Same interface: constant buffers 3 (material)
// and 9 (the rim term's settings), the colour texture in slot 0 and a 16x16 dither texture in slot
// 18; three colour targets as the other G-buffer programs, but the normal comes in view space and
// target 1 is used:
//   target 0: screen-space motion, depth
//   target 1: x, y the vertex colour's y and x, z 7/255 (a material id?), w the rim term
//   target 2: the view-space normal packed into 0..1, w 0
// Every operation is in the game's order, so the result is bit-identical to it.

layout(set = 1, binding = 3, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;
layout(set = 1, binding = 9, std140) uniform Rim { vec4 d[4096]; } rim;
layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D colour_map;
layout(set = 1, binding = 34) uniform sampler2D dither;

layout(location = 1) in vec4 v_colour;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 v_uv;       // x, y: texture coordinates; z: the alpha test's threshold; w: rim offset
layout(location = 4) in vec4 v_normal;   // view space
layout(location = 14) in vec4 v_view;    // the view-space position
layout(location = 15) in vec4 v_last;    // last frame's clip position
layout(location = 16) in vec4 v_screen;  // (clip.xy + w) / 2, clip.zw

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_motion;
layout(location = 1) out vec4 o_extra;
layout(location = 2) out vec4 o_normal;

void main() {
    // alpha test: the texture's alpha x the material's opacity
    float alpha = texture(colour_map, v_uv.xy).w * material.d[1].w;
    if (alpha < v_uv.z) discard;

    // fading: a 16x16 ordered dither, the pixel stays where the opacity reaches the dither's value
    vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy * 0.0625;
    vec2 f = fract(abs(p));
    vec2 cell = vec2(p.x >= -p.x ? f.x : -f.x, p.y >= -p.y ? f.y : -f.y) * 16.0;
    float threshold = texelFetch(dither, ivec2(trunc(cell)), 0).x;
    if (!(alpha >= threshold)) discard;

    // the rim term: how much the surface faces away from the eye, scaled into 0..1
    vec4 k = rim.d[5];
    vec3 eye = (v_view * inversesqrt(dot(v_view, v_view))).xyz;  // all four components, as the game does
    float r = fma(dot(v_normal.xyz, -eye), k.x - k.y, k.y) + v_uv.w;
    o_extra = vec4(clamp(v_colour.yx, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0274509806,
                   clamp(v_colour.z * (clamp(r * k.z, 0.0, 1.0) * k.w), 0.0, 1.0));

    vec3 n = v_normal.xyz * inversesqrt(dot(v_normal.xyz, v_normal.xyz));
    o_normal = vec4(fma(n, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5)), 0.0);
    o_motion = vec4(fma(-v_last.xy, vec2(1.0 / v_last.w), gl_FragCoord.w * v_screen.xy), gl_FragCoord.z, 0.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/gbuffer_skinned.vert`:

```vert
#version 460
// Our version of the game's skinned G-buffer vertex program b742aa (decision 0026; characters),
// with its interface: constant buffers 1 (view), 2 (object: view x world in rows 4-7, projection x
// view x world in 8-11, last frame's view x world in 16-19), 3 (material), 4 (this frame's bones),
// 5 (last frame's bones), and the outputs gbuffer_skinned.frag reads.
//
// Vertices whose attribute 3's z is at most 0.1 are skinned: up to 8 bones (3x4 each), weights
// eight 16-bit numbers in attribute 4 (low half, high half of each word), bone numbers eight bytes
// in attribute 5 (two per word: low byte, next byte), plus the material's first bone (constants 3
// d0.y, added to each word as the game does). The other vertices aren't moved, and attribute 5
// holds their last frame's position. Every operation is in the game's order, so the result is
// bit-identical to it.

layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std140) uniform View { vec4 d[4096]; } view;
layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std140) uniform Object { vec4 d[4096]; } object;
layout(set = 0, binding = 3, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;
layout(set = 0, binding = 4, std140) uniform Bones { vec4 d[4096]; } bones;
layout(set = 0, binding = 5, std140) uniform LastBones { vec4 d[4096]; } last_bones;

layout(location = 0) in vec4 a_position;
layout(location = 1) in vec4 a_colour;
layout(location = 2) in vec4 a_normal;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 a_uv;       // z: above 0.1 not skinned
layout(location = 4) in uvec4 a_weights;
layout(location = 5) in uvec4 a_bones;   // not skinned: last frame's position (float bits)

layout(location = 1) out vec4 v_colour;
layout(location = 3) out vec4 v_uv;      // x, y: texture coordinates; z: the alpha test's threshold; w: rim offset
layout(location = 4) out vec4 v_normal;  // view space
layout(location = 14) out vec4 v_view;   // view-space position
layout(location = 15) out vec4 v_last;   // last frame's clip position: (x + w) / 2, (y + w) / 2, z, w
layout(location = 16) out vec4 v_screen; // (clip.xy + w) / 2, clip.zw

layout(push_constant) uniform YW4 { uint pos_fix; } yw4;

const float unit = 1.525902190e-05;  // 1 / 65535: the weights sum to 65535

// Bone b's row r in a palette, by vec4 index (3 rows a bone)
#define ROW(pal, b, r) pal.d[(b) * 3u + uint(r)]

void main() {
    float mirror = material.d[0].x;  // -1 mirrors the mesh in x
    vec4 p = vec4(a_position.x * mirror, a_position.yzw);
    vec3 pos, last, normal;
    if (0.1 >= a_uv.z) {
        uvec4 b = uvec4(uint(max(trunc(material.d[0].y), 0.0))) + a_bones;
        uint xl = b.x & 255u, xh = b.x >> 8, yl = b.y & 255u, yh = b.y >> 8;
        uint zl = b.z & 255u, zh = b.z >> 8, wl = b.w & 255u, wh = b.w >> 8;
        float w_xl = float(a_weights.x & 65535u), w_xh = float(a_weights.x >> 16);
        float w_yl = float(a_weights.y & 65535u), w_yh = float(a_weights.y >> 16);
        float w_zl = float(a_weights.z & 65535u), w_zh = float(a_weights.z >> 16);
        float w_wl = float(a_weights.w & 65535u), w_wh = float(a_weights.w >> 16);
        bool eight = 0.0 < w_zl;  // bones 5-8 only when the fifth weight isn't 0

        // this frame's blended matrix, then scaled by 1 / 65535
        vec4 m[3];
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
            vec4 s = w_xh * ROW(bones, xh, r);
            s = fma(vec4(w_xl), ROW(bones, xl, r), s);
            s = fma(vec4(w_yl), ROW(bones, yl, r), s);
            m[r] = fma(vec4(w_yh), ROW(bones, yh, r), s);
        }
        if (eight)
            for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
                vec4 s = fma(ROW(bones, zl, r), vec4(w_zl), m[r]);
                s = fma(vec4(w_zh), ROW(bones, zh, r), s);
                s = fma(ROW(bones, wl, r), vec4(w_wl), s);
                m[r] = fma(ROW(bones, wh, r), vec4(w_wh), s);
            }

        // last frame's, the same way
        vec4 l[3];
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
            vec4 s = w_xh * ROW(last_bones, xh, r);
            s = fma(vec4(w_xl), ROW(last_bones, xl, r), s);
            s = fma(vec4(w_yl), ROW(last_bones, yl, r), s);
            l[r] = fma(vec4(w_yh), ROW(last_bones, yh, r), s);
        }
        if (eight)
            for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
                vec4 s = fma(vec4(w_zl), ROW(last_bones, zl, r), l[r]);
                s = fma(vec4(w_zh), ROW(last_bones, zh, r), s);
                s = fma(vec4(w_wl), ROW(last_bones, wl, r), s);
                l[r] = fma(vec4(w_wh), ROW(last_bones, wh, r), s);
            }

        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) m[r] *= unit;
        last = vec3(dot(p * l[0], vec4(unit)), dot(p * l[1], vec4(unit)), dot(l[2] * p, vec4(unit)));
        pos = vec3(dot(p, m[0]), dot(p, m[1]), dot(p, m[2]));
        normal = vec3(dot(a_normal.xyz, m[0].xyz), dot(a_normal.xyz, m[1].xyz), dot(m[2].xyz, a_normal.xyz));
    } else {
        last = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(a_bones.x) * mirror, uintBitsToFloat(a_bones.yz));
        pos = p.xyz;
        normal = a_normal.xyz;
    }

    // last frame's position: last frame's view x world (rows 16-19), then view constants 28-31
    vec4 lp = vec4(last, a_position.w);
    vec4 lv = vec4(dot(lp, object.d[16]), dot(lp, object.d[17]), dot(lp, object.d[18]), dot(object.d[19], lp));
    float lw = dot(view.d[31], lv);
    v_last = vec4((lw + vec2(dot(lv, view.d[28]), dot(lv, view.d[29]))) * 0.5, dot(lv, view.d[30]), lw);

    vec4 wp = vec4(pos, a_position.w);
    vec4 clip = vec4(dot(wp, object.d[8]), dot(wp, object.d[9]), dot(wp, object.d[10]), dot(object.d[11], wp));
    gl_Position = clip;
    v_screen = vec4((clip.w + clip.xy) * 0.5, clip.zw);

    // the rim term's offset: 0.4 near the camera, rising to 1 by 25.5 units away
    float fade = clamp((25.5 - clip.w) * 0.0392156877, 0.0, 1.0);
    fade = min(fma(-fade, 2.5, 2.5), 1.0);

    vec3 nv = vec3(dot(object.d[4].xyz, normal), dot(object.d[5].xyz, normal), dot(object.d[6].xyz, normal));
    v_normal.xyz = inversesqrt(dot(nv, nv)) * nv;
    v_view = vec4(dot(wp, object.d[4]), dot(wp, object.d[5]), dot(wp, object.d[6]), dot(wp, object.d[7]));

    vec3 uv1 = vec3(a_uv.xy, 1.0);  // through the material's 2x3 texture transform (rows 4, 5)
    v_uv = vec4(dot(uv1, material.d[4].xyz), dot(material.d[5].xyz, uv1), material.d[0].w, 1.0 - min(fade, 0.6));
    v_colour = a_colour;

    if ((yw4.pos_fix & 1u) != 0u) gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;
}

```

`runtime/shaders/lamp_light.frag`:

```frag
// The engine's lamp lights (game program 42759b, with its vertex program 198f41): point lights drawn as
// volumes at a third of the size and added up. Per pixel: the position from the depth (texture 1) through the
// camera's inverse projection, the vector to the light (its view-space position and radius from the vertex
// stage), a falloff of saturate((distance - radius) / -radius)^2 times the light's colour, and N.L with the
// normals (texture 0, 0..1). Operations in the game's order, so the result can match it bit for bit.
// docs/frame.md "Lighting stage".
//
// Ours, faster, the same result (2026-11-18): a pixel that can only add 0 stops early. A light whose colour is 0
// (in daylight every lamp is) reads nothing; a pixel past the light's reach (falloff 0: most of a volume's pixels)
// skips the normals. Both write the (0, 0, 0, 1) the full sum gives there. At 4K with full-size effects the pass
// went from 1.09 / 1.22 / 0.49 ms to 0.49 / 0.45 / 0.18 (busy street, the owner's progress save, schoolyard): its
// reads come from 4K images at a third of the size, so each saved read counts. The normals are read with the
// gradients taken before any pixel stops (textureGrad), not texture()'s own from the neighbours: after an early
// return a neighbour may not be running (AMD, issue #8). The colour is one light's, the same across a volume, so its
// test doesn't split the four pixels of a block.
#version 460

layout(set = 1, binding = 8, std140) uniform Camera {
    vec4 rows[32];  // rows 20..23: the inverse projection
} camera;

layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D normals;  // texture 0
layout(set = 1, binding = 17) uniform sampler2D depth;    // texture 1

layout(location = 1) in vec4 colour;  // the light's
layout(location = 3) in vec4 light;   // xyz its view-space position, w its radius (as the vertex stage gives it)
layout(location = 4) in vec4 screen;  // xy the clip position mapped to 0..w

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_light;

void main() {
    vec2 s = (screen * gl_FragCoord.wwww).xy;
    vec2 at = vec2(s.x, -s.y + 1.0);
    vec2 at_dx = dFdx(at), at_dy = dFdy(at);  // while every pixel of the block runs
    if (colour.x == 0.0 && colour.y == 0.0 && colour.z == 0.0) {
        o_light = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        return;
    }
    vec4 clip = vec4(fma(at, vec2(2.0, -2.0), vec2(-1.0, 1.0)), textureGrad(depth, at, at_dx, at_dy).x, 1.0);
    float w = dot(clip, camera.rows[23]);
    vec3 pos = vec3(dot(clip, camera.rows[20]), dot(clip, camera.rows[21]), dot(camera.rows[22], clip));
    vec3 to_light = fma(-pos, vec3(1.0 / w), light.xyz);
    float inv_len = inversesqrt(abs(dot(to_light, to_light)));
    float falloff = clamp(((-light.w) + 1.0 / inv_len) / (-light.w), 0.0, 1.0);
    if (falloff == 0.0) {
        o_light = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        return;
    }
    vec3 lit = (falloff * falloff) * colour.xyz;
    vec3 n = (textureGrad(normals, at, at_dx, at_dy).xyz + -0.5) * 2.0;
    float ndl = clamp(dot(n, inv_len * to_light), 0.0, 1.0);
    o_light = vec4(ndl * lit, 1.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/lighting_inputs.frag`:

```frag
// The engine's lighting inputs (game program 790774, f_7f4c90, with the full-screen quad 98c09b): at half
// size, the shadow mask and two more factors packed into one target, and the normals unpacked into a
// second, each with the linear depth. Read by the full-screen lighting pass. docs/frame.md "Lighting stage".
#version 460

layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D mask;     // texture 0: the shadow mask (x shadow, y linear depth)
layout(set = 1, binding = 17) uniform sampler2D factor1;  // texture 1 (1x1 in the town by day)
layout(set = 1, binding = 18) uniform sampler2D factor2;  // texture 2 (1x1 in the town by day)
layout(set = 1, binding = 19) uniform sampler2D normals;  // texture 3: the half-size G-buffer normals (0..1)

layout(location = 3) in vec4 uv;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_factors;  // shadow, factor 1, factor 2, linear depth
layout(location = 1) out vec4 o_normal;   // normal in -1..1, linear depth

void main() {
    vec2 m = texture(mask, uv.xy).xy;
    vec3 n = texture(normals, uv.xy).xyz;
    o_normal = vec4((n + -0.5) * 2.0, m.y);  // the game's operations: add -0.5, then times 2
    o_factors = vec4(m.x, texture(factor1, uv.xy).x, texture(factor2, uv.xy).x, m.y);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/material_main.frag`:

```frag
#version 460
// Our version of the lit material pass's main fragment program 5eb3b2 (decision 0026): the scene's
// surfaces shaded with their materials, after the G-buffer and the half-resolution light passes.
// Same interface as the game's program. Every operation is in the game's order (fma where it
// fuses), so the result is bit-identical to it; names are what the values seem to be, "?" where
// unsure.
//
// Inputs:
//   constants 3 (material: d2.x emissive strength, d2.w > 0 fog on), 6 (scene lighting: d0 tint,
//   d1 shadow colour, d2 sun direction, d4 sun colour, d37.y indirect strength, d46 ambient
//   occlusion colour, d49 minimum light / d49.w smoothness scale, d50 ambient cube colour, d52
//   reflection and emissive scales), 7 (material: d0.z opacity floor, d1.x specular strength, d1.y
//   specular power, d2 x reflectance... , d6.y bump), 8 (view: d0 camera position, d10-d11 depth
//   linearisation, d32 half-res texel offsets, d34-d47 fog and sky), 12 (reflection box: rows 0-2)
//   textures: 0 colour (alpha: opacity), 1 normal map (x, y normal, z metalness, w smoothness),
//   9 the reflection cube, 13 and 20 half-res depths, 14 half-res shadow/occlusion (x shadow, y
//   occlusion, z ?), 19 half-res indirect light, 21 and 22 what is behind the surface (colour,
//   depth: for blending soft edges)

layout(set = 1, binding = 3, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;
layout(set = 1, binding = 6, std140) uniform Lighting { vec4 d[4096]; } lighting;
layout(set = 1, binding = 7, std140) uniform Surface { vec4 d[4096]; } surface;
layout(set = 1, binding = 8, std140) uniform View { vec4 d[4096]; } view;
layout(set = 1, binding = 12, std140) uniform Box { vec4 d[4096]; } box;
layout(set = 1, binding = 16) uniform sampler2D colour_map;
layout(set = 1, binding = 17) uniform sampler2D normal_map;
layout(set = 1, binding = 25) uniform samplerCube reflection;
layout(set = 1, binding = 29) uniform sampler2D half_depth;     // for the shadow buffer's resolution
layout(set = 1, binding = 30) uniform sampler2D half_shadow;
layout(set = 1, binding = 35) uniform sampler2D half_indirect;
layout(set = 1, binding = 36) uniform sampler2D half_depth2;    // for the indirect light's resolution
layout(set = 1, binding = 37) uniform sampler2D behind_colour;
layout(set = 1, binding = 38) uniform sampler2D behind_depth;

layout(location = 1) in vec4 v_colour;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 v_uv;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 v_normal;
layout(location = 6) in vec4 v_world;
layout(location = 14) in vec4 v_screen;
layout(location = 18) in vec4 v_tangent;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 o_colour;

const vec3 luma = vec3(0.298909992, 0.586610019, 0.114480004);

// Depth-aware upsampling of a half-resolution buffer: from the four neighbours' depths around
// this pixel (left/right `step.x` apart, up/down `step.y`), where this pixel's depth falls between
// them, as an offset of -step..step (0 where the neighbours agree). The game adds each axis's
// part as a vector with a 0 in the other lane: kept, because a NaN (neighbours at the same depth)
// times that 0 is NaN in both lanes.
vec2 upsample_offset(float d_left, float d_right, float d_up, float d_down, float depth, vec2 step) {
    vec2 g = vec2(d_right - d_left, d_down - d_up);
    vec2 t = clamp(vec2(depth - d_left, depth - d_up) * vec2(1.0 / g.x, 1.0 / g.y), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec2 f = fma(vec2(lessThan(vec2(0.0), abs(g))), t - 0.5, vec2(0.5));
    vec2 y_part = fma(vec2(f.y), vec2(0.0, step.y * 2.0), -vec2(0.0, step.y));
    vec2 x_part = fma(vec2(f.x), vec2(step.x * 2.0, 0.0), -vec2(step.x, 0.0));
    return y_part + x_part;
}

void main() {
    // ---- the surface normal: the normal map through the tangent frame (as gbuffer_frag.glsl)
    vec4 nmap = texture(normal_map, v_uv.xy);
    vec4 albedo = texture(colour_map, v_uv.xy);
    vec4 t = v_tangent * inversesqrt(dot(v_tangent, v_tangent));
    vec3 n = v_normal.xyz * inversesqrt(dot(v_normal.xyz, v_normal.xyz));
    vec3 b = fma(n.yzx, t.zxy, -(n.zxy * t.yzx)) * t.w;
    float bump = surface.d[6].y;
    vec3 d = vec3((nmap.xy - 0.5) * bump * 2.0, 1.0);
    d = d * inversesqrt(dot(d, d));
    d = fma(fma(d, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5)), vec3(2.0), vec3(-1.0));
    d.xy *= bump;
    vec3 nw = fma(n, vec3(d.z), fma(t.xyz, vec3(d.x), b * d.y));
    nw *= inversesqrt(dot(nw, nw));

    // ---- the reflection direction, corrected for the reflection box (constants 12) when inside it
    vec3 eye = view.d[0].xyz - v_world.xyz;  // towards the camera
    eye *= inversesqrt(dot(eye, eye));
    vec3 refl = fma(nw * -dot(-eye, nw), vec3(2.0), -eye);
    vec3 rb = vec3(dot(refl, box.d[0].xyz), dot(refl, box.d[1].xyz), dot(box.d[2].xyz, refl));
    vec4 wp = vec4(v_world.xyz, 1.0);
    vec3 pb = vec3(dot(box.d[0], wp), dot(box.d[1], wp), dot(box.d[2], wp));  // the box is -1..1
    rb *= inversesqrt(dot(rb, rb));
    vec3 inv = vec3(1.0 / rb.x, 1.0 / rb.y, 1.0 / rb.z);
    vec3 exit = max(fma(-pb, inv, inv), fma(-pb, inv, -inv));
    bool inside = all(greaterThanEqual(vec3(1.0), abs(pb)));
    vec3 hit = fma(rb, vec3(min(exit.z, min(exit.y, exit.x))), pb);
    vec3 refl_dir = inside ? inversesqrt(dot(hit, hit)) * hit : rb;

    // ---- the material
    vec3 m2 = surface.d[2].xyz;
    float metal = nmap.z;
    vec3 f0 = max(vec3(m2.y), albedo.xyz * metal);                // specular colour
    float s = nmap.w * lighting.d[49].w;
    float rough = max(s * s, 9.999999750e-05);
    float alpha = clamp(albedo.w, 0.0, 1.0);
    float occl_strength = m2.x * alpha;
    float gloss = fma(-nmap.w, lighting.d[49].w, 1.0);
    float gloss2 = gloss * gloss, rough2 = rough * rough;
    float max_mip = float(textureQueryLevels(reflection)) + -1.0;
    vec3 diffuse = fma(albedo.xyz, vec3(-metal), albedo.xyz);      // albedo x (1 - metalness)
    float refl_mip = fma(max_mip, -gloss2 * gloss2, max_mip);
    float refl_scale = lighting.d[52].y * m2.z;
    float spec_scale = surface.d[1].x * lighting.d[52].x;
    float emissive = lighting.d[52].z * material.d[2].x;

    // ---- this pixel on the screen, and the half-res buffers sampled around it
    vec2 sp = v_screen.xy * gl_FragCoord.w;
    float depth = v_screen.z * gl_FragCoord.w;
    vec2 uv = vec2(sp.x, -sp.y) + vec2(0.0, 1.0);
    vec4 step = view.d[32];  // x, y: the shadow buffer's texel; z, w: the indirect light's
    float d_up = texture(half_depth, vec2(uv.x, uv.y - step.y)).x;
    float d_left = texture(half_depth, vec2(uv.x - step.x, uv.y)).x;
    float d_right = texture(half_depth, vec2(sp.x + step.x, uv.y)).x;
    float d_down = texture(half_depth, vec2(uv.x, uv.y + step.y)).x;
    vec3 shadow_occl = texture(half_shadow, uv + upsample_offset(d_left, d_right, d_up, d_down, depth, step.xy)).xyz;
    vec3 occlusion = fma(vec3(shadow_occl.y), lighting.d[46].xyz, vec3(-shadow_occl.y)) + 1.0;

    // ---- the sun: shadow (from the buffer, and where the surface turns away), Blinn-Phong/GGX-like specular
    float sun_len = inversesqrt(dot(lighting.d[2].xyz, lighting.d[2].xyz));
    vec3 sun = sun_len * lighting.d[2].xyz;
    float n_l = dot(nw, sun);
    float shade = max(clamp((n_l + -0.200000003) * -10.0, 0.0, 1.0), shadow_occl.x);
    float d2_left = texture(half_depth2, vec2(uv.x - step.z, uv.y)).x;
    float d2_up = texture(half_depth2, vec2(uv.x, uv.y - step.w)).x;
    float d2_right = texture(half_depth2, vec2(sp.x + step.z, uv.y)).x;
    float d2_down = texture(half_depth2, vec2(uv.x, uv.y + step.w)).x;
    float shade1 = min(shade, 1.0);
    vec3 shadow = fma(lighting.d[1].xyz, vec3(shade1), vec3(-shade1)) + 1.0;  // 1 lit .. the shadow colour
    vec3 h = fma(vec3(sun_len), lighting.d[2].xyz, eye);
    h *= inversesqrt(max(dot(h, h), 0.00100000005));
    float n_h = clamp(dot(nw, h), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec2 offset2 = upsample_offset(d2_left, d2_right, d2_up, d2_down, depth, step.zw);
    float l_h = clamp(dot(sun, h), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 occl_term = fma(-shadow * occlusion, vec3(occl_strength), vec3(occl_strength));
    float p = exp2(log2(n_h) * surface.d[1].y);
    float dn = fma(rough * rough, p, -p) + 1.00001001;
    float vis = (rough + 0.5) * max(l_h * l_h, 0.100000001);
    float spec = spec_scale / inversesqrt(max(rough2 / (dn * dn * vis) * 0.25, 9.999999750e-05));
    vec3 sun_spec = spec * lighting.d[4].xyz;
    sun_spec = fma(vec3(-shade), sun_spec, sun_spec);
    vec3 indirect = texture(half_indirect, uv + offset2).xyz;
    vec3 base = fma(f0, sun_spec, diffuse);

    // ---- light: the sun's diffuse and the indirect light, ambient and reflections from the cube map
    float n_v = clamp(dot(nw, eye), 0.0, 1.0);
    float omv = -n_v + 1.0;
    vec3 light = fma(lighting.d[4].xyz, vec3(clamp(n_l, 0.0, 1.0)), indirect * lighting.d[37].y);
    float omv2 = omv * omv, omv4 = omv2 * omv2;
    float fresnel = fma(-m2.y, omv4, omv4) + m2.y;
    vec3 lit = base * max(light, lighting.d[49].xyz);
    vec3 irradiance = textureLod(reflection, nw, max_mip).xyz;
    vec3 ambient = lighting.d[50].w * lighting.d[50].xyz;
    float k_refl = gloss * (refl_scale * fresnel);
    vec3 amb = diffuse * (ambient * irradiance);
    vec3 c = fma(lit, vec3(0.666000009), fma(vec3(-k_refl), amb, amb));
    vec3 f0s = f0 * -lighting.d[52].w;
    vec3 env = textureLod(reflection, refl_dir, refl_mip).xyz;
    vec3 refl_weight = fma(f0, vec3(lighting.d[52].w), fma(f0s, vec3(k_refl), vec3(k_refl)));
    c = fma(env * ambient, refl_weight, c);
    float out_alpha = fma(surface.d[0].z, -alpha + 1.0, alpha);
    vec3 glow = emissive * albedo.xyz;
    vec4 colour = vec4(fma(c * lighting.d[0].xyz, fma(shadow, occlusion, occl_term), out_alpha * glow), out_alpha);
    colour *= v_colour;  // as the game: (y, z, w, x) times (y, z, w, x)

    // ---- fog and sky scattering towards the camera (material constants 3 d2.w > 0)
    vec3 inscatter;
    float transmit;
    if (0.0 < material.d[2].w) {
        vec3 vdir = v_world.xyz - view.d[0].xyz;
        float inv_dist = inversesqrt(dot(vdir, vdir));
        vdir = inv_dist * vdir;
        vec3 c35 = view.d[35].xyz, c36 = view.d[36].xyz, c37 = view.d[37].xyz;
        vec3 band_a = view.d[34].xyz - c35;
        vec2 hz = vec2(view.d[47].y, view.d[47].x) + 1.0;
        vec2 hz_k = hz * vec2(0.115999997, 0.216000006);
        float far = min(0.00400000019 / inv_dist, 1.0);
        float inv_a = 1.0 / fma(hz.y, 0.216000006, -hz_k.x);
        vec2 up_zw = fma(vec2(vdir.y), vec2(far), hz_k);
        float up_x = fma(vdir.y, far, -hz_k.x);
        float up = vdir.y * far;  // how far up the view ray climbs
        float inv_k = 1.0 / hz_k.x;
        vec4 band = clamp(vec4(inv_a, inv_k, inv_k, inv_a) * vec4(up_x, up, up_zw), 0.0, 1.0);
        float g = view.d[44].x;  // the sun's halo (phase function asymmetry)
        vec3 sky = fma(vec3(band.x), band_a, c35);
        vec2 g2 = fma(vec2(g), vec2(g), vec2(2.0, 1.0));
        vec3 sky_mid = fma(vec3(band.z), c36 - c37, c37);
        vec3 sky_high = fma(vec3(band.y), c35 - c36, c36);
        float cos_sun = dot(vdir, lighting.d[2].xyz);
        float phase_d = -dot(vec2(cos_sun), vec2(g)) + g2.y;
        vec3 sky_low = fma(vec3(band.w), c37 - view.d[38].xyz, view.d[38].xyz);
        float cos2 = cos_sun * cos_sun;
        float mie_k = fma(-g * g, 1.0 / g2.x, 1.0 / g2.x);
        float mie = fma(cos2, exp2(-(log2(abs(phase_d)) * 1.5)), exp2(-(log2(abs(phase_d)) * 1.5))) * mie_k;
        float rayleigh = fma(cos2, 0.0596831031, 0.0596831031);  // 3 / (16 pi) (1 + cos^2)
        float mie_phase = mie * 0.119366206;                     // 3 / (8 pi)
        float ray12 = min(rayleigh * 12.0, 1.0);
        bool above_low = up >= -hz_k.x, above_high = up >= hz_k.x, rising = up >= 0.0;
        float dist = 1.0 / inv_dist;
        vec3 horizon = !above_low ? sky_low : sky_mid;
        if (rising) horizon = sky_high;
        if (!above_high) sky = horizon;
        vec4 c45 = view.d[45], c43 = view.d[43];
        vec2 fd = max(vec2(dist + c43.x, c45.z + dist), 0.0);
        vec2 blend = clamp(vec2(up, up_zw.y) / hz_k.y, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec2 c46 = view.d[46].xy;
        float height = (v_world.y + -c45.x) * c45.y * -1.44269502;
        vec3 c41 = view.d[41].xyz, c42 = view.d[42].xyz;
        vec3 sun_col_lo = fma(vec3(blend.y), c41 - c42, c42);
        vec3 sun_col_hi = fma(vec3(blend.x), view.d[40].xyz - c41, c41);
        float height_f = exp2(height);
        float sat = clamp(fd.x * c43.w, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec4 e = vec4(fd.x * c43.yz, c45.w * fd.y, fd.y * c46.x) * 1.44269502;
        vec4 absorb = -vec4(exp2(e.x), exp2(e.y), exp2(e.z), exp2(e.w)) + 1.0;
        vec4 amount = vec4(ray12, mie_phase, height_f, mie_phase * height_f) * absorb;
        float sky_luma = dot(sky, luma);
        sky = fma(vec3(sat), -sky_luma + sky, vec3(sky_luma));
        vec3 sun_col = fma(vec3(rising ? 1.0 : 0.0), sun_col_hi - sun_col_lo, sun_col_lo);
        vec2 amount_c = clamp(amount.zw, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec3 sun_scatter = fma(vec3(amount.y), sun_col, amount_c.y * sun_col);
        vec3 c39 = view.d[39].xyz;
        float c39_luma = dot(c39, luma);
        float sat2 = clamp(fd.y * c46.y, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec3 haze = fma(vec3(sat2), -c39_luma + c39, vec3(c39_luma)) * amount_c.x;
        vec4 s4 = vec4(amount.x * sky, amount.x) + vec4(haze, amount.z);
        inscatter = s4.xyz + sun_scatter;
        transmit = max(-s4.w + 1.0, 0.0) * max(fma(mie_phase, -absorb.y, 1.0), 0.0);
    } else {
        inscatter = vec3(0.0);
        transmit = 1.0;
    }

    // ---- fogged colour, then blended with what is behind by the depth difference (soft edges)
    vec3 behind = texture(behind_colour, uv).xyz;
    vec3 fogged = fma(colour.xyz, vec3(transmit), inscatter * clamp(shadow_occl.z + view.d[44].y, 0.0, 1.0));
    vec2 dd = vec2(texture(behind_depth, uv).x, depth);
    vec2 lin = fma(-dd, vec2(view.d[11].w), vec2(view.d[10].w)) *
               vec2(1.0 / fma(dd.x, view.d[11].z, -view.d[10].z), 1.0 / fma(dd.y, view.d[11].z, -view.d[10].z));
    float k = clamp(abs(lin.y + -lin.x) / lighting.d[39].y, 0.0, 1.0);
    o_colour = vec4(fma(vec3(k), fogged + -behind, behind), colour.w);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/material_main.vert`:

```vert
#version 460
// Our version of the lit material pass's main vertex program 046b2a (decision 0026), with its
// interface: constant buffers 2 (object: world in rows 0-2, projection x view x world in 8-11) and
// 3 (material), and the outputs its fragment programs read. Every operation is in the game's order.

layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std140) uniform Object { vec4 d[4096]; } object;
layout(set = 0, binding = 3, std140) uniform Material { vec4 d[4096]; } material;

layout(location = 0) in vec4 a_position;
layout(location = 1) in vec4 a_colour;
layout(location = 2) in vec4 a_normal;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 a_tangent;  // w: the bitangent's sign
layout(location = 4) in vec4 a_uv;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 a_uv2;      // a second set of texture coordinates (light maps?)

layout(location = 1) out vec4 v_colour;   // vertex colour x material colour
layout(location = 3) out vec4 v_uv;       // x, y: through the material's texture transform; z, w: the second set
layout(location = 5) out vec4 v_normal;   // world space, w 0
layout(location = 6) out vec4 v_world;    // world position, w 1
layout(location = 14) out vec4 v_screen;  // (clip.xy + w) / 2, clip.zw
layout(location = 18) out vec4 v_tangent; // world space, w: sign
layout(location = 25) out vec4 v_flag;

layout(push_constant) uniform YW4 { uint pos_fix; } yw4;

void main() {
    float mirror = material.d[0].x;  // -1 mirrors the mesh in x
    vec4 p = vec4(a_position.x * mirror, a_position.yzw);

    vec4 clip = vec4(dot(p, object.d[8]), dot(p, object.d[9]), dot(p, object.d[10]), dot(object.d[11], p));
    gl_Position = clip;
    v_screen = vec4((clip.w + clip.xy) * 0.5, clip.zw);

    v_world = vec4(dot(p, object.d[0]), dot(p, object.d[1]), dot(p, object.d[2]), 1.0);
    vec4 t = mirror * a_tangent;
    v_tangent = vec4(dot(object.d[0].xyz, t.xyz), dot(object.d[1].xyz, t.xyz), dot(object.d[2].xyz, t.xyz), t.w);
    v_normal = vec4(dot(a_normal.xyz, object.d[0].xyz), dot(a_normal.xyz, object.d[1].xyz),
                    dot(object.d[2].xyz, a_normal.xyz), 0.0);

    vec3 uv1 = vec3(a_uv.xy, 1.0);  // through the material's 2x3 texture transform (rows 4, 5)
    v_uv = vec4(dot(uv1, material.d[4].xyz), dot(material.d[5].xyz, uv1), a_uv2.xy);
    v_colour = a_colour * material.d[1];
    v_flag = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

    if ((yw4.pos_fix & 1u) != 0u) gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5;
}

```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_cutout.frag`:

```frag
// Cut-out shadow casters (decision 0024): as the game's dceb89..., drop the fragment where
// the material's texture is more transparent than its threshold. Depth only.
#version 450

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D tex;

layout(location = 3) in vec4 cut;

void main() {
    if (texture(tex, cut.xy).w < cut.z) discard;
}
```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_cutout.vert`:

```vert
// Cut-out shadow casters (decision 0024): the position as shadow_static.vert; the texture
// coordinates and the material's alpha threshold go to the fragment stage, as the game's
// 744205... hands them to its fragment shader dceb89... (attribute 3: uv, threshold, 1).
#version 450

layout(location = 0) in vec3 position;
layout(location = 1) in vec4 uv;

layout(push_constant) uniform Draw {
    vec4 row[4];      // projection x view x world, row-major
    float threshold;  // the material's: vertex constant buffer 3, byte 12
} draw;

layout(location = 3) out vec4 cut;

void main() {
    vec4 v = vec4(position, 1.0);
    gl_Position = vec4(dot(draw.row[0], v), dot(draw.row[1], v), dot(draw.row[2], v), dot(draw.row[3], v));
    cut = vec4(uv.xy, draw.threshold, 1.0);
}

```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_fade.frag`:

```frag
// Fading instanced shadow casters (decision 0024): as the game's b7cd6e..., drop the fragment
// where the copy's fade is below the 16x16 dither texture at the pixel (mod 16). The fade comes
// per copy (shadow_instanced.vert), decoded from the copy as the game's 9904c2... does. Depth only.
#version 450

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D dither;

layout(location = 4) flat in float fade;

void main() {
    ivec2 p = ivec2(trunc(fract(gl_FragCoord.xy * 0.0625) * 16.0));
    if (fade < texelFetch(dither, p, 0).x) discard;
}

```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_fade_cutout.frag`:

```frag
// Fading instanced cut-out shadow casters (decision 0024): as the game's d5f536..., the cut-out
// test of shadow_cutout.frag, then the dither test of shadow_fade.frag. Depth only.
#version 450

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D tex;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D dither;

layout(location = 3) in vec4 cut;
layout(location = 4) flat in float fade;

void main() {
    if (texture(tex, cut.xy).w < cut.z) discard;
    ivec2 p = ivec2(trunc(fract(gl_FragCoord.xy * 0.0625) * 16.0));
    if (fade < texelFetch(dither, p, 0).x) discard;
}
```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_instanced.vert`:

```vert
// Instanced shadow casters (decision 0024): one draw for all the copies the game's callback kept,
// as the game draws them. Each copy's projection x view x copy x world (rows, multiplied on the
// CPU) and its fade come from the copies ring (set 1), at the draw's first instance + i; then as
// shadow_static.vert. The fade goes to the fading programs' fragment stage (1 when not fading).
#version 450

layout(location = 0) in vec3 position;

struct Copy {
    vec4 row[4];  // projection x view x copy x world, row-major
    vec4 extra;   // x: fade
};
layout(set = 1, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Copies {
    Copy copy[];
} copies;

layout(location = 4) flat out float fade;

void main() {
    Copy c = copies.copy[gl_InstanceIndex];
    vec4 v = vec4(position, 1.0);
    gl_Position = vec4(dot(c.row[0], v), dot(c.row[1], v), dot(c.row[2], v), dot(c.row[3], v));
    fade = c.extra.x;
}

```

`runtime/shaders/shadow_instanced_cutout.vert`:

```vert
// Instanced cut-out shadow casters (decision 0024): the copies as shadow_instanced.vert, the
// texture coordinates and threshold as shadow_cutout.vert.
#version 450

layout(location = 0) in vec3 position;
layout(location = 1) in vec4 uv;

struct Copy {
    vec4 row[4];  // projection x view x copy x world, row-major
    vec4 extra;   // x: fade
};
layout(set = 1, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Copies {
    Copy copy[];
} copies;

layout(push_constant) uniform Draw {
    float threshold;  // the material's: vertex constant buffer 3, byte 12
} draw;

layout(location = 3) out vec4 cut;
layout(location = 4) flat out float fade;

void main() {
    Copy c = copies.copy[gl_InstanceIndex];
    vec4 v = vec4(position, 1.0);
    gl_Position = vec4(dot(c.row[0], v), dot(c.row[1], v), dot(c.row[2], v), dot(c.row[3], v));
    cut = vec4(uv.xy, draw.threshold, 1.0);
    fade = c.extra.x;
}
```
