`runtime/src/cheats.c`:

```c
/* The game's "save one byte by ID" script command (main+0x296560, registered at startup as command 0xd0c06ed4 in the
 * table main+0xe7b0 fills): a script passes an ID and a value; the ID is found in a sorted table of (ID u32, slot
 * u16) pairs, and the value is stored as one byte at [save data + slot + 0x288]. The Crank-a-kai menu's script keeps
 * the day's cranks left this way (found 2026-11-15: one write per crank, 29 28 27; the save holds the count at
 * offset 0x822 of AUTOSAVE/data.bin with the day's limit, 30, in the next byte).
 *
 * The hook runs just before the store (main+0x2966a8): x9 holds the ID, x20 the new value, x8 the table entry.
 *
 * YW4_TRACE_SAVEBYTE=1: every store that changes a byte is logged (ID, slot, old -> new); unchanged ones are counted
 * and summed up every 1000. Tests: which IDs go through the command. In the owner's play (2026-11-15) only the
 * Crank-a-kai's three used it: a45a65ec (slot 11) cranks left today, 3 -> 30 at the day's reset then one down per
 * crank; 9076e662 (slot 12) the day's limit, 3 -> 30 at the reset; 2f508d80 (slot 13) a byte set at the reset (30 -> 5;
 * other runs 8, 15, 3).
 *
 * YW4_CHEAT_CRANK=1: unlimited cranks. A store that would lower the cranks left (a45a65ec) keeps the old value; the
 * day's reset (a raise) still happens, and the coins are spent as usual (an item count, elsewhere in the save). Read
 * at every store, so the overlay's Cheats page (settings.c) switches it while the game runs. Tested in the owner's
 * play, 2026-11-15: the count stayed at 30, coins went down.
 *
 * YW4_CHEATS=0 (the launcher's "Cheats" off): the Cheats page is hidden and no cheat acts, whatever settings.ini
 * says (owner, 2026-11-15, design canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/XcwzdE1gju4aNQJgxgE2e5 option B). */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cheats.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

enum { CRANKS_LEFT = 0xa45a65ec };

static int trace = -1;
static unsigned long unchanged;
static int crank_on = -1;  /* -1: not read yet; the overlay's Cheats page sets 0 or 1 while the game runs */

static int env_on(const char *name) {
    const char *e = getenv(name);
    return e && *e && *e != '0';
}

int cheats_allowed(void) {
    static int allowed = -1;
    if (allowed < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_CHEATS");
        allowed = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0"));
    }
    return allowed;
}

int cheat_crank_get(void) {
    int v = __atomic_load_n(&crank_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (v < 0) {
        v = env_on("YW4_CHEAT_CRANK");
        __atomic_store_n(&crank_on, v, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    return v;
}

/* The saved byte of ID `id`, found as the command finds it (main+0x296560): the globals at main+0x1548fd8, their ID
 * table at +0x138 (entries at +0x60: ID u32, slot u16 at +4, 8 bytes each; their count at +0x68), the save data at
 * +0x5768, the byte at slot + 0x288. NULL before the save data is there, or without the ID. */
static uint8_t *saved_byte(uint32_t id) {
    uint64_t globals, table, entries, base;
    memcpy(&globals, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(yw4_image_base + 0x1548fd8), 8);
    if (!globals) return NULL;
    memcpy(&table, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(globals + 0x138), 8);
    memcpy(&base, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(globals + 0x5768), 8);
    if (!table || !base) return NULL;
    memcpy(&entries, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(table + 0x60), 8);
    uint32_t count;
    memcpy(&count, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(table + 0x68), 4);
    if (!entries) return NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint32_t e;
        memcpy(&e, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(entries + i * 8ull), 4);
        if (e != id) continue;
        uint16_t slot;
        memcpy(&slot, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(entries + i * 8ull + 4), 2);
        return (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(base + slot + 0x288);
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* Turned on with no cranks left (0, or 255: -1 as a byte), the count becomes 1 so the next crank can happen; it then
 * stays there (owner, 2026-11-15). The Crank-a-kai menu shows it the next time it opens. */
void cheat_crank_toggle(void) {
    int v = !cheat_crank_get();
    __atomic_store_n(&crank_on, v, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cheat: unlimited Crank-a-kai cranks %s\n", v ? "on" : "off");
    if (!v || !cheats_allowed()) return;
    uint8_t *left = saved_byte(CRANKS_LEFT);
    if (left && (*left == 0 || *left == 0xff)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cheat: cranks left was %d, now 1\n", *left == 0xff ? -1 : 0);
        *left = 1;
    }
}

/* Unlimited coins (YW4_CHEAT_COINS=1): spending a Crank-a-kai coin leaves the coin's count as it was.
 *
 * The game's "remove items" function (main+0x4f2e90: x0 an inventory handle, w1 how many) takes coins off. In the
 * owner's play (2026-11-17, YW4_TRACE_ITEMREMOVE) a crank with a Crank-a-Coin, a One-Star Coin and an Old Coin each
 * made one call (count 1); all three went the same way: at main+0x4f3038 the item's ID (the item_config's
 * ITEM_CONSUME_INFO hash) is in w21 and the count to take off in w19, which the store at main+0x4f32c4 subtracts
 * (count - w19, at least 0; a count left at 0 removes the item). The cheat makes w19 0 there for the ten coins, so
 * the count stays and the crank still counts as paid. Not the script command the Crank-a-kai calls (0x195e1fd9,
 * main+0x293760, "remove 1 of this item"): ~20 other scripts use it too (events, the battle item menu, the skill tree
 * reset, equipment making), so the coins are told by item. Read at every call, so the Cheats page switches it live.
 *
 * YW4_TRACE_ITEMREMOVE=1 (a test tool): every call, its item ID and its result are logged. */
static const uint32_t COINS[] = {
    0x21102731, /* Crank-a-Coin */
    0x2c0d27fb, /* One-Star Coin */
    0x351616ba, /* Five-Star Coin */
    0x1e3b4579, /* Special Coin */
    0x07207438, /* Old Coin */
    0x50b8b989, /* Y Coin */
    0x517ad3be, /* Ark Coin */
    0x80b868f7, /* Oni Coin */
    0x99a359b6, /* Super Oni Coin */
    0x49a388c8, /* Ultra Oni Coin */
};
static int coins_on = -1;  /* -1: not read yet; the Cheats page sets 0 or 1 while the game runs */
static int item_trace = -1;

int cheat_coins_get(void) {
    int v = __atomic_load_n(&coins_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (v < 0) {
        v = env_on("YW4_CHEAT_COINS");
        __atomic_store_n(&coins_on, v, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    return v;
}

void cheat_coins_toggle(void) {
    int v = !cheat_coins_get();
    __atomic_store_n(&coins_on, v, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cheat: unlimited Crank-a-kai coins %s\n", v ? "on" : "off");
}

static int item_trace_on(void) {
    if (item_trace < 0) item_trace = env_on("YW4_TRACE_ITEMREMOVE");
    return item_trace;
}

static int is_coin(uint32_t id) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof COINS / sizeof *COINS; i++)
        if (COINS[i] == id) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* The function's start (main+0x4f2e90): the trace only. */
int yw4_hook_item_remove(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (!item_trace_on()) return 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: itemremove: handle %08" PRIx32 " (type %u slot %u) count %u from main+%#llx\n",
            (uint32_t)ctx->x[0], (unsigned)((ctx->x[0] >> 12) & 0xf), (unsigned)(ctx->x[0] & 0xfff),
            (unsigned)(uint32_t)ctx->x[1], (unsigned long long)(ctx->x[30] - yw4_image_base));
    return 0;
}

/* After the item lookups (main+0x4f3038): w21 the item's ID, w19 the count to take off. */
int yw4_hook_item_remove_id(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint32_t id = (uint32_t)ctx->x[21];
    int keep = cheats_allowed() && cheat_coins_get() && is_coin(id);
    if (item_trace_on())
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: itemremove: id %08" PRIx32 " count %u%s\n", id, (unsigned)(uint32_t)ctx->x[19],
                keep ? " -> 0 (unlimited coins)" : "");
    if (keep) ctx->x[19] = 0;
    return 0;
}

/* The end of every path (main+0x4f31a4): w21 the result; the trace only. */
int yw4_hook_item_remove_end(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (item_trace_on()) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: itemremove: result %u\n", (unsigned)(uint32_t)ctx->x[21]);
    return 0;
}

int yw4_hook_save_byte(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (trace < 0) trace = env_on("YW4_TRACE_SAVEBYTE");
    int crank = cheats_allowed() && cheat_crank_get();
    uint32_t id = (uint32_t)ctx->x[9];
    if (!trace && !(crank && id == CRANKS_LEFT)) return 0;
    uint8_t value = (uint8_t)ctx->x[20];
    uint16_t slot;
    memcpy(&slot, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(ctx->x[8] + 4), 2);
    uint64_t globals;  /* the same loads as the game's next instructions */
    memcpy(&globals, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(yw4_image_base + 0x1548fd8), 8);
    uint64_t base;
    memcpy(&base, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(globals + 0x5768), 8);
    uint8_t old = *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(base + slot + 0x288);
    if (crank && id == CRANKS_LEFT && value < old) {
        ctx->x[20] = old;  /* the game's store writes x20 */
        if (trace) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cheat: cranks left kept at %u (would be %u)\n", (unsigned)old, (unsigned)value);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!trace) return 0;
    if (old != value)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: savebyte: id %08" PRIx32 " slot %u: %u -> %u\n", id, (unsigned)slot, (unsigned)old,
                (unsigned)value);
    else if (++unchanged % 1000 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: savebyte: %lu stores left a byte as it was\n", unchanged);
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/crypto.c`:

```c
/* ARMv8 Crypto extension: AESE/AESD/AESMC/AESIMC, SHA1*, SHA256* (decision 0014).
 *
 * Written from the Arm ARM pseudocode (DDI 0487, "Shared/functions/crypto"). Used by the
 * sdk's nn::crypto. Checked like every other instruction: golden results from the Pi.
 *
 * AES state: register byte i is state[row i % 4][column i / 4], as in FIPS-197's input
 * order. The S-box is computed from its definition (inverse in GF(2^8), then the affine
 * map) on first use rather than typed in.
 */
#include "yw4cpu.h"

static uint8_t sbox[256], inv_sbox[256];

static uint8_t gmul(uint8_t a, uint8_t b) {
    uint8_t r = 0;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) r ^= a;
        a = (uint8_t)(a << 1) ^ (a & 0x80 ? 0x1B : 0);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

static void init_sbox(void) {
    if (sbox[0]) return;  /* sbox[0] = 0x63 once built */
    for (int x = 0; x < 256; x++) {
        uint8_t inv = 0;
        for (int y = 1; y < 256 && x; y++)
            if (gmul((uint8_t)x, (uint8_t)y) == 1) { inv = (uint8_t)y; break; }
        uint8_t s = inv;
        for (int k = 1; k < 5; k++) s ^= (uint8_t)((inv << k) | (inv >> (8 - k)));
        s ^= 0x63;
        sbox[x] = s;
        inv_sbox[s] = (uint8_t)x;
    }
}

static void mix_columns(uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *in, int inverse) {
    static const uint8_t fwd[4] = {2, 3, 1, 1}, inv[4] = {14, 11, 13, 9};
    const uint8_t *k = inverse ? inv : fwd;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
            uint8_t v = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) v ^= gmul(k[(j - r + 4) % 4], in[4 * c + j]);
            out[4 * c + r] = v;
        }
}

void yw4_aes(Yw4AesOp op, v128 *d, const v128 *n) {
    init_sbox();
    uint8_t s[16], t[16];
    if (op == YW4_AESMC || op == YW4_AESIMC) {
        memcpy(s, n->b, 16);
        mix_columns(t, s, op == YW4_AESIMC);
        memcpy(d->b, t, 16);
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] = d->b[i] ^ n->b[i];
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
            if (op == YW4_AESE)  /* ShiftRows, then SubBytes */
                t[r + 4 * c] = sbox[s[r + 4 * ((c + r) % 4)]];
            else                 /* InvShiftRows, then InvSubBytes */
                t[r + 4 * ((c + r) % 4)] = inv_sbox[s[r + 4 * c]];
        }
    memcpy(d->b, t, 16);
}

static uint32_t rol32(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x << s) | (x >> (32 - s)); }
static uint32_t ror32c(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x >> s) | (x << (32 - s)); }
static uint32_t sha_choose(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) { return ((y ^ z) & x) ^ z; }
static uint32_t sha_parity(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) { return x ^ y ^ z; }
static uint32_t sha_majority(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) { return (x & y) | ((x | y) & z); }

/* SHA1C/P/M: X = abcd (Qd), Y = e (Sn), W = 4 words (Vm). */
static void sha1_hash(v128 *d, const v128 *n, const v128 *m, uint32_t (*f)(uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t)) {
    uint32_t x[4] = {d->s[0], d->s[1], d->s[2], d->s[3]}, y = n->s[0];
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t t = f(x[1], x[2], x[3]);
        y = y + rol32(x[0], 5) + t + m->s[e];
        x[1] = rol32(x[1], 30);
        /* <Y, X> = ROL(Y:X, 32) */
        uint32_t top = x[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = y;
        y = top;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) d->s[i] = x[i];
}

/* SHA256hash(X, Y, W, part1): returns X if part1, else Y. */
static void sha256_hash(uint32_t *out, const uint32_t *xin, const uint32_t *yin, const uint32_t *w, int part1) {
    uint32_t x[4], y[4];
    memcpy(x, xin, 16);
    memcpy(y, yin, 16);
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t chs = sha_choose(y[0], y[1], y[2]);
        uint32_t maj = sha_majority(x[0], x[1], x[2]);
        uint32_t t = y[3] + (ror32c(y[0], 6) ^ ror32c(y[0], 11) ^ ror32c(y[0], 25)) + chs + w[e];
        x[3] = t + x[3];
        y[3] = t + (ror32c(x[0], 2) ^ ror32c(x[0], 13) ^ ror32c(x[0], 22)) + maj;
        /* <Y, X> = ROL(Y:X, 32): X's top word moves into Y's bottom, Y's top into X's bottom */
        uint32_t xt = x[3], yt = y[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = yt;
        y[3] = y[2], y[2] = y[1], y[1] = y[0], y[0] = xt;
    }
    memcpy(out, part1 ? x : y, 16);
}

void yw4_sha(Yw4ShaOp op, v128 *d, const v128 *n, const v128 *m) {
    v128 r = {{0}};
    switch (op) {
    case YW4_SHA1C: sha1_hash(d, n, m, sha_choose); return;
    case YW4_SHA1P: sha1_hash(d, n, m, sha_parity); return;
    case YW4_SHA1M: sha1_hash(d, n, m, sha_majority); return;
    case YW4_SHA1SU0:  /* (Vn<63:0> : Vd<127:64>) ^ Vd ^ Vm */
        r.d[0] = d->d[1], r.d[1] = n->d[0];
        r.d[0] ^= d->d[0] ^ m->d[0], r.d[1] ^= d->d[1] ^ m->d[1];
        break;
    case YW4_SHA1SU1: {  /* T = Vd ^ (Vn >> 32) */
        uint32_t t[4] = {d->s[0] ^ n->s[1], d->s[1] ^ n->s[2], d->s[2] ^ n->s[3], d->s[3]};
        r.s[0] = rol32(t[0], 1), r.s[1] = rol32(t[1], 1), r.s[2] = rol32(t[2], 1);
        r.s[3] = rol32(t[3], 1) ^ rol32(t[0], 2);
        break;
    }
    case YW4_SHA1H: r.s[0] = rol32(n->s[0], 30); break;
    case YW4_SHA256H: sha256_hash(r.s, d->s, n->s, m->s, 1); break;
    case YW4_SHA256H2: sha256_hash(r.s, n->s, d->s, m->s, 0); break;
    case YW4_SHA256SU0: {  /* T = Vn<31:0> : Vd<127:32> */
        uint32_t t[4] = {d->s[1], d->s[2], d->s[3], n->s[0]};
        for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++)
            r.s[e] = (ror32c(t[e], 7) ^ ror32c(t[e], 18) ^ (t[e] >> 3)) + d->s[e];
        break;
    }
    case YW4_SHA256SU1: {  /* T0 = Vm<31:0> : Vn<127:32>, T1 = Vm<127:64> */
        uint32_t t0[4] = {n->s[1], n->s[2], n->s[3], m->s[0]};
        uint32_t t1[2] = {m->s[2], m->s[3]};
        for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
            uint32_t elt = e < 2 ? t1[e] : r.s[e - 2];
            elt = ror32c(elt, 17) ^ ror32c(elt, 19) ^ (elt >> 10);
            r.s[e] = elt + d->s[e] + t0[e];
        }
        break;
    }
    }
    *d = r;
}

```

`runtime/src/diaryrows.c`:

```c
/* The Diary's stacked rows: the game's data changed in memory (see diaryrows.h).
 *
 * The Diary menu is data (docs/research/diary-save-slots.md, "Stacked rows"): its setting file gives the row layer
 * (diary_load_slot) 2 copies, and the locator object puts copy 0 and copy 1 on two bones of the anchor model
 * save00_06. Here: four bones more (six new ones, so the game's slide-in animation, which moves the old two, doesn't
 * pull rows back), a locator line for each copy, and 6 copies. The formats were checked by writing every menu model
 * of the game back byte for byte (a Python copy of this code, 2026-11-17). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "diaryrows.h"

#define SLOT_LAYER 0xd14f93d6u  /* crc32("diary_load_slot") */
#define ROW_SAVES 5             /* rows 0..4 the saves, row 5 the Autosave */
/* Where the rows go (1920 x 1080 units, y down is negative): the game's were 192 apart from -440. Owner, 2026-11-17:
 * the saves closer together, the gap above the Autosave kept. */
/* The block centred on the card. A row's "Latest!" badge stands above it, over the row above: savefs.c draws each
 * row over the one above it (their draw priorities). */
static const float START_Y = -250.0f, STEP = 100.0f, AUTO_GAP = 128.0f;

int diaryrows_slots_enabled(void) {
    const char *b = getenv("YW4_DIARY_SLOTS");
    return !(b && !strcmp(b, "0"));
}

int diaryrows_enabled(void) {
    const char *a = getenv("YW4_DIARY_ROWS");
    return !(a && !strcmp(a, "0")) && diaryrows_slots_enabled();
}

static uint32_t crc32_str(const char *s) {
    uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (; *s; s++) {
        c ^= (uint8_t)*s;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & (0u - (c & 1u)));
    }
    return ~c;
}

static uint32_t get32(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t v;
    memcpy(&v, p, 4);
    return v;
}
static uint16_t get16(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint16_t v;
    memcpy(&v, p, 2);
    return v;
}
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 4); }
static void put16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 2); }
static size_t al(size_t x, size_t a) { return (x + a - 1) / a * a; }

/* A growing buffer. */
typedef struct {
    uint8_t *b;
    size_t n, cap;
    int bad;
} Buf;
static void put(Buf *o, const void *p, size_t k) {
    if (o->bad) return;
    if (o->n + k > o->cap) {
        size_t c = o->cap ? o->cap : 4096;
        while (c < o->n + k) c *= 2;
        uint8_t *nb = realloc(o->b, c);
        if (!nb) {
            o->bad = 1;
            return;
        }
        o->b = nb, o->cap = c;
    }
    if (p) memcpy(o->b + o->n, p, k);
    else memset(o->b + o->n, 0, k);
    o->n += k;
}
static void pad(Buf *o, size_t a) { put(o, NULL, al(o->n, a) - o->n); }

static void bone_name(char out[32], int i) { snprintf(out, 32, "_pos_load_bar_locate%d", 10 + i); }

/* ---- the anchor model: a G4PK package, its first part the G4SK skeleton (version 104)
 *
 * G4PK: 0x40 header (+0xc: size - 0x40, +0x20: u32 part count), at 0x40 the parts' u32 offsets (/4, from 0x40) and
 * then their u32 sizes; parts 0x20-aligned, the file padded to 0x20.
 * G4SK: 0x40 header (+0xc: size - 0x40, +0x20: u16 bone count, +0x24: 11 u16 section offsets /4 from 0x40): world
 * 3x4 matrices (0x30 each, from 0x40), inverse matrices, local scale / rotation / position (0x30 each; the three
 * 0x20-aligned), three more sections (empty here), name crc32s (u32), parents (u16; the root's is the count), the
 * indices sorted by crc (u16), flags (u8), a u32 each, the names' offsets (u16, from the table, padded to 4) and the
 * names; after them a few bytes kept as they are. */

#define MAXB 64
static uint32_t sort_hash[MAXB];
static int by_hash(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint32_t x = sort_hash[*(const uint16_t *)a], y = sort_hash[*(const uint16_t *)b];
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

static uint8_t *skeleton(const uint8_t *s, size_t n, size_t *out_n) {
    if (n < 0x40 || memcmp(s, "G4SK", 4) || get16(s + 6) != 104) return NULL;
    unsigned nb = get16(s + 0x20);
    size_t f[11];
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) f[i] = 0x40 + 4 * (size_t)get16(s + 0x24 + 2 * i);
    if (nb == 0 || nb + ROW_SAVES + 1 > MAXB || f[8] != f[2] || f[7] + 2 * (size_t)nb > n) return NULL;
    size_t size = get32(s + 0xc);
    if (0x40 + size > n) return NULL;
    const char *name[MAXB];
    size_t end = 0;
    int bar = -1;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
        size_t o = f[7] + get16(s + f[7] + 2 * i);
        const uint8_t *z = o < n ? memchr(s + o, 0, n - o) : NULL;
        if (!z) return NULL;
        name[i] = (const char *)s + o;
        if ((size_t)(z - s) + 1 > end) end = (size_t)(z - s) + 1;
        if (!strcmp(name[i], "_pos_load_bar00")) bar = (int)i;
        char b0[32];
        bone_name(b0, 0);
        if (!strcmp(name[i], b0)) return NULL;  /* already changed */
    }
    if (bar < 0 || end > 0x40 + size) return NULL;
    size_t slack = 0x40 + size - end, pad_end = n - (0x40 + size);
    /* the bar's world position: its matrix's translation column */
    float bx, by;
    memcpy(&bx, s + 0x40 + (size_t)bar * 0x30 + 12, 4);
    memcpy(&by, s + 0x40 + (size_t)bar * 0x30 + 28, 4);

    unsigned nn = nb + ROW_SAVES + 1;
    uint32_t hash[MAXB];
    uint16_t parent[MAXB], order[MAXB];
    uint8_t flag[MAXB];
    uint32_t each[MAXB];
    char extra[ROW_SAVES + 1][32];
    float y[ROW_SAVES + 1];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
        hash[i] = get32(s + f[2] + 4 * i), parent[i] = get16(s + f[3] + 2 * i);
        flag[i] = s[f[5] + i], each[i] = get32(s + f[6] + 4 * i);
    }
    for (int k = 0; k <= ROW_SAVES; k++) {
        unsigned i = nb + (unsigned)k;
        bone_name(extra[k], k);
        name[i] = extra[k];
        hash[i] = crc32_str(extra[k]), parent[i] = (uint16_t)bar, flag[i] = 1, each[i] = 0;
        y[k] = k < ROW_SAVES ? START_Y - (float)k * STEP : START_Y - (float)(ROW_SAVES - 1) * STEP - AUTO_GAP;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nn; i++) order[i] = (uint16_t)i, sort_hash[i] = hash[i];
    qsort(order, nn, sizeof *order, by_hash);

    Buf o = {0};
    put(&o, s, 0x40);
    size_t fi[11];
#define MARK() (o.n)
    /* world matrices, then the inverses, then the local transforms: the game's, then ours */
    for (int sec = 0; sec < 3; sec++) {
        if (sec) fi[sec - 1] = MARK();
        size_t from = sec == 0 ? 0x40 : f[sec - 1];
        put(&o, s + from, (size_t)nb * 0x30);
        for (int k = 0; k <= ROW_SAVES; k++) {
            float m[12] = {0};
            if (sec == 2) {  /* scale 1 1 1 0, rotation 0 0 0 1, position x y 0 1 (under the bar) */
                m[0] = m[1] = m[2] = 1, m[7] = 1, m[8] = 0, m[9] = y[k] - by, m[11] = 1;
            } else {         /* a 3x4 translation: world at (bx, y), its inverse at (-bx, -y) */
                float sg = sec == 0 ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                m[0] = m[5] = m[10] = 1, m[3] = sg * bx, m[7] = sg * y[k];
            }
            put(&o, m, sizeof m);
        }
        pad(&o, 0x20);
    }
    fi[8] = fi[9] = fi[10] = MARK();
    fi[2] = MARK();
    put(&o, hash, 4 * (size_t)nn), pad(&o, 4);
    fi[3] = MARK();
    put(&o, parent, 2 * (size_t)nn), pad(&o, 4);
    fi[4] = MARK();
    put(&o, order, 2 * (size_t)nn), pad(&o, 4);
    fi[5] = MARK();
    put(&o, flag, nn), pad(&o, 4);
    fi[6] = MARK();
    put(&o, each, 4 * (size_t)nn), pad(&o, 4);
    fi[7] = MARK();
    size_t so = al(2 * (size_t)nn, 4), at = so;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nn; i++) {
        uint16_t v = (uint16_t)at;
        put(&o, &v, 2);
        at += strlen(name[i]) + 1;
    }
    put(&o, NULL, so - 2 * (size_t)nn);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nn; i++) put(&o, name[i], strlen(name[i]) + 1);
    put(&o, NULL, slack);
    size_t new_size = o.n - 0x40;
    put(&o, NULL, pad_end);
#undef MARK
    if (o.bad || at > 0xFFFF) {
        free(o.b);
        return NULL;
    }
    put32(o.b + 0xc, (uint32_t)new_size);
    put16(o.b + 0x20, (uint16_t)nn);
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) put16(o.b + 0x24 + 2 * i, (uint16_t)((fi[i] - 0x40) / 4));
    *out_n = o.n;
    return o.b;
}

uint8_t *diaryrows_model(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n) {
    if (n < 0x48 || memcmp(b, "G4PK", 4)) return NULL;
    uint32_t parts = get32(b + 0x20);
    if (parts == 0 || parts > 16 || 0x40 + 8 * (size_t)parts > n) return NULL;
    size_t off[16], len[16];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
        off[i] = 0x40 + 4 * (size_t)get32(b + 0x40 + 4 * i), len[i] = get32(b + 0x40 + 4 * (parts + i));
        if (off[i] > n || len[i] > n - off[i]) return NULL;
    }
    size_t sk_n = 0;
    uint8_t *sk = skeleton(b + off[0], len[0], &sk_n);
    if (!sk) return NULL;
    Buf o = {0};
    put(&o, b, off[0]);  /* the header and its tables (rewritten below) */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
        if (i) pad(&o, 0x20);
        off[i] = o.n, len[i] = i ? len[i] : sk_n;
        put(&o, i ? b + 0x40 + 4 * (size_t)get32(b + 0x40 + 4 * i) : sk, len[i]);
    }
    pad(&o, 0x20);
    free(sk);
    if (o.bad) {
        free(o.b);
        return NULL;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
        put32(o.b + 0x40 + 4 * i, (uint32_t)((off[i] - 0x40) / 4));
        put32(o.b + 0x40 + 4 * (parts + i), (uint32_t)len[i]);
    }
    put32(o.b + 0xc, (uint32_t)(o.n - 0x40));
    *out_n = o.n;
    return o.b;
}

/* ---- Level-5 cfg.bin (the locator object and the menu setting): u32 entry count, string table offset, its size,
 * its string count; entries (u32 name crc, u8 value count, 2-bit value types four to a byte padded to 4, u32
 * values); 0xFF up to 16; the strings; the names' table. Only int values change here, and entries are copied, so the
 * strings stay as they are. */

typedef struct {
    size_t at, end, vals;  /* the entry's start, end, and its first value */
    uint32_t crc;
    unsigned k;
} Ent;

static int entries(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, Ent *e, int max) {
    if (n < 16) return -1;
    uint32_t count = get32(b), st = get32(b + 4);
    if (st > n || (int)count > max) return -1;
    size_t p = 16;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (p + 5 > st) return -1;
        e[i].at = p, e[i].crc = get32(b + p), e[i].k = b[p + 4];
        p = al(p + 5 + (e[i].k + 3) / 4, 4);
        e[i].vals = p;
        p += 4 * (size_t)e[i].k;
        if (p > st) return -1;
        e[i].end = p;
    }
    return (int)count;
}

uint8_t *diaryrows_locator(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n) {
    static Ent e[256];
    int ne = entries(b, n, e, 256);
    if (ne <= 0) return NULL;
    /* PROP_PARAM 'GlobalLayerName', id, bone, child layer, child copy, child's root bone */
    uint32_t pp = crc32_str("PROP_PARAM");
    int line[2], nl = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++)
        if (e[i].crc == pp && e[i].k == 6 && get32(b + e[i].vals + 12) == SLOT_LAYER) {
            if (nl == 2) return NULL;
            line[nl++] = i;
        }
    if (nl != 2 || get32(b + e[line[0]].vals + 16) != 0 || get32(b + e[line[1]].vals + 16) != 1) return NULL;
    const Ent *t = &e[line[1]];
    size_t tl = t->end - t->at, add = (size_t)(DIARY_ROW_COPIES - 2) * tl;
    uint32_t st = get32(b + 4);
    size_t ents_end = e[ne - 1].end, new_end = ents_end + add, padn = al(new_end, 16) - new_end;
    Buf o = {0};
    put(&o, b, t->end);
    for (int c = 2; c < DIARY_ROW_COPIES; c++) put(&o, b + t->at, tl);
    put(&o, b + t->end, ents_end - t->end);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < padn; i++) put(&o, "\xff", 1);
    put(&o, b + st, n - st);
    if (o.bad) {
        free(o.b);
        return NULL;
    }
    char nm[32];
    for (int c = 0; c < DIARY_ROW_COPIES; c++) {
        size_t v = c < 2 ? e[line[c]].vals : t->end + (size_t)(c - 2) * tl + (t->vals - t->at);
        bone_name(nm, c);
        put32(o.b + v + 8, crc32_str(nm));
        if (c >= 2) {
            char id[32];
            snprintf(id, sizeof id, "diary_rows_attach%02d", c);
            put32(o.b + v + 4, crc32_str(id));
            put32(o.b + v + 16, (uint32_t)c);
        }
    }
    put32(o.b, (uint32_t)ne + DIARY_ROW_COPIES - 2);
    put32(o.b + 4, (uint32_t)(new_end + padn));
    *out_n = o.n;
    return o.b;
}

uint8_t *diaryrows_setting(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n) {
    static Ent e[256];
    int ne = entries(b, n, e, 256);
    if (ne <= 0) return NULL;
    /* MENU_LAYER_INFO layer crc, name, object, copies, ... */
    uint32_t li = crc32_str("MENU_LAYER_INFO");
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        if (e[i].crc != li || e[i].k < 4 || get32(b + e[i].vals) != SLOT_LAYER) continue;
        if (get32(b + e[i].vals + 12) != 2) return NULL;
        uint8_t *o = malloc(n);
        if (!o) return NULL;
        memcpy(o, b, n);
        put32(o + e[i].vals + 12, DIARY_ROW_COPIES);
        *out_n = n;
        return o;
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ---- the in-game Save's hint: its system text line (crc 0xcdcfb802, the diary_save script's guide) gets the D-pad's
 * left / right icon (the game's help text: "<CMD_CHANGE_BACK1>, <CMD_CHANGE_NEXT1>, or [$gaiji_key_all_s100] to
 * switch screens") and "Change Slot" before it. TEXT_INFO id, variant, text. The new text goes at the end of the
 * string table (0xFF to 16 after it, then the names' table, as before). */

#define SAVE_HINT_ID 0xcdcfb802u
static const char HINT_EN[] = "<CMD_ENTER|5>[CY2]Save[C]   <CMD_BACK>Back";
/* D-pad left and right as two icons, not the pair's one (gaiji_key_all_s100): on a keyboard the runtime shows each
 * one's key, and the pair (a group) would keep the Switch icon (bindings.c gaiji_swap) */
static const char HINT_NEW[] = "[$gaiji_key_lt_s000][$gaiji_key_rt_s000]Change Slot   <CMD_ENTER|5>[CY2]Save[C]   <CMD_BACK>Back";

/* ---- the title's Continue (the diary_load script, its only user of text 0xbdaf66c1): "Select / Back" gets X's
 * Delete before it (owner, 2026-11-17), the X button's icon (gaiji_bt01: the north button, Switch X; on a keyboard
 * the runtime shows its key, bindings.c gaiji_swap). X deletes there only (savefs.c). */
#define LOAD_HINT_ID 0xbdaf66c1u
static const char LOAD_HINT_EN[] = "<CMD_ENTER>Select   <CMD_BACK>Back";
static const char LOAD_HINT_NEW[] = "[$gaiji_bt01_s000]Delete   <CMD_ENTER>Select   <CMD_BACK>Back";

/* One text line (TEXT_INFO id, its English text) given new text, put at the end of the string table; NULL when the
 * line isn't there as expected (another language: left as it is). */
static uint8_t *hint_replace(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n, uint32_t id, const char *en, const char *text) {
    static Ent e[4096];
    int ne = entries(b, n, e, 4096);
    if (ne <= 0) return NULL;
    uint32_t st = get32(b + 4), sl = get32(b + 8), ns = get32(b + 12);
    if ((uint64_t)st + sl > n) return NULL;
    uint32_t ti = crc32_str("TEXT_INFO");
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        if (e[i].crc != ti || e[i].k < 3 || get32(b + e[i].vals) != id) continue;
        uint32_t so = get32(b + e[i].vals + 8);
        if (so >= sl || !memchr(b + st + so, 0, sl - so) || strcmp((const char *)b + st + so, en)) return NULL;
        size_t names = al(st + (size_t)sl, 16), add = strlen(text) + 1;
        if (names > n) return NULL;
        Buf o = {0};
        put(&o, b, st + (size_t)sl);
        put(&o, text, add);
        while (o.n % 16) put(&o, "\xff", 1);
        put(&o, b + names, n - names);
        if (o.bad) {
            free(o.b);
            return NULL;
        }
        put32(o.b + e[i].vals + 8, sl);
        put32(o.b + 8, sl + (uint32_t)add);
        put32(o.b + 12, ns + 1);
        *out_n = o.n;
        return o.b;
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* The in-game Save's hint and the title's Continue hint, each where it is the English line; NULL when neither is. */
uint8_t *diaryrows_save_hint(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n) {
    size_t n1 = 0, n2 = 0;
    uint8_t *one = hint_replace(b, n, &n1, SAVE_HINT_ID, HINT_EN, HINT_NEW);
    uint8_t *two = hint_replace(one ? one : b, one ? n1 : n, &n2, LOAD_HINT_ID, LOAD_HINT_EN, LOAD_HINT_NEW);
    if (two) {
        free(one);
        *out_n = n2;
        return two;
    }
    if (one) *out_n = n1;
    return one;
}

```

`runtime/src/diaryrows.h`:

```h
/* The Diary's stacked rows (owner, 2026-11-17: "the save slots stack, not Left / Right"): three of the game's data
 * files changed in memory at start, from the owner's own copies (no game data in the repo). The research and the
 * formats: docs/research/diary-save-slots.md, "Stacked rows". The Diary code that fills the rows: savefs.c. */
#ifndef YW4_DIARYROWS_H
#define YW4_DIARYROWS_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define DIARY_ROW_COPIES 6  /* five save rows, then the Autosave row (savefs.c's DIARY_ROWS) */

/* The three files, by their RomFS paths. */
#define DIARYROWS_MODEL "data/common/menu/104_save/104_save00/save00_06/save00_06.g4pkm"
#define DIARYROWS_LOCATOR "data/common/gamedata/menu/obj/diary_load_locator.objbin"
#define DIARYROWS_SETTING "data/common/gamedata/menu/cfg/save_load_menu_setting.cfg.bin"

/* Each takes the game's copy and returns the changed one (malloc'd), or NULL when the copy isn't the one this
 * expects (another layout, a mod's own change, already changed): then nothing is changed and the Diary pages. */
uint8_t *diaryrows_model(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n);    /* the row anchor model: six row bones */
uint8_t *diaryrows_locator(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n);  /* a row copy on each of them */
uint8_t *diaryrows_setting(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n);  /* the menu: six row copies, not two */

/* The in-game Save's hint with its slot paging (Left / Right): the English line of a language's system text. */
uint8_t *diaryrows_save_hint(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, size_t *out_n);

/* 1 unless YW4_DIARY_SLOTS=0 (the game's single slot). */
int diaryrows_slots_enabled(void);
/* 1 unless YW4_DIARY_ROWS=0 or YW4_DIARY_SLOTS=0 (the game's two rows; with the slots off, its single slot). */
int diaryrows_enabled(void);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/discord.c`:

```c
/* Discord Rich Presence (discord.h, decision 0077). A thread of its own, once a second: while DISCORD STATUS is on and
 * the Discord app runs on this PC, the profile shows the game (the Discord application's name, its icon) and the time
 * since the game started, over Discord's local IPC (discord_ipc.c). Nothing about the game's state is read: the game's
 * threads never meet this one.
 *
 * Quiet by design: no Discord, no window, no log spam. It tries to connect every 15 s while on, sets the activity once
 * per connection, and clears it when the setting is turned off. */
#include "discord.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "discord_ipc.h"
#include "host.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
static long this_pid(void) { return (long)GetCurrentProcessId(); }
#else
#include <unistd.h>
static long this_pid(void) { return (long)getpid(); }
#endif

enum { TICK_MS = 1000, RETRY_S = 15, UPDATE_S = 5 };

static int enabled = -1;

static const char *app_id(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_DISCORD_APP_ID");
    return e && *e ? e : YW4_DISCORD_APP_ID;
}

int discord_enabled(void) {
    int on = __atomic_load_n(&enabled, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_DISCORD");
        on = e && atoi(e) == 1;
        __atomic_store_n(&enabled, on, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return on && *app_id();
}

void discord_toggle(void) {
    int on = !discord_enabled();
    __atomic_store_n(&enabled, on, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: status %s\n", on ? "on" : "off");
}

const char *discord_disabled(void) { return *app_id() ? NULL : "NOT SET UP IN THIS BUILD"; }

/* Connects and says hello: 0 once Discord answered the handshake with READY. */
static int connect_discord(DiscordIpc *c) {
    char json[256], reply[2048];
    uint32_t op;
    if (discord_ipc_connect(c, getenv("YW4_DISCORD_IPC_PATH"))) return -1;  /* the path: tests */
    if (!discord_handshake_json(json, sizeof json, app_id()) || discord_ipc_send(c, DISCORD_OP_HANDSHAKE, json)) {
        discord_ipc_close(c);
        return -1;
    }
    if (discord_ipc_recv(c, &op, reply, sizeof reply, 3000) != 1 || op != DISCORD_OP_FRAME || !strstr(reply, "READY")) {
        discord_ipc_close(c);  /* a wrong ID gets a CLOSE frame here */
        return -1;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: connected\n");
    return 0;
}

/* Reads what Discord sent since (its answers to our updates, a ping now and then) so its pipe never fills. */
static void drain(DiscordIpc *c) {
    char buf[1024];
    uint32_t op;
    while (c->open && discord_ipc_recv(c, &op, buf, sizeof buf, 0) == 1) {
        if (op == DISCORD_OP_PING) discord_ipc_send(c, DISCORD_OP_PONG, buf);
        else if (op == DISCORD_OP_CLOSE) discord_ipc_close(c);
    }
}

/* Emoji as UTF-8 bytes (each followed by a space, so no hex escape runs into the text) */
#define E_MAP "\xf0\x9f\x97\xba\xef\xb8\x8f "  /* world map */
#define E_WALK "\xf0\x9f\x9a\xb6 "             /* person walking */
#define E_LOOK "\xf0\x9f\x94\x8d "             /* magnifying glass */
#define E_GHOST "\xf0\x9f\x91\xbb "            /* ghost */
#define E_LEAF "\xf0\x9f\x8d\x83 "             /* leaves in the wind */
#define E_BLOSSOM "\xf0\x9f\x8c\xb8 "          /* cherry blossom */
#define E_TORCH "\xf0\x9f\x94\xa6 "            /* flashlight */
#define E_EYES "\xf0\x9f\x91\x80 "             /* eyes */
#define E_PAWS "\xf0\x9f\x90\xbe "             /* paw prints */
#define E_COMPASS "\xf0\x9f\xa7\xad "          /* compass */
#define E_SPARKLES "\xe2\x9c\xa8 "             /* sparkles */
#define E_RICEBALL "\xf0\x9f\x8d\x99 "         /* rice ball */
#define E_CAMERA "\xf0\x9f\x93\xb8 "           /* camera with flash */
#define E_BIKE "\xf0\x9f\x9a\xb2 "             /* bicycle */
#define E_BACKPACK "\xf0\x9f\x8e\x92 "         /* school backpack */
#define E_QUESTION "\xe2\x9d\x93 "             /* question mark */
#define E_ZANY "\xf0\x9f\xa4\xaa "             /* zany face */
#define E_CHIME "\xf0\x9f\x8e\x90 "            /* wind chime */
#define E_KEY "\xf0\x9f\x97\x9d\xef\xb8\x8f "  /* old key */
#define E_FIST "\xf0\x9f\x91\x8a "             /* oncoming fist */
#define E_BOOM "\xf0\x9f\x92\xa5 "             /* collision */
#define E_SHIELD "\xf0\x9f\x9b\xa1\xef\xb8\x8f "  /* shield */
#define E_FIRE "\xf0\x9f\x94\xa5 "             /* fire */
#define E_ZAP "\xe2\x9a\xa1 "                  /* high voltage */
#define E_SWORDS "\xe2\x9a\x94\xef\xb8\x8f "   /* crossed swords */
#define E_HOME "\xf0\x9f\x8f\xa0 "             /* house */
#define E_WATCH "\xe2\x8c\x9a "                /* watch */

void discord_presence_text(const DiscordGame *g, unsigned flavor, char *details, size_t dn, char *state, size_t sn) {
    static const char ranks[] = "EDCBAS";
    static const char *const field[DISCORD_FLAVORS] = {
        E_MAP "Exploring %s", E_WALK "Wandering around %s", E_LOOK "Searching for Yo-kai in %s",
        E_GHOST "Hunting Yo-kai in %s", E_LEAF "Taking a stroll in %s", E_BLOSSOM "Enjoying the sights in %s",
        E_TORCH "Poking around %s", E_EYES "Looking around %s", E_PAWS "Following Yo-kai tracks in %s",
        E_COMPASS "Finding the way through %s", E_SPARKLES "Sensing Yo-kai in %s", E_RICEBALL "Snacking in %s",
        E_CAMERA "Sightseeing in %s", E_WATCH "Scanning %s with the Watch", E_BIKE "Cruising around %s",
        E_BACKPACK "Adventuring in %s", E_QUESTION "Lost in %s", E_ZANY "Mucking about in %s",
        E_CHIME "Chasing the breeze in %s", E_KEY "Uncovering secrets in %s",
    };
    static const char *const battle[DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS] = {
        E_SWORDS "Battling in %s", E_FIST "Fighting Yo-kai in %s", E_BOOM "In a Yo-kai brawl in %s",
        E_SHIELD "Holding the line in %s", E_FIRE "Turning up the heat in %s", E_ZAP "Unleashing a Soultimate in %s",
    };
    const char *place = g->sub[0] ? g->sub : g->area;  /* the zone when it has a name (the area is the icon's hover) */
    details[0] = state[0] = 0;
    switch (g->where) {
    case DISCORD_AT_TITLE: snprintf(details, dn, E_HOME "In the main menu"); return;
    case DISCORD_AT_BATTLE:
        if (place[0]) snprintf(details, dn, battle[flavor % DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS], place);
        else snprintf(details, dn, E_SWORDS "In a battle");
        break;
    case DISCORD_AT_FIELD:
        if (place[0]) snprintf(details, dn, field[flavor % DISCORD_FLAVORS], place);
        break;
    default: return;  /* starting up: the game's name alone */
    }
    if (g->rank >= 0 && g->rank < (int)sizeof ranks - 1) snprintf(state, sn, E_WATCH "Watch Rank %c", ranks[g->rank]);
}

static void presence_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    DiscordIpc c = {0};
    const int64_t start = (int64_t)time(NULL);
    int64_t next_try = 0, sent_at = 0;
    int shown = 0;  /* the activity is set on this connection */
    unsigned nonce = 0;
    char shown_details[160] = "", shown_state[64] = "";
    unsigned flavor = (unsigned)start % DISCORD_FLAVORS;  /* the first wording: any of them */
    unsigned battle_flavor = (unsigned)start % DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS;
    int flavor_where = -1;
    char flavor_area[DISCORD_AREA_MAX] = "";
    uint32_t seed = (uint32_t)start | 1u;  /* our own xorshift: the C library's rand() is left alone */
    for (;;) {
        host_sleep_ns((int64_t)TICK_MS * 1000000);
        int64_t now = (int64_t)time(NULL);
        if (!discord_enabled()) {
            if (c.open) {  /* turned off: clear the profile's activity, then let go */
                char json[256];
                if (discord_activity_json(json, sizeof json, this_pid(), NULL, ++nonce))
                    discord_ipc_send(&c, DISCORD_OP_FRAME, json);
                discord_ipc_close(&c);
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: status cleared\n");
            }
            shown = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (!c.open) {
            shown = 0;
            if (now < next_try) continue;
            next_try = now + RETRY_S;
            if (connect_discord(&c)) continue;
        }
        drain(&c);
        if (!c.open) continue;
        DiscordGame g;
        discord_game_read(&g);
        /* a new wording for each area (and on coming back to the field), not each update: no flicker */
        const char *place = g.sub[0] ? g.sub : g.area;  /* a new zone gets a new wording too */
        if (g.where != flavor_where || strcmp(place, flavor_area)) {
            if (g.where == DISCORD_AT_FIELD && (flavor_where != DISCORD_AT_BATTLE || strcmp(place, flavor_area))) {
                seed ^= seed << 13, seed ^= seed >> 17, seed ^= seed << 5;
                flavor = (flavor + 1 + seed % (DISCORD_FLAVORS - 1)) % DISCORD_FLAVORS;  /* never the same twice */
            }
            if (g.where == DISCORD_AT_BATTLE && flavor_where != DISCORD_AT_BATTLE) {  /* each battle its own */
                seed ^= seed << 13, seed ^= seed >> 17, seed ^= seed << 5;
                battle_flavor = (battle_flavor + 1 + seed % (DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS - 1)) % DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS;
            }
            flavor_where = g.where;
            snprintf(flavor_area, sizeof flavor_area, "%s", place);
        }
        char details[160], state[64];
        discord_presence_text(&g, g.where == DISCORD_AT_BATTLE ? battle_flavor : flavor, details, sizeof details, state,
                              sizeof state);
        if (shown && !strcmp(details, shown_details) && !strcmp(state, shown_state)) continue;
        /* Discord takes 5 updates per 20 s: one per UPDATE_S at most, the newest text (a quick battle in and out
         * shows only once it has lasted) */
        if (shown && now - sent_at < UPDATE_S) continue;
        /* the game's name is the application's; "icon" the art uploaded to it, its hover the area */
        DiscordActivity a = {.details = details, .state = state, .large_image = "icon",
                             .large_text = g.area[0] && g.where != DISCORD_AT_TITLE ? g.area : "Yo-kai Watch 4",
                             .start = start, .button_label = "Get YW4 Recomp",
                             .button_url = "https://ilfforever.github.io/YW4Recomp/"};
        char json[1024];
        if (!discord_activity_json(json, sizeof json, this_pid(), &a, ++nonce)) continue;
        if (discord_ipc_send(&c, DISCORD_OP_FRAME, json)) continue;  /* gone: tried again later */
        shown = 1, sent_at = now;
        snprintf(shown_details, sizeof shown_details, "%s", details);
        snprintf(shown_state, sizeof shown_state, "%s", state);
    }
}

void discord_start(void) {
    if (!*app_id()) return;  /* no application: nothing to show, no thread */
    if (host_thread_start(presence_thread, NULL, 1 << 16))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: could not start its thread\n");
}

```

`runtime/src/discord.h`:

```h
/* Discord Rich Presence (discord.c, decision 0077): "Playing Yo-kai Watch 4" on the player's Discord profile, with
 * where they are (the main menu, the area's name, a battle), their Watch Rank and the time since the game started.
 * Off unless the player turns it on (DISCORD STATUS, YW4_DISCORD=1); nothing happens without the Discord app running
 * on this PC. */
#ifndef YW4_DISCORD_H
#define YW4_DISCORD_H

/* The Discord application's ID: its name is the game name the profile shows, its art the pictures. Empty: no
 * presence at all (the setting is greyed out). YW4_DISCORD_APP_ID overrides it (tests, or before it is filled in). */
#ifndef YW4_DISCORD_APP_ID
#define YW4_DISCORD_APP_ID "1571532450742665347"
#endif

#include <stddef.h>

/* Where the player is, the area's name and the Watch Rank (discord_game.c reads them from the game). */
enum { DISCORD_AT_START, DISCORD_AT_TITLE, DISCORD_AT_FIELD, DISCORD_AT_BATTLE };
enum { DISCORD_AREA_MAX = 96 };
typedef struct {
    int where;                    /* DISCORD_AT_... */
    int rank;                     /* the Watch Rank, 0 E .. 5 S (3: B); -1 not known */
    char area[DISCORD_AREA_MAX];  /* UTF-8; "" not known */
    char sub[DISCORD_AREA_MAX];   /* the zone in it ("Meeting Bridge"), UTF-8; "" none */
} DiscordGame;
void discord_game_read(DiscordGame *out);
/* The profile's two lines for that, with an emoji in front: details ("Exploring Mystic Grove" or another of
 * DISCORD_FLAVORS wordings, chosen by `flavor`; in a battle one of DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS, "Battling in Mystic
 * Grove", by the same `flavor`; "In the main menu") and state ("Watch Rank B"); "" leaves a line out. The place is
 * the zone when it has a name, else the area. */
enum { DISCORD_FLAVORS = 20, DISCORD_BATTLE_FLAVORS = 6 };
void discord_presence_text(const DiscordGame *g, unsigned flavor, char *details, size_t dn, char *state, size_t sn);

/* At start-up, after the settings are loaded: the presence thread (idle while the setting is off). */
void discord_start(void);
/* The setting: 1 on, 0 off; the panel's switch; why it can't be used (NULL: it can). */
int discord_enabled(void);
void discord_toggle(void);
const char *discord_disabled(void);

#endif

```

`runtime/src/discord_game.c`:

```c
/* What Discord Rich Presence shows about the game (decision 0077): read on the game's thread, handed to the presence
 * thread (discord.c) under a lock.
 *
 * Where the values are: the game data object at *(*(main+0x1548fd8) + 0x5778), the one the game copies into the save
 * summary (HEADERSAVE) when it saves (f_32ec30, main+0x32ec30): +0x17 the Watch Rank (one byte, 3 = B), +0x30 the
 * current map's ID. The save summary turns the map ID into a location text ID with f_70ff90 (main+0x70ff90, takes a
 * pointer to the ID; nonzero: that text) or else f_70fdc0 (main+0x70fdc0); the Diary (f_761aa0) looks the text up with
 * f_9b10d0(table, text, 0) in the text tables at *(G + 8) then *(G + 0), each used only once its vtable's slot 3 (+0x18)
 * says it is ready; the entry's first word is the string (UTF-8; 0: none).
 *
 * Those are the game's functions, so they run here, in the field's player controller hook on the game's thread, and
 * only when the map ID changed, not on the presence thread. */
#include "discord_game.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "battle.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "pause.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

enum {
    GAME_PTR = 0x1548fd8,   /* G: the game's globals */
    G_DATA = 0x5778,        /* G + this: the game data object */
    DATA_RANK = 0x17,       /* u8 */
    DATA_MAP = 0x30,        /* u32 */
    FN_MAP_TEXT_SPECIAL = 0x70ff90,
    FN_MAP_TEXT = 0x70fdc0,
    FN_TEXT_FIND = 0x9b10d0,
};

static HostLock lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static char area[DISCORD_AREA_MAX];  /* under lock */
static char sub[DISCORD_AREA_MAX];   /* under lock: the zone's name, "" none */
static int rank = -1;                /* under lock */
static uint32_t last_map;
static int have_map;

/* Guest stack below the hook's frame: arguments passed by pointer, then the called functions' own frames. */
enum { STACK_ARG = 0x10, STACK_BUF = 0x300, BUF_SIZE = 0x100, STACK_CALL = 0x400 };

/* Calls a game function with x0..x3 on a frame below the hook's stack; returns x0. ctx is put back. */
static uint64_t guest_call4(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t fn_addr, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3) {
    GuestFn fn = yw4_lookup(fn_addr);
    if (!fn) return 0;
    CPUState saved = *ctx;
    ctx->sp = (saved.sp - STACK_CALL) & ~(uint64_t)15;
    ctx->x[0] = a0, ctx->x[1] = a1, ctx->x[2] = a2, ctx->x[3] = a3;
    ctx->x[30] = saved.x[30];
    fn(ctx);
    uint64_t r = ctx->x[0];
    *ctx = saved;
    return r;
}
static uint64_t guest_call(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t fn_addr, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2) {
    return guest_call4(ctx, fn_addr, a0, a1, a2, 0);
}

/* The text's string from one of the game's text tables (as the Diary does it), or NULL. */
static const char *text_in(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t table, uint32_t text) {
    if (!table) return NULL;
    uint64_t vt = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)table;
    if (!vt || !(guest_call(ctx, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(vt + 0x18), table, 0, 0) & 1)) return NULL;
    uint64_t e = guest_call(ctx, yw4_image_base + FN_TEXT_FIND, table, text, 0);
    if (!e) return NULL;
    uint64_t s = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)e;
    return s ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)s : NULL;
}

/* Copies at most n - 1 bytes, not cutting a UTF-8 character in two. */
static void copy_utf8(char *out, size_t n, const char *s) {
    size_t k = strlen(s);
    if (k >= n) {
        k = n - 1;
        while (k > 0 && ((unsigned char)s[k] & 0xc0) == 0x80) k--;  /* s[k] would start the cut character */
    }
    memcpy(out, s, k);
    out[k] = 0;
}

/* ---- The zone (sub-area: "Meeting Bridge" in Springdale City), as the expanded minimap's label finds it
 * (f_758430, main+0x758430; read 2026-11-18). The field manager FM = *(main+0x154b190); the zone slot is the byte at
 * the game data object's +0x301; FM + slot*0x14 + 0x44 is the zone's handle (low 16 bits an index below 0x200,
 * checked against FM + index*0xa60 + 0x148), whose record +0x15c is a block (below 0x400) at FM + block*0x100:
 * +0x18dab0 is -1 for none, +0x18db90 the zone's number. The map's internal name comes from f_4d8e60(*(G+0x230),
 * map ID of FM's current map: FM + *(FM+0x90)*0xb0 + 0x161b34) in the name table at *(*(G+0x230)+0x38). The label's
 * text ID is the CRC-32 (the game's table at main+0x12bd348) of sprintf(main+0x12524ff, map name, number). No such
 * text: the map's own name, as now. */
enum {
    FIELD_PTR = 0x154b190,
    DATA_ZONE_SLOT = 0x301,
    FN_MAP_RECORD = 0x4d8e60,
    FN_SPRINTF = 0x14b9c0,
    ZONE_FORMAT = 0x12524ff,
    CRC_TABLE = 0x12bd348,
};

typedef struct {
    uint32_t handle, block, map_id, number;  /* handle 0: not in a zone */
} Zone;
static Zone last_zone;  /* the game's thread only */

static int read_zone(uint64_t data, Zone *z) {
    memset(z, 0, sizeof *z);
    uint64_t fm = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(yw4_image_base + FIELD_PTR);
    if (!fm) return 0;
    unsigned slot = *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(data + DATA_ZONE_SLOT);
    uint32_t h = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(fm + slot * 0x14ull + 0x44);
    if (!h || (h & 0xffff) > 0x1ff) return 1;
    uint64_t rec = fm + (h & 0xffff) * 0xa60ull;
    if (*(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(rec + 0x148) != h) return 1;
    uint32_t block = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(rec + 0x15c);
    if (block > 0x3ff) return 1;
    uint64_t zb = fm + ((uint64_t)block << 8);
    if (*(const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(zb + 0x18dab0) == -1) return 1;
    uint32_t mi = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(fm + 0x90);
    z->handle = h, z->block = block;
    z->map_id = mi > 0x3ff ? 0 : *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(fm + mi * 0xb0ull + 0x161b34);
    z->number = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(zb + 0x18db90);
    return 1;
}

/* The zone's name, or NULL (no zone, or a zone without a name of its own). */
static const char *zone_name(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t g, const Zone *z) {
    if (!z->handle) return NULL;
    uint64_t names = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(g + 0x230);
    if (!names) return NULL;
    uint64_t r = guest_call(ctx, yw4_image_base + FN_MAP_RECORD, names, z->map_id, 0);
    if (!r) return NULL;
    int32_t off = *(const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(r + 4);
    uint64_t str = 0;
    if (off >= 0) {
        uint64_t t = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(names + 0x38);
        str = t + *(const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(t + 0xa) * 4ull + *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(t + 0x38) + (uint64_t)off;
    }
    uint64_t buf = (ctx->sp - STACK_BUF) & ~(uint64_t)15;
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)buf, 0, BUF_SIZE);
    guest_call4(ctx, yw4_image_base + FN_SPRINTF, buf, yw4_image_base + ZONE_FORMAT, str, z->number);
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)buf;
    if (!*p) return NULL;
    const uint32_t *table = (const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(yw4_image_base + CRC_TABLE);
    uint32_t crc = ~0u;
    for (int i = 0; i < BUF_SIZE && p[i]; i++) crc = table[(crc ^ p[i]) & 0xff] ^ (crc >> 8);
    uint32_t text = ~crc;
    const char *s = text_in(ctx, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(g + 8), text);
    if (!s) s = text_in(ctx, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g, text);
    if (getenv("YW4_DISCORD_LOG"))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: zone '%s' (map %#x) -> text %#x '%s'\n", (const char *)p, z->map_id, text,
                s ? s : "");
    return s && *s ? s : NULL;
}

void discord_game_field_frame(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (!discord_enabled()) return;
    uint64_t g = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(yw4_image_base + GAME_PTR);
    uint64_t data = g ? *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(g + G_DATA) : 0;
    if (!data) return;
    int r = *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(data + DATA_RANK);
    uint32_t map = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(data + DATA_MAP);
    /* 0 while a save is still loading (its rank too: 0 = E); its "text" is some other string (seen 2026-11-18) */
    if (!map) return;
    Zone z;
    read_zone(data, &z);
    /* on the way to another area the field's map (and its zone) turns over a moment before the data's map ID: the
     * zone waits until both name the same map, so the card never shows the new street in the old area */
    if (z.handle && z.map_id != map) {
        if (map != last_map) memset(&z, 0, sizeof z);  /* a new area: its own name for now */
        else z = last_zone;
    }
    if (__atomic_load_n(&have_map, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && map == last_map) {
        const char *zn = NULL;
        int zone_changed = memcmp(&z, &last_zone, sizeof z) != 0;
        if (zone_changed) last_zone = z, zn = zone_name(ctx, g, &z);
        host_lock(&lock);
        rank = r;
        if (zone_changed) copy_utf8(sub, sizeof sub, zn ? zn : "");
        host_unlock(&lock);
        if (zone_changed) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: zone '%s'\n", zn ? zn : "");
        return;
    }
    last_zone = z;
    const char *zn = zone_name(ctx, g, &z);
    last_map = map;
    __atomic_store_n(&have_map, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    /* the map ID -> its location text, as the save summary does */
    uint64_t arg = (ctx->sp - STACK_ARG) & ~(uint64_t)15;  /* above the called functions' frames */
    *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)arg = map;
    uint32_t text = (uint32_t)guest_call(ctx, yw4_image_base + FN_MAP_TEXT_SPECIAL, arg, 0, 0);
    if (!text) text = (uint32_t)guest_call(ctx, yw4_image_base + FN_MAP_TEXT, map, 0, 0);
    const char *name = NULL;
    if (text) {
        name = text_in(ctx, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(g + 8), text);
        if (!name) name = text_in(ctx, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g, text);
    }
    host_lock(&lock);
    copy_utf8(area, sizeof area, name ? name : "");
    copy_utf8(sub, sizeof sub, zn ? zn : "");
    rank = r;
    host_unlock(&lock);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: discord: area '%s' (map %#x, text %#x), zone '%s', watch rank %d\n", name ? name : "", map,
            text, zn ? zn : "", r);
}

void discord_game_read(DiscordGame *out) {
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    out->rank = -1;
    if (scene_on_title()) {  /* the next game loaded may be another save: its area is looked up anew */
        out->where = DISCORD_AT_TITLE;
        host_lock(&lock);
        area[0] = sub[0] = 0, rank = -1;
        host_unlock(&lock);
        __atomic_store_n(&have_map, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return;
    }
    host_lock(&lock);
    copy_utf8(out->area, sizeof out->area, area);
    copy_utf8(out->sub, sizeof out->sub, sub);
    out->rank = rank;
    host_unlock(&lock);
    out->where = battle_active() ? DISCORD_AT_BATTLE : out->area[0] || out->rank >= 0 ? DISCORD_AT_FIELD : DISCORD_AT_START;
}
```

`runtime/src/discord_ipc.c`:

```c
/* Discord's local IPC (discord_ipc.h, decision 0077). */
#include "discord_ipc.h"

#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <errno.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

/* ---- the messages */

size_t discord_frame(uint8_t *out, size_t cap, uint32_t op, const char *json) {
    size_t len = strlen(json);
    if (len > 0xFFFFFFF0u || len + 8 > cap) return 0;
    uint32_t h[2] = {op, (uint32_t)len};
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int b = 0; b < 4; b++) out[i * 4 + b] = (uint8_t)(h[i] >> (8 * b));  /* little-endian on any host */
    memcpy(out + 8, json, len);
    return len + 8;
}

/* Appending to a buffer: `ok` turns 0 once something didn't fit. */
typedef struct {
    char *p;
    size_t n, len;
    int ok;
} Out;

static void put(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (!o->ok) return;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int k = vsnprintf(o->p + o->len, o->n - o->len, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (k < 0 || (size_t)k >= o->n - o->len) o->ok = 0;
    else o->len += (size_t)k;
}

/* A JSON string: quotes, backslashes and control characters escaped; UTF-8 passes as it is. */
static void put_string(Out *o, const char *s) {
    put(o, "\"");
    for (; *s && o->ok; s++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*s;
        if (c == '"' || c == '\\') put(o, "\\%c", c);
        else if (c < 0x20) put(o, "\\u%04x", c);
        else put(o, "%c", c);
    }
    put(o, "\"");
}

size_t discord_handshake_json(char *out, size_t n, const char *client_id) {
    Out o = {out, n, 0, n > 0};
    put(&o, "{\"v\":1,\"client_id\":");
    put_string(&o, client_id);
    put(&o, "}");
    return o.ok ? o.len : 0;
}

static void put_field(Out *o, int *first, const char *key, const char *value) {
    if (!value || !*value) return;
    put(o, "%s\"%s\":", *first ? "" : ",", key);
    put_string(o, value);
    *first = 0;
}

size_t discord_activity_json(char *out, size_t n, long pid, const DiscordActivity *a, unsigned nonce) {
    Out o = {out, n, 0, n > 0};
    put(&o, "{\"cmd\":\"SET_ACTIVITY\",\"args\":{\"pid\":%ld,\"activity\":", pid);
    if (!a) {
        put(&o, "null");
    } else {
        int first = 1;
        put(&o, "{");
        put_field(&o, &first, "details", a->details);
        put_field(&o, &first, "state", a->state);
        if (a->start > 0) put(&o, "%s\"timestamps\":{\"start\":%lld}", first ? "" : ",", (long long)a->start), first = 0;
        if ((a->large_image && *a->large_image) || (a->large_text && *a->large_text)) {
            int f2 = 1;
            put(&o, "%s\"assets\":{", first ? "" : ",");
            put_field(&o, &f2, "large_image", a->large_image);
            put_field(&o, &f2, "large_text", a->large_text);
            put(&o, "}");
            first = 0;
        }
        if (a->button_label && *a->button_label && a->button_url && *a->button_url) {
            int f2 = 1;
            put(&o, "%s\"buttons\":[{", first ? "" : ",");
            put_field(&o, &f2, "label", a->button_label);
            put_field(&o, &f2, "url", a->button_url);
            put(&o, "}]");
            first = 0;
        }
        put(&o, "}");
    }
    put(&o, "},\"nonce\":\"%u\"}", nonce);
    return o.ok ? o.len : 0;
}

/* ---- the connection */

#ifdef _WIN32

static int open_path(DiscordIpc *c, const char *path) {
    HANDLE h = CreateFileA(path, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return -1;
    c->h = (intptr_t)h, c->open = 1;
    return 0;
}

int discord_ipc_connect(DiscordIpc *c, const char *path) {
    c->open = 0;
    if (path) return open_path(c, path);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        char p[64];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "\\\\.\\pipe\\discord-ipc-%d", i);
        if (!open_path(c, p)) return 0;
    }
    return -1;
}

void discord_ipc_close(DiscordIpc *c) {
    if (c->open) CloseHandle((HANDLE)c->h);
    c->open = 0;
}

static int write_all(DiscordIpc *c, const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    while (n) {
        DWORD done = 0;
        if (!WriteFile((HANDLE)c->h, p, (DWORD)n, &done, NULL) || !done) return -1;
        p += done, n -= done;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int read_all(DiscordIpc *c, uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    while (n) {
        DWORD done = 0;
        if (!ReadFile((HANDLE)c->h, p, (DWORD)n, &done, NULL) || !done) return -1;
        p += done, n -= done;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* 1 once a frame's header can be read, 0 at the end of wait_ms, -1 the pipe is gone */
static int wait_readable(DiscordIpc *c, int wait_ms) {
    for (int waited = 0;; waited += 5) {
        DWORD avail = 0;
        if (!PeekNamedPipe((HANDLE)c->h, NULL, 0, NULL, &avail, NULL)) return -1;
        if (avail >= 8) return 1;
        if (waited >= wait_ms) return 0;
        Sleep(5);
    }
}

#else

static int open_path(DiscordIpc *c, const char *path) {
    struct sockaddr_un a = {.sun_family = AF_UNIX};
    if (strlen(path) >= sizeof a.sun_path) return -1;
    strcpy(a.sun_path, path);
    int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    if (fd < 0) return -1;
    if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a) < 0) {
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    c->h = fd, c->open = 1;
    return 0;
}

int discord_ipc_connect(DiscordIpc *c, const char *path) {
    c->open = 0;
    if (path) return open_path(c, path);
    const char *vars[] = {"XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", "TMPDIR", "TMP", "TEMP"};
    const char *dirs[5];
    int nd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const char *d = getenv(vars[i]);
        if (d && *d) dirs[nd++] = d;
    }
    dirs[nd++] = "/tmp";
    /* the Discord app itself, then its Flatpak and Snap packages, which put the socket in a folder of their own */
    static const char *const sub[] = {"", "app/com.discordapp.Discord/", "snap.discord/"};
    for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++)
        for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++)
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                char p[256];
                snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%sdiscord-ipc-%d", dirs[d], sub[s], i);
                if (!open_path(c, p)) return 0;
            }
    return -1;
}

void discord_ipc_close(DiscordIpc *c) {
    if (c->open) close((int)c->h);
    c->open = 0;
}

static int write_all(DiscordIpc *c, const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    while (n) {
        ssize_t k = send((int)c->h, p, n, MSG_NOSIGNAL);  /* a closed socket is an error here, not SIGPIPE */
        if (k < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (k <= 0) return -1;
        p += k, n -= (size_t)k;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int read_all(DiscordIpc *c, uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    while (n) {
        ssize_t k = read((int)c->h, p, n);
        if (k < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (k <= 0) return -1;
        p += k, n -= (size_t)k;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int wait_readable(DiscordIpc *c, int wait_ms) {
    struct pollfd f = {.fd = (int)c->h, .events = POLLIN};
    int r = poll(&f, 1, wait_ms);
    if (r < 0) return errno == EINTR ? 0 : -1;
    if (!r) return 0;
    return f.revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR) ? 1 : 0;  /* a hang-up shows as a failed read next */
}

#endif

int discord_ipc_send(DiscordIpc *c, uint32_t op, const char *json) {
    if (!c->open) return -1;
    size_t cap = strlen(json) + 8;
    uint8_t *f = malloc(cap);
    int r = f && discord_frame(f, cap, op, json) && !write_all(c, f, cap) ? 0 : -1;
    free(f);
    if (r) discord_ipc_close(c);
    return r;
}

int discord_ipc_recv(DiscordIpc *c, uint32_t *op, char *buf, size_t n, int wait_ms) {
    if (!c->open) return -1;
    int w = wait_readable(c, wait_ms);
    if (w <= 0) {
        if (w < 0) discord_ipc_close(c);
        return w;
    }
    uint8_t h[8];
    if (read_all(c, h, 8)) {
        discord_ipc_close(c);
        return -1;
    }
    uint32_t o = h[0] | h[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)h[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)h[3] << 24;
    uint32_t len = h[4] | h[5] << 8 | (uint32_t)h[6] << 16 | (uint32_t)h[7] << 24;
    if (len > (1u << 20)) {  /* not Discord's: nothing it sends is this large */
        discord_ipc_close(c);
        return -1;
    }
    for (uint32_t got = 0; got < len;) {  /* all of it read, what fits kept */
        uint8_t tmp[512];
        uint32_t k = len - got < sizeof tmp ? len - got : (uint32_t)sizeof tmp;
        if (read_all(c, tmp, k)) {
            discord_ipc_close(c);
            return -1;
        }
        if (n && got < n - 1) memcpy(buf + got, tmp, got + k < n - 1 ? k : n - 1 - got);
        got += k;
    }
    if (n) buf[len < n - 1 ? len : n - 1] = 0;
    *op = o;
    return 1;
}
```
