```c
            const uint8_t *eng = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(U64(cur.device + 0x10d0) + NVN_STATE_AT);
            nvn_state(rs, nv);
            int nsame = 1;
            for (int q = 0; q < 8; q++)
                if (memcmp(nv + part[q].at, eng + part[q].at, part[q].n)) prog_st[l].nv_regions[q]++, nsame = 0;
            prog_st[l].nv_ok += nsame;
            /* the model material block, against what the game bound at its slot (list+0x74), in the
             * stage(s) whose shader reads it; rows 4-21 only for this draw's textures */
            unsigned mslot = U16(cur.list + 0x74), ntex;
            for (int st = 0; st < 2 && mslot < 16; st++) {
                if (!p || !(cbuf_slots(p->stages[st].key) >> mslot & 1) || !cb->trace_ub[st][mslot]) continue;
                uint8_t mm[0x160];
                uint8_t mat_state[33];
                render_state(cur.item, mat_state);
                model_material(cur.item, mat_state, mm, &ntex);
                const uint8_t *g = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[st][mslot];
                int msame = 1;
                for (int row = 0; row < 22; row++) {
                    if (row >= 4 && row < 16 && (unsigned)(row - 4) / 2 >= ntex) continue;
                    if (row >= 16 && (unsigned)(row - 16) >= ntex) continue;
                    if (memcmp(mm + 16 * row, g + 16 * row, 16)) prog_st[l].mm_rows[row]++, msame = 0;
                }
                prog_st[l].mm_n++;
                prog_st[l].mm_ok += msame;
                static int shown;
                if (!msame && shown++ < 6) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: model material differs (stage %d, %u textures):", st, ntex);
                    for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
                        const float *a = (const float *)(g + 16 * row), *b = (const float *)(mm + 16 * row);
                        fprintf(stderr, " | row %d game %g %g %g %g ours %g %g %g %g", row, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], b[0], b[1],
                                b[2], b[3]);
                    }
                    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
                }
                break;
            }
            /* the vertex layout, against the attribute and stream states the game bound */
            uint32_t attrs[16];
            int other;
            uint32_t used = vertex_layout(cur.item, attrs, &other), stride = U8(cur.submesh + 0x3e);
            if (used) {
                int vsame = !other && cb->trace_nattribs <= 16;
                for (uint32_t a = 0; vsame && a < cb->trace_nattribs; a++)
                    vsame = attrs[a] == cb->trace_attribs[a] && (!(used >> a & 1) || a >= 8 ||
                                                                 (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[a] == stride);
                prog_st[l].vl_n++;
                prog_st[l].vl_ok += vsame;
                prog_st[l].vl_other += other != 0;
                static int shown;
                if (!vsame && !other && shown++ < 6) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: vertex layout differs: stride %u, game:", stride);
                    for (uint32_t a = 0; a < cb->trace_nattribs; a++)
                        fprintf(stderr, " %#x/%u", cb->trace_attribs[a], a < 8 ? (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[a] : 0);
                    fprintf(stderr, "; ours:");
                    for (int a = 0; a < 16; a++) if (attrs[a]) fprintf(stderr, " %d=%#x", a, attrs[a]);
                    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
                }
            }
        }
        /* the material constants, against what the game bound at the draw list's slot (+0x7a) */
        uint8_t mat[0x80];
        unsigned slot = U16(cur.list + 0x7a);
        if (cur.item && slot < 16 && material_constants(cur.item, mat)) {
            prog_st[l].mat_n++;
            int reads = 0, eq_all = 1;
            for (int stage = 0; stage < 2; stage++) {
                int eq = cb->trace_ub[stage][slot] && !memcmp((const void *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[stage][slot], mat, 0x80);
                prog_st[l].mat_ok[stage] += eq;
                /* only the stages whose shader reads the slot: the other may hold an older block */
                if (p && cbuf_slots(p->stages[stage].key) >> slot & 1) reads = 1, eq_all &= eq;
            }
            prog_st[l].mat_read += reads;
            prog_st[l].mat_any += reads && eq_all;
        }
        prog_st[l].item += cur.item != 0;
        uint64_t bufs = U64(cur.geometry + 0x20);
        int ib_ok = U32(cur.submesh + 0xc) ? index_addr && index_addr == indices_of(cur.geometry, cur.submesh)
                                           : !index_addr;  /* no indices: drawn as the vertices */
        prog_st[l].ib += ib_ok;
        if (!ib_ok) show_ib(bufs, cb->trace_vb0, index_addr, type, count);
        static _Thread_local int shown;
        if (!same_rows(rows, game, ours) && shown < 6) {
            shown++;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: vs %016" PRIx64 " constants 2 rows read %#" PRIx64 " (game, then ours):\n",
                    p->stages[0].key, rows);
            for (int r = 0; r < LOCAL_ROWS; r++)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer:   %2d: %g %g %g %g | %g %g %g %g\n", r, game[4 * r], game[4 * r + 1],
                        game[4 * r + 2], game[4 * r + 3], ours[4 * r], ours[4 * r + 1], ours[4 * r + 2], ours[4 * r + 3]);
        }
    }
    if (!p || p->stages[0].key != GBUFFER_VS || !cb->trace_ub[0][2]) {
        summary();
        return;
    }
    st.main_vs++;
    uint64_t bufs = U64(cur.geometry + 0x20);
    if (bufs && cb->trace_vb0 == U64(bufs) + U32(cur.submesh)) st.vb_ok++;
    if (index_addr && index_addr == indices_of(cur.geometry, cur.submesh)) st.ib_ok++;
    const float *c2 = (const float *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[0][2];
    Mat4 world = mat4_load(cur.object), world40 = mat4_load(cur.object + 0x40);
    if (mat4_diff(c2, world.m, 12) < 1e-4f) st.world_ok++;
    else find_world(c2);
    if (cur.have_world && mat4_diff(c2, cur.world, 12) < 1e-5f) st.hook_world_ok++;
    if (cur.have_world) {  /* projection x view x the renderer's world (3x4, last row 0 0 0 1) */
        Mat4 w = {{0}};
        memcpy(w.m, cur.world, sizeof cur.world);
        w.m[15] = 1;
        Mat4 hw = mat4_mul(&cur.vp, &w);
        if (mat4_diff(c2 + 32, hw.m, 16) < 1e-3f) st.hook_wvp_ok++;
    }
    if (U32(cur.submesh + 0xc) && index_addr != indices_of(cur.geometry, cur.submesh)) {
        st.ib_bad[cur.ret == 0xa4c2d0]++;
        show_ib(bufs, cb->trace_vb0, index_addr, type, count);
    }
    /* the renderer's own world: [sp+0x30] + 0x40 (found for posed parts), for every draw */
    uint64_t rw = U64(cur.sp + 0x30);
    if (guest_ptr(rw) && readable(rw, 0x80) && mat4_diff(c2, (const float *)(uintptr_t)(rw + 0x40), 12) < 1e-5f) {
        st.slot_ok++;
        if (rw == cur.object) st.slot_is_object++;
        /* is it the geometry's model record (object+0x140 + 0x240 x geometry)? */
        uint64_t geos = U64(cur.object + 0x128), models = U64(cur.object + 0x140);
        for (unsigned g = 0; g < U8(cur.object + 0x1c8) && g < 16; g++)
            if (U64(geos + 8ull * g) == cur.geometry && rw == models + 0x240ull * g) st.slot_is_model++;
        static int dumped;
        if (dumped < 2) {  /* what the record is: its first words, next to the object's */
            dumped++;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: [sp+0x30] %#" PRIx64 " (object %#" PRIx64 ", object - record %#" PRIx64 "):",
                    rw, cur.object, cur.object - rw);
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %" PRIx64, U64(rw + 8ull * i));
            fprintf(stderr, " | object:");
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %" PRIx64, U64(cur.object + 8ull * i));
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        }
    } else if (st.slot_shown < 2) {
        st.slot_shown++;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: [sp+0x30] = %#" PRIx64 " (object %#" PRIx64 ") does not hold this draw's world\n",
                rw, cur.object);
    }
    Mat4 wvp = mat4_mul(&cur.vp, &world);
    float d = mat4_diff(c2 + 32, wvp.m, 16);
    if (d < 1e-3f) st.wvp_ok++;
    if (d > st.wvp_worst) st.wvp_worst = d;
    /* last frame's position: last frame's projection x view (vertex constants 1, rows 32-35) x
     * last frame's world (rows 12-15) */
    if (mat4_diff(c2 + 48, world40.m, 16) < 1e-4f) st.prev_a++;
    if (mat4_diff(c2 + 48, world.m, 16) < 1e-4f) st.prev_b++;
    if (cb->trace_ub[0][1] && mat4_diff((const float *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[0][1] + 128, prev_vp.m, 16) < 1e-3f)
        st.prev_c++;
    if (d >= 1e-3f && st.shown < 3) {  /* what the objects with another world are */
        st.shown++;
        uint64_t models = U64(cur.object + 0x140);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: world differs: object %#" PRIx64 " (+0x108 %#" PRIx64 ", instances %#" PRIx64
                ") cbuf 2 row 0: %g %g %g %g, object row 0: %g %g %g %g\n", cur.object, U64(cur.object + 0x108),
                models ? U64(models + 0x80) : 0, c2[0], c2[1], c2[2], c2[3], world.m[0], world.m[1], world.m[2],
                world.m[3]);
    }
    summary();
}

/* ---- step 2b: our draw in place of the game's */

static _Thread_local struct {
    long taken, left[6];  /* left to the game: program, no world, not a plain triangle list, vertex
                           * buffer or layout, index buffer, count or type */
    struct { uint64_t vs, fs; long n; } other[24];  /* the programs left to the game, by draws */
} nat;

static void note_other(const NvnProgram *p) {
    uint64_t vs = p ? p->stages[0].key : 0, fs = p ? p->stages[1].key : 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < 24 && nat.other[i].n && !(nat.other[i].vs == vs && nat.other[i].fs == fs)) i++;
    if (i < 24) nat.other[i].vs = vs, nat.other[i].fs = fs, nat.other[i].n++;
}

static long motion_objects, motion_moved;  /* draws with a last-frame world, how many of them moved (last_world) */

static void native_summary(void) {
    static _Thread_local uint64_t last;
    uint64_t frame = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (frame < last + 300) return;
    last = frame;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s: native: %ld draws ours; the game's: %ld other programs, %ld no world, %ld not a "
            "triangle list, %ld other vertex buffer or layout, %ld other index buffer, %ld other count or type\n",
            pass_name, nat.taken, nat.left[0], nat.left[1], nat.left[2], nat.left[3], nat.left[4], nat.left[5]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 24 && nat.other[i].n; i++)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s:   the game's: vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 ": %ld draws\n", pass_name,
                nat.other[i].vs, nat.other[i].fs, nat.other[i].n);
    if (motion_objects)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s: motion: %ld draws with last frame's world, %ld of them moved\n", pass_name,
                motion_objects, motion_moved);
    motion_objects = motion_moved = 0;
    memset(&nat, 0, sizeof nat);
}

/* Vertex constants 2 (the local matrix block) for the submesh noted last: the renderer's world,
 * view x world, projection x view x world; last frame's world is this frame's (on every draw checked,
 * walking characters too: they move through their bones), with the record's own bottom row (-0
 * where the game has it); last frame's view x world is the renderer's record's +0x240, which the
 * engine writes at the commit (after our hook): read when the draw is recorded. */
/* Each object's world last frame, for motion vectors: the game puts this frame's world in "last frame's" rows, so
 * objects moved by their world (not their bones) had only the camera's motion. Keyed by the record the world is
 * read from ([sp+0x30] at the hook: the object pointer in sp+0x390 is shared by many draws); its submeshes share
 * one entry. Without a world from the frame before (first frame seen, or not drawn then), this frame's.
 * YW4_OBJECT_MOTION=1 turns it on (off by default until checked: objects sharing a model may share the key). */
enum { HISTORY = 1 << 13 };
static struct {
    uint64_t object, frame;
    float world[16], last[16];  /* 3x4 rows and the stored bottom row */
} history[HISTORY];
static HostLock history_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static void last_world(const float now[16], float last[16]) {
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0) off = !(getenv("YW4_OBJECT_MOTION") && *getenv("YW4_OBJECT_MOTION") == '1');  /* off until checked */
    memcpy(last, now, 16 * sizeof(float));
    if (off || !cur.world_rec) return;
    uint64_t frame = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)((cur.world_rec * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 51);
    host_lock(&history_lock);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++, h = (h + 1) & (HISTORY - 1)) {
        if (history[h].object && history[h].object != cur.world_rec && history[h].frame + 2 >= frame) continue;
        if (history[h].object == cur.world_rec && history[h].frame == frame) {  /* another submesh this frame */
            memcpy(last, history[h].last, 16 * sizeof(float));
        } else {
            if (history[h].object == cur.world_rec && history[h].frame + 1 == frame) {
                memcpy(last, history[h].world, 16 * sizeof(float));
                motion_objects++, motion_moved += memcmp(last, now, 12 * sizeof(float)) != 0;
            }
            history[h].object = cur.world_rec, history[h].frame = frame;
            memcpy(history[h].world, now, 16 * sizeof(float));
            memcpy(history[h].last, last, 16 * sizeof(float));
        }
        break;
    }
    host_unlock(&history_lock);
}

static void object_constants(const float *game, float out[GBUFFER_OBJECT_FLOATS]) {
    (void)game;
    Mat4 w = {{0}};
    memcpy(w.m, cur.world, sizeof cur.world);
    w.m[15] = 1;
    float now[16], last[16];
    memcpy(now, cur.world, sizeof cur.world);
    memcpy(now + 12, cur.world_row3, sizeof cur.world_row3);
    last_world(now, last);
    /* view x world, then projection x that: each summed in order without fused multiply-adds, the
     * game's order, bit-identical on every draw checked ((P x V) x W or fused sums are off by a last
     * bit on 2-60% of draws) */
    Mat4 proj = mat4_load(cur.device + 0x280), view = mat4_load(cur.device + 0x2c0);
    Mat4 vw = mat4_mul(&view, &w), wvp = mat4_mul(&proj, &vw);
    memcpy(out, w.m, sizeof w.m);
    memcpy(out + 16, vw.m, sizeof vw.m);
    memcpy(out + 32, wvp.m, sizeof wvp.m);
    memcpy(out + 48, last, 16 * sizeof(float));  /* last frame's world */
    /* last frame's view x world: the device's derived matrix 10 (f_977680, computed at the commit
     * into the matrix cache at [device+0xe90] - 0x180, our record's +0x240): last frame's view (the
     * device's matrix 4, +0x380) times last frame's world (the game's matrix 6 is this frame's; ours the object's
     * history), with its bottom row */
    Mat4 w6, oldview = mat4_load(cur.device + 0x380);
    memcpy(w6.m, last, sizeof w6.m);
    Mat4 ovw = mat4_mul(&oldview, &w6);
    memcpy(out + 64, ovw.m, sizeof ovw.m);
}

int gbuffer_take_draw(CPUState *ctx, const NvnCmdBuf *cb, int indexed, int instanced) {
    if (cur.armed) learn_program(cb);
    if (!cur.armed || __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != MODE_NATIVE) return 0;
    cur.armed = 0;
    native_summary();
    /* DrawElements(cmd, primitive, type, count, address) or DrawArrays(cmd, primitive, first, count);
     * instanced: then (base vertex,) base instance, instances */
    uint32_t prim = (uint32_t)ctx->x[1], type = indexed ? (uint32_t)ctx->x[2] : 0, count = (uint32_t)ctx->x[3];
    uint64_t index_addr = indexed ? ctx->x[4] : 0, first = indexed ? 0 : ctx->x[2];
    int32_t base_vertex = instanced && indexed ? (int32_t)ctx->x[5] : 0;
    uint32_t base_instance = !instanced ? 0 : (uint32_t)ctx->x[indexed ? 6 : 4];
    uint32_t instances = !instanced ? 1 : (uint32_t)ctx->x[indexed ? 7 : 5];
    const NvnProgram *p = cb->program;
    /* any fragment program: our draw changes only what the vertex program reads */
    if (!local_rows(p) || skipped(p)) return note_other(p), nat.left[0]++, 0;
    if (!cur.have_world) return nat.left[1]++, 0;
    if (U8(cur.submesh + 0x3d) != 1 || prim != 4) return nat.left[2]++, 0;  /* table index 1, NVN's triangles */
    uint64_t bufs = U64(cur.geometry + 0x20);
    uint32_t stride = U8(cur.submesh + 0x3e);
    GBufferDraw d;
    d.vertices = bufs ? U64(bufs) + U32(cur.submesh) : 0;
    d.vertex_count = U32(cur.submesh + 8);
    d.vertex_bytes = d.vertex_count * stride;
    /* a submesh without indices (+0xc 0) is drawn as its vertices in order */
    d.index_count = U32(cur.submesh + 0xc);
    d.indices = d.index_count ? indices_of(cur.geometry, cur.submesh) : 0;
    d.index_type = !d.index_count ? 0 : U8(cur.submesh + 0x3f) & 2 ? 2 : 1;
    d.primitive = 4;
    /* the attributes' streams (one each: 0-4 for this program) all bound to the submesh's vertices
     * with its stride, so our buffer can go in all of them */
    int one_stream = cb->trace_nattribs > 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++) {
        uint32_t a = cb->trace_attribs[i], s = a >> 8 & 0x1F;
        if ((a & 0xFF) && (s >= 8 || cb->trace_vb[s] != cb->trace_vb0 || (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[s] != stride))
            one_stream = 0;
    }
    if (!d.vertices || !stride || cb->trace_vb0 != d.vertices || !one_stream) {
        static int shown;
        if (shown++ < 3) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gbuffer: native: vertex layout not ours: buffer %#" PRIx64 " (ours %#" PRIx64 "), stride"
                    " %u, stream 0 %#" PRIx64 ", attributes:", cb->trace_vb0, d.vertices, stride, cb->trace_streams[0]);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %#x", cb->trace_attribs[i]);
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        }
        return nat.left[3]++, 0;
    }
    if (index_addr != d.indices) return nat.left[4]++, 0;
    if (d.index_count ? count != d.index_count || type != d.index_type
                      : first || count != d.vertex_count)
        return nat.left[5]++, 0;
    if (base_vertex) return nat.left[5]++, 0;
    memcpy(d.game, &ctx->x[1], sizeof d.game);
    d.game_indexed = indexed;
    d.game_instanced = instanced;
    d.base_instance = base_instance, d.instances = instances;
    if (!cb->trace_ub[0][2]) return nat.left[1]++, 0;
    object_constants((const float *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[0][2], d.object);
    nvn_record_native(ctx, ctx->x[0], gpu_gbuffer_draw, &d, sizeof d);
    nat.taken++;
    return 1;
}
```

```h
/* Our G-buffer pass (decision 0026): the model renderer's G-buffer layers (kind 2). */
#ifndef YW4_GBUFFER_H
#define YW4_GBUFFER_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "nvn.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

/* From the model renderer hook (shadow.c), at the start of every layer. */
void gbuffer_layer_start(const CPUState *ctx);
/* From the submesh-draw hook (shadow.c), before every submesh draw: 1 if our takeover recorded the
 * draw itself (decision 0030; then the game's submesh draw is skipped). */
int gbuffer_submesh(const CPUState *ctx);
/* The shadow pass drew the submesh noted last itself (the game's draw is skipped): forget it. */
void gbuffer_disarm(void);
/* The renderer's world for the submesh about to be drawn ([sp+0x30]+0x40 at the submesh-draw
 * hook, 3 rows of 4): 1 if found. The shadow pass's too. */
int gbuffer_hook_world(const CPUState *ctx, float out[12]);
/* YW4_GBUFFER=native (our draws and programs) or =programs (our programs in the game's draws,
 * step 2a): gpu_draw.c asks per draw whether our programs replace the game's. The settings panel switches
 * between native and the game's. */
int gbuffer_native(void);
int gbuffer_native_frame(uint64_t gpu_frame);  /* the same, with YW4_GBUFFER_ALTERNATE applied */
void gbuffer_toggle(void);
/* Step 2b, YW4_GBUFFER=native: a G-buffer draw of ours, recorded in place of the game's
 * DrawElements. Our buffers and object constants; the rest (material constants, textures,
 * vertex formats, targets, pipeline state) is what the game bound before it. */
enum { GBUFFER_OBJECT_FLOATS = 80 };  /* 20 rows: the programs read up to row 19 */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t vertices, indices;
    uint32_t vertex_bytes, vertex_count, index_type, index_count, primitive;  /* index_type, primitive: NVN's;
                                                                  * no indices: index_count 0 */
    uint64_t game[7];  /* the game's draw (x1..x7), drawn instead on the game's frames */
    int game_indexed;  /* it was DrawElements, else DrawArrays */
    int game_instanced;  /* ...Instanced: game[] has its base vertex (indexed), base instance, instances */
    uint32_t base_instance, instances;  /* ours: the game's, so the instanced programs read the same
                                         * copies (vertex constants 11, bound by the game) */
    float object[GBUFFER_OBJECT_FLOATS];  /* vertex constants 2: world, projection x view x world,
                                           * last frame's world, in the program's rows (gbuffer.c) */
} GBufferDraw;
/* nvn_cmdbuf.c, DrawElements(cmd, primitive, type, count, address) (indexed) or DrawArrays(cmd,
 * primitive, first, count), or their Instanced forms (then base vertex if indexed, base instance,
 * instances follow): 1 if our draw went in its place (then the game's is not recorded). */
int gbuffer_take_draw(CPUState *c, const NvnCmdBuf *cb, int indexed, int instanced);
/* CMD_NATIVE callback (gpu_draw.c): copies the bound colour targets in the frames of
 * YW4_CAPTURE_LAYER_AT; `data` is a name. */
void gpu_capture_layer(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
/* Same-frame A/B (gpu_ab.c, YW4_AB_AT): its marker's CMD_NATIVE function ('b' or 'e', then the
 * pass's name), whether the pass is the one compared, and the second run (the game's draws). */
void gpu_ab_native(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
int gpu_ab_wanted(const char *pass);
void gbuffer_end_recording(const CPUState *ctx, uint64_t cmd);  /* nvn_cmdbuf.c: EndRecording(cmd) */
extern int gpu_ab_game;
/* CMD_NATIVE callback (gpu_draw.c): `data` holds a GBufferDraw. */
void gpu_gbuffer_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);

/* The takeover (decision 0030, YW4_TAKEOVER=1 with YW4_GBUFFER=native): a draw of ours made at the
 * submesh-draw hook from the game's data alone, in place of the engine's state work and draw. The
 * blocks of constants follow the record (ubo[i].offset from its start). */
enum { TAKEOVER_TEXTURES = 20, TAKEOVER_UBOS = 32 };
typedef struct {
    GBufferDraw d;                  /* buffers, indices, vertex constants 2 */
    uint64_t program, vs_code, fs_code;  /* the guest NVNprogram, and the code it must still have */
    uint8_t nvn[0xb8];              /* NVN state objects as the engine keeps them from state+0x240 */
    uint32_t attribs[16], nattribs, stride;
    uint32_t tex_mask;              /* fragment texture slots of ours */
    uint32_t tex_at;                /* their TakeoverTex, one per slot in tex_mask in slot order, from here */
    struct { uint8_t slot, stages; uint32_t offset, size; } ubo[TAKEOVER_UBOS];
    uint32_t nubo;
} TakeoverDraw;
/* A texture of a takeover draw: its pool entry, copied when recorded (the engine registers textures at
 * rising ids that wrap, so an id can name another texture by the time the draw runs), and its sampler. */
typedef struct {
    NvnTexEntry e;
    NvnSamplerDesc samp;
} TakeoverTex;
/* The TakeoverTex of fragment slot k (in tex_mask). */
static inline const TakeoverTex *takeover_tex(const TakeoverDraw *t, unsigned k) {
    return (const TakeoverTex *)((const uint8_t *)t + t->tex_at) + __builtin_popcount(t->tex_mask & ((1u << k) - 1));
}
/* CMD_NATIVE callback (gpu_draw.c): `data` holds a TakeoverDraw and its blocks. */
void gpu_takeover_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);

/* YW4_GBUFFER=check: nvn_cmdbuf.c calls gbuffer_check_draw for every draw while this is set. */
extern int gbuffer_checking;
/* index_addr 0: not indexed; type and count are the draw's (count: indices or vertices) */
void gbuffer_check_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t index_addr, uint32_t type, uint32_t count);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/gpu.c`:

```c
/* The draw path: NVN command lists run on Vulkan (decision 0021).
 *
 * Memory: every memory pool is imported with VK_EXT_external_memory_host and covered by
 * one VkBuffer, so an NVN buffer address is (that buffer, offset) and the GPU reads and
 * writes the game's memory in place. Textures are VkImages, one per NVN texture, made at
 * first use: those in CPU-no-access pools (render targets) are only ever written by the
 * GPU; the others are uploaded from the game's memory (de-swizzled with tegra.c) when made
 * and again after WriteTexels changes them.
 *
 * Execution: gpu_execute records one Vulkan command buffer per NVN command list and submits
 * it, signalling a timeline semaphore with the submission's number; NVN syncs wait for
 * numbers. Every image stays in layout GENERAL and a full memory barrier separates the
 * operations: simple and correct; finer barriers when profiling asks for them. Draws are
 * in gpu_draw.c.
 *
 * The NVN -> Vulkan format table follows LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/vulkan/textures.c; MIT, see
 * third_party/lasrecomp), as does the sampler translation.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "bindings.h"
#include "events.h"
#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "post.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "shadow.h"
#include "tegra.h"
#include "window.h"

static int ready;
static HostLock gpu_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;  /* recording and submitting */
static VkCommandPool cmd_pool;
static VkSemaphore timeline;
static uint64_t submitted;  /* number of the last submission */

/* Command buffers in a ring; each slot also owns what its submission needs until it has
 * run: descriptor pools and staging memory. */
enum { RING = 16, MAX_DESC_POOLS = 16 };
/* Staging memory: uploads are packed into blocks of STAGING_BLOCK bytes (a bigger upload gets a block of its own),
 * as many blocks as a submission needs. Each upload used to be a buffer and an allocation of its own, at most 256 a
 * submission: a late-game area reloading after a Diary save made more and the game stopped ("more than 256 uploads
 * in one submission", owner 2026-11-17). Each upload starts at a multiple of STAGING_ALIGN: a buffer-to-image
 * copy's offset must be a multiple of 4 and of the texel block's size (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 bytes). */
#define STAGING_BLOCK ((VkDeviceSize)4 << 20)  /* small: up to RING submissions keep theirs until the slot comes round */
#define STAGING_ALIGN ((VkDeviceSize)768)
typedef struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    uint8_t *ptr;
    VkDeviceSize size, used;
} StagingBlock;
typedef struct {
    VkCommandBuffer cb;
    uint64_t seq;  /* the submission that last used it */
    VkDescriptorPool desc[MAX_DESC_POOLS];
    int ndesc;
    StagingBlock *blocks;  /* the submission's staging memory (grown as needed, freed when the slot comes round) */
    int nblocks, blocks_cap;
    /* YW4_DETILE_CHECK=1: the GPU's de-tiled bytes and the CPU's for the same levels, compared when the slot
     * comes round again (the GPU done) */
    struct {
        const uint8_t *gpu, *cpu;
        VkDeviceSize n;
    } checks[64];
    int nchecks;
} Slot;
static Slot ring[RING];
static int ring_next;
static Slot *cur;  /* the slot being recorded */

/* GPU timing (YW4 performance log): each submission writes a timestamp at its start and end
 * into its slot's pair of queries; the results are read once the submission has completed
 * and added up per frame. */
static VkQueryPool qpool;
static double ts_period_ns;  /* nanoseconds per timestamp tick; 0 = no timestamps */
typedef struct {
    int slot;
    uint64_t seq, frame;
} PendingTime;
static PendingTime pending[64];
static int npending;
typedef struct {
    uint64_t frame, busy, first, last;  /* ticks */
    int used;
} FrameTime;
static FrameTime frame_times[32];
static uint64_t present_count;  /* frames presented */

static void gpu_crash_report(VkResult r);

void gpu_fatal(const char *what, VkResult r) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: %s failed (VkResult %d)\n", what, (int)r);
    gpu_crash_report(r);
    yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
}

void gpu_stop(const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: ");
    vfprintf(stderr, fmt, ap);
    fprintf(stderr, " (not supported yet)\n");
    va_end(ap);
    char text[600];
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(text, sizeof text, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    yw4_event_text("fatal", 0, "text", text);
    yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
}

/* Start-up (2026-11-11): the guest boots on its thread while Vulkan and Streamline start on the main one
 * (window.c), ~2 s of each that used to run one after the other. The guest needs nothing of the GPU until its
 * first command list, except that it makes memory pools; so gpu_ready(), which every guest path into the draw
 * path asks first, waits until the start is over (gpu_start_done: with or without a GPU), and pools made before
 * that are kept in a list and imported then. */
static HostLock start_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static HostCond start_cond = HOST_COND_INIT;
static int start_done;
enum { EARLY_POOLS = 64 };
static NvnPool *early_pools[EARLY_POOLS];
static int nearly;

int gpu_ready(void) {
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&start_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
        host_lock(&start_lock);
        while (!start_done) host_cond_wait(&start_cond, &start_lock, -1);
        host_unlock(&start_lock);
    }
    return ready;
}

static void pool_import(NvnPool *p);

void gpu_start_done(void) {
    host_lock(&start_lock);
    for (int i = 0; ready && i < nearly; i++) pool_import(early_pools[i]);
    nearly = 0;
    __atomic_store_n(&start_done, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    host_cond_broadcast(&start_cond);
    host_unlock(&start_lock);
}

void gpu_init(void) {
    if (!vk.host_import) return;
    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT,
                                   .queueFamilyIndex = vk.queue_family};
    CHECK(vkCreateCommandPool(vk.device, &pci, NULL, &cmd_pool));
    for (int i = 0; i < RING; i++) {
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO,
                                          .commandPool = cmd_pool, .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY,
                                          .commandBufferCount = 1};
        CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(vk.device, &ai, &ring[i].cb));
    }
    VkSemaphoreTypeCreateInfo tci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_CREATE_INFO,
                                     .semaphoreType = VK_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_TIMELINE};
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo sci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &tci};
    CHECK(vkCreateSemaphore(vk.device, &sci, NULL, &timeline));
    if (vk.props.limits.timestampComputeAndGraphics && vk.props.limits.timestampPeriod > 0) {
        VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                    .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, .queryCount = 2 * RING};
        if (vkCreateQueryPool(vk.device, &qi, NULL, &qpool) == VK_SUCCESS)
            ts_period_ns = vk.props.limits.timestampPeriod;
    }
    ready = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: draw path on (decision 0021)\n");
    gpu_pcache_init();
    gpu_prebuild_start();
}

/* ================================================================== submissions */

uint64_t gpu_submitted(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&submitted, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

static uint64_t completed(void) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    CHECK(vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(vk.device, timeline, &v));
    return v;
}

_Thread_local int gpu_in_work;

int gpu_wait(uint64_t seq, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    if (!ready || completed() >= seq) return 0;
    VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, .semaphoreCount = 1,
                              .pSemaphores = &timeline, .pValues = &seq};
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    VkResult r = vkWaitSemaphores(vk.device, &wi, timeout_ns);
    if (gpu_in_work) gpu_stall_add(STALL_WAIT, host_now_ns() - t0);
    if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) return 2;
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) gpu_fatal("vkWaitSemaphores", r);
    return 1;
}

/* Adds the timestamps of every completed submission to its frame. gpu_lock held. */
static void collect_times(void) {
    if (!ts_period_ns) return;
    uint64_t done = completed();
    for (int i = 0; i < npending;) {
        PendingTime p = pending[i];
        if (p.seq > done) {
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        uint64_t t[2];
        if (vkGetQueryPoolResults(vk.device, qpool, (uint32_t)p.slot * 2, 2, sizeof t, t, sizeof t[0],
                                  VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT) == VK_SUCCESS && t[1] >= t[0]) {
            FrameTime *f = &frame_times[p.frame % 32];
            if (!f->used || f->frame != p.frame) *f = (FrameTime){.frame = p.frame, .first = t[0], .used = 1};
            f->busy += t[1] - t[0];
            if (t[0] < f->first) f->first = t[0];
            if (t[1] > f->last) f->last = t[1];
        }
        gpu_passes_collect(p.slot);
        pending[i] = pending[--npending];
    }
}

/* The performance log's GPU times (perf.c, on the presenting thread). It never waits for the GPU lock: the GPU
 * thread holds it while it turns a frame's commands into Vulkan's, and waiting for it here was 28% of the main
 * thread's time in the busy street (2026-11-02, YW4_PROFILE). Without the lock, the times begin() collected. */
int gpu_frame_time(uint64_t frame, double *busy_ms, double *span_ms) {
    if (!ready || !ts_period_ns) return 0;
    FrameTime f;
    if (host_trylock(&gpu_lock)) {
        collect_times();
        f = frame_times[frame % 32];
        host_unlock(&gpu_lock);
    } else {
        f = frame_times[frame % 32];  /* may be mid-update: a log figure, checked by its frame below */
    }
    if (!f.used || f.frame != frame) return 0;
    *busy_ms = (double)f.busy * ts_period_ns / 1e6;
    *span_ms = (double)(f.last - f.first) * ts_period_ns / 1e6;
    return 1;
}

/* The next slot of the ring, its command buffer begun; waits if the GPU still runs it, then
 * frees what its last submission used. gpu_lock held. */
static void geo_reset_if_full(void);

static VkCommandBuffer begin(void) {
    Slot *s = &ring[ring_next];
    ring_next = (ring_next + 1) % RING;
    gpu_wait(s->seq, UINT64_MAX);
    geo_reset_if_full();
    collect_times();  /* before the slot's queries are reset below */
    for (int i = 0; i < s->ndesc; i++) CHECK(vkResetDescriptorPool(vk.device, s->desc[i], 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < s->nchecks; i++) {  /* YW4_DETILE_CHECK: before their staging buffers go */
        static long checked, wrong;
        int bad = memcmp(s->checks[i].gpu, s->checks[i].cpu, s->checks[i].n) != 0;
        checked++, wrong += bad;
        if (bad || checked % 500 == 0)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: detile check: %ld textures, %ld differ%s\n", checked, wrong, bad ? " (this one)" : "");
    }
    s->nchecks = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s->nblocks; i++) {
        vkDestroyBuffer(vk.device, s->blocks[i].buf, NULL);
        vkFreeMemory(vk.device, s->blocks[i].mem, NULL);
    }
    s->nblocks = 0;
    CHECK(vkResetCommandBuffer(s->cb, 0));
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(s->cb, &bi));
    if (ts_period_ns) {
        uint32_t q = (uint32_t)(s - ring) * 2;
        vkCmdResetQueryPool(s->cb, qpool, q, 2);
        vkCmdWriteTimestamp(s->cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, qpool, q);
    }
    gpu_passes_begin(s->cb, (int)(s - ring));
    gpu_dynamic_forget();  /* a new command buffer: no dynamic state set yet */
    s->seq = submitted + 1;
    cur = s;
    return s->cb;
}

static void submit(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    gpu_passes_end(cb);
    if (ts_period_ns && cur) vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, qpool, (uint32_t)(cur - ring) * 2 + 1);
    CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb));
    uint64_t seq = submitted + 1;
    VkTimelineSemaphoreSubmitInfo ts = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_TIMELINE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO,
                                        .signalSemaphoreValueCount = 1, .pSignalSemaphoreValues = &seq};
    VkSubmitInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, .pNext = &ts, .commandBufferCount = 1,
                       .pCommandBuffers = &cb, .signalSemaphoreCount = 1, .pSignalSemaphores = &timeline};
    host_lock(&vk.queue_lock);
    VkResult r = vkQueueSubmit(vk.queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    host_unlock(&vk.queue_lock);
    if (r == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: device lost in submission %" PRIu64 "\n", seq);
        gpu_crash_report(r);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) gpu_fatal("vkQueueSubmit", r);
    __atomic_store_n(&submitted, seq, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (ts_period_ns && cur && npending < 64) pending[npending++] = (PendingTime){(int)(cur - ring), seq, present_count + 1};
    cur = NULL;
}

void full_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    VkMemoryBarrier mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER,
                          .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                          .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL,
                         0, NULL);
}

VkDescriptorSet gpu_alloc_set(VkDescriptorSetLayout layout) {
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, .descriptorSetCount = 1,
                                      .pSetLayouts = &layout};
    VkDescriptorSet set;
    if (cur->ndesc) {
        ai.descriptorPool = cur->desc[cur->ndesc - 1];
        VkResult r = vkAllocateDescriptorSets(vk.device, &ai, &set);
        if (r == VK_SUCCESS) return set;
        if (r != VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY && r != VK_ERROR_FRAGMENTED_POOL) gpu_fatal("vkAllocateDescriptorSets", r);
    }
    if (cur->ndesc == MAX_DESC_POOLS) gpu_stop("more than %d descriptor pools in one submission", MAX_DESC_POOLS);
    VkDescriptorPoolSize sizes[] = {{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 16384},
                                    {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 16384},
                                    {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 2048},
                                    {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE, 512}};
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo pci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .maxSets = 4096,
                                      .poolSizeCount = 4, .pPoolSizes = sizes};
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorPool(vk.device, &pci, NULL, &cur->desc[cur->ndesc]));
    ai.descriptorPool = cur->desc[cur->ndesc++];
    CHECK(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(vk.device, &ai, &set));
    return set;
}

/* `size` bytes of host-visible memory, alive until the current submission has run: the buffer it is in and where in
 * it it starts (*base) for the copy commands, and the bytes to write. */
static void *staging(VkDeviceSize size, VkBuffer *buf, VkDeviceSize *base) {
    StagingBlock *k = cur->nblocks ? &cur->blocks[cur->nblocks - 1] : NULL;
    VkDeviceSize at = k ? (k->used + STAGING_ALIGN - 1) / STAGING_ALIGN * STAGING_ALIGN : 0;
    if (!k || at + size > k->size) {  /* a new block */
        if (cur->nblocks == cur->blocks_cap) {
            int cap = cur->blocks_cap ? cur->blocks_cap * 2 : 8;
            StagingBlock *grown = realloc(cur->blocks, (size_t)cap * sizeof *grown);
            if (!grown) gpu_stop("out of host memory for %d staging blocks", cap);
            cur->blocks = grown, cur->blocks_cap = cap;
        }
        k = &cur->blocks[cur->nblocks];
        memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
        k->size = size > STAGING_BLOCK ? size : STAGING_BLOCK;
        VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = k->size,
                                  .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
        CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &k->buf));
        VkMemoryRequirements mr;
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, k->buf, &mr);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
            .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits,
                                              VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)};
        CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &k->mem));
        CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, k->buf, k->mem, 0));
        void *p;
        CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, k->mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &p));
        k->ptr = p;
        cur->nblocks++;
        at = 0;
    }
    k->used = at + size;
    *buf = k->buf, *base = at;
    return k->ptr + at;
}

/* ================================================================== memory pools */

typedef struct {
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    VkBuffer buf;
    uint32_t *page_gen;  /* per 4 KiB page: the write generation it was last seen written in */
    int untracked;       /* the host can't track writes to it: every page counts as written */
    uint32_t *flush_seq; /* per 4 KiB page: the last FlushMappedRange that covered it (flush_count's value) */
} GpuPool;

static uint32_t flush_count;  /* FlushMappedRange calls so far (gpu_note_flushed) */

/* Has a FlushMappedRange covered a page of [addr, addr + size) since flush_count was `seen`? */
static int flushed_since(const NvnPool *p, uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint32_t seen) {
    const GpuPool *gp = p->gpu;
    uint64_t end = addr + size < p->storage + p->size ? addr + size : p->storage + p->size;
    for (uint64_t a = (addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (end - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        if (__atomic_load_n(&gp->flush_seq[a], __ATOMIC_RELAXED) > seen) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* CPU writes to the pools (decision 0021): once a frame, the pages written since the last
 * frame get the new write generation (host_written_pages; Windows tracks writes per page).
 * A texture is uploaded again when one of its pages is newer than its last upload. This
 * catches what the game writes without WriteTexels, like the movie decoder's frames. */
static uint32_t write_gen = 1;

static void mark_written(uint64_t page, void *arg) {
    const NvnPool *p = arg;
    ((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->page_gen[(page - p->storage) >> 12] = write_gen;
}

enum { MAX_POOLS = 64 };
static NvnPool *pools[MAX_POOLS];
static int npools;

static NvnPool *pool_of(uint64_t addr) {
    for (int i = 0; i < npools; i++)
        if (addr >= pools[i]->storage && addr < pools[i]->storage + pools[i]->size) return pools[i];
    return NULL;
}

static void scan_writes(void) {
    __atomic_add_fetch(&write_gen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);  /* gpu_note_written counts too, on game threads */
    /* Every 600 frames, the scan's cost. Slow street 2026-11-17: ~1.1-1.2 ms a frame, ~1,900 pages written, 1,092 MiB
     * walked; ~10% of the GPU worker. Splitting it over 3 helper threads did not shorten it (Windows seems to run
     * GetWriteWatch calls on one process one at a time): no fps gain, removed. */
    static int64_t ns;
    static uint64_t pages, bytes, frames;
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    for (int i = 0; i < npools; i++) {
        NvnPool *p = pools[i];
        GpuPool *g = p->gpu;
        if (p->flags & POOL_CPU_NO_ACCESS || g->untracked) continue;
        long n = host_written_pages(p->storage, p->size, mark_written, p);
        if (n < 0) g->untracked = 1;
        else pages += (uint64_t)n, bytes += p->size;
    }
    ns += host_now_ns() - t0;
    if (++frames == 600) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: write scan: %.2f ms a frame, %.0f pages written a frame, %.0f MiB of pools scanned\n",
                (double)ns / 1e6 / 600, (double)pages / 600, (double)bytes / 600 / 1048576);
        ns = 0, pages = bytes = frames = 0;
    }
}

/* Where the host can't see which pages the game writes (Linux for now: host.c), a texture is uploaded again on the
 * events that change it, not on a guess. Page tracking can't work there: the pools are host memory imported into
 * the GPU driver, and amdgpu and i915 take every page of them for writing at each submission, so a write-protect
 * or a soft-dirty bit would see every page written (kernel 6.12 source, 2026-11-13). Measured on Windows with
 * YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG over 7 scenes (town, busy spots, late game, cutscene): the game rewrites a texture without
 * WriteTexels only for the title movie's planes (one level of R8: Y 1920x1080, U and V 960x540); every other
 * texture's content never changed after its first upload. So, on such a host, t is uploaded again when
 *  - a newer registration of it than the image's last upload is drawn with (the game loaded a new texture
 *    into memory an old one used: it registers it before drawing with it),
 *  - our own code wrote its pages (WriteTexels: gpu_note_written),
 *  - it is a movie plane and a sample of its content differs from the last upload's. */
static int movie_plane(const NvnTexture *t) {
    return t->format == 0x01 && t->layout.levels <= 1 && t->target == TARGET_2D;
}

/* Every 64th 8-byte word and the last: a movie frame changes nearly every texel, so this sees every new frame for
 * ~1/64 of the reading (a 1920x1080 plane: 4 KB instead of 2 MB) */
static uint64_t storage_sample(const NvnTexture *t) {
    uint64_t n = tegra_total_size(&t->layout) / 8, h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    const uint64_t *m = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i += 64) h = (h ^ m[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    if (n) h = (h ^ m[n - 1]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    return h | 1;
}

void gpu_note_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    NvnPool *p = size ? pool_of(addr) : NULL;
    if (!p || !p->gpu || !((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->untracked) return;  /* tracked: the host saw the write itself */
    uint64_t end = addr + size < p->storage + p->size ? addr + size : p->storage + p->size;
    uint32_t gen = __atomic_add_fetch(&write_gen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);  /* newer than every upload so far */
    for (uint64_t a = (addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (end - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        __atomic_store_n(&((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->page_gen[a], gen, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

/* nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange / nvnBufferFlushMappedRange: the game says the CPU wrote [addr, addr + size) for
 * the GPU (on the console a CPU-cached pool needs it). Measured for now (YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG). */
void gpu_note_flushed(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    NvnPool *p = size ? pool_of(addr) : NULL;
    if (!p || !p->gpu) return;
    uint64_t end = addr + size < p->storage + p->size ? addr + size : p->storage + p->size;
    uint32_t seq = __atomic_add_fetch(&flush_count, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    for (uint64_t a = (addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (end - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        __atomic_store_n(&((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->flush_seq[a], seq, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static int untracked_changed(const NvnTexture *t, GpuImage *g) {
    if (t->reg_gen > g->reg_gen) return 1;
    NvnPool *p = pool_of(t->addr);  /* pages our own code wrote (gpu_note_written) */
    const GpuPool *gp = p->gpu;
    uint64_t end = t->addr + tegra_total_size(&t->layout);
    if (end > p->storage + p->size) end = p->storage + p->size;
    for (uint64_t a = (t->addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (end - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        if (__atomic_load_n(&gp->page_gen[a], __ATOMIC_RELAXED) > g->upload_gen) return 1;
    if (movie_plane(t) && storage_sample(t) != g->sample) return 1;
    g->checked_gen = write_gen;  /* asked again this frame (gpu_needs_transfer, then image_of): the same answer */
    return 0;
}

/* Has the CPU written t's storage since its image g was last uploaded? */
static int cpu_changed(const NvnTexture *t, GpuImage *g) {
    if (!g || !t->addr || t->pool_flags & POOL_CPU_NO_ACCESS || g->checked_gen == write_gen) return 0;
    NvnPool *p = pool_of(t->addr);
    if (!p) return 0;
    const GpuPool *gp = p->gpu;
    if (gp->untracked) return untracked_changed(t, g);
    uint64_t end = t->addr + tegra_total_size(&t->layout);
    if (end > p->storage + p->size) end = p->storage + p->size;
    for (uint64_t a = (t->addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (end - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        if (gp->page_gen[a] > g->upload_gen) return 1;
    g->checked_gen = write_gen;
    return 0;
}


void gpu_pool_init(NvnPool *p) {
    if (!p->size) return;
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&start_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {  /* Vulkan is still starting: imported when it is up */
        host_lock(&start_lock);
        if (!start_done) {
            if (nearly == EARLY_POOLS) gpu_stop("more than %d memory pools before Vulkan is up", EARLY_POOLS);
            early_pools[nearly++] = p;
            host_unlock(&start_lock);
            return;
        }
        host_unlock(&start_lock);
    }
    if (ready) pool_import(p);
}

static void pool_import(NvnPool *p) {
    void *host = (void *)(uintptr_t)p->storage;
    if (p->storage % vk.host_import_align || p->size % vk.host_import_align) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pool %#" PRIx64 " + %#" PRIx64 " is not aligned for import\n", p->storage, p->size);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    if (npools == MAX_POOLS) gpu_stop("more than %d memory pools", MAX_POOLS);
    VkMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT hp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_HOST_POINTER_PROPERTIES_EXT};
    CHECK(vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT(vk.device, VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_HOST_ALLOCATION_BIT_EXT, host,
                                              &hp));
    VkExternalMemoryBufferCreateInfo ext = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO,
                                            .handleTypes = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_HOST_ALLOCATION_BIT_EXT};
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &ext, .size = p->size,
        .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT |
                 VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                 VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT |
                 /* the game's conditional draws read its counters where they lie (gpu_query.c) */
                 (vk.conditional_rendering ? VK_BUFFER_USAGE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT : 0)};
    GpuPool *g = calloc(1, sizeof *g);
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &g->buf));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, g->buf, &mr);
    uint32_t type = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits & hp.memoryTypeBits, 0);
    if (type == UINT32_MAX) gpu_stop("no memory type to import pool %#" PRIx64, p->storage);
    VkImportMemoryHostPointerInfoEXT imp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMPORT_MEMORY_HOST_POINTER_INFO_EXT,
                                            .handleType = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_HOST_ALLOCATION_BIT_EXT,
                                            .pHostPointer = host};
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .pNext = &imp,
                                .allocationSize = p->size, .memoryTypeIndex = type};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &g->mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, g->buf, g->mem, 0));
    g->page_gen = calloc(p->size >> 12, sizeof *g->page_gen);
    g->flush_seq = calloc(p->size >> 12, sizeof *g->flush_seq);
    if (!g->page_gen || !g->flush_seq) gpu_stop("no memory for write tracking");
    if (getenv("YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG") && atoi(getenv("YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG")))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: reupload: pool %#" PRIx64 " + %#" PRIx64 " flags %#x\n", p->storage, p->size, p->flags);
    p->gpu = g;
    /* writes before now: uploads read them anyway. YW4_UNTRACKED=1 (tests): as a host that can't track writes
     * (Linux), so its rules run on Windows at full speed */
    static int untracked_test = -1;
    if (untracked_test < 0) untracked_test = getenv("YW4_UNTRACKED") && atoi(getenv("YW4_UNTRACKED"));
    if (untracked_test || host_written_pages(p->storage, p->size, mark_written, p) < 0) g->untracked = 1;
    host_lock(&gpu_lock);
    pools[npools++] = p;
    host_unlock(&gpu_lock);
}

void gpu_pool_finalize(NvnPool *p) {
    GpuPool *g = p->gpu;
    if (!g) return;
    gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX);
    host_lock(&gpu_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < npools; i++)
        if (pools[i] == p) pools[i] = pools[--npools];
    host_unlock(&gpu_lock);
    vkDestroyBuffer(vk.device, g->buf, NULL);
    vkFreeMemory(vk.device, g->mem, NULL);
    free(g->page_gen);
    free(g->flush_seq);
    free(g);
    p->gpu = NULL;
}

/* ---- geometry in video memory (decision 0028; YW4_VRAM_GEOMETRY=0: off): the pools are the
 * game's memory imported as is, so a draw read its vertices and indices from system memory across
 * PCIe, which made the G-buffer and material passes of a busy street take 15 ms each. Here a draw's
 * vertex and index ranges get a copy in one device-local arena, made once and made again when the
 * CPU has written one of the range's pages since (write generations, as for textures). A range
 * the CPU keeps writing (UI, effects) is left in the pool after a few copies. When the arena is
 * full (or its table crowded), it is emptied at the start of the next submission. The arena has two
 * halves, filled in turn: emptying switches to the other half, which the GPU finished with long
 * ago, so the CPU doesn't wait for the work in flight (waiting made one 50 ms frame). */
enum { GEO_ARENA = 1u << 30, GEO_HALF = GEO_ARENA / 2, GEO_SLOTS = 1 << 18, GEO_DYNAMIC = 4 };
typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, size, at;     /* the range, and where its copy is in the arena */
    uint32_t copied_gen, checked_gen;
    uint32_t copies;             /* made again this many times: GEO_DYNAMIC and it stays in the pool */
    uint64_t print;              /* a small range's contents when copied (geo_print) */
    uint64_t lprint;             /* YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG: the whole range's contents when copied */
    uint32_t flush_seen;         /* YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG: flush_count when copied */
    uint32_t made;               /* copied at least once */
} GeoCopy;
static GeoCopy geo[GEO_SLOTS];
static int reupload_log(void);
static VkBuffer geo_buf;
static VkDeviceMemory geo_mem;
static uint64_t geo_used;   /* in the current half */
static uint32_t geo_count;  /* ranges in the table */
static int geo_half;        /* the half being filled */
static uint64_t geo_retired[2];  /* the last submission that read each half before it was left */
static int geo_on = -1, geo_full;
enum { GEO_MEMO = 1024 };
typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, size;
    GeoCopy *c;
    uint32_t epoch;  /* geo_epoch when remembered */
} GeoMemo;
static GeoMemo geo_memo[GEO_MEMO];
static uint32_t geo_epoch = 1;

int gpu_vram_geometry(void) {
    if (geo_on < 0) geo_on = !getenv("YW4_VRAM_GEOMETRY") || atoi(getenv("YW4_VRAM_GEOMETRY"));
    return geo_on;
}

/* begin(): the half filled up: go on in the other one, once the submissions that read it have run
 * (they ran long ago: a half lasts minutes, so the wait is almost always none). */
static void geo_reset_if_full(void) {
    if (!geo_full) return;
    geo_retired[geo_half] = submitted;
    geo_half ^= 1;
    int waited = gpu_wait(geo_retired[geo_half], UINT64_MAX);
    memset(geo, 0, sizeof geo);
    geo_epoch++;  /* the memo's pointers (geo_find) are into the emptied table */
    geo_used = 0, geo_full = 0, geo_count = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: geometry arena emptied (now half %d%s)\n", geo_half, waited ? ", waited for the GPU" : "");
}

static GeoCopy *geo_find(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int add) {
    uint64_t mix = (addr ^ size * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    /* A small memo of ranges found lately in front of the 16 MB table: a draw asks for each of its ranges twice
     * (needs_copy, then geometry_at) and the next frame asks for the same ones; the table's slot is a cache miss
     * each time (2026-11-17). Entries are never removed one by one, only all at once (geo_reset_if_full: geo_epoch),
     * so a remembered pointer stays right until then. */
    GeoMemo *mo = &geo_memo[(uint32_t)(mix >> 54) & (GEO_MEMO - 1)];
    if (mo->epoch == geo_epoch && mo->addr == addr && mo->size == size) return mo->c;
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(mix >> 32) & (GEO_SLOTS - 1);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 64; i++, h = (h + 1) & (GEO_SLOTS - 1)) {
        GeoCopy *c = &geo[h];
        if (c->size && c->addr == addr && c->size == size) {
            *mo = (GeoMemo){addr, size, c, geo_epoch};
            return c;
        }
        if (!c->size) {
            if (!add) return NULL;
            uint64_t at = (geo_used + 255) & ~255ull;
            if (at + size > GEO_HALF) {
                geo_full = 1;
                return NULL;
            }
            geo_used = at + size;
            *c = (GeoCopy){.addr = addr, .size = size, .at = (uint64_t)geo_half * GEO_HALF + at};
            *mo = (GeoMemo){addr, size, c, geo_epoch};
            if (++geo_count % 8192 == 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: geometry table: %u ranges, %" PRIu64 " MiB\n", geo_count, geo_used >> 20);
            return c;
        }
    }
    if (add && !geo_full) {  /* no free slot near: empty the table as if the arena were full (the
                              * table fills first: ~1.5 KB per range in a long session) */
        geo_full = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: geometry table crowded (%u ranges, %" PRIu64 " MiB of the arena used)\n", geo_count,
                geo_used >> 20);
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* Does the range's copy need making (again)? Its pages, checked once a frame. */
static int geo_stale(GeoCopy *c, const NvnPool *p) {
    if (!c->copied_gen) return 1;
    const GpuPool *gp = p->gpu;
    /* a host that can't see the game's writes: the game's flushes say what it wrote. Measured on Windows over two
     * scenes (2026-11-13, YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG): all 31,522 copies made again whose content had changed were of
     * ranges the game had flushed since; the 32 unflushed ones were unchanged. Checked at every use, as flushes
     * come any time (game threads), not once a frame. */
    if (gp->untracked) return flushed_since(p, c->addr, c->size, c->flush_seen);
    if (c->checked_gen == write_gen) return 0;
    for (uint64_t a = (c->addr - p->storage) >> 12, z = (c->addr + c->size - 1 - p->storage) >> 12; a <= z; a++)
        if (gp->page_gen[a] > c->copied_gen) return 1;
    c->checked_gen = write_gen;
    return 0;
}

/* Small ranges are also compared by content (YW4_GEO_PRINT=0: pages only). The pages tell what was written up to
 * the last present, but the game writes a frame's UI quads after it: when its ring of vertex memory comes round
 * to an address that still has a copy, the pages look clean for one more frame and the draw got the quad that
 * was there a lap ago (2026-11-13: the minimap drawn as its icon sheet for one frame, found with the minimap
 * watch, gpu_watch.c). A quad is 160 bytes: reading it costs less than the copy it decides on. */
enum { GEO_SMALL = 1024 };
static uint64_t geo_print(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    /* 8 bytes a step (it runs for every small range of every draw: byte steps were most of
     * gpu_geometry_needs_copy's time, 2026-11-17); a mix after each word so a change anywhere shows */
    const uint8_t *m = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)addr;
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull ^ size, i = 0;
    for (; i + 8 <= size; i += 8) {
        uint64_t v;
        memcpy(&v, m + i, 8);
        h = (h ^ v) * 0x100000001b3ull;
        h ^= h >> 32;
    }
    for (; i < size; i++) h = (h ^ m[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    return h | 1;  /* never 0: 0 is "no print" */
}

static int geo_print_on(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) v = !getenv("YW4_GEO_PRINT") || atoi(getenv("YW4_GEO_PRINT"));
    return v;
}

/* gpu_draw.c, before rendering: 1 if the range would be copied now (rendering must end first). */
int gpu_geometry_needs_copy(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!gpu_vram_geometry() || !size) return 0;
    NvnPool *p = pool_of(addr);
    if (!p || addr + size > p->storage + p->size) return 0;
    GeoCopy *c = geo_find(addr, size, 1);
    if (!c || c->copies >= GEO_DYNAMIC) return 0;
    if (geo_stale(c, p)) return 1;
    if (size > GEO_SMALL || !c->print || !geo_print_on() || geo_print(addr, size) == c->print) return 0;
    static uint64_t missed;  /* rewritten, and its pages don't say so yet */
    if (missed++ < 8 || missed % 1000 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: frame %" PRIu64 ": geometry range %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) was rewritten since its copy"
                        " and its pages don't show it yet: copied again (%" PRIu64 " so far)\n", present_count + 1, addr, size, missed);
    if (missed <= 64) yw4_event("geometry_missed", present_count + 1, "\"addr\":%" PRIu64 ",\"size\":%" PRIu64, addr, size);
    if (++c->copies >= GEO_DYNAMIC) return 0;  /* it keeps changing: read from the pool from now on, as the others */
    c->copied_gen = 0;  /* stale, also for gpu_geometry_copy's own asking */
    return 1;
}

/* gpu_draw.c, outside rendering: makes the range's copy if it needs one. */
void gpu_geometry_copy(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!gpu_geometry_needs_copy(addr, size)) return;
    if (!geo_buf) {
        VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = GEO_ARENA,
                                  .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                                           VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT};
        CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &geo_buf));
        VkMemoryRequirements mr;
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, geo_buf, &mr);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                    .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)};
        CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &geo_mem));
        CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, geo_buf, geo_mem, 0));
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: geometry in video memory (%u MiB arena)\n", GEO_ARENA >> 20);
    }
    NvnPool *p = pool_of(addr);
    GeoCopy *c = geo_find(addr, size, 0);
    if (!c) return;
    VkBufferCopy bc = {.srcOffset = addr - p->storage, .dstOffset = c->at, .size = size};
    uint32_t flushes = __atomic_load_n(&flush_count, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);  /* before the copy's reading is recorded */
    vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, ((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->buf, geo_buf, 1, &bc);
    if (reupload_log()) {  /* a copy made again: did the content change, and did the game flush it? */
        uint64_t print = geo_print(addr, size);
        if (c->made)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: regeo: frame %" PRIu64 " addr %#" PRIx64 " bytes %" PRIu64 " copies %u content %s flushed %s%s\n",
                    present_count + 1, addr, size, c->copies, print == c->lprint ? "same" : "changed",
                    flushed_since(p, addr, size, c->flush_seen) ? "yes" : "no",
                    print != c->lprint && !flushed_since(p, addr, size, c->flush_seen) ? " untracked rule MISSED" : "");
        c->lprint = print, c->made = 1;
    }
    c->flush_seen = flushes;  /* flushes after this make it stale */
    if (c->copied_gen && ++c->copies == GEO_DYNAMIC) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: geometry range %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) rewritten %d times: left in system memory\n",
                    addr, size, GEO_DYNAMIC);
    }
    c->copied_gen = c->checked_gen = write_gen;
    c->print = size <= GEO_SMALL ? geo_print(addr, size) : 0;
}

/* The range's copy in video memory if it has a current one, else 0. */
static int geometry_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, VkBuffer *buf, VkDeviceSize *off) {
    if (!gpu_vram_geometry() || !geo_buf) return 0;
    GeoCopy *c = geo_find(addr, size, 0);
    if (!c || !c->copied_gen || c->copies >= GEO_DYNAMIC) return 0;
    const NvnPool *p = pool_of(addr);
    if (p && ((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->untracked ? flushed_since(p, addr, size, c->flush_seen) : c->checked_gen != write_gen)
        return 0;
    *buf = geo_buf, *off = c->at;
    return 1;
}

int gpu_geometry_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, VkBuffer *buf, VkDeviceSize *off) {
    return geometry_at(addr, size, buf, off) || gpu_buffer_at(addr, size, buf, off);
}

int gpu_buffer_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, VkBuffer *buf, VkDeviceSize *off) {
    for (int i = 0; i < npools; i++) {
        const NvnPool *p = pools[i];
        if (addr >= p->storage && addr + size <= p->storage + p->size) {
            *buf = ((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->buf;
            *off = addr - p->storage;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ================================================================== formats */

/* Format 0x35 is NVN_FORMAT_DEPTH24_STENCIL8. AMD GPUs do not support 24-bit depth attachments;
 * fall back to D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT so depth testing and writes work. YW4_FORCE_D32S8=1 forces it for tests. */
static VkFormat d24s8_format(void) {
    static VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    if (fmt != VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) return fmt;
    if (!vk.gpu) return VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
    VkFormatProperties fp = {0};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(vk.gpu, VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT, &fp);
    VkFormatFeatureFlags needed = VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT;
    if ((fp.optimalTilingFeatures & needed) == needed && !getenv("YW4_FORCE_D32S8")) {
        fmt = VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
    } else {
        fmt = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: depth format 0x35 (D24S8) mapped to D32S8%s\n",
                getenv("YW4_FORCE_D32S8") ? " (forced by YW4_FORCE_D32S8)" : " (D24S8 attachment not supported by GPU)");
    }
    return fmt;
}

VkFormat gpu_format(uint32_t f) {
    switch (f) {
    case 0x01: return VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
    case 0x02: return VK_FORMAT_R8_SNORM;
    case 0x03: return VK_FORMAT_R8_UINT;
    case 0x04: return VK_FORMAT_R8_SINT;
    case 0x05: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT;
    case 0x06: return VK_FORMAT_R16_UNORM;
    case 0x07: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SNORM;
    case 0x08: return VK_FORMAT_R16_UINT;
    case 0x09: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SINT;
    case 0x0A: return VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x0B: return VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT;
    case 0x0C: return VK_FORMAT_R32_SINT;
    case 0x0D: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM;
    case 0x0E: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SNORM;
    case 0x0F: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UINT;
    case 0x10: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SINT;
    case 0x11: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT;
    case 0x12: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UNORM;
    case 0x13: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM;
    case 0x14: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UINT;
    case 0x15: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT;
    case 0x16: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x17: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT;
    case 0x18: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SINT;
    case 0x25: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case 0x26: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM;
    case 0x27: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT;
    case 0x28: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT;
    case 0x29: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT;
    case 0x2A: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UNORM;
    case 0x2B: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM;
    case 0x2C: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT;
    case 0x2D: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT;
    case 0x2E: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x2F: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT;
    case 0x30: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SINT;
    case 0x31: return VK_FORMAT_S8_UINT;
    case 0x32: return VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM;
    case 0x33: return VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;  /* DEPTH24 */
    case 0x34: return VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x35: return d24s8_format();
    case 0x36: return VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    case 0x38: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
    case 0x3C: return VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16;
    case 0x3D: return VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32;
    case 0x3E: return VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UINT_PACK32;
    case 0x3F: return VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32;
    case 0x40: return VK_FORMAT_E5B9G9R9_UFLOAT_PACK32;
    case 0x41: case 0x42: return VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x43: return VK_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x44: return VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x45: case 0x46: return VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_SRGB_BLOCK;
    case 0x47: return VK_FORMAT_BC2_SRGB_BLOCK;
    case 0x48: return VK_FORMAT_BC3_SRGB_BLOCK;
    case 0x49: return VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x4A: return VK_FORMAT_BC4_SNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x4B: return VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x4C: return VK_FORMAT_BC5_SNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x4D: return VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK;
    case 0x4E: return VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK;
    case 0x4F: return VK_FORMAT_BC6H_SFLOAT_BLOCK;
    case 0x50: return VK_FORMAT_BC6H_UFLOAT_BLOCK;
    /* RGBX / BGRX: alpha unused, reads as 1 (gpu_format_alpha_one) */
    case 0x37: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
    case 0x6D: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case 0x71: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT;
    case 0x76: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x98: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case 0x9A: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
    case 0x99: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case 0x9B: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
    default: return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    }
}

int gpu_format_alpha_one(uint32_t f) {
    return f == 0x37 || f == 0x6D || f == 0x71 || f == 0x76 || f == 0x98 || f == 0x9A;
}

static VkImageAspectFlags aspect_of(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT: return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
    case VK_FORMAT_S8_UINT: return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    case VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT:
        return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT | VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    default: return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    }
}

/* ================================================================== images */

/* Copies t's texels from the game's memory into its image: every level and layer. */
static void upload_texels(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *t, GpuImage *g);

/* ---- textures de-tiled on the GPU (runtime/shaders/detile.comp; YW4_GPU_DETILE=0: on the CPU, tegra.c):
 * the GPU reads a level's block-linear bytes straight from the game's pool (imported as a buffer) and writes
 * its rows in order into a ring in video memory, copied into the image after. An area's few hundred new
 * textures took the CPU ~70 ms at once even with tegra.c's GOB rows (2026-11-02). Levels whose rows aren't
 * whole 16-byte pieces (the smallest mips) stay on the CPU. */
/* 256 MiB: an area's 380 textures are ~130 MiB in one submission, where the ring can't go round; 64 MiB left
 * 47-91 MiB of them to the CPU. Video memory at the owner's 4K 21:9 settings peaked at 3.8 of 7.2 GB
 * (2026-11-02, the vram log). */
enum { DETILE_RING = 256u << 20 };
static VkBuffer detile_ring;
static VkDeviceMemory detile_ring_mem;
static VkDeviceSize detile_head;
static uint64_t detile_last_seq;  /* the last submission that used the ring */
static VkPipeline detile_pipe;
static VkPipelineLayout detile_layout;
static VkDescriptorSetLayout detile_set_layout;
static VkDeviceSize detile_align;  /* storage buffer offsets */
static int detile_state = -1;      /* -1 not tried, 0 off, 1 ready */

typedef struct {
    uint32_t src_base, dst_base, row16, rows, slices, width_gobs, bh, bd, block_rows;
} DetileLevel;

static int detile_ready(void) {
    if (detile_state >= 0) return detile_state;
    detile_state = 0;
    if ((getenv("YW4_GPU_DETILE") && !atoi(getenv("YW4_GPU_DETILE"))) || getenv("YW4_DUMP_UPLOAD")) return 0;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(vk.gpu, &props);
    detile_align = props.limits.minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment;
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[2] = {
        {0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, NULL},
        {1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, NULL}};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo sci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .bindingCount = 2,
                                           .pBindings = b};
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &sci, NULL, &detile_set_layout));
    VkPushConstantRange pr = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof(DetileLevel)};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
                                      .pSetLayouts = &detile_set_layout, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1,
                                      .pPushConstantRanges = &pr};
    CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &detile_layout));
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
        .stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT,
                  .module = gpu_native_shader("detile.comp"), .pName = "main"},
        .layout = detile_layout};
    CHECK(vkCreateComputePipelines(vk.device, gpu_pcache(), 1, &ci, NULL, &detile_pipe));
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = DETILE_RING,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT};
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &detile_ring));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, detile_ring, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &detile_ring_mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, detile_ring, detile_ring_mem, 0));
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: textures de-tiled on the GPU (%u MiB ring)\n", DETILE_RING >> 20);
    return detile_state = 1;
}

/* Room for `size` bytes in the ring for the current submission; UINT64_MAX if there is none now (the CPU
 * de-tiles then). It goes round only once the GPU has run the last submission that used it: waiting for that
 * in a loading burst cost 83 ms in one frame (2026-11-02). */
static long detile_busy, detile_busy_bytes;  /* textures that found no room: the stall report's */

static VkDeviceSize detile_room(VkDeviceSize size) {
    if (size > DETILE_RING || (detile_head + size > DETILE_RING && completed() < detile_last_seq)) {
        detile_busy++, detile_busy_bytes += (long)size;
        return UINT64_MAX;
    }
    if (detile_head + size > DETILE_RING) detile_head = 0;
    VkDeviceSize at = detile_head;
    detile_head = (at + size + 255) & ~(VkDeviceSize)255;
    detile_last_seq = cur->seq;
    return at;
}

/* Records the GPU de-tiling and the copies into g of the levels of t it can take; the levels done, as a mask
 * (the rest are the CPU's). Outside rendering. */
static uint32_t detile(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *t, GpuImage *g) {
    const TexLayout *L = &t->layout;
    const FormatInfo *f = L->fmt;
    if (!detile_ready() || !f || !f->bpb || 16 % f->bpb) return 0;
    NvnPool *p = pool_of(t->addr);
    uint64_t span = tegra_total_size(L);
    if (!p || !p->gpu || t->addr + span > p->storage + p->size) return 0;
    uint64_t start = t->addr - p->storage, layer_size = tegra_layer_size(L);
    uint32_t mask = 0;
    VkDeviceSize size = 0;
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < g->levels && l < 16; l++) {
        LevelLayout lv = tegra_level(L, l);
        uint64_t row = (uint64_t)lv.wb * f->bpb;
        int aligned = (start + lv.offset) % 16 == 0 && (g->layers < 2 || layer_size % 16 == 0);
        if (row % 16 || !aligned) continue;
        mask |= 1u << l;
        size += row * lv.hb * lv.d * g->layers;
    }
    if (!mask) return 0;
    VkDeviceSize at = detile_room(size);
    if (at == UINT64_MAX) return 0;
    uint64_t align = detile_align > 16 ? detile_align : 16;  /* both powers of two */
    uint64_t bound = start / align * align;  /* the source binding starts here, on a 16-byte piece */
    VkDescriptorSet set = gpu_alloc_set(detile_set_layout);
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo bi[2] = {{((GpuPool *)p->gpu)->buf, bound, start + span - bound},
                                    {detile_ring, 0, DETILE_RING}};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w[2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        w[i] = (VkWriteDescriptorSet){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = set, .dstBinding = (uint32_t)i,
                                      .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
                                      .pBufferInfo = &bi[i]};
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(vk.device, 2, w, 0, NULL);
    full_barrier(cb);  /* earlier work on the ring and the image */
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, detile_pipe);
    vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, detile_layout, 0, 1, &set, 0, NULL);
    VkBufferImageCopy copies[16];
    uint32_t ncopies = 0;
    VkDeviceSize off = at;
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < g->levels && l < 16; l++) {
        if (!(mask >> l & 1)) continue;
        LevelLayout lv = tegra_level(L, l);
        uint32_t row = lv.wb * f->bpb;
        VkDeviceSize layer_bytes = (VkDeviceSize)row * lv.hb * lv.d;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g->layers; k++) {
            DetileLevel pc = {.src_base = (uint32_t)((start + k * layer_size + lv.offset - bound) / 16),
                              .dst_base = (uint32_t)((off + k * layer_bytes) / 16), .row16 = row / 16, .rows = lv.hb,
                              .slices = lv.d, .width_gobs = (row + 63) / 64, .bh = lv.block_height_log2,
                              .bd = lv.block_depth_log2,
                              .block_rows = (lv.hb + (8u << lv.block_height_log2) - 1) / (8u << lv.block_height_log2)};
            uint64_t groups = ((uint64_t)pc.row16 * pc.rows * pc.slices + 63) / 64;
            uint32_t gx = groups < 65535 ? (uint32_t)groups : 65535, gy = (uint32_t)((groups + gx - 1) / gx);
            vkCmdPushConstants(cb, detile_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof pc, &pc);
            vkCmdDispatch(cb, gx, gy, 1);
        }
        copies[ncopies++] = (VkBufferImageCopy){
            .bufferOffset = off, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, l, 0, g->layers},
            .imageExtent = {lv.w, lv.h, lv.d}};
        off += layer_bytes * g->layers;
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, detile_ring, g->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, ncopies, copies);
    full_barrier(cb);
    /* YW4_DETILE_CHECK=1: the GPU's bytes copied out, and the CPU's for the same levels, for begin() to compare */
    static int check = -1;
```
