```c
int gpu_ab_game;  /* the second run: the game's draws (gbuffer.c asks) */

enum { TARGETS = 9 };  /* up to 8 colour targets and depth */

typedef struct {
    GpuImage *g;
    VkImage saved;  /* the target as the layer found it */
    VkDeviceMemory saved_mem;
    VkBuffer out[2];  /* ours, the game's */
    VkDeviceMemory out_mem[2];
    uint32_t bytes, bpt;  /* size of a copy, bytes per texel */
    int depth;
} Target;

static struct {
    uint64_t exec;    /* the command list run the begin marker was in */
    int active, run;  /* a range is being compared; 0 ours, 1 the game's */
    uint64_t resume;  /* the record after the begin marker */
    GpuState *state;  /* the executor's state at the begin marker */
    Target t[TARGETS];
    int n;
    uint64_t frame;
    char pass[16];
} ab;

/* At present: 1 compare and free, 2 only free (a range that didn't finish) */
static int pending;

static int ab_frame(uint64_t f) {
    static uint64_t at[32], to[32];  /* frames or ranges: "1800,1850" or "3400-4000" (every frame of a wide run) */
    static int n = -1;
    if (n < 0) {
        n = 0;
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_AB_AT");
        for (char *end; e && *e && n < 32; e = *end ? end + 1 : end) {
            at[n] = to[n] = strtoull(e, &end, 10);
            if (end == e) break;
            if (*end == '-') to[n] = strtoull(end + 1, &end, 10);
            n++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (f >= at[i] && f <= to[i]) return 1;
    return 0;
}

int gpu_ab_wanted(const char *pass) {
    const char *p = getenv("YW4_AB_PASS");
    return getenv("YW4_AB_AT") && !strcmp(p ? p : "gbuffer", pass);
}

static uint32_t texel_bytes(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SFLOAT: return 8;
    case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT: return 16;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM: return 1;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R16_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM: return 2;
    default: return 4;  /* RGBA8, R11G11B10, R16G16, R32 */
    }
}

static VkBuffer host_buffer(VkDeviceSize size, VkDeviceMemory *mem) {
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = size,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VkBuffer b;
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &b));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, b, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
        .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits,
                                          VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, b, *mem, 0));
    return b;
}

static void copy_image(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuImage *g, VkImage from, VkImage to) {
    VkImageCopy c = {.srcSubresource = {g->aspect, 0, 0, g->layers}, .dstSubresource = {g->aspect, 0, 0, g->layers},
                     .extent = {g->width, g->height, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImage(cb, from, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, to, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &c);
    full_barrier(cb);
}

static void copy_out(VkCommandBuffer cb, const Target *t, VkBuffer to) {
    VkImageAspectFlags a = t->depth ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    VkBufferImageCopy c = {.imageSubresource = {a, 0, 0, t->g->layers}, .imageExtent = {t->g->width, t->g->height, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, t->g->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, to, 1, &c);
    full_barrier(cb);
}

static void add_target(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *tex, int depth) {
    if (!tex || ab.n >= TARGETS) return;
    GpuImage *g = image_of(cb, tex);
    for (int i = 0; i < ab.n; i++)
        if (ab.t[i].g == g) return;
    if (g->depth != 1) return;  /* 2D (array) targets only */
    /* three copies of each target: the 4096 shadow maps (3 layers, 200 MB a copy) were too much
     * (the game died comparing them); YW4_SHADOW_RES=1024 compares the game's size */
    uint64_t bytes = (uint64_t)g->width * g->height * g->layers * (depth ? 4 : texel_bytes(g->format));
    if (bytes > (64u << 20)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ab: a %ux%u target with %u layers is too big to compare (YW4_SHADOW_RES=1024 for the"
                " shadow maps)\n", g->width, g->height, g->layers);
        return;
    }
    Target *t = &ab.t[ab.n++];
    memset(t, 0, sizeof *t);
    t->g = g, t->depth = depth;
    t->bpt = depth ? (g->format == VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM ? 2 : 4) : texel_bytes(g->format);
    t->bytes = g->width * g->height * g->layers * t->bpt;
    VkImageCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                             .format = g->format, .extent = {g->width, g->height, 1}, .mipLevels = 1,
                             .arrayLayers = g->layers, .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT,
                             .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                             .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                             .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
    CHECK(vkCreateImage(vk.device, &ici, NULL, &t->saved));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(vk.device, t->saved, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &t->saved_mem));
    CHECK(vkBindImageMemory(vk.device, t->saved, t->saved_mem, 0));
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER, .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                              .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                              .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                              .image = t->saved, .subresourceRange = {g->aspect, 0, 1, 0, g->layers}};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1,
                         &b);
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) t->out[k] = host_buffer(t->bytes, &t->out_mem[k]);
    copy_image(cb, g, g->image, t->saved);
}

/* gpu_execute, after SetRenderTargets: targets first bound inside the range are copied too (a layer
 * binds its own), before anything draws into them. */
void gpu_ab_targets(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s) {
    if (!ab.active || ab.run) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < s->ncolor && i < 8; i++) add_target(cb, s->rt.color[i], 0);
    add_target(cb, s->rt.depth, 1);
}

/* A marker's CMD_NATIVE function: gpu_execute hands markers to gpu_ab_marker instead. */
void gpu_ab_native(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    (void)vk_cb, (void)gpu_state, (void)data, (void)size;
}

/* exec: which command list run this is; next: the record after the marker. Returns 1 when the
 * executor must go on at *resume instead (the second run). */
int gpu_ab_marker(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, const void *data, uint32_t size, uint64_t exec, uint64_t next,
                  uint64_t *resume) {
    char what = size ? *(const char *)data : 0;  /* 'b' begin, 'e' end; then the pass's name */
    if (ab.active && exec != ab.exec) {  /* the range ran into another command list: give up on it */
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ab: the %s layer of frame %" PRIu64 " ended in another command list: not compared\n",
                ab.pass, ab.frame);
        free(ab.state);
        ab.active = 0, gpu_ab_game = 0;
        pending = 2;  /* the copies are freed after the GPU, at present */
        return 0;
    }
    if (what == 'b') {
        if (ab.active || pending || !ab_frame(gpu_frames())) return 0;
        gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
        memset(&ab, 0, sizeof ab);
        ab.active = 1, ab.resume = next, ab.frame = gpu_frames(), ab.exec = exec;
        snprintf(ab.pass, sizeof ab.pass, "%.*s", (int)(size > 1 ? size - 1 : 0), (const char *)data + 1);
        if (!(ab.state = malloc(sizeof *ab.state))) return ab.active = 0, 0;
        *ab.state = *s;
        for (int i = 0; i < s->ncolor && i < 8; i++) add_target(cb, s->rt.color[i], 0);
        add_target(cb, s->rt.depth, 1);
        return 0;
    }
    if (what != 'e' || !ab.active) return 0;
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    for (int i = 0; i < ab.n; i++) copy_out(cb, &ab.t[i], ab.t[i].out[ab.run]);
    if (ab.run == 0) {  /* again, from the same images and state, with the game's draws */
        for (int i = 0; i < ab.n; i++) copy_image(cb, ab.t[i].g, ab.t[i].saved, ab.t[i].g->image);
        *s = *ab.state;
        ab.run = 1;
        gpu_ab_game = 1;
        *resume = ab.resume;
        return 1;
    }
    gpu_ab_game = 0;
    ab.active = 0;
    free(ab.state);
    pending = 1;
    return 0;
}

int gpu_ab_pending(void) { return pending; }

/* At present, after the GPU is done: compare and free. */
void gpu_ab_flush(void) {
    if (!pending) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < ab.n; i++) {
        Target *t = &ab.t[i];
        if (pending == 1) {
            uint8_t *a, *b;
            CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, t->out_mem[0], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&a));
            CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, t->out_mem[1], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&b));
            long differ = 0, first = -1, far = 0, far_first = -1;  /* far: 32-bit float depth off by more than
                                                                   * YW4_AB_TOLERANCE (1e-4), not just rounding */
            static float tol = -1.0f;
            if (tol < 0.0f) tol = getenv("YW4_AB_TOLERANCE") ? (float)atof(getenv("YW4_AB_TOLERANCE")) : 1e-4f;
            if (t->depth && (t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT || t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT))
                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < t->bytes / 4; k++) {
                    float fa, fb;
                    memcpy(&fa, a + (size_t)k * 4, 4), memcpy(&fb, b + (size_t)k * 4, 4);
                    if (fabsf(fa - fb) > tol) {
                        if (far_first < 0) far_first = k;
                        far++;
                    }
                }
            /* 24-bit depth comes out in 32 bits whose top 8 are undefined */
            int d24 = t->depth && (t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT || t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32);
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < t->bytes / t->bpt; k++)
                if (d24 ? (((const uint32_t *)a)[k] ^ ((const uint32_t *)b)[k]) & 0xFFFFFF
                        : memcmp(a + (size_t)k * t->bpt, b + (size_t)k * t->bpt, t->bpt)) {
                    if (first < 0) first = k;
                    differ++;
                }
            yw4_event("ab", ab.frame, "\"pass\":\"%s\",\"target\":%d,\"depth\":%d,\"differ\":%ld,\"texels\":%u", ab.pass, i,
                      t->depth ? 1 : 0, differ, t->g->width * t->g->height * t->g->layers);
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ab: %s frame %" PRIu64 " %s %d (%#" PRIx64 ", %ux%u, format %d): %ld of %u texels differ between"
                    " ours and the game's", ab.pass, ab.frame, t->depth ? "depth" : "colour", i, t->g->key.addr, t->g->width,
                    t->g->height, (int)t->g->format, differ, t->g->width * t->g->height * t->g->layers);
            if (first >= 0) fprintf(stderr, " (first at %ld, %ld)", first % t->g->width, first / t->g->width);
            if (t->depth && (t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT || t->g->format == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "; beyond rounding: %ld", far);
                if (far_first >= 0)
                    fprintf(stderr, " (first at %ld, %ld, layer %ld)", far_first % t->g->width,
                            (far_first / t->g->width) % t->g->height, far_first / ((long)t->g->width * t->g->height));
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
            /* YW4_AB_SHOW=<n>: the first n differing texels, ours and the game's (raw, up to 8 bytes) */
            long show = getenv("YW4_AB_SHOW") ? atol(getenv("YW4_AB_SHOW")) : 0;
            for (uint32_t k = (uint32_t)(first < 0 ? 0 : first); first >= 0 && show > 0 && k < t->bytes / t->bpt; k++) {
                uint64_t va = 0, vb = 0;
                memcpy(&va, a + (size_t)k * t->bpt, t->bpt < 8 ? t->bpt : 8);
                memcpy(&vb, b + (size_t)k * t->bpt, t->bpt < 8 ? t->bpt : 8);
                if (va == vb) continue;
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ab:   (%u, %u): ours %#" PRIx64 ", the game's %#" PRIx64 "\n", k % t->g->width,
                        k / t->g->width, va, vb);
                show--;
            }
            vkUnmapMemory(vk.device, t->out_mem[0]), vkUnmapMemory(vk.device, t->out_mem[1]);
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) vkDestroyBuffer(vk.device, t->out[k], NULL), vkFreeMemory(vk.device, t->out_mem[k], NULL);
        vkDestroyImage(vk.device, t->saved, NULL), vkFreeMemory(vk.device, t->saved_mem, NULL);
    }
    ab.n = 0;
    pending = 0;
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_dlss.c`:

```c
/* NVIDIA DLSS upscaling (decision 0040). NVIDIA's NGX SDK (fetched by tools/yw4/deps.py under NVIDIA's own
 * licence, never committed): its static library, linked with runtime/src/msvc_shim.c, finds NGX in the NVIDIA
 * driver, which loads nvngx_dlss.dll from yw4.exe's folder (on Linux libnvidia-ngx-dlss.so.<version> from yw4's,
 * decision 0073). DLSS needs a few device extensions, which window.c enables on NVIDIA GPUs
 * (gpu_dlss_device_extensions).
 *
 * Used by gpu_aa.c like FSR: the same inputs (the encoded scene, its depth, the game's motion, the jitter), the
 * same output image and the same upscaling plumbing (gpu.c). DLSS is told the colour is not HDR (the encoded
 * curve is 0..1) and works out its own exposure. Upscaling modes map to DLSS's: none = DLAA (DLSS's
 * anti-aliasing at the same size), quality, balanced, performance. NVIDIA DLSS is credited where it is offered
 * (the settings panel's option text, README). */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu.h"
#include "gpu_dlss.h"
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
#include "host.h"

#ifdef YW4_DLSS
#include <SDL3/SDL_filesystem.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_vulkan.h>
#include <wchar.h>

#include "nvsdk_ngx_helpers_vk.h"
#include "nvsdk_ngx_vk.h"

int gpu_dlss_built(void) { return 1; }

int gpu_dlss_device_extensions(uint32_t vendor, const char ***exts, unsigned *count) {
    *exts = NULL, *count = 0;
    if (vendor != 0x10de) return 0;  /* NVIDIA */
    unsigned ni = 0;
    const char **ie = NULL;
    if (NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_RequiredExtensions(&ni, &ie, count, exts) != NVSDK_NGX_Result_Success) *exts = NULL, *count = 0;
    return (int)*count;
}

/* Models (2026-10-29, 4K 21:9 output, RTX 4070 laptop, performance mode): DLSS's defaults, the transformers K
 * (quality, balanced) and M (performance), cost 5.3 / 7.4 ms; the CNN preset E 2.6 ms (FSR 3.7). The CNN was the
 * default until 2026-10-31, when it turned out to make shadow edges flicker (the character's shadow, standing
 * still: 4-6% of its edge pixels over 16 frames, the transformers 0%; the same in the build that brought DLSS in).
 * So the transformers only, no panel row; YW4_DLSS_MODEL=0 still picks the CNN for tests. */
int gpu_dlss_model(void) {
    static int m = -1;
    if (m < 0) m = !(getenv("YW4_DLSS_MODEL") && atoi(getenv("YW4_DLSS_MODEL")) == 0);
    return m;
}

static int state = -1;  /* -1 not tried, 0 unavailable, 1 ready */
static NVSDK_NGX_Parameter *params;
static NVSDK_NGX_Handle *feature;
static uint32_t f_rw, f_rh, f_ow, f_oh;
static int f_quality, f_model, f_failed;

int gpu_dlss_available(void) {
    if (state >= 0) return state;
    if (!vk.device) return 0;
    state = 0;
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_DLSS");
    if (e && *e == '0') return 0;
    if (vk.props.vendorID != 0x10de) return 0;
    PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa = dlssg_loader();  /* Streamline's while it runs (DLSS frame generation) */
    if (!gipa) gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)SDL_Vulkan_GetVkGetInstanceProcAddr();
    NVSDK_NGX_FeatureCommonInfo *info = NULL;
#ifndef _WIN32
    /* Linux (decision 0073): libnvidia-ngx-dlss.so.<version> sits next to yw4 (recomp/build.py). NGX's default is
     * the application's folder too; naming it leaves nothing to how NGX finds that folder. */
    static wchar_t dir[1024];
    static const wchar_t *dirs[1] = {dir};
    static NVSDK_NGX_FeatureCommonInfo common;
    const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath();
    if (base && mbstowcs(dir, base, sizeof dir / sizeof dir[0] - 1) != (size_t)-1) {
        common.PathListInfo.Path = dirs, common.PathListInfo.Length = 1;
        info = &common;
    }
#endif
    NVSDK_NGX_Result r = NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_Init_with_ProjectID(
        "4f6c2e1a-8b3d-4c7e-9a52-1d0e7b6c3f88", NVSDK_NGX_ENGINE_TYPE_CUSTOM, "1.0", L".", vk.instance, vk.gpu,
        vk.device, gipa, vkGetDeviceProcAddr, info, NVSDK_NGX_Version_API);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(r)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: NGX did not start (%#x): FSR or TAA instead\n", (unsigned)r);
        return 0;
    }
    NVSDK_NGX_Parameter *caps = NULL;
    int avail = 0, driver = 0;
    if (NVSDK_NGX_SUCCEED(NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_GetCapabilityParameters(&caps)) && caps) {
        NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_GetI(caps, NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_SuperSampling_Available, &avail);
        NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_GetI(caps, NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_SuperSampling_NeedsUpdatedDriver, &driver);
    }
    if (!avail) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: not available on this GPU%s: FSR or TAA instead\n",
                driver ? " (the driver needs an update)" : "");
        return 0;
    }
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_AllocateParameters(&params))) return 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: NVIDIA DLSS ready\n");
    return state = 1;
}

static void release(void) {
    if (!feature) return;
    gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX);  /* DLSS's resources may still be in use */
    NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_ReleaseFeature(feature);
    feature = NULL;
}

static int create(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuDlssInputs *in) {
    int model = gpu_dlss_model();
    int same = f_rw == in->render_w && f_rh == in->render_h && f_ow == in->output_w && f_oh == in->output_h &&
               f_quality == in->quality && f_model == model;
    if (feature && same) return 1;
    if (!feature && f_failed && same) return 0;
    release();
    f_rw = in->render_w, f_rh = in->render_h, f_ow = in->output_w, f_oh = in->output_h, f_quality = in->quality;
    f_model = model;
    f_failed = 0;
    static const int perf[4] = {NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_DLAA, NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_MaxQuality,
                                NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_Balanced, NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value_MaxPerf};
    NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Create_Params cp;
    memset(&cp, 0, sizeof cp);
    cp.Feature.InWidth = in->render_w, cp.Feature.InHeight = in->render_h;
    cp.Feature.InTargetWidth = in->output_w, cp.Feature.InTargetHeight = in->output_h;
    cp.Feature.InPerfQualityValue = (NVSDK_NGX_PerfQuality_Value)perf[in->quality & 3];
    cp.InFeatureCreateFlags = NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_MVLowRes | NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Feature_Flags_AutoExposure;
    /* the model for every mode: the transformer preset K (fast = the CNN's E, tests only); YW4_DLSS_PRESET=<letter>
     * forces one. DLSS's own default for performance is M, the second-generation transformer: at 4K 21:9 output it
     * cost 7.4 ms against K's 5.3, so performance mode was slower than quality (2026-11-02; NVIDIA's defaults are K
     * for DLAA/quality/balanced, M for performance, L for ultra performance). */
    const char *pe = getenv("YW4_DLSS_PRESET");
    unsigned v = model ? NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_K : NVSDK_NGX_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_E;
    if (pe && *pe >= 'A' && *pe <= 'Z') v = (unsigned)(*pe - 'A' + 1);
    {
        static const char *const hints[] = {
            NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_DLAA, NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_Quality,
            NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_Balanced, NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_Performance,
            NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_UltraPerformance,
            NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_DLSS_Hint_Render_Preset_UltraQuality};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof hints / sizeof *hints; i++) NVSDK_NGX_Parameter_SetUI(params, hints[i], v);
    }
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    NVSDK_NGX_Result r = NGX_VULKAN_CREATE_DLSS_EXT1(vk.device, cb, 1, 1, &feature, params, &cp);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(r) || !feature) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: feature for %ux%u -> %ux%u failed (%#x)\n", in->render_w, in->render_h, in->output_w,
                in->output_h, (unsigned)r);
        feature = NULL, f_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: %ux%u -> %ux%u, %s model, ready in %.0f ms\n", in->render_w, in->render_h,
            in->output_w, in->output_h, model ? "best" : "fast", (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6);
    return 1;
}

static NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK resource(VkImageView v, VkImage im, VkFormat f, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, int depth,
                                      int write) {
    VkImageSubresourceRange range = {depth ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    return NVSDK_NGX_Create_ImageView_Resource_VK(v, im, range, f, w, h, write != 0);
}

int gpu_dlss_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuDlssInputs *in) {
    if (gpu_dlss_available() != 1 || !create(cb, in)) return 0;
    NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK color = resource(in->color_view, in->color, in->color_format, in->render_w, in->render_h, 0, 0);
    NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK depth = resource(in->depth_view, in->depth, in->depth_format, in->render_w, in->render_h, 1, 0);
    NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK motion = resource(in->motion_view, in->motion, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT, in->render_w,
                                            in->render_h, 0, 0);
    NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK out = resource(in->output_view, in->output, in->output_format, in->output_w, in->output_h, 0, 1);
    NVSDK_NGX_VK_DLSS_Eval_Params e;
    memset(&e, 0, sizeof e);
    e.Feature.pInColor = &color, e.Feature.pInOutput = &out;
    e.pInDepth = &depth, e.pInMotionVectors = &motion;
    e.InJitterOffsetX = in->jitter[0], e.InJitterOffsetY = in->jitter[1];
    e.InRenderSubrectDimensions.Width = in->render_w, e.InRenderSubrectDimensions.Height = in->render_h;
    e.InReset = in->reset;
    e.InMVScaleX = in->motion_scale[0], e.InMVScaleY = in->motion_scale[1];
    e.InFrameTimeDeltaInMsec = in->frame_ms;
    NVSDK_NGX_Result r = NGX_VULKAN_EVALUATE_DLSS_EXT(cb, feature, params, &e);
    if (NVSDK_NGX_FAILED(r)) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: evaluate failed (%#x)\n", (unsigned)r);
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

#else  /* no DLSS in this build */

int gpu_dlss_built(void) { return 0; }
int gpu_dlss_device_extensions(uint32_t vendor, const char ***exts, unsigned *count) {
    (void)vendor;
    *exts = NULL, *count = 0;
    return 0;
}
int gpu_dlss_available(void) { return 0; }
int gpu_dlss_model(void) { return 1; }
int gpu_dlss_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuDlssInputs *in) {
    (void)cb, (void)in;
    return 0;
}

#endif
```

`runtime/src/gpu_dlss.h`:

```h
/* NVIDIA DLSS upscaling (gpu_dlss.c, decision 0040): NGX from the NVIDIA driver, nvngx_dlss.dll next to yw4.exe. */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#include "vk.h"

typedef struct {
    VkImage color, depth, motion, output;  /* all in layout GENERAL; output has storage use */
    VkImageView color_view, depth_view, motion_view, output_view;
    VkFormat color_format, depth_format, output_format;
    uint32_t render_w, render_h, output_w, output_h;
    int quality;            /* the upscaling mode: 0 none (DLAA), 1 quality, 2 balanced, 3 performance */
    float jitter[2];        /* this frame's shift of the 3D draws, in render pixels */
    float motion_scale[2];  /* motion texel x scale = pixel motion from this frame's position to the last */
    int reset;
    float frame_ms;
} GpuDlssInputs;

/* 1: built with DLSS headers and libraries. */
int gpu_dlss_built(void);
/* The device extensions DLSS needs (NVIDIA GPUs only: vendor id 0x10de), for window.c to enable; 0 if none. */
int gpu_dlss_device_extensions(uint32_t vendor, const char ***exts, unsigned *count);
/* The DLSS model: 1 the transformers (DLSS's own defaults), always; 0 the CNN (preset E), with YW4_DLSS_MODEL=0
 * for tests only (it makes shadow edges flicker). */
int gpu_dlss_model(void);
/* 1: NGX started and DLSS is available on this GPU (checked once, after the device exists). */
int gpu_dlss_available(void);
/* Records DLSS into cb (outside rendering). 0 if it could not run. */
int gpu_dlss_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuDlssInputs *in);
```

`runtime/src/gpu_dlssg.cpp`:

```cpp
/* NVIDIA DLSS frame generation through Streamline 2.14.16 (decision 0041; the SDK is fetched by
 * tools/yw4/deps.py and never committed: Streamline is MIT, its DLSS-G and Reflex DLLs are under NVIDIA's RTX SDK
 * licence). C++ because Streamline's headers are; the rest of the runtime calls the C functions in gpu_dlssg.h.
 *
 * Streamline is started before the Vulkan instance when frame generation is set to DLSS at start (YW4_FG=2), and
 * every Vulkan function then comes through sl.interposer.dll's vkGetInstanceProcAddr: Vulkan's own, except the
 * few Streamline intercepts (instance and device creation, where it adds what DLSS-G needs; the surface; the
 * swapchain and the present, where DLSS-G puts its generated frame in and paces it). Its manual hooking mode
 * (only those few from it, the rest from SDL's loader) crashed in sl.common during vkCreateDevice: a null
 * function pointer (2026-10-29). sl.interposer.dll is loaded at run
 * time and its core functions are reached through pointers: the forwarders below give Streamline's own inline
 * helpers (slDLSSGSetOptions, slReflexSleep...) the functions they call.
 *
 * Per frame, on the presenting thread: a frame token, Reflex's sleep and the simulation-start marker after the
 * last present; after the anti-aliasing the 3D's depth and the game's motion tagged with the camera constants
 * (the game's matrices aren't known: a projection from the field of view, the camera motion taken as part of the
 * motion vectors); before the present the game's rectangle in the window image tagged as the backbuffer's
 * subrect (the black bars stay as they are), the options and the present markers. */
#ifdef YW4_STREAMLINE
#include <windows.h>
#include <dxgi.h>

#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "sl.h"
#include "sl_dlss_g.h"
#include "sl_pcl.h"
#include "sl_reflex.h"

extern "C" {
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"
}

/* ---- Streamline's core functions, from sl.interposer.dll */

static decltype(&slInit) p_slInit;
static decltype(&slShutdown) p_slShutdown;
static decltype(&slIsFeatureSupported) p_slIsFeatureSupported;
static decltype(&slSetTagForFrame) p_slSetTagForFrame;
static decltype(&slSetConstants) p_slSetConstants;
static decltype(&slGetFeatureFunction) p_slGetFeatureFunction;
static decltype(&slGetNewFrameToken) p_slGetNewFrameToken;
static decltype(&slGetFeatureRequirements) p_slGetFeatureRequirements;
static decltype(&slFreeResources) p_slFreeResources;

sl::Result slInit(const sl::Preferences &pref, uint64_t sdkVersion) { return p_slInit(pref, sdkVersion); }
sl::Result slShutdown() { return p_slShutdown(); }
sl::Result slIsFeatureSupported(sl::Feature f, const sl::AdapterInfo &a) { return p_slIsFeatureSupported(f, a); }
sl::Result slSetTagForFrame(const sl::FrameToken &frame, const sl::ViewportHandle &viewport, const sl::ResourceTag *tags,
                            uint32_t n, sl::CommandBuffer *cb) {
    return p_slSetTagForFrame(frame, viewport, tags, n, cb);
}
sl::Result slSetConstants(const sl::Constants &c, const sl::FrameToken &frame, const sl::ViewportHandle &viewport) {
    return p_slSetConstants(c, frame, viewport);
}
sl::Result slGetFeatureFunction(sl::Feature f, const char *name, void *&fn) { return p_slGetFeatureFunction(f, name, fn); }
sl::Result slGetNewFrameToken(sl::FrameToken *&token, const uint32_t *index) { return p_slGetNewFrameToken(token, index); }
sl::Result slGetFeatureRequirements(sl::Feature f, sl::FeatureRequirements &r) { return p_slGetFeatureRequirements(f, r); }
sl::Result slFreeResources(sl::Feature f, const sl::ViewportHandle &v) {
    return p_slFreeResources ? p_slFreeResources(f, v) : sl::Result::eErrorMissingOrInvalidAPI;
}

static HMODULE mod;
static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr sl_gipa;
static PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr sl_gdpa;
static int started = -1;  /* -1 not tried, 0 not running, 1 running */
static int avail = -1;
static const sl::ViewportHandle viewport(0);

static void log_message(sl::LogType type, const char *msg) {
    if (type == sl::LogType::eInfo && !getenv("YW4_SL_LOG")) return;
    size_t n = strlen(msg);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: streamline: %s: %.*s\n", type == sl::LogType::eError ? "error" : type == sl::LogType::eWarn ? "warning" : "info",
            (int)(n && msg[n - 1] == '\n' ? n - 1 : n), msg);
}

/* An NVIDIA GPU in this PC, asked through DXGI: Streamline must start before any Vulkan call, so Vulkan can't be
 * asked. dxgi.dll is loaded here, not linked. */
static int nvidia_gpu(void) {
    HMODULE d = LoadLibraryW(L"dxgi.dll");
    if (!d) return 0;
    auto create = (HRESULT(WINAPI *)(REFIID, void **))(void *)GetProcAddress(d, "CreateDXGIFactory1");
    IDXGIFactory1 *f = NULL;
    int found = 0;
    if (create && SUCCEEDED(create(__uuidof(IDXGIFactory1), (void **)&f)) && f) {
        IDXGIAdapter1 *a = NULL;
        for (UINT i = 0; !found && f->EnumAdapters1(i, &a) != DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND; i++) {
            DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc;
            if (SUCCEEDED(a->GetDesc1(&desc)) && desc.VendorId == 0x10de) found = 1;
            a->Release();
        }
        f->Release();
    }
    FreeLibrary(d);
    return found;
}

extern "C" int dlssg_start(void) {
    if (started >= 0) return started;
    started = 0;
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_STREAMLINE");  /* 0: never (Vulkan as without it) */
    if (e && *e == '0') return 0;
    if (!nvidia_gpu()) return 0;
    mod = LoadLibraryW(L"sl.interposer.dll");
    if (!mod) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: sl.interposer.dll not found next to yw4.exe (python -m recomp.build fetches it)\n");
        return 0;
    }
#define LOAD(f) p_##f = (decltype(p_##f))(void *)GetProcAddress(mod, #f);
    LOAD(slInit) LOAD(slShutdown) LOAD(slIsFeatureSupported) LOAD(slSetTagForFrame) LOAD(slSetConstants)
    LOAD(slGetFeatureFunction) LOAD(slGetNewFrameToken) LOAD(slGetFeatureRequirements) LOAD(slFreeResources)
#undef LOAD
    sl_gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)(void *)GetProcAddress(mod, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr");
    sl_gdpa = (PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr)(void *)GetProcAddress(mod, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr");
    if (!p_slInit || !p_slSetTagForFrame || !p_slGetFeatureFunction || !p_slGetNewFrameToken || !sl_gipa || !sl_gdpa) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: sl.interposer.dll lacks its functions\n");
        return 0;
    }
    static const sl::Feature features[] = {sl::kFeatureDLSS_G, sl::kFeatureReflex, sl::kFeaturePCL};
    sl::Preferences pref{};
    pref.showConsole = false;
    pref.logLevel = getenv("YW4_SL_LOG") ? sl::LogLevel::eVerbose : sl::LogLevel::eDefault;
    pref.logMessageCallback = log_message;
    static wchar_t logdir[512];  /* YW4_SL_LOG=<folder>: Streamline's own log file there too */
    const char *ld = getenv("YW4_SL_LOG");
    if (ld && strlen(ld) > 1 && MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, ld, -1, logdir, 512)) pref.pathToLogsAndData = logdir;
    pref.flags = sl::PreferenceFlags::eDisableCLStateTracking | sl::PreferenceFlags::eUseFrameBasedResourceTagging;  /* no over-the-air plugin downloads */
    pref.featuresToLoad = features;
    pref.numFeaturesToLoad = 3;
    pref.engine = sl::EngineType::eCustom;
    pref.engineVersion = "1.0";
    pref.projectId = "4f6c2e1a-8b3d-4c7e-9a52-1d0e7b6c3f88";  /* the same as DLSS's (gpu_dlss.c) */
    pref.renderAPI = sl::RenderAPI::eVulkan;
    sl::Result r = slInit(pref, sl::kSDKVersion);
    if (r != sl::Result::eOk) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: Streamline did not start (%d)\n", (int)r);
        return 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: Streamline started\n");
    return started = 1;
}

extern "C" PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr dlssg_loader(void) { return started == 1 ? sl_gipa : NULL; }

/* What Streamline's features need from the Vulkan device (slGetFeatureRequirements), all three together: device
 * extensions and the names of Vulkan 1.2 and 1.3 features. Streamline adds some extensions itself while it wraps
 * vkCreateDevice, but not all their dependencies (VK_NV_low_latency2 without VK_KHR_present_id, validation
 * 2026-11-14), so window.c enables what the GPU has of these. Pointers stay valid while Streamline runs. */
static void add_unique(const char **list, unsigned max, unsigned *n, const char *s) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < *n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(list[i], s)) return;
    if (*n < max) list[(*n)++] = s;
}

extern "C" void dlssg_device_requirements(const char **exts, unsigned max_exts, unsigned *n_exts, const char **feats,
                                          unsigned max_feats, unsigned *n_feats) {
    *n_exts = *n_feats = 0;
    if (started != 1 || !p_slGetFeatureRequirements) return;
    static const sl::Feature features[] = {sl::kFeatureDLSS_G, sl::kFeatureReflex, sl::kFeaturePCL};
    for (sl::Feature f : features) {
        sl::FeatureRequirements req{};
        if (slGetFeatureRequirements(f, req) != sl::Result::eOk) continue;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < req.vkNumDeviceExtensions; i++) add_unique(exts, max_exts, n_exts, req.vkDeviceExtensions[i]);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < req.vkNumFeatures12; i++) add_unique(feats, max_feats, n_feats, req.vkFeatures12[i]);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < req.vkNumFeatures13; i++) add_unique(feats, max_feats, n_feats, req.vkFeatures13[i]);
    }
}

/* VK_KHR_win32_surface's create info (the repo's Vulkan headers leave out the platform headers) */
struct Win32SurfaceInfo {
    VkStructureType sType;
    const void *pNext;
    VkFlags flags;
    HINSTANCE hinstance;
    HWND hwnd;
};
typedef VkResult(VKAPI_PTR *CreateWin32Surface)(VkInstance, const Win32SurfaceInfo *, const VkAllocationCallbacks *,
                                                VkSurfaceKHR *);

extern "C" VkSurfaceKHR dlssg_create_surface(void *hwnd) {
    if (started != 1 || !hwnd) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    auto create = (CreateWin32Surface)sl_gipa(vk.instance, "vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR");
    if (!create) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Win32SurfaceInfo ci{};
    ci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WIN32_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_KHR;
    ci.hinstance = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    ci.hwnd = (HWND)hwnd;
    VkSurfaceKHR s = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return create(vk.instance, &ci, NULL, &s) == VK_SUCCESS ? s : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

static int reflex_ok = -1;  /* Reflex runs on this GPU (GeForce 900 and newer) */

static void check_features(void) {
    if (avail >= 0) return;
    if (!vk.device) return;  /* asked before the device exists (the guest boots while Vulkan starts): decide later */
    avail = reflex_ok = 0;
    if (started != 1) return;
    sl::AdapterInfo a{};
    a.vkPhysicalDevice = vk.gpu;
    sl::Result r = slIsFeatureSupported(sl::kFeatureReflex, a);
    reflex_ok = r == sl::Result::eOk;
    if (!reflex_ok) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: Reflex not supported here (%d)\n", (int)r);
    r = slIsFeatureSupported(sl::kFeatureDLSS_G, a);
    avail = reflex_ok && r == sl::Result::eOk;
    if (r != sl::Result::eOk)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: DLSS frame generation not supported here (%d): needs an RTX 40 or newer, a recent "
                        "driver and hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling\n", (int)r);
    else fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: DLSS frame generation available\n");
}

extern "C" int dlssg_available(void) {
    check_features();
    return avail;
}

extern "C" int dlssg_reflex_available(void) {
    check_features();
    return reflex_ok;
}

/* The REFLEX setting: 0 off, 1 on, 2 on + boost (YW4_REFLEX at start) */
static int reflex_setting = -1;

extern "C" int dlssg_reflex_setting(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&reflex_setting, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (m < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_REFLEX");
        m = e ? atoi(e) : 0;
        if (m < 0 || m > 2) m = 0;
        __atomic_store_n(&reflex_setting, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return m;
}

extern "C" void dlssg_reflex_cycle(void) {
    int m = (dlssg_reflex_setting() + 1) % 3;
    __atomic_store_n(&reflex_setting, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

/* What runs: the setting, at least on while DLSS frame generation is chosen (NVIDIA requires it) */
extern "C" int dlssg_reflex(void) {
    if (!dlssg_reflex_available()) return 0;
    int m = dlssg_reflex_setting();
    return gpu_fg() == 2 && avail && m == 0 ? 1 : m;
}

/* ---- per frame */

static sl::FrameToken *token;
static uint32_t frame_index;
static int tagged, mode_on = -1;
static float shown_per_frame;  /* frames on screen per game frame, from DLSS-G's state; 0 while it is off */
static VkImage hudless_image;  /* this present's HUD-less copy at the window's size (window.c), or none */
static VkImageView hudless_view;
static VkFormat hudless_format;
static uint32_t hudless_w, hudless_h;

extern "C" void dlssg_hudless(VkImage image, VkImageView view, VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    hudless_image = image, hudless_view = view, hudless_format = format, hudless_w = w, hudless_h = h;
}

static int ready(void) { return started == 1 && reflex_ok == 1; }  /* the frame tokens and markers */

extern "C" void dlssg_frame_begin(void) {
    if (!ready()) return;
    frame_index++;
    if (slGetNewFrameToken(token, &frame_index) != sl::Result::eOk) {
        token = NULL;
        return;
    }
    static int applied = -1;  /* Reflex's mode, set again when the setting or frame generation changes it */
    int want = dlssg_reflex();
    if (want != applied) {
        sl::ReflexOptions ro{};
        ro.mode = want == 2 ? sl::ReflexMode::eLowLatencyWithBoost : want == 1 ? sl::ReflexMode::eLowLatency
                                                                               : sl::ReflexMode::eOff;
        sl::Result r = slReflexSetOptions(ro);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: Reflex %s%s\n", want == 2 ? "on + boost" : want ? "on" : "off",
                r == sl::Result::eOk ? "" : " (not taken)");
        applied = want;
    }
    slReflexSleep(*token);  /* also with Reflex off: NVIDIA asks for the sleep and markers always */
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::eSimulationStart, *token);
    tagged = 0;
}

/* Row-major, row vectors (as Streamline's own helpers): a 4x4 inverse by Gauss-Jordan elimination. */
static void invert(const sl::float4x4 &m, sl::float4x4 &out) {
    float a[4][8];
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) a[r][c] = (&m[r].x)[c], a[r][c + 4] = r == c ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        int p = c;
        for (int r = c + 1; r < 4; r++)
            if (fabsf(a[r][c]) > fabsf(a[p][c])) p = r;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            float t = a[c][k];
            a[c][k] = a[p][k], a[p][k] = t;
        }
        float d = a[c][c];
        if (d == 0.0f) return;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) a[c][k] /= d;
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            if (r != c) {
                float f = a[r][c];
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) a[r][k] -= f * a[c][k];
            }
    }
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) (&out[r].x)[c] = a[r][c + 4];
}

static void identity(sl::float4x4 &m) {
    memset(&m, 0, sizeof m);
    m[0].x = m[1].y = m[2].z = m[3].w = 1.0f;
}

extern "C" void dlssg_tag(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) {
    (void)ow, (void)oh;
    if (!ready() || !token) return;
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::eSimulationEnd, *token);
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::eRenderSubmitStart, *token);
    if (!avail || gpu_fg() != 2) return;
    sl::Resource depth(sl::ResourceType::eTex2d, (void *)p->depth, nullptr, (void *)p->depth_view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    depth.width = p->render_w, depth.height = p->render_h, depth.nativeFormat = p->depth_format;
    depth.mipLevels = 1, depth.arrayLayers = 1, depth.flags = 0;
    depth.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    sl::Resource mvec(sl::ResourceType::eTex2d, (void *)p->motion, nullptr, (void *)p->motion_view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    mvec.width = p->render_w, mvec.height = p->render_h, mvec.nativeFormat = VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT;
    mvec.mipLevels = 1, mvec.arrayLayers = 1, mvec.flags = 0;
    mvec.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    sl::Extent full{0, 0, p->render_w, p->render_h};
    sl::ResourceTag tags[2] = {sl::ResourceTag(&depth, sl::kBufferTypeDepth, sl::ResourceLifecycle::eValidUntilPresent, &full),
                               sl::ResourceTag(&mvec, sl::kBufferTypeMotionVectors, sl::ResourceLifecycle::eValidUntilPresent, &full)};
    sl::Result r = slSetTagForFrame(*token, viewport, tags, 2, (sl::CommandBuffer *)cb);
    sl::Constants c{};
    float aspect = (float)p->render_w / (float)p->render_h, n = p->cam_near, f = p->cam_far;
    float ys = 1.0f / tanf(p->fov_y * 0.5f), xs = ys / aspect;
    memset(&c.cameraViewToClip, 0, sizeof c.cameraViewToClip);
    c.cameraViewToClip[0].x = xs, c.cameraViewToClip[1].y = ys;
    c.cameraViewToClip[2].z = f / (f - n), c.cameraViewToClip[2].w = 1.0f, c.cameraViewToClip[3].z = -n * f / (f - n);
    invert(c.cameraViewToClip, c.clipToCameraView);
    identity(c.clipToLensClip), identity(c.clipToPrevClip), identity(c.prevClipToClip);
    c.jitterOffset = {p->jitter[0], p->jitter[1]};
    c.mvecScale = {p->motion_scale[0] / (float)p->render_w, p->motion_scale[1] / (float)p->render_h};  /* to [-1, 1] */
    c.cameraPinholeOffset = {0.0f, 0.0f};
    c.cameraPos = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f}, c.cameraUp = {0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f}, c.cameraRight = {1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    c.cameraFwd = {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};
    c.cameraNear = n, c.cameraFar = f, c.cameraFOV = p->fov_y, c.cameraAspectRatio = aspect;
    c.depthInverted = sl::Boolean::eFalse;
    c.cameraMotionIncluded = sl::Boolean::eTrue;
    c.motionVectors3D = sl::Boolean::eFalse;
    /* Start over when generation was off in the last present (a menu, loading): with eRetainResourcesWhenOff it still
     * holds the frame from before the menu, and its first new frame would blend that in. */
    c.reset = mode_on == 1 ? sl::Boolean::eFalse : sl::Boolean::eTrue;
    if (getenv("YW4_DLSSG_NO_RESET")) c.reset = sl::Boolean::eFalse;  /* tests: the old behaviour */
    sl::Result rc = slSetConstants(c, *token, viewport);
    if (r != sl::Result::eOk || rc != sl::Result::eOk) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: tags (%d) or constants (%d) not taken\n", (int)r, (int)rc);
        return;
    }
    tagged = 1;
}

extern "C" void dlssg_present_begin(int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkFormat format, uint32_t images) {
    if (!ready() || !token) return;
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::eRenderSubmitEnd, *token);
    /* Off for a frame with no 3D (menus, loading): keep DLSS-G's memory (eRetainResourcesWhenOff), or switching it
     * on again rebuilds everything inside the next present (~190 ms hitch, every menu closed). Off because the
     * player chose another setting: give the memory back (slFreeResources), as NVIDIA's guide asks. */
    static int retained;  /* off with its memory kept */
    int chosen = avail && gpu_fg() == 2;
    int want = chosen && tagged;
    if ((want != mode_on || (retained && !chosen)) && (avail || mode_on == 1)) {
        sl::DLSSGOptions o{};
        o.mode = want ? sl::DLSSGMode::eOn : sl::DLSSGMode::eOff;
        o.numFramesToGenerate = 1;
        if (chosen && !getenv("YW4_DLSSG_FREE_IN_MENUS")) o.flags = sl::DLSSGFlags::eRetainResourcesWhenOff;
        if (getenv("YW4_DLSSG_SHOW_GENERATED"))  /* tests: only the generated frames on screen (for screen captures) */
            o.flags |= sl::DLSSGFlags::eShowOnlyInterpolatedFrame;
        o.numBackBuffers = images;
        o.colorBufferFormat = (uint32_t)format;
        int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
        sl::Result r = slDLSSGSetOptions(viewport, o);
        int freed = !chosen && (retained || mode_on == 1) && slFreeResources(sl::kFeatureDLSS_G, viewport) == sl::Result::eOk;
        retained = !want && chosen && !getenv("YW4_DLSSG_FREE_IN_MENUS");
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: frame generation %s%s%s, %.1f ms\n", want ? "on" : "off",
                retained ? " (memory kept)" : freed ? " (memory freed)" : "", r == sl::Result::eOk ? "" : " (not taken)",
                (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6);
        mode_on = want;
    }
    if (want) {
        sl::Extent sub{(uint32_t)y, (uint32_t)x, w, h};
        sl::ResourceTag tags[2] = {
            sl::ResourceTag(nullptr, sl::kBufferTypeBackbuffer, sl::ResourceLifecycle::eValidUntilPresent, &sub),
            sl::ResourceTag(nullptr, sl::kBufferTypeHUDLessColor, sl::ResourceLifecycle::eValidUntilPresent, &sub)};
        /* the HUD-less copy at the window image's size (window.c), the same rectangle as the backbuffer's; without
         * it a null tag, so Streamline doesn't use an old one */
        sl::Resource hl(sl::ResourceType::eTex2d, (void *)hudless_image, nullptr, (void *)hudless_view,
                        VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
        hl.width = hudless_w, hl.height = hudless_h, hl.nativeFormat = (uint32_t)hudless_format;
        hl.mipLevels = 1, hl.arrayLayers = 1, hl.flags = 0;
        hl.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
        if (hudless_image) tags[1].resource = &hl;
        slSetTagForFrame(*token, viewport, tags, 2, nullptr);
    }
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::ePresentStart, *token);
}

extern "C" void dlssg_present_end(void) {
    if (!ready() || !token) return;
    slPCLSetMarker(sl::PCLMarker::ePresentEnd, *token);
    static int n;  /* every 30 frames: how many frames DLSS-G showed per game frame (the HUD); every 600 logged */
    if (mode_on == 1 && ++n % 30 == 0) {
        sl::DLSSGState s{};
        if (slDLSSGGetState(viewport, s, nullptr) == sl::Result::eOk) {
            shown_per_frame = (float)s.numFramesActuallyPresented;
            if (n % 600 == 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlssg: status %#x, %u frames presented per frame\n", (unsigned)s.status,
                        s.numFramesActuallyPresented);
        }
    }
    if (mode_on != 1) shown_per_frame = 0.0f;
}

extern "C" float dlssg_shown_per_frame(void) { return shown_per_frame; }

extern "C" int dlssg_on(void) { return ready() && mode_on == 1; }
extern "C" int dlssg_chosen(void) { return ready() && avail == 1 && gpu_fg() == 2; }

#else  /* no Streamline in this build */

extern "C" {
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
}
extern "C" int dlssg_start(void) { return 0; }
extern "C" PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr dlssg_loader(void) { return NULL; }
extern "C" void dlssg_device_requirements(const char **exts, unsigned max_exts, unsigned *n_exts, const char **feats,
                                          unsigned max_feats, unsigned *n_feats) {
    (void)exts, (void)max_exts, (void)feats, (void)max_feats;
    *n_exts = *n_feats = 0;
}
extern "C" VkSurfaceKHR dlssg_create_surface(void *hwnd) { (void)hwnd; return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
extern "C" int dlssg_available(void) { return 0; }
extern "C" int dlssg_reflex_available(void) { return 0; }
extern "C" int dlssg_reflex_setting(void) { return 0; }
extern "C" void dlssg_reflex_cycle(void) {}
extern "C" int dlssg_reflex(void) { return 0; }
extern "C" void dlssg_frame_begin(void) {}
extern "C" void dlssg_tag(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) { (void)cb, (void)p, (void)ow, (void)oh; }
extern "C" void dlssg_present_begin(int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkFormat f, uint32_t n) {
    (void)x, (void)y, (void)w, (void)h, (void)f, (void)n;
}
extern "C" void dlssg_present_end(void) {}
extern "C" float dlssg_shown_per_frame(void) { return 0.0f; }
extern "C" void dlssg_hudless(VkImage i, VkImageView v, VkFormat f, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    (void)i, (void)v, (void)f, (void)w, (void)h;
}
extern "C" int dlssg_on(void) { return 0; }

#endif
```

```h
/* NVIDIA DLSS frame generation through Streamline (gpu_dlssg.cpp, decision 0041). C interface. */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "vk.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* Before the Vulkan instance: starts Streamline (sl.interposer.dll next to yw4.exe) when the PC has an NVIDIA GPU
 * (YW4_STREAMLINE=0: never), so DLSS frame generation and Reflex can be switched while playing. 1 when it runs. */
int dlssg_start(void);
/* sl.interposer.dll's vkGetInstanceProcAddr while Streamline runs (every Vulkan function from it: Vulkan's own,
 * Streamline's for the instance, device, surface, swapchain and present), else NULL: SDL's loader. */
PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr dlssg_loader(void);
/* What Streamline's features need from the device: extension names and Vulkan 1.2 / 1.3 feature names (none
 * unless Streamline runs). window.c enables those the GPU has. */
void dlssg_device_requirements(const char **exts, unsigned max_exts, unsigned *n_exts, const char **feats,
                               unsigned max_feats, unsigned *n_feats);
/* The window's surface through Streamline (hwnd: the window's HWND); VK_NULL_HANDLE: make it as usual. */
VkSurfaceKHR dlssg_create_surface(void *hwnd);
/* 1 when DLSS frame generation runs on this GPU (checked once, after the device). */
int dlssg_available(void);
/* NVIDIA Reflex: 1 when it runs on this GPU; the REFLEX setting (0 off, 1 on, 2 on + boost; YW4_REFLEX) and its
 * step; what runs (the setting, at least on while frame generation is DLSS: NVIDIA requires it). */
int dlssg_reflex_available(void);
int dlssg_reflex_setting(void);
void dlssg_reflex_cycle(void);
int dlssg_reflex(void);

/* The frame's steps, on the presenting (main) thread. Each does nothing unless Streamline runs. */
void dlssg_frame_begin(void);  /* after a present: a new frame, Reflex's sleep, the simulation-start marker */
void dlssg_tag(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p, uint32_t output_w, uint32_t output_h);  /* after the AA */
/* Just before vkQueuePresentKHR: the game's rectangle in the window image (x, y, w, h), the options (on when the
 * setting says DLSS and this frame was tagged), the present-start marker. */
void dlssg_present_begin(int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkFormat format, uint32_t images);

 * the UI scaled into the game's rectangle; VK_NULL_HANDLE: none this frame. */
```

`runtime/src/gpu_draw.c`:

```c
/* Draws on Vulkan (decision 0021): translated shaders, pipelines, descriptors.
 *
 * Shaders: an NVN program's stages are named by the key of their assembly (0020); their
 * SPIR-V and interface (<key>.<stage>.spv, <key>.iface from recomp/shader.py) are read
 * from YW4_SHADER_DIR (default work/shaders/glsl) the first time a program is drawn with.
 *
 * Bindings (0020): descriptor set = stage (vertex 0, fragment 1, geometry 2); constant
 * buffer n -> binding n, texture slot k -> 16 + k, storage buffer n -> 64 + n. A texture
 * slot k is what BindTexture(stage, k, handle) binds: handle = texture id | sampler id << 20
 * in the current texture and sampler pools.
 *
 * Pipelines are cached per program on the state Vulkan can't set dynamically: attachment
 * formats, blending, channel masks, polygon mode, depth clamp, topology, vertex input.
 * Everything else (viewport, scissor, cull, front face, depth and stencil) is dynamic state.
 *
 * Window origin: with NVN's upper-left origin, clip-space y = +1 is the top row, so the
 * viewport is flipped (negative height). With the OpenGL lower-left origin, the rows the
 * Switch writes come out the same without a flip, but Vulkan's area rule (y down) then
 * sees every triangle with the opposite winding, so the front face is inverted.
 *
 * Enum values follow LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#include <dirent.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "post.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"

enum { ST_VERT, ST_FRAG, ST_GEOM, NSETS = 3, ST_COMP = 3 };  /* NSETS: the graphics stages; compute is separate */
static const char *const stage_names[4] = {"vert", "frag", "geom", "comp"};
static const VkShaderStageFlagBits stage_bits[4] = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
                                                    VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT};
/* NVN shader stage numbers used by Bind*(stage, ...) and NvnProgram.stages */
static const int nvn_stage[NSETS] = {0, 1, 2};

/* ================================================================== shaders */

enum { MAX_BINDINGS = 64 };
typedef struct {
    char kind;  /* c constant buffer, t texture, i image, s storage buffer, d a shadow map's raw depth
                 * (texture slot, no compare), p the soft shadow settings (yw4_shadow in recomp/shader.py) */
    uint32_t slot;
    VkImageViewType view;  /* textures */
    int shadow;
} Binding;

typedef struct Shader {
    struct Shader *next;
    uint64_t key;
    int stage;
    VkShaderModule module;
    Binding b[MAX_BINDINGS];
    int nb;
    char inputs[32];  /* vertex inputs: 0 unused, 'f' float, 'u' integer */
    VkDescriptorSetLayout layout;
    int push;             /* its layout is a push-descriptor one: bind_stage_set pushes, nothing allocated */
    VkShaderModule ours;  /* our readable program with the same interface, if we have one (0: none) */
    int pcf_float;  /* samples a shadow map: the float in cbuf 8 where its filter spread starts (2), else -1 */
    int screen_taps;  /* reads cbuf 8 row 32 (tap offsets in the screen-sized targets) */
    int inv_proj;     /* a fragment program reading cbuf 8 rows 20-23 (the inverse projection): positions from depth */
    int dof;          /* the distance blur's composite (gpu_dof) */
    uint32_t cb8_bytes;  /* how much of cbuf 8 it reads (with pcf_float or screen_taps) */
    int model;  /* a vertex program with the engine's local-matrix block in slot 2: it draws 3D objects */
    /* a vertex program whose position is one constant buffer's rows dotted with input 0 (the UI's):
     * that buffer + 1 and the rows of x, y, z, w; or input 0 as it is (pos_input: full-screen passes);
     * neither: the iface has no line m */
    uint32_t pos_cbuf, pos_rows[4];
    int pos_input;
} Shader;

static Shader *shaders;
/* the draw being bound reads a screen-sized image: after the composite it is not UI (widescreen; gpu_dynamic_state) */
static int dyn_reads_screen;
/* the draw being bound is a UI layer over the game's whole screen: stretched, not kept 16:9 (widescreen) */
static int dyn_full_screen;
/* ... in an image narrower than 16:9 (16:10), where the UI is fitted to the width with a strip left above and
 * below: the next gpu_dynamic_state is for a whole-screen layer's second or third drawing, which fills the strip
 * at the top (1) or the bottom (2) from the layer's edge */
static int dyn_edge;

/* Distance blur (depth of field): the game blurs the scene by distance. Fragment shader 27b63a2b... reads
 * depth, turns it into an amount with cbuf 6 row 0 (a, b, c, w: clamp((a / (b z + cam) + c) w)) and draws
 * a blurred half-size image over the scene with that amount as opacity (2026-10-27: it takes 63% of the
 * fine detail of a schoolyard's background and none of the foreground). The blurred image comes from
 * 800x450 passes whose taps are in pixels, so a larger 3D view (YW4_RES) weakens it. YW4_DOF=2 the
 * game's, 1 half (w halved; the default, the owner's pick), 0 off (the draw skipped). */
enum { DOF_SHADER = 0x27b63a2bf65deaf0ull, DOF_BLUR_SHADER = 0xb8856cfd2725bc25ull };  /* composite; the blur passes */
enum { COMPOSITE_SHADER = 0x58b87f4410e7bc5dull };  /* the bloom composite: the scene is done (gpu_aa.c) */
static int dof_level = -1;

int gpu_dof(void) {
    int l = __atomic_load_n(&dof_level, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (l < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_DOF");
        l = e ? atoi(e) : 1;
        if (l < 0 || l > 2) l = 2;
        __atomic_store_n(&dof_level, l, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return l;
}

void gpu_dof_cycle(void) {
    int l = (gpu_dof() + 2) % 3;  /* 2 -> 1 -> 0 -> 2 */
    __atomic_store_n(&dof_level, l, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: distance blur %s\n", l == 2 ? "the game's" : l == 1 ? "half" : "off");
}

static const char *shader_dir(void) {
    const char *d = getenv("YW4_SHADER_DIR");
    return d && *d ? d : "work/shaders/glsl";
}

static void *read_file(const char *path, size_t *size) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *p = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (!p || fread(p, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) gpu_stop("cannot read %s", path);
    fclose(f);
    p[n] = 0;
    *size = (size_t)n;
    return p;
}

static VkImageViewType view_type(const char *dim, int *shadow) {
    *shadow = !strncmp(dim, "SHADOW", 6);
    if (*shadow) dim += 6;
    if (!strcmp(dim, "2D")) return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    if (!strcmp(dim, "ARRAY2D")) return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
    if (!strcmp(dim, "3D")) return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D;
    if (!strcmp(dim, "CUBE")) return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE;
    gpu_stop("texture target %s", dim);
}

/* The shadow mask's fragment program (docs/frame.md "Lighting stage"). */
#define SHADOW_MASK_FS 0x06d03ad703b4bee5ull

/* The screen passes: the game's full-screen programs between the G-buffer and the UI that ours replace in
 * the engine's own draws (the shadow mask's way, decision 0044): same inputs, targets and state.
 * YW4_SCREEN_PASSES=game: the game's. */
static const uint64_t screen_fs[] = {
    0x95ea1b3181bdf579ull,  /* colour and depth copy (depth_copy.frag) */
    0x6b4575fb57b97548ull,  /* depth-only copy */
    0xd2aaa383b27842ecull,  /* fill with the quad's colour */
    0x2571d0a66582ab9bull,  /* copy, negatives to 0 */
    0x2d68c875031cfe11ull,  /* copy times the quad's colour */
    0x79077436c58013f9ull,  /* the lighting inputs (f_7f4c90) */
    0x3c94bd209d61eddcull,  /* edge-aware upsample */
    0x22d01556d2366ea7ull,  /* tone mapping */
    0x42759b97412ca8acull,  /* lamp lights (a light volume per lamp, not a quad) */
    0x3f9fc96541a9bd43ull,  /* the game's own FXAA */
    0x627287ec450d41fdull,  /* sky and aerial perspective */
};

static int is_screen_fs(uint64_t key) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof screen_fs / sizeof *screen_fs; i++)
        if (screen_fs[i] == key) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static int screen_on = -1;

static int screen_native(void) {
    int on = __atomic_load_n(&screen_on, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (on < 0) {
        on = !(getenv("YW4_SCREEN_PASSES") && !strcmp(getenv("YW4_SCREEN_PASSES"), "game"));
        __atomic_store_n(&screen_on, on, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return on;
}

int screen_passes_native(void) { return screen_native(); }

/* the settings panel (DEVELOPER OPTIONS, SCREEN PASSES) */
void screen_passes_toggle(void) {
    int on = !screen_native();
    __atomic_store_n(&screen_on, on, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: screen passes: %s (settings panel)\n", on ? "ours" : "the game's");
}

/* gpu.c, at each draw: YW4_AB_PASS=screen compares this draw, ours against the game's, when its fragment
 * program starts with YW4_AB_FS (hex) and it is one of the screen passes (YW4_AB_AT picks the frame), and
 * it is the frame's YW4_AB_DRAW-th such draw (default 1). YW4_AB_FS=all: any screen pass, the frame's
 * (frame % 32 + 1)-th, so 32 frames in a row in YW4_AB_AT compare each of a frame's screen draws in turn.
 * The second run of the draw is not counted. */
int gpu_screen_ab_draw(const GpuState *s) {
    static int wanted = -1, all;
    static uint64_t prefix, frame;
    static int digits, nth, seen;
    if (wanted < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_AB_FS");
        wanted = gpu_ab_wanted("screen") && e && *e;
        all = wanted && !strcmp(e, "all");
        if (wanted && !all) prefix = strtoull(e, NULL, 16), digits = (int)strlen(e);
        nth = getenv("YW4_AB_DRAW") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_AB_DRAW")) : 1;
    }
    if (!wanted || !s->program || (!all && (digits < 1 || digits > 16))) return 0;
    uint64_t fs = s->program->stages[1].key;
    if (!is_screen_fs(fs) || (!all && fs >> (64 - 4 * digits) != prefix)) return 0;
    if (gpu_ab_game) return 1;  /* the draw again, the game's: the range's end follows it */
    if (frame != gpu_frames()) frame = gpu_frames(), seen = 0;
    return ++seen == (all ? (int)(frame % 32) + 1 : nth);
}

/* Our replacements for game programs (decision 0026): readable GLSL in runtime/shaders with the
 * translated program's interface, used in its place when the G-buffer pass is on (settings panel). */
static const struct {
    uint64_t key;
    int stage;
    const char *name;
} replacements[] = {
    {0xbc358b88a500029full, ST_VERT, "gbuffer_main.vert"},
    {0xa93492ef0b558e21ull, ST_FRAG, "gbuffer_main.frag"},
    {0x01fd748a298cf8b6ull, ST_FRAG, "gbuffer_main_cutout.frag"},
    {0x53ce6660dbaa7332ull, ST_FRAG, "gbuffer_gloss.frag"},

    {0xb0aa5d810b96a62eull, ST_FRAG, "gbuffer_skinned.frag"},
    {SHADOW_MASK_FS, ST_FRAG, "shadow_mask.frag"},  /* its own switch (shadow_mask.c) */
    /* the screen passes' (screen_native) */
    {0x95ea1b3181bdf579ull, ST_FRAG, "depth_copy.frag"},
    {0x6b4575fb57b97548ull, ST_FRAG, "depth_only_copy.frag"},
    {0xd2aaa383b27842ecull, ST_FRAG, "vertex_colour.frag"},

    {0x627287ec450d41fdull, ST_FRAG, "sky_fog.frag"},

static VkShaderModule replacement(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof replacements / sizeof *replacements; i++) {
        if (replacements[i].key != key || replacements[i].stage != stage) continue;
        const char *dir = getenv("YW4_NATIVE_SHADER_DIR");
        char path[1024];
        size_t n;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.spv", dir && *dir ? dir : "work/build/shaders", replacements[i].name);
        uint32_t *spv = read_file(path, &n);
        if (!spv) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: no %s (python -m recomp.build compiles runtime/shaders): the game's program stays\n",
                    path);
            return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }
        VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = n, .pCode = spv};
        VkShaderModule m;
        CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(vk.device, &mci, NULL, &m));
        free(spv);
        return m;
    }
    return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

/* The next non-empty line of *p (NUL-terminated in place), or NULL at the end; *p moves past it. */
static char *next_line(char **p) {
    char *s = *p;
    while (*s == '\n' || *s == '\r') s++;
    if (!*s) return NULL;
    char *e = s + strcspn(s, "\n");
    if (*e) *e++ = 0;
    *p = e;
    return s;
}

/* A translated shader's module and descriptor set layout, from the files (not kept in the list). */
static Shader *load_shader(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    Shader *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s);
    s->key = key, s->stage = stage;
    char path[1024];
    size_t n;
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".%s.spv", shader_dir(), key, stage_names[stage]);
    uint32_t *spv = read_file(path, &n);
    if (!spv) gpu_stop("no translated shader %s (run python -m recomp.shader --check)", path);
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = n, .pCode = spv};
    CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(vk.device, &mci, NULL, &s->module));
    free(spv);

    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".iface", shader_dir(), key);
    char *text = read_file(path, &n);
    if (!text) gpu_stop("no shader interface %s", path);
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding lb[MAX_BINDINGS];
    /* lines split by hand, not strtok: the prewarm threads load shaders at the same time (gpu_prebuild_start) */
    char *rest = text;
    for (char *line; (line = next_line(&rest)) != NULL;) {
        char kind, dim[32] = "";
        unsigned slot, rx, ry, rz, rw;
        if (!strncmp(line, "m in", 4)) {  /* the position: input 0 as it is */
            s->pos_input = 1;
            continue;
        }
        if (sscanf(line, "%c %u %31s", &kind, &slot, dim) < 2) continue;
        if (kind == 'a') {
            if (slot < 32) s->inputs[slot] = dim[0];
            continue;
        }
        if (kind == 'r') continue;  /* rows read from a constant buffer: for gbuffer.c */
        if (kind == 'm') {  /* the position: a matrix, buffer and rows of x y z w */
            if (sscanf(line, "m %u %u %u %u %u", &slot, &rx, &ry, &rz, &rw) == 5 && slot < UBOS)
                s->pos_cbuf = slot + 1, s->pos_rows[0] = rx, s->pos_rows[1] = ry, s->pos_rows[2] = rz, s->pos_rows[3] = rw;
            continue;
        }
        if (kind == 'c' && slot == 2 && stage == ST_VERT && !strcmp(dim, "CBUSE_UB_LOCAL_MATRIX_IDX")) s->model = 1;
        if (s->nb == MAX_BINDINGS) gpu_stop("shader %016" PRIx64 " has too many bindings", key);
        Binding *b = &s->b[s->nb];
        b->kind = kind, b->slot = slot;
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding *l = &lb[s->nb++];
        *l = (VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding){.descriptorCount = 1, .stageFlags = stage_bits[stage]};
        switch (kind) {
        case 'c': l->binding = slot, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER; break;
        case 't':
            l->binding = 16 + slot, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
            b->view = view_type(dim, &b->shadow);
            break;
        case 'd':
            l->binding = 96 + slot, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
            b->view = view_type(dim, &b->shadow);
            break;
        case 'p': l->binding = 95, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER; break;
        case 'i': l->binding = 16 + slot, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE; break;
        case 's': l->binding = 64 + slot, l->descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER; break;
        default: gpu_stop("shader interface line '%s'", line);
        }
    }
    free(text);
    /* Two cbuf 8 (camera) values are in pixels of a target we may make larger (bind_stage_set scales
     * them in a copy):
     * - the shaders that sample a shadow map average 5 taps spread by a value the game sets (half a
     *   texel of the 1024 map and up): d[31].zw in most, d[8].zw in the rest (shadow quality);
     * - row 32 = 1.5/1600, 1.5/900, 0.75/533, 0.75/300: tap offsets in the screen-sized targets
     *   (resolution of the 3D view, F4; docs/frame.md).
     * Found in the GLSL. */
    s->pcf_float = -1, s->screen_taps = 0, s->inv_proj = 0;
    s->dof = stage == ST_FRAG && key == DOF_SHADER;
    int has_cb8 = 0, has_shadow = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s->nb; i++) {
        if (s->b[i].kind == 'c' && s->b[i].slot == 8) has_cb8 = 1;
        if (s->b[i].kind == 't' && s->b[i].shadow) has_shadow = 1;
    }
    if (has_cb8) {
        {
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".%s", shader_dir(), key, stage_names[stage]);
            char *glsl = read_file(path, &n);
            if (glsl) {
                if (has_shadow)
                    s->pcf_float = strstr(glsl, "cb8.d[31].zw") ? 31 * 4 + 2 : strstr(glsl, "cb8.d[8].zw") ? 8 * 4 + 2 : -1;
                s->screen_taps = strstr(glsl, "cb8.d[32]") != NULL;
                s->inv_proj = stage == ST_FRAG && strstr(glsl, "cb8.d[20]") && strstr(glsl, "cb8.d[23]");
                /* the copy only needs what the shader reads: up to its highest constant index
                 * (any computed index: all of it) */
                s->cb8_bytes = 0;
                for (const char *p = glsl; (p = strstr(p, "cb8.d[")) != NULL && s->cb8_bytes != 65536; p += 6) {
                    char *end;
                    unsigned long k = strtoul(p + 6, &end, 10);
                    if (end == p + 6 || *end != ']') s->cb8_bytes = 65536;
                    else if ((k + 1) * 16 > s->cb8_bytes) s->cb8_bytes = (uint32_t)(k + 1) * 16;
                }
                free(glsl);
            }
        }
    }
    /* Push descriptors (window.c) for the fragment and compute programs: a pipeline layout may hold only one
     * push-descriptor set, and these are the only programs in their set index (the fragment set is the one with
     * the textures). Vertex and geometry programs keep allocated sets. */
    s->push = vk.push_descriptor && (stage == ST_FRAG || stage == ST_COMP) && s->nb &&
              (uint32_t)s->nb <= vk.max_push_descriptors;
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                           .flags = s->push ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR : 0,
                                           .bindingCount = (uint32_t)s->nb, .pBindings = lb};
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &s->layout));
    s->ours = replacement(key, stage);
    return s;
}

/* ---- every translated shader loaded in the background at start (gpu_prebuild_start), so a new area's
 * first draws find theirs ready: loading one from its files (SPIR-V, interface, GLSL) and making its module
 * took 5-10 ms on the GPU thread (2026-11-08, town: 12 new shaders = 110 ms, a visible hitch). The slots are
 * made before the threads start and are read-only after, but for s: NULL not loaded yet, &pre_taken taken
 * by the GPU thread (shader()), else a loaded Shader waiting to be taken. YW4_SHADER_PRELOAD=0: off. */
enum { PRE_CAP = 8192 };
typedef struct {
    uint64_t key;  /* 0: empty slot */
    int stage;
    Shader *s;
} PreSlot;
static PreSlot *pre;
static uint32_t *pre_order;  /* the slots in directory order, for the threads */
static size_t pre_n, pre_next;
static Shader pre_taken;
static int64_t pre_t0;
static int pre_left;

static size_t pre_hash(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    return (size_t)(((key ^ (uint64_t)stage * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull) >> 40) & (PRE_CAP - 1);
}

static PreSlot *pre_find(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    if (!pre || !key) return NULL;
    for (size_t i = pre_hash(key, stage);; i = (i + 1) & (PRE_CAP - 1)) {
        if (!pre[i].key) return NULL;
        if (pre[i].key == key && pre[i].stage == stage) return &pre[i];
    }
}

/* The preloaded shader for (key, stage), taken (the slot then stays taken), or NULL: load it here. */
static Shader *pre_take(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    PreSlot *p = pre_find(key, stage);
    if (!p) return NULL;
    Shader *s = __atomic_exchange_n(&p->s, &pre_taken, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    return s == &pre_taken ? NULL : s;
}

static Shader *shader(uint64_t key, int stage) {
    for (Shader *s = shaders; s; s = s->next)
        if (s->key == key && s->stage == stage) return s;
    Shader *s = pre_take(key, stage);
    if (s) {
        s->next = shaders;
        shaders = s;
        return s;
    }
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    s = load_shader(key, stage);
    gpu_stall_add(STALL_SHADER, host_now_ns() - t0);
    s->next = shaders;
    shaders = s;
    return s;
}

static VkDescriptorSetLayout empty_layout(void) {
    static VkDescriptorSetLayout l;
    if (!l) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &l));
    }
    return l;
}

/* ================================================================== programs and pipelines */

typedef struct {
    VkFormat color[8], depth;
    uint8_t blend[8][8];
    uint8_t color_state[4];
    uint32_t channel_mask;
    uint8_t polygon_mode, topology, depth_clamp, ncolor;  /* ncolor: as in the rendering, empty slots too */
    uint8_t ours;  /* our replacement programs in place of the translated ones (Shader.ours) */
    VkVertexInputAttributeDescription attr[16];
    uint32_t nattr;
    VkVertexInputBindingDescription bind[16];
    uint32_t nbind;
} PipeKey;

typedef struct Pipe {
    struct Pipe *next;
    PipeKey key;
    VkPipeline pipeline;
} Pipe;

typedef struct {
    Shader *sh[NSETS];
    VkPipelineLayout layout;
    Pipe *pipes;
    Shader *comp;  /* the compute stage, if any (set 0, no push constants) */
    VkPipelineLayout comp_layout;
    VkPipeline comp_pipe;
    int warm;  /* a prewarm thread's copy (gpu_prebuild_start): not journalled, not counted as a frame's stall */
} Program;

static void journal_add(const Program *g, const PipeKey *k);

static Program *program_of(NvnProgram *p) {
    if (p->gpu) return ((Program *)p->gpu)->sh[ST_VERT] ? p->gpu : NULL;  /* a compute-only program has no draws */
    if (!(p->stage_mask & 1)) return NULL;  /* compute only, or nothing */
    if (p->stage_mask & 0x18) gpu_stop("tessellation shaders");
    Program *g = calloc(1, sizeof *g);
    VkDescriptorSetLayout layouts[NSETS];
    uint32_t nsets = 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < NSETS; i++) {
        if (p->stage_mask & (1u << nvn_stage[i])) g->sh[i] = shader(p->stages[nvn_stage[i]].key, i);
        layouts[i] = g->sh[i] ? g->sh[i]->layout : empty_layout();
    }
    if (g->sh[ST_GEOM]) nsets = 3;
    VkPushConstantRange pc = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT, 0, 4};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = nsets,
                                      .pSetLayouts = layouts, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pc};
    CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(vk.device, &pli, NULL, &g->layout));
    p->gpu = g;
    return g;
}

/* The program with its compute pipeline made (a compute-only program is a Program with no graphics stages). */
static Program *compute_program_of(NvnProgram *p) {
    if (!(p->stage_mask & 0x20)) return NULL;
    Program *g = p->gpu;
    if (!g) p->gpu = g = calloc(1, sizeof *g);
    if (g->comp_pipe) return g;
    g->comp = shader(p->stages[5].key, ST_COMP);
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
                                      .pSetLayouts = &g->comp->layout};
    CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(vk.device, &pli, NULL, &g->comp_layout));
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, .module = g->comp->module,
                                                .pName = "main"},
                                      .layout = g->comp_layout};
    CHECK(vkCreateComputePipelines(vk.device, gpu_pcache(), 1, &ci, NULL, &g->comp_pipe));
    return g;
}

void gpu_program_finalize(NvnProgram *p) {
    /* Pipelines and layouts are small; they are kept (a program's memory is reused for
     * another program with SetShaders, so only the link is dropped). */
    if (p) p->gpu = NULL;
}

static VkBlendFactor blend_factor(uint8_t f) {
    switch (f) {
    case 1: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ZERO;
    case 2: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE;
    case 3: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_COLOR;
    case 4: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR;
    case 5: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA;
    case 6: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
    case 7: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_DST_ALPHA;
    case 8: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA;
    case 9: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_DST_COLOR;
    case 10: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR;
    case 11: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE;
    case 0x10: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC1_COLOR;
    case 0x11: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC1_COLOR;
    case 0x12: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC1_ALPHA;
    case 0x13: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC1_ALPHA;
    case 0x61: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_CONSTANT_COLOR;
    case 0x62: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_COLOR;
    case 0x63: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_CONSTANT_ALPHA;
    case 0x64: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_ALPHA;
    default: gpu_stop("blend factor %#x", f);
    }
}

static VkBlendOp blend_op(uint8_t e) {
    switch (e) {
    case 1: return VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
    case 2: return VK_BLEND_OP_SUBTRACT;
    case 3: return VK_BLEND_OP_REVERSE_SUBTRACT;
    case 4: return VK_BLEND_OP_MIN;
    case 5: return VK_BLEND_OP_MAX;
    default: gpu_stop("blend equation %u", e);
    }
}

static VkCompareOp compare_fn(uint8_t f) {
    static const VkCompareOp ops[9] = {VK_COMPARE_OP_ALWAYS, VK_COMPARE_OP_NEVER, VK_COMPARE_OP_LESS,
                                       VK_COMPARE_OP_EQUAL, VK_COMPARE_OP_LESS_OR_EQUAL, VK_COMPARE_OP_GREATER,
                                       VK_COMPARE_OP_NOT_EQUAL, VK_COMPARE_OP_GREATER_OR_EQUAL, VK_COMPARE_OP_ALWAYS};
    return f < 9 ? ops[f] : VK_COMPARE_OP_ALWAYS;
}

static VkStencilOp stencil_op(uint8_t o) {
    switch (o) {
    case 2: return VK_STENCIL_OP_ZERO;
    case 3: return VK_STENCIL_OP_REPLACE;
    case 4: return VK_STENCIL_OP_INCREMENT_AND_CLAMP;
    case 5: return VK_STENCIL_OP_DECREMENT_AND_CLAMP;
    case 6: return VK_STENCIL_OP_INVERT;
    case 7: return VK_STENCIL_OP_INCREMENT_AND_WRAP;
    case 8: return VK_STENCIL_OP_DECREMENT_AND_WRAP;
    default: return VK_STENCIL_OP_KEEP;
    }
}

static int integer_format(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R8_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R16_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R16_SINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UINT_PACK32: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_SINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_UINT: case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_SINT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_UINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SINT:
        return 1;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

static VkFormat vertex_format(uint32_t f) {
    switch (f) {
    case 0x19: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_UNORM;
    case 0x1A: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_SNORM;
    case 0x1B: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_UINT;
    case 0x1C: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_SINT;
    case 0x1D: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_SFLOAT;
    case 0x1E: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_UNORM;
    case 0x1F: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_SNORM;
    case 0x20: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_UINT;
    case 0x21: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_SINT;
    case 0x22: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SFLOAT;
    case 0x23: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_UINT;
    case 0x24: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SINT;
    case 0x69: return VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_SNORM_PACK32;
    default: return gpu_format(f);
    }
}
```
