```c
             * the same factor down, and moved to the middle from top to bottom */
            yn = xn, yd = xd;
            yoff = ((float)tg->height - (float)tg->key.height * (float)yn / (float)yd) * 0.5f;
        } else {
            xn = kn, xd = kd;
            xoff = ((float)tg->width - (float)tg->key.width * (float)kn / (float)kd) * 0.5f;
        }
    }
    float vx = 0, vy = 0, vw = (float)w, vh = (float)h, xf = (float)xn / (float)xd, yf = (float)yn / (float)yd;
    if (s->have_viewport) vx = xoff + (float)s->viewport[0] * xf, vy = yoff + (float)s->viewport[1] * yf,
                          vw = (float)s->viewport[2] * xf, vh = (float)s->viewport[3] * yf;
    d.viewport = (VkViewport){vx, flip ? vy + vh : vy, vw, flip ? -vh : vh, s->depth_range[0], s->depth_range[1]};
    float jx, jy;
    if (dyn_model && !s->after_composite && gpu_taa_jitter(w, h, &jx, &jy)) d.viewport.x += jx, d.viewport.y += jy;
    dyn_model = dyn_reads_screen = dyn_full_screen = 0;
    int edge = yoff > 0 ? dyn_edge : 0;
    dyn_edge = 0;
    if (edge) {
        /* the strip above or below the fitted UI: the layer 8 times as tall with its top (bottom) edge at the
         * image's, so the strip shows the layer's outermost rows only (its edge drawn out, as a clamp would;
         * the whole layer stretched instead would put its bands where the fitted content's are not) */
        float big = d.viewport.height * 8, top = edge == 1 ? vy - yoff : vy + vh + yoff - vh * 8;
        d.viewport.y = flip ? top + vh * 8 : top, d.viewport.height = big;
    }
    d.scissor = (VkRect2D){{0, 0}, {w, h}};
    if (s->have_scissor) {
        /* edges scaled: left and top down, right and bottom up, so the scissor covers what it did */
        int64_t x0 = s->scissor[0] < 0 ? 0 : s->scissor[0], y0 = s->scissor[1] < 0 ? 0 : s->scissor[1];
        int64_t x1 = x0 + (s->scissor[2] > 0 ? s->scissor[2] : 0), y1 = y0 + (s->scissor[3] > 0 ? s->scissor[3] : 0);
        int64_t x = x0 * xn / xd, y = y0 * yn / yd;
        int64_t sw = (x1 * xn + xd - 1) / xd - x, sh = (y1 * yn + yd - 1) / yd - y;
        x += (int64_t)xoff, y += (int64_t)yoff;
        if (kn != kd || xn != xd || yn != yd || xoff || yoff) {  /* the game's "whole target" scissor can be huge: keep it inside */
            if (x > w) x = w;
            if (y > h) y = h;
            if (sw > w - x) sw = w - x;
            if (sh > h - y) sh = h - y;
        }
        d.scissor = (VkRect2D){{(int32_t)x, (int32_t)y}, {(uint32_t)sw, (uint32_t)sh}};
    }
    if (edge) {
        uint32_t strip = (uint32_t)(yoff + 0.5f);
        if (strip > h) strip = h;
        d.scissor = (VkRect2D){{0, edge == 1 ? 0 : (int32_t)(h - strip)}, {w, strip}};
    }
    cull_of(s->polygon[0], s->polygon[1], &d.cull, &d.front);
    const uint8_t *ds = s->depth_stencil;
    int has_depth = depth != VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED && depth != VK_FORMAT_S8_UINT;
    int has_stencil = depth == VK_FORMAT_S8_UINT || depth == VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT ||
                      depth == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    d.depth_test = has_depth && ds[0], d.depth_write = has_depth && ds[1];
    d.depth_op = compare_fn(ds[2]);
    d.stencil_test = has_stencil && ds[3];
    if (mismatch) d.depth_test = d.depth_write = d.stencil_test = 0;  /* above */
    uint32_t ops = ds[5] | ds[6] << 8 | ds[7] << 16;
    for (int face = 0; face < 2; face++) {
        uint32_t o = ops >> (12 * face);
        d.face[face].fail = stencil_op(o & 0xF), d.face[face].pass = stencil_op(o >> 8 & 0xF);
        d.face[face].depth_fail = stencil_op(o >> 4 & 0xF);
        d.face[face].op = compare_fn(face ? ds[4] >> 4 : ds[4] & 0xF);
        d.face[face].ref = s->stencil_ref[face], d.face[face].write_mask = s->stencil_mask[face];
        d.face[face].compare_mask = s->stencil_value_mask[face];
    }
    d.bias_enable = (s->polygon[3] & 4) != 0;
    d.bias[0] = s->polygon_offset[1], d.bias[1] = s->polygon_offset[2], d.bias[2] = s->polygon_offset[0];
    memcpy(d.blend, s->blend_color, sizeof d.blend);
    d.discard = s->rasterizer_discard != 0;
    int known = cb == dyn_cb;
    if (known && !memcmp(&d, &dyn_last, sizeof d)) return;  /* all of it set already */

    /* Only what changed (a new command buffer: all of it). With TAA the 3D draws' viewport is shifted and the
     * others' is not, so alternating draws differed in the viewport alone and set all ~25 states each time
     * (2026-11-17). d and dyn_last are zeroed with their padding, so each part compares as bytes. */
#define DYN_CHANGED(f) (!known || memcmp(&d.f, &dyn_last.f, sizeof d.f))
    if (DYN_CHANGED(viewport)) vkCmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &d.viewport);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(scissor)) vkCmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &d.scissor);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(cull)) vkCmdSetCullMode(cb, d.cull);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(front)) vkCmdSetFrontFace(cb, d.front);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(depth_test)) vkCmdSetDepthTestEnable(cb, d.depth_test);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(depth_write)) vkCmdSetDepthWriteEnable(cb, d.depth_write);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(depth_op)) vkCmdSetDepthCompareOp(cb, d.depth_op);
    if (!known) vkCmdSetDepthBoundsTestEnable(cb, VK_FALSE);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(stencil_test)) vkCmdSetStencilTestEnable(cb, d.stencil_test);
    for (int face = 0; face < 2; face++) {
        VkStencilFaceFlags f = face ? VK_STENCIL_FACE_BACK_BIT : VK_STENCIL_FACE_FRONT_BIT;
        const __typeof__(d.face[0]) *n = &d.face[face], *o = &dyn_last.face[face];
        if (!known || n->fail != o->fail || n->pass != o->pass || n->depth_fail != o->depth_fail || n->op != o->op)
            vkCmdSetStencilOp(cb, f, n->fail, n->pass, n->depth_fail, n->op);
        if (!known || n->ref != o->ref) vkCmdSetStencilReference(cb, f, n->ref);
        if (!known || n->write_mask != o->write_mask) vkCmdSetStencilWriteMask(cb, f, n->write_mask);
        if (!known || n->compare_mask != o->compare_mask) vkCmdSetStencilCompareMask(cb, f, n->compare_mask);
    }
    if (DYN_CHANGED(bias_enable)) vkCmdSetDepthBiasEnable(cb, d.bias_enable);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(bias)) vkCmdSetDepthBias(cb, d.bias[0], d.bias[1], d.bias[2]);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(blend)) vkCmdSetBlendConstants(cb, d.blend);
    if (DYN_CHANGED(discard)) vkCmdSetRasterizerDiscardEnable(cb, d.discard);
    if (!known) vkCmdSetPrimitiveRestartEnable(cb, VK_FALSE);
#undef DYN_CHANGED
    dyn_last = d, dyn_cb = cb;
}

static void draw(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, const CmdRec *r) {
    Program *g = s->program ? program_of(s->program) : NULL;
    if (!g) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: draw skipped: %s (stage mask %#x, stage keys %016" PRIx64 " %016" PRIx64 ")\n",
                    s->program ? "program without a vertex stage" : "no program bound",
                    s->program ? s->program->stage_mask : 0, s->program ? s->program->stages[0].key : 0,
                    s->program ? s->program->stages[5].key : 0);
        return;
    }
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && (g->sh[ST_FRAG]->dof || g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key == DOF_BLUR_SHADER)) {
        /* the distance blur's images keep the game's size ratio (gpu.c, effects resolution) */
        NvnTexEntry *e = tex_entry(s, s->tex[nvn_stage[ST_FRAG]][0]);
        if (e) gpu_keep_game_ratio(e->tex);
        if (!g->sh[ST_FRAG]->dof && s->ncolor) gpu_keep_game_ratio(s->rt.color[0]);
        if (g->sh[ST_FRAG]->dof && !gpu_dof()) return;  /* distance blur off */
    }
    if (s->color[2] != 8) {
        static int logged;
        if (!logged++) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: alpha test %u ignored for now\n", s->color[2]);
    }
    if (gpu_watch_on()) {  /* the minimap watch (gpu_watch.c): before the uploads, to see which are this draw's */
        GpuWatchTex wt[16];
        int nwt = 0;
        const Shader *fs = g->sh[ST_FRAG];
        for (int i = 0; fs && i < fs->nb && nwt < 16; i++) {
            const Binding *b = &fs->b[i];
            if (b->kind != 't' && b->kind != 'd') continue;
            uint64_t handle = b->slot < TEXTURES ? s->tex[nvn_stage[ST_FRAG]][b->slot] : 0;
            NvnTexEntry *e = tex_entry(s, handle);
            wt[nwt++] = (GpuWatchTex){e ? e->tex : NULL, b->slot, handle, e ? gpu_needs_transfer(e->tex) : 0};
        }
        GpuWatchData wd;
        memset(&wd, 0, sizeof wd);
        const Shader *wvs = g->sh[ST_VERT];
        uint32_t stream = 16;  /* the lowest stream the vertex program reads */
        for (uint32_t loc = 0; wvs && loc < 32; loc++) {
            uint32_t a = loc < s->nattribs ? s->attribs[loc] : 0;
            if (wvs->inputs[loc] && a & 0xFF && (a >> 8 & 0x1F) < stream) stream = a >> 8 & 0x1F;
        }
        int wanted = gpu_watch_wants(s, wt, nwt);  /* the rest only for the minimap's draws: 110 ms a frame for all */
        if (wanted && stream < 16) {
            wd.vb_addr = s->vbuf[stream].addr, wd.vb_size = s->vbuf[stream].size;
            wd.stride = stream < s->nstreams ? s->streams[stream][0] : 0;
            wd.first = r->op == CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS ? (uint32_t)r->x[1] : 0;
            wd.stale = gpu_vram_geometry() && wd.vb_size && gpu_geometry_needs_copy(wd.vb_addr, wd.vb_size);
        }
        for (int st = ST_VERT; wanted && st <= ST_FRAG; st++)
            for (int i = 0; g->sh[st] && i < g->sh[st]->nb && wd.ncb < 4; i++) {
                const Binding *b = &g->sh[st]->b[i];
                if (b->kind != 'c' || b->slot >= UBOS) continue;
                GpuRange ub = s->ubo[nvn_stage[st]][b->slot];
                wd.cb[wd.ncb++] = (GpuWatchBuf){(uint8_t)st, (uint8_t)b->slot, ub.addr, ub.size};
            }
        if (wanted) gpu_watch_draw(s, wvs ? wvs->key : 0, fs ? fs->key : 0, r->x[2], wt, nwt, &wd);
    }
    if (needs_transfers(s, g)) gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    /* Images and uploads first (outside rendering), then rendering. */
    for (int st = 0; st < NSETS; st++)
        for (int i = 0; g->sh[st] && i < g->sh[st]->nb; i++) {
            const Binding *b = &g->sh[st]->b[i];
            NvnTexEntry *e = b->kind == 't' && b->slot < TEXTURES ? tex_entry(s, s->tex[nvn_stage[st]][b->slot]) : NULL;
            if (e && gpu_needs_transfer(e->tex)) image_of(cb, e->tex);
        }
    if (!s->rendering)
        for (int i = 0; i < s->ncolor; i++)
            if (s->rt.color[i]) image_of(cb, s->rt.color[i]);
    if (!s->rendering && s->rt.depth) image_of(cb, s->rt.depth);
    /* geometry in video memory (gpu.c, YW4_VRAM_GEOMETRY): the vertex streams the program reads and
     * the indices, copied outside rendering when they need it */
    if (gpu_vram_geometry() && g->sh[ST_VERT]) {
        GpuRange geo[17];
        int ngeo = 0, need = 0;
        uint32_t used = 0;
        for (uint32_t loc = 0; loc < 32; loc++) {
            uint32_t a = loc < s->nattribs ? s->attribs[loc] : 0;
            if (g->sh[ST_VERT]->inputs[loc] && a & 0xFF) used |= 1u << (a >> 8 & 0x1F);
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            GpuRange vr = own ? (GpuRange){own->vertices, own->vertex_bytes} : s->vbuf[i];
            if (used >> i & 1 && vr.size) geo[ngeo++] = vr;
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS && r->x[1]) geo[ngeo++] = (GpuRange){r->x[3], r->x[2] * (r->x[1] == 1 ? 2 : 4)};
        for (int i = 0; i < ngeo; i++) need |= gpu_geometry_needs_copy(geo[i].addr, geo[i].size);
        if (need) {
            gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
            for (int i = 0; i < ngeo; i++) gpu_geometry_copy(cb, geo[i].addr, geo[i].size);
            full_barrier(cb);
        }
    }

    PipeKey k;
    memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
    uint32_t w, h;
    if (!begin_rendering(cb, s, k.color, &k.depth, &w, &h)) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: draw without render targets skipped (colour targets %d, depth %p, shaders %016" PRIx64
                            " %016" PRIx64 ", rasterizer discard %d, frame %" PRIu64 ")\n",
                    s->ncolor, (void *)s->rt.depth, g->sh[ST_VERT] ? g->sh[ST_VERT]->key : 0,
                    g->sh[ST_FRAG] ? g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key : 0, s->rasterizer_discard, gpu_frames());
        return;
    }
    k.ncolor = (uint8_t)s->ncolor;
    /* our G-buffer programs in place of the game's (decision 0026; F6); the shadow mask's has its own switch */
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key == SHADOW_MASK_FS)
        k.ours = g->sh[ST_FRAG]->ours && shadow_mask_native() && !gpu_ab_game;
    else if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && is_screen_fs(g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key))
        k.ours = g->sh[ST_FRAG]->ours && screen_native() && !gpu_ab_game;
    else
        k.ours = (own || gbuffer_native_frame(gpu_frames())) &&
                 ((g->sh[ST_VERT] && g->sh[ST_VERT]->ours) || (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->ours));
    memcpy(k.blend, s->blend, sizeof k.blend);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) k.blend[i][0] = 0;
    memcpy(k.color_state, s->color, 4);
    k.channel_mask = s->channel_mask;
    k.polygon_mode = s->polygon[2];
    k.depth_clamp = (uint8_t)(s->depth_clamp != 0);
    VkPrimitiveTopology topo;
    int quads = r->x[0] == 7;
    if (quads) {
        if (r->op != CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS) gpu_stop("indexed quads");
        topo = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
    } else if (!topology((uint32_t)r->x[0], &topo)) {
        gpu_stop("primitive type %u", (unsigned)r->x[0]);
    }
    k.topology = (uint8_t)topo;

    /* Vertex input: the shader's inputs, from the bound attribute and stream state. */
    const Shader *vs = g->sh[ST_VERT];
    uint32_t streams_used = 0;
    for (uint32_t loc = 0; loc < 32; loc++) {
        if (!vs->inputs[loc]) continue;
        uint32_t a = loc < s->nattribs ? s->attribs[loc] : 0;
        if (!(a & 0xFF)) {
            static uint32_t logged;
            if (!(logged & 1u << loc)) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: vertex input %u has no attribute\n", loc);
            logged |= 1u << loc;
            continue;
        }
        VkFormat f = vertex_format(a & 0xFF);
        if (f == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) gpu_stop("vertex format %#x", a & 0xFF);
        uint32_t stream = a >> 8 & 0x1F;
        k.attr[k.nattr++] = (VkVertexInputAttributeDescription){loc, stream, input_format(f, vs->inputs[loc], loc),
                                                                a >> 13};
        streams_used |= 1u << stream;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        if (!(streams_used & 1u << i)) continue;
        uint32_t stride = i < s->nstreams ? s->streams[i][0] : 0, divisor = i < s->nstreams ? s->streams[i][1] : 0;
        if (divisor > 1) gpu_stop("vertex stream divisor %u", divisor);
        k.bind[k.nbind++] = (VkVertexInputBindingDescription){
            i, stride, divisor ? VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_INSTANCE : VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_VERTEX};
        VkBuffer buf;
        VkDeviceSize off;
        GpuRange vr = own ? (GpuRange){own->vertices, own->vertex_bytes} : s->vbuf[i];  /* ours: every stream */
        if (!vr.size || !gpu_geometry_at(vr.addr, vr.size, &buf, &off)) buf = dummy_buffer(), off = 0;
        vkCmdBindVertexBuffers(cb, i, 1, &buf, &off);
    }

    VkPipeline pl = pipeline(g, &k);
    if (!pl) return;  /* a 3D object whose new pipeline is being built in the background: drawn from the next frame */
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pl);
    bind_unjitter = !(g->sh[ST_VERT] && g->sh[ST_VERT]->model) && !s->after_composite;
    bind_sets(cb, s, g);

    /* YW4_MOVIE_LOG=1 (testing video pacing): when the movie program's luma texture shows a new picture (a
     * fingerprint of its memory changes), the GPU frame, the host time and how many frames the last one stayed */
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key == 0x2e2b3b7ac92f7848ull) gpu_note_movie_draw();  /* framerate.c: 30 */
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key == 0x2e2b3b7ac92f7848ull && getenv("YW4_MOVIE_LOG")) {
        NvnTexEntry *e = tex_entry(s, s->tex[nvn_stage[ST_FRAG]][0]);
        if (e && e->tex->addr) {
            static uint64_t last_hash, last_frame;
            static int64_t last_ns;
            const uint8_t *y = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)e->tex->addr;
            uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 1920 * 1080; i += 997) hash = (hash ^ y[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
            if (hash != last_hash) {
                int64_t now = host_now_ns();
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: movie: frame %" PRIu64 " new picture at %#" PRIx64 ", %.1f ms and %" PRIu64
                        " frames after the last\n", gpu_frames(), e->tex->addr, last_ns ? (double)(now - last_ns) / 1e6 : 0.0,
                        gpu_frames() - last_frame);
                last_hash = hash, last_frame = gpu_frames(), last_ns = now;
            }
        }
    }

    /* YW4_GPU_TRACE=<n>: describe n draws, from frame YW4_GPU_TRACE_AT (default 0) on */
    static long trace = -1, trace_at;
    if (trace < 0) {
        trace = getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE") ? atol(getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE")) : 0;
        trace_at = getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE_AT") ? atol(getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE_AT")) : 0;
    }
    int requested = __atomic_exchange_n(&trace_request, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    if (requested) trace = requested, trace_at = 0;
    if (trace > 0 && gpu_frames() >= (uint64_t)trace_at) {
        trace--;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw: vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 " prim %u count %u target %ux%u (%d colour, %s depth)"
                " viewport %s%d,%d %dx%d scissor %s%d,%d %dx%d blend %#x\n",
                vs->key, g->sh[ST_FRAG] ? g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key : 0, (unsigned)r->x[0],
                (unsigned)(r->op == CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS ? r->x[2] : r->x[2]), w, h, s->ncolor, s->rt.depth ? "with" : "no",
                s->have_viewport ? "" : "(none) ", s->viewport[0], s->viewport[1], s->viewport[2], s->viewport[3],
                s->have_scissor ? "" : "(none) ", s->scissor[0], s->scissor[1], s->scissor[2], s->scissor[3],
                s->color[0]);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw:   depth range %g..%g clamp %d discard %d polygon %u,%u,%u,%u depth/stencil %u,%u,%u,%u,%#x offset %g,%g,%g\n",
                s->depth_range[0], s->depth_range[1], s->depth_clamp, s->rasterizer_discard, s->polygon[0], s->polygon[1],
                s->polygon[2], s->polygon[3], s->depth_stencil[0], s->depth_stencil[1], s->depth_stencil[2],
                s->depth_stencil[3], s->depth_stencil[4], s->polygon_offset[0], s->polygon_offset[1], s->polygon_offset[2]);
        if (s->rt.depth)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw:   depth target at %#" PRIx64 " kind %u layers %u format %#x view %s layer %u+%u\n",
                    s->rt.depth->addr, s->rt.depth->target, s->rt.depth->depth, s->rt.depth->format,
                    s->rt.has_depth_view ? "yes" : "no", s->rt.has_depth_view ? s->rt.depth_view.min_layer : 0,
                    s->rt.has_depth_view ? s->rt.depth_view.num_layers : 0);
        for (int ci = 0; ci < s->ncolor && ci < 8; ci++)
            if (s->rt.color[ci])
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw:   colour target %d at %#" PRIx64 " kind %u layers %u format %#x view %s layer %u+%u\n",
                        ci, s->rt.color[ci]->addr, s->rt.color[ci]->target, s->rt.color[ci]->depth,
                        s->rt.color[ci]->format, s->rt.has_view[ci] ? "yes" : "no",
                        s->rt.has_view[ci] ? s->rt.views[ci].min_layer : 0, s->rt.has_view[ci] ? s->rt.views[ci].num_layers : 0);
        for (int st = 0; st < NSETS; st++)
            for (int i = 0; g->sh[st] && i < g->sh[st]->nb; i++) {
                const Binding *b = &g->sh[st]->b[i];
                if (b->kind != 't') continue;
                NvnTexEntry *e = tex_entry(s, s->tex[nvn_stage[st]][b->slot]);
                uint64_t h = s->tex[nvn_stage[st]][b->slot];
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw:   %s texture %u: handle %#" PRIx64 " (id %u, sampler %u) -> ", stage_names[st],
                        b->slot, h, (unsigned)(h & 0xFFFFF), (unsigned)(h >> 20 & 0xFFF));
                if (e) fprintf(stderr, "%ux%u format %#x at %#" PRIx64 " kind %u layers %u view %s layer %u+%u\n", e->tex->width,
                               e->tex->height, e->tex->format, e->tex->addr, e->tex->target, e->tex->depth,
                               e->has_view ? "yes" : "no", e->has_view ? e->view.min_layer : 0,
                               e->has_view ? e->view.num_layers : 0);
                else fprintf(stderr, "none\n");
            }
        /* YW4_GPU_TRACE_SCREEN=1: constants that look like a screen-derived size (1600x900 and the game's
         * smaller copies of it) or 0.25..4 over one (offsets of a few pixels): what resolution scaling
         * must change; coincidences come too (0.01 = 2/200). Once per
         * shader, block and float. */
        static int screen_scan = -1;
        if (screen_scan < 0) screen_scan = getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE_SCREEN") && atoi(getenv("YW4_GPU_TRACE_SCREEN"));
        for (int st = 0; screen_scan && st < 2; st++) {
            const Shader *sh = g->sh[st];
            if (!sh) continue;
            static const float sizes[] = {1600, 900, 800, 450, 533, 300, 400, 225, 200, 112, 120, 67, 1920, 1080};
            static const float muls[] = {0.25f, 0.5f, 0.75f, 1, 1.25f, 1.5f, 2, 2.5f, 3, 4};
            static uint64_t seen[4096];
            for (int i = 0; i < sh->nb; i++) {
                const Binding *b = &sh->b[i];
                if (b->kind != 'c' || b->slot >= UBOS) continue;
                GpuRange ub = s->ubo[nvn_stage[st]][b->slot];
                if (!ub.size || ub.size > 0x10000 || !host_readable(ub.addr, ub.size)) continue;
                const float *f = (const float *)(uintptr_t)ub.addr;
                for (uint64_t k = 0; k < ub.size / 4; k++) {
                    float v = f[k], a = v < 0 ? -v : v;
                    if (!(a > 1e-5f) || a > 5000) continue;
                    const char *what = NULL;
                    float x = 0, m = 0;
                    for (size_t z = 0; !what && z < sizeof sizes / sizeof *sizes; z++) {
                        if (a == sizes[z]) what = "size", x = sizes[z];
                        for (size_t q = 0; !what && q < sizeof muls / sizeof *muls; q++) {
                            float r = muls[q] / sizes[z];
                            if (a > r * 0.9999f && a < r * 1.0001f) what = "1/size", x = sizes[z], m = muls[q];
                        }
                    }
                    if (!what) continue;
                    uint64_t id = sh->key ^ (uint64_t)b->slot << 56 ^ k << 40 ^ (uint64_t)st << 62;
                    size_t at = (size_t)(id * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 52), n;
                    for (n = 0; n < 4096 && seen[at] && seen[at] != id; n++) at = (at + 1) & 4095;
                    if (n == 4096 || seen[at] == id) continue;
                    seen[at] = id;
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: screen const: %s %016" PRIx64 " cbuf %u row %" PRIu64 ".%c = %g (%g/%g) target %ux%u"
                            " row: %g %g %g %g\n", stage_names[st], sh->key, b->slot, k / 4, "xyzw"[k % 4], v, m ? m : x,
                            m ? x : 1, w, h, f[k & ~3ull], f[(k & ~3ull) + 1], f[(k & ~3ull) + 2], f[(k & ~3ull) + 3]);
                }
            }
        }
        /* the vertex stage's constant buffers: where, how big, and their first 16 floats */
        for (int i = 0; i < vs->nb; i++) {
            const Binding *b = &vs->b[i];
            if (b->kind != 'c' || b->slot >= UBOS) continue;
            GpuRange ub = s->ubo[0][b->slot];
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu draw:   vs cbuf %u at %#" PRIx64 " size %" PRIu64 ":", b->slot, ub.addr, ub.size);
            if (ub.size >= 192 && host_readable(ub.addr, 192)) {  /* floats 32..47: where the shadow shaders keep a matrix */
                const float *f = (const float *)(uintptr_t)ub.addr;
                for (int k = 32; k < 48; k++) fprintf(stderr, " %g", f[k]);
                /* a matrix whose second row is 0 0 0 1 and third row 0: the broken shadow cascade */
                static int scanned;
                #define NEAR0(x) ((x) > -1e-4f && (x) < 1e-4f)
                if (!scanned && vs->nb && NEAR0(f[36]) && NEAR0(f[37]) && NEAR0(f[38]) && f[39] > 0.999f && f[39] < 1.001f &&
                    NEAR0(f[40]) && NEAR0(f[41]) && NEAR0(f[42]) && NEAR0(f[43]) && !NEAR0(f[32])) {
                    scanned = 1;
                    fprintf(stderr, "\nyw4: scan: broken matrix in the cbuf at %#" PRIx64 ": write watch on its matrix %#" PRIx64 "\n",
                            ub.addr, ub.addr + 128);
                    /* watch disabled: the command-level watch is armed in the generated code */  
                }
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        }
    }

    gpu_taa_note_targets(s);
    dyn_model = g->sh[ST_VERT] && g->sh[ST_VERT]->model;
    if (dyn_model && !s->after_composite) gpu_note_model_draw();
    /* A layer over the whole screen (widescreen), by the textures it samples:
     * - a 16:9 texture from the game's files, a picture made for the screen (the map's backdrop 960x540,
     *   the copyright notice 1920x1080, movies: 1920x1080 and 960x540 planes): kept 16:9 in the middle
     *   with black bars at the sides, also over the 3D world the game still draws behind the map;
     * - a 16:9 texture the game renders into (the map's UI, drawn into a 1920x1080 image first): kept
     *   16:9 like the rest of the UI;
     * - anything else is stretched: the dimming behind a dialog (a part of a 2048x2304 sheet), the
     *   loading screen's black (no texture). A full-screen pass program (input 0 is the position) only
     *   with no texture at all: it also copies other images. */
    int samples = 0, picture = 0, layer = 0;
    for (int i = 0; g->sh[ST_FRAG] && i < g->sh[ST_FRAG]->nb; i++) {
        const Binding *b = &g->sh[ST_FRAG]->b[i];
        if (b->kind != 't' || b->slot >= TEXTURES) continue;
        samples = 1;
        NvnTexEntry *e = tex_entry(s, s->tex[nvn_stage[ST_FRAG]][b->slot]);
        if (e && (uint64_t)e->tex->width * 9 == (uint64_t)e->tex->height * 16) {
            if (e->tex->pool_flags & POOL_CPU_NO_ACCESS) layer = 1;
            else picture = 1;
        }
    }
    int cover = s->after_composite && gpu_wide() && !dyn_reads_screen && !layer ? covers_screen(s, vs, r) : 0;
    int full = cover == 2;  /* a 16:9 picture gets bars only when it fills the screen; a band of one stays 16:9 */
    /* a band across the width stays 16:9 in a frame whose picture got black bars (the map's bar at the bottom) */
    static uint64_t bars_frame = UINT64_MAX;
    int barred = __atomic_load_n(&bars_frame, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == gpu_frames();
    dyn_full_screen = (full || (cover && !barred)) && !picture && !(vs->pos_input && samples);
    const GpuImage *ti = s->ncolor && s->rt.color[0] ? image_find(s->rt.color[0]) : NULL;
    int bars = full && picture && ti && whole_width(s, ti) && !gpu_is_presented(ti->key.addr);
    if (bars) __atomic_store_n(&bars_frame, gpu_frames(), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (dyn_full_screen || bars) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: widescreen: UI layer over the whole %s %s (vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64
                            ", frame %" PRIu64 ")\n", full ? "screen" : "width",
                    bars ? "kept 16:9 with black bars" : "stretched", vs->key,
                    g->sh[ST_FRAG] ? g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key : 0, gpu_frames());
    }
    /* an image narrower than 16:9 (16:10): the UI is fitted to the width, smaller, with a strip left above and
     * below (gpu_dynamic_state). A layer over the whole screen is fitted like the rest, so its bands stay where
     * the content on them is, and drawn twice more for the strips (dyn_edge); a band across the width is
     * simply fitted (across, fitting and stretching are the same there) */
    int edges = 0;
    if (dyn_full_screen && ti && ti->wide_num < ti->wide_den && !gpu_is_presented(ti->key.addr) &&
        s->have_viewport && whole_width(s, ti)) {
        dyn_full_screen = 0;
        edges = full ? 2 : 0;
    }
    gpu_dynamic_state(cb, s, k.depth, w, h);
    if (bars) {  /* the sides black, then the picture in the middle */
        uint32_t inner = gpu_scaled(ti->key.width, ti->scale_num, ti->scale_den), side = w > inner ? (w - inner) / 2 : 0;
        VkClearAttachment ca = {.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, .colorAttachment = 0,
                                .clearValue.color = {{0, 0, 0, 1}}};
        VkClearRect cr[2] = {{{{0, 0}, {side, h}}, 0, 1}, {{{(int32_t)(w - side), 0}, {side, h}}, 0, 1}};
        if (ti->wide_num < ti->wide_den) {  /* narrower than 16:9: the picture is fitted to the width, bars above and below */
            inner = gpu_scaled(gpu_scaled(ti->key.height, ti->scale_num, ti->scale_den), ti->wide_num, ti->wide_den);
            side = h > inner ? (h - inner) / 2 : 0;
            cr[0].rect = (VkRect2D){{0, 0}, {w, side}}, cr[1].rect = (VkRect2D){{0, (int32_t)(h - side)}, {w, side}};
        }
        if (side) vkCmdClearAttachments(cb, 1, &ca, 2, cr);
    }
    uint32_t pos_fix = nvn_depth_mode == 0 ? (g->sh[ST_GEOM] ? 2u : 1u) : 0u;
    vkCmdPushConstants(cb, g->layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT, 0, 4, &pos_fix);

    gpu_query_before_draw(cb, s);  /* the game's occlusion query or condition around this draw, if any */
    for (int pass = 0; pass <= edges; pass++) {  /* edges: the strips above and below too (16:10) */
    if (pass) dyn_edge = pass, gpu_dynamic_state(cb, s, k.depth, w, h);
    if (quads) {  /* (primitive, first, count, base instance, instances) */
        uint32_t nquads = (uint32_t)r->x[2] / 4;
        if (nquads > QUADS) gpu_stop("%u quads in one draw", nquads);
        vkCmdBindIndexBuffer(cb, quad_indices(), 0, VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT32);
        vkCmdDrawIndexed(cb, nquads * 6, (uint32_t)r->x[4] ? (uint32_t)r->x[4] : 1, 0, (int32_t)r->x[1],
                         (uint32_t)r->x[3]);
    } else if (r->op == CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS) {  /* (primitive, first, count, base instance, instances) */
        vkCmdDraw(cb, (uint32_t)r->x[2], (uint32_t)r->x[4] ? (uint32_t)r->x[4] : 1, (uint32_t)r->x[1],
                  (uint32_t)r->x[3]);
    } else {  /* (primitive, index type, count, index address, base vertex, base instance, instances) */
        uint32_t type = (uint32_t)r->x[1], size = type == 1 ? 2 : 4;
        if (type == 0) gpu_stop("8-bit indices");
        VkBuffer buf;
        VkDeviceSize off;
        if (!gpu_geometry_at(r->x[3], (uint64_t)r->x[2] * size, &buf, &off))
            gpu_stop("index buffer %#" PRIx64 " outside the memory pools", r->x[3]);
        vkCmdBindIndexBuffer(cb, buf, off, type == 1 ? VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT16 : VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT32);
        vkCmdDrawIndexed(cb, (uint32_t)r->x[2], (uint32_t)r->x[6] ? (uint32_t)r->x[6] : 1, 0, (int32_t)r->x[4],
                         (uint32_t)r->x[5]);
    }
    }
    gpu_query_after_draw(cb);
    capture_after_draw(cb, s, g);
    /* the bloom composite, the last 3D pass before the UI: anti-aliasing here (gpu_aa.c) */
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->dof) gpu_dof_after_composite(cb, s);  /* YW4_DOF_PASS=check */
    if (g->sh[ST_FRAG] && g->sh[ST_FRAG]->key == COMPOSITE_SHADER) {
        gpu_bloom_after_composite(cb, s);  /* YW4_BLOOM=check: the game's results, before anti-aliasing */
        s->after_composite = 1;
        gpu_aa_apply(cb, s);  /* anti-aliasing, upscaling, SHARPENING: it returns at once when none is on */
    }
}

void gpu_draw(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, const CmdRec *r) { draw(cb, s, r); }

/* CMD_NATIVE: a G-buffer draw of ours (gbuffer.c). On the game's frames of YW4_GBUFFER_ALTERNATE,
 * the game's DrawElements it replaced instead, with the game's programs and buffers. */
void gpu_gbuffer_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    const GBufferDraw *d = data;
    if (size < sizeof *d) return;
    CmdRec r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    r.size = sizeof r;
    if (!gbuffer_native_frame(gpu_frames())) {
        memcpy(r.x, d->game, sizeof r.x);
        r.op = d->game_indexed ? CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS : CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS;
        if (d->game_instanced) {
            /* the game's instanced call: its base vertex, base instance and instances as recorded */
        } else if (d->game_indexed) {
            r.x[4] = 0, r.x[5] = 0, r.x[6] = 1;  /* base vertex 0, base instance 0, one instance */
        } else {
            r.x[3] = 0, r.x[4] = 1;  /* base instance 0, one instance */
        }
        draw(vk_cb, gpu_state, &r);
        return;
    }
    if (d->index_count) {  /* (primitive, index type, count, index address, base vertex, base instance, instances) */
        r.op = CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS;
        r.x[0] = d->primitive, r.x[1] = d->index_type, r.x[2] = d->index_count, r.x[3] = d->indices;
        r.x[5] = d->base_instance, r.x[6] = d->instances;
    } else {  /* (primitive, first, count, base instance, instances) */
        r.op = CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS;
        r.x[0] = d->primitive, r.x[2] = d->vertex_count, r.x[3] = d->base_instance, r.x[4] = d->instances;
    }
    own = d;
    draw(vk_cb, gpu_state, &r);
    own = NULL;
}

/* CMD_NATIVE: a takeover draw (gbuffer.c, decision 0030). The engine did no state work for it: its
 * program, NVN state objects, vertex layout, material textures (fragment slots) and constant blocks
 * go into the executor's state for this one draw and are put back after, so the game's next draw
 * finds the state the game's own commands left. Everything else (targets, scene constants and
 * textures, stencil reference, depth bias) is what the game bound for the layer. */
void gpu_takeover_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    const TakeoverDraw *t = data;
    GpuState *s = gpu_state;
    if (size < sizeof *t) return;
    NvnProgram *prog = t->program ? (NvnProgram *)(uintptr_t)*(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)t->program : NULL;
    if (!prog || prog->stages[0].code != t->vs_code || prog->stages[1].code != t->fs_code) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: takeover: program %#" PRIx64 " is no longer the one recorded: draw lost\n",
                                  t->program);
        return;
    }
    /* what we change, saved */
    NvnProgram *program = s->program;
    uint8_t blend[8][8], color[4], ds[8], polygon[4];
    uint32_t mask = s->channel_mask, attribs[16], nattribs = s->nattribs, streams[16][2], nstreams = s->nstreams;
    uint64_t tex[TAKEOVER_TEXTURES];
    uint32_t sref[2], smask[2];
    float offset[3];
    memcpy(sref, s->stencil_ref, sizeof sref), memcpy(smask, s->stencil_mask, sizeof smask);
    memcpy(offset, s->polygon_offset, sizeof offset);
    memcpy(blend, s->blend, sizeof blend), memcpy(color, s->color, 4), memcpy(ds, s->depth_stencil, 8);
    memcpy(polygon, s->polygon, 4), memcpy(attribs, s->attribs, sizeof attribs), memcpy(streams, s->streams, sizeof streams);
    memcpy(tex, s->tex[1], sizeof tex);
    /* ours */
    s->program = prog;
    memcpy(s->blend, t->nvn, 0x40);
    memcpy(&s->channel_mask, t->nvn + 0x40, 4);
    memcpy(s->color, t->nvn + 0x44, 4);
    memcpy(s->depth_stencil, t->nvn + 0x48, 8);
    memcpy(s->polygon, t->nvn + 0x68, 4);
    memcpy(s->attribs, t->attribs, sizeof t->attribs);
    s->nattribs = t->nattribs;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s->streams[i][0] = t->stride, s->streams[i][1] = 0;
    s->nstreams = 16;
    /* the textures: our copies of their pool entries, each pointing at its own snapshot */
    static _Thread_local NvnTexEntry ents[TAKEOVER_TEXTURES];
    for (int k = 0; k < TAKEOVER_TEXTURES; k++)
        if (t->tex_mask >> k & 1) {
            ents[k] = takeover_tex(t, (unsigned)k)->e;
            ents[k].tex = &ents[k].snap;
            s->tex[1][k] = 1ull << 63 | (uint64_t)k;
        }
    own_tex = ents;
    /* stencil reference and write mask, polygon offset: what the engine's commit sets from the state it
     * keeps (f_974cd0: state+0x2b8, +0x2b4; +0x2c0, +0x2bc, +0x2c4 = factor, units, clamp) */
    uint32_t ref, wmask;
    memcpy(&ref, t->nvn + 0x78, 4), memcpy(&wmask, t->nvn + 0x74, 4);
    s->stencil_ref[0] = s->stencil_ref[1] = ref, s->stencil_mask[0] = s->stencil_mask[1] = wmask;
    memcpy(&s->polygon_offset[0], t->nvn + 0x80, 4), memcpy(&s->polygon_offset[1], t->nvn + 0x7c, 4);
    memcpy(&s->polygon_offset[2], t->nvn + 0x84, 4);
    CmdRec r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    r.size = sizeof r;
    const GBufferDraw *d = &t->d;
    if (d->index_count) {  /* (primitive, index type, count, index address, base vertex, base instance, instances) */
        r.op = CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS;
        r.x[0] = d->primitive, r.x[1] = d->index_type, r.x[2] = d->index_count, r.x[3] = d->indices, r.x[6] = d->instances ? d->instances : 1;
    } else {  /* (primitive, first, count, base instance, instances) */
        r.op = CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS;
        r.x[0] = d->primitive, r.x[2] = d->vertex_count, r.x[4] = d->instances ? d->instances : 1;
    }
    own = d, own_t = t;
    draw(vk_cb, s, &r);
    own = NULL, own_t = NULL, own_tex = NULL;
    /* the game's, back */
    s->program = program;
    memcpy(s->blend, blend, sizeof blend), memcpy(s->color, color, 4), memcpy(s->depth_stencil, ds, 8);
    memcpy(s->polygon, polygon, 4), memcpy(s->attribs, attribs, sizeof attribs), memcpy(s->streams, streams, sizeof streams);
    s->channel_mask = mask, s->nattribs = nattribs, s->nstreams = nstreams;
    memcpy(s->tex[1], tex, sizeof tex);
    memcpy(s->stencil_ref, sref, sizeof sref), memcpy(s->stencil_mask, smask, sizeof smask);
    memcpy(s->polygon_offset, offset, sizeof offset);
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_fg.c`:

```c
/* Frame generation with AMD FSR (FidelityFX SDK 2.4.0, amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_vk.dll, loaded through
 * amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll like the upscaler in gpu_fsr.c; MIT, fetched by tools/yw4/deps.py).
 *
 * Without the SDK's own swapchain (FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_NO_SWAPCHAIN_CONTEXT_NOTIFY): the window keeps
 * presenting as before, so our HUD and settings panel are drawn sharp onto every frame shown.
 * - After the anti-aliasing (gpu_aa.c) the 3D's depth and the game's motion go to FSR's prepare pass.
 * - At the present (gpu.c) the game's finished image is copied into one of two slots, and FSR makes the frame
 *   between the last one and it into the same slot.
 * - A pacing thread presents the generated frame at once and the game's half a frame later (half the measured
 *   time between the game's frames), so the main thread never waits for that half frame.
 * The generated frame is made from the whole picture, menus included (the game draws them into the 3D's image).
 * YW4_FG=0 off / 1 FSR / 2 DLSS (gpu_dlssg.cpp, through Streamline) at start; the settings panel cycles it.
 * Windows only for now. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu_dlss.h"
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "gpu_fsr.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "window.h"

static int fg_mode = -1;
static uint64_t switch_until;  /* gpu_fg_switching: the GPU frame the switch's safe frames end at */
enum { SWITCH_FRAMES = 30 };

static void switch_started(void) {
    __atomic_store_n(&switch_until, gpu_frames() + SWITCH_FRAMES, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

int gpu_fg_switching(void) {
    static int off = -1;  /* YW4_FG_SAFE_SWITCH=0: switch without waiting (tests) */
    if (off < 0) off = getenv("YW4_FG_SAFE_SWITCH") && *getenv("YW4_FG_SAFE_SWITCH") == '0';
    return !off && gpu_frames() < __atomic_load_n(&switch_until, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}

int gpu_fg(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&fg_mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (m < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_FG");
        m = e ? atoi(e) : 0;
        if (m < 0 || m > 2) m = 0;
        if (m == 2 && !gpu_dlss_built()) {
            m = gpu_fsr_built() ? 1 : 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: DLSS is not in this build: %s instead\n", m == 1 ? "FSR" : "off");
        }
        if (m == 1 && !gpu_fsr_built()) {
            m = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: FSR is not in this build: off instead\n");
        }
        __atomic_store_n(&fg_mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    if (m == 2 && __atomic_load_n(&vk.up, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && (!gpu_dlss_built() || !dlssg_available())) {
        m = gpu_fsr_built() ? 1 : 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: DLSS frame generation not supported on this GPU: %s instead\n",
                m == 1 ? "FSR" : "off");
        __atomic_store_n(&fg_mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return m;
}

/* YW4_FG_AT=<frame>:<mode>,...: tests switch frame generation at those frames, as the panel would */
void gpu_fg_test_switch(uint64_t frame) {
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_FG_AT");
    for (const char *p = e; p && *p;) {
        char *end;
        unsigned long long f = strtoull(p, &end, 10);
        if (*end != ':') return;
        int m = atoi(end + 1);
        if (f == frame && m >= 0 && m <= 2) {
            __atomic_store_n(&fg_mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            switch_started();
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: frame generation %d at frame %llu (YW4_FG_AT)\n", m, f);
        }
        p = strchr(end, ',');
        if (p) p++;
    }
}

/* One step forward (dir 1) or back (dir -1), skipping FSR and DLSS where they can't run: one switch per step */
void gpu_fg_step(int dir) {
    int m = (gpu_fg() + 3 + dir) % 3;
    while ((m == 2 && (!gpu_dlss_built() || !dlssg_available())) || (m == 1 && !gpu_fsr_built()))
        m = (m + 3 + dir) % 3;
    __atomic_store_n(&fg_mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    switch_started();
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: frame generation %s\n", m == 2 ? "DLSS" : m == 1 ? "FSR" : "off");
}

void gpu_fg_cycle(void) { gpu_fg_step(1); }

#ifdef YW4_FSR
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#ifndef _WINDOWS
#define _WINDOWS  /* ffx_api_loader.h looks for MSBuild's name for Windows (as gpu_fsr.c) */
#endif

#include "ffx_api.h"
#include "ffx_api_loader.h"
#include "ffx_api_types.h"
#include "vk/ffx_api_vk.h"
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wunknown-pragmas"  /* MSVC's warning pragmas in the header */
#include "../../framegeneration/include/ffx_framegeneration.h"
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#else
/* Linux (decision 0073): FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4's frame generation in libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so, opened by gpu_fsr.c;
 * without AMD's swapchain, as here (FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_NO_SWAPCHAIN_CONTEXT_NOTIFY) */
#include <dlfcn.h>

#include "ffx_api.h"
#include "ffx_api_types.h"
#include "vk/ffx_api_vk.h"
#include "ffx_framegeneration.h"
#include "gpu_fsr.h"
typedef struct {
    PfnFfxCreateContext CreateContext;
    PfnFfxDestroyContext DestroyContext;
    PfnFfxConfigure Configure;
    PfnFfxQuery Query;
    PfnFfxDispatch Dispatch;
} ffxFunctions;
#endif

static ffxFunctions fx;
static int loaded = -1;  /* -1 not tried, 0 failed, 1 loaded */
static ffxContext ctx;
static uint32_t ctx_dw, ctx_dh, ctx_rw, ctx_rh;
static VkFormat ctx_fmt;
static int ctx_failed;

static int available(void) {
    if (loaded >= 0) return loaded;
#ifdef _WIN32
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryA("amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll");
    if (!m) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll not found next to yw4.exe: no frame generation\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    ffxLoadFunctions(&fx, m);
#else
    void *m = gpu_ffx_library();
    if (!m) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: no frame generation\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    fx.CreateContext = (PfnFfxCreateContext)dlsym(m, "ffxCreateContext");
    fx.DestroyContext = (PfnFfxDestroyContext)dlsym(m, "ffxDestroyContext");
    fx.Configure = (PfnFfxConfigure)dlsym(m, "ffxConfigure");
    fx.Query = (PfnFfxQuery)dlsym(m, "ffxQuery");
    fx.Dispatch = (PfnFfxDispatch)dlsym(m, "ffxDispatch");
#endif
    if (!fx.CreateContext || !fx.Dispatch || !fx.Configure || !fx.DestroyContext) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: the loader DLL lacks its functions: no frame generation\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    return loaded = 1;
}

/* On, and a 3D scene drawn lately (gpu_scene_recent): 2D screens such as the title menu's video bypass it, as DLSS
 * frame generation does on frames without its tags (gpu_dlssg.cpp). */
int gpu_fg_active(void) { return gpu_fg() == 1 && gpu_aa() >= 3 && available() == 1 && gpu_scene_recent(); }

static uint32_t surface_format(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
    case VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT:
    case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R32_UINT;  /* as ffx_api_vk.h maps them */
    case VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16_UNORM;
    default: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    }
}

/* Our images and the game's stay in layout GENERAL: FSR's unordered-access state (as gpu_fsr.c). */
static struct FfxApiResource resource(VkImage image, VkFormat f, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t usage) {
    struct FfxApiResource r = {.resource = (void *)image, .state = FFX_API_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS};
    r.description.type = FFX_API_RESOURCE_TYPE_TEXTURE2D;
    r.description.format = surface_format(f);
    r.description.width = w, r.description.height = h, r.description.depth = 1, r.description.mipCount = 1;
    r.description.usage = usage;
    return r;
}

static void destroy(void) {
    if (!ctx) return;
    gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX);
    fx.DestroyContext(&ctx, NULL);
    ctx = NULL;
}

/* A context for frames of dw x dh in fmt from a 3D of up to rw x rh. */
static int create(uint32_t dw, uint32_t dh, uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, VkFormat fmt) {
    if (ctx && ctx_dw == dw && ctx_dh == dh && ctx_rw == rw && ctx_rh == rh && ctx_fmt == fmt) return 1;
    if (!ctx && ctx_failed && ctx_dw == dw && ctx_dh == dh && ctx_rw == rw && ctx_rh == rh && ctx_fmt == fmt) return 0;
    destroy();
    ctx_dw = dw, ctx_dh = dh, ctx_rw = rw, ctx_rh = rh, ctx_fmt = fmt, ctx_failed = 0;
    if (surface_format(fmt) == FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_UNKNOWN) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: presented format %d not handled: no frame generation\n", (int)fmt);
        ctx_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    struct ffxCreateBackendVKDesc backend = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_BACKEND_VK},
#ifdef _WIN32
        .deviceContext = {.vkDevice = vk.device, .vkPhysicalDevice = vk.gpu, .vkDeviceProcAddr = vkGetDeviceProcAddr}};
#else  /* SDK v1.1.4 (gpu_fsr.c): the same three fields, not yet in a VkDeviceContext */
        .vkDevice = vk.device, .vkPhysicalDevice = vk.gpu, .vkDeviceProcAddr = vkGetDeviceProcAddr};
#endif
    struct ffxCreateContextDescFrameGeneration desc = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION, .pNext = &backend.header},
        .displaySize = {dw, dh}, .maxRenderSize = {rw, rh}, .backBufferFormat = surface_format(fmt)};
    struct ffxCreateContextDescFrameGenerationHudless hl = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION_HUDLESS}, .hudlessBackBufferFormat = surface_format(fmt)};
    backend.header.pNext = &hl.header;  /* the HUD-less copy (prepare): FSR keeps the UI still */
    if (getenv("YW4_FG_DEBUG")) desc.flags |= FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_ENABLE_DEBUG_CHECKING;
    if (getenv("YW4_FG_FLAGS")) desc.flags |= (uint32_t)atoi(getenv("YW4_FG_FLAGS"));  /* tests: e.g. 8 depth inverted */
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.CreateContext(&ctx, &desc.header, NULL);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: context for %ux%u (3D %ux%u) failed (%u): no frame generation\n", dw, dh, rw, rh,
                (unsigned)r);
        ctx = NULL, ctx_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    struct ffxQueryGetProviderVersion qv = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_GET_PROVIDER_VERSION}};
    fx.Query(&ctx, &qv.header);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: %s for %ux%u (3D up to %ux%u) ready in %.0f ms\n",
            qv.versionName ? qv.versionName : "frame generation", dw, dh, rw, rh, (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6);
    return 1;
}

static uint32_t debug_flags(void) {
    static int d = -1;  /* YW4_FG_DEBUG=1: FSR's tear and reset marks on the generated frames; 2: its debug view */
    if (d < 0) d = getenv("YW4_FG_DEBUG") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_FG_DEBUG")) : 0;
    return (d == 1 ? FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_DRAW_DEBUG_TEAR_LINES | FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_DRAW_DEBUG_RESET_INDICATORS
                   : 0) |
           (d == 2 ? FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW : 0);
}

/* ---- prepare (after the anti-aliasing) */

static uint32_t want_rw, want_rh;  /* the 3D's size last prepared (or asked for: the context follows at present) */
static uint64_t next_id = 1, prepared_id;  /* FSR's frame identifier; prepared_id: this frame's, 0 if not */
static int prepared_reset;

typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
} FgImage;

static void image_make(FgImage *im, VkFormat fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h);  /* below */
static void image_free(FgImage *im);
static void to_general(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage image);
static VkFormat raw_format(VkFormat f);

/* The HUD-less copy: the picture before the UI, blitted into the presented format (the conversion the game's own
 * copy into the window image makes), so FSR can tell the UI from the 3D and keep it still. */
static FgImage hudless;
static VkFormat hudless_fmt, presented_fmt;
static uint32_t hudless_w, hudless_h, presented_w, presented_h;
static int hudless_ok;  /* made this frame */
static uint64_t hudless_frame;  /* gpu_frames() when it was made: valid for the present that follows */
static VkRect2D shown_rect;  /* the part of the presented image the window shows (the game's crop), last frame */

void gpu_fg_note_present(VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkRect2D rect) {
    presented_fmt = format, presented_w = w, presented_h = h;
    if (rect.offset.x != shown_rect.offset.x || rect.offset.y != shown_rect.offset.y ||
        rect.extent.width != shown_rect.extent.width || rect.extent.height != shown_rect.extent.height) {
        if (gpu_fg())
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: the window shows %ux%u at %d,%d of the presented image\n", rect.extent.width,
                    rect.extent.height, rect.offset.x, rect.offset.y);
        shown_rect = rect;
    }
}

VkImage gpu_fg_hudless(void) {
    return hudless_ok && hudless_frame + 1 == gpu_frames() ? hudless.image : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

void gpu_fg_hudless_copy(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p) {
    hudless_ok = 0;
    /* the presented image is the window texture: the picture sits in it where the crop takes it from */
    VkRect2D r = shown_rect;
    uint32_t pw = presented_w, ph = presented_h;
    if (!p->scene || !presented_fmt || p->scene_w != r.extent.width || p->scene_h != r.extent.height ||
        r.offset.x < 0 || r.offset.y < 0 || r.offset.x + r.extent.width > pw || r.offset.y + r.extent.height > ph)
        return;
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0) off = getenv("YW4_FG_HUDLESS") && *getenv("YW4_FG_HUDLESS") == '0';
    if (off) return;
    if (!hudless.image || hudless_fmt != presented_fmt || hudless_w != pw || hudless_h != ph) {
        if (hudless.image) gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX), image_free(&hudless);
        image_make(&hudless, presented_fmt, pw, ph);
        to_general(cb, hudless.image);
        hudless_fmt = presented_fmt, hudless_w = pw, hudless_h = ph;
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    int32_t x = r.offset.x, y = r.offset.y;
    VkImageBlit b = {.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                     .srcOffsets = {{0, 0, 0}, {(int32_t)p->scene_w, (int32_t)p->scene_h, 1}},
                     .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                     .dstOffsets = {{x, y, 0}, {x + (int32_t)p->scene_w, y + (int32_t)p->scene_h, 1}}};
    vkCmdBlitImage(cb, p->scene, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, hudless.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &b, VK_FILTER_NEAREST);
    full_barrier(cb);
    hudless_ok = 1, hudless_frame = gpu_frames();
}

static int configure(uint64_t id, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    struct ffxConfigureDescFrameGeneration c = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_CONFIGURE_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION}};
    c.frameGenerationEnabled = true;
    if (hudless_ok) c.HUDLessColor = resource(hudless.image, raw_format(hudless_fmt), w, h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    c.flags = FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_FLAG_NO_SWAPCHAIN_CONTEXT_NOTIFY | debug_flags();
    c.generationRect.left = 0, c.generationRect.top = 0;
    c.generationRect.width = (int32_t)w, c.generationRect.height = (int32_t)h;
    c.frameID = id;
    return fx.Configure(&ctx, &c.header) == FFX_API_RETURN_OK;
}

void gpu_fg_prepare(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p) {
    prepared_id = 0;
    if (!gpu_fg_active()) return;
    want_rw = p->render_w, want_rh = p->render_h;
    if (!ctx || ctx_rw != p->render_w || ctx_rh != p->render_h) return;  /* made at the next present */
    uint64_t id = next_id;
    gpu_fg_hudless_copy(cb, p);
    if (!configure(id, ctx_dw, ctx_dh)) return;
#ifdef _WIN32
    struct ffxDispatchDescFrameGenerationPrepareV2 d = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION_PREPARE_V2}};
    d.reset = prepared_reset;
#define CAM d
#else  /* SDK v1.1.4: the camera's vectors in a description of their own, chained on; no reset (its field is unused) */
    struct ffxDispatchDescFrameGenerationPrepare d = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION_PREPARE}};
    struct ffxDispatchDescFrameGenerationPrepareCameraInfo cam = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION_PREPARE_CAMERAINFO}};
    d.header.pNext = &cam.header;
#define CAM cam
#endif
    d.frameID = id, d.flags = debug_flags(), d.commandList = cb;
    d.renderSize.width = p->render_w, d.renderSize.height = p->render_h;
    float mx = 1.0f, my = 1.0f, jx = 1.0f, jy = 1.0f;  /* tests: YW4_FG_MV_SIGN / YW4_FG_JITTER_SIGN=x,y scale them */
    if (getenv("YW4_FG_MV_SIGN")) sscanf(getenv("YW4_FG_MV_SIGN"), "%f,%f", &mx, &my);
    if (getenv("YW4_FG_JITTER_SIGN")) sscanf(getenv("YW4_FG_JITTER_SIGN"), "%f,%f", &jx, &jy);
    d.jitterOffset.x = p->jitter[0] * jx, d.jitterOffset.y = p->jitter[1] * jy;
    d.motionVectorScale.x = p->motion_scale[0] * mx, d.motionVectorScale.y = p->motion_scale[1] * my;
    d.frameTimeDelta = p->frame_ms;
    d.cameraNear = p->cam_near, d.cameraFar = p->cam_far, d.cameraFovAngleVertical = p->fov_y;
    d.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1.0f;
    d.depth = resource(p->depth, p->depth_format, p->render_w, p->render_h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_DEPTHTARGET);
    d.motionVectors = resource(p->motion, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT, p->render_w, p->render_h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    CAM.cameraForward[2] = 1.0f, CAM.cameraUp[1] = 1.0f, CAM.cameraRight[0] = 1.0f;  /* not known: a plain frame */
#undef CAM
    full_barrier(cb);
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.Dispatch(&ctx, &d.header);
    full_barrier(cb);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: prepare failed (%u)\n", (unsigned)r);
        return;
    }
    prepared_id = id;
}

/* ---- slots: the game's frame and the generated one, until the pacing thread has shown them */

typedef struct {
    FgImage real, gen;
    VkFormat fmt;
    uint32_t w, h;
    int busy, has_gen;
} Slot;

static Slot slots[2];
static int next_slot;
static HostLock plock;
static HostCond pcond;
static int queued = -1, showing = -1;  /* the slot waiting for the pacing thread, the one it shows */
static VkRect2D queued_rect;
static uint64_t queued_frame;
static int64_t queued_ns;
static int pacer_started;

/* The format FSR is told and views our images in: an sRGB one's UNORM twin, so FSR reads and writes the
 * encoded bytes (its sRGB transfer function) and can write them at all (sRGB formats have no storage use). */
static VkFormat raw_format(VkFormat f) {
    return f == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB ? VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM : f == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM : f;
}

/* In the presented format (the window's copy decodes it as it does the game's), viewable in raw_format too. */
static void image_make(FgImage *im, VkFormat fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    VkFormat raw = raw_format(fmt), both[2] = {fmt, raw};
    VkImageFormatListCreateInfo list = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_LIST_CREATE_INFO, .viewFormatCount = 2,
                                        .pViewFormats = both};
    VkImageCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, .format = fmt,
                             .extent = {w, h, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1, .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT,
                             .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                             .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                                      VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT};
    if (raw != fmt)  /* storage use through the UNORM view only */
        ici.pNext = &list, ici.flags = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_CREATE_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT;
    VkFormatProperties fp;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(vk.gpu, raw, &fp);
    if (!(fp.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT)) ici.usage &= ~VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT;
    CHECK(vkCreateImage(vk.device, &ici, NULL, &im->image));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(vk.device, im->image, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &im->mem));
    CHECK(vkBindImageMemory(vk.device, im->image, im->mem, 0));
}

static void image_free(FgImage *im) {
    if (!im->image) return;
    vkDestroyImage(vk.device, im->image, NULL);
    vkFreeMemory(vk.device, im->mem, NULL);
    memset(im, 0, sizeof *im);
}

static void to_general(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage image) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER, .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                              .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                              .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                              .image = image, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1,
                         &b);
}

/* The slot's images for frames of w x h in fmt (made again on a change; only when nothing shows them). */
static void slot_images(VkCommandBuffer cb, Slot *s, VkFormat fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    if (s->real.image && s->fmt == fmt && s->w == w && s->h == h) return;
    if (s->real.image) gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX), image_free(&s->real), image_free(&s->gen);
    image_make(&s->real, fmt, w, h);
    image_make(&s->gen, fmt, w, h);
    to_general(cb, s->real.image);
    to_general(cb, s->gen.image);
    s->fmt = fmt, s->w = w, s->h = h;
}

/* ---- pacing: the generated frame now, the game's half the game's frame time later */

static int gen_share_x1000;  /* the share of recent game frames shown with a generated one, x1000 (the HUD) */

float gpu_fg_shown_per_frame(void) {
    if (gpu_fg() == 2) return dlssg_shown_per_frame();
    if (!gpu_fg_active() || !pacer_started) return 0.0f;
    return 1.0f + (float)__atomic_load_n(&gen_share_x1000, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) / 1000.0f;
}

static void pacer(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    host_thread_set_priority(NULL, 36);  /* presentation pacing: wake up with minimal jitter */
    double interval_ms = 16.7;
    int64_t last_ns = 0;
    for (;;) {
        host_lock(&plock);
        while (queued < 0) host_cond_wait(&pcond, &plock, -1);
        int k = queued;
        VkRect2D rect = queued_rect;
        uint64_t frame = queued_frame;
        int64_t t = queued_ns;
        queued = -1, showing = k;
        host_cond_broadcast(&pcond);
        host_unlock(&plock);
        Slot *s = &slots[k];
        if (last_ns) {  /* the game's frame time, smoothed over ~10 frames */
            double d = (double)(t - last_ns) / 1e6;
            if (d > 0.0 && d < 100.0) interval_ms += (d - interval_ms) * 0.1;
        }
        last_ns = t;
        if (s->has_gen) {
            /* screenshots are of the game's frames; YW4_FG_SHOT_GEN=1: of the generated one shown before it instead,
             * 2: of both (the generated one as frame_N_gen.bmp) */
            static int shot_gen = -1;
            if (shot_gen < 0) shot_gen = getenv("YW4_FG_SHOT_GEN") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_FG_SHOT_GEN")) : 0;
            if (shot_gen == 2) window_screenshot_suffix("_gen");
            window_present_image(s->gen.image, s->fmt, rect, shot_gen ? frame : UINT64_MAX);
            if (shot_gen == 2) window_screenshot_suffix("");
            if (shot_gen == 1) frame = UINT64_MAX;
            int64_t due = t + (int64_t)(interval_ms * 0.5e6), now = host_now_ns();
            if (due > now && due - now < 50000000) host_sleep_ns(due - now);
        }
        window_present_image(s->real.image, s->fmt, rect, frame);
        static int shown, made;  /* every 600 of the game's frames: how many got a generated one */
        made += s->has_gen;
        __atomic_store_n(&gen_share_x1000, gen_share_x1000 + (s->has_gen * 1000 - gen_share_x1000) / 16, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (++shown == 600) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: %d of the last 600 frames had a generated frame before them (%.1f ms apart)\n",
                    made, interval_ms * 0.5);
            shown = made = 0;
        }
        host_lock(&plock);
        s->busy = 0, showing = -1;
        host_cond_broadcast(&pcond);
        host_unlock(&plock);
    }
}

int gpu_fg_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage image, VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    uint64_t id = prepared_id;
    prepared_id = 0;
    if (!gpu_fg_active()) {
        if (ctx && gpu_fg() != 1) destroy();
        return -1;
    }
    if (!pacer_started) {
        host_lock_init(&plock);
        host_cond_init(&pcond);
        if (host_thread_start(pacer, NULL, 1 << 20)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: no pacing thread: no frame generation\n");
            loaded = 0;
            return -1;
        }
        pacer_started = 1;
    }
    /* the context follows the presented size and the 3D's: made here, used from the next frame's prepare */
    if (want_rw && want_rh && create(w, h, want_rw, want_rh, raw_format(format)) == 0) return -1;
    int k = next_slot;
    next_slot ^= 1;
    host_lock(&plock);
    while (slots[k].busy) host_cond_wait(&pcond, &plock, -1);  /* still to be shown: the pacing thread is behind */
    slots[k].busy = 1;
    host_unlock(&plock);
    Slot *s = &slots[k];
    slot_images(cb, s, format, w, h);
    full_barrier(cb);
    VkImageCopy c = {.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                     .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .extent = {w, h, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImage(cb, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, s->real.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &c);
    s->has_gen = 0;
    if (id && ctx && ctx_dw == w && ctx_dh == h) {
        struct ffxDispatchDescFrameGeneration d = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_FRAMEGENERATION}};
        d.commandList = cb;
        /* our copy of the game's frame: the game's image has no UNORM view */
        d.presentColor = resource(s->real.image, raw_format(format), w, h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
        d.outputs[0] = resource(s->gen.image, raw_format(format), w, h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV);
        d.numGeneratedFrames = 1;
        d.reset = prepared_reset;
        d.backbufferTransferFunction = FFX_API_BACKBUFFER_TRANSFER_FUNCTION_SRGB;  /* the game's bytes, shown as they are */
        d.minMaxLuminance[0] = 0.0f, d.minMaxLuminance[1] = 1000.0f;
        d.generationRect.width = (int32_t)w, d.generationRect.height = (int32_t)h;
        d.frameID = id;
        full_barrier(cb);
        ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.Dispatch(&ctx, &d.header);
        full_barrier(cb);
        static int show_hudless = -1;  /* tests: YW4_FG_SHOW_HUDLESS=1 shows the HUD-less copy in its place */
        if (show_hudless < 0) show_hudless = getenv("YW4_FG_SHOW_HUDLESS") != NULL;
        if (show_hudless && hudless_ok && hudless_w == w && hudless_h == h) {
            VkImageCopy hc = {.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                              .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .extent = {w, h, 1}};
            vkCmdCopyImage(cb, hudless.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, s->gen.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &hc);
            full_barrier(cb);
        }
        if (r == FFX_API_RETURN_OK) s->has_gen = 1;
        else {
            static int logged;
            if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fg: generation failed (%u)\n", (unsigned)r);
        }
        next_id = id + 1;
        prepared_reset = 0;
    } else {
        prepared_reset = 1;  /* a frame without a prepare: FSR starts over */
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    return k;
}

void gpu_fg_show(int k, VkRect2D rect, uint64_t frame) {
    host_lock(&plock);
    while (queued >= 0) host_cond_wait(&pcond, &plock, -1);
    queued = k, queued_rect = rect, queued_frame = frame, queued_ns = host_now_ns();
    host_cond_broadcast(&pcond);
    host_unlock(&plock);
}

void gpu_fg_drain(void) {
    if (!pacer_started) return;
    host_lock(&plock);
    while (queued >= 0 || showing >= 0) host_cond_wait(&pcond, &plock, -1);
    host_unlock(&plock);
}

#else  /* no FSR in this build */

int gpu_fg_active(void) { return 0; }
float gpu_fg_shown_per_frame(void) { return 0.0f; }
void gpu_fg_note_present(VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkRect2D rect) { (void)format, (void)w, (void)h, (void)rect; }
VkImage gpu_fg_hudless(void) { return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
void gpu_fg_hudless_copy(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p) { (void)cb, (void)p; }
void gpu_fg_prepare(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p) { (void)cb, (void)p; }
int gpu_fg_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage image, VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    (void)cb, (void)image, (void)format, (void)w, (void)h;
    return -1;
}
void gpu_fg_show(int slot, VkRect2D rect, uint64_t frame) { (void)slot, (void)rect, (void)frame; }
void gpu_fg_drain(void) {}

#endif
```

`runtime/src/gpu_fg.h`:

```h
/* Frame generation (gpu_fg.c): a frame made between each two of the game's, shown half a frame earlier. */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#include "vk.h"

/* The setting: 0 off, 1 AMD FSR, 2 NVIDIA DLSS (gpu_dlssg.cpp; Streamline starts only when it is set at start).
 * Works with anti-aliasing TAA, FSR or DLSS (they have the game's motion). */
int gpu_fg(void);
void gpu_fg_cycle(void);
void gpu_fg_step(int dir);
void gpu_fg_test_switch(uint64_t frame);  /* YW4_FG_AT=<frame>:<mode>,... (tests) */
/* 1 for the frames after a switch of the setting: the window lets the GPU finish all its work before each of
 * them and shows "switching" (FSR's and Streamline's switch freed image views a command buffer still used:
 * Vulkan validation, 2026-11-04; an occasional device-lost crash when turning frame generation on). */
int gpu_fg_switching(void);
/* 1 while FSR's frame generation shows frames: the window then doesn't wait for the monitor (window.c). */
int gpu_fg_active(void);
/* Frames on screen per game frame while frame generation runs (about 2), else 0 (the HUD's SHOWN line). */
float gpu_fg_shown_per_frame(void);

typedef struct {
    VkImage depth, motion;  /* the 3D's size, layout GENERAL */
    VkImageView depth_view, motion_view;
    VkImage scene;          /* the picture before the UI is drawn (output size, layout GENERAL): the HUD-less copy */
    VkFormat scene_format;
    uint32_t scene_w, scene_h;
    VkFormat depth_format;
    uint32_t render_w, render_h;
    float jitter[2];        /* as told to FSR's upscaler: the same conventions */
    float motion_scale[2];
    float frame_ms, cam_near, cam_far, fov_y;
} GpuFgPrepare;

/* After the anti-aliasing (in cb, outside rendering): this frame's depth and motion. */
void gpu_fg_prepare(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p);
/* At the present (in cb, before it is submitted): when frame generation is on, copies the presented image and,
 * if this frame was prepared, makes the frame between the last one and it. Returns the slot to give to
 * gpu_fg_show after the submit, or -1: present as usual. */
int gpu_fg_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage image, VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h);
/* Every present (gpu.c): the presented image's format and size, and the part of it the window shows. */
void gpu_fg_note_present(VkFormat format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkRect2D rect);
/* The HUD-less copy: the picture before the UI in the presented format, at its place in the presented image
 * (made after the anti-aliasing, for FSR's and DLSS's frame generation). gpu_fg_hudless: it, when made for the
 * present now happening, else VK_NULL_HANDLE. */
void gpu_fg_hudless_copy(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFgPrepare *p);
VkImage gpu_fg_hudless(void);
/* Hands the slot's frames to the pacing thread, which presents the generated one, then the game's half a
 * frame later. */
void gpu_fg_show(int slot, VkRect2D rect, uint64_t frame);
/* Waits until the pacing thread has shown everything (before presenting without it). */
void gpu_fg_drain(void);
```
