`runtime/src/gpu_fsr.c`:

```c
/* AMD FSR upscaling through the FidelityFX SDK's own Vulkan DLLs (decision 0039; MIT, fetched and checked by
 * tools/yw4/deps.py, never committed): amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll next to yw4.exe, which loads
 * amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll from the same folder. The loader picks the upscaler the GPU supports: FSR 3.1 on
 * any GPU, FSR 4 on the AMD ones it names.
 *
 * Used by gpu_aa.c in place of TAA's blend: the same jitter point (3D draws shifted in the viewport), the game's
 * motion (copied at the end of the G-buffer pass) and the scene's depth. The colour goes in through the
 * anti-aliasing's reversible curve (perceptual, 0..1), so FSR is told the colour is non-linear.
 * Linux (decision 0073): AMD ships no Linux build, so tools/yw4/fsr_linux.py builds FSR 3.1.5 from AMD's SDK v1.1.4
 * source (with xplane-fsr3's Linux port, third_party/fsr3-linux) into libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so next to yw4: the same
 * five functions, opened with dlopen once for this file and gpu_fg.c (gpu_ffx_library). */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu.h"
#include "gpu_fsr.h"
#include "host.h"

#ifdef YW4_FSR
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#ifndef _WINDOWS
#define _WINDOWS  /* ffx_api_loader.h looks for MSBuild's name for Windows; without it ffxLoadFunctions is empty */
#endif

#include "ffx_api.h"
#include "ffx_api_loader.h"
#include "ffx_api_types.h"
#include "vk/ffx_api_vk.h"
#include "../../upscalers/include/ffx_upscale.h"
#else
/* Linux: FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4's ffx-api, built here as libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so next to yw4 (decision 0073). Its
 * loader header is Windows-only (HMODULE), so the five functions are looked up with dlsym. */
#include <SDL3/SDL_filesystem.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_vulkan.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>

#include "ffx_api.h"
#include "ffx_api_types.h"
#include "vk/ffx_api_vk.h"
#include "ffx_upscale.h"
typedef struct {
    PfnFfxCreateContext CreateContext;
    PfnFfxDestroyContext DestroyContext;
    PfnFfxConfigure Configure;
    PfnFfxQuery Query;
    PfnFfxDispatch Dispatch;
} ffxFunctions;
/* the library's own: what our device enabled, so AMD's backend uses no feature or extension it wasn't given */
typedef void (*Yw4FfxHostSet)(PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr, VkInstance, const char *const *, uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t,
                              uint32_t);

/* libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so from yw4's folder, opened once for FSR and its frame generation (gpu_fg.c), and told what
 * the device enabled; NULL (said why, once) without it */
void *gpu_ffx_library(void) {
    static void *m;
    static int tried;
    if (tried) return m;
    tried = 1;
    char path[1024];
    const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath();
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%slibamd_fidelityfx_vk.so", base ? base : "");
    void *lib = dlopen(path, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!lib) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: %s\n", dlerror());
        return NULL;
    }
    Yw4FfxHostSet host_set = (Yw4FfxHostSet)dlsym(lib, "yw4FfxHostSet");
    if (!host_set) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: %s lacks yw4FfxHostSet\n", path);
        return NULL;
    }
    host_set((PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)SDL_Vulkan_GetVkGetInstanceProcAddr(), vk.instance, vk.device_exts,
             vk.ndevice_exts, (uint32_t)vk.shader_f16, (uint32_t)vk.shader_i16, (uint32_t)vk.sync2);
    return m = lib;
}
#endif

static ffxFunctions fx;
static int loaded = -1;  /* -1 not tried, 0 failed, 1 loaded */
static ffxContext ctx;
static uint32_t ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh;
static int ctx_failed;   /* creation failed for this size: don't retry every frame */

static void message(uint32_t type, const wchar_t *text) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: %s: %ls\n", type == FFX_API_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR ? "error" : "warning", text);
}

int gpu_fsr_built(void) { return 1; }

int gpu_fsr_available(void) {
    if (loaded >= 0) return loaded;
#ifdef _WIN32
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryA("amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll");
    if (!m) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll not found next to yw4.exe (python -m recomp.build "
                        "fetches it): TAA instead\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    ffxLoadFunctions(&fx, m);
#else
    void *m = gpu_ffx_library();
    if (!m) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: TAA instead\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    fx.CreateContext = (PfnFfxCreateContext)dlsym(m, "ffxCreateContext");
    fx.DestroyContext = (PfnFfxDestroyContext)dlsym(m, "ffxDestroyContext");
    fx.Configure = (PfnFfxConfigure)dlsym(m, "ffxConfigure");
    fx.Query = (PfnFfxQuery)dlsym(m, "ffxQuery");
    fx.Dispatch = (PfnFfxDispatch)dlsym(m, "ffxDispatch");
#endif
    if (!fx.CreateContext || !fx.Dispatch || !fx.Query || !fx.DestroyContext) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: the loader DLL lacks its functions: TAA instead\n");
        return loaded = 0;
    }
    return loaded = 1;
}

static void destroy(void) {
    if (!ctx) return;
    gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX);  /* FSR's resources may still be in use */
    fx.DestroyContext(&ctx, NULL);
    ctx = NULL;
}

static int create(uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) {
    if (ctx && ctx_rw == rw && ctx_rh == rh && ctx_ow == ow && ctx_oh == oh) return 1;
    if (!ctx && ctx_failed && ctx_rw == rw && ctx_rh == rh && ctx_ow == ow && ctx_oh == oh) return 0;
    destroy();
    ctx_rw = rw, ctx_rh = rh, ctx_ow = ow, ctx_oh = oh, ctx_failed = 0;
    struct ffxCreateBackendVKDesc backend = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_BACKEND_VK},
#ifdef _WIN32
        .deviceContext = {.vkDevice = vk.device, .vkPhysicalDevice = vk.gpu, .vkDeviceProcAddr = vkGetDeviceProcAddr}};
#else  /* SDK v1.1.4: the same three fields, not yet in a VkDeviceContext */
        .vkDevice = vk.device, .vkPhysicalDevice = vk.gpu, .vkDeviceProcAddr = vkGetDeviceProcAddr};
#endif
    struct ffxCreateContextDescUpscale desc = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE, .pNext = &backend.header},
        .flags = FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_NON_LINEAR_COLORSPACE,
        .maxRenderSize = {rw, rh}, .maxUpscaleSize = {ow, oh}, .fpMessage = message};
    if (getenv("YW4_FSR_DEBUG")) desc.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_DEBUG_CHECKING;
#ifdef _WIN32  /* SDK 2.x; v1.1.4 (Linux) has the debug view as a dispatch flag only */
    if (getenv("YW4_FSR_DEBUG_VIEW")) desc.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_DEBUG_VISUALIZATION;
#endif
    /* The upscalers the DLL offers on this GPU, logged once; YW4_FSR_VERSION=<name> (e.g. 2.3.4) picks one */
    struct ffxOverrideVersion over = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_DESC_TYPE_OVERRIDE_VERSION}};
    {
        uint64_t ids[16], count = 16;
        const char *names[16] = {0};
        struct ffxQueryDescGetVersions qv = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_GET_VERSIONS},
                                             .createDescType = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE,
#ifdef _WIN32
                                             .device = &backend.deviceContext,
#else  /* v1.1.4 reads it for DX12 only */
                                             .device = vk.device,
#endif
                                             .outputCount = &count, .versionIds = ids,
                                             .versionNames = names};
        fx.Query(NULL, &qv.header);
        static int listed;
        const char *want = getenv("YW4_FSR_VERSION");
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < count && i < 16; i++) {
            if (!listed) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: offers %s\n", names[i] ? names[i] : "?");
            if (want && names[i] && !strcmp(want, names[i])) over.versionId = ids[i];
        }
        listed = 1;
        if (over.versionId) backend.header.pNext = &over.header;
        else if (want) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: no version %s: the default instead\n", want);
    }
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.CreateContext(&ctx, &desc.header, NULL);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: context for %ux%u -> %ux%u failed (%u): TAA instead\n", rw, rh, ow, oh, (unsigned)r);
        ctx = NULL, ctx_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    struct ffxQueryGetProviderVersion qv = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_GET_PROVIDER_VERSION}};
    fx.Query(&ctx, &qv.header);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: %s for %ux%u -> %ux%u ready in %.0f ms\n", qv.versionName ? qv.versionName : "upscaler",
            rw, rh, ow, oh, (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6);
    return 1;
}

/* FSR's context made ahead, at the first frame the sizes are known (the title, a loading screen), not at its first
 * use in a battle: making it took 260-755 ms, a freeze at the first Demon Hand of every session (2026-11-11). */
void gpu_fsr_prepare(uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) {
    if (gpu_fsr_available() == 1 && rw && rh && ow && oh) create(rw, rh, ow, oh);
}

void gpu_fsr_jitter(uint32_t w, uint32_t ow, uint64_t n, float *jx, float *jy) {
    *jx = *jy = 0.0f;
    if (gpu_fsr_available() != 1) return;
    int32_t phases = 8;
    struct ffxQueryDescUpscaleGetJitterPhaseCount qp = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE_GETJITTERPHASECOUNT}, .renderWidth = w, .displayWidth = ow,
        .pOutPhaseCount = &phases};
    fx.Query(ctx ? &ctx : NULL, &qp.header);
    if (phases < 1) phases = 8;
    struct ffxQueryDescUpscaleGetJitterOffset qo = {
        .header = {.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE_GETJITTEROFFSET}, .index = (int32_t)(n % (uint64_t)phases),
        .phaseCount = phases, .pOutX = jx, .pOutY = jy};
    fx.Query(ctx ? &ctx : NULL, &qo.header);
}

static uint32_t surface_format(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT:
    case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;
    case VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT:
    case VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R32_UINT;  /* as ffx_api_vk.h maps them */
    case VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16_UNORM;
    default: return FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    }
}

/* Our images stay in layout GENERAL, which FSR's Vulkan backend calls the unordered-access state: it moves them
 * to what it needs and back. */
static struct FfxApiResource resource(VkImage image, VkFormat f, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t usage) {
    struct FfxApiResource r = {.resource = (void *)image, .state = FFX_API_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS};
    r.description.type = FFX_API_RESOURCE_TYPE_TEXTURE2D;
    r.description.format = surface_format(f);
    r.description.width = w, r.description.height = h, r.description.depth = 1, r.description.mipCount = 1;
    r.description.usage = usage;
    return r;
}

int gpu_fsr_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFsrInputs *in) {
    if (gpu_fsr_available() != 1 || !create(in->render_w, in->render_h, in->output_w, in->output_h)) return 0;
    struct ffxDispatchDescUpscale d = {.header = {.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE}, .commandList = cb};
    d.color = resource(in->color, in->color_format, in->render_w, in->render_h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    d.depth = resource(in->depth, in->depth_format, in->render_w, in->render_h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_DEPTHTARGET);
    d.motionVectors = resource(in->motion, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT, in->render_w, in->render_h,
                               FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    d.output = resource(in->output, in->output_format, in->output_w, in->output_h, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV);
    d.jitterOffset.x = in->jitter[0], d.jitterOffset.y = in->jitter[1];
    d.motionVectorScale.x = in->motion_scale[0], d.motionVectorScale.y = in->motion_scale[1];
    d.renderSize.width = in->render_w, d.renderSize.height = in->render_h;
    static float test = -1.0f;  /* YW4_FSR_TEST_RATIO=1.5: timing only, FSR told the 3D used 1/ratio of the images */
    if (test < 0.0f) test = getenv("YW4_FSR_TEST_RATIO") ? (float)atof(getenv("YW4_FSR_TEST_RATIO")) : 0.0f;
    if (test > 1.0f)
        d.renderSize.width = (uint32_t)((float)in->render_w / test), d.renderSize.height = (uint32_t)((float)in->render_h / test);
    d.upscaleSize.width = in->output_w, d.upscaleSize.height = in->output_h;
    d.enableSharpening = in->sharpness > 0.0f, d.sharpness = in->sharpness;
    d.frameTimeDelta = in->frame_ms, d.preExposure = 1.0f, d.reset = in->reset != 0;
    d.cameraNear = in->cam_near, d.cameraFar = in->cam_far, d.cameraFovAngleVertical = in->fov_y;
    d.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1.0f;
    if (getenv("YW4_FSR_DEBUG_VIEW")) d.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_FLAG_DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW;  /* FSR's own diagnostic picture */
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.Dispatch(&ctx, &d.header);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fsr: dispatch failed (%u)\n", (unsigned)r);
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

#else  /* no FSR in this build */

int gpu_fsr_built(void) { return 0; }
int gpu_fsr_available(void) { return 0; }
void gpu_fsr_prepare(uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) { (void)rw, (void)rh, (void)ow, (void)oh; }
void gpu_fsr_jitter(uint32_t w, uint32_t ow, uint64_t n, float *jx, float *jy) {
    (void)w, (void)ow, (void)n;
    *jx = *jy = 0.0f;
}
int gpu_fsr_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFsrInputs *in) {
    (void)cb, (void)in;
    return 0;
}

#endif
```

`runtime/src/gpu_fsr.h`:

```h
/* AMD FSR upscaling (gpu_fsr.c): the FidelityFX SDK's Vulkan DLLs, loaded on first use. */
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#include "vk.h"

typedef struct {
    VkImage color, depth, motion, output;  /* all in layout GENERAL; output has storage use */
    VkFormat color_format, depth_format, output_format;
    uint32_t render_w, render_h, output_w, output_h;
    float jitter[2];        /* this frame's shift of the 3D draws, in render pixels */
    float motion_scale[2];  /* motion texel x scale = FSR's pixel motion (from this frame's position to the last) */
    int reset;              /* no usable history: the first frame, a size change, a frame without FSR */
    float frame_ms, sharpness, cam_near, cam_far, fov_y;
} GpuFsrInputs;

/* 1: built with FSR headers and libraries. */
int gpu_fsr_built(void);
/* 1: the DLLs are there and FSR runs on this device (checked once). */
int gpu_fsr_available(void);
/* FSR's context for these sizes made now, if it isn't (ahead of its first use: making it takes ~0.5 s). */
void gpu_fsr_prepare(uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh);
/* The shift for frame n of FSR's jitter sequence (render w against output ow), in pixels. */
void gpu_fsr_jitter(uint32_t w, uint32_t ow, uint64_t n, float *jx, float *jy);
/* Records FSR's passes into cb (outside rendering). 0 if FSR could not run. */
int gpu_fsr_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuFsrInputs *in);
#if defined(YW4_FSR) && !defined(_WIN32)
/* Linux: libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so (decision 0073), opened once for FSR and its frame generation; NULL without it. */
void *gpu_ffx_library(void);
#endif

```

```h
/* Shared by gpu.c (submissions, memory, images) and gpu_draw.c (shaders, pipelines, draws):
 * the draw path of decision 0021. */
#ifndef YW4_GPU_INTERNAL_H
#define YW4_GPU_INTERNAL_H

#include "gpu.h"
#include "c11_keywords.h"
#include "nvn.h"
#include "vk.h"

YW4_NORETURN void gpu_fatal(const char *what, VkResult r);
#define CHECK(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) gpu_fatal(#x, r_); } while (0)
YW4_NORETURN void gpu_stop(const char *fmt, ...);  /* something the draw path can't do yet */

/* ---- gpu.c: where a frame's time on the GPU thread went, logged when it is long (hitches; YW4_STALL_MS) */
enum { STALL_EXEC, STALL_LOCK, STALL_BEGIN, STALL_PIPE, STALL_IMAGE, STALL_UPLOAD, STALL_PRESENT, STALL_SHADER, STALL_WAIT,
       STALL_KINDS };
void gpu_stall_add(int kind, int64_t ns);
extern _Thread_local int gpu_in_work;  /* the GPU thread is executing or presenting: its gpu_waits are stalls */

/* ---- gpu_ab.c: same-frame A/B of a pass (YW4_AB_AT) */
typedef struct GpuState GpuState;
int gpu_ab_marker(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, const void *data, uint32_t size, uint64_t exec, uint64_t next,
                  uint64_t *resume);
void gpu_ab_targets(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s);
/* gpu_draw.c: the per-pass timer's label for this draw if it is the shadow mask in YW4_MASK_BREAKDOWN, else NULL */
const char *gpu_mask_breakdown_label(const GpuState *s);
/* gpu_draw.c: is this draw one of the screen passes to compare (YW4_AB_PASS=screen, YW4_AB_FS)? */
int gpu_screen_ab_draw(const GpuState *s);
int gpu_ab_pending(void);
void gpu_ab_flush(void);

/* ---- gpu_watch.c: the minimap watch (YW4_MINIMAP_WATCH=1): what was drawn into the minimap's images and put on
 * screen each frame, and the images themselves read back; logs the frames it goes blank in */
typedef struct {
    const NvnTexture *tex;  /* NULL: the slot names no texture (the draw gets a dummy) */
    uint32_t slot;
    uint64_t handle;        /* the texture handle bound to the slot */
    int fresh;              /* made or uploaded for this very draw */
} GpuWatchTex;
typedef struct {
    uint8_t stage, slot;  /* 0 vertex, 1 fragment */
    uint64_t addr, size;
} GpuWatchBuf;
typedef struct {  /* the draw's own data, in the game's memory */
    uint64_t vb_addr, vb_size;  /* the first vertex stream the program reads */
    uint32_t first, stride;
    int stale;                  /* our video-memory copy of it was out of date before this draw */
    GpuWatchBuf cb[4];          /* constant buffers of the vertex and fragment programs */
    int ncb;
} GpuWatchData;

void gpu_watch_clear(const NvnTexture *t);  /* a colour clear of t */
/* is this draw one the watch records: into a minimap image, or sampling one? */
int gpu_watch_wants(const GpuState *s, const GpuWatchTex *tex, int ntex);
/* a draw into s's targets by these programs, with its fragment program's textures */
void gpu_watch_draw(const GpuState *s, uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs, uint64_t verts, const GpuWatchTex *tex, int ntex,
                    const GpuWatchData *data);
void gpu_watch_frame(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t frame);  /* gpu_present; then, cb submitted: */

void gpu_passes_collect(int slot);
void gpu_passes_note(int what);  /* 1 rendering ended, 2 a texture uploaded */

/* ---- gpu.c */

/* Per submission, freed when it completes: descriptor sets. */
VkDescriptorSet gpu_alloc_set(VkDescriptorSetLayout layout);

typedef struct GpuView GpuView;

/* What identifies a texture's image: where its texels are and how they are laid out. Two
 * NVN texture objects (or copies of one) with the same key share one image, as they share
 * the memory on the Switch. */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr;
    uint32_t format, target, width, height, depth, layers, levels, block_height_log2, block_depth_log2, linear;
    /* made larger by scale_num / scale_den (0 / 0: the game's size): the shadow maps (YW4_SHADOW_RES / panel,
     * res / 1024) and the screen-sized targets (YW4_RES / panel, height / 900) */
    uint32_t scale_num, scale_den;
    /* the width also times wide_num / wide_den (0 / 0: not): the screen-sized targets in another picture
     * shape than 16:9 (widescreen.c) */
    uint32_t wide_num, wide_den;
} ImageKey;

/* v made num / den times larger, rounded to the nearest whole pixel */
static inline uint32_t gpu_scaled(uint32_t v, uint32_t num, uint32_t den) {
    return (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)v * num + den / 2) / den);
}

typedef struct GpuImage GpuImage;
struct GpuImage {
    GpuImage *next;           /* hash chain (gpu.c) */
    ImageKey key;
    uint64_t last_frame;      /* frame it was last used in, and the submission: for freeing */
    uint64_t last_seq;
    VkImage image;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;            /* its own allocation, or NULL: a slice of a shared block (gpu.c) */
    struct MemBlock *block;
    VkDeviceSize mem_off, mem_size;
    VkFormat format;
    VkImageAspectFlags aspect;
    uint32_t width, height, depth, layers, levels;
    uint32_t scale_num, scale_den;  /* width and height are the texture's times this (key's; 1 / 1 if none) */
    uint32_t wide_num, wide_den;    /* ... and the width also times this (key's; 1 / 1 if none) */
    GpuView *views;  /* cached image views */
    uint64_t uploaded_frame;  /* YW4_GPU_REUPLOAD: the frame it was last uploaded in */
    uint32_t upload_gen;      /* write generation (gpu.c) when it was last uploaded */
    uint32_t checked_gen;     /* ... when its pages were last found unchanged */
    uint32_t reg_gen;         /* the newest registration (NvnTexture.reg_gen) it was uploaded for */
    uint64_t sample;          /* hosts without write tracking, movie planes: a sample of the content uploaded */
    uint64_t print;           /* YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG: its storage's content when last uploaded */
    uint32_t flush_seen;      /* YW4_REUPLOAD_LOG: flush_count (gpu.c) when last uploaded */
};

/* Effects resolution: t (a distance-blur image) keeps the game's size ratio (gpu.c). */
void gpu_keep_game_ratio(const NvnTexture *t);
/* t's image: made on first use, uploaded from the game's memory unless the GPU owns it. */
GpuImage *image_of(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *t);
/* t's image if it exists (no upload, no creation). */
GpuImage *image_find(const NvnTexture *t);
/* Would image_of record a copy for t (make it, or upload it)? Not allowed while rendering. */
int gpu_needs_transfer(const NvnTexture *t);
VkFormat gpu_format(uint32_t nvn_format);
int gpu_format_alpha_one(uint32_t nvn_format);  /* RGBX-style: alpha reads as 1 */

/* A view of t for rendering (one level, the layers of v) or sampling (as `type`, through

VkImageView gpu_render_view(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *t, const NvnTextureView *v, int has_view, uint32_t *w,

/* The sampler being asked for is a 3D draw's, before the anti-aliasing point: it gets upscaling's mip bias. Set

extern _Thread_local int gpu_sampler_scene;

/* ---- gpu_draw.c: the state a command list builds up, and its draws */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, size;
} GpuRange;

enum { STAGES = 6, UBOS = 16, SSBOS = 16, TEXTURES = 48 };

typedef struct GpuState {
    RenderTargets rt;
    int ncolor;
    int rendering;  /* inside vkCmdBeginRendering for rt */

    int cond_mode;        /* SetRenderEnableConditional: 0 none, 1 draw if the two counter values at cond_addr are */
    uint64_t cond_addr;   /* equal, 2 if not equal (gpu_query.c) */
} GpuState;

/* ---- gpu_query.c: the game's occlusion queries and its draws conditional on them */
```

`runtime/src/gpu_passes.c`:

```c
/* Per-pass GPU timing (F5, or YW4_GPU_PASSES=1 at start): where the GPU's time goes in a frame.
 *
 * While it is on, every submission writes a GPU timestamp at each change of render targets (the
 * start of a pass), around each compute dispatch and around each pass of our own renderer
 * (CMD_NATIVE), plus one at its start and end. The time between two marks belongs to the pass
 * the first one started. Passes are grouped by what they draw into (the colour targets' and the
 * depth target's sizes and NVN formats) and their first program, summed over 300 frames, and the
 * most expensive groups go to the log in milliseconds per frame. A timestamp waits for the work
 * before it, so a pass's time includes any wait for the one before (barriers). gpu_lock held. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu_internal.h"

enum { SLOTS = 16, PER_SLOT = 512, GROUPS = 512, REPORT_FRAMES = 300, SHOWN = 24 };

typedef struct {
    char label[80];
    uint64_t vs, fs;  /* the first program drawn or dispatched after the mark */
    uint32_t draws, restarts, uploads;  /* rendering ended inside the pass; textures uploaded */
    uint64_t vertices;  /* drawn: indices (or vertices) x instances */
} Mark;

static VkQueryPool pool;
static double period_ns;
static int on = -1;
static Mark marks[SLOTS][PER_SLOT];
static uint32_t nmarks[SLOTS];
static int timed[SLOTS];  /* the slot's submission writes marks */
static int cur = -1;      /* the slot being recorded */

typedef struct {
    char label[80];
    uint64_t vs, fs;
    double ms;
    long draws, passes, restarts, uploads;
    uint64_t vertices;
} Group;
static Group groups[GROUPS];
static int ngroups;
static uint64_t report_from;

static int enabled(void) {
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("YW4_GPU_PASSES") && atoi(getenv("YW4_GPU_PASSES"));
    return on;
}

void gpu_passes_toggle(void) {
    on = !enabled();
    ngroups = 0, report_from = gpu_frames();
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu passes: timing %s (F5)\n", on ? "on: the most expensive passes every 300 frames" : "off");
}

static void mark(VkCommandBuffer cb, const char *label) {
    if (cur < 0 || !timed[cur] || nmarks[cur] >= PER_SLOT - 1) return;
    Mark *m = &marks[cur][nmarks[cur]];
    snprintf(m->label, sizeof m->label, "%s", label);
    m->vs = m->fs = 0, m->draws = m->restarts = m->uploads = 0, m->vertices = 0;
    vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, pool, (uint32_t)cur * PER_SLOT + nmarks[cur]++);
}

/* gpu.c, begin(): the slot's submission starts. */
void gpu_passes_begin(VkCommandBuffer cb, int slot) {
    cur = slot;
    timed[slot] = 0;
    if (!enabled() || slot >= SLOTS) return;
    if (!pool) {
        if (!vk.props.limits.timestampComputeAndGraphics || vk.props.limits.timestampPeriod <= 0) return;
        VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                    .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, .queryCount = SLOTS * PER_SLOT};
        if (vkCreateQueryPool(vk.device, &qi, NULL, &pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return;
        period_ns = vk.props.limits.timestampPeriod;
    }
    vkCmdResetQueryPool(cb, pool, (uint32_t)slot * PER_SLOT, PER_SLOT);
    timed[slot] = 1, nmarks[slot] = 0;
    mark(cb, "(start of a submission)");
}

/* gpu.c, submit(): the last mark closes the last pass. */
void gpu_passes_end(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    mark(cb, "");
    cur = -1;
}

static void describe_targets(const GpuState *s, char *out, size_t size) {
    size_t n = 0;
    out[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s->ncolor && i < 8 && n < size; i++) {
        const NvnTexture *t = s->rt.color[i];
        if (t) n += (size_t)snprintf(out + n, size - n, "%s%ux%u f%u", n ? " " : "", t->width, t->height, t->format);
    }
    const NvnTexture *d = s->rt.depth;
    if (d && n < size) n += (size_t)snprintf(out + n, size - n, "%sdepth %ux%u f%u", n ? " + " : "", d->width, d->height, d->format);
    if (!n) snprintf(out, size, "(no targets)");
}

/* gpu.c: render targets set (after the previous rendering ended), or a dispatch or a native pass
 * done (what follows draws into the targets again). */
void gpu_passes_targets(VkCommandBuffer cb, const GpuState *s) {
    if (cur < 0 || !timed[cur]) return;
    char label[80];
    describe_targets(s, label, sizeof label);
    mark(cb, label);
}

/* gpu.c: a compute dispatch or a pass of our own is about to run. */
void gpu_passes_other(VkCommandBuffer cb, const char *what, uint64_t key) {
    if (cur < 0 || !timed[cur]) return;
    char label[80];
    snprintf(label, sizeof label, "%s", what);
    mark(cb, label);
    if (key && nmarks[cur]) marks[cur][nmarks[cur] - 1].vs = key;
}

/* gpu.c: a draw, with the program bound. */
void gpu_passes_draw(const NvnProgram *p, uint64_t vertices) {
    if (cur < 0 || !timed[cur] || !nmarks[cur]) return;
    Mark *m = &marks[cur][nmarks[cur] - 1];
    if (!m->draws && p) m->vs = p->stages[0].key, m->fs = p->stages[1].key;
    m->draws++;
    m->vertices += vertices;
}

/* gpu.c / gpu_draw.c: rendering ended (1) or a texture uploaded (2) inside the current pass. */
void gpu_passes_note(int what) {
    if (cur < 0 || !timed[cur] || !nmarks[cur]) return;
    Mark *m = &marks[cur][nmarks[cur] - 1];
    if (what == 1) m->restarts++;
    else m->uploads++;
}

static void report(void) {
    uint64_t frames = gpu_frames() - report_from;
    if (!frames) return;
    double total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ngroups; i++) total += groups[i].ms;
    /* most expensive first */
    for (int i = 1; i < ngroups; i++)
        for (int j = i; j > 0 && groups[j].ms > groups[j - 1].ms; j--) {
            Group g = groups[j];
            groups[j] = groups[j - 1], groups[j - 1] = g;
        }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu passes: %.2f ms of GPU time per frame over %" PRIu64 " frames; most expensive:\n",
            total / (double)frames, frames);
    /* the most expensive, and every shadow mask form of YW4_MASK_BREAKDOWN (each a quarter of the frames: its ms per
     * pass is that form's cost) */
    for (int i = 0; i < ngroups; i++) {
        if (i >= SHOWN && strncmp(groups[i].label, "shadow mask:", 12)) continue;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu passes: %6.2f ms %5.2f passes (%5.2f ms each) %6.1f draws %6.1f restarts %6.1f uploads "
                "%7.0fk vertices  %-44s vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 "\n", groups[i].ms / (double)frames,
                (double)groups[i].passes / (double)frames, groups[i].passes ? groups[i].ms / (double)groups[i].passes : 0.0,
                (double)groups[i].draws / (double)frames, (double)groups[i].restarts / (double)frames,
                (double)groups[i].uploads / (double)frames, (double)groups[i].vertices / (double)frames / 1000,
                groups[i].label, groups[i].vs, groups[i].fs);
    }
    ngroups = 0;
    report_from = gpu_frames();
}

/* gpu.c: the slot's submission has completed (before its queries are reset). */
void gpu_passes_collect(int slot) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= SLOTS || !timed[slot]) return;
    timed[slot] = 0;
    uint32_t n = nmarks[slot];
    static uint64_t t[PER_SLOT];
    if (n < 2 || vkGetQueryPoolResults(vk.device, pool, (uint32_t)slot * PER_SLOT, n, sizeof t, t, sizeof t[0],
                                       VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT) != VK_SUCCESS)
        return;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < n; i++) {
        const Mark *m = &marks[slot][i];
        double ms = t[i + 1] >= t[i] ? (double)(t[i + 1] - t[i]) * period_ns / 1e6 : 0;
        int g = 0;
        while (g < ngroups && !(groups[g].vs == m->vs && groups[g].fs == m->fs && !strcmp(groups[g].label, m->label))) g++;
        if (g == ngroups) {
            if (ngroups == GROUPS) g = GROUPS - 1;  /* full: the last group takes the rest */
            else {
                ngroups++;
                memset(&groups[g], 0, sizeof groups[g]);
                memcpy(groups[g].label, m->label, sizeof groups[g].label);
                groups[g].vs = m->vs, groups[g].fs = m->fs;
            }
        }
        groups[g].ms += ms, groups[g].draws += m->draws, groups[g].passes++;
        groups[g].restarts += m->restarts, groups[g].uploads += m->uploads, groups[g].vertices += m->vertices;
    }
    if (gpu_frames() >= report_from + REPORT_FRAMES) report();
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_pcache.c`:

```c
/* The pipeline cache on disk: every pipeline the driver compiles is kept between runs.
 *
 * Without one, every graphics pipeline was compiled from nothing in every run, on the GPU thread, the first
 * time a draw needed it: 40-300 ms each on a Radeon RX 6650 XT (2026-11-08), 117 of them (2.9 s) when the town
 * first appears, and a hitch whenever a new effect, character or menu showed up. With the cache a pipeline
 * built once before comes back from the driver in about a millisecond. All pipeline builds pass gpu_pcache().
 *
 * Saved by a thread every 10 s when pipelines were built since the last save, and at exit; written to a
 * temporary file and renamed, so a crash never leaves half a file. YW4_PIPELINE_CACHE=<file> moves it
 * (default work/pipelines.cache), =none turns it off.
 *
 * When the files are thrown away (decision 0063). The cache and the pipeline journal (gpu_draw.c) are only good
 * for the GPU, the driver and the translated shaders they were made with, so a third file beside the cache,
 * <cache>.stamp, says which those were:
 *   - the GPU and driver: vendorID, deviceID and pipelineCacheUUID of VkPhysicalDeviceProperties;
 *   - the shaders: a sum over the names, sizes and modification times of the *.spv and *.iface files in the two
 *     shader folders (the game's translated ones and our own). One directory listing each, no file is read: the
 *     shader build writes thousands of files and hashing their contents at every start would cost more than the
 *     cache saves on a warm run. A rebuilt shader has a new time even when its bytes are the same; then the files
 *     go although they were still good, which costs one run of first-time builds.
 * Another GPU or driver, or no stamp: the cache and the journal are deleted before either is read. Only the
 * shaders changed: both are kept and the journal's pipelines are built again at start (decision 0070). The cache file's
 * own header (Vulkan's VkPipelineCacheHeaderVersionOne: the same three values) is checked as well before it is
 * handed to the driver, so a damaged or foreign file is never loaded; the specification asks applications to do
 * this themselves and not to rely on the driver. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#undef GPTR  /* windows.h's; hle.h (through gpu_internal.h) has its own */
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#endif

#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"

static VkPipelineCache cache;
static char path[1024];
static char journal_path[1024];  /* "" off */
static uint64_t builds, saved_builds;
static HostLock save_lock;

VkPipelineCache gpu_pcache(void) { return cache; }

void gpu_pcache_built(void) { __atomic_add_fetch(&builds, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

static void save(void) {
    if (!cache) return;
    host_lock(&save_lock);
    uint64_t now = __atomic_load_n(&builds, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (now != saved_builds) {
        size_t n = 0;
        void *data = NULL;
        if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(vk.device, cache, &n, NULL) == VK_SUCCESS && n && (data = malloc(n)) &&
            vkGetPipelineCacheData(vk.device, cache, &n, data) == VK_SUCCESS) {
            char tmp[1040];
            snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp", path);
            FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "wb");
            if (f && fwrite(data, 1, n, f) == n && fclose(f) == 0) {
                remove(path);
                if (rename(tmp, path) == 0) saved_builds = now;
            } else if (f) {
                fclose(f);
            }
        }
        free(data);
    }
    host_unlock(&save_lock);
}

static void saver(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    for (;;) {
        host_sleep_ns(10000000000ll);
        save();
    }
}

static void at_exit(void) { save(); }

static uint64_t fnv(uint64_t h, const void *data, size_t n) {
    const unsigned char *p = data;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) h = (h ^ p[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
    return h;
}

static int shader_name(const char *name) {
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    return (n > 4 && !strcmp(name + n - 4, ".spv")) || (n > 6 && !strcmp(name + n - 6, ".iface"));
}

/* One number for the shader files in `dir`: each file's name, size and modification time hashed, the hashes
 * added up (so the order the system lists them in doesn't matter). 0 for no folder or no shaders. */
static uint64_t folder_stamp(const char *dir) {
    uint64_t sum = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    char pattern[1100];
    snprintf(pattern, sizeof pattern, "%s\\*", dir);
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;  /* the listing carries size and time: no call per file */
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pattern, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    do {
        if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY || !shader_name(fd.cFileName)) continue;
        uint64_t v[2] = {(uint64_t)fd.nFileSizeHigh << 32 | fd.nFileSizeLow,
                         (uint64_t)fd.ftLastWriteTime.dwHighDateTime << 32 | fd.ftLastWriteTime.dwLowDateTime};
        sum += fnv(fnv(1469598103934665603ull, fd.cFileName, strlen(fd.cFileName)), v, sizeof v);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
#else
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return 0;
    for (struct dirent *e; (e = readdir(d)) != NULL;) {
        if (!shader_name(e->d_name)) continue;
        struct stat st;
        if (fstatat(dirfd(d), e->d_name, &st, 0) || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) continue;
        uint64_t v[2] = {(uint64_t)st.st_size, (uint64_t)st.st_mtim.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)st.st_mtim.tv_nsec};
        sum += fnv(fnv(1469598103934665603ull, e->d_name, strlen(e->d_name)), v, sizeof v);
    }
    closedir(d);
#endif
    return sum;
}

/* What the cache and the journal were made with, as one line of text: the GPU, its driver, the shaders. */
static void stamp_now(char *out, size_t size, const VkPhysicalDeviceProperties *gp) {
    const char *game = getenv("YW4_SHADER_DIR"), *ours = getenv("YW4_NATIVE_SHADER_DIR");
    uint64_t shaders = folder_stamp(game && *game ? game : "work/shaders/glsl") * 31 +
                       folder_stamp(ours && *ours ? ours : "work/build/shaders");
    int n = snprintf(out, size, "YW4PIPES1 gpu %08x:%08x:", (unsigned)gp->vendorID, (unsigned)gp->deviceID);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)VK_UUID_SIZE && (size_t)n < size; i++)
        n += snprintf(out + n, size - (size_t)n, "%02x", gp->pipelineCacheUUID[i]);
    if ((size_t)n < size) snprintf(out + n, size - (size_t)n, " shaders %016" PRIx64, shaders);
}

/* Vulkan's header of a pipeline cache's data (VkPipelineCacheHeaderVersionOne): for this GPU and driver? */
static int header_ok(const void *data, size_t n, const VkPhysicalDeviceProperties *gp) {
    uint32_t h[4];  /* headerSize, headerVersion, vendorID, deviceID; then pipelineCacheUUID */
    if (n < 16 + VK_UUID_SIZE) return 0;
    memcpy(h, data, sizeof h);
    return h[0] == 16 + VK_UUID_SIZE && h[1] == VK_PIPELINE_CACHE_HEADER_VERSION_ONE && h[2] == gp->vendorID &&
           h[3] == gp->deviceID && !memcmp((const char *)data + 16, gp->pipelineCacheUUID, VK_UUID_SIZE);
}

const char *gpu_pcache_journal_path(void) { return *journal_path ? journal_path : NULL; }

void gpu_pcache_init(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_PIPELINE_CACHE"), *j = getenv("YW4_PIPELINE_JOURNAL");
    int cache_on = !(e && !strcmp(e, "none")), journal_on = !(j && !strcmp(j, "none"));
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", cache_on && e && *e ? e : "work/pipelines.cache");
    if (journal_on) snprintf(journal_path, sizeof journal_path, "%s", j && *j ? j : "work/pipelines.journal");
    if (!cache_on && !journal_on) return;
    host_lock_init(&save_lock);
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties gp;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(vk.gpu, &gp);

    /* made with another GPU, driver or set of shaders (or before there was a stamp): both files go */
    char stamp_path[1040], now[160], was[160] = "";
    snprintf(stamp_path, sizeof stamp_path, "%s.stamp", path);
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    stamp_now(now, sizeof now, &gp);
    int64_t stamp_ms = (host_now_ns() - t0) / 1000000;
    FILE *f = fopen(stamp_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        size_t k = fread(was, 1, sizeof was - 1, f);
        was[k] = 0;
        was[strcspn(was, "\r\n")] = 0;
        fclose(f);
    }
    /* Only the shaders changed (a game update): both files stay (decision 0070). The cache's entries are keyed by
     * the shaders' bytes, so the old ones just don't match; the unchanged ones still do. The journal's records name
     * shaders by the game's keys and the pipeline state, which a rebuild doesn't change: at start the prewarm builds
     * them again from the new files in the background, before the game asks for them. A cache that grew past
     * 64 MiB through updates goes (the journal fills it again). */
    const char *now_sh = strstr(now, " shaders "), *was_sh = strstr(was, " shaders ");
    if (strcmp(now, was) != 0 && now_sh && was_sh && now_sh - now == was_sh - was && !strncmp(now, was, (size_t)(now_sh - now))) {
        f = cache_on ? fopen(path, "rb") : NULL;
        long len = 0;
        if (f) fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END), len = ftell(f), fclose(f);
        int too_big = len > 64l << 20;
        if (too_big) remove(path);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pipeline cache%s and journal kept: the shaders changed; the journal's pipelines are "
                "built again in the background at start\n", too_big ? " (over 64 MiB: emptied)" : "");
        if ((f = fopen(stamp_path, "wb")) != NULL) {
            fprintf(f, "%s\n", now);
            fclose(f);
        }
    } else if (strcmp(now, was) != 0) {
        char tmp[1040];
        snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp", path);
        int had = 0;
        if (cache_on) had |= remove(path) == 0, remove(tmp);
        if (journal_on) {
            had |= remove(journal_path) == 0;
            snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.old", journal_path);  /* and the one journal_open set aside, if any */
            remove(tmp);
        }
        if (had)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pipeline cache and journal thrown away: %s\n",
                    *was ? "another GPU, driver or set of shaders than they were made with" : "no stamp beside them");
        if ((f = fopen(stamp_path, "wb")) != NULL) {  /* after the files are gone: a crash in between repeats this */
            fprintf(f, "%s\n", now);
            fclose(f);
        }
    }
    if (stamp_ms >= 20) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pipeline cache: listing the shader folders took %lld ms\n", (long long)stamp_ms);
    if (!cache_on) return;

    size_t n = 0;
    void *data = NULL;
    f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        long len = ftell(f);
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
        if (len > 0 && (data = malloc((size_t)len)) && fread(data, 1, (size_t)len, f) == (size_t)len) n = (size_t)len;
        fclose(f);
    }
    if (n && !header_ok(data, n, &gp)) {
        /* not this GPU's and driver's (or damaged): never handed to the driver; the next save replaces it */
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pipeline cache %s: its header isn't this GPU's and driver's, not loaded\n", path);
        n = 0;
        remove(path);
    }
    VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_CACHE_CREATE_INFO, .initialDataSize = n,
                                    .pInitialData = n ? data : NULL};
    if (vkCreatePipelineCache(vk.device, &ci, NULL, &cache) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        /* a file the driver won't take after all: start empty */
        ci.initialDataSize = 0, ci.pInitialData = NULL;
        n = 0;
        if (vkCreatePipelineCache(vk.device, &ci, NULL, &cache) != VK_SUCCESS) cache = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    free(data);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: pipeline cache %s: %zu KiB loaded\n", cache ? path : "off", n / 1024);
    if (!cache) return;
    atexit(at_exit);
    if (host_thread_start(saver, NULL, 1 << 16)) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: cannot start the pipeline cache saver\n");
}

void gpu_pcache_save(void) { save(); }

```

`runtime/src/gpu_post.c`:

```c
/* Our post-processing passes, the executor side: bloom (decision 0037) and the distance blur (decision 0038).
 * The engine sides and the data: bloom.c, dof.c, post.h.
 *
 * Each runs where its hook's CMD_NATIVE record sits, in place of the engine's draws, with the same quad,
 * viewport, samplers, blend and operations as those (runtime/shaders/bloom*, dof*), so the result is identical.
 * Bloom: the bright pass into the half-size image, each level blurred across and down, the composite onto the
 * scene image the game has bound (s's first colour target), then anti-aliasing as after the game's composite.
 * Distance blur: the scene shrunk into the half-size image, the blur rounds (across, down) between that and its
 * pair, the composite onto the scene by depth (the panel's DISTANCE BLUR setting: half its amount, or none).
 *
 * Check mode (YW4_BLOOM=check, YW4_DOF_PASS=check): the same passes into copies of the images (the scene copied
 * first); after the game's own composite both versions are copied out and compared once the GPU is done
 * (gpu_post_flush). Every 300th frame, or the frames in YW4_BLOOM_CHECK_AT / YW4_DOF_CHECK_AT. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "post.h"

enum { P_BRIGHT, P_BLUR, P_COMPOSITE, P_DOF_COPY, P_DOF_BLUR, P_DOF_COMPOSITE, PASSES };
enum { BLEND_NONE, BLEND_BLOOM, BLEND_DOF };
static const struct { const char *vs, *fs; int blend; } programs[PASSES] = {
    {"bloom.vert", "bloom_bright.frag", BLEND_NONE},
    {"bloom.vert", "bloom_blur.frag", BLEND_NONE},
    {"bloom.vert", "bloom_composite.frag", BLEND_BLOOM},  /* colour + scene x (1 - alpha), the scene's alpha kept */
    {"dof.vert", "dof_copy.frag", BLEND_NONE},
    {"dof.vert", "dof_blur.frag", BLEND_NONE},
    {"dof.vert", "dof_composite.frag", BLEND_DOF},  /* colour x alpha + scene x (1 - alpha), our alpha written */
};
enum { PUSH = 128 };

static VkDescriptorSetLayout set_layout;
static VkPipelineLayout pipe_layout;
/* The game's samplers for these images (as its draws bind them), made through gpu_sampler so the texture
 * filtering setting (YW4_ANISO) changes ours as it changes the game's: the colour images' (min filter 3, mag 1,
 * clamped, levels 0-15) and the distance blur's depth (min 2, mag 0). */
static const NvnSamplerDesc color_sampler = {.min_filter = 3, .mag_filter = 1, .wrap = {7, 7, 7}, .compare_func = 8,
                                             .lod_min = 0.0f, .lod_max = 15.0f, .max_aniso = 1.0f};
static const NvnSamplerDesc depth_sampler = {.min_filter = 2, .mag_filter = 0, .wrap = {7, 7, 7}, .compare_func = 8,
                                             .lod_min = 0.0f, .lod_max = 15.0f, .max_aniso = 1.0f};

static void layouts(void) {
    if (set_layout) return;
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[3];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        b[i] = (VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding){i, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
                                              NULL};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .bindingCount = 3,
                                           .pBindings = b};
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &set_layout));
    VkPushConstantRange pc = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, PUSH};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
                                      .pSetLayouts = &set_layout, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pc};
    CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(vk.device, &pli, NULL, &pipe_layout));
}

static VkShaderModule shader(const char *name) {
    enum { MAX = 16 };
    static struct { const char *name; VkShaderModule m; } loaded[MAX];
    static int n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(loaded[i].name, name)) return loaded[i].m;
    if (n == MAX) gpu_stop("post-processing: too many shaders");
    loaded[n].name = name, loaded[n].m = gpu_native_shader(name);
    return loaded[n++].m;
}

static VkPipeline pipeline(int pass, VkFormat out) {
    enum { MAX = 32 };
    static struct { int pass; VkFormat out; VkPipeline pipe; } pipes[MAX];
    static int n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (pipes[i].pass == pass && pipes[i].out == out) return pipes[i].pipe;
    if (n == MAX) gpu_stop("post-processing: too many pipelines");
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo st[2] = {
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT,
         .module = shader(programs[pass].vs), .pName = "main"},
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
         .module = shader(programs[pass].fs), .pName = "main"}};
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo ia = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                 .topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST};
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                            .viewportCount = 1, .scissorCount = 1};
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rs = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                 .polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL, .cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE,
                                                 .lineWidth = 1.0f};
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT};
    VkPipelineDepthStencilStateCreateInfo ds = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DEPTH_STENCIL_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    int blend = programs[pass].blend;
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState cba = {.blendEnable = (VkBool32)(blend != BLEND_NONE),
                                               .colorBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD, .alphaBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD,
                                               .colorWriteMask = 0xF};
    if (blend == BLEND_BLOOM) {
        cba.srcColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE, cba.dstColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
        cba.srcAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ZERO, cba.dstAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE;
    } else if (blend == BLEND_DOF) {
        cba.srcColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA, cba.dstColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
        cba.srcAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE, cba.dstAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ZERO;
    }
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo cbs = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .attachmentCount = 1, .pAttachments = &cba};
    static const VkDynamicState dyn[] = {VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR};
    VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo dy = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                           .dynamicStateCount = 2, .pDynamicStates = dyn};
    VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO,
                                        .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachmentFormats = &out};
    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &ri, .stageCount = 2, .pStages = st,
        .pVertexInputState = &vi, .pInputAssemblyState = &ia, .pViewportState = &vp, .pRasterizationState = &rs,
        .pMultisampleState = &ms, .pDepthStencilState = &ds, .pColorBlendState = &cbs, .pDynamicState = &dy,
        .layout = pipe_layout};
    CHECK(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(vk.device, gpu_pcache(), 1, &pci, NULL, &pipes[n].pipe));
    pipes[n].pass = pass, pipes[n].out = out;
    return pipes[n++].pipe;
}

/* Where a pass draws: a view, its format and size, and the game's size of the image (for the viewport). */
typedef struct {
    VkImageView view;
    VkFormat format;
    uint32_t w, h;
    const GpuImage *g;  /* the game's image (its scale and width factor) */
} Dest;

/* One full-screen pass reading `in` (sampler per input: NULL = the colour images'). The viewport as
 * gpu_dynamic_state makes the game's (its 0, 0, width, height scaled like the image, flipped for the
 * upper-left origin), so the quad covers the same pixels the same way. */
static void pass(VkCommandBuffer cb, int p, const Dest *d, const VkImageView *in, int nin,
                 const NvnSamplerDesc *const *samplers, const float push[PUSH / 4]) {
    VkDescriptorSet set = gpu_alloc_set(set_layout);
    VkDescriptorImageInfo ii[3];
    VkWriteDescriptorSet wr[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        int k = i < nin ? i : 0;
        const NvnSamplerDesc *sd = samplers && samplers[k] ? samplers[k] : &color_sampler;
        ii[i] = (VkDescriptorImageInfo){gpu_sampler(sd), in[k], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL};
        wr[i] = (VkWriteDescriptorSet){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = set,
                                       .dstBinding = (uint32_t)i, .descriptorCount = 1,
                                       .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, .pImageInfo = &ii[i]};
    }
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(vk.device, 3, wr, 0, NULL);
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO, .imageView = d->view,
                                    .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD,
                                    .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE};
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, {d->w, d->h}},
                          .layerCount = 1, .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachments = &ca};
    vkCmdBeginRendering(cb, &ri);
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline(p, d->format));
    vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipe_layout, 0, 1, &set, 0, NULL);
    int64_t kn = d->g->scale_num, kd = d->g->scale_den, xn = kn * d->g->wide_num, xd = kd * d->g->wide_den;
    float kf = (float)kn / (float)kd, xf = (float)xn / (float)xd;
    float vw = (float)d->g->key.width * xf, vh = (float)d->g->key.height * kf;
    int flip = nvn_window_origin == 1;
    VkViewport vpt = {0.0f, flip ? vh : 0.0f, vw, flip ? -vh : vh, 0.0f, 1.0f};
    VkRect2D sc = {{0, 0}, {d->w, d->h}};
    vkCmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vpt);
    vkCmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    vkCmdPushConstants(cb, pipe_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, PUSH, push);
    vkCmdDraw(cb, 6, 1, 0, 0);
    vkCmdEndRendering(cb);
    full_barrier(cb);
}

/* ---- check mode: our results in copies, compared with the game's */

typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    VkImageView view;
    VkFormat format;
    uint32_t w, h;
} Copy;

static void copy_make(Copy *c, const GpuImage *g) {
    if (c->image && c->format == g->format && c->w == g->width && c->h == g->height) return;
    if (c->image) {
        gpu_wait(gpu_submitted(), UINT64_MAX);
        vkDestroyImageView(vk.device, c->view, NULL), vkDestroyImage(vk.device, c->image, NULL);
        vkFreeMemory(vk.device, c->mem, NULL);
    }
    VkImageCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                             .format = g->format, .extent = {g->width, g->height, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1,
                             .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                             .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT |
                                      VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    CHECK(vkCreateImage(vk.device, &ici, NULL, &c->image));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(vk.device, c->image, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)};
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &c->mem));
    CHECK(vkBindImageMemory(vk.device, c->image, c->mem, 0));
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = c->image,
                                 .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = g->format,
                                 .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    CHECK(vkCreateImageView(vk.device, &vci, NULL, &c->view));
    c->format = g->format, c->w = g->width, c->h = g->height;
}

static void image_copy(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage from, VkImage to, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    VkImageCopy r = {.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                     .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .extent = {w, h, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImage(cb, from, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, to, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &r);
}

static uint32_t texel_bytes(VkFormat f) {
    return f == VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT ? 8 : f == VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT ? 16 : 4;
}

enum { CHECK_MAX = 8 };
typedef struct {
    const char *name, *env;      /* for the log line; the variable with the frames to check */
    int n;
    const char *image[CHECK_MAX];
    int open;                    /* our copies are drawn, waiting for the game's composite */
    uint64_t frame;
    Copy ours[CHECK_MAX];
    NvnTexture game[CHECK_MAX];  /* the game's images, compared with ours */
    VkBuffer buf[2][CHECK_MAX];  /* ours, the game's, read back */
    VkDeviceMemory mem[2][CHECK_MAX];
    uint32_t bytes[CHECK_MAX];
    int pending;
    uint64_t at[16];
    int nat;                     /* -1: the frames not read yet */
} Check;

static Check bloom_chk = {"bloom", "YW4_BLOOM_CHECK_AT", 8,
                          {"bright", "level 0 across", "level 0", "level 1 across", "level 1", "level 2 across",
                           "level 2", "scene"}, .nat = -1};
static Check dof_chk = {"distance blur", "YW4_DOF_CHECK_AT", 3, {"half", "half across", "scene"}, .nat = -1};
static Check blur_chk = {"blur rounds", "YW4_BLUR_CHECK_AT", 2, {"a", "b"}, .nat = -1};

static int check_now(Check *k) {
    if (k->open || k->pending) return 0;
    if (k->nat < 0) {
        k->nat = 0;
        for (const char *e = getenv(k->env); e && *e && k->nat < 16; e += strcspn(e, ","), e += *e == ',')
            k->at[k->nat++] = strtoull(e, NULL, 10);
    }
    uint64_t frame = gpu_frames();
    if (!k->nat) return frame % 300 == 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k->nat; i++)
        if (k->at[i] == frame) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* After the game's own pass: copy both versions of every image out. */
static void check_copy_out(Check *k, VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (!k->open) return;
    k->open = 0;
    full_barrier(cb);
    for (int i = 0; i < k->n; i++) {
        GpuImage *g = image_find(&k->game[i]);
        Copy *c = &k->ours[i];
        k->bytes[i] = 0;
        if (!g || g->width != c->w || g->height != c->h) continue;
        k->bytes[i] = c->w * c->h * texel_bytes(c->format);
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = k->bytes[i],
                                      .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
            CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &k->buf[j][i]));
            VkMemoryRequirements mr;
            vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, k->buf[j][i], &mr);
            /* cached, so the CPU's compare reads it at memory speed: uncached reads of the ~300 MB of a 4K check
             * took 13 s and stalled the game (2026-10-28) */
            VkMemoryPropertyFlags host = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT;
            uint32_t type = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, host | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT);
            if (type == UINT32_MAX) type = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, host);
            VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                        .memoryTypeIndex = type};
            CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &k->mem[j][i]));
            CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, k->buf[j][i], k->mem[j][i], 0));
            VkBufferImageCopy r = {.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .imageExtent = {c->w, c->h, 1}};
            vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, j ? g->image : c->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, k->buf[j][i], 1, &r);
        }
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    k->pending = 1;
}

static void check_flush(Check *k) {
    if (!k->pending) return;
    k->pending = 0;
    char line[512];
    int at = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "yw4: %s: check frame %" PRIu64 ":", k->name, k->frame);
    for (int i = 0; i < k->n; i++) {
        if (!k->bytes[i]) {
            at += snprintf(line + at, sizeof line - (size_t)at, " %s not compared;", k->image[i]);
            continue;
        }
        const uint8_t *a, *b;
        CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, k->mem[0][i], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&a));
        CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, k->mem[1][i], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&b));
        uint32_t tb = texel_bytes(k->ours[i].format), n = k->bytes[i] / tb, bad = 0;
        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < n; t++) bad += memcmp(a + (size_t)t * tb, b + (size_t)t * tb, tb) != 0;
        at += snprintf(line + at, sizeof line - (size_t)at, " %s %u of %u differ;", k->image[i], bad, n);
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            vkUnmapMemory(vk.device, k->mem[j][i]);
            vkDestroyBuffer(vk.device, k->buf[j][i], NULL), vkFreeMemory(vk.device, k->mem[j][i], NULL);
        }
        if (at >= (int)sizeof line - 64) break;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line);
}

int gpu_post_pending(void) { return bloom_chk.pending || dof_chk.pending || blur_chk.pending; }

void gpu_post_flush(void) { check_flush(&bloom_chk), check_flush(&dof_chk), check_flush(&blur_chk); }

/* An image the record names: made, and a view to sample it. NULL if not. */
static GpuImage *record_image(VkCommandBuffer cb, NvnTexture *t, VkImageView *sample) {
    GpuImage *g = image_of(cb, t);
    *sample = g ? gpu_sample_view(cb, t, NULL, 0, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D) : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return *sample ? g : NULL;
}

/* ---- bloom */

void gpu_bloom_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cb;
    GpuState *s = gpu_state;
    BloomPass p;
    if (size < sizeof p) return;
    memcpy(&p, data, sizeof p);
    if (p.check && !check_now(&bloom_chk)) return;
    NvnTexture *scene_t = s->ncolor ? s->rt.color[0] : NULL;
    if (!scene_t) {
        static int logged;
        if (!logged++) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: bloom: no scene target bound at our pass\n");
        return;
    }
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    layouts();
    GpuImage *g[BLOOM_IMAGES];
    VkImageView sv[BLOOM_IMAGES];
    for (int i = 0; i < BLOOM_IMAGES; i++)
        if (!(g[i] = record_image(cb, &p.tex[i], &sv[i]))) return;
    GpuImage *sg = image_of(cb, scene_t);
    uint32_t sw, sh;
    VkImageView scene_rv = gpu_render_view(cb, scene_t, &s->rt.views[0], s->rt.has_view[0], &sw, &sh);
    if (!sg || !scene_rv) return;
    const NvnTextureView *v = &s->rt.views[0];  /* the format the scene renders in (as begin_rendering) */
    VkFormat scene_fmt = s->rt.has_view[0] && v->setmask & 4 ? gpu_format(v->format) : sg->format;
    /* where each pass draws, and what the next one reads: the game's images, or in check mode our copies */
    Dest dst[BLOOM_IMAGES], scene = {scene_rv, scene_fmt, sw, sh, sg};
    VkImageView rd[BLOOM_IMAGES];
    for (int i = 0; i < BLOOM_IMAGES; i++) rd[i] = sv[i];
    for (int i = BLOOM_BRIGHT; i < BLOOM_IMAGES; i++) {
        uint32_t w, h;
        VkImageView rv = gpu_render_view(cb, &p.tex[i], NULL, 0, &w, &h);
        dst[i] = (Dest){rv, g[i]->format, w, h, g[i]};
        if (p.check) {
            Copy *c = &bloom_chk.ours[i - BLOOM_BRIGHT];
            copy_make(c, g[i]);
            dst[i].view = rd[i] = c->view;
        }
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    if (p.check) {
        Copy *c = &bloom_chk.ours[bloom_chk.n - 1];
        copy_make(c, sg);
        image_copy(cb, sg->image, c->image, sg->width, sg->height);
        full_barrier(cb);
        scene.view = c->view, scene.format = sg->format;
    }
    float push[PUSH / 4];
    memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
    memcpy(push, p.bright, sizeof p.bright);
    gpu_passes_other(cb, "our bloom: bright pass and blur", 0);  /* the per-pass timer (F5) */
    VkImageView in[3] = {rd[BLOOM_IN_SCENE], rd[BLOOM_IN_HALF]};
    pass(cb, P_BRIGHT, &dst[BLOOM_BRIGHT], in, 2, NULL, push);
    static const float weights[4] = {0.15021657943725586f, 0.13866737484931946f, 0.1181645467877388f,
                                     0.09295152127742767f};
    int src = BLOOM_BRIGHT;
    for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++) {
        int across = BLOOM_L0_ACROSS + 2 * l, down = across + 1;
        memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
        memcpy(push + 4, weights, sizeof weights);
        push[12] = 1.0f;  /* blur taps */
        push[0] = p.step[l] / (float)p.tex[across].width;
        in[0] = rd[src];
        pass(cb, P_BLUR, &dst[across], in, 1, NULL, push);
        push[0] = 0.0f, push[1] = p.step[l] / (float)p.tex[across].height;
        in[0] = rd[across];
        pass(cb, P_BLUR, &dst[down], in, 1, NULL, push);
        src = down;
    }
    memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
    memcpy(push, p.composite, sizeof p.composite);
    VkImageView lv[3] = {rd[BLOOM_L0], rd[BLOOM_L1], rd[BLOOM_L2]};
    gpu_passes_other(cb, "our bloom: composite", 0);
    pass(cb, P_COMPOSITE, &scene, lv, 3, NULL, push);
    gpu_passes_targets(cb, s);  /* what follows is the game's again */
    gpu_dynamic_forget();  /* our pipelines set viewport and scissor: the game's next draw sets its own again */
    if (p.check) {
        bloom_chk.open = 1, bloom_chk.frame = gpu_frames();
        for (int i = BLOOM_BRIGHT; i < BLOOM_IMAGES; i++) bloom_chk.game[i - BLOOM_BRIGHT] = p.tex[i];
        bloom_chk.game[bloom_chk.n - 1] = *scene_t;
        return;
    }
    s->after_composite = 1;
    gpu_aa_apply(cb, s);  /* anti-aliasing, upscaling, SHARPENING: it returns at once when none is on */
}

void gpu_bloom_after_composite(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state) {
    (void)gpu_state;
    check_copy_out(&bloom_chk, vk_cb);
}

/* ---- distance blur */

/* The camera's far distance as the game's composite reads it: row 3 .y of the camera block (fragment constant
 * buffer 8) the game has bound, else the renderer's. */
static float camera_far(const GpuState *s, float fallback) {
    const GpuRange *r = &s->ubo[1][8];  /* stage 1: the fragment stage (gpu_draw.c nvn_stage) */
    return r->addr && r->size >= 56 ? *(const float *)(uintptr_t)(r->addr + 52) : fallback;
}

void gpu_dof_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cb;
    GpuState *s = gpu_state;
    DofPass p;
    if (size < sizeof p) return;
    memcpy(&p, data, sizeof p);
    int mode = gpu_dof();  /* the panel's DISTANCE BLUR: 0 off (no composite), 1 half its amount, 2 the game's */
    if (p.check && (!mode || !check_now(&dof_chk))) return;
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    layouts();
    /* with full-size effects these keep the game's size ratio, as when the game's own draws are seen (gpu_draw.c) */
    gpu_keep_game_ratio(&p.tex[DOF_A]), gpu_keep_game_ratio(&p.tex[DOF_B]);
    GpuImage *g[DOF_IMAGES];
    VkImageView sv[DOF_IMAGES];
    for (int i = 0; i < DOF_IMAGES; i++)
        if (!(g[i] = record_image(cb, &p.tex[i], &sv[i]))) return;
    Dest dst[DOF_IMAGES];
    VkImageView rd[DOF_IMAGES];
    for (int i = 0; i < DOF_IMAGES; i++) {
        uint32_t w = 0, h = 0;
        VkImageView rv = i == DOF_DEPTH ? VK_NULL_HANDLE : gpu_render_view(cb, &p.tex[i], NULL, 0, &w, &h);
        dst[i] = (Dest){rv, g[i]->format, w, h, g[i]};
        rd[i] = sv[i];
    }
    if (p.check) {  /* copies of the two half-size images and of the scene (copied first: the composite blends) */
        static const int img[3] = {DOF_A, DOF_B, DOF_SCENE};
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            Copy *c = &dof_chk.ours[k];
            copy_make(c, g[img[k]]);
            dst[img[k]].view = c->view;
            if (img[k] != DOF_SCENE) rd[img[k]] = c->view;
        }
        full_barrier(cb);
        image_copy(cb, g[DOF_SCENE]->image, dof_chk.ours[2].image, g[DOF_SCENE]->width, g[DOF_SCENE]->height);
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    float push[PUSH / 4];
    memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
    gpu_passes_other(cb, "our distance blur: shrink and blur", 0);
    VkImageView in[2] = {rd[DOF_SCENE]};
    pass(cb, P_DOF_COPY, &dst[DOF_A], in, 1, NULL, push);
    memcpy(push + 12, p.weights, sizeof p.weights);
    push[20] = 1.0f;  /* blur taps */
    for (uint32_t r = 0; r < p.rounds; r++) {
        push[8] = p.spread / (float)p.tex[DOF_A].width, push[9] = 0.0f;
        in[0] = rd[DOF_A];
        pass(cb, P_DOF_BLUR, &dst[DOF_B], in, 1, NULL, push);
        push[8] = 0.0f, push[9] = p.spread / (float)p.tex[DOF_A].height;
        in[0] = rd[DOF_B];
        pass(cb, P_DOF_BLUR, &dst[DOF_A], in, 1, NULL, push);
    }
    if (mode) {
        memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
        memcpy(push, p.focus, sizeof p.focus);
        if (mode == 1) push[3] *= 0.5f;  /* half the amount (the game's draws get the same in gpu_draw.c) */
        push[8] = p.texel[0], push[9] = p.texel[1];
        push[20] = 2.0f, push[21] = camera_far(s, p.far);
        VkImageView cv[2] = {rd[DOF_A], rd[DOF_DEPTH]};
        const NvnSamplerDesc *samp[2] = {&color_sampler, &depth_sampler};
        gpu_passes_other(cb, "our distance blur: composite", 0);
        pass(cb, P_DOF_COMPOSITE, &dst[DOF_SCENE], cv, 2, samp, push);
    }
    gpu_passes_targets(cb, s);
    gpu_dynamic_forget();
    if (p.check) {
        dof_chk.open = 1, dof_chk.frame = gpu_frames();
        dof_chk.game[0] = p.tex[DOF_A], dof_chk.game[1] = p.tex[DOF_B], dof_chk.game[2] = p.tex[DOF_SCENE];
    }
}

void gpu_dof_after_composite(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state) {
    (void)gpu_state;
    check_copy_out(&dof_chk, vk_cb);
}

/* ---- the engine's shared blur rounds (dof.c yw4_hook_blur) */

void gpu_blur_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cb;
    GpuState *s = gpu_state;
    BlurPass p;
    if (size < sizeof p) return;
    memcpy(&p, data, sizeof p);
    if (p.check && !check_now(&blur_chk)) return;
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    layouts();
    NvnTexture *t[2] = {&p.a, &p.b};
    GpuImage *g[2];
    VkImageView rd[2];
    Dest dst[2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (!(g[i] = record_image(cb, t[i], &rd[i]))) return;
        uint32_t w, h;
        VkImageView rv = gpu_render_view(cb, t[i], NULL, 0, &w, &h);
        dst[i] = (Dest){rv, g[i]->format, w, h, g[i]};
    }
    if (p.check) {  /* our rounds on copies of both, starting from the same images */
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Copy *c = &blur_chk.ours[i];
            copy_make(c, g[i]);
            full_barrier(cb);
            image_copy(cb, g[i]->image, c->image, g[i]->width, g[i]->height);
            dst[i].view = rd[i] = c->view;
        }
    }
    full_barrier(cb);
    /* YW4_BLUR_FAST=1: blurs add up (their widths squared), so n rounds equal one sqrt(n) times as wide; a
     * quarter of the rounds (at least 1) with the taps sqrt(n / m) times as far apart give the same total width
     * for a quarter of the passes. Not identical (the 8-tap kernel's ends are cut differently); not in check mode. */
    if (blur_fast() && !p.check && p.rounds > 2) {
        uint32_t m = (p.rounds + 3) / 4;
        float k = sqrtf((float)p.rounds / (float)m);
        p.step[0] *= k, p.step[1] *= k, p.rounds = m;
    }
    gpu_passes_other(cb, "our blur rounds", 0);
    float push[PUSH / 4];
    memset(push, 0, sizeof push);
    memcpy(push + 12, p.weights, sizeof p.weights);
    push[20] = 1.0f;  /* blur taps */
    VkImageView in[1];
    for (uint32_t r = 0; r < p.rounds; r++) {
        push[8] = p.step[0], push[9] = 0.0f;
        in[0] = rd[0];
        pass(cb, P_DOF_BLUR, &dst[1], in, 1, NULL, push);
        push[8] = 0.0f, push[9] = p.step[1];
        in[0] = rd[1];
        pass(cb, P_DOF_BLUR, &dst[0], in, 1, NULL, push);
    }
    gpu_passes_targets(cb, s);
    gpu_dynamic_forget();
    if (p.check) {
        blur_chk.open = 1, blur_chk.frame = gpu_frames();
        blur_chk.game[0] = p.a, blur_chk.game[1] = p.b;
    }
}

void gpu_blur_check_end(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    (void)data, (void)size;
    gpu_end_rendering(vk_cb, gpu_state);
    check_copy_out(&blur_chk, vk_cb);
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_query.c`:

```c
/* The game's occlusion queries, and the draws it makes conditional on them (decision 0072).
 *
 * What the game does (measured, YW4_COUNTER_LOG): before each shadow cascade and before the main view
 * it draws one 36-vertex box per object into a 240x135 depth-only target, each between two
 * ReportCounter(SAMPLES_PASSED) calls that write to addresses 16 bytes apart (two NVNcounterData
 * {u64 value, u64 timestamp}). Later in the same frame its model renderer (f_a45890) wraps that
 * object's draws in SetRenderEnableConditional(RENDER_IF_NOT_EQUAL, first address): the GPU itself
 * compares the two values and skips the draws when they are equal, i.e. when no sample of the box
 * passed. The CPU never has to read the counts, so the answer is needed on the GPU within the frame.
 *
 * Here: a pair of reports becomes one Vulkan occlusion query around the draws between them. NVN's
 * counter runs on; ours writes 0 as the first value and the query's count as the second, so the
 * difference (all anyone uses) is right. The count goes into the game's own memory on the GPU
 * (vkCmdCopyQueryPoolResults into the imported pool, decision 0021): no wait, no read-back. The
 * conditional draws use VK_EXT_conditional_rendering on the second value (its low 32 bits: is it 0?),
 * around each single draw, so nothing of ours (passes of our renderer, copies, upscaling) falls
 * under a condition by accident.
 *
 * Vulkan's rules that shape this: a query begun inside a render pass ends inside the same one, and
 * resets and result copies happen outside. So the query begins at the first draw after the first
 * report (rendering is on by then), results are copied when rendering next ends, and queries are
 * reset a block at a time. When a pass ends inside a pair and more draws follow (not seen), the
 * answer is "visible". Without the extension, or for an address no pair of ours wrote, the draws
 * are simply made, as before.
 *
 * All of it runs on the thread that records a submission, gpu_lock held. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"

/* BLOCK: queries reset at a time, each reset outside rendering (the render pass ends, a barrier, then it starts
 * again). 64 meant ~7 such breaks a frame (~110 boxes before each of three cascades and the main view); 512 is about
 * one (2026-11-18, the GPU-time bench). The pool still holds ~9 frames of queries, so a block is reset long after its
 * last results were copied. */
enum { QUERIES = 4096, BLOCK = 512, PENDING = 256, KNOWN = 8192 };
enum { PAIR_NONE, PAIR_WAITING, PAIR_COUNTING, PAIR_CLOSED };  /* waiting: for its first draw; closed: by a pass's end */
enum { RESULT_COUNT, RESULT_ZERO, RESULT_VISIBLE };

static VkQueryPool pool;
static int pool_state;  /* 0 not tried, 1 made, -1 none */
static uint32_t next_query, fresh;  /* fresh: reset queries left in the current block */
static struct {
    uint64_t begin;  /* the first report's address */
    uint32_t query;
    int state, lost;  /* lost: draws came after the query had to end */
    int draws;
} pair;
static struct {
    uint64_t addr;
    uint32_t query;
    int kind;
} pending[PENDING];  /* second values to write, once rendering has ended */
static int npending;
static uint64_t known[KNOWN];  /* first addresses of the pairs we wrote: what a condition may name */
static int cond_open;

/* YW4_OCCLUSION=0: the counts stay real, but the game's conditional draws are all made.
 * YW4_OCCLUSION=off: no queries at all, as before 2026-11-14: each SAMPLES_PASSED report writes 0 by hand and
 * every conditional draw is made. No query, result copy or conditional rendering reaches the GPU (issue #14: a
 * GPU hang on Intel HD 520 / Mesa, to tell whether this code is the cause). */
static int occ_mode = -1;  /* 2 on, 1 counts only (=0), 0 off */
static int occlusion_mode(void) {
    if (occ_mode < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_OCCLUSION");
        occ_mode = !e ? 2 : !strcmp(e, "off") ? 0 : *e == '0' ? 1 : 2;
        if (!occ_mode)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: occlusion queries: off (YW4_OCCLUSION=off), conditional draws always drawn\n");
        else
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: occlusion queries: %s counts, conditional draws %s\n",
                    vk.occlusion_precise ? "exact" : "zero-or-not",
                    !vk.conditional_rendering ? "always drawn (no VK_EXT_conditional_rendering)"
                    : occ_mode == 2 ? "skipped on the GPU when hidden" : "always drawn (YW4_OCCLUSION=0)");
    }
    return occ_mode;
}
static int cull_on(void) { return occlusion_mode() == 2 && vk.conditional_rendering; }

/* ---- YW4_COUNTER_LOG=<from>-<to>: in those GPU frames, one line per pair and per condition, and a
 * summary per frame. A count shown is what the game's memory holds at that moment: the GPU writes it
 * later, so it is usually the count of an earlier frame at the same address. */
static uint64_t log_from, log_to;
static struct {
    uint64_t frame;
    int pairs, conds, cond_draws, cond_draws_zero, cond_unknown;
} tally;
static int log_on(void) {
    static int read;
    if (!read) {
        read = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_COUNTER_LOG");
        if (e) sscanf(e, "%" SCNu64 "-%" SCNu64, &log_from, &log_to);
    }
    if (!log_to) return 0;
    uint64_t f = gpu_frames();
    if (tally.frame != f) {
        if (tally.pairs || tally.conds)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: counter: frame %" PRIu64 ": %d query pairs, %d conditions, %d draws under a condition"
                    " (%d with a count of 0 in memory, %d with an address no pair wrote)\n", tally.frame, tally.pairs,
                    tally.conds, tally.cond_draws, tally.cond_draws_zero, tally.cond_unknown);
        memset(&tally, 0, sizeof tally);
        tally.frame = f;
    }
    return f >= log_from && f <= log_to;
}
static uint64_t count_in_memory(uint64_t begin) {
    const uint64_t *v = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)begin;
    return v[2] - v[0];
}

static int known_slot(uint64_t addr) {
    unsigned i = (unsigned)((addr >> 4) * 0x9E3779B1u) % KNOWN;
    for (int n = 0; n < 64; n++, i = (i + 1) % KNOWN)
        if (known[i] == addr || !known[i]) return (int)i;
    return -1;
}

static int have_pool(void) {
    if (!pool_state) {
        VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                    .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_OCCLUSION, .queryCount = QUERIES};
        pool_state = vkCreateQueryPool(vk.device, &qi, NULL, &pool) == VK_SUCCESS ? 1 : -1;
        if (pool_state < 0) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: no occlusion query pool: every query answers \"visible\"\n");
    }
    return pool_state > 0;
}

/* Writes the second values that are due. Outside rendering only. */
static void flush(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    for (int i = 0; i < npending; i++) {
        VkBuffer buf;
        VkDeviceSize off;
        uint64_t addr = pending[i].addr;
        if (!gpu_buffer_at(addr, 8, &buf, &off) || off & 7) {  /* not in a pool (not seen): by hand, "visible" */
            *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)addr = pending[i].kind != RESULT_ZERO;
            continue;
        }
        if (pending[i].kind == RESULT_COUNT) {
            vkCmdCopyQueryPoolResults(cb, pool, pending[i].query, 1, buf, off, 8,
                                      VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT | VK_QUERY_RESULT_WAIT_BIT);
```
