```c
        } else {
            vkCmdFillBuffer(cb, buf, off, 4, pending[i].kind == RESULT_VISIBLE);
            vkCmdFillBuffer(cb, buf, off + 4, 4, 0);
        }
    }
    npending = 0;
}

void gpu_query_rendering_ends(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (pair.state != PAIR_COUNTING) return;
    vkCmdEndQuery(cb, pool, pair.query);
    pair.state = PAIR_CLOSED, pair.lost = 0;
}

void gpu_query_rendering_ended(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (npending) flush(cb);
}

void gpu_query_flush(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s) {
    if (!npending) return;
    if (s->rendering) {
        gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);  /* flushes, then its barrier */
    } else {
        flush(cb);
        full_barrier(cb);
    }
}

static void pair_abandon(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (pair.state == PAIR_COUNTING) vkCmdEndQuery(cb, pool, pair.query);
    if (pair.state) {
        static int logged;
        if (!logged++)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: a SAMPLES_PASSED report at %#" PRIx64 " without its second one 16 bytes on: "
                    "that count stays 0 (logged once)\n", pair.begin);
    }
    pair.state = PAIR_NONE;
}

void gpu_query_report(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, uint64_t addr) {
    if (!occlusion_mode()) {  /* off: no pair is ever made, so no condition is ever "known" */
        *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)addr = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (pair.state && addr == pair.begin + 16) {  /* the pair's second report */
        int kind = RESULT_COUNT;
        if (pair.state == PAIR_COUNTING) vkCmdEndQuery(cb, pool, pair.query);
        else if (pair.state == PAIR_WAITING) kind = RESULT_ZERO;  /* nothing was drawn between the two */
        else if (pair.lost) kind = RESULT_VISIBLE;
        if (pair.lost) {
            static int logged;
            if (!logged++)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: an occlusion query at %#" PRIx64 " spans two render passes with draws in "
                        "both: answered \"visible\" (logged once)\n", pair.begin);
        }
        if (log_on()) {
            tally.pairs++;
            const NvnTexture *t = s->rt.depth ? s->rt.depth : s->rt.color[0];
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: counter: frame %" PRIu64 ": pair at %#" PRIx64 ", %d draw%s into %ux%u (%d colour, depth "
                    "%#" PRIx64 "), %s; count in memory %" PRIu64 "\n", gpu_frames(), pair.begin, pair.draws,
                    pair.draws == 1 ? "" : "s", t ? t->width : 0, t ? t->height : 0, s->ncolor,
                    s->rt.depth ? s->rt.depth->addr : 0,
                    kind == RESULT_COUNT ? "counted" : kind == RESULT_ZERO ? "nothing drawn: 0" : "visible",
                    count_in_memory(pair.begin));
        }
        if (npending == PENDING) gpu_query_flush(cb, s);
        pending[npending].addr = addr, pending[npending].query = pair.query, pending[npending].kind = kind;
        npending++;
        int k = known_slot(pair.begin);
        if (k >= 0) known[k] = pair.begin;
        pair.state = PAIR_NONE;
        if (s->cond_mode) gpu_query_flush(cb, s);  /* a query under a condition: the next draw may read it */
        return;
    }
    pair_abandon(cb);
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)addr = 0;  /* the first value: the counter starts each pair at 0 */
    pair.begin = addr, pair.draws = 0, pair.lost = 0;
    if (!have_pool()) {
        pair.state = PAIR_CLOSED, pair.lost = 1;  /* answers "visible" */
        return;
    }
    if (!fresh) {  /* the next block of queries, reset: outside rendering */
        gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
        if (next_query >= QUERIES) next_query = 0;
        vkCmdResetQueryPool(cb, pool, next_query, BLOCK);
        fresh = BLOCK;
    }
    pair.query = next_query++, fresh--;
    pair.state = PAIR_WAITING;
}

void gpu_query_render_enable(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, int mode, uint64_t addr) {
    s->cond_mode = mode, s->cond_addr = addr;
    if (!mode) return;
    gpu_query_flush(cb, s);  /* its counts must be in memory before the draws that test them */
    if (log_on()) {
        tally.conds++;
        int k = known_slot(addr);
        if (tally.conds <= 40)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: counter: frame %" PRIu64 ": condition %s at %#" PRIx64 "%s; count in memory %" PRIu64
                    "\n", gpu_frames(), mode == 1 ? "IF_EQUAL" : "IF_NOT_EQUAL", addr,
                    k >= 0 && known[k] == addr ? "" : " (no pair wrote it)", count_in_memory(addr));
    }
}

void gpu_query_before_draw(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s) {
    if (pair.state == PAIR_WAITING) {
        vkCmdBeginQuery(cb, pool, pair.query, vk.occlusion_precise ? VK_QUERY_CONTROL_PRECISE_BIT : 0);
        pair.state = PAIR_COUNTING;
    } else if (pair.state == PAIR_CLOSED) {
        pair.lost = 1;
    }
    if (pair.state) pair.draws++;
    gpu_query_condition(cb, s->cond_mode, s->cond_addr);
}

void gpu_query_condition(VkCommandBuffer cb, int mode, uint64_t addr) {
    if (!mode) return;
    int k = known_slot(addr);
    int is_known = k >= 0 && known[k] == addr;
    if (log_on()) {
        tally.cond_draws++;
        if (!is_known) tally.cond_unknown++;
        else if (!count_in_memory(addr) == (mode == 2)) tally.cond_draws_zero++;
    }
    VkBuffer buf;
    VkDeviceSize off;
    if (!cull_on() || !is_known || !gpu_buffer_at(addr + 16, 4, &buf, &off) || off & 3) return;
    /* IF_NOT_EQUAL: draw when the second value (the count; the first is 0) is not 0 */
    VkConditionalRenderingBeginInfoEXT bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BEGIN_INFO_EXT,
                                             .buffer = buf, .offset = off,
                                             .flags = mode == 1 ? VK_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_INVERTED_BIT_EXT : 0};
    vkCmdBeginConditionalRenderingEXT(cb, &bi);
    cond_open = 1;
}

void gpu_query_after_draw(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (!cond_open) return;
    vkCmdEndConditionalRenderingEXT(cb);
    cond_open = 0;
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_queue.c`:

```c
/* The GPU worker (decision 0029): the game's command lists are translated to Vulkan on a thread
 * of our own, in the order the game submitted them, instead of inside the game's submit call.
 *
 * nvnQueueSubmitCommands used to run gpu_execute on the game's render thread, under gpu_lock,
 * before returning: ~9 ms a frame of our work on the chain the game's frame waits for (the busy
 * towns). Now a submission, a present and the freeing of an object queued work may still use
 * are jobs in one queue, run by one worker in order.
 *
 * Syncs: a fence takes a ticket, the number of jobs queued so far (not a Vulkan submission:
 * the work may not be submitted yet). Waiting for a ticket waits for the worker to have run that
 * job, then for the Vulkan submissions it had made by then to complete. So nothing the game
 * waits for is signalled before its work has been recorded and run.
 *
 * Changing an object queued work reads (a program's shaders) first waits for the queue to
 * empty (gpu_queue_drain); freeing one goes through the queue (gpu_queue_call).
 *
 * YW4_GPU_THREAD=0: everything runs in the caller as before. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "gpu.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "nvn.h"

enum { JOBS = 1024, TICKETS = 4096 };
enum { JOB_EXECUTE, JOB_PRESENT, JOB_CALL };
typedef struct {
    int kind;
    uint64_t a;          /* execute: the command list's handle; present: the frame */
    void *p;             /* present: the texture; call: the argument */
    void (*fn)(void *);  /* call */
    int crop[4];         /* present */
} Job;

static Job jobs[JOBS];
static uint64_t queued, done;        /* tickets: jobs queued, jobs run (job t is jobs[(t - 1) % JOBS]) */
static uint64_t seq_after[TICKETS];  /* the Vulkan submissions made when job t had run */
static HostLock lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static HostCond work = HOST_COND_INIT, progress = HOST_COND_INIT;
static int on = -1;
static void *worker_host;  /* the worker's host thread, for its CPU time in the per-thread report */

static int queue_on(void) {
    int o = __atomic_load_n(&on, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (o >= 0) return o;
    host_lock(&lock);
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_GPU_THREAD");
        yw4_boot_mark("the game's first GPU work (waits here for Vulkan)");
        int v = gpu_ready() && (!e || atoi(e));
        if (v) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: command lists translated on a worker thread (decision 0029)\n");
        __atomic_store_n(&on, v, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
    return on;
}

static void run(const Job *j) {
    switch (j->kind) {
    case JOB_EXECUTE: gpu_execute(j->a); break;
    case JOB_PRESENT: gpu_present((NvnTexture *)j->p, j->a, j->crop); break;
    case JOB_CALL: j->fn(j->p); break;
    }
}

static void worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    host_thread_set_priority(NULL, 39);  /* same priority as guest render workers */
    __atomic_store_n(&worker_host, host_thread_self(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    for (;;) {
        host_lock(&lock);
        while (done == queued) host_cond_wait(&work, &lock, -1);
        Job j = jobs[done % JOBS];
        host_unlock(&lock);
        yw4_profile_thread(YW4_ROLE_SUBMIT, gpu_frames());
        run(&j);
        uint64_t seq = gpu_submitted();
        host_lock(&lock);
        done++;
        seq_after[done % TICKETS] = seq;
        host_cond_broadcast(&progress);
        host_unlock(&lock);
    }
}

static void put(const Job *j) {
    static int started;
    host_lock(&lock);
    if (!started) {
        started = 1;
        if (host_thread_start(worker, NULL, 1 << 20)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: cannot start the GPU worker thread\n");
            yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        }
    }
    while (queued - done >= JOBS) host_cond_wait(&progress, &lock, -1);  /* the worker is far behind */
    jobs[queued % JOBS] = *j;
    queued++;
    host_cond_signal(&work);
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

void gpu_queue_execute(uint64_t handle) {
    if (!queue_on()) {
        gpu_execute(handle);
        return;
    }
    put(&(Job){.kind = JOB_EXECUTE, .a = handle});
}

void gpu_queue_present(NvnTexture *texture, uint64_t frame, const int crop[4]) {
    if (!queue_on()) {
        gpu_present(texture, frame, crop);
        return;
    }
    Job j = {.kind = JOB_PRESENT, .a = frame, .p = texture};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) j.crop[i] = crop[i];
    put(&j);
}

void gpu_queue_call(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg) {
    if (!queue_on()) {
        fn(arg);
        return;
    }
    put(&(Job){.kind = JOB_CALL, .fn = fn, .p = arg});
}

uint64_t gpu_queue_fence(void) {
    if (!queue_on()) return gpu_submitted();
    host_lock(&lock);
    uint64_t t = queued;
    host_unlock(&lock);
    return t;
}

/* 0 already signalled, 1 waited, 2 timed out (NVN's sync results) */
int gpu_queue_wait(uint64_t fence, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    if (!queue_on()) return gpu_wait(fence, timeout_ns);
    if (!fence) return 0;
    int forever = timeout_ns >= (uint64_t)INT64_MAX / 2;
    int64_t start = host_now_ns(), deadline = forever ? 0 : start + (int64_t)timeout_ns;
    int waited = 0;
    host_lock(&lock);
    while (done < fence) {
        int64_t left = forever ? -1 : deadline - host_now_ns();
        if (!forever && left <= 0) {
            host_unlock(&lock);
            return 2;
        }
        waited = 1;
        host_cond_wait(&progress, &lock, left);
    }
    /* the submissions job `fence` had made; a ticket long past: whatever has been submitted */
    uint64_t seq = done - fence < TICKETS ? seq_after[fence % TICKETS] : gpu_submitted();
    host_unlock(&lock);
    uint64_t left = forever ? UINT64_MAX : deadline > host_now_ns() ? (uint64_t)(deadline - host_now_ns()) : 0;
    int r = gpu_wait(seq, left);
    return r == 2 ? 2 : waited || r;
}

/* The worker's CPU time so far (ns), 0 before it starts or with YW4_GPU_THREAD=0. */
int64_t gpu_queue_worker_cpu_ns(void) {
    void *h = __atomic_load_n(&worker_host, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    return h ? host_thread_cpu_ns(h) : 0;
}

void gpu_queue_drain(void) {
    if (!queue_on()) return;
    host_lock(&lock);
    uint64_t t = queued;
    while (done < t) host_cond_wait(&progress, &lock, -1);
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_shadow.c`:

```c
/* Our shadow-caster pass on Vulkan (decision 0024): draws a ShadowPass (shadow.h) into the
 * cascade layer the game's own commands left bound, with our shader
 * runtime/shaders/shadow_static.vert, shadow_cutout.vert/.frag for cut-out casters or
 * shadow_skinned.vert for skinned ones (compiled
 * by recomp/build.py into work/build/shaders, YW4_NATIVE_SHADER_DIR to move it). Depth only;
 * the pipeline state the game's shadow draws use (depth test and write, bias) comes from the
 * executor's state; culling per draw, as the game drew that submesh. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "shadow.h"

/* What our pass left out, for the log (shadow.c's report every 600 frames, the run's summary, a GPU crash): passes
 * (the whole layer's draws: its shadow map no longer bound, or not found again) and single draws, by why. Since the
 * last report, and since the start. The first few of each kind are also logged when they happen, with the frame, so
 * a player's "the shadows flickered at ..." can be matched to one (owner, 2026-11-16: enough in the log for a report). */
static long passes_skipped, draws_skipped[SHADOW_SKIP_N];
static long passes_skipped_total, draws_skipped_total[SHADOW_SKIP_N];
const char *const shadow_skip_name[SHADOW_SKIP_N] = {"other", "vertices not in GPU memory",
                                                     "indices not in GPU memory", "cut-out texture",
                                                     "skin layout", "dither texture", "wind textures"};

void gpu_shadow_counts(long *p, long d[SHADOW_SKIP_N]) {
    *p = __atomic_exchange_n(&passes_skipped, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N; i++) d[i] = __atomic_exchange_n(&draws_skipped[i], 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void gpu_shadow_totals(long *p, long d[SHADOW_SKIP_N]) {
    *p = __atomic_load_n(&passes_skipped_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N; i++) d[i] = __atomic_load_n(&draws_skipped_total[i], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

/* a pass left out: counted, and the first 5 logged */
static void pass_skipped(const ShadowPass *p, const char *why) {
    __atomic_add_fetch(&passes_skipped, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&passes_skipped_total, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (n <= 5)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: our pass for shadow map %#" PRIx64 " layer %u left out at GPU frame %" PRIu64
                " (%u draws): %s%s\n", p->depth_addr, p->depth_layer, gpu_frames(), p->n, why,
                n == 5 ? " (the last one logged; the count goes on in the shadows lines)" : "");
}

/* a draw left out: counted, and the first 3 of each reason logged */
static void draw_skipped(const ShadowDraw *d, int why) {
    __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_skipped[why], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    long n = __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_skipped_total[why], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (n <= 3)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: one of our draws left out at GPU frame %" PRIu64 ": %s (vertices %#" PRIx64
                " x %u, stride %u, indices %#" PRIx64 " x %u, texture %#" PRIx64 ")%s\n", gpu_frames(),
                shadow_skip_name[why], d->vertices, d->vertex_count, d->stride, d->indices, d->index_count, d->texture,
                n == 3 ? " (the last one logged for this reason)" : "");
}

static VkShaderModule module(const char *name) {
    const char *dir = getenv("YW4_NATIVE_SHADER_DIR");
    char path[1024];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.spv", dir && *dir ? dir : "work/build/shaders", name);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) gpu_stop("no native shader %s (python -m recomp.build compiles runtime/shaders)", path);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint32_t *code = malloc((size_t)n);
    if (!code || fread(code, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) gpu_stop("cannot read %s", path);
    fclose(f);
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = (size_t)n,
                                    .pCode = code};
    VkShaderModule m;
    CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(vk.device, &mci, NULL, &m));
    free(code);
    return m;
}

/* Kinds of caster, each its own shaders and pipeline layout. The instanced ones draw all of a
 * submesh's copies at once, their matrices in the copies ring. */
enum {
    KIND_STATIC, KIND_CUTOUT, KIND_SKINNED, KIND_SKINNED4, KIND_INST, KIND_INST_CUTOUT, KIND_INST_FADE,
    KIND_INST_FADE_CUTOUT, KIND_WIND, KINDS
};
/* Push constants: the matrix (64 bytes), for cut-out casters also the threshold; instanced ones
 * only the threshold (their matrices come per copy); wind-swayed ones projection x view, the
 * threshold and their header's index in the copies ring. */
static const uint32_t push_size[KINDS] = {64, 68, 64, 64, 4, 4, 4, 4, 72};
static int kind_instanced(int kind) { return kind >= KIND_INST; }
static int kind_skinned(int kind) { return kind == KIND_SKINNED || kind == KIND_SKINNED4; }
/* kinds with three vertex bindings (the same vertices, at the second and third attributes' offsets) */
static int kind_three(int kind) { return kind == KIND_WIND || kind == KIND_SKINNED4; }

/* Instanced casters' copies: a ring in host-visible memory, as the palettes'. The render thread
 * that gathers a pass writes each draw's copies in (gpu_shadow_copies); the draw's first instance
 * is the first one's index, read by shadow_instanced.vert through one storage-buffer descriptor.
 * 16 MiB is 200,000 copies: hundreds of frames. */
enum { COPIES_RING = 16 << 20 };
static struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    ShadowCopy *map;
    uint32_t next, size;  /* in copies */
    VkDescriptorSetLayout layout;
    VkDescriptorSet set;
} cps;
static HostLock cps_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static VkDescriptorSetLayout copies_set_layout(void) {
    if (!cps.layout) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b = {0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, NULL};
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .bindingCount = 1, .pBindings = &b};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &cps.layout));
    }
    return cps.layout;
}

/* The ring, its memory and its one descriptor set (cps_lock held). */
static void copies_ring(void) {
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = COPIES_RING,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT};
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &cps.buf));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, cps.buf, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
        .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits,
                                          VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)};
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, cps.buf, mem, 0));
    CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&cps.map));
    VkDescriptorPoolSize size = {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1};
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo pci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .maxSets = 1,
                                      .poolSizeCount = 1, .pPoolSizes = &size};
    VkDescriptorPool pool;
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorPool(vk.device, &pci, NULL, &pool));
    VkDescriptorSetLayout l = copies_set_layout();
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, .descriptorPool = pool,
                                      .descriptorSetCount = 1, .pSetLayouts = &l};
    CHECK(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(vk.device, &ai, &cps.set));
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo bi = {cps.buf, 0, COPIES_RING};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = cps.set, .dstBinding = 0,
                              .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
                              .pBufferInfo = &bi};
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(vk.device, 1, &w, 0, NULL);
    cps.size = COPIES_RING / sizeof(ShadowCopy);
}

ShadowCopy *gpu_shadow_copies(uint32_t n, uint32_t *first) {
    host_lock(&cps_lock);
    if (!cps.buf) copies_ring();
    if (!n || n > cps.size) {
        host_unlock(&cps_lock);
        return NULL;
    }
    uint32_t at = cps.next + n > cps.size ? 0 : cps.next;
    cps.next = at + n;
    host_unlock(&cps_lock);
    *first = at;
    return cps.map + at;
}

/* Skinned casters' bone palettes: a ring in host-visible memory. The render thread that gathers
 * a pass copies each palette in (gpu_shadow_palette), the pass's draws read it through one
 * descriptor with a dynamic offset. 16 MiB is about 100 frames of palettes: reused long after
 * the GPU has read them. */
enum { PALETTE_RING = 16 << 20, PALETTE_MAX = 3 * 256 * 16 };  /* the shader's array: 256 bones */
static struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    uint8_t *map;
    uint64_t next;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout layout;
    VkDescriptorSet set;
} pal;
static HostLock pal_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static VkDescriptorSetLayout palette_set_layout(void) {
    if (!pal.layout) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b = {0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, NULL};
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .bindingCount = 1, .pBindings = &b};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &pal.layout));
    }
    return pal.layout;
}

/* The ring, its memory and its one descriptor set (pal_lock held). */
static void palette_ring(void) {
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = PALETTE_RING + PALETTE_MAX,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT};
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &pal.buf));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, pal.buf, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
        .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits,
                                          VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)};
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, pal.buf, mem, 0));
    CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&pal.map));
    VkDescriptorPoolSize size = {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC, 1};
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo pci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .maxSets = 1,
                                      .poolSizeCount = 1, .pPoolSizes = &size};
    VkDescriptorPool pool;
    CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorPool(vk.device, &pci, NULL, &pool));
    VkDescriptorSetLayout l = palette_set_layout();
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, .descriptorPool = pool,
                                      .descriptorSetCount = 1, .pSetLayouts = &l};
    CHECK(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(vk.device, &ai, &pal.set));
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo bi = {pal.buf, 0, PALETTE_MAX};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = pal.set, .dstBinding = 0,
                              .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC,
                              .pBufferInfo = &bi};
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(vk.device, 1, &w, 0, NULL);
}

int gpu_shadow_palette(const void *src, uint32_t size, uint32_t *offset) {
    if (!size || size > PALETTE_MAX) return 0;
    VkDeviceSize align = vk.props.limits.minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment;
    host_lock(&pal_lock);
    if (!pal.buf) palette_ring();
    uint64_t at = (pal.next + align - 1) / align * align;
    if (at + size > PALETTE_RING) at = 0;
    pal.next = at + size;
    host_unlock(&pal_lock);
    memcpy(pal.map + at, src, size);
    *offset = (uint32_t)at;
    return 1;
}

/* Cut-out and fading casters: their textures at set 0, bindings 0 .. n-1 (cut-out: the texture;
 * fading: the dither; fading cut-out: the texture, then the dither). n = 0: an empty set 0 for
 * the instanced kinds without textures (their copies are set 1). */
static VkDescriptorSetLayout textures_set_layout(uint32_t n) {
    static VkDescriptorSetLayout l[3];
    if (!l[n]) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[2] = {
            {0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, NULL},
            {1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, NULL}};
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .bindingCount = n, .pBindings = b};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &l[n]));
    }
    return l[n];
}
/* Wind-swayed casters: the leaf texture (fragment stage), then the noise and the wind map (vertex). */
static VkDescriptorSetLayout wind_set_layout(void) {
    static VkDescriptorSetLayout l;
    if (!l) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[3] = {
            {0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, NULL},
            {1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, NULL},
            {2, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, NULL}};
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .bindingCount = 3, .pBindings = b};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &l));
    }
    return l;
}
static uint32_t kind_textures(int kind) {
    return kind == KIND_WIND ? 3 : kind == KIND_INST_FADE_CUTOUT ? 2 : kind == KIND_CUTOUT || kind == KIND_INST_CUTOUT || kind == KIND_INST_FADE;
}

static VkPipelineLayout layout(int kind) {
    static VkPipelineLayout l[KINDS];
    if (!l[kind]) {
        VkPushConstantRange pc = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, push_size[kind]};
        VkDescriptorSetLayout set[2] = {kind_skinned(kind) ? palette_set_layout()
                                        : kind == KIND_WIND  ? wind_set_layout()
                                                             : textures_set_layout(kind_textures(kind)),
                                        copies_set_layout()};
        uint32_t nsets = kind_instanced(kind) ? 2 : kind == KIND_STATIC ? 0 : 1;
        VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo lci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                          .setLayoutCount = nsets, .pSetLayouts = set,
                                          .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pc};
        CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(vk.device, &lci, NULL, &l[kind]));
    }
    return l[kind];
}

/* One pipeline per depth format and kind: triangle lists, the position (R32G32B32 at offset 0,
 * the stride set per draw), no fragment stage. Cut-out casters also read their texture
 * coordinates (`uv`, a Vulkan format) through a second binding of the same vertices and have a
 * fragment stage; skinned ones read weights (R32G32B32A32_UINT at 28) and bone indices
 * (R16G16B16A16_UINT at 44) from the same binding. Instanced ones take their matrices per copy;
 * fading ones have the dither in their fragment stage. */
static int kind_has_uv(int kind) {
    return kind == KIND_CUTOUT || kind == KIND_INST_CUTOUT || kind == KIND_INST_FADE_CUTOUT || kind == KIND_WIND;
}
static VkPipeline pipeline(VkFormat depth, int kind, VkFormat uv, VkFormat wind) {
    enum { MAX = 48 };
    static struct { VkFormat depth, uv, wind; int kind; VkPipeline pipe; } pipes[MAX];
    static int n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (pipes[i].depth == depth && pipes[i].kind == kind && pipes[i].uv == uv && pipes[i].wind == wind)
            return pipes[i].pipe;
    if (n == MAX) gpu_stop("shadow pass: too many pipelines");
    static VkShaderModule vs[KINDS], fs[KINDS];
    static const char *const vs_name[KINDS] = {"shadow_static.vert",          "shadow_cutout.vert",
                                               "shadow_skinned.vert",         "shadow_skinned4.vert",
                                               "shadow_instanced.vert",
                                               "shadow_instanced_cutout.vert", "shadow_instanced.vert",
                                               "shadow_instanced_cutout.vert", "shadow_wind.vert"};
    static const char *const fs_name[KINDS] = {NULL, "shadow_cutout.frag", NULL, NULL, NULL, "shadow_cutout.frag",
                                               "shadow_fade.frag", "shadow_fade_cutout.frag", "shadow_cutout.frag"};
    if (!vs[kind]) vs[kind] = module(vs_name[kind]);
    if (fs_name[kind] && !fs[kind]) fs[kind] = module(fs_name[kind]);
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo st[2] = {
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT,
         .module = vs[kind], .pName = "main"},
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
         .module = fs[kind], .pName = "main"}};
    VkVertexInputBindingDescription bind[3] = {{0, 12, VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_VERTEX}, {1, 12, VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_VERTEX},
                                               {2, 12, VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_VERTEX}};
    VkVertexInputAttributeDescription attr[3] = {{0, 0, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SFLOAT, 0}, {1, 1, uv, 0}, {2, 2, wind, 0}};
    if (kind == KIND_SKINNED) {
        attr[1] = (VkVertexInputAttributeDescription){1, 0, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT, 28};
        attr[2] = (VkVertexInputAttributeDescription){2, 0, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT, 44};
    }
    uint32_t nattr = kind == KIND_SKINNED || kind_three(kind) ? 3 : kind_has_uv(kind) ? 2 : 1;
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .vertexBindingDescriptionCount = kind_three(kind) ? 3 : kind_has_uv(kind) ? 2 : 1,
                                               .pVertexBindingDescriptions = bind,
                                               .vertexAttributeDescriptionCount = nattr,
                                               .pVertexAttributeDescriptions = attr};
    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo ia = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                 .topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST};
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                            .viewportCount = 1, .scissorCount = 1};
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rs = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                 .polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL, .lineWidth = 1.0f};
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                               .rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT};
    VkPipelineDepthStencilStateCreateInfo ds = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DEPTH_STENCIL_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                .maxDepthBounds = 1.0f};
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo cbs = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    /* the same dynamic state as the game's pipelines (gpu_dynamic_state), plus the stride */
    static const VkDynamicState dyn[] = {
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_BIAS,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_BLEND_CONSTANTS, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_STENCIL_COMPARE_MASK, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_STENCIL_WRITE_MASK,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_STENCIL_REFERENCE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_CULL_MODE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_FRONT_FACE,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_COMPARE_OP,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_BOUNDS_TEST_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_STENCIL_TEST_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_STENCIL_OP,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_RASTERIZER_DISCARD_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_BIAS_ENABLE,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_PRIMITIVE_RESTART_ENABLE, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VERTEX_INPUT_BINDING_STRIDE};
    VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo dy = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO,
                                           .dynamicStateCount = sizeof dyn / sizeof *dyn, .pDynamicStates = dyn};
    int stencil = depth == VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT || depth == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO,
                                        .depthAttachmentFormat = depth,
                                        .stencilAttachmentFormat = stencil ? depth : VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED};
    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &ri, .stageCount = fs_name[kind] ? 2 : 1,
        .pStages = st, .pVertexInputState = &vi, .pInputAssemblyState = &ia, .pViewportState = &vp,
        .pRasterizationState = &rs, .pMultisampleState = &ms, .pDepthStencilState = &ds, .pColorBlendState = &cbs,
        .pDynamicState = &dy, .layout = layout(kind)};
    CHECK(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(vk.device, gpu_pcache(), 1, &pci, NULL, &pipes[n].pipe));
    pipes[n].depth = depth, pipes[n].kind = kind, pipes[n].uv = uv, pipes[n].wind = wind;
    return pipes[n++].pipe;
}

static uint32_t depth_layer_of(const RenderTargets *rt) {
    return rt->has_depth_view && rt->depth_view.setmask & 2 ? rt->depth_view.min_layer : 0;
}

/* A depth-only target (a shadow map layer) and the state the game's draws into it ended with:
 * what a pass drawn after the game has moved on needs (the next target's viewport can differ). */
typedef struct {
    RenderTargets rt;
    int32_t viewport[4], scissor[4];
    int have_viewport, have_scissor;
    float depth_range[2], polygon_offset[3];
    uint8_t depth_stencil[8], polygon[4];
} TargetState;

static void target_state_get(TargetState *t, const GpuState *s) {
    memcpy(&t->rt, &s->rt, sizeof t->rt);
    render_targets_fix(&t->rt);
    memcpy(t->viewport, s->viewport, sizeof t->viewport), memcpy(t->scissor, s->scissor, sizeof t->scissor);
    t->have_viewport = s->have_viewport, t->have_scissor = s->have_scissor;
    memcpy(t->depth_range, s->depth_range, sizeof t->depth_range);
    memcpy(t->polygon_offset, s->polygon_offset, sizeof t->polygon_offset);
    memcpy(t->depth_stencil, s->depth_stencil, sizeof t->depth_stencil), memcpy(t->polygon, s->polygon, sizeof t->polygon);
}

static void target_state_set(GpuState *s, const TargetState *t) {
    memcpy(&s->rt, &t->rt, sizeof s->rt);
    render_targets_fix(&s->rt);
    memcpy(s->viewport, t->viewport, sizeof s->viewport), memcpy(s->scissor, t->scissor, sizeof s->scissor);
    s->have_viewport = t->have_viewport, s->have_scissor = t->have_scissor;
    memcpy(s->depth_range, t->depth_range, sizeof s->depth_range);
    memcpy(s->polygon_offset, t->polygon_offset, sizeof s->polygon_offset);
    memcpy(s->depth_stencil, t->depth_stencil, sizeof s->depth_stencil), memcpy(s->polygon, t->polygon, sizeof s->polygon);
}

/* The depth-only targets left last, by texels' address and layer. */
enum { NOTED = 8 };
static HostLock noted_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static TargetState noted[NOTED];
static int nnoted, noted_next;

void gpu_shadow_note_targets(const GpuState *s) {
    if (s->ncolor || !s->rt.depth) return;
    uint64_t addr = s->rt.depth->addr;
    uint32_t layer = depth_layer_of(&s->rt);
    host_lock(&noted_lock);
    int i = 0;
    while (i < nnoted && (noted[i].rt.depth->addr != addr || depth_layer_of(&noted[i].rt) != layer)) i++;
    if (i == nnoted) {
        if (nnoted < NOTED) i = nnoted++;
        else i = noted_next, noted_next = (noted_next + 1) % NOTED;
    }
    target_state_get(&noted[i], s);
    host_unlock(&noted_lock);
}

static void draw_pass(VkCommandBuffer cb, GpuState *s, const ShadowPass *p) {
    /* cut-out casters' textures, the dither and the wind textures: images made and uploaded before
     * rendering, as for the game's draws */
    uint64_t uploaded[3] = {0};  /* dither, wind noise, wind map: one each in a pass */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n; i++) {
        const ShadowDraw *d = &p->d[i];
        uint64_t once[3] = {d->dither, d->wind_tex[0], d->wind_tex[1]};
        if (d->texture) {
            if (s->rendering) gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
            gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, d->texture, 1, NULL);
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++)
            if (once[t] && once[t] != uploaded[t]) {
                if (s->rendering) gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
                gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, once[t], 1, NULL);
                uploaded[t] = once[t];
            }
    }
    /* the casters' geometry in video memory (gpu.c, YW4_VRAM_GEOMETRY): copies first, outside rendering */
    int copies = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n && !copies; i++) {
        const ShadowDraw *d = &p->d[i];
        copies = gpu_geometry_needs_copy(d->vertices, (uint64_t)d->vertex_count * d->stride) ||
                 (d->index_count && gpu_geometry_needs_copy(d->indices, (uint64_t)d->index_count * (d->index_type == 2 ? 4 : 2)));
    }
    if (copies) {
        gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n; i++) {
            const ShadowDraw *d = &p->d[i];
            gpu_geometry_copy(cb, d->vertices, (uint64_t)d->vertex_count * d->stride);
            if (d->index_count) gpu_geometry_copy(cb, d->indices, (uint64_t)d->index_count * (d->index_type == 2 ? 4 : 2));
        }
        full_barrier(cb);
    }
    VkFormat color[8], depth;
    uint32_t w, h;
    if (!gpu_begin_targets(cb, s, color, &depth, &w, &h)) {
        pass_skipped(p, "its shadow map could not be bound");
        return;
    }
    VkPipeline bound = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    int cull = -1, front = -1;
    long skipped = 0;
    long skip_why[7] = {0};  /* 1 vertices, 2 indices, 3 cut-out texture, 4 skin layout, 5 dither, 6 wind textures */
    /* YW4_AB_SELFTEST=1: leave out every second draw of ours, a fault the same-frame A/B must report (checks the tool) */
    static int selftest = -1;
    if (selftest < 0) selftest = getenv("YW4_AB_SELFTEST") && atoi(getenv("YW4_AB_SELFTEST")) > 0;
    static int no_alpha = -1;  /* YW4_SHADOW_NO_ALPHA=1 (tests): cut-out casters drawn solid, no alpha test */
    if (no_alpha < 0) no_alpha = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_NO_ALPHA") && atoi(getenv("YW4_SHADOW_NO_ALPHA")) > 0;
    ShadowDraw solid;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n; i += 1 + (uint32_t)selftest) {
        const ShadowDraw *d = &p->d[i];
        if (no_alpha && d->texture) solid = *d, solid.threshold = -1.0f, d = &solid;
        VkBuffer vb[3], ib;
        VkDeviceSize voff[3], ioff, stride[3] = {d->stride, d->stride, d->stride};
        uint32_t isize = d->index_type == 2 ? 4 : 2;
        VkDescriptorImageInfo ii[4];  /* the cut-out texture, the dither, the wind noise, the wind map */
        /* 4-bone skinned casters: the weights' format in uv_format, the bone indices' in wind_format */
        VkFormat uv = d->texture || d->skin4 ? gpu_format(d->uv_format) : VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
        VkFormat wind = d->wind_tex[0] || d->skin4 ? gpu_format(d->wind_format) : VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
        /* why a draw is skipped, counted per reason for YW4_SHADOW_SKIP_LOG=<from>-<to> (GPU frames) */
        int why = !gpu_geometry_at(d->vertices, (uint64_t)d->vertex_count * d->stride, &vb[0], &voff[0]) ? 1
                  : d->index_count && !gpu_geometry_at(d->indices, (uint64_t)d->index_count * isize, &ib, &ioff) ? 2
                  : d->texture && (uv == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED || !gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, d->texture, 0, &ii[0])) ? 3
                  : d->skin4 && (uv == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED || wind == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) ? 4
                  : d->dither && !gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, d->dither, 0, &ii[1]) ? 5
                  : d->wind_tex[0] && (wind == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED || !gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, d->wind_tex[0], 0, &ii[2]) ||
                                       !gpu_handle_texture(cb, s, d->wind_tex[1], 0, &ii[3])) ? 6
                  : 0;
        if (why) {
            skipped++;
            skip_why[why]++;
            draw_skipped(d, why);
            continue;
        }
        if (d->texture && d->has_sampler) {  /* the sampler settings learned with the caster, not the ring slot's now */
            NvnSamplerDesc sd;
            memcpy(&sd, d->sampler, sizeof sd);
            sd.compare_mode = 0;
            ii[0].sampler = gpu_sampler(&sd);
        }
        int kind = d->palette_size ? (d->skin4 ? KIND_SKINNED4 : KIND_SKINNED)
                   : d->wind_tex[0] ? KIND_WIND
                   : d->copies     ? (d->dither ? (d->texture ? KIND_INST_FADE_CUTOUT : KIND_INST_FADE)
                                                : (d->texture ? KIND_INST_CUTOUT : KIND_INST))
                   : d->texture    ? KIND_CUTOUT
                                   : KIND_STATIC;
        if (kind_skinned(kind) && !pal.buf) {  /* can't happen: the gather made the ring */
            skipped++;
            draw_skipped(d, 0);
            continue;
        }
        VkPipeline pipe = pipeline(depth, kind, uv, wind);
        if (pipe != bound) {
            vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipe);
            if (bound == VK_NULL_HANDLE) gpu_dynamic_state(cb, s, depth, w, h);
            bound = pipe;
            cull = front = -1;
        }
        if (d->cull != cull || d->front != front) gpu_cull(cb, d->cull, d->front), cull = d->cull, front = d->front;
        vb[1] = vb[2] = vb[0], voff[1] = voff[0] + d->uv_offset, voff[2] = voff[0] + d->wind_offset;
        vkCmdBindVertexBuffers2(cb, 0, kind_three(kind) ? 3 : kind_has_uv(kind) ? 2 : 1, vb, voff, NULL, stride);
        if (kind_skinned(kind))
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, layout(kind), 0, 1, &pal.set, 1,
                                    &d->palette_offset);
        uint32_t ntex = kind_textures(kind);
        if (ntex) {  /* the cut-out texture at binding 0 if any, then the dither, or the wind textures */
            const VkDescriptorImageInfo *tex[3] = {d->texture ? &ii[0] : &ii[1], kind == KIND_WIND ? &ii[2] : &ii[1], &ii[3]};
            VkDescriptorSet set = gpu_alloc_set(kind == KIND_WIND ? wind_set_layout() : textures_set_layout(ntex));
            VkWriteDescriptorSet wr[3];
            for (uint32_t t = 0; t < ntex; t++)
                wr[t] = (VkWriteDescriptorSet){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = set, .dstBinding = t,
                                               .descriptorCount = 1,
                                               .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER,
                                               .pImageInfo = tex[t]};
            vkUpdateDescriptorSets(vk.device, ntex, wr, 0, NULL);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, layout(kind), 0, 1, &set, 0, NULL);
        }
        if (kind == KIND_WIND) {  /* the copies; projection x view, the threshold, the header */
            struct { float vp[16], threshold; uint32_t header; } push;
            memcpy(push.vp, d->mvp, sizeof push.vp);
            push.threshold = d->threshold, push.header = d->wind_header;
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, layout(kind), 1, 1, &cps.set, 0, NULL);
            vkCmdPushConstants(cb, layout(kind), VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, push_size[kind], &push);
        } else if (kind_instanced(kind)) {  /* the copies; only the threshold in push constants */
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, layout(kind), 1, 1, &cps.set, 0, NULL);
            vkCmdPushConstants(cb, layout(kind), VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, push_size[kind], &d->threshold);
        } else {  /* the matrix, and for cut-out casters the threshold right after it */
            vkCmdPushConstants(cb, layout(kind), VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, push_size[kind], d->mvp);
        }
        uint32_t instances = d->copies ? d->copies : 1, first = d->copies ? d->first_copy : 0;
        gpu_query_condition(cb, (int)d->cond_mode, d->cond_addr);  /* skipped when the game's draw would be */
        if (d->index_count) {
            vkCmdBindIndexBuffer(cb, ib, ioff, d->index_type == 2 ? VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT32 : VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT16);
            vkCmdDrawIndexed(cb, d->index_count, instances, 0, 0, first);
        } else {
            vkCmdDraw(cb, d->vertex_count, instances, 0, first);
        }
        gpu_query_after_draw(cb);
    }
    {
        static uint64_t from = 1, to;
        if (from == 1) {
            from = 0;
            const char *e = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_SKIP_LOG");
            if (e) sscanf(e, "%" SCNu64 "-%" SCNu64, &from, &to);
        }
        uint64_t f = gpu_frames();
        if (to && f >= from && f <= to) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadowskip: frame %" PRIu64 " layer %u: %u draws, skipped %ld (vertices %ld, indices %ld, "
                    "cut-out texture %ld, skin %ld, dither %ld, wind %ld); texture pool %p\n", f, p->depth_layer, p->n,
                    skipped, skip_why[1], skip_why[2], skip_why[3], skip_why[4], skip_why[5], skip_why[6],
                    (const void *)s->tex_pool);
            /* the first cut-out draw's sampler, as the bound sampler pool names it */
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->n; i++) {
                if (!p->d[i].texture) continue;
                NvnSamplerDesc sd;
                if (gpu_handle_sampler(s, p->d[i].texture, &sd))
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadowskip:   cut-out handle %#" PRIx64 ": sampler filters %u/%u wrap %u/%u/%u "
                            "compare %u lod %g..%g bias %g aniso %g reduction %u\n", p->d[i].texture, sd.min_filter,
                            sd.mag_filter, sd.wrap[0], sd.wrap[1], sd.wrap[2], sd.compare_mode, sd.lod_min, sd.lod_max,
                            sd.lod_bias, sd.max_aniso, sd.reduction);
                else
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadowskip:   cut-out handle %#" PRIx64 ": no sampler in the bound pool\n",
                            p->d[i].texture);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

/* CMD_NATIVE (shadow.c, only with YW4_AB_PASS=shadow): the game's draw that follows is one ours replaces. It is
 * kept in the command list so the same-frame A/B's second run (the game's) has it; every other run skips it. */
void gpu_shadow_game_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    (void)vk_cb, (void)data, (void)size;
    ((GpuState *)gpu_state)->skip_next_draw = !gpu_ab_game;
}

void gpu_shadow_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cb;
    GpuState *s = gpu_state;
    const ShadowPass *p;
    if (gpu_ab_game) return;  /* the same-frame A/B's second run: the game's draws instead */
    if (size < sizeof p) return;
    memcpy(&p, data, sizeof p);
    if (!p || !p->n) return;
    if (s->rt.depth && s->rt.depth->addr == p->depth_addr && depth_layer_of(&s->rt) == p->depth_layer && !s->ncolor) {
        draw_pass(cb, s, p);
        return;
    }
    /* The game has moved on to another target before the pass's turn (cutscenes: a cascade's second
     * layer goes into a second shadow map, bound before that layer starts, with its own viewport).
     * Draw into the pass's layer with the target and state the game's draws there ended with, then
     * put the game's back. */
    TargetState *game = malloc(sizeof *game), *ours = malloc(sizeof *ours);
    int found = 0;
    if (game && ours) {
        host_lock(&noted_lock);
        for (int i = 0; i < nnoted && !found; i++)
            if (noted[i].rt.depth->addr == p->depth_addr && depth_layer_of(&noted[i].rt) == p->depth_layer)
                *ours = noted[i], render_targets_fix(&ours->rt), found = 1;
        host_unlock(&noted_lock);
    }
    if (!found) {
        free(game), free(ours);
        pass_skipped(p, game && ours ? "the game had moved to another target and its shadow map was not seen before"
                                     : "out of memory");
        return;
    }
    int ncolor = s->ncolor;
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    target_state_get(game, s);
    target_state_set(s, ours);
    s->ncolor = 0;
    draw_pass(cb, s, p);
    gpu_end_rendering(cb, s);
    target_state_set(s, game);
    s->ncolor = ncolor;
    free(game), free(ours);
}

```

`runtime/src/gpu_watch.c`:

```c
/* Minimap watch (YW4_MINIMAP_WATCH=1; python -m tools.dev.minimap): finds the frames in which the minimap goes
 * blank, and what was different about them.
 *
 * The game draws the minimap into small images of its own (340x304 and 516x460, docs/frame.md) and then puts
 * them on the screen with a UI draw that samples them. So a blank minimap is one of three things, and the watch
 * looks at each, every frame:
 *
 *   1. nothing (or less) was drawn into the minimap's image    -> the count of draws into it, and of clears
 *   2. it was drawn, but from textures that weren't there      -> its draws' textures: missing, or uploaded
 *                                                                 in this very frame
 *   3. the image was fine but never reached the screen         -> the count of draws elsewhere that sample it
 *
 * and at the image itself, read back two frames later without stalling (as the flash detector does, window.c):
 * how much of it is lit and how much is opaque. That is the ground truth for "blank"; the counts are the why.
 *
 * Written to YW4_MINIMAP_DIR (default work/minimap):
 *   minimap_draws.csv    one row per frame and image: the counts
 *   minimap_pixels.csv   one row per frame and image: lit and opaque texels (per mille), mean colour
 *   minimap_<frame>_<w>x<h>_{a_before,b_blank,c_after}.bmp   the image around a drop in lit or opaque texels
 *   minimap_<frame>_draws.txt   every draw of the frame before and of the frame a count dropped in
 * and an event per drop and recovery in the run's events file (events.h, kind "minimap").
 *
 * All of it runs on the thread that holds gpu_lock (gpu_execute, gpu_present). */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#define MAKE_DIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define MAKE_DIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
#endif

#include "events.h"
#include "gpu_internal.h"

enum { TARGETS = 4, SLOTS = 4, MAX_DRAWS = 256, DRAW_TEX = 6, MAX_SAVED = 40, RING = 8 };

typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, handle;  /* the texels' guest address; the handle the draw named it by (pool ids) */
    uint32_t w, h, format;
    uint8_t slot, missing, fresh;
} WTex;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t vs, fs;
    uint32_t verts;
    int8_t target;   /* the minimap image drawn into, or -1: a draw elsewhere that samples one */
    int8_t samples;  /* ... which one */
    uint8_t ntex;
    WTex tex[DRAW_TEX];
    /* the draw's own data as the game's memory held it when the draw was translated: where, a fingerprint, and
     * the start of it as floats (the GPU reads the same memory, but later) */
    uint64_t vb_addr, vb_hash;
    uint32_t first, stride;
    uint8_t stale, nvf, ncb;
    float vf[16];
    struct { uint8_t stage, slot, nf; uint64_t addr, size, hash; float f[8]; } cb[4];
} WDraw;

typedef struct {
    int draws, clears, shown, missing, fresh;
    uint64_t verts;
} WCount;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t frame;
    WCount c[TARGETS];
    int ndraws;
    WDraw d[MAX_DRAWS];
} WFrame;

typedef struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    uint8_t *map;
    uint64_t seq, frame;  /* seq 0: nothing to read */
} WSlot;

typedef struct {
    NvnTexture tex;  /* a copy: the image is found by it at the end of the frame */
    uint64_t last_used;
    WSlot slot[SLOTS];
    uint32_t pw, ph;  /* the size the readback buffers were made for */
    /* the picture: the last one read, and a drop in progress */
    uint8_t *prev, *work;
    uint64_t prev_frame;
    int prev_lit, prev_opaque;
    int blank, base_lit, base_opaque;
    uint64_t blank_from;
    /* the counts: a drop in progress */
    int low, base_draws, base_shown;
    uint64_t low_from;
} WTarget;

static int on = -1;
static char dir[400] = "work/minimap";
static WTarget tg[TARGETS];
static int ntg;
static WFrame fr[RING];  /* the frame being drawn (cur) and the ones before: a picture is judged two frames late */
static int cur;
static FILE *draws_csv, *pixels_csv;
static int saved;

int gpu_watch_on(void) {
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_MINIMAP_WATCH");
        on = e && atoi(e) > 0;
        if (on) {
            const char *d = getenv("YW4_MINIMAP_DIR");
            if (d && *d) snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", d);
            MAKE_DIR(dir);
            char path[512];
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/minimap_draws.csv", dir);
            draws_csv = fopen(path, "w");
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/minimap_pixels.csv", dir);
            pixels_csv = fopen(path, "w");
            if (!draws_csv || !pixels_csv) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: can't write in %s: watch off\n", dir);
                on = 0;
                return 0;
            }
            fprintf(draws_csv, "frame,target,draws,clears,shown,missing,fresh,verts\n");
            fprintf(pixels_csv, "frame,target,lit_pm,opaque_pm,r,g,b,a\n");
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: watch on, files in %s\n", dir);
        }
    }
    return on;
}

static int minimap_size(const NvnTexture *t) {
    return (t->width == 340 && t->height == 304) || (t->width == 516 && t->height == 460);
}

static int target_of(const NvnTexture *t, int add) {
    if (!t || !t->addr) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntg; i++)
        if (tg[i].tex.addr == t->addr && tg[i].tex.width == t->width && tg[i].tex.height == t->height) return i;
    if (!add || !minimap_size(t)) return -1;
    int i = ntg;
    if (ntg < TARGETS) {
        ntg++;
    } else {  /* full: the one unused longest goes (the game made its images anew) */
        i = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k < TARGETS; k++)
            if (tg[k].last_used < tg[i].last_used) i = k;
        for (int k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++) tg[i].slot[k].seq = 0;
        free(tg[i].prev);
        uint8_t *work = tg[i].work;
        WSlot keep[SLOTS];
        uint32_t pw = tg[i].pw, ph = tg[i].ph;
        memcpy(keep, tg[i].slot, sizeof keep);
        memset(&tg[i], 0, sizeof tg[i]);
        memcpy(tg[i].slot, keep, sizeof keep), tg[i].pw = pw, tg[i].ph = ph, tg[i].work = work;
    }
    tg[i].tex = *t;
    tg[i].tex.found = NULL, tg[i].tex.found_epoch = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 ": watching image %#" PRIx64 " (%ux%u)\n", gpu_frames() + 1, t->addr,
            t->width, t->height);
    return i;
}

void gpu_watch_clear(const NvnTexture *t) {
    int i = target_of(t, 1);
    if (i >= 0) fr[cur].c[i].clears++, tg[i].last_used = gpu_frames() + 1;
}

int gpu_watch_wants(const GpuState *s, const GpuWatchTex *tex, int ntex) {
    if (s->ncolor && target_of(s->rt.color[0], 1) >= 0) return 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++)
        if (target_of(tex[i].tex, 0) >= 0) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* FNV-1a of up to `max` bytes at addr, and its first floats; 0 when the memory can't be read. */
static uint64_t fingerprint(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t max, float *f, int maxf, uint8_t *nf) {
    *nf = 0;
    if (size > max) size = max;
    /* in a memory pool of the game's (host_readable asks Windows about the region: 0.8 ms a call here, 2026-11-13) */
    VkBuffer buf;
    VkDeviceSize at;
    if (!addr || !size || !gpu_buffer_at(addr, size, &buf, &at)) return 0;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)addr;
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < size; i++) h = (h ^ p[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    *nf = (uint8_t)(size / 4 < (uint64_t)maxf ? size / 4 : (uint64_t)maxf);
    memcpy(f, p, (size_t)*nf * 4);
    return h;
}

void gpu_watch_draw(const GpuState *s, uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs, uint64_t verts, const GpuWatchTex *tex, int ntex,
                    const GpuWatchData *data) {
    WFrame *f = &fr[cur];
    int into = s->ncolor ? target_of(s->rt.color[0], 1) : -1, samples = -1;
    if (into < 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < ntex && samples < 0; i++) samples = target_of(tex[i].tex, 0);
        if (samples < 0) return;
        f->c[samples].shown++;
    } else {
        WCount *c = &f->c[into];
        c->draws++, c->verts += verts;
        for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) c->missing += !tex[i].tex, c->fresh += tex[i].fresh;
        tg[into].last_used = gpu_frames() + 1;
    }
    if (f->ndraws == MAX_DRAWS) return;
    WDraw *d = &f->d[f->ndraws++];
    memset(d, 0, sizeof *d);
    d->vs = vs, d->fs = fs, d->verts = (uint32_t)verts, d->target = (int8_t)into, d->samples = (int8_t)samples;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex && d->ntex < DRAW_TEX; i++) {
        WTex *x = &d->tex[d->ntex++];
        x->slot = (uint8_t)tex[i].slot, x->missing = !tex[i].tex, x->fresh = (uint8_t)tex[i].fresh, x->handle = tex[i].handle;
        if (tex[i].tex)
            x->addr = tex[i].tex->addr, x->w = tex[i].tex->width, x->h = tex[i].tex->height, x->format = tex[i].tex->format;
    }
    uint64_t off = (uint64_t)data->first * data->stride, len = verts * data->stride;
    d->vb_addr = data->vb_addr + off, d->first = data->first, d->stride = data->stride, d->stale = (uint8_t)data->stale;
    if (data->vb_addr && off + len <= data->vb_size) d->vb_hash = fingerprint(d->vb_addr, len, 1024, d->vf, 16, &d->nvf);
    for (int i = 0; i < data->ncb; i++) {
        const GpuWatchBuf *b = &data->cb[i];
        d->cb[i].stage = b->stage, d->cb[i].slot = b->slot, d->cb[i].addr = b->addr, d->cb[i].size = b->size;
        d->cb[i].hash = fingerprint(b->addr, b->size, 1024, d->cb[i].f, 8, &d->cb[i].nf);
    }
    d->ncb = (uint8_t)data->ncb;
}

/* ---- the picture */

static void save_bmp(const WTarget *t, const uint8_t *px, uint64_t frame, uint64_t named, const char *tag) {
    if (!px) return;
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/minimap_%06" PRIu64 "_%ux%u_%s.bmp", dir, named, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, tag);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    uint32_t w = t->pw, h = t->ph, row = (w * 3 + 3) & ~3u, size = 54 + row * h;
    uint8_t hd[54] = {'B', 'M'};
    int32_t top_down = -(int32_t)h;
    memcpy(hd + 2, &size, 4), memcpy(hd + 10, &(uint32_t){54}, 4), memcpy(hd + 14, &(uint32_t){40}, 4);
    memcpy(hd + 18, &w, 4), memcpy(hd + 22, &top_down, 4), memcpy(hd + 26, &(uint16_t){1}, 2);
    memcpy(hd + 28, &(uint16_t){24}, 2);
    fwrite(hd, 1, 54, f);
    uint8_t *line = calloc(1, row);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            const uint8_t *p = px + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4;
            line[x * 3] = p[2], line[x * 3 + 1] = p[1], line[x * 3 + 2] = p[0];
        }
        fwrite(line, 1, row, f);
    }
    free(line);
    fclose(f);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 " saved as %s\n", frame, path);
}

static void write_draws(FILE *f, const WFrame *w);

/* The draws of frames first..last that the ring still has, to minimap_<named>_draws.txt. */
static void dump_draws(uint64_t named, uint64_t first, uint64_t last) {
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/minimap_%06" PRIu64 "_draws.txt", dir, named);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!f) return;
    for (uint64_t n = first; n <= last; n++)
        for (int i = 0; i < RING; i++)
            if (i != cur && fr[i].frame == n) write_draws(f, &fr[i]);
    fclose(f);
}

/* One picture read back: its numbers, and whether it went blank against the one before. */
static void picture(int ti, const uint8_t *px, uint64_t frame) {
    WTarget *t = &tg[ti];
    size_t n = (size_t)t->pw * t->ph, lit = 0, opaque = 0;
    uint64_t sum[4] = {0};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const uint8_t *p = px + i * 4;
        lit += p[0] > 24 || p[1] > 24 || p[2] > 24;
        opaque += p[3] > 16;
        sum[0] += p[0], sum[1] += p[1], sum[2] += p[2], sum[3] += p[3];
    }
    int lit_pm = (int)(lit * 1000 / n), opaque_pm = (int)(opaque * 1000 / n);
    fprintf(pixels_csv, "%" PRIu64 ",%ux%u,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, lit_pm, opaque_pm,
            (int)(sum[0] / n), (int)(sum[1] / n), (int)(sum[2] / n), (int)(sum[3] / n));
    if (!t->blank) {
        int lit_drop = t->prev && t->prev_lit >= 50 && lit_pm * 2 < t->prev_lit;
        int opaque_drop = t->prev && t->prev_opaque >= 50 && opaque_pm * 2 < t->prev_opaque;
        if (lit_drop || opaque_drop) {
            t->blank = 1, t->blank_from = frame, t->base_lit = t->prev_lit, t->base_opaque = t->prev_opaque;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 ": image %ux%u went blank: lit %d -> %d, opaque %d -> %d per mille"
                            " (frame %" PRIu64 " before)\n", frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, t->prev_lit, lit_pm,
                    t->prev_opaque, opaque_pm, t->prev_frame);
            yw4_event("minimap", frame, "\"what\":\"pixels\",\"target\":\"%ux%u\",\"lit\":[%d,%d],\"opaque\":[%d,%d]",
                      t->tex.width, t->tex.height, t->prev_lit, lit_pm, t->prev_opaque, opaque_pm);
            if (saved++ < MAX_SAVED) {
                save_bmp(t, t->prev, t->prev_frame, frame, "a_before");
                save_bmp(t, px, frame, frame, "b_blank");
                dump_draws(frame, frame - 1, frame + 1);
            }
        }
    } else if ((lit_pm * 4 >= t->base_lit * 3 && opaque_pm * 4 >= t->base_opaque * 3) || frame - t->blank_from > 600) {
        int back = frame - t->blank_from <= 600;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 ": image %ux%u %s after %" PRIu64 " frames (lit %d, opaque %d)\n",
                frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, back ? "is back" : "stays as it is: taken as the new normal",
                frame - t->blank_from, lit_pm, opaque_pm);
        yw4_event("minimap", frame, "\"what\":\"%s\",\"of\":\"pixels\",\"target\":\"%ux%u\",\"since\":%" PRIu64
                  ",\"frames\":%" PRIu64, back ? "back" : "stays", t->tex.width, t->tex.height, t->blank_from,
                  frame - t->blank_from);
        if (back && saved <= MAX_SAVED) save_bmp(t, px, frame, t->blank_from, "c_after");
        t->blank = 0;
    }
    if (!t->prev) t->prev = malloc(n * 4);
    memcpy(t->prev, px, n * 4);
    t->prev_frame = frame, t->prev_lit = lit_pm, t->prev_opaque = opaque_pm;
}

static void slots_free(WTarget *t) {
    for (int k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++) {
        if (t->slot[k].buf) vkDestroyBuffer(vk.device, t->slot[k].buf, NULL), vkFreeMemory(vk.device, t->slot[k].mem, NULL);
        memset(&t->slot[k], 0, sizeof t->slot[k]);
    }
    free(t->prev), free(t->work);
    t->prev = t->work = NULL, t->blank = 0;
}

static void slot_make(WTarget *t, WSlot *sl) {
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = (VkDeviceSize)t->pw * t->ph * 4,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(vk.device, &bci, NULL, &sl->buf));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(vk.device, sl->buf, &mr);
    /* cached memory: reading the plain host-visible kind is uncached and took 157 ms a frame (2026-11-13) */
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
                                .memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT |
                                                                                         VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT |
                                                                                         VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT)};
    if (mai.memoryTypeIndex == UINT32_MAX)
        mai.memoryTypeIndex = vk_memory_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT |
                                                                    VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(vk.device, &mai, NULL, &sl->mem));
    CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(vk.device, sl->buf, sl->mem, 0));
    void *p;
    CHECK(vkMapMemory(vk.device, sl->mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &p));
    sl->map = p;
}

/* ---- the counts */

static void write_draws(FILE *f, const WFrame *w) {
    fprintf(f, "frame %" PRIu64 ": %d draws recorded%s\n", w->frame, w->ndraws, w->ndraws == MAX_DRAWS ? " (more not kept)" : "");
    for (int i = 0; i < w->ndraws; i++) {
        const WDraw *d = &w->d[i];
        if (d->target >= 0)
            fprintf(f, "  into %ux%u ", tg[d->target].tex.width, tg[d->target].tex.height);
        else
            fprintf(f, "  ON SCREEN from %ux%u ", tg[d->samples].tex.width, tg[d->samples].tex.height);
        fprintf(f, "vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 " verts %u, textures:", d->vs, d->fs, d->verts);
        for (int k = 0; k < d->ntex; k++) {
            const WTex *x = &d->tex[k];
            if (x->missing) fprintf(f, " [%u: MISSING]", x->slot);
            else fprintf(f, " [%u: handle %#" PRIx64 " texels %#" PRIx64 " %ux%u fmt %u%s]", x->slot, x->handle, x->addr, x->w,
                         x->h, x->format, x->fresh ? " UPLOADED NOW" : "");
        }
        fprintf(f, "\n      vertices at %#" PRIx64 " first %u stride %u%s print %016" PRIx64 ":", d->vb_addr, d->first, d->stride,
                d->stale ? " COPY STALE" : "", d->vb_hash);
        for (int k = 0; k < d->nvf; k++) fprintf(f, " %g", d->vf[k]);
        for (int k = 0; k < d->ncb; k++) {
            fprintf(f, "\n      %s cbuf %u at %#" PRIx64 " size %" PRIu64 " print %016" PRIx64 ":", d->cb[k].stage ? "fs" : "vs",
                    d->cb[k].slot, d->cb[k].addr, d->cb[k].size, d->cb[k].hash);
            for (int j = 0; j < d->cb[k].nf; j++) fprintf(f, " %g", d->cb[k].f[j]);
        }
        fputc('\n', f);
    }
}

static void counts(uint64_t frame) {
    WFrame *now = &fr[cur], *before = &fr[(cur + RING - 1) % RING];
    now->frame = frame;
    int dump = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntg; i++) {
        WTarget *t = &tg[i];
        const WCount *c = &now->c[i], *p = &before->c[i];
        fprintf(draws_csv, "%" PRIu64 ",%ux%u,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%" PRIu64 "\n", frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, c->draws,
                c->clears, c->shown, c->missing, c->fresh, c->verts);
        if (before->frame + 1 != frame) continue;
        if (!t->low) {
            int fewer = p->draws >= 2 && c->draws * 2 < p->draws, hidden = p->shown > 0 && !c->shown;
            int lost = c->missing > p->missing;
            if (!fewer && !hidden && !lost) continue;
            if (fewer || hidden) t->low = 1, t->low_from = frame, t->base_draws = p->draws, t->base_shown = p->shown;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 ": image %ux%u: draws into it %d -> %d, draws putting it on screen"
                            " %d -> %d, missing textures %d -> %d, uploaded now %d\n", frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height,
                    p->draws, c->draws, p->shown, c->shown, p->missing, c->missing, c->fresh);
            yw4_event("minimap", frame, "\"what\":\"%s\",\"target\":\"%ux%u\",\"draws\":[%d,%d],\"shown\":[%d,%d],"
                      "\"missing\":[%d,%d],\"fresh\":%d", fewer ? "draws" : hidden ? "shown" : "missing", t->tex.width,
                      t->tex.height, p->draws, c->draws, p->shown, c->shown, p->missing, c->missing, c->fresh);
            dump = 1;
        } else if ((c->draws * 4 >= t->base_draws * 3 && (c->shown || !t->base_shown)) || frame - t->low_from > 600) {
            int back = frame - t->low_from <= 600;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: frame %" PRIu64 ": image %ux%u: draws %s after %" PRIu64 " frames (%d into it, %d"
                            " on screen)\n", frame, t->tex.width, t->tex.height, back ? "are back" : "stay as they are",
                    frame - t->low_from, c->draws, c->shown);
            yw4_event("minimap", frame, "\"what\":\"%s\",\"of\":\"draws\",\"target\":\"%ux%u\",\"since\":%" PRIu64
                      ",\"frames\":%" PRIu64, back ? "back" : "stays", t->tex.width, t->tex.height, t->low_from,
                      frame - t->low_from);
            t->low = 0;
        }
    }
    fflush(draws_csv);
    cur = (cur + 1) % RING;
    if (dump && saved++ < MAX_SAVED) dump_draws(frame, frame - 1, frame);
    memset(&fr[cur], 0, sizeof fr[cur]);
}

/* gpu_present: the frame's counts, the pictures that have arrived, and this frame's pictures on their way
 * (copies recorded in cb, which the caller submits and then names with gpu_watch_submitted). */
static WSlot *pending[TARGETS];

void gpu_watch_frame(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t frame) {
    counts(frame);
    for (int i = 0; i < ntg; i++) {
        WTarget *t = &tg[i];
        pending[i] = NULL;
        /* arrived: oldest first */
        for (;;) {
            WSlot *old = NULL;
            for (int k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++)
                if (t->slot[k].seq && (!old || t->slot[k].frame < old->frame)) old = &t->slot[k];
            if (!old || gpu_wait(old->seq, 0) != 0) break;
            if (!t->work) t->work = malloc((size_t)t->pw * t->ph * 4);
            memcpy(t->work, old->map, (size_t)t->pw * t->ph * 4);  /* one pass over the GPU's memory, then ours */
            picture(i, t->work, old->frame);
            old->seq = 0;
        }
        if (frame - t->last_used > 120) continue;  /* not drawn lately: nothing new to see */
        GpuImage *g = image_find(&t->tex);
        if (!g) continue;
        if (g->format != VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && g->format != VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB) {
            static int logged;
            if (!logged++) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: minimap: image format %d: its picture isn't read, counts only\n", (int)g->format);
            continue;
        }
        if (t->pw != g->width || t->ph != g->height) {
            int busy = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++) busy |= t->slot[k].seq != 0;
            if (busy) continue;  /* the old size's pictures first */
            slots_free(t);
            t->pw = g->width, t->ph = g->height;
        }
        WSlot *sl = NULL;
        for (int k = 0; k < SLOTS && !sl; k++)
            if (!t->slot[k].seq) sl = &t->slot[k];
        if (!sl) continue;  /* the GPU is four frames behind: skip this one */
        if (!sl->buf) slot_make(t, sl);
        full_barrier(cb);
        VkBufferImageCopy cp = {.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .imageExtent = {g->width, g->height, 1}};
        vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, g->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, sl->buf, 1, &cp);
        sl->frame = frame;
        pending[i] = sl;
    }
    fflush(pixels_csv);
}

void gpu_watch_submitted(uint64_t seq) {
    for (int i = 0; i < TARGETS; i++)
        if (pending[i]) pending[i]->seq = seq, pending[i] = NULL;
}
```
