`runtime/src/heap.c`:

```c
/* TLSF heap over a guest memory region: the native nn::mem::StandardAllocator (decision 0011).
 *
 * TLSF ("two-level segregated fit", Masmano et al. 2004): free blocks sit in lists indexed by
 * (first level = power of two of the size, second level = which of 16 slices of that power).
 * Two bitmaps say which lists are non-empty, so finding a block that fits is a couple of
 * count-trailing-zeros, O(1). Neighbouring free blocks are always merged, so fragmentation
 * stays low over a long game session.
 *
 * Every block starts with a 16-byte header inside the region:
 *   prev_phys  the block physically before it (NULL for the first)
 *   size       whole block size including the header, a multiple of 16; bit 0 = free
 * A free block also keeps its list links in the first 16 bytes of its payload, so the
 * smallest block is 32 bytes. A used 16-byte sentinel at the end of the region stops merges.
 * Payloads are 16-byte aligned, like malloc on AArch64.
 *
 * Only the lists and bitmaps live in host memory; everything the guest sees is in its region.
 */
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"

typedef struct Block {
    struct Block *prev_phys;
    uint64_t size;
    struct Block *next_free, *prev_free;  /* only while free: overlaps the payload */
} Block;

#define HDR 16u
#define MIN_BLOCK 32u
#define FREE_BIT 1u
#define SL_LOG 4
#define SL_COUNT (1u << SL_LOG)
#define FL_SHIFT (SL_LOG + 4)       /* sizes below 256 bytes go linearly into first level 0 */
#define SMALL (1u << FL_SHIFT)
#define FL_COUNT (64 - FL_SHIFT + 1)

struct Yw4Heap {
    uint8_t *start, *end;           /* the managed region, 16-aligned */
    uint64_t fl_map;
    uint32_t sl_map[FL_COUNT];
    Block *lists[FL_COUNT][SL_COUNT];
    size_t free_bytes;              /* payload bytes of all free blocks */
};

static inline size_t bsize(const Block *b) { return b->size & ~(uint64_t)15; }
static inline int is_free(const Block *b) { return b->size & FREE_BIT; }
static inline Block *next_phys(const Block *b) { return (Block *)((uint8_t *)b + bsize(b)); }
static inline void *payload(Block *b) { return (uint8_t *)b + HDR; }
static inline int fls64(uint64_t v) { return 63 - __builtin_clzll(v); }

static void mapping(size_t size, unsigned *fl, unsigned *sl) {
    if (size < SMALL) {
        *fl = 0;
        *sl = (unsigned)(size / (SMALL / SL_COUNT));
    } else {
        int f = fls64(size);
        *sl = (unsigned)(size >> (f - SL_LOG)) ^ SL_COUNT;
        *fl = (unsigned)(f - FL_SHIFT + 1);
    }
}

static void insert(Yw4Heap *h, Block *b) {
    unsigned fl, sl;
    mapping(bsize(b), &fl, &sl);
    b->size |= FREE_BIT;
    b->prev_free = NULL;
    b->next_free = h->lists[fl][sl];
    if (b->next_free) b->next_free->prev_free = b;
    h->lists[fl][sl] = b;
    h->fl_map |= 1ull << fl;
    h->sl_map[fl] |= 1u << sl;
    h->free_bytes += bsize(b) - HDR;
}

static void unlink_free(Yw4Heap *h, Block *b) {
    unsigned fl, sl;
    mapping(bsize(b), &fl, &sl);
    if (b->prev_free) b->prev_free->next_free = b->next_free;
    else h->lists[fl][sl] = b->next_free;
    if (b->next_free) b->next_free->prev_free = b->prev_free;
    if (!h->lists[fl][sl]) {
        h->sl_map[fl] &= ~(1u << sl);
        if (!h->sl_map[fl]) h->fl_map &= ~(1ull << fl);
    }
    b->size &= ~(uint64_t)FREE_BIT;
    h->free_bytes -= bsize(b) - HDR;
}

/* A free block of at least `size` bytes, or NULL. The request is first rounded up to the
 * next list, where any block fits (O(1)); only if that finds nothing is the request's own
 * list searched, so that the largest free block can still be allocated whole. */
static Block *find_fit(Yw4Heap *h, size_t size) {
    unsigned fl, sl;
    size_t rounded = size >= SMALL ? size + (1ull << (fls64(size) - SL_LOG)) - 1 : size;
    mapping(rounded, &fl, &sl);
    if (fl < FL_COUNT) {
        uint32_t sl_bits = sl < SL_COUNT ? h->sl_map[fl] & (~0u << sl) : 0;
        uint64_t fl_bits = h->fl_map & (~0ull << (fl + 1));
        if (sl_bits) return h->lists[fl][__builtin_ctz(sl_bits)];
        if (fl_bits) {
            fl = (unsigned)__builtin_ctzll(fl_bits);
            return h->lists[fl][__builtin_ctz(h->sl_map[fl])];
        }
    }
    mapping(size, &fl, &sl);
    if (fl >= FL_COUNT) return NULL;
    for (Block *b = h->lists[fl][sl]; b; b = b->next_free)
        if (bsize(b) >= size) return b;
    return NULL;
}

/* Cuts a used block down to `size`, returning the rest to the free lists (merged with the
 * next block if that is free). */
static void trim(Yw4Heap *h, Block *b, size_t size) {
    if (bsize(b) - size < MIN_BLOCK) return;
    Block *rest = (Block *)((uint8_t *)b + size);
    rest->prev_phys = b;
    rest->size = bsize(b) - size;
    b->size = size;  /* used, so no flag bits */
    Block *n = next_phys(rest);
    if (is_free(n)) {
        unlink_free(h, n);
        rest->size += bsize(n);
        n = next_phys(rest);
    }
    n->prev_phys = rest;
    insert(h, rest);
}

static size_t block_size_for(size_t size) {
    if (size > SIZE_MAX / 2) return 0;
    size_t n = ((size + 15) & ~(size_t)15) + HDR;
    return n < MIN_BLOCK ? MIN_BLOCK : n;
}

Yw4Heap *yw4_heap_create(void *region, size_t size) {
    uint8_t *start = (uint8_t *)(((uintptr_t)region + 15) & ~(uintptr_t)15);
    uint8_t *end = (uint8_t *)(((uintptr_t)region + size) & ~(uintptr_t)15);
    if (end <= start || (size_t)(end - start) < MIN_BLOCK + HDR) return NULL;
    Yw4Heap *h = calloc(1, sizeof *h);
    if (!h) return NULL;
    h->start = start;
    h->end = end;
    Block *first = (Block *)start;
    Block *sentinel = (Block *)(end - HDR);
    first->prev_phys = NULL;
    first->size = (uint64_t)((uint8_t *)sentinel - start);
    sentinel->prev_phys = first;
    sentinel->size = 0;  /* used, size 0: never merged, never walked past */
    insert(h, first);
    return h;
}

void yw4_heap_destroy(Yw4Heap *h) { free(h); }

void *yw4_heap_alloc(Yw4Heap *h, size_t size, size_t align) {
    if (align < 16) align = 16;
    if (align & (align - 1)) return NULL;
    size_t need = block_size_for(size ? size : 1);
    if (!need || align > SIZE_MAX / 4) return NULL;
    /* An aligned payload may need a gap in front, which must be big enough to stay a block. */
    size_t search = align > 16 ? need + align + MIN_BLOCK : need;
    Block *b = find_fit(h, search);
    if (!b) return NULL;
    unlink_free(h, b);
    if (align > 16) {
        uintptr_t p = ((uintptr_t)payload(b) + align - 1) & ~(uintptr_t)(align - 1);
        size_t gap = p - (uintptr_t)payload(b);
        if (gap && gap < MIN_BLOCK) gap += align;  /* align >= 32 here, so this is enough */
        if (gap) {
            Block *a = (Block *)((uint8_t *)b + gap);
            a->prev_phys = b;
            a->size = bsize(b) - gap;
            next_phys(a)->prev_phys = a;
            b->size = gap;
            insert(h, b);  /* the gap's previous neighbour is used, else it would have merged */
            b = a;
        }
    }
    trim(h, b, need);
    return payload(b);
}

/* The used block whose payload is p, or NULL if p isn't one. Walks nothing: checks the
 * header and that both neighbours point back at it, which catches double frees and most
 * stray pointers. */
static Block *checked_block(const Yw4Heap *h, const void *p) {
    if ((const uint8_t *)p < h->start + HDR || (const uint8_t *)p >= h->end - HDR || ((uintptr_t)p & 15))
        return NULL;
    Block *b = (Block *)((uintptr_t)p - HDR);
    if (is_free(b) || bsize(b) < MIN_BLOCK || (uint8_t *)next_phys(b) > h->end - HDR) return NULL;
    if (next_phys(b)->prev_phys != b) return NULL;
    if (b->prev_phys && next_phys(b->prev_phys) != b) return NULL;
    return b;
}

int yw4_heap_is_allocated(const Yw4Heap *h, const void *p) { return checked_block(h, p) != NULL; }

int yw4_heap_free(Yw4Heap *h, void *p) {
    if (!p) return 0;
    Block *b = checked_block(h, p);
    if (!b) return -1;
    Block *n = next_phys(b);
    if (is_free(n)) {
        unlink_free(h, n);
        b->size += bsize(n);
    }
    Block *prev = b->prev_phys;
    if (prev && is_free(prev)) {
        unlink_free(h, prev);
        prev->size += bsize(b);
        b = prev;
    }
    next_phys(b)->prev_phys = b;
    insert(h, b);
    return 0;
}

void *yw4_heap_realloc(Yw4Heap *h, void *p, size_t size) {
    if (!p) return yw4_heap_alloc(h, size, 16);
    Block *b = checked_block(h, p);
    if (!b) return NULL;
    size_t need = block_size_for(size ? size : 1);
    if (!need) return NULL;
    if (bsize(b) < need) {
        Block *n = next_phys(b);  /* grow in place into a free neighbour */
        if (is_free(n) && bsize(b) + bsize(n) >= need) {
            unlink_free(h, n);
            b->size += bsize(n);
            next_phys(b)->prev_phys = b;
        } else {
            void *q = yw4_heap_alloc(h, size, 16);
            if (!q) return NULL;
            memcpy(q, p, bsize(b) - HDR);
            yw4_heap_free(h, p);
            return q;
        }
    }
    trim(h, b, need);
    return p;
}

size_t yw4_heap_total_free(const Yw4Heap *h) { return h->free_bytes; }

size_t yw4_heap_largest_free(const Yw4Heap *h) {
    if (!h->fl_map) return 0;
    unsigned fl = (unsigned)fls64(h->fl_map);
    size_t best = 0;
    for (const Block *b = h->lists[fl][fls64(h->sl_map[fl])]; b; b = b->next_free)
        if (bsize(b) > best) best = bsize(b);
    return best - HDR;
}
```

```c
 * Since decision 0014 the sdk is recompiled and runs itself, so main no longer calls these

    {"_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator8AllocateEmm", hle_mem_StandardAllocator_AllocateAligned},
    {"_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator4FreeEPv", hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Free},
    {"_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator10ReallocateEPvm", hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Reallocate},
    {"_ZNK2nn3mem17StandardAllocator16GetTotalFreeSizeEv", hle_mem_StandardAllocator_GetTotalFreeSize},
    {"_ZNK2nn3mem17StandardAllocator18GetAllocatableSizeEv", hle_mem_StandardAllocator_GetAllocatableSize},
    {NULL, NULL},
};

_Noreturn void yw4_hle_stop(CPUState *ctx, const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ");
    vfprintf(stderr, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    char where[48];
    fprintf(stderr, "\n     called from %s\n", yw4_describe(ctx->x[30] - 4, where));
    yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
}

/* The native implementation of an sdk function, by mangled name, or NULL. Since decision
 * 0014 the sdk itself is recompiled, so nothing reaches these through import stubs any
 * more. They stay until the recompiled sdk passes the same checks (sdkref --check); this
 * lookup is also where symbol overrides (NVN) will come from. */
GuestFn yw4_hle_find(const char *name) {
    for (const HleEntry *e = hle_table; e->name; e++)
        if (strcmp(e->name, name) == 0) return e->fn;
    return NULL;
}

```

```h
/* Shared by the native implementations of sdk imports (HLE, decision 0011).
 *
 * An implementation is a GuestFn: it reads its arguments from x0-x7 / v0-v7 (then the guest
 * stack), as the AArch64 calling convention passes them, and writes its result to x0 or v0.
 * Guest pointers are host pointers (decision 0005), so a guest char* can be used directly.
 */
#ifndef HLE_H
#define HLE_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "c11_keywords.h"  /* before yw4rt.h: its _Noreturn in C++ */
#include "yw4rt.h"

#define GPTR(v) ((void *)(uintptr_t)(v))
#define GADDR(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))

/* nn::Result: 0 is success. */
#define RESULT_SUCCESS 0u

/* Stops the program: an import was used in a way the runtime doesn't support yet, or the
 * game reported a fatal error. Prints the message and the guest address of the call. */
YW4_NORETURN void yw4_hle_stop(CPUState *ctx, const char *fmt, ...);

/* Native implementation by mangled name, or NULL (hle.c). */
GuestFn yw4_hle_find(const char *name);

/* Variadic arguments of a guest call (AAPCS64: integer arguments in x[next_gr..7] then the
 * stack, floating-point ones in v[next_vr..7] then the stack, 8 bytes per stack slot). */
typedef struct {
    CPUState *ctx;
    unsigned next_gr, next_vr;
    uint64_t stack;  /* guest address of the next stack slot */
} GuestVarargs;

/* ... starts after `fixed_gr` integer and `fixed_vr` floating-point named arguments. */
GuestVarargs yw4_varargs(CPUState *ctx, unsigned fixed_gr, unsigned fixed_vr);
uint64_t yw4_vararg_int(GuestVarargs *va);

 * Returns the length the full output would have (like snprintf). */

/* The heap behind nn::mem::StandardAllocator (runtime/src/heap.c): a TLSF allocator over a
 * guest memory region. Plain C, no CPUState, so it's tested on its own. Not thread-safe yet:
 * there is one guest thread so far (decision 0010). */
typedef struct Yw4Heap Yw4Heap;
Yw4Heap *yw4_heap_create(void *region, size_t size);  /* NULL if the region is too small */
```

`runtime/src/hle_diag.c`:

```c
/* nn::diag: the sdk's logging and assertion reporting (decision 0011), plus the guest
 * printf formatting it needs.
 *
 * Guest variadic arguments can't be handed to the host's vprintf: they sit in guest
 * registers and on the guest stack. yw4_guest_format walks the format string, takes each
 * argument from where AAPCS64 puts it, and formats one conversion at a time with snprintf.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"

GuestVarargs yw4_varargs(CPUState *ctx, unsigned fixed_gr, unsigned fixed_vr) {
    GuestVarargs va = {ctx, fixed_gr, fixed_vr, ctx->sp};
    return va;
}

uint64_t yw4_vararg_int(GuestVarargs *va) {
    if (va->next_gr < 8) return va->ctx->x[va->next_gr++];
    uint64_t v;
    memcpy(&v, GPTR(va->stack), 8);
    va->stack += 8;
    return v;
}

double yw4_vararg_double(GuestVarargs *va) {
    if (va->next_vr < 8) return va->ctx->v[va->next_vr++].df[0];
    double v;
    memcpy(&v, GPTR(va->stack), 8);
    va->stack += 8;
    return v;
}

int yw4_guest_format(char *out, size_t size, const char *fmt, GuestVarargs *va) {
    size_t len = 0;  /* length of the full output so far, even past `size` */
#define ROOM (len < size ? size - len : 0)
#define DST (len < size ? out + len : NULL)
    for (const char *p = fmt; *p;) {
        if (*p != '%') {
            if (len + 1 < size) out[len] = *p;
            len++, p++;
            continue;
        }
        /* One conversion: copy flags, width and precision into a host spec, resolving '*'. */
        char spec[48];
        size_t n = 0;
        spec[n++] = *p++;
        while (*p && strchr("-+ #0", *p) && n < 8) spec[n++] = *p++;
        for (int part = 0; part < 2; part++) {
            if (part == 1) {
                if (*p != '.') break;
                spec[n++] = *p++;
            }
            if (*p == '*') {
                n += (size_t)snprintf(spec + n, sizeof spec - n, "%d", (int)(int32_t)yw4_vararg_int(va));
                p++;
            } else {
                while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9' && n < 30) spec[n++] = *p++;
            }
        }
        /* Length modifier: on AArch64, long/size_t/ptrdiff_t/intmax_t are all 64-bit. */
        int bits = 32;
        if (*p == 'h') { p++; bits = 16; if (*p == 'h') { p++; bits = 8; } }
        else if (*p == 'l') { p++; bits = 64; if (*p == 'l') p++; }
        else if (*p == 'z' || *p == 'j' || *p == 't') { p++; bits = 64; }
        else if (*p == 'L') {
            /* long double is 128-bit on AArch64 and passed in a q register: not supported. */
            return snprintf(out, size, "<unsupported %%L in guest format \"%s\">", fmt);
        }
        char conv = *p ? *p++ : '\0';
        int w = 0;
        switch (conv) {
        case 'd': case 'i': {
            int64_t v = (int64_t)yw4_vararg_int(va);
            v = bits == 64 ? v : bits == 32 ? (int32_t)v : bits == 16 ? (int16_t)v : (int8_t)v;
            memcpy(spec + n, PRId64, sizeof PRId64);
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, spec, v);
            break;
        }
        case 'u': case 'x': case 'X': case 'o': {
            uint64_t v = yw4_vararg_int(va);
            v = bits == 64 ? v : bits == 32 ? (uint32_t)v : bits == 16 ? (uint16_t)v : (uint8_t)v;
            const char *m = conv == 'u' ? PRIu64 : conv == 'x' ? PRIx64 : conv == 'X' ? PRIX64 : PRIo64;
            memcpy(spec + n, m, strlen(m) + 1);
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, spec, v);
            break;
        }
        case 'c':
            spec[n++] = 'c', spec[n] = '\0';
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, spec, (int)(unsigned char)yw4_vararg_int(va));
            break;
        case 's': {
            const char *s = GPTR(yw4_vararg_int(va));
            spec[n++] = 's', spec[n] = '\0';
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, spec, s ? s : "(null)");
            break;
        }
        case 'p':
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, "0x%" PRIx64, yw4_vararg_int(va));
            break;
        case 'f': case 'F': case 'e': case 'E': case 'g': case 'G': case 'a': case 'A':
            spec[n++] = conv, spec[n] = '\0';
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, spec, yw4_vararg_double(va));
            break;
        case '%':
            w = snprintf(DST, ROOM, "%%");
            break;
        case 'n':
            yw4_vararg_int(va);  /* writes back a count: never seen in logs, skip the argument */
            break;
        default:
            return snprintf(out, size, "<unsupported %%%c in guest format \"%s\">", conv ? conv : '?', fmt);
        }
        if (w > 0) len += (size_t)w;
    }
    if (size) out[len < size ? len : size - 1] = '\0';
    return (int)len;
#undef ROOM
#undef DST
}

/* nn::diag::LogMetaData: where the log call is, then module name and severity. */
typedef struct {
    int32_t line;
    uint32_t pad;
    const char *file, *function, *module;
    int32_t severity;
} LogMetaData;

/* nn::diag::detail::LogImpl(const LogMetaData&, const char *format, ...) */
void hle_diag_LogImpl(CPUState *ctx) {
    const LogMetaData *meta = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    GuestVarargs va = yw4_varargs(ctx, 2, 0);
    char msg[1024];
    yw4_guest_format(msg, sizeof msg, GPTR(ctx->x[1]), &va);
    size_t n = strlen(msg);
    fprintf(stderr, "[game %s] %s%s", meta->function && *meta->function ? meta->function : "log", msg,
            n && msg[n - 1] == '\n' ? "" : "\n");
}

static const char *str_or(uint64_t p, const char *dflt) {
    const char *s = GPTR(p);
    return s && *s ? s : dflt;
}

/* nn::diag::detail::OnAssertionFailure(AssertionType, const char *condition,
 * const char *function, const char *file, int line). In a release build the strings are
 * empty, so the guest address of the call is the useful part. A failed assertion during
 * start-up means an HLE function returned something the game didn't expect: stop. */
void hle_diag_OnAssertionFailure(CPUState *ctx) {
    yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "game assertion failed (type %u): %s in %s at %s:%d", (unsigned)ctx->x[0],
                 str_or(ctx->x[1], "?"), str_or(ctx->x[2], "?"), str_or(ctx->x[3], "?"), (int)ctx->x[4]);
}

/* nn::diag::detail::AbortImpl(const char *condition, const char *function, const char *file, int line) */
void hle_diag_AbortImpl(CPUState *ctx) {
    yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "game abort: %s in %s at %s:%d", str_or(ctx->x[0], "?"), str_or(ctx->x[1], "?"),
                 str_or(ctx->x[2], "?"), (int)ctx->x[3]);
}

/* nndetailDiagAbortFormatImpl: a C function, so its signature isn't in the symbol. Stop and
 * show the raw arguments rather than guess their meaning. */
void hle_diag_AbortFormatImpl(CPUState *ctx) {
    yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "game abort (nndetailDiagAbortFormatImpl, arguments not decoded): "
                      "x0=%#" PRIx64 " x1=%#" PRIx64 " x2=%#" PRIx64 " x3=%#" PRIx64 " x4=%#" PRIx64 " x5=%#" PRIx64,
                 ctx->x[0], ctx->x[1], ctx->x[2], ctx->x[3], ctx->x[4], ctx->x[5]);
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_libc.c`:

```c
/* The sdk's C library (musl, "nnmusl") as main sees it (decision 0012).
 *
 * __nnmusl_init_dso / __nnmusl_fini_dso are called by main's DT_INIT / DT_FINI with the
 * module's base and section bounds. In the sdk they register main as a module and give it a
 * TLS block in the calling thread. main never reads the thread pointer (no MRS at all,
 * decision 0008), so it has no use for that block: registering it is all bookkeeping the
 * native runtime doesn't need.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>

#include "hle.h"

/* What main's DT_INIT does with the result (main+0x30): 1 = "not now", constructors are
 * skipped and run on the next DT_INIT call; anything else = run the constructors now. The
 * sdk returns only 1 or 2. */
#define INIT_DSO_RUN_CONSTRUCTORS 2

/* int __nnmusl_init_dso(module base, ...section bounds) */
void hle_libc_nnmusl_init_dso(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (ctx->x[0] != yw4_image_base)
        yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "__nnmusl_init_dso for a module at %#" PRIx64 ": only main is loaded", ctx->x[0]);
    ctx->x[0] = INIT_DSO_RUN_CONSTRUCTORS;
}

/* __nnmusl_fini_dso(module base, ...): main's .fini_array is empty, nothing to undo. */
void hle_libc_nnmusl_fini_dso(CPUState *ctx) { (void)ctx; }

/* Function-local statics (Itanium C++ ABI 3.3.2). The guard is 64-bit; the game's inline
 * fast path tests bit 0 of its first byte with an acquire load (ldarb + tbz #0), so that
 * byte = 1 means "initialized". The second byte marks an initialization in progress.
 * One guest thread so far: when threads come, acquire must wait for another thread's
 * initialization instead of treating it as recursion. */

/* int __cxa_guard_acquire(uint64_t *guard): 1 = caller must initialize, 0 = already done */
void hle_libc_cxa_guard_acquire(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint8_t *g = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&g[0], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & 1) {
        ctx->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (g[1]) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "static local at %#" PRIx64 " initialized recursively", ctx->x[0]);
    g[1] = 1;
    ctx->x[0] = 1;
}

/* void __cxa_guard_release(uint64_t *guard) */
void hle_libc_cxa_guard_release(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint8_t *g = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    g[1] = 0;
    __atomic_store_n(&g[0], 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_math.c`:

```c
/* libm: the sdk's math functions, bit-exact (decision 0013).
 *
 * The sdk's libm is musl 1.1.19's (checked against the sdk's own code on the ARM64
 * reference machine: tools/yw4/sdkref.py), compiled for AArch64. Here:
 *  - most functions are musl 1.1.19's C (third_party/musl, one documented patch);
 *  - ceil/floor/sqrt/fabs are single instructions in musl's aarch64 build (FRINTP, FRINTM,
 *    FSQRT, FABS), so they use the recompiler's exact models of those (yw4fp.h, decision
 *    0008). musl's C calls sqrt/sqrtf/floor internally; those calls land here too.
 *  - NaN results are made ARM's: x86 generates a negative default NaN and picks the first
 *    operand when both are NaN; AArch64 generates +NaN (0x7ff8...) and prefers a signalling
 *    NaN (decision 0008). Where musl returns a NaN argument without arithmetic, both
 *    machines already agree.
 *
 * Guest calling convention: double/float arguments and results in v0/v1, pointers and ints
 * in x0.
 */
#include "hle.h"
#include "yw4fp.h"

/* musl 1.1.19 (third_party/musl/yw4/glue.h gives every function a musl_ prefix) */
#define MUSL_DD(n) double musl_##n(double);
#define MUSL_FF(n) float musl_##n(float);
MUSL_DD(acos) MUSL_DD(asin) MUSL_DD(atan) MUSL_DD(cos) MUSL_DD(cosh) MUSL_DD(exp) MUSL_DD(log)
MUSL_DD(log10) MUSL_DD(sin) MUSL_DD(sinh) MUSL_DD(tan) MUSL_DD(tanh)
MUSL_FF(acosf) MUSL_FF(asinf) MUSL_FF(atanf) MUSL_FF(cosf) MUSL_FF(exp2f) MUSL_FF(expf)
MUSL_FF(log10f) MUSL_FF(logf) MUSL_FF(sinf) MUSL_FF(tanf)
double musl_atan2(double, double), musl_fmod(double, double), musl_pow(double, double);
float musl_atan2f(float, float), musl_fmodf(float, float), musl_powf(float, float);
double musl_frexp(double, int *), musl_ldexp(double, int), musl_modf(double, double *);
float musl_modff(float, float *);

/* What musl's aarch64 build has as instructions, also used by musl's own C. */
double musl_sqrt(double x) { return f64_of(f64_sqrt(bits_f64(x))); }
float musl_sqrtf(float x) { return f32_of(f32_sqrt(bits_f32(x))); }
double musl_floor(double x) { return f64_of(f64_rint(bits_f64(x), 'm')); }

/* ARM NaN results (see the top of the file). */
static uint64_t nan64(uint64_t r, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, int nargs) {
    if (!f64_isnan(r)) return r;
    int na = f64_isnan(a), nb = nargs == 2 && f64_isnan(b);
    if (!na && !nb) return F64_DEFAULT_NAN;
    if (na && nb) f64_nans2(a, b, &r);
    return r;
}
static uint32_t nan32(uint32_t r, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int nargs) {
    if (!f32_isnan(r)) return r;
    int na = f32_isnan(a), nb = nargs == 2 && f32_isnan(b);
    if (!na && !nb) return F32_DEFAULT_NAN;
    if (na && nb) f32_nans2(a, b, &r);
    return r;
}

/* Scalar FP results clear the rest of the vector register, as the instructions do. */
static void ret64(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t r) { ctx->v[0].d[0] = r, ctx->v[0].d[1] = 0; }
static void ret32(CPUState *ctx, uint32_t r) { ctx->v[0].d[0] = r, ctx->v[0].d[1] = 0; }

#define DD(n)                                                                        \
    void hle_math_##n(CPUState *ctx) {                                               \
        uint64_t a = ctx->v[0].d[0];                                                 \
        ret64(ctx, nan64(bits_f64(musl_##n(f64_of(a))), a, 0, 1));                   \
    }
#define FF(n)                                                                        \
    void hle_math_##n(CPUState *ctx) {                                               \
        uint32_t a = ctx->v[0].s[0];                                                 \
        ret32(ctx, nan32(bits_f32(musl_##n(f32_of(a))), a, 0, 1));                   \
    }
#define DDD(n)                                                                       \
    void hle_math_##n(CPUState *ctx) {                                               \
        uint64_t a = ctx->v[0].d[0], b = ctx->v[1].d[0];                             \
        ret64(ctx, nan64(bits_f64(musl_##n(f64_of(a), f64_of(b))), a, b, 2));        \
    }
#define FFF(n)                                                                       \
    void hle_math_##n(CPUState *ctx) {                                               \
        uint32_t a = ctx->v[0].s[0], b = ctx->v[1].s[0];                             \
        ret32(ctx, nan32(bits_f32(musl_##n(f32_of(a), f32_of(b))), a, b, 2));        \
    }
DD(acos) DD(asin) DD(atan) DD(cos) DD(cosh) DD(exp) DD(log) DD(log10) DD(sin) DD(sinh) DD(tan) DD(tanh)
FF(acosf) FF(asinf) FF(atanf) FF(cosf) FF(exp2f) FF(expf) FF(log10f) FF(logf) FF(sinf) FF(tanf)
DDD(atan2) DDD(fmod) DDD(pow)
FFF(atan2f) FFF(fmodf) FFF(powf)

/* Instructions in musl's aarch64 build */
void hle_math_ceil(CPUState *ctx) { ret64(ctx, f64_rint(ctx->v[0].d[0], 'p')); }
void hle_math_floor(CPUState *ctx) { ret64(ctx, f64_rint(ctx->v[0].d[0], 'm')); }
void hle_math_sqrt(CPUState *ctx) { ret64(ctx, f64_sqrt(ctx->v[0].d[0])); }
void hle_math_fabs(CPUState *ctx) { ret64(ctx, ctx->v[0].d[0] & ~(1ull << 63)); }
void hle_math_ceilf(CPUState *ctx) { ret32(ctx, f32_rint(ctx->v[0].s[0], 'p')); }
void hle_math_floorf(CPUState *ctx) { ret32(ctx, f32_rint(ctx->v[0].s[0], 'm')); }
void hle_math_sqrtf(CPUState *ctx) { ret32(ctx, f32_sqrt(ctx->v[0].s[0])); }
void hle_math_fabsf(CPUState *ctx) { ret32(ctx, ctx->v[0].s[0] & ~(1u << 31)); }

/* double frexp(double, int *exp). For inf and NaN musl leaves *exp untouched, so the
 * guest's value goes in first. */
void hle_math_frexp(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t a = ctx->v[0].d[0];
    int32_t *out = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    int e = *out;
    double r = musl_frexp(f64_of(a), &e);
    *out = e;
    ret64(ctx, nan64(bits_f64(r), a, 0, 1));
}

/* double ldexp(double, int) */
void hle_math_ldexp(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t a = ctx->v[0].d[0];
    ret64(ctx, nan64(bits_f64(musl_ldexp(f64_of(a), (int)(int32_t)ctx->x[0])), a, 0, 1));
}

/* double modf(double, double *iptr), float modff(float, float *iptr) */
void hle_math_modf(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t a = ctx->v[0].d[0];
    double ip;
    double r = musl_modf(f64_of(a), &ip);
    *(uint64_t *)GPTR(ctx->x[0]) = nan64(bits_f64(ip), a, 0, 1);
    ret64(ctx, nan64(bits_f64(r), a, 0, 1));
}
void hle_math_modff(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint32_t a = ctx->v[0].s[0];
    float ip;
    float r = musl_modff(f32_of(a), &ip);
    *(uint32_t *)GPTR(ctx->x[0]) = nan32(bits_f32(ip), a, 0, 1);
    ret32(ctx, nan32(bits_f32(r), a, 0, 1));
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_mem.c`:

```c
/* nn::mem::StandardAllocator on the native TLSF heap (heap.c, decision 0011).
 *
 * The guest object (wherever the game put it) holds only a pointer to the host-side heap
 * state, in its first 8 bytes; the sdk's own fields are never looked at by game code. The
 * memory handed out is inside the region the game gave to Initialize, as on the Switch.
 *
 * Anything unexpected (a bad pointer, use before Initialize) stops the program instead of
 * returning an error the game might ignore.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>

#include "hle.h"

#define DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT 16

static Yw4Heap **slot(CPUState *ctx) { return GPTR(ctx->x[0]); }

static Yw4Heap *heap_of(CPUState *ctx) {
    Yw4Heap *h = *slot(ctx);
    if (!h) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator %#" PRIx64 " used before Initialize", ctx->x[0]);
    return h;
}

/* StandardAllocator::StandardAllocator() (C1 and C2) */
void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_ctor(CPUState *ctx) { *slot(ctx) = NULL; }

/* Initialize(void *address, size_t size) and Initialize(void *address, size_t size,
 * bool enableThreadCache). The thread cache only changes speed, so it is ignored. */
void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Initialize(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (*slot(ctx)) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator %#" PRIx64 " initialized twice", ctx->x[0]);
    Yw4Heap *h = yw4_heap_create(GPTR(ctx->x[1]), ctx->x[2]);
    if (!h) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator::Initialize(%#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 ") failed", ctx->x[1], ctx->x[2]);
    *slot(ctx) = h;
}

void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Finalize(CPUState *ctx) {
    yw4_heap_destroy(heap_of(ctx));
    *slot(ctx) = NULL;
}

/* void *Allocate(size_t size): NULL when out of memory, as on the Switch. */
void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Allocate(CPUState *ctx) {
    ctx->x[0] = GADDR(yw4_heap_alloc(heap_of(ctx), ctx->x[1], DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT));
}

/* void *Allocate(size_t size, size_t alignment) */
void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_AllocateAligned(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t align = ctx->x[2];
    if (align & (align - 1)) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator::Allocate: alignment %#" PRIx64 " is not a power of two", align);
    ctx->x[0] = GADDR(yw4_heap_alloc(heap_of(ctx), ctx->x[1], align));
}

void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Free(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (yw4_heap_free(heap_of(ctx), GPTR(ctx->x[1])))
        yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator::Free(%#" PRIx64 "): not an allocated block", ctx->x[1]);
}

/* void *Reallocate(void *address, size_t newSize). A null address allocates. Size 0 stops:
 * whether the sdk frees or keeps the block then isn't verified. */
void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_Reallocate(CPUState *ctx) {
    Yw4Heap *h = heap_of(ctx);
    void *p = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    if (p && !yw4_heap_is_allocated(h, p))
        yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator::Reallocate(%#" PRIx64 "): not an allocated block", ctx->x[1]);
    if (p && !ctx->x[2]) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "StandardAllocator::Reallocate to size 0: semantics unverified");
    ctx->x[0] = GADDR(yw4_heap_realloc(h, p, ctx->x[2]));
}

void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_GetTotalFreeSize(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = yw4_heap_total_free(heap_of(ctx)); }

void hle_mem_StandardAllocator_GetAllocatableSize(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = yw4_heap_largest_free(heap_of(ctx)); }
```

`runtime/src/hle_os.c`:

```c
/* nn::os memory: the heap the game carves its allocators from (decision 0011).
 *
 * On the Switch a game asks how much memory it has (QueryMemoryInfo), sets its heap to that
 * (SetMemoryHeapSize) and takes blocks from the heap in 2 MiB units (AllocateMemoryBlock).
 * YW4's nninitStartup takes 0xB9C00000 bytes (~2.9 GiB) for its malloc and a second block
 * for whatever is left. The game never frees a block (FreeMemoryBlock isn't imported), so
 * blocks are handed out bottom-up from one reserved range.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

#define HEAP_BASE 0x7200000000ull  /* just above main (0x7100000000): inside the 39-bit space */
#define BLOCK_UNIT 0x200000ull     /* nn::os::MemoryBlockUnitSize, 2 MiB */

/* What a game sees on a retail 4 GiB Switch: the application pool of the 4 GiB memory
 * arrangement. Taken from the kernel's memory arrangement table, not measured on hardware. */
#define TOTAL_AVAILABLE 0xCD500000ull
#define MAIN_STACK_SIZE (8ull << 20)  /* = GUEST_STACK_SIZE in main.c */

static uint8_t *heap;
static uint64_t heap_size, heap_used;

/* nn::os::QueryMemoryInfo(nn::os::MemoryInfo*) */
void hle_os_QueryMemoryInfo(CPUState *ctx) {
    struct {
        uint64_t total_available, total_used, heap_size, heap_allocated, program_size, stack_size;
        int32_t thread_count;
    } *info = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    info->total_available = TOTAL_AVAILABLE;
    info->program_size = yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].mem_size;
    info->stack_size = MAIN_STACK_SIZE;
    info->heap_size = heap_size;
    info->heap_allocated = heap_used;
    info->total_used = info->program_size + info->stack_size + heap_size;
    info->thread_count = 1;
}

/* nn::Result nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize(size_t). Only the first call (from nninitStartup) is
 * supported: growing or shrinking a heap that blocks were taken from would need more care. */
void hle_os_SetMemoryHeapSize(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t size = ctx->x[0];
    if (size % BLOCK_UNIT || (heap && size != heap_size))
        yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "SetMemoryHeapSize(%#" PRIx64 "): only one heap of whole 2 MiB units is supported "
                          "(current %#" PRIx64 ")", size, heap_size);
    if (!heap) {
        heap = yw4_reserve(HEAP_BASE, size);
        if (!heap) yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "cannot reserve a %#" PRIx64 "-byte heap", size);
        heap_size = size;
    }
    ctx->x[0] = RESULT_SUCCESS;
}

/* nn::Result nn::os::AllocateMemoryBlock(uintptr_t *address, size_t size) */
void hle_os_AllocateMemoryBlock(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t *out = GPTR(ctx->x[0]), size = ctx->x[1];
    if (!size || size % BLOCK_UNIT || size > heap_size - heap_used)
        yw4_hle_stop(ctx, "AllocateMemoryBlock(%#" PRIx64 "): heap %#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 " used",
                     size, heap_size, heap_used);
    *out = GADDR(heap + heap_used);
    heap_used += size;
    ctx->x[0] = RESULT_SUCCESS;
}
```

`runtime/src/hle_string.c`:

```c
/* C library: memory, strings, character classes, integer parsing (decision 0012).
 *
 * Only functions whose result is fully defined by their inputs live here, so the host can
 * compute them. Where C leaves the exact value open (the sign-carrying int of memcmp and
 * friends), musl's choice is reproduced: the difference of the first differing bytes, as
 * unsigned chars. Character classes are musl's "C" locale: ASCII only, nothing above 127.
 *
 * Arguments are taken from x0..x3; int arguments are the low 32 bits.
 */
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"

#define ARG_INT(i) ((int)(uint32_t)ctx->x[i])
#define RET_INT(v) (ctx->x[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int)(v))

/* errno: one for the single guest thread so far (per thread once threads exist). */
static int guest_errno;
void hle_libc_errno_location(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = GADDR(&guest_errno); }

/* Memory */
void hle_libc_memcpy(CPUState *ctx) { memcpy(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]), ctx->x[2]); }
void hle_libc_memmove(CPUState *ctx) { memmove(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]), ctx->x[2]); }
void hle_libc_memset(CPUState *ctx) { memset(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), ARG_INT(1), ctx->x[2]); }

void hle_libc_memchr(CPUState *ctx) {
    ctx->x[0] = GADDR(memchr(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), (unsigned char)ARG_INT(1), ctx->x[2]));
}

void hle_libc_memcmp(CPUState *ctx) {
    const uint8_t *l = GPTR(ctx->x[0]), *r = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    size_t n = ctx->x[2];
    for (; n && *l == *r; n--, l++, r++) {}
    RET_INT(n ? *l - *r : 0);
}

/* errno_t memset_s(void *s, rsize_t smax, int c, rsize_t n) (C11 Annex K): on n > smax it
 * still fills smax bytes and reports EINVAL. */
void hle_libc_memset_s(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint64_t smax = ctx->x[1], n = ctx->x[3];
    if (!ctx->x[0] || smax > (SIZE_MAX >> 1)) {
        RET_INT(EINVAL);
        return;
    }
    memset(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), ARG_INT(2), n > smax ? smax : n);
    RET_INT(n > smax || n > (SIZE_MAX >> 1) ? EINVAL : 0);
}

/* Strings: results are pointers or lengths, identical on any correct libc. */
void hle_libc_strlen(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = strlen(GPTR(ctx->x[0])); }
void hle_libc_strnlen(CPUState *ctx) {
    const char *s = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    size_t n = 0;
    while (n < ctx->x[1] && s[n]) n++;
    ctx->x[0] = n;
}
void hle_libc_strcpy(CPUState *ctx) { strcpy(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1])); }
void hle_libc_strncpy(CPUState *ctx) { strncpy(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]), ctx->x[2]); }
void hle_libc_strcat(CPUState *ctx) { strcat(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1])); }
void hle_libc_strncat(CPUState *ctx) { strncat(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]), ctx->x[2]); }
void hle_libc_strchr(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = GADDR(strchr(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), (char)ARG_INT(1))); }
void hle_libc_strrchr(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = GADDR(strrchr(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), (char)ARG_INT(1))); }
void hle_libc_strstr(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = GADDR(strstr(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]))); }
void hle_libc_strpbrk(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = GADDR(strpbrk(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1]))); }
void hle_libc_strspn(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = strspn(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), GPTR(ctx->x[1])); }

void hle_libc_strcmp(CPUState *ctx) {
    const uint8_t *l = GPTR(ctx->x[0]), *r = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    for (; *l == *r && *l; l++, r++) {}
    RET_INT(*l - *r);
}

/* strcoll in the "C" locale is strcmp. */
void hle_libc_strcoll(CPUState *ctx) { hle_libc_strcmp(ctx); }

void hle_libc_strncmp(CPUState *ctx) {
    const uint8_t *l = GPTR(ctx->x[0]), *r = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    size_t n = ctx->x[2];
    if (!n) {
        RET_INT(0);
        return;
    }
    for (; *l && *r && n > 1 && *l == *r; l++, r++, n--) {}
    RET_INT(*l - *r);
}

static int c_lower(int c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c | 32 : c; }
static int c_upper(int c) { return c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' ? c & 0x5f : c; }

void hle_libc_strcasecmp(CPUState *ctx) {
    const uint8_t *l = GPTR(ctx->x[0]), *r = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    for (; *l && *r && (*l == *r || c_lower(*l) == c_lower(*r)); l++, r++) {}
    RET_INT(c_lower(*l) - c_lower(*r));
}

/* char *strtok(char *s, const char *sep): keeps its position between calls, like libc's
 * (which isn't thread-safe either). */
void hle_libc_strtok(CPUState *ctx) {
    static char *pos;
    char *s = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    const char *sep = GPTR(ctx->x[1]);
    if (!s && !(s = pos)) {
        ctx->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    s += strspn(s, sep);
    if (!*s) {
        pos = NULL;
        ctx->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    pos = s + strcspn(s, sep);
    if (*pos) *pos++ = '\0';
    else pos = NULL;
    ctx->x[0] = GADDR(s);
}

/* Character classes, "C" locale. EOF (-1) and everything above 127 are in no class. */
#define CTYPE(name, test)                                   \
    void hle_libc_##name(CPUState *ctx) {                   \
        int c = ARG_INT(0);                                 \
        RET_INT((unsigned)c < 128 && (test));               \
    }
CTYPE(isdigit, c >= '0' && c <= '9')
CTYPE(islower, c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
CTYPE(isalnum, (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c | 32) - 'a' < 26u)
CTYPE(isxdigit, (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c | 32) - 'a' < 6u)
CTYPE(isspace, c == ' ' || (c >= '\t' && c <= '\r'))
CTYPE(iscntrl, c < 32 || c == 127)
CTYPE(ispunct, c > 32 && c < 127 && !((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c | 32) - 'a' < 26u))
void hle_libc_tolower(CPUState *ctx) { RET_INT(c_lower(ARG_INT(0))); }
void hle_libc_toupper(CPUState *ctx) { RET_INT(c_upper(ARG_INT(0))); }

/* Integers. Guest long is 64-bit (LP64); the Windows host's long is 32-bit, so the long
 * functions go through the long long ones. errno values are the same numbers in musl and
 * the host CRT for the two that occur here (EINVAL 22, ERANGE 34). */
void hle_libc_abs(CPUState *ctx) {
    int v = ARG_INT(0);
    RET_INT(v < 0 ? 0u - (unsigned)v : (unsigned)v);
}

/* int atoi(const char *): as musl, accumulates negatively and wraps on overflow. */
void hle_libc_atoi(CPUState *ctx) {
    const char *s = GPTR(ctx->x[0]);
    unsigned n = 0;
    int neg = 0;
    while (*s == ' ' || (*s >= '\t' && *s <= '\r')) s++;
    if (*s == '-' || *s == '+') neg = *s++ == '-';
    while (*s >= '0' && *s <= '9') n = 10 * n - (unsigned)(*s++ - '0');
    RET_INT(neg ? (int)n : (int)(0u - n));
}

static void strto_finish(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t value, char *end) {
    if (ctx->x[1]) *(uint64_t *)GPTR(ctx->x[1]) = GADDR(end);
    if (errno == ERANGE || errno == EINVAL) guest_errno = errno;
    ctx->x[0] = value;
}

void hle_libc_strtol(CPUState *ctx) {
    char *end;
    errno = 0;
    long long v = strtoll(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), &end, ARG_INT(2));
    strto_finish(ctx, (uint64_t)v, end);
}

void hle_libc_strtoull(CPUState *ctx) {
    char *end;
    errno = 0;
    unsigned long long v = strtoull(GPTR(ctx->x[0]), &end, ARG_INT(2));
    strto_finish(ctx, v, end);
}

/* unsigned long is 64-bit on the guest: the same function as strtoull. */
void hle_libc_strtoul(CPUState *ctx) { hle_libc_strtoull(ctx); }
```

`runtime/src/host.c`:

```c
/* Host threads, locks, condition variables and a monotonic clock (host.h). */
#ifndef _GNU_SOURCE
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include <errno.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "host.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

void yw4_exit(int code, const char *file, int line) {
    const char *base = strrchr(file, '/');
    const char *b2 = strrchr(file, '\\');
    if (b2 && (!base || b2 > base)) base = b2;
    base = base ? base + 1 : file;
#ifdef _WIN32
    MEMORYSTATUSEX m = {.dwLength = sizeof m};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&m))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: exit %d from %s:%d (memory: %llu MiB of %llu free, commit %llu MiB of %llu free)\n", code,
                base, line, (unsigned long long)(m.ullAvailPhys >> 20), (unsigned long long)(m.ullTotalPhys >> 20),
                (unsigned long long)(m.ullAvailPageFile >> 20), (unsigned long long)(m.ullTotalPageFile >> 20));
    else
#endif
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: exit %d from %s:%d\n", code, base, line);
    exit(code);
}

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <process.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#include <psapi.h>

void host_lock_init(HostLock *l) { InitializeSRWLock((PSRWLOCK)l); }
void host_lock(HostLock *l) { AcquireSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)l); }
int host_trylock(HostLock *l) { return TryAcquireSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)l) != 0; }
void host_unlock(HostLock *l) { ReleaseSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)l); }

void host_cond_init(HostCond *c) { InitializeConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }
void host_cond_signal(HostCond *c) { WakeConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }
void host_cond_broadcast(HostCond *c) { WakeAllConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }

void host_cond_wait(HostCond *c, HostLock *l, int64_t timeout_ns) {
    /* Millisecond resolution, rounded up so a wait is never shorter than asked. */
    DWORD ms = INFINITE;
    if (timeout_ns >= 0) ms = timeout_ns >= 0xFFFFFFFEll * 1000000 ? 0xFFFFFFFE : (DWORD)((timeout_ns + 999999) / 1000000);
    SleepConditionVariableSRW((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c, (PSRWLOCK)l, ms, 0);
}

typedef struct {
    void (*fn)(void *);
    void *arg;
} Start;

static unsigned __stdcall thread_entry(void *p) {
    Start s = *(Start *)p;
    free(p);
    s.fn(s.arg);
    return 0;
}

int host_thread_start(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg, size_t stack_size) {
    Start *s = malloc(sizeof *s);
    if (!s) return -1;
    s->fn = fn, s->arg = arg;
    uintptr_t h = _beginthreadex(NULL, (unsigned)stack_size, thread_entry, s, STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION, NULL);
    if (!h) {
        free(s);
        return -1;
    }
    CloseHandle((HANDLE)h);  /* detached: nobody joins guest threads */
    return 0;
}

void host_yield(void) { SwitchToThread(); }

static void (*crash_report)(const char *, uint64_t, uint64_t);

static LONG WINAPI crash_filter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *e) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *r = e->ExceptionRecord;
    const char *what = r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION ? "access violation"
                     : r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_STACK_OVERFLOW ? "host stack overflow"
                     : r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION ? "illegal instruction"
                     : "exception";
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: crash in yw4.exe+%#llx\n",
            (unsigned long long)((uintptr_t)r->ExceptionAddress - (uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleW(NULL)));
    crash_report(what, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)r->ExceptionAddress,
                 r->NumberParameters >= 2 ? (uint64_t)r->ExceptionInformation[1] : 0);
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

void host_install_crash_handler(void (*report)(const char *, uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    crash_report = report;
    SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(crash_filter);
}

/* Windows' default timer ticks every 15.6 ms: Sleep and timed condition-variable waits
 * round up to it, so a 16.7 ms vsync sleep really lasted ~31 ms. timeBeginPeriod(1) makes
 * it 1 ms for the whole process (and its waits). */
void host_timer_init(void) { timeBeginPeriod(1); }

/* A high-resolution waitable timer per thread (Windows 10 1803+: sub-millisecond), else Sleep. */
void host_sleep_ns(int64_t ns) {
    static _Thread_local HANDLE timer;
    static _Thread_local int tried;
    if (ns <= 0) return;
    /* The timer can't wait less than ~0.5 ms, but the game polls its job counters with
     * nn::os::SleepThread(1 us) on the main thread: each poll overslept ~500x. Short sleeps
     * give the core away and check the clock instead (YW4_SHORT_SLEEP=0: the timer, as before). */
    static int short_sleep = -1;
    if (short_sleep < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_SHORT_SLEEP");
        short_sleep = !(e && *e == '0');
    }
    if (short_sleep && ns < 200000) {
        int64_t end = host_now_ns() + ns;
        do SwitchToThread();
        while (host_now_ns() < end);
        return;
    }
    if (!tried) {
        tried = 1;
        timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    }
    LARGE_INTEGER due;
    due.QuadPart = -(ns + 99) / 100;  /* relative, in 100 ns units */
    if (timer && SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    else Sleep((DWORD)((ns + 999999) / 1000000));
}

int64_t host_now_ns(void) {
    static LARGE_INTEGER freq;
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    if (!freq.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&freq);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return (int64_t)((unsigned __int128)now.QuadPart * 1000000000u / (uint64_t)freq.QuadPart);
}

int64_t host_process_age_ns(void) {
    FILETIME created, exited, kernel, user, now;
    if (!GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &created, &exited, &kernel, &user)) return 0;
    GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime(&now);
    return (int64_t)((((uint64_t)now.dwHighDateTime << 32 | now.dwLowDateTime) -
                      ((uint64_t)created.dwHighDateTime << 32 | created.dwLowDateTime)) * 100);  /* 100 ns units */
}

void *host_thread_self(void) {
    HANDLE h = NULL;
    DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &h,
                    THREAD_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION | THREAD_SET_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0);
    return h;
}

void host_thread_set_priority(void *thread, int guest_priority) {
    static int on = -1;  /* YW4_THREAD_PRIO=0: every thread stays at normal priority (tests, A/B) */
    if (on < 0) on = !(getenv("YW4_THREAD_PRIO") && getenv("YW4_THREAD_PRIO")[0] == '0');
    if (!on) return;
    HANDLE h = thread ? (HANDLE)thread : GetCurrentThread();
    int p = THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL;
    if (guest_priority < 38) p = THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST;
    else if (guest_priority <= 40) p = THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL;
    else if (guest_priority >= 58) p = THREAD_PRIORITY_LOWEST;
    else if (guest_priority >= 50) p = THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL;
    SetThreadPriority(h, p);
}

int64_t host_thread_cpu_ns(void *thread) {
    FILETIME created, exited, kernel, user;
    if (!thread || !GetThreadTimes((HANDLE)thread, &created, &exited, &kernel, &user)) return 0;
    return (int64_t)((((uint64_t)kernel.dwHighDateTime << 32 | kernel.dwLowDateTime) +
                      ((uint64_t)user.dwHighDateTime << 32 | user.dwLowDateTime)) * 100);
}

void host_process_usage(int64_t *cpu_ns, uint64_t *rss_bytes) {
    FILETIME created, exited, kernel, user;
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS pmc = {sizeof pmc};
    GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &created, &exited, &kernel, &user);
    *cpu_ns = (int64_t)((((uint64_t)kernel.dwHighDateTime << 32 | kernel.dwLowDateTime) +
                         ((uint64_t)user.dwHighDateTime << 32 | user.dwLowDateTime)) * 100);  /* 100 ns units */
    *rss_bytes = GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &pmc, sizeof pmc) ? pmc.WorkingSetSize : 0;
}

int host_cpu_count(void) {
    DWORD n = GetActiveProcessorCount(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);
    return n ? (int)n : 1;
}

void *host_reserve_watched(uint64_t want, size_t size) {
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_WRITE_WATCH, PAGE_NOACCESS);
    if (!p) {
        DWORD err = GetLastError();
        fprintf(stderr,
                "yw4: host_reserve_watched: VirtualAlloc at %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) failed: error %lu\n",
                want, (uint64_t)size, (unsigned long)err);
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)want, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) {
            char mod[MAX_PATH] = "";
            if (mbi.Type == MEM_IMAGE && mbi.AllocationBase) {
                GetModuleFileNameA((HMODULE)mbi.AllocationBase, mod, sizeof mod);
            }
            fprintf(stderr,
                    "yw4:   collision at %#" PRIx64 ": base=%#" PRIx64 " size=%#" PRIx64 " state=%#x type=%#x%s%s\n",
                    want, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress, (uint64_t)mbi.RegionSize,
                    (unsigned)mbi.State, (unsigned)mbi.Type, mod[0] ? " module=" : "", mod[0] ? mod : "");
        }
    }
    return p;
}

void host_respawn(int argc, char **argv) {
    (void)argc;
    (void)argv;
    SetEnvironmentVariableA("YW4_ASLR_RETRY", "1");
    STARTUPINFOA si = {sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {0};
    char *cmd = _strdup(GetCommandLineA());
    /* The copy goes in a job that is killed when this process's handle to it closes, so stopping this process (a
     * test run's time limit, a launcher closing it) stops the copy too. Without it the copy ran on: a timed bench run
     * that respawned (2026-11-18) left a game open, and every later run refused to start. */
    HANDLE job = CreateJobObjectA(NULL, NULL);
    if (job) {
        JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION lim = {0};
        lim.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
        SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &lim, sizeof lim);
    }
    if (cmd && CreateProcessA(NULL, cmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
        if (job) AssignProcessToJobObject(job, pi.hProcess);  /* before it runs: nothing it starts escapes */
        ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
        WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);
        DWORD code = 0;
        GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code);
        CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
        CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
        free(cmd);
        yw4_exit((int)code, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    free(cmd);
}

/* Write watchpoint: the watched page is made read-only; a write to it faults on the writing
 * thread, which reports it (if it touches [addr, addr + size)), then the page is opened for
 * one single-stepped instruction and protected again. Writes to the page by other threads
 * during that one step are missed. */
static uint64_t ww_addr, ww_size, ww_page;
static void (*ww_report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr);
static _Thread_local int ww_stepping, ww_hit;

static LONG CALLBACK ww_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *e) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *r = e->ExceptionRecord;
    DWORD old;
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && r->NumberParameters >= 2 && r->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1) {
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)r->ExceptionInformation[1];
        if (a < ww_page || a >= ww_page + 4096) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
        ww_hit = a < ww_addr + ww_size && a + 16 > ww_addr;
        if (ww_hit) ww_report((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)r->ExceptionAddress, a);
        VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)ww_page, 4096, PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
        e->ContextRecord->EFlags |= 0x100;  /* trap after this one instruction */
        ww_stepping = 1;
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP && ww_stepping) {
        ww_stepping = 0;
        if (ww_hit) {  /* the watched bytes after the write */
            uint64_t v = 0;
            memcpy(&v, (const void *)(uintptr_t)ww_addr, ww_size < 8 ? ww_size : 8);
            fprintf(stderr, "       -> watched value now %#llx\n", (unsigned long long)v);
        }
        VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)ww_page, 4096, PAGE_READONLY, &old);
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

int host_write_watch(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, void (*report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr)) {
    DWORD old;
    ww_addr = addr, ww_size = size, ww_page = addr & ~(uint64_t)4095, ww_report = report;
    if (!AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, ww_handler)) return -1;
    return VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)ww_page, 4096, PAGE_READONLY, &old) ? 0 : -1;
}

/* Read watchpoint (YW4_TRACE_AI, ai_trace.c): the page is made inaccessible; an access by the game reports it when it
 * touches [addr, addr + size) (any access in the page faults; only those are reported), then the page is opened for one
 * single-stepped instruction and closed again. After `left` reports it stays open. */
static uint64_t rw_addr, rw_size, rw_page;
static long rw_left;
static void (*rw_report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr);
static _Thread_local int rw_stepping;

static LONG CALLBACK rw_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *e) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *r = e->ExceptionRecord;
    DWORD old;
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && r->NumberParameters >= 2 && rw_page) {
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)r->ExceptionInformation[1];
        if (a < rw_page || a >= rw_page + 4096) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
        if (a < rw_addr + rw_size && a + 16 > rw_addr && __atomic_fetch_sub(&rw_left, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) > 0)
            rw_report((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)r->ExceptionAddress, a);
        VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)rw_page, 4096, PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
        if (__atomic_load_n(&rw_left, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) <= 0) {  /* done: the page stays open */
            rw_page = 0;
            return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
        }
        e->ContextRecord->EFlags |= 0x100;
        rw_stepping = 1;
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP && rw_stepping) {
        rw_stepping = 0;
        if (rw_page) VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)rw_page, 4096, PAGE_NOACCESS, &old);
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

int host_read_watch(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, long reports, void (*report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr)) {
    static int added;
    DWORD old;
    rw_addr = addr, rw_size = size, rw_left = reports, rw_report = report, rw_page = addr & ~(uint64_t)4095;
    if (!added && !AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, rw_handler)) return -1;
    added = 1;
    return VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)rw_page, 4096, PAGE_NOACCESS, &old) ? 0 : -1;
}

/* Calls of host_readable and their callers (profile.c reports them for a long frame, 2026-11-12) */
volatile long host_readable_calls;
volatile long long host_readable_ns, host_readable_max_ns;
volatile uintptr_t host_readable_callers[8];
volatile long host_readable_caller_n[8];

__attribute__((noinline)) int host_readable(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    __atomic_add_fetch(&host_readable_calls, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    uintptr_t ra = (uintptr_t)__builtin_return_address(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        uintptr_t c = host_readable_callers[i];
        if (c == ra) { __atomic_add_fetch(&host_readable_caller_n[i], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); break; }
        if (!c && __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&host_readable_callers[i], &c, ra, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) {
            __atomic_add_fetch(&host_readable_caller_n[i], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            break;
        }
    }
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    SIZE_T got = VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, &mbi, sizeof mbi);
    long long dt = host_now_ns() - t0;
    __atomic_add_fetch(&host_readable_ns, dt, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (dt > host_readable_max_ns) host_readable_max_ns = dt;
    if (!got || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) return 0;
    if (!(mbi.Protect & (PAGE_READONLY | PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE))) return 0;
    return addr + size <= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
}

long host_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, void (*fn)(uint64_t page, void *arg), void *arg) {
    enum { BATCH = 4096 };
    static void *pages[BATCH];  /* callers hold the draw path's lock */
    long total = 0;
    for (;;) {
        ULONG_PTR n = BATCH;
        DWORD gran;
        if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, (void *)(uintptr_t)addr, (SIZE_T)size, pages, &n, &gran)) return -1;
        for (ULONG_PTR i = 0; i < n; i++) fn((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pages[i], arg);
        total += (long)n;
        if (n < BATCH) return total;  /* a full batch: there may be more */
    }
}

#include <sys/mman.h>

void host_lock_init(HostLock *l) { pthread_mutex_init(l, NULL); }
void host_lock(HostLock *l) { pthread_mutex_lock(l); }
int host_trylock(HostLock *l) { return pthread_mutex_trylock(l) == 0; }

void host_cond_init(HostCond *c) {
    pthread_condattr_t a;
    pthread_condattr_init(&a);
    pthread_condattr_setclock(&a, CLOCK_MONOTONIC);  /* timeouts don't jump with the wall clock */
    pthread_cond_init(c, &a);
    pthread_condattr_destroy(&a);
}
void host_cond_signal(HostCond *c) { pthread_cond_signal(c); }
void host_cond_broadcast(HostCond *c) { pthread_cond_broadcast(c); }

void host_cond_wait(HostCond *c, HostLock *l, int64_t timeout_ns) {
    if (timeout_ns < 0) {
        pthread_cond_wait(c, l);
        return;
    }
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    int64_t ns = ts.tv_nsec + timeout_ns % 1000000000;
    ts.tv_sec += (time_t)(timeout_ns / 1000000000 + ns / 1000000000);
    ts.tv_nsec = (long)(ns % 1000000000);
    pthread_cond_timedwait(c, l, &ts);
}

typedef struct {
    void (*fn)(void *);
    void *arg;
} Start;

static void *thread_entry(void *p) {
    Start s = *(Start *)p;
    free(p);
    s.fn(s.arg);
    return NULL;
}

int host_thread_start(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg, size_t stack_size) {
    Start *s = malloc(sizeof *s);
    if (!s) return -1;
    s->fn = fn, s->arg = arg;
    pthread_attr_t a;
    pthread_t t;
    pthread_attr_init(&a);
    /* glibc takes the thread's static thread-local storage out of its stack, and refuses a stack too small for it
     * (EINVAL): the vsync thread's 64 KiB was refused on Linux (2026-11-12). The floor is glibc's own default, 8 MiB:
     * AMD's FSR frame interpolation built for Linux (decision 0073) puts a 142 KiB frame on the GPU worker's already
     * deep stack, which overflowed its 1 MiB at the first generated frame (2026-11-14). Stack pages are only used
     * when touched, so the floor costs address space, not memory. */
    if (stack_size < ((size_t)8 << 20)) stack_size = (size_t)8 << 20;
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&a, stack_size);
    pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&a, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
    int r = pthread_create(&t, &a, thread_entry, s);
    pthread_attr_destroy(&a);
    if (r) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: host: pthread_create (stack %zu): %s\n", stack_size, strerror(r));
    if (r) free(s);
    return r ? -1 : 0;
}

void host_yield(void) { sched_yield(); }

static void (*crash_report)(const char *, uint64_t, uint64_t);

static void crash_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *info, void *uc) {
    (void)uc;
    crash_report(sig == SIGSEGV ? "segmentation fault" : sig == SIGBUS ? "bus error" : "illegal instruction", 0,
                 (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)info->si_addr);
}

void host_install_crash_handler(void (*report)(const char *, uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    crash_report = report;
    struct sigaction sa = {0};
    sa.sa_sigaction = crash_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
}

void host_timer_init(void) {}

void host_sleep_ns(int64_t ns) {
    if (ns <= 0) return;
    struct timespec ts = {(time_t)(ns / 1000000000), (long)(ns % 1000000000)};
    while (nanosleep(&ts, &ts)) {}  /* interrupted: sleep the rest */
}

int64_t host_now_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000 + ts.tv_nsec;
}

int64_t host_process_age_ns(void) {
    static int64_t first;
    int64_t now = host_now_ns();
    if (!first) first = now;
    return now - first;
}

void *host_thread_self(void) {
    clockid_t *c = malloc(sizeof *c);
    if (c && pthread_getcpuclockid(pthread_self(), c)) free(c), c = NULL;
    return c;
}

int64_t host_thread_cpu_ns(void *thread) {
    struct timespec ts;
    if (!thread || clock_gettime(*(clockid_t *)thread, &ts)) return 0;
    return (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000 + ts.tv_nsec;
}

void host_thread_set_priority(void *thread, int guest_priority) {
    (void)thread;
    (void)guest_priority;
}

void host_process_usage(int64_t *cpu_ns, uint64_t *rss_bytes) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, &ts);
    *cpu_ns = (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000 + ts.tv_nsec;
    unsigned long pages = 0, resident = 0;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/statm", "r");
    if (f) {
        if (fscanf(f, "%lu %lu", &pages, &resident) != 2) resident = 0;
        fclose(f);
    }
    *rss_bytes = (uint64_t)resident * 4096;
}

int host_cpu_count(void) {
    long n = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
    return n > 0 ? (int)n : 1;
}

/* No write tracking on Linux yet (to do: soft-dirty bits or mprotect): plain reservation,
 * and every page counts as written. */
void *host_reserve_watched(uint64_t want, size_t size) {
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (p != MAP_FAILED && p != (void *)(uintptr_t)want) {
        munmap(p, size);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: host_reserve_watched: mmap placed at %p instead of %#" PRIx64 "\n", p, want);
        return NULL;
    }
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: host_reserve_watched: mmap at %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) failed: %s\n",
                want, (uint64_t)size, strerror(errno));
        return NULL;
    }
    return p;
}

void host_respawn(int argc, char **argv) {
    (void)argc;
    setenv("YW4_ASLR_RETRY", "1", 1);
    execv("/proc/self/exe", argv);
}

    (void)addr, (void)size, (void)fn, (void)arg;
    return -1;
}

    (void)addr, (void)size, (void)report;
    return -1;  /* to do: mprotect + SIGSEGV + single step */
}

    (void)addr, (void)size, (void)reports, (void)report;
    return -1;  /* Windows only for now (YW4_TRACE_AI) */
}

int host_readable(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size) return 1;
    if (addr + size < addr) return 0;
    long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    uint64_t start_page = addr & ~(uint64_t)(page - 1);
    uint64_t end_page = (addr + size - 1) & ~(uint64_t)(page - 1);
    pid_t pid = getpid();
    char dummy;
    struct iovec local = {.iov_base = &dummy, .iov_len = 1};
    for (uint64_t p = start_page; p <= end_page; p += (uint64_t)page) {
        struct iovec remote = {.iov_base = (void *)(uintptr_t)p, .iov_len = 1};
        if (process_vm_readv(pid, &local, 1, &remote, 1, 0) != 1) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
```

`runtime/src/host.h`:

```h
/* Host threads, locks, condition variables and a monotonic clock: the little the kernel
 * needs from the host OS, for Windows and Linux. Private to the runtime. */
#ifndef HOST_H
#define HOST_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "c11_keywords.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
/* SRWLOCK and CONDITION_VARIABLE are one pointer each; zero is their initial state. */
typedef struct { void *p; } HostLock;
typedef struct { void *p; } HostCond;
#define HOST_LOCK_INIT {0}
#define HOST_COND_INIT {0}
#else
#include <pthread.h>
typedef pthread_mutex_t HostLock;
typedef pthread_cond_t HostCond;
#define HOST_LOCK_INIT PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER
#define HOST_COND_INIT PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER
#endif

void host_lock_init(HostLock *l);
void host_lock(HostLock *l);
int host_trylock(HostLock *l);  /* 1: taken; 0: someone holds it (doesn't wait) */
void host_unlock(HostLock *l);

void host_cond_init(HostCond *c);
void host_cond_signal(HostCond *c);
void host_cond_broadcast(HostCond *c);  /* wakes every waiter */
/* Releases l, waits for a signal or at most timeout_ns (< 0: no limit), takes l again.
 * May wake early (spurious wake-ups): callers re-check their condition. */
void host_cond_wait(HostCond *c, HostLock *l, int64_t timeout_ns);

/* Runs fn(arg) on a new detached host thread; 0 on success. */
int host_thread_start(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg, size_t stack_size);
void host_yield(void);

/* Calls report(what, host pc, faulting address) when the process crashes (access
 * violation, segmentation fault...). report should not return. */
void host_install_crash_handler(void (*report)(const char *what, uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr));

/* Sleeps the calling thread for ns (no-op for ns <= 0), to well under a millisecond. */
void host_sleep_ns(int64_t ns);

/* Once at start-up: makes timed waits precise (Windows: 1 ms system timer instead of 15.6). */
void host_timer_init(void);

/* Nanoseconds from an arbitrary start, never going backwards. */
int64_t host_now_ns(void);
/* Nanoseconds since this process was created (Windows: before its DLLs loaded; elsewhere: since the first call). */
int64_t host_process_age_ns(void);
/* Start-up timing (log.c): a "yw4: boot: <ms since the process was created> ms: <what>" line. */
void yw4_boot_mark(const char *what);
/* The machine's OS, CPU, RAM, disk and display session: "yw4: system: ..." lines at the start of every log (sysinfo.c). */
void yw4_sysinfo_dump(void);

/* This process's CPU time so far (user + kernel, all threads) and its memory in use (working set), for the performance log. */
void host_process_usage(int64_t *cpu_ns, uint64_t *rss_bytes);
/* The number of logical processors (at least 1). */
int host_cpu_count(void);
/* A handle to the calling thread, and the CPU time (user + kernel) a thread has used so far. */
void *host_thread_self(void);
int64_t host_thread_cpu_ns(void *thread);
/* Sets the host priority of `thread` (or calling thread if NULL) based on guest priority (0..63). */
void host_thread_set_priority(void *thread, int guest_priority);

/* Address space at exactly `want` with no memory behind it yet, in which the host tracks
 * which pages get written (Windows: MEM_WRITE_WATCH). NULL if the range is taken. */
void *host_reserve_watched(uint64_t want, size_t size);
/* Pages of [addr, addr + size) written since the last call for them: fn(page address) for
 * each, then their tracking starts over. Returns the number of pages, or -1 where the host
 * can't track writes (then anything may have changed). */
long host_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, void (*fn)(uint64_t page, void *arg), void *arg);
/* Can [addr, addr + size) be read now (committed, readable)? For diagnostics. */
int host_readable(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
/* Diagnostics: report(host pc, address) on the writing thread for each write to
 * [addr, addr + size) (one watch per process; Windows only). 0 if armed. */
int host_write_watch(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, void (*report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr));
/* A read watchpoint: report (on the reading thread) up to `reports` reads of [addr, addr + size). 0, or -1. */
int host_read_watch(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, long reports, void (*report)(uint64_t pc, uint64_t addr));

/* Relaunches the current process with a fresh ASLR layout (one retry on memory collision). */
void host_respawn(int argc, char **argv);

/* exit() that says in the log where it came from (and, on Windows, how much memory was left):
 * every exit of the runtime goes through it, so a run that ends without a "crash" line still
 * names what ended it (2026-11-09: a run ended without a word, from one of the silent ones). */
YW4_NORETURN void yw4_exit(int code, const char *file, int line);

#endif

```

`runtime/src/hud.c`:

```c
/* The F1 settings panel (hud.h) drawn into an RGBA image in a 5x7 pixel font of the characters it uses (lower
 * case drawn as upper case, characters without a glyph as blanks). stb_truetype's code is compiled here for
 * ui.c, which draws the overlay's text. */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION  /* for ui.c */
#include "stb_truetype.h"

#include "hud.h"

/* One glyph: 7 rows, the 5 low bits of each, bit 4 the leftmost column. */
static const struct {
    char c;
    uint8_t rows[7];
} glyphs[] = {
    {'0', {0x0E, 0x11, 0x13, 0x15, 0x19, 0x11, 0x0E}}, {'1', {0x04, 0x0C, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x0E}},
```
