```c
    if (mutex & 3) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    /* Wait only if the word still says "owner, with waiters"; otherwise it changed in the
     * meantime and the guest tries again. The word first, then the handle, as mesosphere: the
     * owner may have unlocked, exited and had its handle closed since the guest read the word. */
    if (__atomic_load_n(u32p(mutex), __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) != (owner | WAITERS_BIT)) return R_OK;
    if (!thread_get(owner)) return R_INVALID_HANDLE;
    cur->wait = WAIT_LOCK;
    cur->addr = mutex;
    cur->tag = tag;
    return wait_current(-1);
}

static uint32_t wait_condvar(uint64_t mutex, uint64_t key, uint32_t tag, int64_t timeout) {
    if (mutex & 3) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    release_lock(mutex);
    __atomic_store_n(u32p(key), 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);  /* "someone waits" */
    if (timeout == 0) return R_TIMEOUT;
    cur->wait = WAIT_CONDVAR;
    cur->addr = key;
    cur->mutex = mutex;
    cur->tag = tag;
    /* On a timeout the mutex is NOT held: the sdk takes it again itself (as libnx does). */
    return wait_current(timeout);
}

/* A signalled condition-variable waiter takes its mutex back: at once if it is free, else
 * it becomes a waiter of the mutex (and the owner's unlock will call the kernel). */
static void condvar_wake(KThread *t) {
    uint32_t *word = u32p(t->mutex);
    uint32_t v = __atomic_load_n(word, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t want = v ? v | WAITERS_BIT : t->tag;
        if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(word, &v, want, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) break;
    }
    if (!v) {
        end_wait(t, R_OK);
    } else if (!thread_get(v & ~WAITERS_BIT)) {
        end_wait(t, R_INVALID_STATE);  /* the word names no thread */
    } else {
        t->wait = WAIT_LOCK;  /* keeps waiting, same deadline; joins the mutex's queue now */
        t->addr = t->mutex;
        t->seq = next_seq++;
    }
}

static void signal_condvar(uint64_t key, int32_t count) {
    for (int32_t n = 0; count <= 0 || n < count; n++) {
        KThread *t = first_waiter(WAIT_CONDVAR, key, NULL);
        if (!t) break;
        condvar_wake(t);
    }
    if (!first_waiter(WAIT_CONDVAR, key, NULL)) __atomic_store_n(u32p(key), 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
}

/* ---- address arbiter (mesosphere KAddressArbiter): wait while a word has some value */

static uint32_t wait_for_address(uint64_t addr, uint32_t type, int32_t value, int64_t timeout) {
    if (addr & 3) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    int32_t *word = GPTR(addr);
    switch (type) {
    case 0:  /* WaitIfLessThan */
        if (__atomic_load_n(word, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) >= value) return R_INVALID_STATE;
        break;
    case 1: {  /* DecrementAndWaitIfLessThan */
        int32_t v = __atomic_load_n(word, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        do
            if (v >= value) return R_INVALID_STATE;
        while (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(word, &v, v - 1, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST));
        break;
    }
    case 2:  /* WaitIfEqual */
        if (__atomic_load_n(word, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) != value) return R_INVALID_STATE;
        break;
    default:
        return R_INVALID_ENUM;
    }
    if (timeout == 0) return R_TIMEOUT;
    cur->wait = WAIT_ADDRESS;
    cur->addr = addr;
    return wait_current(timeout);
}

static uint32_t signal_to_address(uint64_t addr, uint32_t type, int32_t value, int32_t count) {
    if (addr & 3) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    int32_t *word = GPTR(addr);
    switch (type) {
    case 0:  /* Signal */
        break;
    case 1: {  /* SignalAndIncrementIfEqual */
        int32_t v = value;
        if (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(word, &v, value + 1, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST))
            return R_INVALID_STATE;
        break;
    }
    case 2: {  /* SignalAndModifyByWaitingCountIfEqual: the new value depends on who waits, as in
                * mesosphere's KAddressArbiter (read 2026-10-21): with waiters, -1 if this signal wakes
                * them all, else unchanged; with none, +1 */
        int n;
        first_waiter(WAIT_ADDRESS, addr, &n);
        int32_t new_value = !n ? value + 1 : count <= 0 || n <= count ? value - 1 : value;
        int32_t v = value;
        if (new_value != value
                ? !__atomic_compare_exchange_n(word, &v, new_value, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)
                : __atomic_load_n(word, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) != value)
            return R_INVALID_STATE;
        break;
    }
    default:
        return R_INVALID_ENUM;
    }
    for (int32_t n = 0; count <= 0 || n < count; n++) {
        KThread *t = first_waiter(WAIT_ADDRESS, addr, NULL);
        if (!t) break;
        end_wait(t, R_OK);
    }
    return R_OK;
}

/* ---- the rest */

static void sleep_thread(int64_t ns) {
    host_unlock(&klock);  /* nothing to wake it: sleep without holding the kernel */
    if (ns <= 0) host_yield();  /* 0, -1, -2: the yield variants */
    else yw4_host_sleep_ns(ns);
    host_lock(&klock);
}

static uint64_t entropy(uint64_t which) {
    /* Fixed for now, so runs are reproducible; real entropy can come later. */
    return 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull * (which + 1) ^ 0x5D5E2B1C3A4F6E7Dull;
}

static uint32_t get_info(uint32_t id0, uint32_t handle, uint64_t id1, uint64_t *out) {
    (void)handle;
    switch (id0) {
    case 0: *out = 0xF; return R_OK;                         /* CoreMask */
    case 1: *out = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull; return R_OK;       /* PriorityMask */
    case 2: *out = YW4_ALIAS_BASE; return R_OK;
    case 3: *out = YW4_ALIAS_SIZE; return R_OK;
    case 4: *out = YW4_HEAP_BASE; return R_OK;
    case 5: *out = YW4_HEAP_SIZE; return R_OK;
    case 6: case 21: *out = TOTAL_MEMORY; return R_OK;      /* Total(NonSystem)MemorySize */
    case 7: case 22: {                                      /* Used(NonSystem)MemorySize */
        uint64_t used = heap_size;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_nmodules; i++) used += yw4_modules[i].mem_size;
        *out = used + yw4_main_stack_size;
        return R_OK;
    }
    case 8: *out = 0; return R_OK;                           /* DebuggerAttached */
    case 9: *out = 0; return R_OK;                           /* ResourceLimit: none */
    case 11: *out = entropy(id1); return R_OK;               /* RandomEntropy, subtype 0..3 */
    case 12: *out = YW4_GUEST_LO; return R_OK;               /* AslrRegion */
    case 13: *out = YW4_GUEST_HI - YW4_GUEST_LO; return R_OK;
    case 14: *out = YW4_STACK_BASE; return R_OK;             /* StackRegion */
    case 15: *out = YW4_STACK_SIZE; return R_OK;
    case 16: case 17: *out = 0; return R_OK;                 /* SystemResourceSize total/used */
    case 18: *out = PROGRAM_ID; return R_OK;
    case 20: *out = 0; return R_OK;                          /* UserExceptionContextAddress */
    default:
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: kernel: GetInfo(%u, %#x, %#" PRIx64 ") not implemented\n", id0, handle, id1);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
}

static void svc(CPUState *ctx, uint32_t imm) {
    uint64_t *x = ctx->x;
    switch (imm) {
    case 0x01: {  /* SetHeapSize(_, size) -> address */
        uint32_t r = set_heap_size(x[1]);
        x[0] = r;
        x[1] = r == R_OK ? YW4_HEAP_BASE : 0;
        return;
    }
    case 0x04:  /* MapMemory(dst, src, size): dst aliases src, src is inaccessible meanwhile */
    case 0x05: {  /* UnmapMemory(dst, src, size) */
        uint64_t dst = x[0], src = x[1], size = x[2];
        if ((dst | src | size) & 0xFFF || !size) { x[0] = R_INVALID_SIZE; return; }
        if (imm == 0x04) {
            /* Copying is equivalent to aliasing: nothing may touch src until UnmapMemory. */
            if (yw4_commit(dst, size)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: kernel: MapMemory: cannot map %#" PRIx64 " bytes at %#" PRIx64 "\n", size, dst);
                yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            }
            memcpy(GPTR(dst), GPTR(src), size);
            region_add(dst, size, dst - YW4_STACK_BASE < YW4_STACK_SIZE ? MEM_STACK : MEM_ALIAS, PERM_RW);
        } else {
            memcpy(GPTR(src), GPTR(dst), size);
            yw4_decommit(dst, size);
            region_remove(dst);
        }
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    }
    case 0x06:  /* QueryMemory(MemoryInfo *out, PageInfo *_, addr) -> page info */
        query_memory(x[2], x[0]);
        x[0] = R_OK;
        x[1] = 0;
        return;
    case 0x08: {  /* CreateThread(_, entry, argument, stack top, priority, core) -> handle */
        uint32_t h = 0;
        x[0] = create_thread(x[1], x[2], x[3], (int32_t)x[4], (int32_t)x[5], &h);
        x[1] = h;
        return;
    }
    case 0x09:  /* StartThread(handle) */
        x[0] = start_thread((uint32_t)x[0]);
        return;
    case 0x0A:  /* ExitThread: does not return */
        if (cur == &main_thread) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: kernel: the main thread called ExitThread: not implemented\n");
            yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        }
        thread_exit(cur);
        host_unlock(&klock);
        longjmp(*exit_jump, 1);
    case 0x0B:  /* SleepThread(ns): 0 / -1 / -2 are yields */
        sleep_thread((int64_t)x[0]);
        return;
    case 0x0C: {  /* GetThreadPriority(_, handle) -> priority */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[1]);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        x[1] = t ? (uint64_t)t->priority : 0;
        return;
    }
    case 0x0D: {  /* SetThreadPriority(handle, priority) */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[0]);
        if (t) {
            t->priority = (int32_t)x[1];
            if (t->host) host_thread_set_priority(t->host, t->priority);
        }
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return;
    }
    case 0x0E: {  /* GetThreadCoreMask(_, _, handle) -> ideal core, affinity mask */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[2]);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        x[1] = t ? (uint64_t)(uint32_t)t->core : 0;
        x[2] = 0x7;  /* cores 0-2: an application's */
        return;
    }
    case 0x0F: {  /* SetThreadCoreMask(handle, ideal core, mask): recorded, not enforced */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[0]);
        if (t && (int32_t)x[1] >= 0) t->core = (int32_t)x[1];
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        return;
    }
    case 0x10:  /* GetCurrentProcessorNumber: the ideal core, as threads don't migrate here */
        x[0] = (uint64_t)cur->core;
        return;
    case 0x11: case 0x12: case 0x17: {  /* SignalEvent / ClearEvent / ResetSignal(handle) */
        KEvent *e = event_get((uint32_t)x[0]);
        if (!e) x[0] = R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        else if (imm == 0x11) yw4_event_signal(e), x[0] = R_OK;
        else if (imm == 0x17 && !e->signaled) x[0] = R_INVALID_STATE;
        else yw4_event_clear(e), x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    }
    case 0x13:  /* MapSharedMemory(handle, address, size, permission) */
        x[0] = map_shared_memory((uint32_t)x[0], x[1], x[2]);
        return;
    case 0x15: {  /* CreateTransferMemory(_, address, size, permission) -> handle */
        uint32_t h = 0;
        x[0] = create_transfer_memory(x[1], x[2], (uint32_t)x[3], &h);
        x[1] = h;
        return;
    }
    case 0x16: {  /* CloseHandle(handle) */
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)x[0];
        KThread *t = thread_get(h);
        if (!ipc_close_handle(h)) yw4_handle_close(h);
        if (t && h != PSEUDO_CURRENT_THREAD) {
            t->handle_closed = 1;
            thread_free_if_done(t);
        }
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    }
    case 0x18: {  /* WaitSynchronization(_, handles, count, timeout ns) -> index */
        int32_t index = -1;
        x[0] = wait_synchronization(x[1], (int32_t)x[2], (int64_t)x[3], &index);
        x[1] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)index;
        return;
    }
    case 0x19: {  /* CancelSynchronization(thread handle) */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[0]);
        if (!t) { x[0] = R_INVALID_HANDLE; return; }
        if (t->wait == WAIT_SYNC) end_wait(t, R_CANCELLED);
        else t->cancel_pending = 1;
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    }
    case 0x1A:  /* ArbitrateLock(owner handle, mutex, requester tag) */
        x[0] = arbitrate_lock((uint32_t)x[0], x[1], (uint32_t)x[2]);
        return;
    case 0x1B:  /* ArbitrateUnlock(mutex) */
        if (x[0] & 3) { x[0] = R_INVALID_ADDRESS; return; }
        release_lock(x[0]);
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    case 0x1C:  /* WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic(mutex, key, tag, timeout ns) */
        x[0] = wait_condvar(x[0], x[1], (uint32_t)x[2], (int64_t)x[3]);
        return;
    case 0x1D:  /* SignalProcessWideKey(key, count; <= 0: all) */
        signal_condvar(x[0], (int32_t)x[1]);
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    case 0x1E:  /* GetSystemTick */
        x[0] = yw4_cntpct();
        return;
    case 0x1F: {  /* ConnectToNamedPort(_, name) -> session */
        uint32_t h = 0;
        x[0] = ipc_connect_named_port((const char *)GPTR(x[1]), &h);
        x[1] = h;
        return;
    }
    case 0x21:  /* SendSyncRequest(session): the message is in this thread's TLR */
        x[0] = ipc_send_request((uint32_t)x[0], ctx->tpidrro_el0);
        return;
    case 0x22:  /* SendSyncRequestWithUserBuffer(buffer, size, session) */
        x[0] = ipc_send_request((uint32_t)x[2], x[0]);
        return;
    case 0x25: {  /* GetThreadId(_, handle) -> id */
        KThread *t = thread_get((uint32_t)x[1]);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_INVALID_HANDLE;
        x[1] = t ? t->id : 0;
        return;
    }
    case 0x26: {  /* Break(reason, info, size): the program stops itself */
        char where[48];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: guest svcBreak(reason %#" PRIx64 ") at %s", x[0], yw4_describe(x[30], where));
        if (x[1] && x[2] == 4)
            fprintf(stderr, ", result %#x (module %u, description %u)", *u32p(x[1]), *u32p(x[1]) & 0x1FF, *u32p(x[1]) >> 9);
        fprintf(stderr, " on thread %" PRIu64 "\n", cur->id);
        backtrace(ctx);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    case 0x27:  /* OutputDebugString(text, size) */
        fprintf(stderr, "[game debug] %.*s\n", (int)x[1], (const char *)GPTR(x[0]));
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    case 0x29: {  /* GetInfo(_, id0, handle, id1) -> value */
        uint64_t v = 0;
        x[0] = get_info((uint32_t)x[1], (uint32_t)x[2], x[3], &v);
        x[1] = v;
        return;
    }
    case 0x34:  /* WaitForAddress(address, type, value, timeout ns) */
        x[0] = wait_for_address(x[0], (uint32_t)x[1], (int32_t)x[2], (int64_t)x[3]);
        return;
    case 0x35:  /* SignalToAddress(address, type, value, count; <= 0: all) */
        x[0] = signal_to_address(x[0], (uint32_t)x[1], (int32_t)x[2], (int32_t)x[3]);
        return;
    case 0x45: {  /* CreateEvent -> writable, readable (one object behind both handles) */
        uint32_t w;
        KEvent *e = yw4_event_new(&w);
        x[0] = R_OK;
        x[1] = w;
        x[2] = yw4_handle_new(&e->obj);
        return;
    }
    default: {
        char where[48];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: unimplemented SVC %#x at %s on thread %" PRIu64 " (x0=%#" PRIx64 " x1=%#" PRIx64
                        " x2=%#" PRIx64 " x3=%#" PRIx64 ")\n", imm, yw4_describe(x[30], where), cur->id, x[0], x[1], x[2], x[3]);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    }
}

/* YW4_WAITPROF=1: where the main thread blocks (SleepThread, WaitSynchronization, ArbitrateLock,
 * WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic, WaitForAddress), per guest call stack: time and count, reported
 * with the performance summary every 600 frames. Only the main thread writes and reads the table. */
#define WAITPROF_SLOTS 256
#define WAITPROF_DEPTH 8
typedef struct {
    uint64_t stack[WAITPROF_DEPTH];
    int depth;
    uint32_t imm;
    uint64_t addr;   /* x0 at the call: the address (or mutex) waited on */
    uint64_t count;
    int64_t ns;
} WaitSite;
static WaitSite wait_sites[WAITPROF_SLOTS];
static int waitprof = -1;
static uint64_t waitprof_thread;  /* YW4_WAITPROF_THREAD=n: watch guest thread n instead of the main thread (0: main) */

static void waitprof_add(uint32_t imm, uint64_t addr, const uint64_t *st, int k, int64_t ns) {
    uint64_t h = imm ^ (addr * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) h = (h ^ st[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    for (uint64_t i = h % WAITPROF_SLOTS, n = 0; n < WAITPROF_SLOTS; i = (i + 1) % WAITPROF_SLOTS, n++) {
        WaitSite *w = &wait_sites[i];
        if (w->count && (w->imm != imm || w->addr != addr || w->depth != k || memcmp(w->stack, st, (size_t)k * 8)))
            continue;
        if (!w->count) memcpy(w->stack, st, (size_t)k * 8), w->depth = k, w->imm = imm, w->addr = addr;
        w->count++, w->ns += ns;
        return;
    }
}

/* The signal side (YW4_WAITPROF): SignalToAddress calls per signalling guest thread, address and stack.
 * Written under klock (in the svc), read under klock by the report. */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t stack[WAITPROF_DEPTH];
    int depth;
    uint64_t tid, addr, count;
} SignalSite;
static SignalSite signal_sites[WAITPROF_SLOTS];

static void signalprof_add(uint64_t tid, uint64_t addr, const uint64_t *st, int k) {
    uint64_t h = (tid * 0x100000001B3ull) ^ (addr * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) h = (h ^ st[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    for (uint64_t i = h % WAITPROF_SLOTS, n = 0; n < WAITPROF_SLOTS; i = (i + 1) % WAITPROF_SLOTS, n++) {
        SignalSite *s = &signal_sites[i];
        if (s->count && (s->tid != tid || s->addr != addr || s->depth != k || memcmp(s->stack, st, (size_t)k * 8)))
            continue;
        if (!s->count) memcpy(s->stack, st, (size_t)k * 8), s->depth = k, s->tid = tid, s->addr = addr;
        s->count++;
        return;
    }
}

/* YW4_HANDOFF_PROBE=<dispatch address>,<done address> (hex, with YW4_WAITPROF=1): times, per frame, the main thread's
 * wait on the done address, its dispatch signal to the dispatch address, and the done signal (from the thread that
 * finishes the job). The wait report prints the averages. Times in a ring under klock. */
enum { PROBE_WAIT0, PROBE_WAIT1, PROBE_DISPATCH, PROBE_DONE };
typedef struct { uint8_t kind; int64_t t; } ProbeEv;
#define PROBE_N 4096
static ProbeEv probe_ev[PROBE_N];
static uint32_t probe_n;
static uint64_t probe_dispatch, probe_done;
static int probe_on = -1;

static void probe_rec(int kind, int64_t t) {  /* klock held */
    probe_ev[probe_n % PROBE_N] = (ProbeEv){(uint8_t)kind, t};
    probe_n++;
}

/* YW4_MUTEX_HOLD=1 (with YW4_WAITPROF=1): how long each guest mutex is held, from a successful ArbitrateLock to the
 * ArbitrateUnlock of the same mutex, per mutex and locking thread. Written under klock; reported with the wait report.
 * It replaces the ArbitrateLock/Unlock wait tally, which these calls go around. LIMITATION: uncontended lock and unlock
 * are done in guest code without a kernel call, so only contended locks are seen here; the hold times this prints are
 * not usable (they pair a lock with a later unlock that may be far apart). The wait tally of ArbitrateLock is the
 * measure that holds: each contended acquisition waits about 15-20 us (see the wait report). */
static int mutex_hold_on = -1;
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, tid, count; int64_t ns; } HoldSite;
static HoldSite hold_sites[64];
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, tid; int64_t since; } HoldOpen;
static HoldOpen hold_open[32];

static void hold_acquire(uint64_t addr, uint64_t tid, int64_t t) {  /* klock held */
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        if (!hold_open[i].addr) { hold_open[i] = (HoldOpen){addr, tid, t}; return; }
}

static void hold_release(uint64_t addr, int64_t t) {  /* klock held */
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        if (hold_open[i].addr != addr) continue;
        uint64_t tid = hold_open[i].tid;
        int64_t dur = t - hold_open[i].since;
        hold_open[i].addr = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < 64; j++) {
            HoldSite *h = &hold_sites[j];
            if (h->count && h->addr == addr && h->tid == tid) { h->count++, h->ns += dur; return; }
            if (!h->count) { h->addr = addr, h->tid = tid, h->count = 1, h->ns = dur; return; }
        }
        return;
    }
}

/* YW4_WAKE_PROBE=1 (with YW4_WAITPROF=1): for each contended guest mutex (an ArbitrateLock that had to wait), how
 * long the waiter waited, and how long after the holder's ArbitrateUnlock it returned (the wake-up). Under klock. */
/* YW4_LOCK_SPIN=<ns>: a contended ArbitrateLock spins up to this long watching the mutex word (outside klock) before it
 * sleeps in the kernel; if the holder lets go in that time, the sleep and wake-up (a few us each) are skipped. 0: off. */
static int64_t lock_spin_ns = -1;

static int wake_on = -1;
typedef struct { uint64_t mutex, t; } WakeUnlock;
static WakeUnlock wake_unl[32];
typedef struct { uint64_t mutex, tid, count; int64_t wake_ns, wait_ns; int depth; uint64_t stack[WAITPROF_DEPTH]; } WakeStat;
static WakeStat wake_stats[64];

static void wake_unlocked(uint64_t mutex, int64_t t) {  /* klock held */
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        if (wake_unl[i].mutex == mutex || !wake_unl[i].mutex) { wake_unl[i].mutex = mutex, wake_unl[i].t = t; return; }
    wake_unl[mutex % 32].mutex = mutex, wake_unl[mutex % 32].t = t;
}

static int wake_find(uint64_t mutex) {  /* klock held: index of the mutex's last unlock, or -1 */
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        if (wake_unl[i].mutex == mutex) return i;
    return -1;
}

static void wake_stat(uint64_t mutex, uint64_t tid, int64_t wake, int64_t wait, const uint64_t *st, int k) {  /* klock held */
    for (int j = 0; j < 64; j++) {
        WakeStat *s = &wake_stats[j];
        if (s->count && s->mutex == mutex && s->tid == tid) { s->count++, s->wake_ns += wake, s->wait_ns += wait; return; }
        if (!s->count) {
            s->mutex = mutex, s->tid = tid, s->count = 1, s->wake_ns = wake, s->wait_ns = wait;
            s->depth = k, memcpy(s->stack, st, (size_t)k * 8);  /* the first call's guest stack */
            return;
        }
    }
}

void yw4_wait_report(FILE *f, int frames) {
    if (waitprof <= 0 || frames <= 0) return;
    static const char *const names[] = {[0x0B] = "SleepThread", [0x18] = "WaitSynchronization",
                                        [0x1A] = "ArbitrateLock", [0x1C] = "WaitProcessWideKey", [0x34] = "WaitForAddress"};
    host_lock(&klock);  /* the watched thread writes the table under klock too */
    int64_t total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < WAITPROF_SLOTS; i++) total += wait_sites[i].ns;
    if (waitprof_thread)
        fprintf(f, "  thread %" PRIu64 " waits, last %d frames: %.2f ms/frame\n", waitprof_thread, frames,
                (double)total / 1e6 / frames);
    else
        fprintf(f, "  main thread waits, last %d frames: %.2f ms/frame\n", frames, (double)total / 1e6 / frames);
    for (int shown = 0; shown < 8; shown++) {
        WaitSite *best = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < WAITPROF_SLOTS; i++)
            if (wait_sites[i].count && (!best || wait_sites[i].ns > best->ns)) best = &wait_sites[i];
        if (!best || best->ns * 100 < total) break;  /* under 1% of the waiting */
        char where[48];
        fprintf(f, "    %.2f ms/frame, %.1f calls/frame, %s at %#" PRIx64 ":", (double)best->ns / 1e6 / frames,
                (double)best->count / frames, names[best->imm], best->addr);
        for (int i = 0; i < best->depth; i++) fprintf(f, " %s", yw4_describe(best->stack[i] - 4, where));
        fprintf(f, "\n");
        best->count = 0, best->ns = 0;  /* taken out of the search; cleared below */
    }
    memset(wait_sites, 0, sizeof wait_sites);
    fprintf(f, "  SignalToAddress calls, last %d frames (signalling thread, address, call stack):\n", frames);
    for (int shown = 0; shown < 8; shown++) {
        SignalSite *best = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < WAITPROF_SLOTS; i++)
            if (signal_sites[i].count && (!best || signal_sites[i].count > best->count)) best = &signal_sites[i];
        if (!best) break;
        char where[48];
        fprintf(f, "    %.2f calls/frame, thread %" PRIu64 ", address %#" PRIx64 ":", (double)best->count / frames,
                best->tid, best->addr);
        for (int i = 0; i < best->depth; i++) fprintf(f, " %s", yw4_describe(best->stack[i] - 4, where));
        fprintf(f, "\n");
        best->count = 0;  /* taken out of the search; cleared below */
    }
    memset(signal_sites, 0, sizeof signal_sites);
    if (wake_on > 0) {
        fprintf(f, "  contended mutex waits, last %d frames (mutex, waiting thread): per frame, average wait, average wake after unlock\n", frames);
        for (int shown = 0; shown < 8; shown++) {
            WakeStat *best = NULL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++)
                if (wake_stats[i].count && (!best || wake_stats[i].wait_ns > best->wait_ns)) best = &wake_stats[i];
            if (!best) break;
            fprintf(f, "    %.2f per frame, mutex %#" PRIx64 ", thread %" PRIu64 ": waited %.1f us, woke %.1f us after the unlock\n",
                    (double)best->count / frames, best->mutex, best->tid, (double)best->wait_ns / best->count / 1e3,
                    (double)best->wake_ns / best->count / 1e3);
            char where[48];
            fprintf(f, "      from:");
            for (int i = 0; i < best->depth; i++) fprintf(f, " %s", yw4_describe(best->stack[i] - 4, where));
            fprintf(f, "\n");
            best->count = 0;
        }
        memset(wake_stats, 0, sizeof wake_stats);
        memset(wake_unl, 0, sizeof wake_unl);
    }
    if (mutex_hold_on > 0) {
        fprintf(f, "  mutex holds, last %d frames (mutex, locking thread: holds per frame, average hold):\n", frames);
        for (int shown = 0; shown < 8; shown++) {
            HoldSite *best = NULL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++)
                if (hold_sites[i].count && (!best || hold_sites[i].ns > best->ns)) best = &hold_sites[i];
            if (!best) break;
            fprintf(f, "    %.2f per frame, mutex %#" PRIx64 ", thread %" PRIu64 ": average %.3f ms, total %.2f ms a frame\n",
                    (double)best->count / frames, best->addr, best->tid, (double)best->ns / best->count / 1e6,
                    (double)best->ns / 1e6 / frames);
            best->count = 0;
        }
        memset(hold_sites, 0, sizeof hold_sites);
    }
    if (probe_on > 0) {  /* the hand-off probe: averages over the events since the last report */
        uint32_t n = probe_n < PROBE_N ? probe_n : PROBE_N, start = probe_n - n;
        double wait = 0, work = 0, t20 = 0, tail = 0;
        int nw = 0, nwork = 0, nt20 = 0, ntail = 0;
        int64_t w0 = -1, w1 = -1, disp = -1;
        int tail_done = 1, t20_done = 1, kinds[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ProbeEv e = probe_ev[(start + i) % PROBE_N];
            kinds[e.kind]++;
            switch (e.kind) {
            case PROBE_WAIT0:  /* a main-thread wait starts; the dispatch-to-this-wait gap counts once per cycle */
                if (disp >= 0 && !tail_done) tail += (double)(e.t - disp), ntail++, tail_done = 1;
                w0 = e.t;
                break;
            case PROBE_WAIT1:
                if (w0 >= 0) wait += (double)(e.t - w0), nw++;
                w1 = e.t;
                break;
            case PROBE_DISPATCH:
                if (w1 >= 0) work += (double)(e.t - w1), nwork++;
                disp = e.t, w1 = -1, tail_done = 0, t20_done = 0;
                break;
            case PROBE_DONE:  /* the job's done signal, from the worker thread */
                if (disp >= 0 && !t20_done) t20 += (double)(e.t - disp), nt20++, t20_done = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        fprintf(f, "  hand-off probe events: wait start %d, wait end %d, dispatch %d, done %d\n",
                kinds[PROBE_WAIT0], kinds[PROBE_WAIT1], kinds[PROBE_DISPATCH], kinds[PROBE_DONE]);
        fprintf(f, "  hand-off probe, last %d frames: main waits %.2f ms (%d), main work before dispatch %.2f ms (%d),"
                   " dispatch to done %.2f ms (%d), dispatch to next wait %.2f ms (%d)\n", frames,
                nw ? wait / nw / 1e6 : 0.0, nw, nwork ? work / nwork / 1e6 : 0.0, nwork,
                nt20 ? t20 / nt20 / 1e6 : 0.0, nt20, ntail ? tail / ntail / 1e6 : 0.0, ntail);
        probe_n = 0;
    }
    host_unlock(&klock);
}

void yw4_svc(CPUState *ctx, uint32_t imm) {
    static int trace = -1;
    if (trace < 0) {
        const char *t = getenv("YW4_TRACE_SVC");
        trace = t && *t && *t != '0';
    }
    if (waitprof < 0) {
        const char *t = getenv("YW4_WAITPROF");
        waitprof = t && *t && *t != '0';
    }
    if (lock_spin_ns < 0) {
        const char *s = getenv("YW4_LOCK_SPIN");
        lock_spin_ns = s ? atoll(s) : 0;
    }
    if (lock_spin_ns > 0 && imm == 0x1A) {
        uint32_t *m = u32p(ctx->x[1]);
        uint32_t seen = __atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        int64_t until = host_now_ns() + lock_spin_ns;
        while (__atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == seen && host_now_ns() < until) { }
    }
    if (wake_on < 0) wake_on = getenv("YW4_WAKE_PROBE") && *getenv("YW4_WAKE_PROBE") != '0';
    if (wake_on && (imm == 0x1A || imm == 0x1B)) {
        host_lock(&klock);
        if (imm == 0x1B) {
            wake_unlocked(ctx->x[0], host_now_ns());
            svc(ctx, imm);
        } else {
            uint64_t mutex = ctx->x[1], tid = cur ? cur->id : 0, st[WAITPROF_DEPTH];
            int k = yw4_call_stack(ctx, st, WAITPROF_DEPTH);
            int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
            svc(ctx, imm);
            int64_t t1 = host_now_ns();
            int i = ctx->x[0] == R_OK ? wake_find(mutex) : -1;
            if (i >= 0) {
                int64_t wake = t1 - wake_unl[i].t;
                wake_unl[i].mutex = 0;  /* consumed: one wake per unlock */
                if (t1 - t0 > 2000 && wake < 5000000) wake_stat(mutex, tid, wake, t1 - t0, st, k);
            }
        }
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    if (mutex_hold_on < 0) mutex_hold_on = getenv("YW4_MUTEX_HOLD") && *getenv("YW4_MUTEX_HOLD") != '0';
    if (mutex_hold_on && (imm == 0x1A || imm == 0x1B)) {
        host_lock(&klock);
        uint64_t mutex = imm == 0x1A ? ctx->x[1] : ctx->x[0], tid = cur ? cur->id : 0;
        svc(ctx, imm);
        int64_t t = host_now_ns();
        if (imm == 0x1A && ctx->x[0] == R_OK) hold_acquire(mutex, tid, t);
        if (imm == 0x1B) hold_release(mutex, t);
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    if (probe_on < 0) {  /* once: YW4_HANDOFF_PROBE=<dispatch>,<done> */
        const char *p = getenv("YW4_HANDOFF_PROBE");
        char *e = NULL;
        probe_dispatch = p ? strtoull(p, &e, 0) : 0;
        probe_done = e && *e == ',' ? strtoull(e + 1, NULL, 0) : 0;
        probe_on = probe_dispatch && probe_done;
    }
    if (probe_on && imm == 0x34 && cur == &main_thread && ctx->x[0] == probe_done) {
        host_lock(&klock);
        probe_rec(PROBE_WAIT0, host_now_ns());
        svc(ctx, imm);
        probe_rec(PROBE_WAIT1, host_now_ns());
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    if (probe_on && imm == 0x35 && ((ctx->x[0] == probe_dispatch && cur == &main_thread) || ctx->x[0] == probe_done)) {
        int done = ctx->x[0] == probe_done;
        host_lock(&klock);
        svc(ctx, imm);
        probe_rec(done ? PROBE_DONE : PROBE_DISPATCH, host_now_ns());
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    if (waitprof && !waitprof_thread) {  /* once: which thread the waits are watched on */
        const char *w = getenv("YW4_WAITPROF_THREAD");
        waitprof_thread = w ? strtoull(w, NULL, 10) : 0;
    }
    if (waitprof && (waitprof_thread ? cur->id == waitprof_thread : cur == &main_thread) &&
        (imm == 0x0B || imm == 0x18 || imm == 0x1A || imm == 0x1C || imm == 0x34)) {
        uint64_t st[WAITPROF_DEPTH];
        int k = yw4_call_stack(ctx, st, WAITPROF_DEPTH);
        uint64_t addr = ctx->x[0];
        if (imm == 0x1A) {  /* ArbitrateLock: x0 is the owner's handle; tally the owner's thread id (bit 40 marks it) */
            host_lock(&klock);
            KThread *ot = thread_get((uint32_t)ctx->x[0]);
            host_unlock(&klock);
            if (ot) addr = ((uint64_t)ot->id) | (1ull << 40);
        }
        int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
        host_lock(&klock);
        svc(ctx, imm);
        waitprof_add(imm, addr, st, k, host_now_ns() - t0);
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    if (waitprof && imm == 0x35) {  /* SignalToAddress: who signals the address the waits above are on */
        uint64_t st[WAITPROF_DEPTH];
        int k = yw4_call_stack(ctx, st, WAITPROF_DEPTH);
        uint64_t addr = ctx->x[0], tid = cur ? cur->id : 0;
        host_lock(&klock);
        svc(ctx, imm);
        signalprof_add(tid, addr, st, k);
        host_unlock(&klock);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t in[4] = {ctx->x[0], ctx->x[1], ctx->x[2], ctx->x[3]};
    host_lock(&klock);
    svc(ctx, imm);
    if (trace)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: [t%" PRIu64 "] svc %#04x(%#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 ") -> %#" PRIx64
                        " %#" PRIx64 "\n", cur->id, imm, in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3], ctx->x[0], ctx->x[1]);
    host_unlock(&klock);
}

extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */

extern int yw4_replay_done;  /* svc_hid.c */

/* Replays that don't drift: while a replay (YW4_REPLAY) gives the input, the thread that presents (the game's main
 * loop) reads a counter that moves exactly 1/60 s per presented frame, so the game's time step (nnMain measures it
 * with this counter) is a fixed 1/60; plus one count per read so a wait on it can't stand still. Other threads keep
 * real time. svc_hid.c plays the replay by presented frame (vi.c). A slow loading screen or shader build then no
 * longer shifts what happens after it: the town walk ended in the same place 3 runs of 3 (2026-10-31), against 3
 * different places on the wall clock. The game's time then follows its frames, not the wall: right for tests, not
 * for timing. When the replay hands over (its last line), real time again, never going back.
 * YW4_REPLAY_CLOCK=real: the replay on the wall clock as before. */
int yw4_replay_frame_clock(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("YW4_REPLAY") && !(getenv("YW4_REPLAY_CLOCK") && !strcmp(getenv("YW4_REPLAY_CLOCK"), "real"));
    /* from the start (the boot logos too, or the title comes up on a different frame each run) to the hand-over */
    return on && !__atomic_load_n(&yw4_replay_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}

static uint64_t real_cntpct(void);

/* CNTPCT_EL0 counts at 19.2 MHz from boot on the Switch: here, from the first call. */
uint64_t yw4_cntpct(void) {
    if (!cur || !(cur->roles & YW4_ROLE_PRESENT)) return real_cntpct();
    static uint64_t base, last, offset;  /* the main loop's thread only */
    if (yw4_replay_frame_clock()) {
        /* YW4_REPLAY_HZ=<rate> (tests): from presented frame YW4_REPLAY_HZ_AT on, each frame moves 1/rate s instead
         * of 1/60, so the game's logic steps as at that frame rate (issue #9: a running jump at 30 vs 120 fps) */
        static uint64_t step_hz, hz_at, acc, acc_frame;
        static int hz_read;
        if (!hz_read) {
            const char *e = getenv("YW4_REPLAY_HZ"), *a = getenv("YW4_REPLAY_HZ_AT");
            step_hz = e && atoi(e) > 0 ? 19200000u / (uint64_t)atoi(e) : 320000u;
            hz_at = a ? strtoull(a, NULL, 10) : 0;
            hz_read = 1;
        }
        uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (!base) base = real_cntpct(), acc_frame = f;
        for (; acc_frame < f; acc_frame++) acc += acc_frame >= hz_at ? step_hz : 320000u;  /* 19.2 MHz / 60 */
        uint64_t v = base + acc;
        last = v > last ? v : last + 1;
        return last;
    }
    uint64_t r = real_cntpct();
    if (r + offset <= last) offset = last + 1 - r;  /* after a frame-clock replay: real time on from where it was */
    return last = r + offset;
}

static uint64_t real_cntpct(void) {
    static int64_t start;
    int64_t now = host_now_ns();
    int64_t s = __atomic_load_n(&start, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (!s) {
        int64_t zero = 0;
        __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&start, &zero, now, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        s = __atomic_load_n(&start, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    return (uint64_t)((unsigned __int128)(now - s) * 192u / 10000u);
}

void yw4_msr_fpcr(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t value) {
    if (value != 0) {  /* rounding modes, flush-to-zero, default NaN: not modelled (decision 0008) */
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: guest sets FPCR to %#" PRIx64 "; only 0 is supported\n", value);
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    ctx->fpcr = 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/kernel.h`:

```h
/* The Horizon kernel as the recompiled sdk sees it (decision 0014): private to the runtime. */
#ifndef KERNEL_H
#define KERNEL_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "c11_keywords.h"  /* before yw4rt.h: its _Noreturn in C++ */
#include "yw4rt.h"

#include <stdio.h>

/* Performance log: what a guest thread was seen doing, and each thread's CPU use. */
enum { YW4_ROLE_PRESENT = 1, YW4_ROLE_SUBMIT = 2, YW4_ROLE_ANY = 4 /* profile.c: every guest thread, at its start */ };
void yw4_thread_role(int role);
/* The guest thread id of the calling thread (the performance report's "thread N"); 0 if none. */
uint64_t yw4_thread_id(void);
void yw4_thread_cpu_report(FILE *f, int64_t interval_ns);
/* The writable regions of the game's memory (heap, data, mappings), up to max; their count. */
int yw4_memory_rw_regions(uint64_t *addr, uint64_t *size, int max);
/* YW4_MEMSCAN (memscan.c): the memory search's work for this presented frame. */
void yw4_memscan_frame(uint64_t frame);
/* YW4_MEMSCAN=<value>@live: Insert was pressed (window.c): a sample at the next frame. */
void yw4_memscan_key(void);
/* YW4_WAITPROF=1: where the main thread blocked over the last `frames` frames (then cleared). */
void yw4_wait_report(FILE *f, int frames);

/* Horizon memory types and permissions, as svcQueryMemory reports them. */
enum {
    MEM_UNMAPPED = 0x00, MEM_CODE_STATIC = 0x03, MEM_CODE_MUTABLE = 0x04, MEM_HEAP = 0x05,
    MEM_SHARED = 0x06, MEM_ALIAS = 0x07, MEM_STACK = 0x0B, MEM_THREAD_LOCAL = 0x0C,
};
enum { PERM_NONE = 0, PERM_R = 1, PERM_W = 2, PERM_X = 4, PERM_RW = 3, PERM_RX = 5 };

/* Kernel objects behind handles. Each kind embeds KObject first. */
typedef enum { KOBJ_THREAD = 1, KOBJ_SESSION, KOBJ_EVENT, KOBJ_SHARED_MEMORY, KOBJ_TRANSFER_MEMORY } KType;
typedef struct {
    KType type;
} KObject;

uint32_t yw4_handle_new(KObject *o);
KObject *yw4_handle_get(uint32_t h);   /* NULL if not a valid handle */
void yw4_handle_close(uint32_t h);     /* forgets the handle; the object's owner frees it */

/* Events: signalled by the kernel or a service, waited on by the game (WaitSynchronization).
 * Like everything here, call only while the kernel lock is held: from inside an SVC or a
 * service command (decision 0015). */
typedef struct {
    KObject obj;
    int signaled;
    int host_signalled;  /* a host thread signals it (vsync...): waiting on it is never a deadlock */
} KEvent;
KEvent *yw4_event_new(uint32_t *handle);  /* a new unsignalled event and a handle to it */
void yw4_event_signal(KEvent *e);
void yw4_event_signal_from_host(KEvent *e);  /* the same from a host thread: takes the kernel lock */
void yw4_event_clear(KEvent *e);

/* Shared memory a service gives the game: the game maps it at an address of its choice
 * (svcMapSharedMemory); on_map then fills it. */
typedef struct KSharedMemory KSharedMemory;
struct KSharedMemory {
    KObject obj;
    uint64_t size;
    uint64_t guest_addr;  /* 0 until mapped */
    void (*on_map)(KSharedMemory *m);
};
KSharedMemory *yw4_shared_memory_new(uint64_t size, void (*on_map)(KSharedMemory *), uint32_t *handle);

/* Transfer memory: a block of the game's own memory it lends to a service
 * (svcCreateTransferMemory, then passed in an IPC message). The service uses it in place. */
typedef struct {
    KObject obj;
    uint64_t addr, size;
    uint32_t perm;  /* what the game itself may still do with it meanwhile */
} KTransferMemory;
KTransferMemory *yw4_transfer_memory_get(uint32_t handle);  /* NULL if not one */

/* The display's vsync (vi.c): a 60 Hz host thread, started on first use. */
void yw4_vsync_start(void);
/* Controller input into hid's shared memory (svc_hid.c); the vsync thread calls it. */
void yw4_hid_update(uint64_t tick);
/* The buttons yw4_hid_update last gave the game (Switch bits: A 0, B 1, X 2... as the npad state); any thread. */
uint64_t hid_current_buttons(void);
uint64_t yw4_vsync_count(void);
void yw4_wait_vsync(uint64_t n);  /* until vsync number n has happened */

/* For native code that runs inside a guest call rather than an SVC (overrides) and needs
 * kernel objects: the lock every SVC holds. */
void yw4_kernel_lock(void);
void yw4_kernel_unlock(void);

/* Stops the program after printing the current guest thread and its backtrace: for "not
 * implemented yet" stops reached from guest code (any guest thread, lock held or not). */
YW4_NORETURN void yw4_stop(void);
/* Up to n return addresses of ctx's guest call stack (frame-pointer chain); how many. */
int yw4_call_stack(const CPUState *ctx, uint64_t *out, int n);
/* YW4_WATCHW: report every write to [addr, addr + size) with the writer's call stack. */
int yw4_write_watch_arm(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
/* YW4_TRACE_AI: report up to `reports` reads of [addr, addr + size) with the reader's call stack. */
int yw4_read_watch_arm(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, long reports);

/* Sets up the memory map (modules, main stack, thread-local regions) and the main thread,
 * which runs on the calling host thread with `ctx` (its TPIDRRO_EL0 is set here); returns
 * the main thread's handle. Call after yw4_load_modules. */
uint32_t yw4_kernel_init(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t stack, uint64_t stack_size);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/loader.c`:

```c
/* Load the recompiled modules and relocate them (decisions 0010, 0014).
 *
 * Does what the Switch's rtld does, minus symbol lookup (already done at translation time):
 *   1. reserve one block per module for its image and .bss, at its preferred address if
 *      possible (main at its Switch address 0x7100000000, the sdk right after it)
 *   2. copy the flat image, after checking its size and SHA-256 against the build
 *   3. RELATIVE relocations: base + addend
 *   4. symbolic relocations: the target module's base + value (or 0 for weak symbols
 *      nobody defines)
 */
#ifndef _GNU_SOURCE
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#ifndef MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
#define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE 0x100000
#endif
#endif

#include "host.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

uint64_t yw4_image_base;
uint64_t yw4_sdk_base;

/* Which 4 KiB pages of the guest's range [YW4_MAP_LO, YW4_MAP_HI) have memory: one bit each (1 MiB), set by
 * yw4_reserve and yw4_commit once the memory is there, cleared by yw4_decommit before it goes. Asking this instead of
 * VirtualQuery (host_readable): the graphics driver holds the process's address-space lock while it makes GPU memory,
 * and VirtualQuery waits for it, up to 41 ms a call; the render threads' calls froze the first Demon Hand of a
 * session for 125-344 ms (2026-11-12). */
#define YW4_MAP_LO YW4_GUEST_LO  /* the whole guest range (yw4load.h) */
#define YW4_MAP_HI YW4_GUEST_HI
static uint64_t page_map[(YW4_MAP_HI - YW4_MAP_LO) >> 12 >> 6];

static void map_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int on) {
    if (!size) return;
    uint64_t lo = addr < YW4_MAP_LO ? YW4_MAP_LO : addr, hi = addr + size > YW4_MAP_HI ? YW4_MAP_HI : addr + size;
    if (lo >= hi) return;
    for (uint64_t p = (lo - YW4_MAP_LO) >> 12, e = (hi - YW4_MAP_LO + 4095) >> 12; p < e; p++) {
        uint64_t bit = 1ull << (p & 63);
        if (on) __atomic_fetch_or(&page_map[p >> 6], bit, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        else __atomic_fetch_and(&page_map[p >> 6], ~bit, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
}

/* 1: every page of [addr, addr + size) has memory (by the map); 0: not, or outside the guest range (-1: unknown) */
int yw4_guest_mapped(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (addr < YW4_MAP_LO || addr + size > YW4_MAP_HI || addr + size < addr) return -1;
    for (uint64_t p = (addr - YW4_MAP_LO) >> 12, e = (addr + size - YW4_MAP_LO + 4095) >> 12; p < e; p++)
        if (!(__atomic_load_n(&page_map[p >> 6], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) >> (p & 63) & 1)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

void *yw4_reserve(uint64_t want, size_t size) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!p && want) p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!p && want) p = VirtualAlloc(NULL, size, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (p) map_pages((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, size, 1);
    return p;
#else
    if (want && mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE) == 0) {  /* inside the reserved range */
        map_pages(want, size, 1);
        return (void *)(uintptr_t)want;
    }
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    if (p != MAP_FAILED) map_pages((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, size, 1);
    return p == MAP_FAILED ? NULL : p;
#endif
}

/* Address space without memory behind it, at exactly `want` (NULL if taken). */
void *yw4_reserve_range(uint64_t want, size_t size) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS);
    if (!p) {
        DWORD err = GetLastError();
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: yw4_reserve_range: VirtualAlloc at %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) failed: error %lu\n",
                want, (uint64_t)size, (unsigned long)err);
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)want, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) {
            char mod[MAX_PATH] = "";
            if (mbi.Type == MEM_IMAGE && mbi.AllocationBase) {
                GetModuleFileNameA((HMODULE)mbi.AllocationBase, mod, sizeof mod);
            }
            fprintf(stderr,
                    "yw4:   collision at %#" PRIx64 ": base=%#" PRIx64 " size=%#" PRIx64 " state=%#x type=%#x%s%s\n",
                    want, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress, (uint64_t)mbi.RegionSize,
                    (unsigned)mbi.State, (unsigned)mbi.Type, mod[0] ? " module=" : "", mod[0] ? mod : "");
        }
    }
    return p;
#else
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)want, size, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (p != MAP_FAILED && p != (void *)(uintptr_t)want) {
        munmap(p, size);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: yw4_reserve_range: mmap placed at %p instead of %#" PRIx64 "\n", p, want);
        return NULL;
    }
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: yw4_reserve_range: mmap at %#" PRIx64 " (%" PRIu64 " bytes) failed: %s\n",
                want, (uint64_t)size, strerror(errno));
        return NULL;
    }
    return p;
#endif
}

/* Zeroed read/write memory inside a reserved range; 0 on success. */
volatile uint32_t yw4_memory_generation;

/* Only yw4_decommit changes yw4_memory_generation: a commit can turn "not readable" into "readable", never back, and
 * gbuffer.c's "not readable" answers last a second anyway. Commits came in hundreds while the Demon Hand loaded, and
 * each emptied every answer: the render threads asked VirtualQuery again and again, a 343 ms frame (2026-11-12). */
int yw4_commit(uint64_t addr, size_t size) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    int r = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE) ? 0 : -1;
#else
    int r = 0;
    if (mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE) != 0) {
        void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,  /* not reserved: map it */
                       MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
        r = p == (void *)(uintptr_t)addr ? 0 : -1;
    }
#endif
    if (!r) map_pages(addr, size, 1);
    return r;
}

/* Reserves every free part of [lo, hi), so later commits work at any 4 KiB page: Windows
 * places reservations only at 64 KiB boundaries, but the game maps at 4 KiB ones. Linux
 * maps pages anywhere, so there is nothing to do there. */
void yw4_reserve_free(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    for (uint64_t a = lo; a < hi;) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) break;
        uint64_t end = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
        if (end > hi) end = hi;
        if (mbi.State == MEM_FREE) VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)a, (size_t)(end - a), MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS);
        a = end;
    }
#else
    (void)lo, (void)hi;
#endif
}

static int guest_memory_ready;

int yw4_guest_memory_init(void) {
    if (guest_memory_ready) return 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!host_reserve_watched(YW4_HEAP_BASE, YW4_HEAP_SIZE) || !yw4_reserve_range(YW4_TLR_BASE, YW4_TLR_SIZE)) {
        return -1;
    }
    yw4_reserve_free(YW4_GUEST_LO, YW4_GUEST_HI);
#else
    if (!yw4_reserve_range(YW4_GUEST_LO, (size_t)(YW4_GUEST_HI - YW4_GUEST_LO))) {
        return -1;
    }
#endif
    guest_memory_ready = 1;
    return 0;
}

/* Give the memory back but keep the range reserved; the next commit reads as zeros. */
void yw4_decommit(uint64_t addr, size_t size) {
    map_pages(addr, size, 0);  /* before the memory goes */
#ifdef _WIN32
    VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, MEM_DECOMMIT);
#else
    mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
#endif
    __atomic_add_fetch(&yw4_memory_generation, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);  /* after: no answer from before it stays */
}

void yw4_host_sleep_ns(int64_t ns) { host_sleep_ns(ns); }

static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *buf = n > 0 ? malloc((size_t)n) : NULL;
    if (buf && fread(buf, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) {
        free(buf);
        buf = NULL;
    }
    fclose(f);
    *len = (size_t)n;
    return buf;
}

/* ---- host callbacks: a guest address per host function, found through the lookup hook */

#define MAX_HOST_FNS 4096
static struct {
    GuestFn fn;
    void *data;
} host_fns[MAX_HOST_FNS];
static size_t nhost_fns;  /* entries below this are complete (published with release order) */
static uint64_t host_fn_base;
static HostLock host_fns_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static _Thread_local void *host_data;

static GuestFn host_lookup(uint64_t a) {
    uint64_t off = a - host_fn_base;
    if (!host_fn_base || off >= __atomic_load_n(&nhost_fns, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) * 16 || off % 16) return NULL;
    host_data = host_fns[off / 16].data;  /* the call follows the lookup on this same thread */
    return host_fns[off / 16].fn;
}

uint64_t yw4_host_function_data(GuestFn fn, void *data) {
    host_lock(&host_fns_lock);  /* guest threads may register callbacks at the same time */
    if (!host_fn_base) {
        host_fn_base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)yw4_reserve(YW4_HOST_FN_BASE, MAX_HOST_FNS * 16);
        yw4_lookup_hook = host_lookup;
    }
    if (!host_fn_base || nhost_fns == MAX_HOST_FNS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: no room for host callbacks\n");
        yw4_exit(1, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    size_t i = nhost_fns;
    host_fns[i].fn = fn;
    host_fns[i].data = data;
    __atomic_store_n(&nhost_fns, i + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    host_unlock(&host_fns_lock);
    return host_fn_base + 16 * i;
}

uint64_t yw4_host_function(GuestFn fn) { return yw4_host_function_data(fn, NULL); }

void *yw4_host_data(void) { return host_data; }

uint64_t yw4_guest_symbol(const char *name) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_nguest_symbols; i++)
        if (!strcmp(yw4_guest_symbols[i].name, name))
            return *yw4_modules[yw4_guest_symbols[i].module].base + yw4_guest_symbols[i].offset;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: guest symbol %s is not in recomp/overrides.toml [[guest_symbol]]\n", name);
    yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
}

/* ---- modules */

static int load_one(const Yw4Module *m, const char *dir) {
    char path[1024];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, m->file);
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *file = read_file(path, &len);
    if (!file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cannot read %s\n", path);
        return 1;
    }
    char hash[65];
    yw4_sha256_hex(file, len, hash);
    if (len != m->file_size || strcmp(hash, m->sha256) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s is not the build this was recompiled from\n"
                        "  expected %s (%" PRIu64 " bytes)\n  got      %s (%zu bytes)\n",
                path, m->sha256, m->file_size, hash, len);
        free(file);
        return 1;
    }
    uint8_t *base = yw4_reserve(m->preferred_base, (size_t)m->mem_size);
    if (!base || ((uintptr_t)base & 0xFFF)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cannot reserve %#" PRIx64 " bytes (4 KiB aligned) for %s\n", m->mem_size, m->name);
        return 1;
    }
    memcpy(base, file, len);  /* the rest (.bss) is already zero */
    free(file);
    *m->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)base;
    return 0;
}

int yw4_load_modules(const char *exefs_dir) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_nmodules; i++)
        if (load_one(&yw4_modules[i], exefs_dir)) return 1;
    size_t nrel = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_nmodules; i++) {
        const Yw4Module *m = &yw4_modules[i];
        uint64_t base = *m->base;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < m->nrelative; k++)
            st64(base + m->relative[k].offset, base + (uint64_t)m->relative[k].addend);
        for (size_t k = 0; k < m->nsymrelocs; k++) {
            const Yw4SymReloc *r = &m->symrelocs[k];
            st64(base + r->offset, r->module == YW4_NO_MODULE ? 0 : *yw4_modules[r->module].base + r->value);
        }
        nrel += m->nrelative + m->nsymrelocs;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_nmodules; i++) {
        const Yw4Module *m = &yw4_modules[i];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %-4s loaded at %#014" PRIx64 "%s\n", m->name, *m->base,
                *m->base == m->preferred_base ? "" : "  (NOT its preferred address)");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %zu relocations applied\n", nrel);
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/log.c`:

```c
/* Log file: everything the runtime prints on stderr is also saved in work/logs/yw4_<time>.log
 * (YW4_LOG=0 turns it off, YW4_LOG_DIR moves it), so a run started without a visible terminal
 * still leaves its messages. stderr is replaced by a pipe; a thread copies what comes through
 * to the original stderr and to the file. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <io.h>
#include <windows.h>
#define MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#define PIPE(fds) _pipe(fds, 1 << 16, _O_BINARY)
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#define MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
#define PIPE(fds) pipe(fds)
#endif

#include <stdint.h>

#include "host.h"

static int pipe_fds[2], saved_stderr;
static FILE *logfile;
static char log_name[600];

/* The log file being written ("" when there is none): the bug report copies it. */
const char *yw4_log_path(void) { return log_name; }

static void copy_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    host_thread_set_priority(NULL, 60);  /* background disk logging: yield to gameplay and rendering */
    char buf[4096];
    for (;;) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        int n = _read(pipe_fds[0], buf, sizeof buf);
#else
        ssize_t n = read(pipe_fds[0], buf, sizeof buf);
#endif
        if (n <= 0) return;
#ifdef _WIN32
        _write(saved_stderr, buf, (unsigned)n);
#else
        if (write(saved_stderr, buf, (size_t)n) < 0) {}
#endif
        fwrite(buf, 1, (size_t)n, logfile);
        fflush(logfile);
    }
}

/* Start-up timing: where the time from launch to the first frame goes (grep "boot:" in the log). */
void yw4_boot_mark(const char *what) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: boot: %6.0f ms: %s\n", (double)host_process_age_ns() / 1e6, what);
}

/* ---- Old runs' files: every start writes a new log (here) and new performance files (perf.c), and nothing removed
 * them, so a player's logs folder grew for good: about 3 MB a start on average, 17-30 MB an hour of play, nearly all
 * of it the per-frame perf_*.csv (owner, 2026-11-16: "cap the size to 1gb and keep only last 5"). Files in `dir`
 * named <prefix><YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS>... are one run's; the newest YW4_LOG_KEEP runs (default 5, the current one among
 * them) are kept, as long as they come to no more than YW4_LOG_CAP_MB (default 1024) together; the current run is
 * always kept. YW4_LOG_KEEP=0 keeps everything (the dev tools' runs: tools/dev/run.py). */
enum { STAMP = 15, MAX_FILES = 4096 };
typedef struct { char name[260], stamp[STAMP + 1]; uint64_t size; } RunFile;

static int by_stamp_newest(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return strcmp(((const RunFile *)b)->stamp, ((const RunFile *)a)->stamp);
}

static int run_file(const char *name, const char *prefix, char stamp[STAMP + 1]) {
    size_t p = strlen(prefix);
    if (strncmp(name, prefix, p) || strlen(name) < p + STAMP || strlen(name) >= 260) return 0;
    memcpy(stamp, name + p, STAMP), stamp[STAMP] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < STAMP; i++)  /* digits, an underscore at 8: not someone else's file that starts the same */
        if (i == 8 ? stamp[i] != '_' : (stamp[i] < '0' || stamp[i] > '9')) return 0;
    return 1;
}

void yw4_prune_runs(const char *dir, const char *prefix, const char *current) {
    const char *k = getenv("YW4_LOG_KEEP"), *c = getenv("YW4_LOG_CAP_MB");
    int keep = k && *k ? atoi(k) : 5;
    uint64_t cap = (uint64_t)(c && *c ? atoi(c) : 1024) << 20;
    if (keep <= 0) return;
    RunFile *f = malloc(sizeof *f * MAX_FILES);
    if (!f) return;
    int n = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    char pattern[600];
    snprintf(pattern, sizeof pattern, "%s\\%s*", dir, prefix);
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pattern, &fd);
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            if (!(fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) && n < MAX_FILES &&
                run_file(fd.cFileName, prefix, f[n].stamp)) {
                snprintf(f[n].name, sizeof f[n].name, "%s", fd.cFileName);
                f[n++].size = (uint64_t)fd.nFileSizeHigh << 32 | fd.nFileSizeLow;
            }
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
#else
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    for (struct dirent *e; d && (e = readdir(d)) != NULL;) {
        struct stat st;
        if (n >= MAX_FILES || !run_file(e->d_name, prefix, f[n].stamp)) continue;
        if (fstatat(dirfd(d), e->d_name, &st, 0) || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) continue;
        snprintf(f[n].name, sizeof f[n].name, "%s", e->d_name);
        f[n++].size = (uint64_t)st.st_size;
    }
    if (d) closedir(d);
#endif
    qsort(f, (size_t)n, sizeof *f, by_stamp_newest);
    int runs = 0, removed = 0, full = 0;
    uint64_t kept = 0, freed = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n;) {  /* one run at a time, newest first */
        int j = i;
        uint64_t size = 0;
        while (j < n && !strcmp(f[j].stamp, f[i].stamp)) size += f[j++].size;
        int now = current && !strcmp(f[i].stamp, current);
        if (!now && (runs >= keep || kept + size > cap)) full = 1;  /* from here on, older runs all go */
        if (now || !full) {
            runs++, kept += size;
        } else {
            for (int m = i; m < j; m++) {
                char path[900];
                snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, f[m].name);
                if (remove(path) == 0) removed++, freed += f[m].size;
            }
        }
        i = j;
    }
    free(f);
    if (removed)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: log: removed %d old %s* file%s (%.1f MB) from %s; kept the newest %d run%s (%.1f MB)\n",
                removed, prefix, removed == 1 ? "" : "s", (double)freed / (1 << 20), dir, runs, runs == 1 ? "" : "s",
                (double)kept / (1 << 20));
}

/* At exit, give the copying thread a moment to drain the last messages (the stop message of a crash). */
static void drain(void) { host_sleep_ns(150 * 1000000LL); }

void yw4_log_start(void) {
    const char *on = getenv("YW4_LOG");
    if (on && *on == '0') return;
    const char *dir = getenv("YW4_LOG_DIR");
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", dir && *dir ? dir : "work/logs");
    for (char *p = path + 1; *p; p++)
        if (*p == '/' || *p == '\\') {
            char c = *p;
            *p = 0;
            MKDIR(path);
            *p = c;
        }
    MKDIR(path);
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm tmv;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&tmv, &now);
#else
    localtime_r(&now, &tmv);
#endif
    char when[32], name[600];
    strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", &tmv);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s/yw4_%s.log", path, when);
    logfile = fopen(name, "wb");
    if (!logfile) return;
    snprintf(log_name, sizeof log_name, "%s", name);
#ifdef _WIN32
    saved_stderr = _dup(2);
    if (PIPE(pipe_fds) != 0 || saved_stderr < 0 || _dup2(pipe_fds[1], 2) != 0) return;
#else
    saved_stderr = dup(2);
    if (PIPE(pipe_fds) != 0 || saved_stderr < 0 || dup2(pipe_fds[1], 2) < 0) return;
#endif
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    if (host_thread_start(copy_thread, NULL, 1 << 16) != 0) {
        /* Nobody reads the pipe: give stderr back, or every message is lost and the game blocks once the pipe is
         * full. (Linux, 2026-11-12: the thread's 64 KiB stack was refused, and a run that quit at start left an
         * empty terminal and an empty log.) */
#ifdef _WIN32
        _dup2(saved_stderr, 2);
#else
        dup2(saved_stderr, 2);
#endif
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: log: cannot start the copying thread; no log file this run\n");
        return;
    }
    atexit(drain);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: log file %s\n", name);
    yw4_prune_runs(path, "yw4_", when);  /* after this run's file exists, so it is the newest */
}

```

`runtime/src/main.c`:

```c
/* yw4: load main and the sdk, then start the game the way the Switch does (decision 0014).
 *
 *   yw4 <exefs work directory: main.bin, sdk.bin> <romfs folder> [save data folder]
 *
 * Without a save folder (on the command line or as YW4_SAVE in game.ini) the saves go to the user's data folder:
 * $XDG_DATA_HOME/YW4Recomp/save (~/.local/share/YW4Recomp/save) on Linux, %APPDATA%/YW4 Recomp/save on Windows.
 *
 * rtld is not needed: the loader relocates both modules. Then the main guest thread calls
 * the sdk's nn::init::Start(thread handle, argument region, init, fini), as rtld would. It
 * calls back to run the sdk's DT_INIT right after nnosInitialize, and main's DT_INIT
 * after nninitStartup (when the game has set up its heap), then calls nnMain. The two
 * callbacks are host functions (yw4_host_function), as in LAS Recomp's start-up.
 *
 * The process's main thread runs the window (window.c, decision 0019); the main guest
 * thread gets its own host thread.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>  /* _chdir, _getcwd */
#else
#include <limits.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#include <SDL3/SDL_filesystem.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_messagebox.h>

#include "discord.h"
#include "game_ini.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "romfs.h"
#include "savefs.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "version.h"
#include "window.h"
#include "yw4load.h"
#include "host.h"

static void init_module(CPUState *ctx, size_t i) {
    const Yw4Module *m = &yw4_modules[i];
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: running %s DT_INIT (%s+%#" PRIx64 ")\n", m->name, m->name, m->dt_init);
    yw4_resolve(*m->base + m->dt_init)(ctx);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s DT_INIT returned\n", m->name);
    yw4_boot_mark(i == YW4_SDK ? "sdk's constructors done" : "main's constructors done");
}
static void init_sdk(CPUState *ctx) { init_module(ctx, YW4_SDK); }
static void init_main(CPUState *ctx) { init_module(ctx, YW4_MAIN); }

/* The main guest thread, on its own host thread while the window owns the main one. */
static void start_guest(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    CPUState *ctx = calloc(1, sizeof *ctx);
    uint8_t *stack = yw4_reserve(YW4_STACK_BASE, yw4_main_stack_size);
    if (!ctx || !stack) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: out of memory\n");
        yw4_exit(1, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    ctx->sp = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(stack + yw4_main_stack_size)) & ~15ull;
    ctx->x[0] = yw4_kernel_init(ctx, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stack, yw4_main_stack_size);
    ctx->x[1] = 0;  /* argument region: none */
    ctx->x[2] = yw4_host_function(init_sdk);
    ctx->x[3] = yw4_host_function(init_main);
    ctx->x[30] = 0;  /* returning from the entry is a normal C return; x30 is never jumped to */
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: main thread: stack %#" PRIx64 " bytes, priority %u; running nn::init::Start (sdk+%#" PRIx64 ")\n",
            yw4_main_stack_size, yw4_main_priority, yw4_entry_init_start);
    yw4_resolve(yw4_sdk_base + yw4_entry_init_start)(ctx);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: nn::init::Start returned, x0=%#" PRIx64 "\n", ctx->x[0]);
}

void yw4_log_start(void);  /* log.c */

/* The runtime's own files are found by paths starting work/ (shaders, mods, logs, screenshots...), relative to
 * the current folder. So that the game works from wherever it is started (a double-click, a launcher), it first
 * goes to its home folder (decision 0048): YW4_HOME if set, else the folder above work/ when yw4.exe sits in
 * <home>/work/build/ (the layout recomp.build makes, for the owner and for an install), else it stays put. The
 * paths it was given are made absolute first, so they still name the same folders. */
static void absolute(char **arg, char *buf, size_t size) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (_fullpath(buf, *arg, size)) *arg = buf;
#else
    if (realpath(*arg, buf)) *arg = buf;  /* buf is PATH_MAX long */
    (void)size;
#endif
}

static void go_home(void) {
    char home[1024] = "";
    const char *env = getenv("YW4_HOME");
    if (env && *env) {
        snprintf(home, sizeof home, "%s", env);
    } else {
        const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath();  /* the exe's folder, ending in a separator */
        if (!base) return;
        char dir[1024];
        snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", base);
        size_t n = strlen(dir);
        while (n && (dir[n - 1] == '/' || dir[n - 1] == '\\')) dir[--n] = 0;  /* .../work/build */
        char *cut = strrchr(dir, '/'), *cut2 = strrchr(dir, '\\');
        if (cut2 > cut) cut = cut2;
        if (!cut) return;
        *cut = 0;  /* .../work */
        char *name = strrchr(dir, '/'), *name2 = strrchr(dir, '\\');
        if (name2 > name) name = name2;
        if (!name || strcmp(name + 1, "work") != 0) return;  /* not the <home>/work/build layout: stay */
        *name = 0;
        snprintf(home, sizeof home, "%s", dir);
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (_chdir(home) != 0) return;
#else
    if (chdir(home) != 0) return;
#endif
}

/* The save folder when none is given: the platform's per-user data folder, so the saves don't live inside the
 * game's folder (deleting or re-cloning it would lose them). Linux follows the XDG Base Directory spec, which says
 * to ignore an XDG_DATA_HOME that isn't an absolute path. savefs_init makes the folder when it's missing. NULL
 * when the environment names no home folder. */
static const char *default_save_dir(void) {
    static char buf[1024];
#ifdef _WIN32
    const char *appdata = getenv("APPDATA");
    if (!appdata || !*appdata) return NULL;
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s/YW4 Recomp/save", appdata);  /* as the launcher's "appdata" choice */
#else
    const char *xdg = getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"), *home = getenv("HOME");
    if (xdg && xdg[0] == '/')
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s/YW4Recomp/save", xdg);
    else if (home && *home)
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s/.local/share/YW4Recomp/save", home);
    else
        return NULL;
#endif
    return buf;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--version")) {  /* for the launcher and bug reports: one line on stdout */
        printf("YW4 Recomp %s (%s, built %s)\n", yw4_version, yw4_git_commit, yw4_build_date);
        return 0;
    }
    /* the launcher's Mods tab: which mods clash, no game start (decision 0068); without a folder, game.ini's RomFS
     * and mods, as a start without arguments has them */
    if ((argc == 2 || argc == 3) && !strcmp(argv[1], "--mod-clashes")) {
        if (argc == 2) game_ini_load();
        const char *romfs = argc == 3 ? argv[2] : getenv("YW4_ROMFS");
        if (!romfs || !*romfs) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: --mod-clashes: no RomFS folder (give one, or a game.ini with YW4_ROMFS)\n");
            return 1;
        }
        return romfs_mod_clashes(romfs, stdout);
    }
    if (yw4_guest_memory_init()) {
        const char *retried = getenv("YW4_ASLR_RETRY");
        if (!retried || !*retried) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: guest memory collision; retrying with a fresh ASLR layout...\n");
            host_respawn(argc, argv);
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fatal: cannot reserve guest address space (0x7000000000 - 0x7800000000)\n");
        return 3;
    }
    /* No arguments (a double-click, a shortcut): the folders come from game.ini next to the exe (decision 0050) */
    static char *ini_args[4];
    int from_ini = 0, default_save = 0;
    if (argc == 1 && game_ini_load()) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_EXEFS"), *r = getenv("YW4_ROMFS"), *s = getenv("YW4_SAVE");
        if (!s || !*s) s = default_save_dir(), default_save = 1;
        if (e && r && s) {
            ini_args[0] = argv[0], ini_args[1] = (char *)e, ini_args[2] = (char *)r, ini_args[3] = (char *)s;
            argv = ini_args, argc = 4, from_ini = 1;
        }
    }
    if (argc == 1) {
        SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION, "YW4 Recomp",
                                 "The game isn't set up yet.\n\nStart the YW4 Recomp launcher: it sets up the game "
                                 "from your own copy and then starts it.", NULL);
        return 1;
    }
    static char *args3[4];
    if (argc == 3 && default_save_dir()) {  /* exefs and romfs only: the default save folder */
        args3[0] = argv[0], args3[1] = argv[1], args3[2] = argv[2], args3[3] = (char *)default_save_dir();
        argv = args3, argc = 4, default_save = 1;
    }
    static char paths[3][4096];
    for (int i = 1; i < argc && i <= 3; i++) absolute(&argv[i], paths[i - 1], sizeof paths[i - 1]);
    go_home();  /* before the log: its folder is a work/ path too */
    yw4_log_start();
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: YW4 Recomp %s (commit %s, built %s)\n", yw4_version, yw4_git_commit, yw4_build_date);
    {
        char cwd[1024];
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (_getcwd(cwd, sizeof cwd)) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: home %s\n", cwd);
#else
        if (getcwd(cwd, sizeof cwd)) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: home %s\n", cwd);
#endif
    }
    yw4_sysinfo_dump();  /* after the home folder is set: its disk is the one the game's files are on */
    if (from_ini) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: folders from game.ini\n");
    yw4_boot_mark("main() running, guest memory reserved, log open");
    settings_load();
    if (argc != 4) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: yw4 <exefs work directory with main.bin and sdk.bin> <romfs folder> [save data folder]\n");
        return 1;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: saves in %s%s\n", argv[3], default_save ? " (the default save folder)" : "");
    window_prestart();
    discord_start();  /* Discord Rich Presence: its own thread, idle unless DISCORD STATUS is on (decision 0077) */
    if (yw4_load_modules(argv[1])) return 1;
    yw4_boot_mark("main and sdk loaded");
    if (romfs_open(argv[2])) return 1;
    yw4_boot_mark("RomFS and mods scanned");
    if (savefs_init(argv[3])) return 1;
    yw4_probe_init();
    yw4_watch_init();
    {
        void ai_trace_start(void);  /* ai_trace.c: YW4_TRACE_AI=1 only */
        ai_trace_start();
    }

    window_run(start_guest, NULL);
    return 0;
}
```
