`runtime/src/msvc_shim.c`:

```c
/* The few Microsoft C/C++ runtime pieces NVIDIA's static NGX library (DLSS, decision 0040) expects. It is built
 * with MSVC; we build with llvm-mingw, which has neither MSVC's runtime nor its C++ library. What the library
 * reaches for, found by linking a test against it: operator new/delete (MSVC names), the floating-point marker,
 * the /GS stack cookie and its check, the two GS exception filters named in its unwind tables, two MSVC STL
 * error functions, and thread-safe local statics. It throws no C++ exceptions (no __CxxFrameHandler). Empty
 * stand-ins for libmsvcprt.a and libOLDNAMES.a (recomp/build.py) satisfy its default-library requests. */
#if defined(YW4_DLSS) && defined(_WIN32)  /* NVIDIA's Linux library is built with GCC and needs none of this */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <windows.h>

void *yw4_msvc_new(size_t n) __asm__("??2@YAPEAX_K@Z");
void *yw4_msvc_new(size_t n) {
    void *p = malloc(n ? n : 1);
    if (!p) abort();
    return p;
}
void yw4_msvc_delete(void *p) __asm__("??3@YAXPEAX@Z");
void yw4_msvc_delete(void *p) { free(p); }

int _fltused = 0x9875;

/* /GS: the cookie the library's functions copy onto their stack and check on return */
uintptr_t __security_cookie = 0x2B992DDFA232ull;
void __security_check_cookie(uintptr_t c) {
    if (c != __security_cookie) {
        fputs("yw4: dlss: stack cookie mismatch in NVIDIA's library\n", stderr);
        abort();
    }
}

/* only reached while an exception unwinds through the library's frames: let it pass on */
EXCEPTION_DISPOSITION __GSHandlerCheck(void *rec, void *frame, void *ctx, void *disp) {
    (void)rec, (void)frame, (void)ctx, (void)disp;
    return ExceptionContinueSearch;
}
EXCEPTION_DISPOSITION __GSHandlerCheck_EH(void *rec, void *frame, void *ctx, void *disp) {
    (void)rec, (void)frame, (void)ctx, (void)disp;
    return ExceptionContinueSearch;
}

static void xlength(const char *m) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: dlss: length error in NVIDIA's library: %s\n", m);
    abort();
}
static void xbadalloc(void) {
    fputs("yw4: dlss: out of memory in NVIDIA's library\n", stderr);
    abort();
}
void (*yw4_imp_xlength)(const char *) __asm__("__imp_?_Xlength_error@std@@YAXPEBD@Z") = xlength;
void (*yw4_imp_xbadalloc)(void) __asm__("__imp_?_Xbad_alloc@std@@YAXXZ") = xbadalloc;

/* Thread-safe local statics: the header claims a static for initialisation (0: not yet) and holds one lock
 * until the footer marks it done; a static already done (> 0) passes. Few, one-time: one lock for all. */
static SRWLOCK init_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static int init_epoch = INT32_MIN;
__thread int _Init_thread_epoch = INT32_MIN;
void _Init_thread_header(int *once) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&init_lock);
    if (*once == 0) {
        *once = -1;
        return;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&init_lock);
}
void _Init_thread_footer(int *once) {
    *once = ++init_epoch;
    _Init_thread_epoch = init_epoch;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&init_lock);
}
#endif
```

`runtime/src/nvn.c`:

```c
/* NVN, the Switch's graphics API, implemented natively (decisions 0005, 0016).
 *
 * The game reaches NVN only through nvnBootstrapLoader (an override of the sdk's, see
 * recomp/overrides.toml): it asks for nvnDeviceGetProcAddress, then for every NVN function
 * by name. Each name gets a guest address that runs native code. Functions not written yet
 * still get an address, so asking for one is fine; calling it stops with its name, like an
 * unimplemented SVC. (Real NVN returns NULL for names it doesn't know; the game only asks
 * for names it uses, so a stub address for every name is the stricter choice.)
 *
 * The functions themselves are in nvn_objects.c and nvn_cmdbuf.c (decision 0017).
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "nvn.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

static void DeviceGetProcAddress(CPUState *ctx);

static const NvnImpl entry_impls[] = {
    {"nvnDeviceGetProcAddress", DeviceGetProcAddress},
    {NULL, NULL},
};
static const NvnImpl *const impl_tables[] = {entry_impls, nvn_object_impls, nvn_cmdbuf_impls};

static GuestFn find_impl(const char *name) {
    for (size_t t = 0; t < sizeof impl_tables / sizeof *impl_tables; t++)
        for (const NvnImpl *e = impl_tables[t]; e->name; e++)
            if (!strcmp(e->name, name)) return e->fn;
    return NULL;
}

_Noreturn void nvn_fatal(const CPUState *c, const char *fmt, ...) {
    char where[48];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: ");
    vfprintf(stderr, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    fprintf(stderr, " (called from %s)\n", yw4_describe(c->x[30] - 4, where));
    yw4_stop();
}

void nvn_guest_call(CPUState *c, uint64_t fn) {
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    yw4_resolve(fn)(c);
    c->x[30] = lr;
}

/* ---- names to guest addresses */

#define MAX_PROCS 1024
static struct {
    char *name;
    uint64_t addr;
} procs[MAX_PROCS];
static int nprocs;
static HostLock procs_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static void missing(CPUState *ctx) {
    const char *name = yw4_host_data();
    char where[48];
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN function %s not implemented yet (called from %s; x0=%#" PRIx64 " x1=%#" PRIx64
                    " x2=%#" PRIx64 ")\n", name, yw4_describe(ctx->x[30] - 4, where), ctx->x[0], ctx->x[1], ctx->x[2]);
    yw4_stop();
}

static uint64_t proc_address(const char *name) {
    host_lock(&procs_lock);
    uint64_t addr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nprocs && !addr; i++)
        if (!strcmp(procs[i].name, name)) addr = procs[i].addr;
    if (!addr) {
        if (nprocs == MAX_PROCS) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: too many function names\n");
            yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        }
        char *copy = malloc(strlen(name) + 1);
        if (!copy) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        strcpy(copy, name);
        GuestFn fn = find_impl(name);
        addr = fn ? yw4_host_function_data(fn, copy) : yw4_host_function_data(missing, copy);
        procs[nprocs].name = copy;
        procs[nprocs++].addr = addr;
    }
    host_unlock(&procs_lock);
    return addr;
}

/* nvnBootstrapLoader(name) -> function */
void yw4_nvn_BootstrapLoader(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = proc_address((const char *)GPTR(ctx->x[0])); }

/* nvnDeviceGetProcAddress(device or NULL, name) -> function */
static void DeviceGetProcAddress(CPUState *ctx) { ctx->x[0] = proc_address((const char *)GPTR(ctx->x[1])); }

/* ---- the sdk's GPU driver, which we don't run */

/* nv::InitializeGraphics(memory, size): the memory is for the driver's own bookkeeping.
 * Ours lives on the host, so it stays unused. */
void yw4_nv_InitializeGraphics(CPUState *ctx) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: nv::InitializeGraphics(%#" PRIx64 ", %#" PRIx64 "): no GPU driver to start\n", ctx->x[0],
            ctx->x[1]);
}

void yw4_nv_FinalizeGraphics(CPUState *ctx) { (void)ctx; }
```

`runtime/src/nvn.h`:

```h
/* NVN on the host (decisions 0005, 0016, 0017): what nvn*.c share.
 *
 * Calls arrive in the AArch64 calling convention on the guest CPUState: integer and pointer
 * arguments in x0.., floats in s0.. (v[i].f[0]), the result in x0 (or s0). The first argument
 * is the NVN object. Its memory belongs to the game (sizes fixed by the NVN ABI), so:
 *   - real objects (memory pool, texture, sampler, program, window, command buffer, sync,
 *     texture/sampler pool) keep a pointer to our host object in their first 8 bytes;
 *   - builders and small state objects (blend, depth-stencil...) keep their fields directly
 *     in guest memory, at offsets inside their ABI size, because the game copies them by value.
 *
 * Builder offsets and state packing are adapted from LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/nvn.h,
 * objects.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#ifndef NVN_H
#define NVN_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "c11_keywords.h"
#include "tegra.h"

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    GuestFn fn;
} NvnImpl;

/* Each nvn_*.c file's functions, ended by {NULL, NULL}. */
extern const NvnImpl nvn_object_impls[];
extern const NvnImpl nvn_cmdbuf_impls[];

#define NVN(name) static void name(CPUState *c)
#define IMPL(name) {#name, name}

#define A(i) (c->x[(i)])
#define AP(i) ((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[(i)])
#define AF(i) (c->v[(i)].f[0])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define G(T, base, off) (*(T *)(uintptr_t)((uint64_t)(base) + (off)))
#define HOST(T, guest) ((T *)(uintptr_t)G(uint64_t, guest, 0))
#define SET_HOST(guest, p) (G(uint64_t, guest, 0) = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))

/* Stops: something this NVN can't do yet. */
YW4_NORETURN void nvn_fatal(const CPUState *c, const char *fmt, ...);
/* Calls a guest function (a game callback) on this thread; x0.. are already set. */
void nvn_guest_call(CPUState *c, uint64_t fn);

/* ---- host objects */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t storage, size;  /* guest address of the game's memory */
    uint32_t flags;
    void *gpu;               /* the draw path's import of it (gpu.c) */
} NvnPool;

#define POOL_CPU_NO_ACCESS 0x1u  /* NVN memory pool flag: only the GPU uses it (render targets) */

enum { TARGET_1D, TARGET_2D, TARGET_3D, TARGET_1D_ARRAY, TARGET_2D_ARRAY, TARGET_2D_MS, TARGET_2D_MS_ARRAY,
       TARGET_RECTANGLE, TARGET_CUBE, TARGET_CUBE_ARRAY, TARGET_BUFFER };
#define FLAG_LINEAR 0x10u

typedef struct {
    uint32_t target, format, flags, width, height, depth, levels, samples, ds_mode;
    uint8_t swizzle[4];
    uint64_t stride;
    uint64_t addr;  /* guest address of the texels */
    TexLayout layout;
    uint32_t pool_flags;  /* of the memory pool it lives in */
    void *gpu;            /* the draw path's image (gpu.c) */
    int cpu_written;      /* WriteTexels changed its storage: upload before the GPU uses it */
    int registered;       /* times registered in a texture pool (diagnostic) */
    int pool_id;          /* the id it was registered at last (the takeover finds textures by it) */
    void *found;          /* the image gpu.c found for it last, valid while found_epoch is current */
    uint32_t found_epoch;
    uint32_t reg_gen;     /* pool entries' copies: which registration this is (nvn_objects.c counts them; 0: none) */
} NvnTexture;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t min_filter, mag_filter, wrap[3], compare_mode, compare_func, reduction;
    float lod_min, lod_max, lod_bias, max_aniso;
    float border[4];
} NvnSamplerDesc;  /* also stored inside the guest NVNsamplerBuilder, at +8 */

/* Our layout of the guest NVNtextureView (0x28 bytes): which fields are set, and them. */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t setmask;
    uint16_t base_level, num_levels, min_layer, num_layers;
    uint32_t format, target, ds_mode;
    uint8_t swizzle[4];
} NvnTextureView;

/* A texture pool entry. Like the hardware's descriptor, it keeps a copy of the texture as it
 * was registered (snap; tex points at it, NULL if the slot is empty): the game finalizes
 * and reuses texture objects that are still registered, so a pointer to the live object
 * would end up naming a different texture. */
typedef struct {
    NvnTexture *tex;
    NvnTexture snap;
    NvnTextureView view;
    int has_view;
    uint64_t guest;  /* the guest NVNtexture* it was registered from (diagnostic) */
} NvnTexEntry;

/* The data of a SetRenderTargets record (x[0] = colour count): copies of the textures as
 * they were when recorded (the objects may be finalized before the list runs) and of the
 * views. color[i] / depth point at the copies, or are NULL; whoever copies this struct
 * must point them at its own copies (gpu.c). */
typedef struct {
    NvnTexture *color[8];
    NvnTexture color_snap[8];
    NvnTextureView views[8];
    uint8_t has_view[8];
    NvnTexture *depth;
    NvnTexture depth_snap;
    NvnTextureView depth_view;
    uint8_t has_depth_view;
} RenderTargets;

/* Points rt's texture pointers at rt's own copies (after copying the struct). */
static inline void render_targets_fix(RenderTargets *rt) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) rt->color[i] = rt->color[i] ? &rt->color_snap[i] : NULL;
    rt->depth = rt->depth ? &rt->depth_snap : NULL;
}

typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr;
    int count;
    void *entries;  /* NvnTexEntry[] or NvnSamplerDesc[] */
} NvnDescPool;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t code;     /* guest address of the stage's code (NVN header + Maxwell program) */
    uint64_t control;  /* guest address of its control section */
    uint64_t key;      /* the translated shader: FNV-1a 64 of its assembly (nvn_shader.c) */
} NvnShaderStage;

typedef struct {
    NvnShaderStage stages[6];  /* vertex, fragment, geometry, tess control, tess eval, compute */
    uint32_t stage_mask;
    void *gpu;                 /* the draw path's shaders and layouts (gpu_draw.c) */
} NvnProgram;

/* Device modes (nvnDeviceSetWindowOriginMode / SetDepthMode): 0 lower-left / near at -w
 * (OpenGL, the defaults), 1 upper-left / near at 0. */
extern uint32_t nvn_window_origin, nvn_depth_mode;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t textures[8];  /* guest NVNtexture* */
    int num, active, interval, next;
    int crop[4];
} NvnWindow;

/* ---- command recording: records live in the game's command memory (nvn_cmdbuf.c) */

enum { TRACE_TEXTURES = 20 };  /* texture slots recorded per stage (the shadow fade programs read slot 18) */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t mem, size, used;  /* current command memory chunk (guest address, or an overflow chunk) */
    uint64_t base;             /* the command memory the game added last */
    int overflows;             /* overflow chunks used since (nvn_cmdbuf.c) */
    uint64_t start;            /* first record of the list being recorded */
    uint64_t callback, callback_data;
    int recording;
    uint64_t guest;            /* the guest NVNcommandBuffer* */
    const NvnProgram *program; /* bound last (YW4_TRACE_DRAW_CALLERS) */
    uint64_t program_guest;    /* ... its guest NVNprogram* */
    uint32_t target_w, target_h, target_colors, target_depth;  /* set last (YW4_TRACE_DRAW_CALLERS) */
    int cond_mode;             /* SetRenderEnableConditional in force while recording: 0 none, else NVN's mode + 1, */
    uint64_t cond_addr;        /* and its counter address (our shadow pass takes it along, gpu_query.c) */
    uint64_t trace_vb0, trace_ub[2][16];  /* bound last, vertex and fragment stage (YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST) */
    uint64_t trace_vb[8], trace_streams[8];  /* vertex buffers 0-7 and stream states 0-7 bound last */
    uint64_t trace_tex[2][TRACE_TEXTURES];  /* texture handles bound last, vertex and fragment stage */
    const NvnDescPool *trace_texpool;       /* texture pool set last */
    const NvnDescPool *trace_samplerpool;   /* sampler pool set last */
    uint32_t bound_ub[2], bound_tex[2];     /* slots bound since the last draw (gbuffer.c clears them) */
    uint32_t trace_attribs[16], trace_nattribs;  /* vertex attribute state bound last */
    uint64_t depth_addr;    /* depth target set last: texels' address, first layer of its view */
    uint32_t depth_layer;
    uint64_t depth_guest;   /* ... and the guest NVNtexture* it was set with */
    uint8_t polygon[4];     /* polygon state bound last: cull, front face, mode, offset enables */
} NvnCmdBuf;

/* YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST (trace_drawlist.c): on, and a recorded draw (index address or 0) */
int trace_drawlist_on(void);
void trace_drawlist_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t index_addr);
/* Our shadow pass (shadow.c), while learning from the game's draws: a draw was recorded with
 * this state bound, these index address and instancing */
typedef struct { int32_t base_vertex; uint32_t base_instance, instances; } ShadowDrawCall;
void shadow_check_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t index_addr, const ShadowDrawCall *call);
extern int shadow_checking;

/* One recorded call: header, the call's x1..x7 and s0..s3, then copied data. A command
 * handle is the guest address of a list's first record. */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t op, size;  /* size includes the header, a multiple of 8 */
    uint64_t x[7];
    float f[4];
    uint8_t extra[];
} CmdRec;

enum {
    CMD_END, CMD_JUMP, CMD_CALL,
    CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, CMD_BIND_BLEND, CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK, CMD_BIND_COLOR, CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL,
    CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE, CMD_BIND_POLYGON, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM,
    CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_TEXTURES,
    CMD_BIND_IMAGES, CMD_BIND_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK, CMD_SET_TEXTURE_POOL, CMD_SET_SAMPLER_POOL,
    CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS, CMD_SET_VIEWPORTS, CMD_SET_SCISSORS, CMD_SET_DEPTH_RANGES, CMD_SET_BLEND_COLOR,
    CMD_SET_STENCIL, CMD_SET_DEPTH_CLAMP, CMD_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET, CMD_SET_SAMPLE_MASK, CMD_SET_RENDER_ENABLE,
    CMD_SET_RASTERIZER_DISCARD, CMD_SET_CONSERVATIVE_RASTER, CMD_SET_SCRATCH_MEMORY,
    CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, CMD_CLEAR_DEPTH_STENCIL,
    CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS, CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS_INDIRECT, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS_INDIRECT,
    CMD_DRAW_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK, CMD_DISPATCH,
    CMD_BEGIN_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK, CMD_END_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK,
    CMD_BARRIER, CMD_REPORT_COUNTER, CMD_RESET_COUNTER,
    CMD_NATIVE,  /* a pass of our own renderer (decision 0024): x[0] = NvnNativePass, data in extra */
    CMD_COUNT
};

/* A native pass, run by the executor where its CMD_NATIVE record sits in the command stream:
 * `vk_cb` is the VkCommandBuffer being recorded, `gpu_state` the executor's GpuState (the
 * targets the game bound, gpu_internal.h), `data` the record's copied data. */
typedef void (*NvnNativePass)(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
/* Records a native pass into the NVN command buffer `cmd` (guest address); copies `size` bytes. */
void nvn_record_native(const CPUState *c, uint64_t cmd, NvnNativePass fn, const void *data, uint32_t size);
/* The condition the game's draws are being recorded under in `cmd` (SetRenderEnableConditional): 0 none,
 * else NVN's mode + 1 and its counter address. */
int nvn_record_condition(uint64_t cmd, uint64_t *addr);

/* YW4_TRACE_TEXPOOL (nvn_objects.c): 0 off, 1 trace id in detail (UINT32_MAX: any), -1 only
 * summaries for it. */
int nvn_trace_texpool(uint32_t id);

/* Walks a submitted command list (headless: counts what it would run). */
void nvn_execute(uint64_t handle);
/* Draw and dispatch counts since the last call (for the frame log). */
uint64_t nvn_take_draw_count(void);
/* perf.c: one row of the performance log per presented frame (times from host_now_ns). */
void yw4_perf_frame(uint64_t frame, int64_t enter, int64_t shown, int64_t exit_, uint64_t draws);
/* Adds host time to this frame's row: PERF_SUBMIT (nvnQueueSubmitCommands) or PERF_SYNC (waits on the GPU). */
enum { PERF_SUBMIT, PERF_SYNC };

extern _Thread_local int yw4_perf_presenter;  /* set on the thread that presents */

/* nvn_shader.c: shader keys (decision 0020) and YW4_NVN_STATS usage statistics */

void nvn_stats_shader(uint64_t key, const char *stage);

void nvn_stats_draw(int kind);
void nvn_stats_program(const void *program);
void nvn_stats_frame(uint64_t frame);

#endif

```

`runtime/src/nvn_cmdbuf.c`:

```c
/* NVN command buffers (decision 0017).
 *
 * Commands are recorded as CmdRec records into the command memory the game gives the
 * command buffer (AddCommandMemory), so the game's own memory management works as designed;
 * a list that outgrows a chunk continues in the next through a JUMP record (in an overflow chunk
 * of ours when the game has added none, see rec). A command handle
 * is the guest address of a list's first record. Each record keeps the call's arguments and
 * copies of what its pointers point at (state objects, colours), because the game may reuse
 * that memory before the list runs.
 *
 * Headless: QueueSubmitCommands walks the lists and counts draws; nothing executes.
 *
 * Adapted from LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/cmdbuf.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "gpu.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "nvn.h"
#include "pixels.h"
#include "shadow.h"

#define JUMP_RESERVE (sizeof(CmdRec) + 8)  /* room always kept for the record that leaves a chunk */

static NvnCmdBuf *cb_of(uint64_t guest) { return HOST(NvnCmdBuf, guest); }

NVN(nvnCommandBufferInitialize) {  /* (cmd, device) */
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = calloc(1, sizeof *cb);
    if (!cb) nvn_fatal(c, "out of host memory");
    cb->guest = A(0);
    SET_HOST(A(0), cb);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferFinalize) { free(cb_of(A(0))); SET_HOST(A(0), 0); }

static CmdRec *raw_rec(uint64_t at, uint32_t op, uint32_t size) {
    CmdRec *r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)at;
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    r->op = op;
    r->size = size;
    return r;
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory) {  /* (cmd, memory pool, offset, size) */
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    uint64_t mem = HOST(NvnPool, A(1))->storage + A(2);
    if (cb->recording && cb->mem) raw_rec(cb->mem + cb->used, CMD_JUMP, sizeof(CmdRec))->x[0] = mem;
    cb->mem = mem;
    cb->size = A(3);
    cb->used = 0;
    cb->base = mem, cb->overflows = 0;
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory) { (void)c; }  /* (cmd, memory, size): the driver's; ours needs none */

/* Our records are larger than the driver's commands, and this game gives each command buffer
 * a fixed chunk (2 MiB) with no memory callback: a busy scene can outgrow it where the Switch
 * would not. Such a list continues in overflow chunks of our own, kept per chunk of the game's
 * they extend and reused when the game adds that chunk again (the game reuses it only when its
 * commands are done, and so are the ones that continued from it). */
enum { OVERFLOW_SIZE = 2 << 20, OVERFLOW_MAX = 16, OVERFLOW_BASES = 64 };
static struct {
    uint64_t base;
    uint8_t *chunk[OVERFLOW_MAX];
} overflow[OVERFLOW_BASES];
static HostLock overflow_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static uint8_t *overflow_chunk(uint64_t base, int i) {
    if (i >= OVERFLOW_MAX) return NULL;
    host_lock(&overflow_lock);
    int k = 0;
    while (k < OVERFLOW_BASES && overflow[k].base && overflow[k].base != base) k++;
    uint8_t *p = NULL;
    if (k < OVERFLOW_BASES) {
        overflow[k].base = base;
        if (!overflow[k].chunk[i]) overflow[k].chunk[i] = malloc(OVERFLOW_SIZE);
        p = overflow[k].chunk[i];
    }
    host_unlock(&overflow_lock);
    return p;
}

/* Room for one record of `extra` bytes after the header. */
static CmdRec *rec(const CPUState *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra) {
    uint32_t size = (uint32_t)((sizeof(CmdRec) + extra + 7) & ~7u);
    if (cb->mem && cb->used + size + JUMP_RESERVE > cb->size) {
        uint8_t *next = size + JUMP_RESERVE <= OVERFLOW_SIZE ? overflow_chunk(cb->base, cb->overflows) : NULL;
        if (next) {
            static int shown;
            if (!shown++)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: a command list outgrew the game's command memory (%llu bytes); it continues "
                        "in overflow chunks of %d MiB (logged once)\n", (unsigned long long)cb->size, OVERFLOW_SIZE >> 20);
            raw_rec(cb->mem + cb->used, CMD_JUMP, sizeof(CmdRec))->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)next;
            cb->overflows++;
            cb->mem = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)next, cb->size = OVERFLOW_SIZE, cb->used = 0;
        }
    }
    if (!cb->mem || cb->used + size + JUMP_RESERVE > cb->size)
        nvn_fatal(c, "out of command memory (%u bytes needed, %llu of %llu used)", size,
                  (unsigned long long)cb->used, (unsigned long long)cb->size);
    CmdRec *r = raw_rec(cb->mem + cb->used, op, size);
    cb->used += size;
    return r;
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    cb->recording = 1;
    rec(c, cb, CMD_BARRIER, 0);  /* the list starts with a harmless record, so it starts in memory that exists */
    cb->start = cb->mem + cb->used - sizeof(CmdRec);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferEndRecording) {
    gbuffer_end_recording(c, A(0));  /* closes a same-frame A/B range (gpu_ab.c) */
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    rec(c, cb, CMD_END, 0);
    cb->recording = 0;
    RET(cb->start);
}

/* ---- generic recording: x1..x7 and s0..s3 as they were at the call */

static CmdRec *record(CPUState *c, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra) {
    CmdRec *r = rec(c, cb_of(A(0)), op, extra);
    memcpy(r->x, &c->x[1], sizeof r->x);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r->f[i] = AF(i);
    return r;
}
/* ... with a copy of `len` bytes from the pointer in argument `arg` */
static CmdRec *record_copy(CPUState *c, uint32_t op, int arg, uint32_t len) {
    CmdRec *r = record(c, op, len);
    if (A(arg) && len) memcpy(r->extra, AP(arg), len);
    return r;
}
#define PLAIN(name, op) NVN(name) { record(c, op, 0); }

/* ---- state */
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindProgram) {  /* (cmd, program, stage bits) */
    record(c, CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, 0)->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnProgram, A(1));
    cb_of(A(0))->program = HOST(NvnProgram, A(1));
    cb_of(A(0))->program_guest = A(1);
}

/* YW4_TRACE_DRAW_CALLERS=1: each different guest call stack that records a draw, once,
 * with the bound program's shaders: where the engine's renderers draw from. */
static void trace_draw_caller(const CPUState *c) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAW_CALLERS") && *getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAW_CALLERS") != '0';
    if (!on) return;
    enum { DEPTH = 14, SEEN = 4096 };
    static uint64_t seen[SEEN];
    static int nseen;
    uint64_t st[DEPTH];
    int n = yw4_call_stack(c, st, DEPTH);
    const NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    const NvnProgram *p = cb->program;
    /* one line per call stack, target and program: the mesh passes draw many programs from one stack */
    uint64_t h = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) h = (h ^ st[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    h = (h ^ ((uint64_t)cb->target_w << 32 | cb->target_h)) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    if (p) h = ((h ^ p->stages[0].key) * 0x100000001B3ull ^ p->stages[1].key) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < nseen; i++)
        if (seen[i] == h) return;
    if (nseen < SEEN) seen[nseen++] = h;
    char where[48];
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: draw caller: vs %016llx fs %016llx target %ux%u (%u colour, %s depth)\n",
            p ? (unsigned long long)p->stages[0].key : 0ull, p ? (unsigned long long)p->stages[1].key : 0ull,
            cb->target_w, cb->target_h, cb->target_colors, cb->target_depth ? "with" : "no");
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) fprintf(stderr, "       %s\n", yw4_describe(st[i] - 4, where));
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindBlendState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_BLEND, 1, 8); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindChannelMaskState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK, 1, 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindColorState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_COLOR, 1, 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindDepthStencilState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL, 1, 8); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindMultisampleState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE, 1, 0x18); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindPolygonState) {
    record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_POLYGON, 1, 4);
    if (A(1)) memcpy(cb_of(A(0))->polygon, AP(1), 4);
}
/* (cmd, count, const state*) */
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexAttribState) {
    record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB, 2, (uint32_t)A(1) * 4);
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    cb->trace_nattribs = A(1) < 16 ? (uint32_t)A(1) : 16;
    if (A(2)) memcpy(cb->trace_attribs, AP(2), cb->trace_nattribs * 4);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexStreamState) {  /* (cmd, count, states: stride, divisor) */
    record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM, 2, (uint32_t)A(1) * 8);
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    if (A(2)) memcpy(cb->trace_streams, AP(2), (A(1) < 8 ? (uint32_t)A(1) : 8) * 8);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexBuffer) {  /* (cmd, index, address, size) */
    record(c, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS, 0);
    if (A(1) == 0) cb_of(A(0))->trace_vb0 = A(2);
    if (A(1) < 8) cb_of(A(0))->trace_vb[A(1)] = A(2);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindUniformBuffer) {  /* (cmd, stage, index, address, size) */
    record(c, CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS, 0);
    if (A(1) < 2 && A(2) < 16) cb_of(A(0))->trace_ub[A(1)][A(2)] = A(3), cb_of(A(0))->bound_ub[A(1)] |= 1u << A(2);
}
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferBindStorageBuffer, CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS)    /* (cmd, stage, index, address, size) */
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindTexture) {  /* (cmd, stage, index, handle) */
    record(c, CMD_BIND_TEXTURES, 0);
    if (A(1) < 2 && A(2) < TRACE_TEXTURES) cb_of(A(0))->trace_tex[A(1)][A(2)] = A(3), cb_of(A(0))->bound_tex[A(1)] |= 1u << A(2);
    if (nvn_trace_texpool((uint32_t)(A(3) & 0xFFFFF)) > 0) {  /* once per (stage, index, texture id, fragment shader) */
        enum { SEEN = 1024 };
        static uint64_t seen[SEEN];
        static int nseen;
        const NvnProgram *p = cb_of(A(0))->program;
        uint64_t k = (A(1) << 40 | A(2) << 20 | (A(3) & 0xFFFFF)) ^ (p ? p->stages[1].key : 0);
        int i = 0;
        while (i < nseen && seen[i] != k) i++;
        if (i == nseen && nseen < SEEN) {
            seen[nseen++] = k;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: BindTexture(stage %u, %u, %#" PRIx64 ") in cmdbuf %#" PRIx64 ", program fs %016llx\n",
                    (unsigned)A(1), (unsigned)A(2), A(3), A(0), p ? (unsigned long long)p->stages[1].key : 0ull);
        }
    }
}

                (void *)HOST(NvnDescPool, A(1)), A(1), A(0));
}

/* SetRenderTargets(cmd, count, const NVNtexture *const *colours, const NVNtextureView *const *views,
 * const NVNtexture *depth, const NVNtextureView *depth view): host textures and copies of the views */
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets) {
    int n = (int)A(1);
    if (n < 0 || n > 8) nvn_fatal(c, "%d render targets", n);
    RenderTargets rt = {0};
    const uint64_t *colors = AP(2), *views = AP(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (colors && colors[i]) {  /* copies: the texture objects may be gone when the list runs */
            rt.color_snap[i] = *HOST(NvnTexture, colors[i]);
            rt.color_snap[i].gpu = NULL;
            rt.color[i] = &rt.color_snap[i];
        }
        if (views && views[i]) rt.has_view[i] = 1, memcpy(&rt.views[i], (const void *)(uintptr_t)views[i], sizeof rt.views[i]);
    }
    if (A(4)) {
        rt.depth_snap = *HOST(NvnTexture, A(4));
        rt.depth_snap.gpu = NULL;
        rt.depth = &rt.depth_snap;
    }
    if (A(5)) rt.has_depth_view = 1, memcpy(&rt.depth_view, AP(5), sizeof rt.depth_view);
    /* our shadow pass for a layer the game is leaving goes in first (shadow.c) */
    shadow_before_targets(c, A(0), rt.depth ? rt.depth->addr : 0,
                          rt.has_depth_view && rt.depth_view.setmask & 2 ? rt.depth_view.min_layer : 0);
    memcpy(record(c, CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS, sizeof rt)->extra, &rt, sizeof rt);
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    cb->depth_addr = rt.depth ? rt.depth->addr : 0;
    cb->depth_guest = A(4);
    cb->depth_layer = rt.has_depth_view && rt.depth_view.setmask & 2 ? rt.depth_view.min_layer : 0;
    const NvnTexture *first = rt.color[0] ? rt.color[0] : rt.depth;
    cb->target_w = first ? first->width : 0, cb->target_h = first ? first->height : 0;
    cb->target_colors = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cb->target_colors += rt.color[i] != NULL;
    cb->target_depth = rt.depth != NULL;
}

    trace_draw_caller(c);

/* ---- running a list (headless: walking it) */

static uint64_t draws;

/* ---- what runs on the CPU for now (decision 0019): colour clears, written into the
 * texture's storage in the game's memory, so the presented frame shows them */

static NvnTexture *render_targets[8];  /* bound by the last SetRenderTargets */

/* Level 0 of layer 0 of t, every texel set to the clear colour in the channels of `mask`. */
static void clear_color(NvnTexture *t, const float color[4], uint32_t mask) {
    static uint32_t unknown_logged[8];
    uint8_t texel[16];
    int n = pixel_encode(t->format, color, texel);
    if (!n || n != t->layout.fmt->bpb) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            if (unknown_logged[i] == t->format) return;
            else if (!unknown_logged[i]) { unknown_logged[i] = t->format; break; }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: clear of format %#x not done on the CPU yet\n", t->format);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t *base = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr;
    uint64_t level0 = t->layout.levels > 1 ? tegra_level(&t->layout, 1).offset : tegra_layer_size(&t->layout);
    if ((mask & 0xF) == 0xF && 16 % n == 0) {  /* every texel equal: the layout doesn't matter */
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < level0; i += (uint64_t)n) memcpy(base + i, texel, (size_t)n);
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: clear with channel mask %#x not done on the CPU yet\n", mask);
}

void nvn_execute(uint64_t handle) {
    int gpu = gpu_ready();
    if (gpu) gpu_queue_execute(handle);  /* the draw path (0021, 0029); the walk below then only counts */
    uint64_t at = handle;
    for (int n = 0;; n++) {
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)at;
        if (r->op >= CMD_COUNT || r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || r->size & 7 || n > 10000000) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: command list %#llx is broken at %#llx (op %u, size %u)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)handle, (unsigned long long)at, r->op, r->size);
            yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        }
        switch (r->op) {
        case CMD_END: return;
        case CMD_JUMP: at = r->x[0]; continue;
        case CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS: case CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS: case CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS_INDIRECT: case CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS_INDIRECT:
        case CMD_DRAW_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK: case CMD_DISPATCH:
            __atomic_add_fetch(&draws, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            nvn_stats_draw(r->op == CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS ? 0 : r->op == CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS ? 1 : r->op == CMD_DISPATCH ? 3 : 2);
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_PROGRAM:
            nvn_stats_program((const void *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0]);
            break;
        case CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS: {
            static RenderTargets rt;  /* the record's copies; its pointers must be re-pointed */
            memcpy(&rt, r->extra, sizeof rt);
            render_targets_fix(&rt);
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) render_targets[i] = i < (int)r->x[0] ? rt.color[i] : NULL;
            break;
        }
        case CMD_CLEAR_COLOR: {  /* (index, colour, mask) */
            NvnTexture *t = r->x[0] < 8 ? render_targets[r->x[0]] : NULL;
            if (!gpu && t && t->addr) {
                float color[4];
                memcpy(color, r->extra, 16);
                clear_color(t, color, (uint32_t)r->x[2]);
            }
            break;
        }
        case CMD_REPORT_COUNTER: {  /* (counter, address): NVNcounterData {u64 value, u64 GPU ticks at 614.4 MHz} */
            if (gpu) break;
            uint64_t *out = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[1];
            out[0] = 0;
            out[1] = (uint64_t)((unsigned __int128)(uint64_t)host_now_ns() * 384 / 625);
            break;
        }
        }
        at += r->size;
    }
}

uint64_t nvn_take_draw_count(void) { return __atomic_exchange_n(&draws, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

const NvnImpl nvn_cmdbuf_impls[] = {
    IMPL(nvnCommandBufferInitialize), IMPL(nvnCommandBufferFinalize), IMPL(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory),
```

```c
 *
 * Headless for now: objects record what the game asks for; nothing is drawn. Only the NVN
 * functions the game uses are here (work/recon/nvn.md lists 177); any other one stops with
 * its name (nvn.c).
 *
 * Builder field offsets, state packing and the stage detection in ProgramSetShaders are
 * adapted from LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/objects.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */

        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }

}

/* YW4_TRACE_TEXPOOL=<id>: texture and sampler pools (diagnostic). Every pool, registration
 * counts per pool, and in detail what touches texture ids id-10..id+10 (1: around 3003). */
int nvn_trace_texpool(uint32_t id) {
    static int on = -1;
    static uint32_t center;
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_TRACE_TEXPOOL");
        on = e && *e && *e != '0';
        center = on ? (uint32_t)strtoul(e, NULL, 0) : 0;
        if (center <= 1) center = 3003;
    }
    if (!on) return 0;
    return id == UINT32_MAX || (id + 10 >= center && id <= center + 10) ? 1 : -1;
}
/* "caller <- caller's caller" of a guest call, for the trace */
static const char *trace_callers(const CPUState *c, char buf[320], uint64_t *hash) {
    uint64_t st[6];
    int n = yw4_call_stack(c, st, 6);
    char w[48];
    buf[0] = 0;
    uint64_t h = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        size_t l = strlen(buf);
        snprintf(buf + l, 320 - l, "%s%s", i ? " <- " : "", yw4_describe(st[i] - 4, w));
        h = (h ^ st[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    }
    if (hash) *hash = h;
    return buf;
}

/* Handles a shader uses to name descriptors: texture ID in the low 20 bits, sampler ID above. */
NVN(nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle) {
    if (nvn_trace_texpool((uint32_t)A(1)) > 0) {  /* once per texture id and call stack */
        enum { SEEN = 1024 };
        static uint64_t seen[SEEN];
        static int nseen;
        char b[320];
        uint64_t h;
        trace_callers(c, b, &h);
        h ^= A(1) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < nseen && seen[i] != h) i++;
        if (i == nseen && nseen < SEEN) {
            seen[nseen++] = h;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: GetTextureHandle(tex %u, sampler %u) = %#" PRIx64 " from %s\n", (unsigned)A(1),
                    (unsigned)A(2), (uint64_t)((A(1) & 0xFFFFF) | (A(2) & 0xFFF) << 20), b);
        }
    }
    RET((A(1) & 0xFFFFF) | (A(2) & 0xFFF) << 20);
}

static uint64_t frames;
extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c (YW4_TRACE_RENDER_JOBS) */

/* YW4_PRESENT_LOG=<frame>,<count> (testing frame order): the queue calls of those frames, with the calling
 * thread (numbered as first seen) and the queue. */
static void plog(const char *what, uint64_t queue, uint64_t arg) {
    static long long from = -2, count;
    if (from == -2) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_PRESENT_LOG");
        from = -1;
        if (e) sscanf(e, "%lld,%lld", &from, &count);
    }
    if (from < 0 || (long long)frames < from || (long long)frames >= from + count) return;
    static int next_id;
    static _Thread_local int id;
    if (!id) id = __atomic_add_fetch(&next_id, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: plog: frame %" PRIu64 " thread %d queue %#" PRIx64 " %s %#" PRIx64 " (jobs %" PRIu64 ")\n",
            frames, id, queue, what, arg, gpu_queue_fence());
}

NVN(nvnQueueSubmitCommands) {  /* (queue, count, const NVNcommandHandle*) */
    int n = (int)A(1);
    plog("submit", A(0), (uint64_t)n);
    const uint64_t *handles = AP(2);
    int64_t t = host_now_ns();
    yw4_thread_role(YW4_ROLE_SUBMIT);
    yw4_profile_thread(YW4_ROLE_SUBMIT, frames);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) nvn_execute(handles[i]);
    yw4_perf_add(PERF_SUBMIT, host_now_ns() - t);
}
/* The display flips at vsync and shows each frame for `interval` vsyncs; NVN only hands
 * out a window texture again once the display is done with it. Headless, presenting waits
 * for that flip directly, which paces the game as the Switch does (60 / interval). */
static uint64_t next_flip;

/* The presented texture, read back from the game's memory as RGBA8 rows for the window. */
static void show(NvnTexture *t, uint64_t frame, const int crop[4]) {
    static uint8_t *texels, *rgba;
    static size_t cap;
    static uint32_t logged_format;
    if (t && gpu_ready()) {
        gpu_queue_present(t, frame, crop);
        return;
    }
    if (!t || !t->addr || t->target != 1 /* 2D */ || t->layout.fmt->bw != 1) return;
    uint32_t w = t->width, h = t->height, bpb = t->layout.fmt->bpb;
    size_t n = (size_t)w * h;
    if (n > cap) {
        free(texels), free(rgba);
        texels = malloc(n * bpb), rgba = malloc(n * 4);
        if (!texels || !rgba) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        cap = n;
    }
    tegra_read_region(&t->layout, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, w, h, 1, texels);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!pixel_to_rgba8(t->format, texels + i * bpb, rgba + 4 * i)) {
            if (logged_format != t->format) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: can't show window format %#x yet\n", t->format);
            logged_format = t->format;
            return;
        }
    window_present_rgba(rgba, w, h, frame);
}

NVN(nvnQueuePresentTexture) {  /* (queue, window, texture index) */
    NvnWindow *w = HOST(NvnWindow, A(1));
    int index = (int)A(2);
    plog("present texture", A(0), (uint64_t)index);
    yw4_perf_presenter = 1;
    yw4_thread_role(YW4_ROLE_PRESENT);
    yw4_profile_thread(YW4_ROLE_PRESENT, frames);
    int64_t perf_enter = host_now_ns();
    if (index >= 0 && index < w->num) show(HOST(NvnTexture, w->textures[index]), frames + 1, w->crop);
    int64_t perf_shown = host_now_ns();
    yw4_vsync_start();
    if (w->interval > 0) {  /* the game's own pacing (YW4_FRAME_VSYNCS) */
        uint64_t now = yw4_vsync_count();
        if (next_flip < now + 1) next_flip = now + 1;
        yw4_wait_vsync(next_flip);
        next_flip += (uint64_t)w->interval;
    } else {
        framerate_wait();  /* interval 0: the panel's frame rate (framerate.c) */
    }
    static int64_t last_log;  /* host time of the last logged frame, for the rate since then */
    static uint64_t last_frames;
    frames++;
    __atomic_store_n(&yw4_frames_presented, frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    uint64_t draws = nvn_take_draw_count();
    yw4_perf_frame(frames, perf_enter, perf_shown, host_now_ns(), draws);
    nvn_stats_frame(frames);
    if (frames <= 3 || frames % 300 == 0) {
        int64_t now = host_now_ns();
        double fps = last_log ? (double)(frames - last_frames) * 1e9 / (double)(now - last_log) : 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN frame %" PRIu64 " presented (texture %d, %" PRIu64 " draws, %.1f frames/s)\n", frames,
                (int)A(2), draws, fps);
        last_log = now, last_frames = frames;
        if (frames == 1) yw4_boot_mark("first frame presented");
    }
}

/* Syncs: a sync keeps, in the game's NVNsync at +0, the number of the GPU submission it
 * waits for (gpu.c, decision 0021). Fencing takes the latest submission. Headless, GPU work
 * is done the moment it is submitted and every sync is signalled. One queue: the GPU never
 * has to wait for another queue (QueueWaitSync). */
NVN(nvnQueueFenceSync) {  /* (queue, sync, condition, flags) */
    G(uint64_t, A(1), 0) = gpu_queue_fence();
    plog("fence sync", A(0), A(1));
}
NVN(nvnQueueWaitSync) {  /* (queue, sync) */
    plog("wait sync", A(0), A(1));
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnSyncInitialize) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = 0; RET(1); }
NVN(nvnSyncFinalize) { (void)c; }
/* (sync, timeout ns) -> ALREADY_SIGNALED 0, CONDITION_SATISFIED 1, TIMEOUT_EXPIRED 2 */
NVN(nvnSyncWait) {
    plog("cpu wait sync", 0, A(0));
    int64_t t = host_now_ns();
    int r = gpu_queue_wait(G(uint64_t, A(0), 0), A(1));
    yw4_perf_add(PERF_SYNC, host_now_ns() - t);
    RET(r);
}

/* ================================================================== memory pools
 * Builder: device@0 flags@8 storage@0x10 size@0x18. GPU addresses are guest addresses. */

NVN(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults) { memset(AP(0), 0, 0x20); G(uint32_t, A(0), 8) = 0x9; }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags) { G(uint32_t, A(0), 8) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x10) = A(1); G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x18) = A(2); }

NVN(nvnMemoryPoolInitialize) {
    NvnPool *p = alloc(sizeof *p);
    p->storage = G(uint64_t, A(1), 0x10);
    p->size = G(uint64_t, A(1), 0x18);
    p->flags = G(uint32_t, A(1), 8);
    nvn_stats_pool(p->flags, p->size);
    if (nvn_stats_enabled())
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN pool %#llx + %#llx flags %#x\n", (unsigned long long)p->storage,
                (unsigned long long)p->size, p->flags);
    gpu_pool_init(p);
    SET_HOST(A(0), p);
    RET(1);
}
/* Freeing an object that queued GPU work may still use goes through the GPU worker's queue
 * (decision 0029): it runs after that work. */
static void finalize_pool(void *p) { gpu_pool_finalize(p), free(p); }
static void finalize_texture(void *t) { gpu_texture_finalize(t), free(t); }
static void finalize_program(void *p) { gpu_program_finalize(p), free(p); }
static void finalize_desc_pool(void *p) { NvnDescPool *d = p; free(d->entries), free(d); }

NVN(nvnMemoryPoolFinalize) {
    gpu_queue_call(finalize_pool, HOST(NvnPool, A(0)));
    SET_HOST(A(0), 0);
}
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolMap) { RET(HOST(NvnPool, A(0))->storage); }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags) { RET(HOST(NvnPool, A(0))->flags); }
/* CPU writes visible to the GPU: shared memory already. Noted: the game says what it wrote (pool, offset, size). */
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange) { gpu_note_flushed(HOST(NvnPool, A(0))->storage + A(1), A(2)); }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolInvalidateMappedRange) { (void)c; }

/* ================================================================== buffers
 * Builder: device@0 pool@8 offset@0x10 size@0x18. Buffer: address@0 pool@8 offset@0x10 size@0x18 */

NVN(nvnBufferBuilderSetDevice) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnBufferBuilderSetDefaults) { memset((uint8_t *)AP(0) + 8, 0, 0x18); }
NVN(nvnBufferBuilderSetStorage) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 8) = A(1); G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x10) = A(2); G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x18) = A(3); }
NVN(nvnBufferInitialize) {
    uint64_t pool = G(uint64_t, A(1), 8), off = G(uint64_t, A(1), 0x10);
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = HOST(NvnPool, pool)->storage + off;
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 8) = pool;
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x10) = off;
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x18) = G(uint64_t, A(1), 0x18);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnBufferFinalize) { (void)c; }
NVN(nvnBufferMap) { RET(G(uint64_t, A(0), 0)); }
NVN(nvnBufferGetAddress) { RET(G(uint64_t, A(0), 0)); }
NVN(nvnBufferFlushMappedRange) { gpu_note_flushed(G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) + A(1), A(2)); }  /* (buffer, offset, size) */
NVN(nvnBufferInvalidateMappedRange) { (void)c; }

/* ================================================================== textures
 * TextureBuilder: device@0 flags@8 target@0xC width@0x10 height@0x14 depth@0x18 levels@0x1C
 *   format@0x20 samples@0x24 swizzle@0x28 ds mode@0x2C stride@0x30 pool@0x38 offset@0x40
 *   packaged layout@0x50 */

#define TB(T, off) G(T, A(0), off)

NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetDevice) { TB(uint64_t, 0) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetDefaults) {
    memset((uint8_t *)AP(0) + 8, 0, 0x58);
    TB(uint32_t, 0xC) = TARGET_2D;
    TB(uint32_t, 0x10) = TB(uint32_t, 0x14) = TB(uint32_t, 0x18) = TB(uint32_t, 0x1C) = 1;
    TB(uint8_t, 0x28) = 2, TB(uint8_t, 0x29) = 3, TB(uint8_t, 0x2A) = 4, TB(uint8_t, 0x2B) = 5;  /* R G B A */
}
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetFlags) { TB(uint32_t, 8) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetTarget) { TB(uint32_t, 0xC) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetSize3D) { TB(uint32_t, 0x10) = (uint32_t)A(1), TB(uint32_t, 0x14) = (uint32_t)A(2), TB(uint32_t, 0x18) = (uint32_t)A(3); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetLevels) { TB(uint32_t, 0x1C) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetFormat) { TB(uint32_t, 0x20) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetSamples) { TB(uint32_t, 0x24) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetSwizzle) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) TB(uint8_t, 0x28 + i) = (uint8_t)A(1 + i);
}
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetStorage) { TB(uint64_t, 0x38) = A(1); TB(uint64_t, 0x40) = A(2); }
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderSetPackagedTextureLayout) { TB(uint64_t, 0x50) = A(1) ? *(const uint64_t *)AP(1) : 0; }

static const FormatInfo *format_of(const CPUState *c, uint32_t format) {
    const FormatInfo *f = nvn_format_info(format);
    if (!f) nvn_fatal(c, "texture format %#x not known", format);
    return f;
}

/* The texture's storage layout from a builder. Multisampled textures are stored as one
 * bigger surface: 2x as 2x1 samples per pixel, 4x as 2x2, 8x as 4x2 (Maxwell). */
static void builder_layout(const CPUState *c, uint64_t b, TexLayout *t) {
    uint32_t target = G(uint32_t, b, 0xC), samples = G(uint32_t, b, 0x24);
    memset(t, 0, sizeof *t);
    t->fmt = format_of(c, G(uint32_t, b, 0x20));
    t->width = G(uint32_t, b, 0x10);
    t->height = target == TARGET_1D || target == TARGET_1D_ARRAY ? 1 : G(uint32_t, b, 0x14);
    t->depth = target == TARGET_3D ? G(uint32_t, b, 0x18) : 1;
    t->layers = target == TARGET_1D_ARRAY ? G(uint32_t, b, 0x14)
              : target == TARGET_CUBE ? 6
              : target == TARGET_2D_ARRAY || target == TARGET_2D_MS_ARRAY || target == TARGET_CUBE_ARRAY ? G(uint32_t, b, 0x18)
              : 1;
    if (!t->layers) t->layers = 1;
    t->levels = G(uint32_t, b, 0x1C) ? G(uint32_t, b, 0x1C) : 1;
    if (samples > 1) {
        if (samples != 2 && samples != 4 && samples != 8) nvn_fatal(c, "%u samples per pixel", samples);
        t->width *= samples == 8 ? 4 : 2;
        if (samples >= 4) t->height *= 2;
    }
    tegra_layout_init(t);
    /* Packaged textures were laid out offline with their own block height: the low word of
     * NVNpackagedTextureLayout is log2(GOBs per block). */
    uint64_t packaged = G(uint64_t, b, 0x50);
    if (packaged && (uint32_t)packaged <= 5) t->block_height_log2 = (uint32_t)packaged;
}

static int builder_linear(uint64_t b) { return (G(uint32_t, b, 8) & FLAG_LINEAR) || G(uint32_t, b, 0xC) == TARGET_BUFFER; }

NVN(nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize) {
    uint64_t b = A(0);
    if (G(uint32_t, b, 0xC) == TARGET_BUFFER) {
        RET((uint64_t)G(uint32_t, b, 0x10) * format_of(c, G(uint32_t, b, 0x20))->bpb);
    } else if (builder_linear(b)) {
        RET(G(uint64_t, b, 0x30) * G(uint32_t, b, 0x14));  /* stride x height */
    } else {
        TexLayout t;
        builder_layout(c, b, &t);
        RET(tegra_total_size(&t));
    }
}
NVN(nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment) { RET(builder_linear(A(0)) ? 32 : 512); }

NVN(nvnTextureInitialize) {
    uint64_t b = A(1);
    NvnTexture *t = alloc(sizeof *t);
    t->flags = G(uint32_t, b, 8);
    t->target = G(uint32_t, b, 0xC);
    t->width = G(uint32_t, b, 0x10), t->height = G(uint32_t, b, 0x14), t->depth = G(uint32_t, b, 0x18);
    t->levels = G(uint32_t, b, 0x1C) ? G(uint32_t, b, 0x1C) : 1;
    t->format = G(uint32_t, b, 0x20);
    t->samples = G(uint32_t, b, 0x24);
    memcpy(t->swizzle, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(b + 0x28), 4);
    t->ds_mode = G(uint32_t, b, 0x2C);
    t->stride = G(uint64_t, b, 0x30);
    uint64_t pool = G(uint64_t, b, 0x38);
    t->addr = pool ? HOST(NvnPool, pool)->storage + G(uint64_t, b, 0x40) : 0;
    t->pool_flags = pool ? HOST(NvnPool, pool)->flags : 0;
    if (t->target != TARGET_BUFFER) builder_layout(c, b, &t->layout);
    if (nvn_stats_enabled() && (t->format == 0x4d || t->flags & FLAG_LINEAR))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN texture %ux%u format %#x flags %#x packaged %#llx stride %llu block height log2 %u\n",
                t->width, t->height, t->format, t->flags, (unsigned long long)G(uint64_t, b, 0x50),
                (unsigned long long)t->stride, t->layout.block_height_log2);
    SET_HOST(A(0), t);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnTextureFinalize) {
    static long finalized_registered;
    if (HOST(NvnTexture, A(0))->registered && finalized_registered++ < 5)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN: texture %ux%u finalized while registered in a texture pool\n",
                HOST(NvnTexture, A(0))->width, HOST(NvnTexture, A(0))->height);
    gpu_queue_call(finalize_texture, HOST(NvnTexture, A(0)));
    SET_HOST(A(0), 0);
}
NVN(nvnTextureGetFlags) { RET(HOST(NvnTexture, A(0))->flags); }

/* (texture, view or NULL, const NVNcopyRegion*, data): tightly packed linear texels into the
 * texture's storage. Region: x, y, z offsets, then width, height, depth, in texels; for
 * array and cube textures z and depth pick layers. The view can choose the level (its base
 * level) and the first layer. */
NVN(nvnTextureWriteTexels) {
    NvnTexture *t = HOST(NvnTexture, A(0));
    const NvnTextureView *v = AP(1);
    const int32_t *r = AP(2);
    if (t->flags & FLAG_LINEAR || t->target == TARGET_BUFFER) nvn_fatal(c, "WriteTexels to a linear texture");
    if (v && v->setmask & ~0xFu) nvn_fatal(c, "WriteTexels through a view with target or depth-stencil mode set (%#x)", v->setmask);
    if (v && v->setmask & 4) {  /* a view format: the bytes go in as they are if its blocks have the same size */
        const FormatInfo *vf = format_of(c, v->format);
        if (vf->bpb != t->layout.fmt->bpb || vf->bw != t->layout.fmt->bw || vf->bh != t->layout.fmt->bh)
            nvn_fatal(c, "WriteTexels through a view of format %#x, texture format %#x", v->format, t->format);
    }  /* a view swizzle changes how shaders read, not the bytes */
    if (!r || r[0] < 0 || r[1] < 0 || r[2] < 0 || r[3] <= 0 || r[4] <= 0 || r[5] <= 0) nvn_fatal(c, "WriteTexels region");
    uint32_t level = v && v->setmask & 1 ? v->base_level : 0, layer = v && v->setmask & 2 ? v->min_layer : 0;
    uint32_t w = t->layout.width >> level, h = t->layout.height >> level, d = t->layout.depth >> level;
    if (!w) w = 1;
    if (!h) h = 1;
    if (!d) d = 1;
    int layered = t->layout.layers > 1 || t->target == TARGET_2D_ARRAY || t->target == TARGET_CUBE ||
                  t->target == TARGET_CUBE_ARRAY || t->target == TARGET_1D_ARRAY;
    uint32_t x = (uint32_t)r[0], y = (uint32_t)r[1], z = (uint32_t)r[2], rw = (uint32_t)r[3], rh = (uint32_t)r[4],
             rd = (uint32_t)r[5];
    if (level >= t->layout.levels || x + rw > w || y + rh > h ||
        (layered ? layer + z + rd > t->layout.layers : z + rd > d))
        nvn_fatal(c, "WriteTexels region (%u,%u,%u)+(%u,%u,%u) outside level %u (%ux%ux%u, %u layers)", x, y, z, rw, rh,
                  rd, level, w, h, d, t->layout.layers);
    const FormatInfo *f = t->layout.fmt;
    uint64_t slice = (uint64_t)((rw + f->bw - 1) / f->bw) * ((rh + f->bh - 1) / f->bh) * f->bpb;
    const uint8_t *src = AP(3);
    nvn_stats_texels(slice * rd);
    t->cpu_written = 1;
    if (layered) {
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < rd; k++)
            tegra_write_region(&t->layout, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, level, layer + z + k, x, y, 0, rw, rh, 1,
                               src + k * slice);
    } else {
        tegra_write_region(&t->layout, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, level, layer, x, y, z, rw, rh, rd, src);
    }
    gpu_note_written(t->addr, tegra_total_size(&t->layout));  /* after the bytes: draws use the registration's copy */
}

/* Texture views: our layout of the 0x28-byte NVNtextureView, a set-mask and the fields */
NVN(nvnTextureViewSetDefaults) { memset(AP(0), 0, 0x28); }
NVN(nvnTextureViewSetLevels) {
    NvnTextureView *v = AP(0);
    v->setmask |= 1, v->base_level = (uint16_t)A(1), v->num_levels = (uint16_t)A(2);
}
NVN(nvnTextureViewSetLayers) {
    NvnTextureView *v = AP(0);
    v->setmask |= 2, v->min_layer = (uint16_t)A(1), v->num_layers = (uint16_t)A(2);
}
NVN(nvnTextureViewSetFormat) { NvnTextureView *v = AP(0); v->setmask |= 4, v->format = (uint32_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnTextureViewSetSwizzle) {
    NvnTextureView *v = AP(0);
    v->setmask |= 8;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v->swizzle[i] = (uint8_t)A(1 + i);
}

/* ================================================================== samplers
 * SamplerBuilder: device@0, then an NvnSamplerDesc at 8 (fits in the 0x60-byte builder) */

#define SD ((NvnSamplerDesc *)((uint8_t *)AP(0) + 8))
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetDevice) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetDefaults) {
    NvnSamplerDesc *d = SD;
    memset(d, 0, sizeof *d);
    d->wrap[0] = d->wrap[1] = d->wrap[2] = 1;  /* REPEAT */
    d->lod_max = 1000.0f;
    d->max_aniso = 1.0f;
    d->compare_func = 4;
}
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetMinMagFilter) { SD->min_filter = (uint32_t)A(1), SD->mag_filter = (uint32_t)A(2); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetWrapMode) { for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) SD->wrap[i] = (uint32_t)A(1 + i); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetLodClamp) { SD->lod_min = AF(0), SD->lod_max = AF(1); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetLodBias) { SD->lod_bias = AF(0); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetCompare) { SD->compare_mode = (uint32_t)A(1), SD->compare_func = (uint32_t)A(2); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetBorderColor) { memcpy(SD->border, AP(1), 16); }
NVN(nvnSamplerBuilderSetMaxAnisotropy) { SD->max_aniso = AF(0); }

/* ================================================================== texture and sampler pools
 * Pool: host@0 memory pool@8 offset@16 count@24 */

static void desc_pool_init(CPUState *c, size_t entry) {  /* (pool, memory pool, offset, count) */
    NvnDescPool *d = alloc(sizeof *d);
    d->addr = HOST(NvnPool, A(1))->storage + A(2);
    d->count = (int)A(3);
    d->entries = alloc((size_t)d->count * entry);
    if (nvn_trace_texpool(UINT32_MAX) > 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: %s pool %p (guest %#" PRIx64 ") at %#" PRIx64 ", %d entries\n",
                entry == sizeof(NvnTexEntry) ? "texture" : "sampler", (void *)d, A(0), d->addr, d->count);
    SET_HOST(A(0), d);
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 8) = A(1);
    G(uint64_t, A(0), 16) = A(2);
    G(uint32_t, A(0), 24) = (uint32_t)A(3);
    RET(1);
}
static void desc_pool_finalize(CPUState *c) {
    NvnDescPool *d = HOST(NvnDescPool, A(0));
    if (nvn_trace_texpool(UINT32_MAX) > 0) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: pool %p finalized\n", (void *)d);
    if (d) gpu_queue_call(finalize_desc_pool, d);
    SET_HOST(A(0), 0);
}
static void *desc_entry(CPUState *c, size_t entry) {  /* (pool, id, ...) */
    NvnDescPool *d = HOST(NvnDescPool, A(0));
    int id = (int)A(1);
    if (id < 0 || id >= d->count) nvn_fatal(c, "descriptor %d outside a pool of %d", id, d->count);
    return (uint8_t *)d->entries + (size_t)id * entry;
}

NVN(nvnTexturePoolInitialize) { desc_pool_init(c, sizeof(NvnTexEntry)); }
NVN(nvnTexturePoolFinalize) { desc_pool_finalize(c); }
/* Every registration gets the next number: a newer one of the same memory than the image's last upload is a
 * reason to upload it again where the host can't see the game's writes (gpu.c cpu_changed). */
static uint32_t registrations;

static void register_texture(CPUState *c) {  /* (pool, id, texture, view or NULL) */
    NvnTexEntry *e = desc_entry(c, sizeof *e);
    NvnTexture *t = HOST(NvnTexture, A(2));
    t->registered++;
    t->pool_id = (int)A(1);
    e->snap = *t;  /* a copy, as the hardware's descriptor is */
    e->snap.gpu = NULL;
    e->snap.reg_gen = __atomic_add_fetch(&registrations, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    e->tex = &e->snap;
    e->has_view = A(3) != 0;
    e->guest = A(2);
    if (e->has_view) memcpy(&e->view, AP(3), sizeof e->view);
    int tr = nvn_trace_texpool((uint32_t)A(1));
    if (tr) {
        enum { POOLS = 16 };
        static const void *pools[POOLS];
        static long regs[POOLS], detail;
        const void *d = HOST(NvnDescPool, A(0));
        int i = 0;
        while (i < POOLS && pools[i] && pools[i] != d) i++;
        if (i < POOLS) {
            pools[i] = d;
            long r = ++regs[i];  /* its own statement: read and written in one expression was undefined (GCC, #12) */
            if (!(r & (r - 1)))  /* powers of two */
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: pool %p: %ld registrations\n", d, regs[i]);
        }
        char b[320];
        if (tr > 0 && detail++ < 400)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: texpool: pool %p id %u <- %ux%u format %#x at %#" PRIx64 " target %u levels %u%s from %s\n",
                    d, (unsigned)A(1), t->width, t->height, t->format, t->addr, t->target, t->levels,
                    e->has_view ? " (view)" : "", trace_callers(c, b, NULL));
    }
}
NVN(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture) { register_texture(c); }
NVN(nvnTexturePoolRegisterImage) { register_texture(c); }

NVN(nvnSamplerPoolInitialize) { desc_pool_init(c, sizeof(NvnSamplerDesc)); }
NVN(nvnSamplerPoolFinalize) { desc_pool_finalize(c); }
NVN(nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSamplerBuilder) {  /* (pool, id, builder) */
    *(NvnSamplerDesc *)desc_entry(c, sizeof(NvnSamplerDesc)) = *(const NvnSamplerDesc *)((uint8_t *)AP(2) + 8);
}

/* ================================================================== programs */

NVN(nvnProgramInitialize) { SET_HOST(A(0), alloc(sizeof(NvnProgram))); RET(1); }
NVN(nvnProgramFinalize) {
    gpu_queue_call(finalize_program, HOST(NvnProgram, A(0)));
    SET_HOST(A(0), 0);
}
/* (program, count, const NVNshaderData*): each {u64 code address, const void *control}. The
 * stage comes from the Maxwell shader program header after the 0x30-byte NVN header; code
 * without the header magic is compute. */
NVN(nvnProgramSetShaders) {
    NvnProgram *p = HOST(NvnProgram, A(0));
    int n = (int)A(1);
    const uint64_t *data = AP(2);
    gpu_queue_drain();  /* queued work may still draw with the old shaders (decision 0029) */
    gpu_program_finalize(p);
    memset(p, 0, sizeof *p);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t code = data[2 * i], control = data[2 * i + 1];
        int stage = 5;
        if (G(uint32_t, code, 0) == 0x12345678) switch ((G(uint32_t, code, 0x30) >> 10) & 0xF) {
            case 1: stage = 0; break;  /* vertex */
            case 5: stage = 1; break;  /* fragment */
            case 4: stage = 2; break;  /* geometry */
            case 2: stage = 3; break;  /* tessellation control */
            case 3: stage = 4; break;  /* tessellation evaluation */
            }
        uint64_t key = nvn_shader_key(control);
        if (!key) nvn_fatal(c, "shader stage %d has no NV_gpu_program5 assembly in its control section", stage);
        static const char *const names[6] = {"vert", "frag", "geom", "tesc", "tese", "comp"};
        nvn_stats_shader(key, names[stage]);
        p->stages[stage] = (NvnShaderStage){code, control, key};
        p->stage_mask |= 1u << stage;
    }
    RET(1);
}

/* ================================================================== window
 * WindowBuilder: device@0 native window@8 count@0x10 textures@0x18 interval@0x20 active@0x24 */

NVN(nvnWindowBuilderSetDevice) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnWindowBuilderSetDefaults) { memset((uint8_t *)AP(0) + 8, 0, 0x20); G(uint32_t, A(0), 0x20) = 1; }
NVN(nvnWindowBuilderSetNativeWindow) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 8) = A(1); }
NVN(nvnWindowBuilderSetTextures) { G(uint32_t, A(0), 0x10) = (uint32_t)A(1); G(uint64_t, A(0), 0x18) = A(2); }

NVN(nvnWindowInitialize) {
    NvnWindow *w = alloc(sizeof *w);
    w->num = (int)G(uint32_t, A(1), 0x10);
    if (w->num < 1 || w->num > 8) nvn_fatal(c, "window with %d textures", w->num);
    memcpy(w->textures, (const void *)(uintptr_t)G(uint64_t, A(1), 0x18), (size_t)w->num * 8);
    w->interval = (int)G(uint32_t, A(1), 0x20);
    w->active = G(uint32_t, A(1), 0x24) ? (int)G(uint32_t, A(1), 0x24) : w->num;
    SET_HOST(A(0), w);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN window with %d textures\n", w->num);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnWindowFinalize) { free(HOST(NvnWindow, A(0))); SET_HOST(A(0), 0); }
NVN(nvnWindowSetCrop) { NvnWindow *w = HOST(NvnWindow, A(0)); for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) w->crop[i] = (int)A(1 + i); }
NVN(nvnWindowSetPresentInterval) {
    HOST(NvnWindow, A(0))->interval = (int)A(1);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN present interval %d (%s)\n", (int)A(1), A(1) ? "60 frames/s divided by it at most" : "no limit");
}
NVN(nvnWindowAcquireTexture) {  /* (window, sync signalled when it's free, int *index) */
    NvnWindow *w = HOST(NvnWindow, A(0));
    if (A(1)) G(uint64_t, A(1), 0) = gpu_queue_fence();  /* free once what was submitted has run */
    *(int32_t *)AP(2) = w->next;
    plog("acquire texture", 0, (uint64_t)w->next);
    w->next = (w->next + 1) % w->active;
    RET(0);  /* NVN_WINDOW_ACQUIRE_TEXTURE_RESULT_SUCCESS */
}

/* ================================================================== small state objects
 * The game binds these by value (the command buffer copies them), so their fields live in
 * the guest object, packed into its ABI size. */

/* BlendState (8 bytes): target, src colour, dst colour, src alpha, dst alpha, eq colour, eq alpha */
NVN(nvnBlendStateSetDefaults) {
    static const uint8_t d[8] = {0, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 0};  /* ONE, ZERO, ONE, ZERO, ADD, ADD */
    memcpy(AP(0), d, 8);
}
NVN(nvnBlendStateSetBlendTarget) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnBlendStateSetBlendFunc) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) G(uint8_t, A(0), 1 + i) = (uint8_t)A(1 + i); }
NVN(nvnBlendStateSetBlendEquation) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 5) = (uint8_t)A(1); G(uint8_t, A(0), 6) = (uint8_t)A(2); }

/* ChannelMaskState (4 bytes): 4 bits per colour target */
NVN(nvnChannelMaskStateSetDefaults) { G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = 0xFFFFFFFFu; }
NVN(nvnChannelMaskStateSetChannelMask) {  /* (state, target, r, g, b, a) */
    unsigned t = (unsigned)A(1) & 7;
    uint32_t m = (A(2) ? 1u : 0) | (A(3) ? 2u : 0) | (A(4) ? 4u : 0) | (A(5) ? 8u : 0);
    G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = (G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) & ~(0xFu << (4 * t))) | m << (4 * t);
}

/* ColorState (4 bytes): blend enable per target, logic op, alpha test */
NVN(nvnColorStateSetDefaults) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = 0; G(uint8_t, A(0), 1) = 3; G(uint8_t, A(0), 2) = 8; }
NVN(nvnColorStateSetBlendEnable) {
    uint8_t bit = (uint8_t)(1u << (A(1) & 7));
    G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = A(2) ? G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) | bit : G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) & ~bit;
}

/* DepthStencilState (8 bytes): depth test, depth write, depth func, stencil test, stencil func
 * (front | back << 4), then the stencil ops (fail, depth fail, pass) in 4-bit fields, front then back */
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetDefaults) {
    static const uint8_t d[8] = {0, 1, 2, 0, 0x88, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11};
    memcpy(AP(0), d, 8);
}
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetDepthTestEnable) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetDepthWriteEnable) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 1) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetDepthFunc) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 2) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetStencilTestEnable) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 3) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetStencilFunc) {  /* (state, face: 1 front 2 back 3 both, func) */
    uint8_t *d = AP(0);
    if (A(1) & 1) d[4] = (uint8_t)((d[4] & 0xF0) | (A(2) & 0xF));
    if (A(1) & 2) d[4] = (uint8_t)((d[4] & 0x0F) | (A(2) & 0xF) << 4);
}
NVN(nvnDepthStencilStateSetStencilOp) {  /* (state, face, fail, depth fail, pass) */
    uint8_t *d = AP(0);
    uint32_t ops = (uint32_t)((A(2) & 0xF) | (A(3) & 0xF) << 4 | (A(4) & 0xF) << 8);
    uint32_t packed = d[5] | d[6] << 8 | d[7] << 16;
    if (A(1) & 1) packed = (packed & ~0xFFFu) | ops;
    if (A(1) & 2) packed = (packed & 0xFFFu) | ops << 12;
    d[5] = (uint8_t)packed, d[6] = (uint8_t)(packed >> 8), d[7] = (uint8_t)(packed >> 16);
}

/* MultisampleState (0x18 bytes): enable@0 samples@4 ... */
NVN(nvnMultisampleStateSetDefaults) { memset(AP(0), 0, 0x18); G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = 1; G(uint8_t, A(0), 0xD) = 1; }
NVN(nvnMultisampleStateSetMultisampleEnable) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = (uint8_t)A(1); }

/* PolygonState (4 bytes): cull face, front face, polygon mode, offset enables */
NVN(nvnPolygonStateSetDefaults) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = 0; G(uint8_t, A(0), 1) = 1; G(uint8_t, A(0), 2) = 2; G(uint8_t, A(0), 3) = 0; }
NVN(nvnPolygonStateSetCullFace) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 0) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnPolygonStateSetFrontFace) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 1) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnPolygonStateSetPolygonMode) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 2) = (uint8_t)A(1); }
NVN(nvnPolygonStateSetPolygonOffsetEnables) { G(uint8_t, A(0), 3) = (uint8_t)A(1); }

/* VertexAttribState (4 bytes): format bits 0-7, stream bits 8-12, relative offset bits 13-31 */
NVN(nvnVertexAttribStateSetDefaults) { G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = 0; }
NVN(nvnVertexAttribStateSetFormat) {  /* (state, format, relative offset) */
    G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = (G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) & 0x1F00u) | (uint32_t)(A(1) & 0xFF) | (uint32_t)(A(2) << 13);
}
NVN(nvnVertexAttribStateSetStreamIndex) {
    G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = (G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) & ~0x1F00u) | (uint32_t)((A(1) & 0x1F) << 8);
}

/* VertexStreamState (8 bytes): stride, divisor */
NVN(nvnVertexStreamStateSetDefaults) { G(uint64_t, A(0), 0) = 0; }
NVN(nvnVertexStreamStateSetStride) { G(uint32_t, A(0), 0) = (uint32_t)A(1); }
```

`runtime/src/nvn_shader.c`:

```c
/* Which translated shader a program stage is (decision 0020), and NVN usage statistics.
 *
 * The control section the game passes to nvnProgramSetShaders holds the NV_gpu_program5
 * assembly the stage was compiled from. Its FNV-1a 64 hash, from "!!NV" through "END",
 * names the translated shader: <work_dir>/shaders/glsl/<key>.<stage> (recomp/shader.py).
 *
 * YW4_NVN_STATS=1 prints, every 300 frames, how the game feeds the GPU: memory pools by
 * flags, texture uploads, draws and programs, and whether every program's shader exists in
 * YW4_SHADER_DIR. Measurements for the draw path's design; not needed to run.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "nvn.h"

#define SCAN_LIMIT (1u << 20)  /* the assembly sits within the first KiBs of a control section */

uint64_t nvn_shader_key(uint64_t control) {
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)control;
    uint32_t a = 0;
    while (a + 4 <= SCAN_LIMIT && memcmp(p + a, "!!NV", 4)) a++;
    if (a + 4 > SCAN_LIMIT) return 0;
    uint64_t h = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull;
    for (uint32_t i = a; i < a + SCAN_LIMIT; i++) {
        h = (h ^ p[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
        /* "\nEND" not followed by a capital letter (ENDIF, ENDREP) ends the program */
        if (i >= a + 3 && !memcmp(p + i - 3, "\nEND", 4) && !(p[i + 1] >= 'A' && p[i + 1] <= 'Z')) return h;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- statistics */

static int stats_on = -1;
int nvn_stats_enabled(void) {
    if (stats_on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_NVN_STATS");
        stats_on = e && *e && *e != '0';
    }
    return stats_on;
}

enum { MAX_KEYS = 4096, MAX_POOL_KINDS = 16 };
static uint64_t keys[MAX_KEYS];
static uint8_t key_known[MAX_KEYS];
static int nkeys, nmissing;
static struct { uint32_t flags, count; uint64_t bytes; } pools[MAX_POOL_KINDS];
static int npool_kinds;
static uint64_t texel_writes, texel_bytes, binds, draws_by_kind[4];
static uint64_t frame_programs[256];
static int nframe_programs;

/* Remembers a shader key; checks once whether its translation exists. */
void nvn_stats_shader(uint64_t key, const char *stage) {
    if (!nvn_stats_enabled() || !key) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < nkeys; i++)
        if (keys[i] == key) return;
    if (nkeys == MAX_KEYS) return;
    const char *dir = getenv("YW4_SHADER_DIR");
    char path[1024];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".%s", dir ? dir : "work/shaders/glsl", key, stage);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    key_known[nkeys] = f != NULL;
    if (f) fclose(f);
    else if (nmissing++ < 10) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN stats: no translated shader %s\n", path);
    keys[nkeys++] = key;
}

void nvn_stats_pool(uint32_t flags, uint64_t size) {
    if (!nvn_stats_enabled()) return;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < npool_kinds && pools[i].flags != flags) i++;
    if (i == MAX_POOL_KINDS) return;
    if (i == npool_kinds) pools[npool_kinds++].flags = flags;
    pools[i].count++, pools[i].bytes += size;
}

void nvn_stats_texels(uint64_t bytes) { texel_writes++, texel_bytes += bytes; }

/* kind: 0 draw, 1 indexed draw, 2 indirect draw, 3 dispatch */
void nvn_stats_draw(int kind) { draws_by_kind[kind]++; }

void nvn_stats_program(const void *program) {
    binds++;
    uint64_t p = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)program;
    for (int i = 0; i < nframe_programs; i++)
        if (frame_programs[i] == p) return;
    if (nframe_programs < 256) frame_programs[nframe_programs++] = p;
}

void nvn_stats_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    if (!nvn_stats_enabled()) return;
    if (frame % 300 == 0) {
        int known = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nkeys; i++) known += key_known[i];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN stats frame %" PRIu64 ": shaders seen %d (translated %d); last frame: %" PRIu64
                " draws, %" PRIu64 " indexed, %" PRIu64 " indirect, %" PRIu64 " dispatches, %" PRIu64
                " program binds, %d programs; since last: %" PRIu64 " WriteTexels (%" PRIu64 " KiB)\n",
                frame, nkeys, known, draws_by_kind[0], draws_by_kind[1], draws_by_kind[2], draws_by_kind[3], binds,
                nframe_programs, texel_writes, texel_bytes >> 10);
        for (int i = 0; i < npool_kinds; i++)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: NVN stats   pools flags %#x: %u, %" PRIu64 " MiB\n", pools[i].flags, pools[i].count,
                    pools[i].bytes >> 20);
        texel_writes = texel_bytes = 0;
    }
    memset(draws_by_kind, 0, sizeof draws_by_kind);
    binds = 0, nframe_programs = 0;
}

```

`runtime/src/pause.c`:

```c
/* The overlay's pause (2026-11-05): the game's own pause, its pause screen hidden.
 *
 * How the game pauses (found with the scene-open log below, YW4_MENU_LOG): its main loop is a state machine
 * (f_846d20: the current state's Enter / Update / Exit, vtable slots 2 / 3 / 4). Plus in the field switches it
 * from the field's state to yw::MenuState (vtable main+0x14ccea0). MenuState's Enter (f_866540) opens a scene,
 * f_880750(out, "SceneMenu", 1, params), with the menu the field asked for in params: the menu "gameover_menu"
 * (CRC-32 0xf30e0a97) with the sub-menu "pause_menu" (0xd9d00e37), the "Paused" screen (Continue / Return to
 * Title; the Lua script pause_menu.lua builds it on the game-over screen's layers). MenuState's Update (f_8667d0)
 * waits while that scene exists; once Continue has closed it, it goes back to the field's state, and the state's
 * Exit (f_866cc0) runs.
 *
 * The pause screen's scene is what freezes the world: tried 2026-11-05, MenuState without the scene (the
 * scene-open hook handing back "no scene") stops the player and the camera, but people and Yo-kai on the map go
 * on moving (and Whisper comes out, as for a menu). So the screen opens as usual and the window hides it behind
 * the picture kept at the press (window.c). Here the hooks only say where the game is: paused (the pause scene
 * opened for the overlay's Plus) and resumed (MenuState's Exit), so the window knows when to press A on Continue
 * (again until the game has resumed) and when to show the live picture again, without guessing from the picture. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "kernel.h"
#include "pause.h"
#include "savefs.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

#define ENTER_CALL_RET 0x8665d8u  /* MenuState's Enter, just after its f_880750 call (main-relative) */
#define MENU_GAMEOVER 0xf30e0a97u  /* CRC-32 of the names in data_path.cfg.bin */
#define MENU_PAUSE 0xd9d00e37u

static int state = PAUSE_OFF;

int pause_state(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }
static int set_from(int from, int to) {
    return __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&state, &from, to, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}
void pause_request(void) { __atomic_store_n(&state, PAUSE_WANTED, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
int pause_resume(void) { return set_from(PAUSE_ON, PAUSE_RESUME); }
int pause_to_title(void) { return set_from(PAUSE_ON, PAUSE_TITLE); }
void pause_forget(void) { __atomic_store_n(&state, PAUSE_OFF, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

/* f_880750(out, scene name, flag, params): opens a scene. params: entries of 0x14 bytes, a type (2) and a hash;
 * for SceneMenu the first is the menu, the second the sub-menu. */
/* The title screen's menus (New Game, Continue, Languages, DLC, then the save list): from SceneTitle opening until
 * SceneRpg (the game itself) opens. Seen in order at a start, 2026-11-15: SceneRoot, SceneMain, SceneTitle,
 * SceneMenu (the save list), SceneRpg; Return to Title opens SceneTitle again. */
static int on_title;
int scene_on_title(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&on_title, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

int yw4_hook_scene_open(CPUState *ctx) {
    static int log = -1;
    if (log < 0) log = getenv("YW4_MENU_LOG") != NULL;
    if (ctx->x[1]) {
        char n[12] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++)
            if (!(n[i] = (char)ld8(ctx->x[1] + i))) break;
        if (!strcmp(n, "SceneTitle")) __atomic_store_n(&on_title, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), savefs_title_opened();
        else if (!strcmp(n, "SceneRpg")) __atomic_store_n(&on_title, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    if (log) {  /* which scene, with what, from where: how the pause was found */
        char name[40] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < 39 && ctx->x[1]; i++)
            if (!(name[i] = (char)ld8(ctx->x[1] + i))) break;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: scene open '%s' params", name);
        for (int i = 0; i < 12 && ctx->x[3]; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %08x", ld32(ctx->x[3] + 4 * i));
        uint64_t st[10];
        int n = yw4_call_stack(ctx, st, 10);
        fprintf(stderr, " from main+%#llx:", (unsigned long long)(ctx->x[30] - yw4_image_base));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %#llx", (unsigned long long)(st[i] - yw4_image_base));
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
    }
    if (ctx->x[30] == yw4_image_base + ENTER_CALL_RET && ctx->x[3] && ld32(ctx->x[3] + 4) == MENU_GAMEOVER &&
        ld32(ctx->x[3] + 0x18) == MENU_PAUSE && set_from(PAUSE_WANTED, PAUSE_ON))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: pause: the game is paused (its pause screen hidden)\n");
    return 0;
}

/* MenuState's Exit (f_866cc0): the game left its menu state, here its pause. */
int yw4_hook_menu_state_exit(CPUState *ctx) {
    (void)ctx;
    if (set_from(PAUSE_RESUME, PAUSE_OFF) || set_from(PAUSE_ON, PAUSE_OFF))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: pause: the game resumed\n");
    else if (set_from(PAUSE_TITLE, PAUSE_OFF))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: pause: the game left its pause for the title screen\n");
    return 0;
}
```

```h
/* The overlay's pause: where the game's own pause is (pause.c). */
#ifndef YW4_PAUSE_H
#define YW4_PAUSE_H

enum {
    PAUSE_OFF,
    PAUSE_WANTED,  /* Plus is being pressed for the player */
    PAUSE_ON,      /* the game is paused: its pause screen is open (hidden by the window) */
    PAUSE_RESUME,  /* resume asked: A on Continue until the game has left its pause */
    PAUSE_TITLE,   /* Return to Title asked: its buttons pressed (window.c) until the game has left its pause */
};

int pause_state(void);
void pause_request(void);  /* before pressing Plus for the player */
int pause_resume(void);    /* paused -> resume asked; 0 if the game isn't paused */
int pause_to_title(void);  /* paused -> Return to Title asked; 0 if the game isn't paused */
void pause_forget(void);   /* give up (the game didn't pause, or didn't resume) */
/* 1 while the title screen's menus are up (SceneTitle until SceneRpg): the mouse works them as a menu (bindings.c) */
int scene_on_title(void);

#endif
```
