`runtime/src/perf.c`:

```c
/* Performance log (YW4_PERF=0 turns it off, YW4_PERF=1 adds the per-frame CSV, YW4_PERF_DIR sets the folder,
 * default work/perf).
 *
 * A summary in perf_<time>.txt (also on stderr every 600 frames and at exit), events in perf_<time>.jsonl, and with
 * YW4_PERF=1 one row per presented frame in perf_<time>.csv (the dev tools set it; players don't get it: 17-30 MB
 * an hour of play). The game paces itself on the display's vsync, so the
 * frame interval mostly shows the cap (30 frames/s = 33.3 ms). What says how much headroom
 * there is is `work_ms`: the time from the end of the last present to the start of this one,
 * i.e. everything the game's thread did for the frame (game logic, recompiled code, command
 * recording, waits on the GPU). `present_ms` is the host's share of the present (copying or
 * handing the frame to the window), before the wait for the flip.
 *
 * The GPU's own time comes from timestamp queries (gpu.c) and arrives a few frames late, so
 * a row is written PERF_DELAY frames after its frame. `gpu_busy_ms` adds up the durations of
 * the frame's GPU submissions; `gpu_span_ms` is from the first start to the last end (busy
 * plus the gaps where the GPU waited for work). Both are the work for the frame as the game
 * submitted it, on this host GPU, which is not the Switch's: they show how heavy the frame
 * is for the recompiled renderer, not what a Switch needs.
 *
 * Columns: frame, t_s, interval_ms, work_ms, present_ms, wait_ms, draws, cpu_pct (process CPU
 * time over the interval, 100 = one core), rss_mb, gpu_busy_ms, gpu_span_ms (empty: none),
 * submit_ms / submit_other_ms (time in nvnQueueSubmitCommands, i.e. the host's translation of
 * the command lists, on the presenting thread / on other threads), sync_ms (nvnSyncWait on
 * the presenting thread). submit_ms and sync_ms are part of work_ms; the rest of work_ms is
 * the game's own code. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#define MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
#endif

#include "events.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "gpu.h"
#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "framerate.h"
#include "hud.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "nvn.h"

void shadow_summary_text(char *buf, size_t n);  /* shadow.c (shadow.h needs the CPU state's type) */
void yw4_prune_runs(const char *dir, const char *prefix, const char *current);  /* log.c */

int gpu_frame_time(uint64_t frame, double *busy_ms, double *span_ms);  /* gpu.c */

#define PERF_DELAY 6

typedef struct {
    uint64_t frame, draws;
    double t, interval, work, present, wait, cpu, rss, submit, submit_other, sync;
} Row;

_Thread_local int yw4_perf_presenter;
static int64_t acc_submit, acc_submit_other, acc_sync;  /* ns since the last present */

void yw4_perf_add(int what, int64_t ns) {
    int64_t *a = what == PERF_SYNC ? (yw4_perf_presenter ? &acc_sync : NULL)
                                   : yw4_perf_presenter ? &acc_submit : &acc_submit_other;
    if (a) __atomic_add_fetch(a, ns, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static FILE *csv, *events;  /* events: events.h */
static char summary_path[600];
static int enabled = -1, exiting;
static int64_t t0, last_exit, last_cpu;
static uint64_t peak_rss;
/* The last RING frames' rows, and the GPU times of the last RING frames that had them: what the HUD (30 and 600
 * frames back), the 600-frame reports and the CSV (PERF_DELAY back) read. Every frame of the run used to be kept
 * for the whole run's summary: ~112 bytes a frame, 150-470 MB after three hours, never given back (owner,
 * 2026-11-16). The whole run is now counted as it goes (the totals and histograms below): memory stays the same
 * however long the game runs. Row i of the run is ROW(i), GPU sample j is GBUSY(j) / GSPAN(j). */
enum { RING = 8192 };
static Row ring_rows[RING];
static double ring_busy[RING], ring_span[RING];
#define ROW(i) ring_rows[(i) & (RING - 1)]
#define GBUSY(j) ring_busy[(j) & (RING - 1)]
#define GSPAN(j) ring_span[(j) & (RING - 1)]
static size_t nrows, written, ngpu;  /* rows of the run so far, rows settled (GPU times asked), GPU samples */
static uint64_t last_summary_frame;
static double cpu_pct_sum;
/* The whole run: totals, and histograms in 0.1 ms steps (the summary prints 0.1 ms) up to 2000 ms, longer frames
 * in the last step (the maximum is kept exactly). */
enum { HIST_STEPS = 20001 };  /* 0 .. 2000.0 ms */
typedef struct { uint32_t n[HIST_STEPS]; double max; } Hist;
static Hist h_interval, h_work, h_busy, h_span;
static double run_sum, run_wsum, run_sumsq, run_sub, run_sync, run_other, run_bsum, run_ssum;
static size_t run_over34, run_over50;

static void hist_add(Hist *h, double v) {
    long b = v > 0 ? (long)(v * 10.0 + 0.5) : 0;
    h->n[b < HIST_STEPS ? b : HIST_STEPS - 1]++;
    if (v > h->max) h->max = v;
}
/* Percentile p (0..100) of the m values counted, as percentile() picks it from the sorted values */
static double hist_percentile(const Hist *h, size_t m, double p) {
    if (!m) return 0;
    if (p >= 100) return h->max;
    size_t k = (size_t)((double)(m - 1) * p / 100.0 + 0.5), seen = 0;
    for (int b = 0; b < HIST_STEPS; b++)
        if ((seen += h->n[b]) > k) return b == HIST_STEPS - 1 ? h->max : b / 10.0;
    return h->max;
}
static size_t hist_over(const Hist *h, double limit) {  /* how many were over limit (to the step) */
    size_t c = 0;
    for (int b = HIST_STEPS - 1; b >= 0 && b / 10.0 > limit; b--) c += h->n[b];
    return c;
}

static int cmp_double(const void *a, const void *b) {
    double x = *(const double *)a, y = *(const double *)b;
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

/* Percentile p (0..100) of v[from..n), sorted copy. */
static double percentile(const double *v, size_t from, size_t n, double p) {
    size_t m = n > from ? n - from : 0;
    if (!m) return 0;
    double *c = malloc(m * sizeof *c);
    if (!c) return 0;
    memcpy(c, v + from, m * sizeof *c);
    qsort(c, m, sizeof *c, cmp_double);
    double r = c[(size_t)((double)(m - 1) * p / 100.0 + 0.5)];
    free(c);
    return r;
}

/* Slow frames in the text log (owner, 2026-11-16: without the CSV, a player's stutter must still reach us, and the log
 * is what a bug report attaches). A frame is slow over 50 ms or 2.5 frames of the cap, whichever is longer; it is
 * logged once settled, with its GPU time, at most one a second and SLOW_LINES a run; the summary counts them all.
 * The GPU thread's own hitches have their "yw4: stall:" lines (gpu.c) with what they were spent on. */
enum { SLOW_LINES = 300 };
static size_t slow_total, slow_logged;
static double slow_last_t = -10;

static double slow_limit(void) {
    int hz = framerate_hz();
    double cap = hz > 0 ? 2500.0 / hz : 0;
    return cap > 50 ? cap : 50;
}

static void note_slow(const Row *r, int has_gpu, double busy) {
    if (r->interval <= slow_limit()) return;
    slow_total++;
    if (slow_logged >= SLOW_LINES || r->t - slow_last_t < 1.0) return;
    slow_logged++, slow_last_t = r->t;
    char gpu[32] = "-";
    if (has_gpu) snprintf(gpu, sizeof gpu, "%.1f", busy);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: slow frame %" PRIu64 " at %.1f s: %.1f ms (game work %.1f of it: translation %.1f, GPU waits "
            "%.1f; present %.1f, wait for the display %.1f; GPU %s ms; %" PRIu64 " draws)%s\n", r->frame, r->t,
            r->interval, r->work, r->submit, r->sync, r->present, r->wait, gpu, r->draws,
            slow_logged == SLOW_LINES ? " (the last one logged: the summary counts the rest)" : "");
}

/* The numbers of a summary: the whole run (from the totals and histograms) or the last stretch (from the ring). */
typedef struct {
    size_t m, over34, over50, late, gm;
    double sum, wsum, sumsq, sub, sync, other, ip[4], wp[4], bsum, ssum, bp[4], sp95;
} Stats;
static const double pct[4] = {50, 95, 99, 100};

static void stats_whole(Stats *s, double late_limit) {
    s->m = nrows, s->over34 = run_over34, s->over50 = run_over50, s->late = hist_over(&h_interval, late_limit);
    s->sum = run_sum, s->wsum = run_wsum, s->sumsq = run_sumsq, s->sub = run_sub, s->sync = run_sync, s->other = run_other;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        s->ip[i] = hist_percentile(&h_interval, nrows, pct[i]), s->wp[i] = hist_percentile(&h_work, nrows, pct[i]),
        s->bp[i] = hist_percentile(&h_busy, ngpu, pct[i]);
    s->gm = ngpu, s->bsum = run_bsum, s->ssum = run_ssum, s->sp95 = hist_percentile(&h_span, ngpu, 95);
}

static int stats_last(Stats *s, size_t from, double late_limit) {
    size_t m = nrows - from;  /* at most a few hundred: the 600-frame reports */
    double *interval = malloc(m * sizeof *interval), *work = malloc(m * sizeof *work);
    if (!interval || !work) {
        free(interval), free(work);
        return 0;
    }
    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
    s->m = m;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        const Row *r = &ROW(from + i);
        interval[i] = r->interval, work[i] = r->work;
        s->sum += r->interval, s->wsum += r->work, s->sumsq += r->interval * r->interval;
        s->over34 += r->interval > 34.5, s->over50 += r->interval > 50, s->late += r->interval > late_limit;
        s->sub += r->submit, s->sync += r->sync, s->other += r->submit_other;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s->ip[i] = percentile(interval, 0, m, pct[i]), s->wp[i] = percentile(work, 0, m, pct[i]);
    free(interval), free(work);
    size_t g0 = ngpu > m ? ngpu - m : 0;  /* the same stretch, roughly */
    s->gm = ngpu - g0;
    if (s->gm) {
        double *b = malloc(s->gm * sizeof *b), *sp = malloc(s->gm * sizeof *sp);
        if (b && sp) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < s->gm; j++) b[j] = GBUSY(g0 + j), sp[j] = GSPAN(g0 + j), s->bsum += b[j], s->ssum += sp[j];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s->bp[i] = percentile(b, 0, s->gm, pct[i]);
            s->sp95 = percentile(sp, 0, s->gm, 95);
        } else {
            s->gm = 0;
        }
        free(b), free(sp);
    }
    return 1;
}

static void print_summary(FILE *f, size_t from, const char *what) {
    size_t n = nrows;
    if (n <= from) return;
    int cap = framerate_hz();
    double limit = cap > 0 ? 1500.0 / cap : 1e9;  /* "late": over one and a half of the cap's frame time */
    Stats st;
    if (from == 0) stats_whole(&st, limit);
    else if (!stats_last(&st, from, limit)) return;
    double frames = (double)st.m, sum = st.sum, wsum = st.wsum;
    size_t m = st.m;
    fprintf(f, "%s: %zu frames, %.1f frames/s average\n", what, m, 1000.0 * frames / sum);
    char pic[400];  /* what the numbers were measured with (issue #12) */
    gpu_picture_text(pic, sizeof pic);
    int changes = gpu_picture_changes();
    fprintf(f, "  picture now: %s", pic);
    if (changes)
        fprintf(f, "  (changed %d time%s during the run: the numbers may mix settings)", changes, changes == 1 ? "" : "s");
    fputc('\n', f);
    char sh[600];  /* the shadow pass over the run: which, and what ours replaced and left out (shadow.c) */
    shadow_summary_text(sh, sizeof sh);
    fprintf(f, "  shadows: %s\n", sh);
    fprintf(f, "  interval ms: p50 %.1f  p95 %.1f  p99 %.1f  max %.1f   (slower than 34.5 ms: %zu = %.1f%%, than 50 ms: %zu)\n",
            st.ip[0], st.ip[1], st.ip[2], st.ip[3], st.over34, 100.0 * (double)st.over34 / frames, st.over50);
    if (cap == 30 || cap == 60) {
        /* for comparing the two ways of holding 30 and 60 (YW4_PACE): frames that took over one and a half of the
         * cap's frame time (25 ms at 60, 50 ms at 30), and how much the frame times spread */
        double mean = sum / frames, var = st.sumsq / frames - mean * mean;
        fprintf(f, "  pacing %s at %d frames/s: %zu frames over %.0f ms = %.2f%%, standard deviation %.2f ms\n",
                framerate_pacing(cap) ? "refresh" : "tick", cap, st.late, limit, 100.0 * (double)st.late / frames,
                sqrt(var > 0 ? var : 0));
    }
    fprintf(f, "  game work ms: avg %.1f  p50 %.1f  p95 %.1f  p99 %.1f  max %.1f   (budget at 30 frames/s: 33.3)\n", wsum / frames,
            st.wp[0], st.wp[1], st.wp[2], st.wp[3]);
    if (st.gm) {
        double cnt = (double)st.gm;
        fprintf(f, "  GPU busy ms: avg %.1f  p50 %.1f  p95 %.1f  p99 %.1f  max %.1f   (span, with gaps: avg %.1f  p95 %.1f)\n",
                st.bsum / cnt, st.bp[0], st.bp[1], st.bp[2], st.bp[3], st.ssum / cnt, st.sp95);
    } else {
        fprintf(f, "  GPU time: not available\n");
    }
    fprintf(f, "  of the game work: submit (host translation) avg %.1f, GPU waits avg %.1f, game code avg %.1f; submit on other threads avg %.1f\n",
            st.sub / frames, st.sync / frames, (wsum - st.sub - st.sync) / frames, st.other / frames);
    if (from == 0)
        fprintf(f, "  slow frames (over %.0f ms) in the whole run: %zu, %zu of them in the log (\"yw4: slow frame\")\n",
                slow_limit(), slow_total, slow_logged);
    fprintf(f, "  process CPU: %.0f%% of one core on average, memory peak %.0f MB\n", cpu_pct_sum / (double)n,
            (double)peak_rss / 1048576.0);
}

/* Settles the rows up to (but not including) index `upto`: their GPU times (which arrive PERF_DELAY frames late) into
 * the ring and the run's histograms, a slow one into the log, and, with YW4_PERF=1, the CSV line. */
static void write_rows(size_t upto) {
    if (upto > written + RING) written = upto - RING;  /* can't happen (PERF_DELAY behind), but never read past the ring */
    for (; written < upto; written++) {
        Row *r = &ROW(written);
        double busy, span;
        /* At exit the GPU lock may be held by the thread that is exiting (a stop inside a draw):
         * asking for GPU times then would deadlock, so the last rows go without them. */
        int has = exiting ? 0 : gpu_frame_time(r->frame, &busy, &span);
        if (has) {
            GBUSY(ngpu) = busy, GSPAN(ngpu) = span, ngpu++;
            hist_add(&h_busy, busy), hist_add(&h_span, span), run_bsum += busy, run_ssum += span;
        }
        note_slow(r, has, has ? busy : 0);
        if (!csv) continue;
        fprintf(csv, "%" PRIu64 ",%.3f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%" PRIu64 ",%.0f,%.0f,", r->frame, r->t, r->interval, r->work,
                r->present, r->wait, r->draws, r->cpu, r->rss);
        if (has) fprintf(csv, "%.2f,%.2f,", busy, span);
        else fprintf(csv, ",,");
        fprintf(csv, "%.2f,%.2f,%.2f\n", r->submit, r->submit_other, r->sync);
    }
}

/* The whole run's summary (at exit), or meanwhile the last 600 frames': sorting every frame of the run on the
 * presenting thread every 600 frames was a hitch that grew with play time (220 ms after an hour, 2026-10-28). */
static void write_summary(size_t from, const char *what) {
    FILE *f = fopen(summary_path, "w");
    if (f) {
        print_summary(f, from, what);
        fclose(f);
    }
}

static void start(void);

void yw4_event_text(const char *kind, uint64_t frame, const char *key, const char *text) {
    char esc[900];
    size_t n = 0;
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)text; *p && n + 8 < sizeof esc; p++) {
        if (*p == '"' || *p == '\\') esc[n++] = '\\', esc[n++] = (char)*p;
        else if (*p < 0x20) n += (size_t)snprintf(esc + n, 7, "\\u%04x", *p);
        else esc[n++] = (char)*p;
    }
    esc[n] = 0;
    yw4_event(kind, frame, "\"%s\":\"%s\"", key, esc);
}

void yw4_event(const char *kind, uint64_t frame, const char *fields, ...) {
    if (enabled < 0) start();
    if (!events) return;
    char line[1400];  /* one fputs per line: lines of different threads don't mix */
    size_t n = (size_t)snprintf(line, sizeof line, "{\"kind\":\"%s\",\"frame\":%" PRIu64 ",\"t\":%.3f", kind, frame,
                                (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e9);
    if (fields && n < sizeof line - 8) {
        line[n++] = ',';
        size_t room = sizeof line - n - 3;
        va_list ap;
        va_start(ap, fields);
        int m = vsnprintf(line + n, room, fields, ap);
        va_end(ap);
        n += m < 0 ? 0 : (size_t)m < room ? (size_t)m : room - 1;
    }
    line[n++] = '}', line[n++] = '\n', line[n] = 0;
    fputs(line, events);
    fflush(events);
}

/* At exit: what was scheduled for a frame the run never got to. A screenshot, an image dump or a setting change
 * at a frame number is silently not done when the run ends first, and "the tool is broken" was the wrong guess
 * more than once (2026-11-11: frame numbers reckoned at 60 frames/s in a run at 30). Each of these variables is
 * a list whose items start with a frame number. */
static void report_unreached(uint64_t last) {
    static const char *const at[] = {"YW4_SCREENSHOTS", "YW4_SET_AT", "YW4_DUMP_IMAGE_AT", "YW4_AB_AT", "YW4_DUMP_AT",
                                     "YW4_CAPTURE_LAYER_AT", "YW4_GPU_TRACE_AT", "YW4_FG_AT", "YW4_FLASH_SAVE",
                                     "YW4_GBUFFER_ALTERNATE", "YW4_PCSS_ALTERNATE"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof at / sizeof *at; i++)
        for (const char *p = getenv(at[i]); p && *p;) {
            char *end;
            unsigned long long f = strtoull(p, &end, 10);
            if (end != p && f > last) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: never reached: %s frame %llu (the run ended at frame %" PRIu64 ")\n", at[i], f, last);
                yw4_event("unreached", f, "\"what\":\"%s\"", at[i]);
            }
            p = strchr(end, ',');
            if (p) p++;
        }
}

static void finish(void) {
    if (enabled <= 0 || exiting) return;
    exiting = 1;
    write_rows(nrows);
    if (csv) fclose(csv);
    csv = NULL;
    write_summary(0, "whole run");
    print_summary(stderr, 0, "yw4: perf, whole run");
    uint64_t last = nrows ? ROW(nrows - 1).frame : 0;
    report_unreached(last);
    yw4_event("end", last, "\"frames\":%zu", nrows);
    if (events) fclose(events);
    events = NULL;
}

static void start(void) {
    enabled = 0;
    const char *on = getenv("YW4_PERF");
    if (on && *on == '0') return;
    const char *dir = getenv("YW4_PERF_DIR");
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", dir && *dir ? dir : "work/perf");
    for (char *p = path + 1; *p; p++)  /* make every folder on the way */
        if (*p == '/' || *p == '\\') {
            char c = *p;
            *p = 0;
            MKDIR(path);
            *p = c;
        }
    MKDIR(path);
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm tmv;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&tmv, &now);
#else
    localtime_r(&now, &tmv);
#endif
    char when[32], csv_path[600];
    strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", &tmv);
    snprintf(csv_path, sizeof csv_path, "%s/perf_%s.csv", path, when);
    snprintf(summary_path, sizeof summary_path, "%s/perf_%s.txt", path, when);
    char events_path[600];
    snprintf(events_path, sizeof events_path, "%s/perf_%s.jsonl", path, when);
    events = fopen(events_path, "w");
    /* the per-frame CSV only when asked (YW4_PERF=1; the dev tools ask): 17-30 MB an hour of play, 90-180 MB for a
     * three-hour session, and no bug report attaches it (owner, 2026-11-16). The summary and the events stay. */
    if (on && *on == '1') {
        csv = fopen(csv_path, "w");
        if (csv) {
            fprintf(csv, "frame,t_s,interval_ms,work_ms,present_ms,wait_ms,draws,cpu_pct,rss_mb,gpu_busy_ms,gpu_span_ms,"
                         "submit_ms,submit_other_ms,sync_ms\n");
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: performance log %s\n", csv_path);
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: performance summary %s%s\n", summary_path, csv ? "" : " (per-frame CSV: YW4_PERF=1)");
    yw4_prune_runs(path, "perf_", when);  /* the newest 5 runs' perf_* files kept, at most 1 GB (log.c) */
    uint64_t rss;
    t0 = host_now_ns();
    host_process_usage(&last_cpu, &rss);
    atexit(finish);
    enabled = 1;
}

/* The HUD (hud.h): averages over the last 30 frames; lows, min and max over the last 600 (20 s);
 * the graph is the last HUD_POINTS frames. */
void yw4_perf_hud(HudContent *c, int compact, unsigned parts) {
    c->nlines = c->npoints = 0;
    c->valid = 0;
    int hz = framerate_hz();
    c->target_fps = hz > 0 ? (float)hz : 0.0f;
    c->target_ms = hz > 0 ? 1000.0f / (float)hz : 1000.0f / 30.0f;
#define LINE(...) (c->nlines < HUD_LINES ? snprintf(c->lines[c->nlines++], HUD_COLS, __VA_ARGS__) : 0)
    if (enabled <= 0 || !nrows) {
        LINE(enabled == 0 ? "PERF OFF (YW4_PERF=0)" : "PERF: NO FRAMES YET");
    } else {
        size_t k = nrows < 30 ? nrows : 30, from = nrows - k;
        double interval = 0, work = 0, cpu = 0, draws = 0;
        for (size_t i = from; i < nrows; i++)
            interval += ROW(i).interval, work += ROW(i).work, cpu += ROW(i).cpu, draws += (double)ROW(i).draws;
        interval /= (double)k, work /= (double)k, cpu /= (double)k, draws /= (double)k;
        /* 1% / 0.1% low: the frame rate of the 99th / 99.9th percentile frame time */
        static double recent[600];
        size_t m = nrows < 600 ? nrows : 600;
        double lo = 1e9, hi = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            recent[i] = ROW(nrows - m + i).interval;
            if (recent[i] < lo) lo = recent[i];
            if (recent[i] > hi) hi = recent[i];
        }
        double p99 = percentile(recent, 0, m, 99), p999 = percentile(recent, 0, m, 99.9);
        {  /* the values, for the styled HUD */
            static int nc;
            if (!nc) nc = host_cpu_count();
            size_t gg = ngpu < 30 ? ngpu : 30;
            double b = 0;
            for (size_t i = ngpu - gg; i < ngpu; i++) b += GBUSY(i);
            float sh = gpu_fg_shown_per_frame();
            c->valid = 1;
            c->fps = interval > 0 ? (float)(1000.0 / interval) : 0;
            c->low1 = p99 > 0 ? (float)(1000.0 / p99) : 0, c->low01 = p999 > 0 ? (float)(1000.0 / p999) : 0;
            c->frame_avg_ms = (float)interval, c->min_ms = (float)lo, c->max_ms = (float)hi;
            c->work_avg_ms = (float)work, c->gpu_ms = gg ? (float)(b / (double)gg) : -1.0f;
            c->ncpu = nc, c->cpu_pct = (float)(cpu / nc), c->cpu_cores = (float)(cpu / 100.0);
            c->draws = (float)draws, c->ram_mb = (float)ROW(nrows - 1).rss;
            c->shown_fps = sh > 0.0f && interval > 0 ? (float)(1000.0 / interval * sh) : 0.0f;
            c->fg = gpu_fg() == 2 ? "DLSS" : "FSR";
        }
        if (compact) {  /* one line: the frame rate and its 1% low */
            LINE("FPS %4.1f  1%% %4.1f", interval > 0 ? 1000.0 / interval : 0.0, p99 > 0 ? 1000.0 / p99 : 0.0);
            return;
        }
        if (parts & HUD_PART_FPS)
            LINE("FPS %4.1f  1%% %4.1f  0.1%% %4.1f", interval > 0 ? 1000.0 / interval : 0.0,
                 p99 > 0 ? 1000.0 / p99 : 0.0, p999 > 0 ? 1000.0 / p999 : 0.0);
        /* frame generation: the frames on screen (the lines above count the game's) */
        float shown = gpu_fg_shown_per_frame();
        if ((parts & HUD_PART_FG) && shown > 0.0f && interval > 0)
            LINE("SHOWN %4.1f  FRAME GEN %s", 1000.0 / interval * shown, gpu_fg() == 2 ? "DLSS" : "FSR");
        if (parts & HUD_PART_FPS) LINE("FRAME %4.1f  MIN %4.1f  MAX %5.1f MS", interval, lo, hi);
        size_t g = ngpu < 30 ? ngpu : 30;  /* GPU times arrive PERF_DELAY frames late */
        double busy = 0;
        for (size_t i = ngpu - g; i < ngpu; i++) busy += GBUSY(i);
        if (!(parts & HUD_PART_TIMES)) {
        } else if (g) {
            LINE("WORK %4.1f  GPU %4.1f MS", work, busy / (double)g);
        } else {
            LINE("WORK %4.1f  GPU - MS", work);
        }
        /* cpu is 100 per busy core: shown as the share of the whole CPU (as task managers do) and in cores */
        static int ncpu;
        if (!ncpu) ncpu = host_cpu_count();
        if (parts & HUD_PART_TIMES) {
            LINE("CPU %.0f%% (%.1f OF %d CORES)", cpu / ncpu, cpu / 100.0, ncpu);
            LINE("DRAWS %.0f  RAM %.0f MB", draws, ROW(nrows - 1).rss);
        }
        size_t p = nrows < HUD_POINTS ? nrows : HUD_POINTS;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            c->frame_ms[i] = (float)ROW(nrows - p + i).interval;
            c->work_ms[i] = (float)ROW(nrows - p + i).work;
        }
        c->npoints = parts & HUD_PART_GRAPH ? (int)p : 0;
    }
#undef LINE
}

/* Called by nvnQueuePresentTexture: enter = on entry, shown = after the host's part of the
 * present, exit = after the wait for the flip. */
uint64_t yw4_world_frames;  /* presents in a row with the 3D world drawn (over 100 draws): replays wait on it */

void yw4_perf_frame(uint64_t frame, int64_t enter, int64_t shown, int64_t exit_, uint64_t draws) {
    __atomic_store_n(&yw4_world_frames, draws > 100 ? yw4_world_frames + 1 : 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (enabled < 0) start();
    /* YW4_EXIT_AT=<frame> (tests): the run ends cleanly once that frame has been presented, so a test lasts as long
     * as its last scheduled frame needs and not a guessed number of seconds */
    static uint64_t exit_at = UINT64_MAX;
    if (exit_at == UINT64_MAX) exit_at = getenv("YW4_EXIT_AT") ? strtoull(getenv("YW4_EXIT_AT"), NULL, 10) : 0;
    if (exit_at && frame >= exit_at) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: frame %" PRIu64 " presented, exiting (YW4_EXIT_AT)\n", frame);
        yw4_exit(0, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
    if (enabled <= 0) return;
    if (!last_exit) {  /* the first present: nothing to compare with yet */
        last_exit = exit_;
        return;
    }
    int64_t cpu;
    uint64_t rss;
    host_process_usage(&cpu, &rss);
    double cpu_pct = exit_ > last_exit ? 100.0 * (double)(cpu - last_cpu) / (double)(exit_ - last_exit) : 0;
    Row *r = &ROW(nrows);
    nrows++;
    *r = (Row){.frame = frame, .draws = draws, .t = (double)(exit_ - t0) / 1e9,
                          .interval = (double)(exit_ - last_exit) / 1e6, .work = (double)(enter - last_exit) / 1e6,
                          .present = (double)(shown - enter) / 1e6, .wait = (double)(exit_ - shown) / 1e6,
                          .cpu = cpu_pct, .rss = (double)rss / 1048576.0,
                          .submit = (double)__atomic_exchange_n(&acc_submit, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) / 1e6,
                          .submit_other = (double)__atomic_exchange_n(&acc_submit_other, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) / 1e6,
                          .sync = (double)__atomic_exchange_n(&acc_sync, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) / 1e6};
    last_cpu = cpu, last_exit = exit_;
    if (rss > peak_rss) peak_rss = rss;
    cpu_pct_sum += cpu_pct;
    /* the whole run, counted as it goes */
    hist_add(&h_interval, r->interval), hist_add(&h_work, r->work);
    run_sum += r->interval, run_wsum += r->work, run_sumsq += r->interval * r->interval;
    run_sub += r->submit, run_sync += r->sync, run_other += r->submit_other;
    run_over34 += r->interval > 34.5, run_over50 += r->interval > 50;
    if (nrows > PERF_DELAY) write_rows(nrows - PERF_DELAY);
    if (csv && nrows % 60 == 0) fflush(csv);
    if (frame - last_summary_frame >= 600) {
        print_summary(stderr, nrows > 600 ? nrows - 600 : 0, "yw4: perf, last 600 frames");
        static int64_t last_threads;  /* host time of the last per-thread report */
        if (last_threads) fprintf(stderr, "  threads, last 600 frames:\n");
        yw4_thread_cpu_report(stderr, last_threads ? exit_ - last_threads : 0);  /* 0: only takes the start values */
        {   /* our GPU worker (gpu_queue.c) is a host thread, not a guest one: listed here so the CPU chain that
             * feeds the GPU (guest render threads -> this worker -> GPU) shows whole */
            static int64_t worker_last;
            int64_t w = gpu_queue_worker_cpu_ns(), interval = exit_ - last_threads, frames = frame - last_summary_frame;
            if (last_threads && w && interval > 0 && frames > 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "    gpu worker (host): %3.0f%% of a core, %.2f ms/frame  [translates GPU work]\n",
                        100.0 * (double)(w - worker_last) / (double)interval, (double)(w - worker_last) / 1e6 / (double)frames);
            worker_last = w;
        }
        yw4_wait_report(stderr, (int)(frame - last_summary_frame));
        last_threads = exit_;
        /* so a killed or crashed run leaves numbers (every frame is in the CSV too) */
        write_summary(nrows > 600 ? nrows - 600 : 0, "last 600 frames (the whole run is written at exit)");
        last_summary_frame = frame;
    }
}
```

`runtime/src/pixels.c`:

```c
/* NVN colour formats on the CPU (pixels.h).
 *
 * Format numbers: NVN's enum, in the order of the table in tegra.c (R8, R8_SNORM, R8UI,
 * R8I, then R16F, R16, ... in groups). Only the formats a clear or a window texture needs so
 * far are here; anything else returns 0 and the caller says so.
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "pixels.h"

enum {
    F_R8 = 0x01, F_R16F = 0x05, F_R32F = 0x0A, F_RG8 = 0x0D, F_RG16F = 0x11, F_RG32F = 0x16,
    F_RGBA8 = 0x25, F_RGBA16F = 0x29, F_RGBA32F = 0x2E, F_RGBX8_SRGB = 0x37, F_RGBA8_SRGB = 0x38,
    F_RGB10A2 = 0x3D, F_R11G11B10F = 0x3F, F_BGRX8 = 0x98, F_BGRA8 = 0x99, F_BGRX8_SRGB = 0x9A, F_BGRA8_SRGB = 0x9B,
};

static float clamp01(float v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v; }
static uint8_t unorm8(float v) { return (uint8_t)(clamp01(v) * 255.0f + 0.5f); }
static float srgb(float v) {  /* linear -> sRGB transfer function */
    v = clamp01(v);
    return v <= 0.0031308f ? v * 12.92f : 1.055f * powf(v, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
}

/* IEEE half from float (round to nearest even; overflow to infinity). */
static uint16_t half(float f) {
    uint32_t x;
    memcpy(&x, &f, 4);
    uint32_t sign = (x >> 16) & 0x8000, e = (x >> 23) & 0xFF, m = x & 0x7FFFFF;
    if (e == 0xFF) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7C00 | (m ? 0x200 : 0));
    int ex = (int)e - 127 + 15;
    if (ex >= 31) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7C00);
    if (ex <= 0) {
        if (ex < -10) return (uint16_t)sign;
        m |= 0x800000;
        uint32_t shift = (uint32_t)(14 - ex), h = m >> shift, rest = m & ((1u << shift) - 1), mid = 1u << (shift - 1);
        if (rest > mid || (rest == mid && (h & 1))) h++;
        return (uint16_t)(sign | h);
    }
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)ex << 10 | m >> 13, rest = m & 0x1FFF;
    if (rest > 0x1000 || (rest == 0x1000 && (h & 1))) h++;
    return (uint16_t)(sign | h);
}

static float from_half(uint16_t h) {
    uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 0x1F, m = h & 0x3FF, x;
    if (e == 0) {
        float f = (float)m * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);  /* subnormal: m * 2^-24 */
        return sign ? -f : f;
    }
    x = sign | (e == 31 ? 0xFFu << 23 | m << 13 : (e - 15 + 127) << 23 | m << 13);
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, &x, 4);
    return f;
}

/* Unsigned small floats of R11G11B10F: 5-bit exponent, 6 or 5 bits of mantissa, no sign. */
static uint32_t small_float(float f, int mbits) {
    if (!(f > 0)) return 0;
    uint16_t h = half(f);  /* same exponent as a half; cut the mantissa */
    uint32_t e = (h >> 10) & 0x1F, m = h & 0x3FF;
    if (e == 31) return (31u << mbits) | (m ? 1 : 0);
    return e << mbits | m >> (10 - mbits);
}

int pixel_encode(uint32_t format, const float c[4], uint8_t out[16]) {
    switch (format) {
    case F_R8: out[0] = unorm8(c[0]); return 1;
    case F_RG8: out[0] = unorm8(c[0]), out[1] = unorm8(c[1]); return 2;
    case F_RGBA8: for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) out[i] = unorm8(c[i]); return 4;
    case F_RGBA8_SRGB: case F_RGBX8_SRGB:
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) out[i] = unorm8(srgb(c[i]));
        out[3] = unorm8(c[3]);
        return 4;
    case F_BGRA8: case F_BGRX8:
        out[0] = unorm8(c[2]), out[1] = unorm8(c[1]), out[2] = unorm8(c[0]), out[3] = unorm8(c[3]);
        return 4;
    case F_BGRA8_SRGB: case F_BGRX8_SRGB:
        out[0] = unorm8(srgb(c[2])), out[1] = unorm8(srgb(c[1])), out[2] = unorm8(srgb(c[0])), out[3] = unorm8(c[3]);
        return 4;
    case F_R16F: case F_RG16F: case F_RGBA16F: {
        int n = format == F_R16F ? 1 : format == F_RG16F ? 2 : 4;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            uint16_t h = half(c[i]);
            memcpy(out + 2 * i, &h, 2);
        }
        return 2 * n;
    }
    case F_R32F: case F_RG32F: case F_RGBA32F: {
        int n = format == F_R32F ? 1 : format == F_RG32F ? 2 : 4;
        memcpy(out, c, 4 * (size_t)n);
        return 4 * n;
    }
    case F_RGB10A2: {
        uint32_t v = (uint32_t)(clamp01(c[0]) * 1023 + 0.5f) | (uint32_t)(clamp01(c[1]) * 1023 + 0.5f) << 10 |
                     (uint32_t)(clamp01(c[2]) * 1023 + 0.5f) << 20 | (uint32_t)(clamp01(c[3]) * 3 + 0.5f) << 30;
        memcpy(out, &v, 4);
        return 4;
    }
    case F_R11G11B10F: {
        uint32_t v = small_float(c[0], 6) | small_float(c[1], 6) << 11 | small_float(c[2], 5) << 22;
        memcpy(out, &v, 4);
        return 4;
    }
    }
    return 0;
}

int pixel_to_rgba8(uint32_t format, const uint8_t *t, uint8_t out[4]) {
    switch (format) {
    case F_RGBA8: case F_RGBA8_SRGB: memcpy(out, t, 4); return 1;
    case F_RGBX8_SRGB: memcpy(out, t, 3), out[3] = 255; return 1;
    case F_BGRA8: case F_BGRA8_SRGB: out[0] = t[2], out[1] = t[1], out[2] = t[0], out[3] = t[3]; return 1;
    case F_BGRX8: case F_BGRX8_SRGB: out[0] = t[2], out[1] = t[1], out[2] = t[0], out[3] = 255; return 1;
    case F_RGB10A2: {
        uint32_t v;
        memcpy(&v, t, 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) out[i] = (uint8_t)(((v >> (10 * i)) & 1023) >> 2);
        out[3] = (uint8_t)((v >> 30) * 85);
        return 1;
    }
    case F_RGBA16F:
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            uint16_t h;
            memcpy(&h, t + 2 * i, 2);
            out[i] = unorm8(from_half(h));
        }
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

```h
#ifndef PIXELS_H
```

`runtime/src/post.h`:

```h
/* Our post-processing passes (decisions 0037 bloom, 0038 distance blur): what the hooks on the engine's passes
 * (bloom.c, dof.c, render thread) hand the executor (gpu_post.c) in their CMD_NATIVE records. */
#ifndef YW4_POST_H
#define YW4_POST_H

#include "nvn.h"

/* ---- bloom (bloom.c) */

enum {
    BLOOM_IN_SCENE, BLOOM_IN_HALF,  /* read by the bright pass: renderer image records 0 and 11 */
    BLOOM_BRIGHT,                   /* its output, record 9 (half size) */
    BLOOM_L0_ACROSS, BLOOM_L0,      /* level 0 (quarter size): records 20 and 19 */
    BLOOM_L1_ACROSS, BLOOM_L1,      /* level 1: 22, 21 */
    BLOOM_L2_ACROSS, BLOOM_L2,      /* level 2: 24, 23 */
    BLOOM_IMAGES
};

typedef struct {
    NvnTexture tex[BLOOM_IMAGES];  /* copies taken at the hook (render targets: they stay the same) */
    float bright[8];               /* bright pass: scale and threshold for the scene, then for the half image */
    float step[3];                 /* blur step per level, in texture coordinates of the level's width/height */
    float composite[8];            /* brightness and weight per level: (l0, w0, l1, w1), (l2, w2, -, -) */
    int check;                     /* YW4_BLOOM=check: draw into copies and compare with the game's */
} BloomPass;

/* bloom.c: ours drawing (YW4_BLOOM, the settings panel)? */
int bloom_native(void);
void bloom_toggle(void);

void gpu_bloom_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
/* Check mode, after the game's composite draw (gpu_draw.c): copy the game's results out for comparison. */
void gpu_bloom_after_composite(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state);

/* ---- distance blur (dof.c) */

enum {
    DOF_SCENE,   /* record 0: shrunk, and the composite's target */
    DOF_A,       /* record 9: the shrunk scene, then each round's result (half size) */
    DOF_B,       /* record 10: each round's across pass */
    DOF_DEPTH,   /* record 42: the G-buffer's depth, read by the composite */
    DOF_IMAGES
};

typedef struct {
    NvnTexture tex[DOF_IMAGES];
    uint32_t rounds;     /* blur rounds (renderer +0x868, at most 32) */
    float weights[8];    /* Gaussian weights, centre first */
    float spread;        /* +0x860: the blur step in pixels of the half-size image, before / its width or height */
    float texel[2];      /* the composite's neighbour distance: +0x86c / the depth's width, height */
    float focus[8];      /* the composite's fragment constants, rows 0 and 1 */
    float far;           /* the camera's far distance (renderer +0x5c4), if the camera block isn't bound */
    int check;           /* YW4_DOF_PASS=check */
} DofPass;

/* dof.c: ours drawing (YW4_DOF_PASS, the settings panel)? */
int dof_native(void);
void dof_toggle(void);

void gpu_dof_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
void gpu_dof_after_composite(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state);

/* ---- the engine's shared blur rounds f_7f3620 (dof.c): the distance blur's, the battle effects' (f_7f1bf0) and
 * two more callers; the distance blur pass of ours above draws its own rounds instead */

typedef struct {
    NvnTexture a, b;     /* read across into b, then down into a, per round */
    uint32_t rounds;
    float weights[8];
    float step[2];       /* across, down, in texture coordinates */
    int check;           /* YW4_BLUR_PASS=check: ours into copies; the game's runs after it (dof.c) */
} BlurPass;

int blur_native(void);
/* The fast blur rounds (YW4_BLUR_FAST, the settings panel's BATTLE BLUR): fewer, wider rounds; ours draw them. */
int blur_fast(void);
void blur_fast_toggle(void);
void gpu_blur_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
void gpu_blur_check_end(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);  /* after the game's rounds */

/* All checks: results waiting to be compared; compare and log (after the GPU finished). */
int gpu_post_pending(void);
void gpu_post_flush(void);

#endif
```
