`runtime/src/profile.c`:

```c
/* Sampling profiler (Windows only).
 *
 * YW4_PROFILE=1 samples the thread that presents frames (the game's main thread);
 * YW4_PROFILE=submit samples every thread that submits GPU command lists instead.
 * YW4_PROFILE_FROM=<frame> starts at that frame, to skip start-up.
 * YW4_PROFILE_THREAD=<n> samples only guest thread n (the performance report's "thread n").
 * YW4_PROFILE=hitch samples the presenting thread but keeps only the samples of frames that took longer than
 * YW4_PROFILE_HITCH_MS (default 100): what the game did in a freeze, not on average (2026-11-11, the Demon Hand).
 * Hitch mode samples every guest thread (the presenting one may only be waiting for another): each key carries the
 * guest thread id in bits 48-62.
 *
 * Every millisecond a host thread stops each sampled thread, reads where it is, and lets it
 * go again. The counts go to work/perf/profile_<time>.txt (rewritten every 10 s and at exit)
 * as offsets into yw4.exe; a sample in a system DLL is unwound to its first yw4.exe caller
 * and marked with bit 63. `python -m tools.yw4.profile` names them with the executable's
 * symbol table. Only where a thread is, not who called it: time spent in a function itself. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "kernel.h"
#include "nvn.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>

#define PROFILE_SLOTS (1 << 20)
#define MAX_TARGETS 48

static HANDLE targets[MAX_TARGETS];
static uint64_t target_tag[MAX_TARGETS];  /* hitch mode: the guest thread id << 48 */
static uint64_t cur_tag;
static volatile LONG ntargets;
static uint64_t *keys, *counts;  /* open addressing on the exe offset; key 0 = empty */
static uint64_t outside, total;
static uintptr_t exe_base, exe_end;
static volatile LONG stop;
static char out_path[128];
static int mode = -1;  /* 0 off, 1 presenting thread, 2 submitting threads, 3 presenting thread, hitches only */
extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */
static uint64_t pending[1 << 14];      /* hitch mode: this frame's samples, kept if the frame turns out long */
static int npending;
static uint64_t hitch_ms = 100;
static long readable_before;
static long long readable_ns_before;
static uint64_t from_frame;
static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;  /* the counts, between the sampler and write_out */

static void add(uint64_t key) {
    for (uint64_t i = (key * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 44;; i = (i + 1) & (PROFILE_SLOTS - 1)) {
        if (keys[i] == key) {
            counts[i]++;
            return;
        }
        if (!keys[i]) {
            keys[i] = key, counts[i] = 1;
            return;
        }
    }
}

static void write_out(void) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    FILE *f = fopen(out_path, "w");
    if (f) {
        fprintf(f, "# samples %" PRIu64 " outside %" PRIu64 "\n", total, outside);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < PROFILE_SLOTS; i++)
            if (keys[i]) fprintf(f, "%" PRIx64 " %" PRIu64 "\n", keys[i], counts[i]);
        fclose(f);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

static void record(uint64_t key) {
    if (mode != 3) add(key);
    else if (npending < (int)(sizeof pending / sizeof *pending)) pending[npending++] = key | cur_tag;
}

/* Hitch mode: at each new frame, the last frame's samples go to the counts if it was long, else away. */
static void frame_check(void) {
    static uint64_t last_frame, last_ms;
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), now = GetTickCount64();
    if (f == last_frame) return;
    if (last_ms && now - last_ms >= hitch_ms && npending && last_frame >= from_frame) {
        for (int i = 0; i < npending; i++) add(pending[i]);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: profile: frame %" PRIu64 " took %" PRIu64 " ms: its %d samples kept\n", last_frame,
                now - last_ms, npending);
        /* host.c counts host_readable's calls and callers: a long frame's system calls, named (2026-11-12) */
        extern volatile long host_readable_calls, host_readable_caller_n[8];
        extern volatile uintptr_t host_readable_callers[8];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: profile:   host_readable calls in it: %ld; callers so far:", host_readable_calls - readable_before);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            if (host_readable_callers[i])
                fprintf(stderr, " exe+%#llx x%ld", (unsigned long long)(host_readable_callers[i] - exe_base),
                        host_readable_caller_n[i]);
        extern volatile long long host_readable_ns, host_readable_max_ns;
        fprintf(stderr, "\nyw4: profile:   host_readable time in it: %lld ms, longest call %lld ms\n",
                (host_readable_ns - readable_ns_before) / 1000000, host_readable_max_ns / 1000000);
        host_readable_max_ns = 0;
    }
    {
        extern volatile long host_readable_calls;
        extern volatile long long host_readable_ns;
        readable_before = host_readable_calls, readable_ns_before = host_readable_ns;
    }
    npending = 0, last_frame = f, last_ms = now;
}

static void sample(HANDLE t) {
    if (SuspendThread(t) == (DWORD)-1) return;
    CONTEXT c = {.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL};
    if (GetThreadContext(t, &c)) {
        total++;
        if (c.Rip >= exe_base && c.Rip < exe_end) {
            record(c.Rip - exe_base);
        } else {
            /* In a system DLL: unwind to the first yw4.exe frame, the caller (bit 63 marks it). */
            outside++;
            for (int depth = 0; depth < 64 && c.Rip; depth++) {
                DWORD64 base;
                RUNTIME_FUNCTION *fn = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(c.Rip, &base, NULL);
                if (fn) {
                    void *data;
                    DWORD64 frame;
                    RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, c.Rip, fn, &c, &data, &frame, NULL);
                } else {  /* a leaf: the return address is on top of the stack */
                    c.Rip = *(DWORD64 *)c.Rsp;
                    c.Rsp += 8;
                }
                if (c.Rip >= exe_base && c.Rip < exe_end) {
                    record((c.Rip - exe_base) | 1ull << 63);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ResumeThread(t);
}

static DWORD WINAPI sampler(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    timeBeginPeriod(1);
    uint64_t next_write = 10000;
    while (!stop) {
        Sleep(1);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        for (LONG i = 0; i < ntargets; i++) cur_tag = target_tag[i], sample(targets[i]);
        if (mode == 3) frame_check();
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        if (total >= next_write) write_out(), next_write = total + 10000;  /* a killed run still leaves its numbers */
    }
    return 0;
}

static void finish(void) {
    stop = 1;
    Sleep(5);
    write_out();
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: profile (%" PRIu64 " samples) in %s\n", total, out_path);
}

static void setup(void) {
    const char *on = getenv("YW4_PROFILE");
    mode = !on || !*on || *on == '0' ? 0 : !strcmp(on, "submit") ? 2 : !strcmp(on, "hitch") ? 3 : 1;
    if (getenv("YW4_PROFILE_HITCH_MS")) hitch_ms = strtoull(getenv("YW4_PROFILE_HITCH_MS"), NULL, 10);
    const char *from = getenv("YW4_PROFILE_FROM");
    if (from) from_frame = strtoull(from, NULL, 10);
    if (!mode) return;
    HMODULE exe = GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *nt = (IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *)((uint8_t *)exe + ((IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *)exe)->e_lfanew);
    exe_base = (uintptr_t)exe, exe_end = exe_base + nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;
    keys = calloc(PROFILE_SLOTS, sizeof *keys), counts = calloc(PROFILE_SLOTS, sizeof *counts);
    if (!keys || !counts) {
        mode = 0;
        return;
    }
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm tmv;
    localtime_s(&tmv, &now);
    char when[32];
    strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", &tmv);
    snprintf(out_path, sizeof out_path, "work/perf/profile_%s.txt", when);
    atexit(finish);
    CreateThread(NULL, 1 << 16, sampler, NULL, 0, NULL);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: profiling the %s thread(s) from frame %" PRIu64 "\n", mode == 2 ? "submitting" : mode == 3 ? "presenting (hitches only)" : "presenting",
            from_frame);
}

/* Adds the calling thread to the sampled ones (once) if it plays the role being profiled. */
void yw4_profile_thread(int role, uint64_t frame) {
    static _Thread_local int added;
    if (added || mode == 0) return;
    if (mode < 0) {
        static INIT_ONCE once = INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT;
        BOOL pending;
        InitOnceBeginInitialize(&once, 0, &pending, NULL);
        if (pending) setup(), InitOnceComplete(&once, 0, NULL);
        if (!mode) return;
    }
    if (mode == 3 ? !(role & (YW4_ROLE_PRESENT | YW4_ROLE_SUBMIT | YW4_ROLE_ANY))
                  : (role == YW4_ROLE_PRESENT) != (mode == 1) || role == YW4_ROLE_ANY || frame < from_frame)
        return;
    const char *only = getenv("YW4_PROFILE_THREAD");
    if (only && *only && strtoull(only, NULL, 10) != yw4_thread_id()) return;
    added = 1;
    HANDLE h;
    if (!DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &h,
                         THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0))
        return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (ntargets < MAX_TARGETS) target_tag[ntargets] = (uint64_t)(yw4_thread_id() & 0x7fff) << 48, targets[ntargets++] = h;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}
#else
void yw4_profile_thread(int role, uint64_t frame) { (void)role, (void)frame; }
#endif

```

`runtime/src/romfs.c`:

```c
/* Virtual RomFS image of a folder (romfs.h, decision 0014).
 *
 * Image layout, as the game's own: a 0x50-byte header (padded to 0x200), file data from 0x200
 * (each file 16-byte aligned), then the directory hash table, directory entries, file hash
 * table and file entries. The game finds entries by hash, so the order inside the tables
 * only has to be consistent: directories and files sorted by name, a directory's
 * subdirectories after all of its files' and siblings'. The table construction and the name
 * hash follow LAS Recomp's runtime/romfs_build.c (MIT, github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp); here the
 * file data is not copied but read from the original files on demand.
 */
#include "romfs.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include "host.h"
#include "diaryrows.h"
#include "modmerge.h"

#define EMPTY 0xFFFFFFFFu
#define DATA_START 0x200u

typedef struct Dir Dir;
typedef struct {
    char *name, *path;
    uint64_t size, data_off;  /* data_off: relative to DATA_START */
    uint32_t entry;           /* offset in the file table */
    Dir *parent;
    int read_before;          /* YW4_TRACE_ROMFS: its first read was logged */
    uint8_t *mem;             /* made here, read from memory instead of path (a merged file, decisions 0067/0068) */
    char *game_path;          /* the game's own copy when a mod replaced it (NULL: the game has it in an archive) */
    char **layers;            /* each mod's copy, in load order (the last is `path`), and the mod it came from */
    const char **layer_mods;
    int nlayers;
} File;
struct Dir {
    char *name;
    Dir *parent;
    Dir **dirs;
    File **files;
    int ndirs, nfiles;
    uint32_t entry;           /* offset in the directory table */
};

static char *dup_str(const char *s) {
    char *d = malloc(strlen(s) + 1);
    if (!d) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    return strcpy(d, s);
}

static int64_t file_size(const char *path, int *is_dir) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    struct _stat64 st;
    if (_stat64(path, &st)) return -1;
#else
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(path, &st)) return -1;
#endif
    *is_dir = (st.st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFDIR;
    return (int64_t)st.st_size;
}

static int by_dir_name(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(Dir *const *)a)->name, (*(Dir *const *)b)->name); }
static int by_file_name(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(File *const *)a)->name, (*(File *const *)b)->name); }

static Dir *scan(const char *path, const char *name, Dir *parent, int depth) {
    DIR *d = depth < 32 ? opendir(path) : NULL;
    if (!d) return NULL;
    Dir *dir = calloc(1, sizeof *dir);
    if (!dir) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    dir->name = dup_str(name);
    dir->parent = parent;
    int cap_d = 0, cap_f = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        size_t n = strlen(path) + strlen(e->d_name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        if (!p) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        int is_dir = 0;
        int64_t size = file_size(p, &is_dir);
        if (size < 0) {
            free(p);
        } else if (is_dir) {
            Dir *c = scan(p, e->d_name, dir, depth + 1);
            free(p);
            if (!c) continue;
            if (dir->ndirs == cap_d) dir->dirs = realloc(dir->dirs, sizeof *dir->dirs * (size_t)(cap_d = cap_d ? 2 * cap_d : 8));
            dir->dirs[dir->ndirs++] = c;
        } else {
            File *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f);
            if (!f) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            f->name = dup_str(e->d_name), f->path = p, f->size = (uint64_t)size, f->parent = dir;
            if (dir->nfiles == cap_f) dir->files = realloc(dir->files, sizeof *dir->files * (size_t)(cap_f = cap_f ? 2 * cap_f : 16));
            dir->files[dir->nfiles++] = f;
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (dir->ndirs) qsort(dir->dirs, (size_t)dir->ndirs, sizeof *dir->dirs, by_dir_name);
    if (dir->nfiles) qsort(dir->files, (size_t)dir->nfiles, sizeof *dir->files, by_file_name);
    return dir;
}

/* ---- mods (LayeredFS, decision 0043): a mod's romfs/ folder laid over the game's, as Atmosphere does on a
 * Switch: a file at the same path replaces the game's, a new path is added. The English patch replaces whole
 * .cpk archives and data/cpk_list.cfg.bin and adds loose files that the new list sends the game to. */

static int mod_replaced, mod_added;
static const char *mod_now;  /* the mod being laid over (overlay's caller sets it; kept for the life of the run) */

static int count_files(const Dir *d) {
    int n = d->nfiles;
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) n += count_files(d->dirs[i]);
    return n;
}

static void add_layer(File *f, char *path) {
    f->layers = realloc(f->layers, sizeof *f->layers * (size_t)(f->nlayers + 1));
    f->layer_mods = realloc(f->layer_mods, sizeof *f->layer_mods * (size_t)(f->nlayers + 1));
    if (!f->layers || !f->layer_mods) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    f->layers[f->nlayers] = path, f->layer_mods[f->nlayers] = mod_now;
    f->nlayers++;
}

/* A folder a mod added: its files are that mod's copies (a later mod replacing one must not take it for the
 * game's). */
static void mark_mod_files(Dir *d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) add_layer(d->files[i], d->files[i]->path);
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) mark_mod_files(d->dirs[i]);
}

static void overlay(Dir *dst, const char *path, int depth) {
    DIR *d = depth < 32 ? opendir(path) : NULL;
    if (!d) return;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        size_t n = strlen(path) + strlen(e->d_name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        if (!p) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        int is_dir = 0;
        int64_t size = file_size(p, &is_dir);
        if (size < 0) {
            free(p);
        } else if (is_dir) {
            Dir *c = NULL;
            for (int i = 0; i < dst->ndirs && !c; i++)
                if (!strcmp(dst->dirs[i]->name, e->d_name)) c = dst->dirs[i];
            if (c) {
                overlay(c, p, depth + 1);
            } else if ((c = scan(p, e->d_name, dst, depth + 1))) {
                dst->dirs = realloc(dst->dirs, sizeof *dst->dirs * (size_t)(dst->ndirs + 1));
                dst->dirs[dst->ndirs++] = c;
                mod_added += count_files(c);
                mark_mod_files(c);
            }
            free(p);
        } else {
            File *f = NULL;
            for (int i = 0; i < dst->nfiles && !f; i++)
                if (!strcmp(dst->files[i]->name, e->d_name)) f = dst->files[i];
            if (f) {
                if (!f->nlayers) f->game_path = f->path;  /* else the old path is an earlier mod's layer */
                mod_replaced++;
            } else {
                if (!(f = calloc(1, sizeof *f))) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
                f->name = dup_str(e->d_name), f->parent = dst;
                dst->files = realloc(dst->files, sizeof *dst->files * (size_t)(dst->nfiles + 1));
                dst->files[dst->nfiles++] = f;
                mod_added++;
            }
            f->path = p, f->size = (uint64_t)size;
            add_layer(f, p);
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (dst->ndirs) qsort(dst->dirs, (size_t)dst->ndirs, sizeof *dst->dirs, by_dir_name);
    if (dst->nfiles) qsort(dst->files, (size_t)dst->nfiles, sizeof *dst->files, by_file_name);
}

typedef struct {
    char *name, *romfs;
} DiscoveredMod;

static int by_mod_name(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return strcmp(((const DiscoveredMod *)a)->name, ((const DiscoveredMod *)b)->name);
}

static int ieq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) {
        if (tolower((unsigned char)*a) != tolower((unsigned char)*b)) return 0;
        a++;
        b++;
    }
    return *a == *b;
}

static int is_mod_disabled(const char *name, const char *disabled_list) {
    if (!disabled_list || !*disabled_list) return 0;
    const char *p = disabled_list;
    size_t nlen = strlen(name);
    while (*p) {
        while (*p == ';' || *p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        const char *end = p;
        while (*end && *end != ';' && *end != ',') end++;
        size_t len = (size_t)(end - p);
        if (len == nlen) {
            int match = 1;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                if (tolower((unsigned char)p[i]) != tolower((unsigned char)name[i])) {
                    match = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (match) return 1;
        }
        p = end;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* A mod's folder: <dir>/romfs, or <dir> itself when it holds data/ directly (mods shared as the romfs contents
 * alone, to be put in a romfs folder on a Switch). */
/* Returns 1 when `dir` is a mod (added, or already there). */
static int check_add_mod(DiscoveredMod *mods, int *n, int max, const char *name, const char *dir) {
    if (*n >= max) return 0;
    char romfs[1200];
    int is_dir = 0;
    snprintf(romfs, sizeof romfs, "%s/romfs", dir);
    if (file_size(romfs, &is_dir) < 0 || !is_dir) {
        snprintf(romfs, sizeof romfs, "%s/data", dir);
        if (file_size(romfs, &is_dir) >= 0 && is_dir) snprintf(romfs, sizeof romfs, "%s", dir);
        else is_dir = 0;
    }
    if (is_dir) {
        for (int i = 0; i < *n; i++) {
            if (!strcmp(mods[i].romfs, romfs)) return 1;
        }
        mods[*n].name = dup_str(name);
        mods[*n].romfs = dup_str(romfs);
        (*n)++;
    }
    return is_dir;
}

/* The mods inside `dir`; a folder that isn't one is looked into `depth` more levels: downloads often wrap the mod
 * in a folder of their own (free_tag_battles/Tags/romfs), and players drop the whole download in. */
static void scan_submods(DiscoveredMod *mods, int *n, int max, const char *dir, int depth) {
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d)) && *n < max) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        if (ieq(e->d_name, "romfs")) continue;
        char sub[1024];
        snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
        int is_dir = 0;
        if (file_size(sub, &is_dir) >= 0 && is_dir) {
            if (!check_add_mod(mods, n, max, e->d_name, sub) && depth > 0) scan_submods(mods, n, max, sub, depth - 1);
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
}

static File *find_file(const Dir *d, const char *path) {
    while (d && *path) {
        const char *slash = strchr(path, '/');
        size_t n = slash ? (size_t)(slash - path) : strlen(path);
        if (!slash) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++)
                if (strlen(d->files[i]->name) == n && !strncmp(d->files[i]->name, path, n)) return d->files[i];
            return NULL;
        }
        const Dir *next = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs && !next; i++)
            if (strlen(d->dirs[i]->name) == n && !strncmp(d->dirs[i]->name, path, n)) next = d->dirs[i];
        d = next, path = slash + 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ---- data/cpk_list.cfg.bin from several mods. The list names every file and the archive it is in; the game reads
 * a file with no archive (the value 0xFFFFFFFF or an empty string) from the folder. A mod "frees" the files it ships
 * loose by clearing their archive, in a copy of the whole list. Two mods' copies can't both be used, and the later
 * one would send the earlier one's files back to the archives (the English patch frees ~3,000; a gameplay mod made
 * from the original list frees only its own). So the list used is the last mod's with every file any mod freed
 * also freed. The format is Level-5's cfg.bin: a count, the string table's offset and size, then entries of
 * (crc32 u32, value count u8, 2-bit value types padded to 4 bytes, u32 values); a file's entry has 3 values:
 * path (string), archive (string), size. */

typedef struct {
    const char *path;
    size_t archive;  /* offset of the archive value in the buffer */
    const char *arch_name;  /* the archive's path ("data/common/gamedata.cpk"), NULL or "" when loose */
    int loose;
} CpkEntry;

static uint8_t *read_all(const char *path, size_t *n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    uint8_t *b = NULL;
    int is_dir = 0;
    int64_t size = file_size(path, &is_dir);
    if (size > 0 && size < (1 << 28) && (b = malloc((size_t)size)) && fread(b, 1, (size_t)size, f) != (size_t)size) {
        free(b);
        b = NULL;
    }
    fclose(f);
    *n = b ? (size_t)size : 0;
    return b;
}

static uint32_t get32(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t v;
    memcpy(&v, p, 4);
    return v;
}

/* The file entries of a cpk_list, or -1 if it isn't one. */
static int cpk_entries(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, CpkEntry **out) {
    *out = NULL;
    if (n < 16) return -1;
    uint32_t count = get32(b), st_off = get32(b + 4), st_len = get32(b + 8);
    if (st_off > n || st_len > n - st_off || count > n / 8) return -1;
    const char *st = (const char *)b + st_off;
    CpkEntry *e = malloc(sizeof *e * (count ? count : 1));
    if (!e) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    int m = 0;
    size_t p = 16;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (p + 5 > st_off) goto bad;
        unsigned k = b[p + 4];
        p += 5;
        size_t tl = (k + 3) / 4;
        if (p + tl > st_off) goto bad;
        const uint8_t *types = b + p;
        p = (p + tl + 3) & ~(size_t)3;
        if (p + 4 * (size_t)k > st_off) goto bad;
        if (k == 3 && (types[0] & 0xF) == 0) {  /* path and archive are strings */
            uint32_t path = get32(b + p), arch = get32(b + p + 4);
            if (path < st_len && memchr(st + path, 0, st_len - path)) {
                e[m].path = st + path;
                e[m].archive = p + 4;
                e[m].arch_name = arch != EMPTY && arch < st_len && memchr(st + arch, 0, st_len - arch) ? st + arch : NULL;
                e[m].loose = arch == EMPTY || (arch < st_len && st[arch] == 0);
                m++;
            }
        }
        p += 4 * (size_t)k;
    }
    *out = e;
    return m;
bad:
    free(e);
    return -1;
}

static uint32_t path_hash(const char *s) {
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    while (*s) h = (h ^ (uint8_t)*s++) * 16777619u;
    return h;
}

/* base: the game's own list; lists: each mod's, in load order (the last one is what the tree points to now). */
static void merge_cpk_lists(Dir *root, const char *base, char **lists, int nlists) {
    File *target = find_file(root, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
    if (nlists < 2 || !target || !base) return;
    size_t bn = 0;
    uint8_t *bb = read_all(base, &bn);
    CpkEntry *be = NULL;
    int nb = bb ? cpk_entries(bb, bn, &be) : -1;
    if (nb <= 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: cpk_list: cannot read the game's list (%s), the last mod's is used\n", base);
        free(bb), free(be);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t cap = 1;
    while (cap < 2u * (uint32_t)nb) cap <<= 1;
    int32_t *slot = malloc(sizeof *slot * cap);
    uint8_t *freed = calloc((size_t)nb, 1);
    if (!slot || !freed) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cap; i++) slot[i] = -1;
    /* A path can be listed several times (the same file in several archives; 8,504 in 2.2.0): one slot per path, at
     * its first entry, "loose" only if every entry is (a mod frees them all). */
    for (int i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
        uint32_t h = path_hash(be[i].path) & (cap - 1);
        while (slot[h] >= 0 && strcmp(be[slot[h]].path, be[i].path)) h = (h + 1) & (cap - 1);
        if (slot[h] >= 0) be[slot[h]].loose &= be[i].loose;
        else slot[h] = i;
    }
#define FIND(p, j)                                                                         \
    do {                                                                                   \
        uint32_t h_ = path_hash(p) & (cap - 1);                                            \
        for ((j) = -1; slot[h_] >= 0; h_ = (h_ + 1) & (cap - 1))                           \
            if (!strcmp(be[slot[h_]].path, (p))) { (j) = slot[h_]; break; }                \
    } while (0)
    uint8_t *last = NULL;
    size_t last_n = 0;
    CpkEntry *le = NULL;
    int nl = -1, ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < nlists && ok; i++) {
        size_t n = 0;
        uint8_t *b = read_all(lists[i], &n);
        CpkEntry *e = NULL;
        int ne = b ? cpk_entries(b, n, &e) : -1;
        if (ne < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: cpk_list: cannot read %s, the last mod's list is used\n", lists[i]);
            ok = 0;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < ne; k++) {
            int j;
            FIND(e[k].path, j);
            if (j >= 0 && e[k].loose && !be[j].loose) freed[j] = 1;
        }
        if (i == nlists - 1 && ok) {
            last = b, last_n = n, le = e, nl = ne;
        } else {
            free(b), free(e);
        }
    }
    /* A file is freed the way the mods free it: its archive an empty string (0xFFFFFFFF is how the game's own list
     * marks files that were never in an archive; both read as loose, but the mods' way is the one known to work for
     * a freed file). Any NUL in the string table is an empty string: one a mod already uses, else the table's last
     * byte. */
    uint32_t empty = EMPTY;
    for (int k = 0; ok && k < nl && empty == EMPTY; k++)
        if (le[k].loose && get32(last + le[k].archive) != EMPTY) empty = get32(last + le[k].archive);
    if (ok && empty == EMPTY && last_n >= 16) {
        uint32_t so = get32(last + 4), sl = get32(last + 8);
        if (sl && (uint64_t)so + sl <= last_n && last[so + sl - 1] == 0) empty = sl - 1;
    }
    int added = 0;
    for (int k = 0; ok && k < nl; k++) {
        int j;
        FIND(le[k].path, j);
        if (j >= 0 && freed[j] && !le[k].loose) {
            memcpy(last + le[k].archive, &empty, 4);
            added++;
        }
    }
#undef FIND
    if (ok) {
        target->mem = last, target->size = last_n;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: cpk_list: %d mods' lists merged, %d entries freed by an earlier mod kept loose\n",
                nlists, added);
    } else {
        free(last);
    }
    free(le), free(slot), free(freed), free(be), free(bb);
}

/* ---- data files several mods replace (decision 0068): Level-5 .cfg.bin lists (items, shops, NPCs...) are merged
 * entry by entry against the game's own copy (modmerge.c), so mods that change different entries all work. */

static int clash_check;              /* romfs_mod_clashes: every mod laid over, nothing merged */
static const char *game_list_path;   /* the game's own data/cpk_list.cfg.bin */

/* rel + "/" + name in rel's 1024 bytes (just name at the top); 0 if it doesn't fit. */
static int rel_join(char *rel, size_t rl, const char *name) {
    int k = snprintf(rel + rl, 1024 - rl, rl ? "/%s" : "%s", name);
    if (k < 0 || (size_t)k >= 1024 - rl) {
        rel[rl] = 0;
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int is_cfgbin(const char *rel) {
    size_t n = strlen(rel);
    return n > 8 && !strcmp(rel + n - 8, ".cfg.bin") && strcmp(rel, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
}

/* The game's own copy of a file: its loose file, or from the archive the game's list puts it in. */
static uint8_t *game_copy(Dir *root, const File *f, const char *rel, size_t *n) {
    if (f->game_path) return read_all(f->game_path, n);
    static uint8_t *lb;
    static CpkEntry *le;
    static int nl = -1;
    static int32_t *slot;
    static uint32_t cap;
    if (nl < 0) {  /* once: the game's list and a path -> entry table */
        size_t ln = 0;
        lb = game_list_path ? read_all(game_list_path, &ln) : NULL;
        nl = lb ? cpk_entries(lb, ln, &le) : -1;
        if (nl < 0) nl = 0;
        for (cap = 1; cap < 2u * (uint32_t)nl + 1; cap <<= 1) {}
        slot = malloc(sizeof *slot * cap);
        if (!slot) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cap; i++) slot[i] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
            if (!le[i].arch_name || !*le[i].arch_name) continue;  /* loose in the game: it has no archive copy */
            uint32_t h = path_hash(le[i].path) & (cap - 1);
            while (slot[h] >= 0 && strcmp(le[slot[h]].path, le[i].path)) h = (h + 1) & (cap - 1);
            if (slot[h] < 0) slot[h] = i;
        }
    }
    uint32_t h = path_hash(rel) & (cap - 1);
    for (; slot[h] >= 0; h = (h + 1) & (cap - 1)) {
        if (strcmp(le[slot[h]].path, rel)) continue;
        const File *a = find_file(root, le[slot[h]].arch_name);
        if (!a) return NULL;
        return cpk_read_file(a->game_path ? a->game_path : a->path, rel, n);  /* the game's archive, not a mod's */
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* The list's sizes of loose files must be the files the game reads: it reads a loose file by the size its entry
 * gives. A mod that frees a file writes its own copy's size in its list (the English patch: 2,168 of its 2,984
 * files); the list that wins is one mod's, and a merged data file has a size no list has. Measured 2026-11-14: the
 * translation's item text (177,072 bytes) listed with the game's 324,736 by another mod's list drew every item
 * name blank, and a merged item list read past its end emptied the menu. So every loose entry gets the size of the
 * file at its path after all the laying over and merging. */
static void fix_list_sizes(Dir *root) {
    File *list = find_file(root, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
    if (!list || !list->nlayers) return;  /* the game's own list: its sizes are its files' */
    size_t n = list->mem ? list->size : 0;
    uint8_t *b = list->mem ? list->mem : read_all(list->path, &n);
    CpkEntry *e = NULL;
    int ne = b ? cpk_entries(b, n, &e) : -1, fixed = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        if (!e[i].loose) continue;
        const File *f = find_file(root, e[i].path);
        size_t at = e[i].archive + 4;  /* the size: the value after the archive */
        if (!f || f->size > 0xFFFFFFFFu || at + 4 > n || get32(b + at) == (uint32_t)f->size) continue;
        uint32_t sz = (uint32_t)f->size;
        memcpy(b + at, &sz, 4);
        fixed++;
    }
    free(e);
    if (fixed && !list->mem) list->mem = b, list->size = n;
    else if (b != list->mem) free(b);
    if (fixed) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: cpk_list: %d loose files' sizes set to the files read\n", fixed);
}

static void merge_data_files(Dir *root, Dir *d, char *rel, size_t rl) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        File *f = d->files[i];
        if (f->nlayers < 2 || !rel_join(rel, rl, f->name)) continue;
        const char *last = f->layer_mods[f->nlayers - 1];
        if (is_cfgbin(rel)) {
            size_t bn = 0, on = 0;
            uint8_t *base = game_copy(root, f, rel, &bn);
            uint8_t **m = calloc((size_t)f->nlayers, sizeof *m);
            size_t *mn = calloc((size_t)f->nlayers, sizeof *mn);
            if (!m || !mn) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            int ok = base != NULL, ca = -1, cb = -1;
            for (int k = 0; k < f->nlayers && ok; k++) ok = (m[k] = read_all(f->layers[k], &mn[k])) != NULL;
            uint8_t *r = ok ? cfgbin_merge(base, bn, (const uint8_t *const *)m, mn, f->nlayers, &on, &ca, &cb) : NULL;
            if (r) {
                f->mem = r, f->size = on;
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: merged from %d mods\n", rel, f->nlayers);
            } else if (ca >= 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: %s and %s change the same entries, %s's copy is used\n", rel,
                        f->layer_mods[ca], f->layer_mods[cb], last);
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: can't be merged (%s), %s's copy is used\n", rel,
                        base ? "not a list this reads" : "the game's copy wasn't found", last);
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < f->nlayers; k++) free(m[k]);
            free(m), free(mn), free(base);
        } else if (strcmp(rel, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin")) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: in %d mods, %s's copy is used\n", rel, f->nlayers, last);
        }
        rel[rl] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        if (!rel_join(rel, rl, d->dirs[i]->name)) continue;
        merge_data_files(root, d->dirs[i], rel, strlen(rel));
        rel[rl] = 0;
    }
}

/* Every mod in YW4_MODS (default work/mods; "none": no mods), in name order (a later one wins): folders with a
 * romfs/ inside, in Atmosphere's layout contents/<title_id>/<mod>/romfs, contents/<mod>/romfs or simply <mod>/romfs. */
static void apply_mods(Dir *root) {
    const char *env = getenv("YW4_MODS"), *base = env && *env ? env : "work/mods";
    if (!strcmp(base, "none")) return;
    DIR *d = opendir(base);
    if (!d) {
        if (env && *env) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: cannot read %s\n", base);
        return;
    }
    DiscoveredMod mods[256];
    int n = 0;
    check_add_mod(mods, &n, 256, "romfs", base);
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d)) && n < 256) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        if (ieq(e->d_name, "romfs")) continue;
        char path[1024];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", base, e->d_name);
        int is_dir = 0;
        if (file_size(path, &is_dir) < 0 || !is_dir) continue;
        if (ieq(e->d_name, "contents")) {
            DIR *dc = opendir(path);
            if (dc) {
                struct dirent *ec;
                while ((ec = readdir(dc)) && n < 256) {
                    if (ec->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
                    char sub[1024];
                    snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s/%s", path, ec->d_name);
                    int sub_is_dir = 0;
                    if (file_size(sub, &sub_is_dir) >= 0 && sub_is_dir) {
                        check_add_mod(mods, &n, 256, ec->d_name, sub);
                        scan_submods(mods, &n, 256, sub, 1);
                    }
                }
                closedir(dc);
            }
        } else {
            check_add_mod(mods, &n, 256, e->d_name, path);
            scan_submods(mods, &n, 256, path, 1);
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    const char *disabled_env = getenv("YW4_MODS_DISABLED");
    qsort(mods, (size_t)n, sizeof *mods, by_mod_name);
    const File *game_list = find_file(root, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
    char *base_list = game_list ? dup_str(game_list->path) : NULL;
    game_list_path = base_list;  /* kept: merge_data_files looks up archives in it */
    char *lists[256];
    int nlists = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!clash_check && is_mod_disabled(mods[i].name, disabled_env)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: disabled, skipped\n", mods[i].name);
            free(mods[i].name);
            free(mods[i].romfs);
            continue;
        }
        mod_replaced = mod_added = 0;
        mod_now = mods[i].name;  /* kept for the life of the run: the files' layers name it */
        overlay(root, mods[i].romfs, 0);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: mods: %s: %d files replaced, %d added (%s)\n", mods[i].name, mod_replaced, mod_added,
                mods[i].romfs);
        char list[1300];
        int is_dir = 0;
        snprintf(list, sizeof list, "%s/data/cpk_list.cfg.bin", mods[i].romfs);
        if (file_size(list, &is_dir) >= 0 && !is_dir) lists[nlists++] = dup_str(list);
        free(mods[i].romfs);
    }
    merge_cpk_lists(root, base_list, lists, nlists);
    for (int i = 0; i < nlists; i++) free(lists[i]);
    const char *merge_env = getenv("YW4_MODS_MERGE");  /* "0": no data-file merge, the later copy wins (A/B checks) */
    if (!clash_check && !(merge_env && !strcmp(merge_env, "0"))) {
        char rel[1024] = "";
        merge_data_files(root, root, rel, 0);
    }
    if (!clash_check) fix_list_sizes(root);
}

/* yw4 --mod-clashes <romfs>: for the launcher's Mods tab (decision 0068). Every mod in YW4_MODS, on or off, is laid
 * over the game as at a start, and each pair of mods that can't both have their way with one file is printed as
 * "clash\t<file>\t<mod>\t<mod>": any shared file but the merged ones, unless it is a data file this code merges
 * and the two change different entries. Pairs, not groups: whether two mods merge doesn't depend on the others. */
static void print_clashes(Dir *root, Dir *d, char *rel, size_t rl, FILE *out) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        File *f = d->files[i];
        if (f->nlayers < 2) continue;
        if (!rel_join(rel, rl, f->name)) continue;
        if (!strcmp(rel, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin")) {
            rel[rl] = 0;
            continue;
        }
        size_t bn = 0;
        uint8_t *base = is_cfgbin(rel) ? game_copy(root, f, rel, &bn) : NULL;
        for (int a = 0; a < f->nlayers; a++)
            for (int b = a + 1; b < f->nlayers; b++) {
                int clash = 1;
                if (base) {
                    size_t n[2] = {0, 0}, on = 0;
                    uint8_t *m[2] = {read_all(f->layers[a], &n[0]), read_all(f->layers[b], &n[1])};
                    int ca, cb;
                    uint8_t *r = m[0] && m[1] ? cfgbin_merge(base, bn, (const uint8_t *const *)m, n, 2, &on, &ca, &cb) : NULL;
                    clash = !r;
                    free(r), free(m[0]), free(m[1]);
                }
                if (clash) fprintf(out, "clash\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", rel, f->layer_mods[a], f->layer_mods[b]);
            }
        free(base);
        rel[rl] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        if (!rel_join(rel, rl, d->dirs[i]->name)) continue;
        print_clashes(root, d->dirs[i], rel, strlen(rel), out);
        rel[rl] = 0;
    }
}

int romfs_mod_clashes(const char *dir, FILE *out) {
    Dir *root = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!root) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cannot read the RomFS folder %s\n", dir);
        return 1;
    }
    clash_check = 1;
    apply_mods(root);
    char rel[1024] = "";
    print_clashes(root, root, rel, 0, out);
    return 0;
}

/* One image: the flat tables below, its header (0..0x200), file data, then `tables` (from tables_off). The game's
 * RomFS is one; each add-on's is another (fsp-srv OpenDataStorageByDataId, decision 0056). */
struct RomfsImage {
    /* Table order: a directory's files, then its subdirectories, then each subdirectory's. */
    Dir **dirs;
    File **files;
    int ndirs, nfiles, cap_dirs, cap_files;
    uint8_t header[DATA_START];
    uint8_t *tables;
    uint64_t tables_off, tables_size, image_size, data_size;
};
static RomfsImage game;
static const Dir *game_root;  /* the game's tree with the mods laid over it (romfs_host_path) */

static void flatten(RomfsImage *m, Dir *d) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        if (m->nfiles == m->cap_files)
            m->files = realloc(m->files, sizeof *m->files * (size_t)(m->cap_files = m->cap_files ? 2 * m->cap_files : 256));
        m->files[m->nfiles++] = d->files[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        if (m->ndirs == m->cap_dirs)
            m->dirs = realloc(m->dirs, sizeof *m->dirs * (size_t)(m->cap_dirs = m->cap_dirs ? 2 * m->cap_dirs : 64));
        m->dirs[m->ndirs++] = d->dirs[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) flatten(m, d->dirs[i]);
}

/* The RomFS name hash and bucket count, as the game's RomFS code computes them. */
static uint32_t name_hash(uint32_t parent, const char *name) {
    uint32_t h = parent ^ 123456789u;
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; *p; p++) h = ((h >> 5) | (h << 27)) ^ *p;
    return h;
}
static uint32_t bucket_count(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 3) return 3;
    if (n < 19) return n | 1;
    uint32_t c = n;
    while (c % 2 == 0 || c % 3 == 0 || c % 5 == 0 || c % 7 == 0 || c % 11 == 0 || c % 13 == 0 || c % 17 == 0) c++;
    return c;
}

static uint32_t align4(uint32_t x) { return (x + 3) & ~3u; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 4); }
static void put64(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 8); }

/* The tables and header of the image of `root` (scanned from `dir`). */
static void build(RomfsImage *m, Dir *root, const char *dir) {
    m->dirs = realloc(m->dirs, sizeof *m->dirs * (size_t)(m->cap_dirs = 64));
    m->dirs[m->ndirs++] = root;
    flatten(m, root);
    Dir **dirs = m->dirs;
    File **files = m->files;
    int ndirs = m->ndirs, nfiles = m->nfiles;

    uint32_t dsize = 0, fsize = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ndirs; i++) dirs[i]->entry = dsize, dsize += 0x18 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(dirs[i]->name));
    for (int i = 0; i < nfiles; i++) files[i]->entry = fsize, fsize += 0x20 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(files[i]->name));
    for (int i = 0; i < nfiles; i++) {
        m->data_size = (m->data_size + 15) & ~15ull;
        files[i]->data_off = m->data_size;
        m->data_size += files[i]->size;
    }

    uint32_t nbd = bucket_count((uint32_t)ndirs), nbf = bucket_count((uint32_t)nfiles);
    m->tables_off = (DATA_START + m->data_size + 3) & ~3ull;
    uint64_t dhash = 0, dmeta = 4ull * nbd, fhash = dmeta + dsize, fmeta = fhash + 4ull * nbf;
    m->tables_size = fmeta + fsize;
    uint8_t *tables = m->tables = malloc(m->tables_size);
    if (!tables) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbd; i++) put32(tables + dhash + 4 * i, EMPTY);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbf; i++) put32(tables + fhash + 4 * i, EMPTY);
    memset(tables + dmeta, 0, dsize);
    memset(tables + fmeta, 0, fsize);

    for (int i = 0; i < ndirs; i++) {  /* parent, sibling, first child dir, first file, hash chain, name */
        Dir *d = dirs[i];
        uint8_t *e = tables + dmeta + d->entry;
        uint32_t parent = d->parent ? d->parent->entry : 0, nl = (uint32_t)strlen(d->name), sibling = EMPTY;
        if (d->parent)
            for (int k = 0; k + 1 < d->parent->ndirs; k++)
                if (d->parent->dirs[k] == d) sibling = d->parent->dirs[k + 1]->entry;
        uint8_t *bucket = tables + dhash + 4 * (name_hash(parent, d->name) % nbd);
        put32(e, parent);
        put32(e + 4, sibling);
        put32(e + 8, d->ndirs ? d->dirs[0]->entry : EMPTY);
        put32(e + 12, d->nfiles ? d->files[0]->entry : EMPTY);
        memcpy(e + 16, bucket, 4);
        put32(e + 20, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x18, d->name, nl);
        put32(bucket, d->entry);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < nfiles; i++) {  /* parent, sibling, data offset, size, hash chain, name */
        File *f = files[i];
        uint8_t *e = tables + fmeta + f->entry;
        uint32_t nl = (uint32_t)strlen(f->name), sibling = EMPTY;
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < f->parent->nfiles; k++)
            if (f->parent->files[k] == f) sibling = f->parent->files[k + 1]->entry;
        uint8_t *bucket = tables + fhash + 4 * (name_hash(f->parent->entry, f->name) % nbf);
        put32(e, f->parent->entry);
        put32(e + 4, sibling);
        put64(e + 8, f->data_off);
        put64(e + 16, f->size);
        memcpy(e + 24, bucket, 4);
        put32(e + 28, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x20, f->name, nl);
        put32(bucket, f->entry);
    }

    uint64_t hv[10] = {0x50, m->tables_off + dhash, 4ull * nbd, m->tables_off + dmeta, dsize,
                       m->tables_off + fhash, 4ull * nbf, m->tables_off + fmeta, fsize, DATA_START};
    memcpy(m->header, hv, sizeof hv);
    m->image_size = m->tables_off + m->tables_size;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: RomFS: %d files, %d directories, %.1f GiB of data (from %s)\n", nfiles, ndirs - 1,
            (double)m->data_size / (1 << 30), dir);
}

/* ---- the Diary's stacked rows (diaryrows.h): three of the game's files changed in memory, after the mods (a mod's
 * copy of one is the one changed), and freed from their archives in the list, as a mod frees its files. All three or
 * none: a file that isn't what the change expects (a mod changed it, or it is already changed) leaves the game's two
 * rows, and the Diary pages (savefs.c). */

/* The file at path in the tree, made (with its folders) if it isn't there: for a file the game has only in an archive. */
static File *tree_file(Dir *root, const char *path) {
    Dir *d = root;
    for (;;) {
        const char *slash = strchr(path, '/');
        size_t n = slash ? (size_t)(slash - path) : strlen(path);
        char *name = malloc(n + 1);
        if (!name) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        memcpy(name, path, n), name[n] = 0;
        if (!slash) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++)
                if (!strcmp(d->files[i]->name, name)) return free(name), d->files[i];
            File *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f);
            File **nf = realloc(d->files, sizeof *d->files * (size_t)(d->nfiles + 1));
            if (!f || !nf) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            f->name = name, f->path = dup_str("(made in memory: the Diary's stacked rows)"), f->parent = d;
            d->files = nf, d->files[d->nfiles++] = f;
            qsort(d->files, (size_t)d->nfiles, sizeof *d->files, by_file_name);
            return f;
        }
        Dir *next = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs && !next; i++)
            if (!strcmp(d->dirs[i]->name, name)) next = d->dirs[i];
        if (next) {
            free(name);
        } else {
            next = calloc(1, sizeof *next);
            Dir **nd = realloc(d->dirs, sizeof *d->dirs * (size_t)(d->ndirs + 1));
            if (!next || !nd) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            next->name = name, next->parent = d;
            d->dirs = nd, d->dirs[d->ndirs++] = next;
            qsort(d->dirs, (size_t)d->ndirs, sizeof *d->dirs, by_dir_name);
        }
        d = next, path = slash + 1;
    }
}

typedef uint8_t *(*Change)(const uint8_t *, size_t, size_t *);

/* The copy of path the game would read now: a mod's or a merged one in the tree, else the game's from its archive. */
static uint8_t *current_copy(Dir *root, const char *path, size_t *n) {
    File *f = find_file(root, path);
    *n = 0;
    if (f && f->mem) {
        uint8_t *b = malloc(f->size ? (size_t)f->size : 1);
        if (b) memcpy(b, f->mem, (size_t)f->size), *n = (size_t)f->size;
        return b;
    }
    if (f) return read_all(f->path, n);
    File none = {0};
    return game_copy(root, &none, path, n);
}

/* Changes n files in memory, all or none (change[i] returns NULL: not the copy expected), and frees them in the
 * archive list (archive an empty string, as mods free theirs, with the new sizes). Returns 1 when done; quiet says
 * nothing when a file is not the one expected (a choice among copies, e.g. languages). */
static int memory_patch(Dir *root, const char *what, const char *const *paths, const Change *change, int n, int quiet) {
    File *list = find_file(root, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
    if (!list || n > 8) return 0;
    if (!game_list_path) game_list_path = dup_str(list->game_path ? list->game_path : list->path);  /* no mods */
    uint8_t *out[8] = {0};
    size_t on[8] = {0};
    int ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && ok; i++) {
        size_t bn = 0;
        uint8_t *b = current_copy(root, paths[i], &bn);
        out[i] = b ? change[i](b, bn, &on[i]) : NULL;
        if (!out[i]) {
            if (!quiet)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s: %s %s, not changed\n", what, paths[i],
                        b ? "is not the one expected (a mod's, or already changed)" : "not found");
            ok = 0;
        }
        free(b);
    }
    size_t ln = list->mem ? (size_t)list->size : 0;
    uint8_t *lb = NULL;
    if (ok) {
        lb = list->mem ? list->mem : read_all(list->path, &ln);
        ok = lb != NULL;
    }
    CpkEntry *e = NULL;
    int ne = ok ? cpk_entries(lb, ln, &e) : -1;
    uint32_t empty = EMPTY;
    for (int k = 0; k < ne && empty == EMPTY; k++)
        if (e[k].loose && get32(lb + e[k].archive) != EMPTY) empty = get32(lb + e[k].archive);
    if (ne > 0 && empty == EMPTY) {
        uint32_t so = get32(lb + 4), sl = get32(lb + 8);
        if (sl && (uint64_t)so + sl <= ln && lb[so + sl - 1] == 0) empty = sl - 1;
    }
    int named[8] = {0}, freed = 0, all = 1;
    for (int k = 0; k < ne && empty != EMPTY; k++)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (!strcmp(e[k].path, paths[i]) && e[k].archive + 8 <= ln) {
                uint32_t sz = (uint32_t)on[i];
                memcpy(lb + e[k].archive, &empty, 4);
                memcpy(lb + e[k].archive + 4, &sz, 4);
                named[i] = 1, freed++;
            }
    free(e);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) all &= named[i];
    if (!ok || !all) {
        if (ok) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: %s: the archive list doesn't name the files, not changed\n", what);
        if (lb && lb != list->mem) free(lb);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) free(out[i]);
        return 0;
    }
    if (lb != list->mem) list->mem = lb, list->size = ln;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        File *f = tree_file(root, paths[i]);
        if (f->mem) free(f->mem);
        f->mem = out[i], f->size = on[i];
    }
    return freed;
}

static void diary_rows(Dir *root) {
    if (!diaryrows_enabled()) return;
    static const char *const paths[3] = {DIARYROWS_MODEL, DIARYROWS_LOCATOR, DIARYROWS_SETTING};
    static const Change change[3] = {diaryrows_model, diaryrows_locator, diaryrows_setting};
    int freed = memory_patch(root, "diary rows", paths, change, 3, 0);
    if (freed) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: diary rows: on (%d row copies; %d list entries freed)\n", DIARY_ROW_COPIES, freed);
    else fprintf(stderr, "yw4: diary rows: off, the Diary keeps its two rows\n");
}

/* The in-game Save's hint names its slot paging (Left / Right): its line in each language's system text that has the
 * English one (the translation patch's), every language folder the archive list names. */
static void diary_save_hint(Dir *root) {
    if (!diaryrows_slots_enabled()) return;
    File *list = find_file(root, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin");
    if (!list) return;
    size_t ln = list->mem ? (size_t)list->size : 0;
    uint8_t *lb = list->mem ? list->mem : read_all(list->path, &ln);
    CpkEntry *e = NULL;
    int ne = lb ? cpk_entries(lb, ln, &e) : -1, done = 0;
    char paths[16][128];
    int np = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < ne && np < 16; k++) {
        const char *p = e[k].path;
        size_t pl = strlen(p);
        if (strncmp(p, "data/common/text/", 17) || pl < 20 || strcmp(p + pl - 20, "/system_text.cfg.bin") ||
            pl >= sizeof paths[0])
            continue;
        int dup = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < np && !dup; i++) dup = !strcmp(paths[i], p);
        if (!dup) snprintf(paths[np++], sizeof paths[0], "%s", p);
    }
    free(e);
    if (lb != list->mem) free(lb);
    for (int i = 0; i < np; i++) {
        const char *one[1] = {paths[i]};
        static const Change ch[1] = {diaryrows_save_hint};
        if (memory_patch(root, "diary save hint", one, ch, 1, 1)) done++;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: diary save hint: %d of %d system texts\n", done, np);
}

int romfs_open(const char *dir) {
    Dir *root = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!root) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: cannot read the RomFS folder %s\n", dir);
        return -1;
    }
    apply_mods(root);
    diary_rows(root);
    diary_save_hint(root);
    build(&game, root, dir);
    game_root = root;
    return 0;
}

const char *romfs_host_path(const char *path) {
    const File *f = find_file(game_root, path);
    return f && !f->mem ? f->path : NULL;  /* a merged file has no host copy */
}

RomfsImage *romfs_image_open(const char *dir) {
    Dir *root = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!root) return NULL;
    RomfsImage *m = calloc(1, sizeof *m);
    if (!m) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    build(m, root, dir);
    return m;
}

uint64_t romfs_size(void) { return game.image_size; }
uint64_t romfs_image_size(const RomfsImage *m) { return m->image_size; }

/* A few open files: reads come in long runs from the same file. */
#define OPEN_FILES 32
static struct {
    const File *file;
    FILE *fp;
} open_files[OPEN_FILES];
static int next_slot;

static FILE *file_handle(const File *f) {
    for (int i = 0; i < OPEN_FILES; i++)
        if (open_files[i].file == f) return open_files[i].fp;
    int i = next_slot++ % OPEN_FILES;
    if (open_files[i].fp) fclose(open_files[i].fp);
    open_files[i].file = f;
    open_files[i].fp = fopen(f->path, "rb");
    return open_files[i].fp;
}

static int read_file_part_locked(const File *f, uint64_t at, uint8_t *out, uint64_t n) {
    if (f->mem) {
        if (at > f->size || n > f->size - at) return -1;
        memcpy(out, f->mem + at, (size_t)n);
        return 0;
    }
    FILE *fp = file_handle(f);
    if (!fp) return -1;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (_fseeki64(fp, (long long)at, SEEK_SET)) return -1;
#else
    if (fseeko(fp, (off_t)at, SEEK_SET)) return -1;
#endif
    /* Through a bounce buffer: the OS writing the game's memory directly (a large fread
     * becomes ReadFile into it) isn't seen by write tracking, and the draw path relies on
     * that to notice textures loaded after they were made (decision 0021). Callers hold
     * romfs_io (read_file_part), so one buffer is enough. */
    static uint8_t *bounce;
    enum { BOUNCE = 1 << 20 };
    if (!bounce && !(bounce = malloc(BOUNCE))) return -1;
    while (n) {
        size_t k = n < BOUNCE ? (size_t)n : BOUNCE;
        if (fread(bounce, 1, k, fp) != k) return -1;
        memcpy(out, bounce, k);
        out += k, n -= k;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* The reads run without the kernel lock (svc_fs.c), so that a loading thread's disk reads don't hold up every other
 * thread's SVCs; this lock keeps the open files and the bounce buffer to one reader at a time. A read that took
 * long is logged (YW4_TRACE_ROMFS names the files, this says when the disk was the wait). */
static HostLock romfs_io = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static int read_file_part(const File *f, uint64_t at, uint8_t *out, uint64_t n) {
    host_lock(&romfs_io);
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    int r = read_file_part_locked(f, at, out, n);
    int64_t ms = (host_now_ns() - t0) / 1000000;
    host_unlock(&romfs_io);
    if (ms >= 20)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: romfs: slow read: %s +%#llx, %llu bytes, %lld ms\n", f->path, (unsigned long long)at,
                (unsigned long long)n, (long long)ms);
    return r;
}

int romfs_image_read(RomfsImage *m, uint64_t offset, void *out_, uint64_t size) {
    uint8_t *out = out_;
    const uint8_t *header = m->header, *tables = m->tables;
    File *const *files = m->files;
    int nfiles = m->nfiles;
    uint64_t image_size = m->image_size, tables_off = m->tables_off;
    if (offset > image_size || size > image_size - offset) return -1;
    while (size) {
        uint64_t n;
        if (offset < DATA_START) {  /* header */
            n = DATA_START - offset < size ? DATA_START - offset : size;
            memcpy(out, header + offset, (size_t)n);
        } else if (offset >= tables_off) {  /* tables */
            n = size;
            memcpy(out, tables + (offset - tables_off), (size_t)n);
        } else {  /* file data: find the last file starting at or before this offset */
            uint64_t rel = offset - DATA_START;
            int lo = 0, hi = nfiles;
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
                if (files[mid]->data_off <= rel) lo = mid + 1;
                else hi = mid;
            }
            const File *f = lo ? files[lo - 1] : NULL;
            uint64_t next = lo < nfiles ? DATA_START + files[lo]->data_off : tables_off;
            if (f && rel < f->data_off + f->size) {
                /* YW4_TRACE_ROMFS=1: name each file at its first read; =2: every read, with
                 * its offset in the file (to find entries inside CPK archives) */
                static int trace = -1;
                if (trace < 0) trace = getenv("YW4_TRACE_ROMFS") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_TRACE_ROMFS")) : 0;
                if (trace == 2) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: romfs: read %s +%#" PRIx64 " %#" PRIx64 "\n", f->path, rel - f->data_off,
                            size);
                } else if (trace && !((File *)f)->read_before) {
                    ((File *)f)->read_before = 1;
                    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: romfs: read %s (%" PRIu64 " bytes)\n", f->path, f->size);
                }
                uint64_t left = f->data_off + f->size - rel;
                n = left < size ? left : size;
                if (read_file_part(f, rel - f->data_off, out, n)) return -1;
            } else {  /* alignment padding between files */
                n = next - offset < size ? next - offset : size;
                memset(out, 0, (size_t)n);
            }
        }
        out += n, offset += n, size -= n;
    }
    return 0;
}

int romfs_read(uint64_t offset, void *out, uint64_t size) { return romfs_image_read(&game, offset, out, size); }
```

`runtime/src/romfs.h`:

```h
/* A RomFS image of a folder, built in memory at start-up (decision 0014).
 *
 * The game reads its data as one raw RomFS image (fsp-srv OpenDataStorageByCurrentProcess)
 * and the sdk parses the RomFS tables itself. The owner has an extracted romfs/ folder, so
 * the runtime builds the tables from it and serves reads from the file-data area straight
 * from the files on disk: no 8.5 GB second copy. Mods (YW4_MODS, default work/mods) are laid
 * over it in the same build, as LayeredFS does on a Switch (decision 0043). */
#ifndef ROMFS_H
#define ROMFS_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/* Builds the image of `dir`; returns 0, or prints why not and returns -1. */
int romfs_open(const char *dir);
uint64_t romfs_size(void);
/* Reads [offset, offset + size) of the image; returns 0, or -1 on a host read error. */
int romfs_read(uint64_t offset, void *out, uint64_t size);
/* The file on disk that serves `path` in the game's image (e.g. "data/common/text/ja/chara_text.cfg.bin"), mods
 * laid over; NULL if the image has no such loose file (a file inside a .cpk isn't one). */
const char *romfs_host_path(const char *path);

/* yw4 --mod-clashes <romfs>, for the launcher: every pair of mods in YW4_MODS (on or off) that can't both have their
 * way with one file, as "clash\t<file>\t<mod>\t<mod>" lines on `out` (decision 0068). Returns 0, or 1. */
#include <stdio.h>
int romfs_mod_clashes(const char *dir, FILE *out);

/* Another image built the same way, without mods: an add-on's RomFS (fsp-srv OpenDataStorageByDataId, decision
 * 0056). NULL if `dir` can't be read. */
typedef struct RomfsImage RomfsImage;
RomfsImage *romfs_image_open(const char *dir);
uint64_t romfs_image_size(const RomfsImage *m);
int romfs_image_read(RomfsImage *m, uint64_t offset, void *out, uint64_t size);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/run.c`:

```c
/* Running modes (issue #18): run without holding B, by a toggle or always, with B left to the game.
 *
 * How the game runs (traced 2026-11-17 with YW4_WATCHW; work/re): the field's player controller, main+0x1fe950
 * (x0 = the controller, one object, called once a frame), sets "run this frame" (ctrl+0x5d) when B's hold time
 * (ctrl+0x54, growing by dt while B is down) reaches a threshold from the game's config, OR while a carry-on timer
 * (ctrl+0x58, counted down by dt every frame, refilled when B is let go) is above zero. A tap of B jumps through its
 * own path. "Run" then goes cmd+0xa9 -> action+0x234 -> action+0x614 == 2 -> the run speed (9.0 against 6.55).
 *
 * Here a hook runs before the controller: while running is wanted and the real B is up, it sets the controller up
 * as if B had been held past the threshold, the path that runs in any action state (the carry-on timer alone is
 * cleared outside the "moving" state, 7, and dropped out on a walk with turns; tested 2026-11-17). The controller
 * clears both values itself at the end of the frame. While the real B is down the hook stays out, so the game's
 * own hold and tap, and the jump, are untouched. To walk at once in ALWAYS, the carry-on timer is cleared while
 * the Run key is held.
 *
 * The modes (the Controls page's RUNNING row; YW4_RUN_MODE=0/1/2/3; owner, 2026-11-18), with one Run input (Left
 * Shift on the keyboard; the left stick press on a pad, shared there with Close hints, no button being free):
 *   DEFAULT  the game's: B holds to run, taps to jump. The Run input does nothing.
 *   ALWAYS   always run; hold Run to walk.
 *   TOGGLE   Run switches running on and off. Off again when a battle starts.
 *   HOLD     hold Run to run. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "battle.h"
#include "bindings.h"
#include "discord_game.h"
#include "run.h"
#include "yw4load.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

static int mode = -1;

/* B is down, as the game's input object has it for this frame (pointer at main+0x14d1008; +0x8 the held buttons in
 * the game's bits, B = 0x4000, mapped from the Switch's by the table at main+0x12bdfb0). */
static int b_down(uint64_t base) {
    uint64_t input = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(base + 0x14d1008);
    return input && (*(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(input + 0x8) & 0x4000u) != 0;
}

int run_mode(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (m < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_RUN_MODE");
        m = e && *e ? atoi(e) : RUN_DEFAULT;
        if (m < 0 || m >= RUN_MODES) m = RUN_DEFAULT;
        __atomic_store_n(&mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return m;
}
void run_mode_set(int m) {
    if (m < 0 || m >= RUN_MODES) m = RUN_DEFAULT;
    __atomic_store_n(&mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}
const char *run_mode_name(int m) {
    static const char *const names[RUN_MODES] = {"DEFAULT", "ALWAYS", "TOGGLE", "HOLD"};
    return m >= 0 && m < RUN_MODES ? names[m] : names[0];
}
const char *run_mode_save(int m) {
    static const char *const values[RUN_MODES] = {"0", "1", "2", "3"};
    return m >= 0 && m < RUN_MODES ? values[m] : values[0];
}

/* YW4_RUN_KEY_TEST=<from>-<to>[,<from>-<to>...]: tests, Run held between those presented frames (a replay
 * feeds the Switch's buttons, not keys, so it can't hold the key itself). */
extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */
static int key_test(void) {
    enum { MAX = 8 };
    static int read, n;
    static unsigned long long from[MAX], to[MAX];
    if (!read) {
        read = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_RUN_KEY_TEST");
        for (int used; e && *e && n < MAX && sscanf(e, "%llu-%llu%n", &from[n], &to[n], &used) == 2; n++) {
            e += used;
            if (*e == ',') e++;
        }
    }
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (f >= from[i] && f <= to[i]) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* YW4_RUN_LOG=1: every 30th call, what the hook saw and did, and the controller's values after the game's code. */
static int log_on(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("YW4_RUN_LOG") && *getenv("YW4_RUN_LOG") != '0';
    return on;
}
static int hook_inner(CPUState *ctx);
static _Thread_local int in_original;
int yw4_hook_player_run(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (in_original) return 0;
    discord_game_field_frame(ctx);  /* the area and Watch Rank for Discord (decision 0077); nothing while it's off */
    if (!log_on()) return hook_inner(ctx);
    static long calls;
    uint64_t ctrl = ctx->x[0], base = *yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].base;
    float hold0 = *(const float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x54), carry0 = *(const float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x58);
    hook_inner(ctx);
    float hold1 = *(const float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x54);
    uint8_t held5c = *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x5c);
    static GuestFn original;
    if (!original) original = yw4_lookup(base + 0x1fe950);
    if (!original) return 0;
    in_original = 1;
    original(ctx);
    in_original = 0;
    if (calls++ % 30 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: run: frame %llu mode %d key %d B %d threshold %g | before: hold %g carry %g | set: hold %g "
                "5c %u | after the game: ran %u hold %g carry %g\n",
                (unsigned long long)__atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), run_mode(),
                bindings_run_held() || key_test(), b_down(base),
                (double)*(const float *)(uintptr_t)(base + 0x1531390), (double)hold0, (double)carry0, (double)hold1,
                held5c, *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x5d), (double)*(const float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x54),
                (double)*(const float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x58));
    return 1;
}

/* Runs first, then the game's controller (returns 0). */
static int hook_inner(CPUState *ctx) {
    static int toggled, was_held;
    int m = run_mode(), held = bindings_run_held() || key_test();
    if (battle_active()) {  /* not the field's controller's business; a toggle ends with the battle */
        toggled = 0, was_held = held;
        return 0;
    }
    if (m == RUN_TOGGLE && held && !was_held) toggled = !toggled;
    if (m != RUN_TOGGLE) toggled = 0;
    was_held = held;
    int run = m == RUN_ALWAYS ? !held : m == RUN_TOGGLE ? toggled : m == RUN_HOLD ? held : 0;
    uint64_t ctrl = ctx->x[0], base = *yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].base;
    /* the frame B goes up the game judges the press by its hold time (a tap jumps): that frame stays the game's too,
     * or the fake hold below would turn every tap into a long hold (no jump; tested 2026-11-17) */
    static int b_was_down, was_run;
    int b_now = b_down(base), b_released = b_was_down && !b_now;
    b_was_down = b_now;
    /* running switched off (TOGGLE off, Run let go in HOLD): the carry-on timer the game set at the end of
     * the last faked frame (about 0.55 s, as after a long B hold) is cleared, so the walk starts at once (owner,
     * 2026-11-17: "faster"). A real B hold still carries on as the game does. */
    int stopped = was_run && !run;
    was_run = run;
    if (run && !b_now && !b_released) {
        /* as if B had been held long enough: B down last frame (ctrl+0x5c, so the hold time isn't cleared) and the
         * hold time (ctrl+0x54) at the run threshold, which runs in any action state. The controller itself puts
         * both back to 0 at the end of the frame, B being up. While the real B is down this stays out: the game
         * sees its own press from a hold time of 0, so a tap still jumps. */
        /* the game's check is "greater than" (b.gt), so a little over: the threshold alone never ran (2026-11-17) */
        float over = *(const float *)(uintptr_t)(base + 0x1531390) + 0.05f;
        float *hold = (float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x54);
        *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x5c) = 1;
        if (!(*hold >= over)) *hold = over;
    } else if (!run && !b_now && (stopped || m == RUN_ALWAYS)) {
        /* walking now: the carry-on timer the game left from the "long hold" above (ctrl+0x58) cleared */
        *(float *)(uintptr_t)(ctrl + 0x58) = 0.0f;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

```c
/* Save data on the host: IFileSystem and IFile over a folder (Switchbrew "Filesystem_services").
 *
 * Each save is a folder <save dir>/<program id>/<user id>/. Paths the game sends are
 * Switch paths ("/data/save.bin", at most 0x300 bytes); ".." and backslashes are refused,
 * so nothing outside the save folder can be reached.
 *
 * Simplification: the Switch journals save data, so writes only become permanent at
 * Commit; here they go to the file at once and Commit does nothing. A crash in the middle
 * of a save can therefore leave a half-written file that the Switch would have discarded.
 */
#include <errno.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <time.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#include <io.h>
#define mkdir_one(p) _mkdir(p)
#define rmdir_one(p) _rmdir(p)
#define truncate_file(f, n) _chsize_s(_fileno(f), (long long)(n))
#else
#include <unistd.h>
#define mkdir_one(p) mkdir(p, 0755)
#define rmdir_one(p) rmdir(p)
#define truncate_file(f, n) ftruncate(fileno(f), (off_t)(n))
#endif

#include "gamemenu.h"

/* PoC switch for save-slot research (when YW4_DIARY_SLOTS=0). */
static int save_slot_test(void) {
    static int cached = -1;
    int c = __atomic_load_n(&cached, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (c < 0) {
        const char *v = getenv("YW4_SAVE_SLOT_TEST");
        c = (v && v[0] && strcmp(v, "0") != 0) ? 1 : 0;
        __atomic_store_n(&cached, c, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    return c;
}

/* 10-slot Diary & Autosave system: enabled by default; set YW4_DIARY_SLOTS=0 for vanilla 1-slot behavior. */
static int diary_slots_enabled(void) {
    static int cached = -1;
    int c = __atomic_load_n(&cached, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (c < 0) {
        const char *v = getenv("YW4_DIARY_SLOTS");
        c = (v && strcmp(v, "0") == 0) ? 0 : 1;
        __atomic_store_n(&cached, c, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    return c;
}

#define DIARY_SLOT_COUNT 5  /* the Diary's slots (owner, 2026-11-17: five, then one Autosave row under them) */
#define DIARY_OF "/5"      /* the labels' "<n>/5" */
#define HDR_REC_SIZE 0xA0u

typedef struct {
    uint8_t raw[HDR_REC_SIZE];
    uint8_t valid;
} DiarySlotRow;

static HostLock slot_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static void set_active_slot(int val) {
    __atomic_store_n(&active_slot, val, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}
static int diary_slot;             /* slot (0..9) currently shown in the Diary menu */
static int diary_opened_once;
/* the armed row's label: no button named, it is X, Tab, the X key or Square by device (owner, 2026-11-17) */
#define DELETE_LABEL "Press again to delete"

static uint64_t diary_seen_ms;     /* host ms of the Diary's last update: savefs_diary_open, for the mouse */
/* A slot a New Game was started over (yw4_hook_save_clear): its old files stay on disk until the new game's first
 * save, but it reads as empty until then, so no save writes the old game's rows back into its HEADERSAVE. -1 none. */
static int fresh_slot = -1;
static int new_game_slot_set;  /* this new game's slot is chosen (savefs_new_game_naming) */
static int title_loaded_save;  /* since the title last opened, a save was loaded (so no new game is starting) */
static int input_cooldown;

/* Stacked rows (owner, 2026-11-17: "the save slots stack, not Left / Right"): when the menu's data has six copies of
 * the row layer (diary_load_slot; the menu setting's count, a row bone for each in save00_06), copy k shows slot k+1
 * and the last copy the Autosave. The game's own row code fills each copy: it reads its row data at
 * menu + 0x210 + j * 0x288 (j 0 a save row, 1 the Autosave row) and finds the copy by f_9f3e90(menu, layer, j); for a
 * paint pass that lookup is sent to copy k (yw4_hook_menu_layer). Without the six copies the Diary pages as before. */
#define DIARY_ROWS (DIARY_SLOT_COUNT + 1)
#define SLOT_LAYER 0xd14f93d6u  /* crc32("diary_load_slot") */
static int rows_on;             /* (declared above) this Diary has the stacked rows (diary_paint_rows found copy DIARY_ROWS - 1) */
```
