`runtime/src/setjmp.c`:

```c
/* setjmp and longjmp in recompiled code (decision 0018).
 *
 * The guest's setjmp saves the callee-saved registers, sp and the return address; its
 * longjmp restores them and branches to that return address. Recompiled code has no
 * function there: the return address is the middle of the function that called setjmp.
 *
 * So the translator turns each call to setjmp into a host setjmp in the calling
 * function's own C frame, registered here under (return address, guest sp). The guest
 * longjmp's final indirect branch misses in yw4_resolve, which asks yw4_setjmp_resume; a
 * registered point is jumped to with longjmp, which lands in that frame right after the
 * setjmp call. The guest registers are already the restored ones.
 *
 * The C library's setjmp/longjmp, not GCC/Clang's __builtin_ ones: on Windows x64 Clang's
 * __builtin_setjmp saves the canonical frame address but code addresses locals through rbp,
 * which sits above it in frames bigger than 128 bytes (rbp = rsp + 0x80 in f_d2cde0), so
 * after __builtin_longjmp locals were read from the wrong place. The CRT's longjmp unwinds
 * properly (Windows: RtlUnwind over the unwind data Clang emits for every function).
 *
 * Points are per thread, ordered outermost first (decreasing guest sp: the stack grows
 * down). Registering at sp S drops points deeper than S, since those frames must have
 * returned. A longjmp to a frame that has returned is undefined in C too.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "yw4load.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

#define MAX_POINTS 256

typedef struct {
    uint64_t ret, sp;
    jmp_buf *jb;
} Point;

static _Thread_local Point points[MAX_POINTS];
static _Thread_local int npoints;
static _Thread_local CPUState *thread_ctx;

void yw4_setjmp_register(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t ret, jmp_buf jb) {
    uint64_t sp = ctx->sp;
    thread_ctx = ctx;
    while (npoints && points[npoints - 1].sp < sp) npoints--;
    for (int i = npoints - 1; i >= 0 && points[i].sp == sp; i--)
        if (points[i].ret == ret) {  /* the same call site in the same frame, again */
            points[i].jb = (jmp_buf *)jb;
            npoints = i + 1;
            return;
        }
    if (npoints == MAX_POINTS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: more than %d nested setjmp points on one thread\n", MAX_POINTS);
        yw4_stop();
    }
    points[npoints++] = (Point){ret, sp, (jmp_buf *)jb};
}

/* Diagnostic: a longjmp in this game is Lua's luaD_throw. The protected call that catches
 * it keeps its lua_State in a callee-saved register (restored by the longjmp), and the
 * error message is the value on top of that state's stack. Lua 5.2, 64-bit: lua_State.top
 * at +0x10; a TValue is {value, int tt} (16 bytes); a string has tt 0x44 (short) or 0x54
 * (long) and its characters at +0x18. Prints the message if a register looks like that. */
static int guest_ok(uint64_t a) { return a >= YW4_GUEST_LO && a < YW4_GUEST_HI && !(a & 7); }

static void lua_error_message(const CPUState *ctx) {
    /* luaD_rawrunprotected keeps L in its frame, and L->errorJmp (+0x70) still points into
     * that frame when the throw arrives: look for such a word in the frame. */
    for (uint64_t at = ctx->sp; at < ctx->sp + 0x200; at += 8) {
        uint64_t L = *(const uint64_t *)GPTR(at);
        if (!guest_ok(L) || !guest_ok(L + 0x70)) continue;
        uint64_t ej = *(const uint64_t *)GPTR(L + 0x70);
        if (ej < ctx->sp || ej >= ctx->sp + 0x200) continue;
        /* lua_longjmp {previous; jmp_buf; int status}: status at +0x140 in this build.
         * 1 LUA_YIELD (a coroutine yielding from C: normal), 2 run, 3 syntax, 4 memory, 6 error handler */
        int status = *(const int32_t *)GPTR(ej + 0x140);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4:   Lua throw status %d\n", status);
        if (status == 1) return;
        uint64_t top = *(const uint64_t *)GPTR(L + 0x10);
        if (!guest_ok(top) || !guest_ok(top - 16)) continue;
        uint64_t ts = *(const uint64_t *)GPTR(top - 16);
        uint32_t tt = *(const uint32_t *)GPTR(top - 8);
        if ((tt != 0x44 && tt != 0x54) || !guest_ok(ts)) continue;
        uint64_t len = *(const uint64_t *)GPTR(ts + 0x10);
        if (len > 400) len = 400;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4:   Lua error (lua_State %#llx): %.*s\n", (unsigned long long)L, (int)len,
                (const char *)GPTR(ts + 0x18));
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4:   (no Lua error message found)\n");
}

void yw4_setjmp_resume(uint64_t target) {
    if (!thread_ctx) return;
    for (int i = npoints - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        if (points[i].ret == target && points[i].sp == thread_ctx->sp) {
            /* YW4_TRACE_LONGJMP=1: report longjmps (in this game, Lua's luaD_throw: errors,
             * and coroutine yields from C) with the Lua status and error message */
            static int trace = -1;
            if (trace < 0) trace = getenv("YW4_TRACE_LONGJMP") && *getenv("YW4_TRACE_LONGJMP") != '0';
            static long count;
            char where[48];
            if (trace && (count++ < 20 || count % 1000 == 0)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: longjmp #%ld to %s\n", count, yw4_describe(target, where));
                lua_error_message(thread_ctx);
            }
            npoints = i + 1;  /* the frames below are being left */
            longjmp(*points[i].jb, 1);
        }
}
```

```c
/* The settings panel's list (settings.h): each row reads its setting's current option and steps it with
 * the setting's own cycle function, so the panel and the replays' keys always agree. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL_filesystem.h>

#include "events.h"
#include "bindings.h"
#include "framerate.h"

const char *shadow_mode_name(void);

typedef struct {
    const char *category, *name, *help;
    const char *options[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];
    const char *notes[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];
    int noptions;
    int (*current)(void);  /* index into options */
    void (*next)(void);    /* one step forward, wrapping */
    const char *env;       /* the environment variable it starts from, and its value per option */
    const char *values[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];
    const char *(*disabled)(void);  /* NULL, or why it can't be used now (greyed out) */
    /* a slider (noptions 0): get/set the value, lo..hi in steps; 0 below lo is AUTO (auto_note says what it does) */
    float (*get)(void);
    void (*set)(float);
    float lo, hi, step;
    const char *auto_note;
    int percent;  /* a slider of 0..1 shown in percent: no AUTO, 0 is a value like any other (auto_note: what it does) */
    float (*parse)(const char *);  /* a slider's saved value as get() returns it (YW4_SET_AT); NULL: atof */
    /* a slider's names for the points along it, evenly spread from end to end (SHARPENING: OFF .. MAX at 0, 25, 50,
     * 75, 100%): the overlay marks them on the track, and the nearest one's name is shown instead of a number */
    const char *marks[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];
} Setting;

/* A slider's value as shown and as saved. */
static void slider_text(const Setting *s, char *shown, size_t n1, char *saved, size_t n2) {
    float v = s->get();
    if (s->percent && s->marks[0]) {  /* named points (SHARPENING): the nearest one's name is all that shows */
        int n = 0;
        while (n < SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS && s->marks[n]) n++;
        float f = (v - s->lo) / (s->hi - s->lo);
        int k = (int)(f * (float)(n - 1) + 0.5f);
        if (shown) snprintf(shown, n1, "%s", s->marks[k < 0 ? 0 : k > n - 1 ? n - 1 : k]);
        if (saved) snprintf(saved, n2, "%.2f", v);
    } else if (s->percent) {
        if (shown) snprintf(shown, n1, "%d%%", (int)(v * 100 + 0.5f));
        if (saved) snprintf(saved, n2, "%.2f", v);
    } else if (v <= 0) {
        if (shown) snprintf(shown, n1, "AUTO");
        if (saved) snprintf(saved, n2, "auto");
    } else {
        if (shown) snprintf(shown, n1, "%.2fX", v);
        if (saved) snprintf(saved, n2, "%.2f", v);
    }
}
static void slider_step(const Setting *s, int dir) {
    float v = s->get();
    if (s->percent) {
        v = (float)(int)((v + dir * s->step) / s->step + 0.5f) * s->step;  /* on the steps */
        s->set(v < s->lo ? s->lo : v > s->hi ? s->hi : v);
        return;
    }
    if (v <= 0) v = dir > 0 ? s->lo : 0;
    else {
        v += dir * s->step;
        v = (float)(int)(v / s->step + 0.5f) * s->step;  /* on the steps */
        if (v < s->lo - s->step * 0.5f) v = 0;          /* below the lowest: AUTO */
        if (v > s->hi) v = s->hi;
    }
    s->set(v);
}

static int res_index(void) {
    int h = gpu_res_choice();  /* the choice (the images follow it a few frames later) */
    return h == 1080 ? 1 : h == 1440 ? 2 : h == 2160 ? 3 : 0;
}
static int aniso_index(void) {
    int a = gpu_aniso();
    return a == 2 ? 1 : a == 4 ? 2 : a == 8 ? 3 : a == 16 ? 4 : 0;
}
static int dof_index(void) { return 2 - gpu_dof(); }  /* 2 the game's, 1 half, 0 off */
static int shadow_res_index(void) {
    int r = gpu_shadow_res();
    return r == 2048 ? 1 : r == 4096 ? 2 : 0;
}
static int pcss_index(void) { return gpu_pcss_level() & 3; }
/* shadow_pass_ours, not shadow_mode_name: the mode is set only when the first shadows are drawn, and before that
 * the name said ORIGINAL, so the row showed GAME and a save then (the first start's, at boot) wrote
 * YW4_SHADOWS=game: every new install got the game's shadow pass, not ours (found 2026-11-16) */
static int shadow_pass_index(void) { return shadow_pass_ours(); }
static int gbuffer_index(void) { return gbuffer_native(); }
static int bloom_index(void) { return bloom_native(); }
static int shadow_mask_index(void) { return shadow_mask_native(); }

static int blur_fast_index(void) { return blur_fast(); }

    if (!shadow_mask_native()) return "NEEDS SHADOW MASK SET TO CUSTOM";
    return gpu_pcss_level() ? NULL : "NEEDS SOFT SHADOWS";
}
static const char *contact_disabled(void) { return shadow_mask_native() ? NULL : "NEEDS SHADOW MASK SET TO CUSTOM"; }
/* Why a row is locked when AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS are not in the program. On Windows the builder left them out
 * (recomp.build --no-fsr / --no-dlss). On Linux what isn't there can't be built in yet, and "not in this build" read
 * like something had gone wrong (owner, 2026-11-12). Linux has DLSS and FSR upscaling and FSR frame generation (decision
 * 0073), but not NVIDIA's frame generation or Reflex: those come through Streamline, which is Windows only. */
#ifdef _WIN32
#define NOT_BUILT "NOT IN THIS BUILD"
#define NO_STREAMLINE 0
#else
#define NOT_BUILT "NOT SUPPORTED ON LINUX YET"
#define NO_STREAMLINE 1
#endif
static int reflex_index(void) { return dlssg_reflex(); }  /* what runs: on while DLSS frame generation is */
static const char *reflex_disabled(void) {
    if (NO_STREAMLINE || !gpu_dlss_built()) return NOT_BUILT;
    if (!dlssg_reflex_available()) return "NEEDS AN NVIDIA GPU";
    /* locked on, not off: the panels show a reason starting "ALWAYS ON" without their "Off for now" */
    return gpu_fg() == 2 && dlssg_available() ? "ALWAYS ON WITH DLSS FRAME GENERATION. NVIDIA REQUIRES IT" : NULL;
}
static const char *fg_disabled(void) {
    if (!gpu_fsr_built() && (NO_STREAMLINE || !gpu_dlss_built())) return NOT_BUILT;
    if (!gpu_fsr_built() && !dlssg_available()) return "NOT SUPPORTED ON THIS GPU";
    return gpu_aa() >= 3 ? NULL : (gpu_dlss_available() ? "NEEDS ANTI-ALIASING SET TO TAA, FSR OR DLSS"
                                                        : "NEEDS ANTI-ALIASING SET TO TAA OR FSR");
}
static const char *sharpen_ui_disabled(void) { return gpu_sharpen() ? NULL : "NEEDS SHARPENING"; }

    if (!gpu_fsr_built() && !gpu_dlss_built()) return NOT_BUILT;
    if (!gpu_fsr_built() && !gpu_dlss_available()) return "NEEDS AN NVIDIA RTX GPU FOR DLSS";

}

enum { NPLAYER = sizeof player / sizeof *player, NDEVELOPER = sizeof developer / sizeof *developer,
       NCHEATS = sizeof cheats / sizeof *cheats, NSETTINGS = NPLAYER + NDEVELOPER + NCHEATS, LINK_ROW = NPLAYER };

/* Every setting, both pages and the cheats: for the settings file. */
static const Setting *setting(int i) {
    return i < NPLAYER ? &player[i] : i < NPLAYER + NDEVELOPER ? &developer[i - NPLAYER] : &cheats[i - NPLAYER - NDEVELOPER];
}

static const char *const link_help =
    "SWITCHES FOR TESTING THE PORT: WHO DRAWS EACH PART OF THE PICTURE, THE GAME OR OUR OWN RENDERER, AND "
    "SPEED-UPS THAT LOOK THE SAME. THE PICTURE DOESN'T CHANGE; THE DEFAULTS ARE THE RECOMMENDED ONES.";

static int panel_open, page, developer_page, selected[2];  /* selected: on the player's page, the developer page */

/* ---- the settings file: YW4_SETTINGS_FILE, or settings.ini next to the executable; "none": no file */

static char file_path[1024];

static const char *settings_file(void);
const char *settings_file_name(void) { return settings_file(); }

static const char *settings_file(void) {
    if (!file_path[0]) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_SETTINGS_FILE");
        if (e && (!*e || !strcmp(e, "none"))) return "";
        const char *base = e ? "" : SDL_GetBasePath();
        snprintf(file_path, sizeof file_path, "%s%s", base ? base : "", e ? e : "settings.ini");
    }
    return file_path;
}

static void set_env(const char *name, const char *value) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _putenv_s(name, value);
#else
    setenv(name, value, 0);
#endif
}

/* Graphics not picked yet: a settings file is in use (not YW4_SETTINGS_FILE=none) but doesn't exist, or exists
 * without a YW4_SHADOW_RES line. The game's own save writes every setting, so only a file someone else started has
 * none: the launcher writes YW4_WINDOW (Full screen at start) and the cheats into settings.ini, and a player who
 * flipped one before the first start used to skip this and got the high defaults on any GPU (issue #14: an Intel
 * HD 520, device lost in the first cutscene). settings_first_run then picks the graphics for the GPU once and writes
 * the file, keeping the lines that were there. */
static int first_run;

/* Lines a player adds to settings.ini by hand when a bug report asks for them (no panel row): read like the panel's,
 * and written back as they were, so the game's own saves don't drop them. YW4_PERF=1: the per-frame performance CSV
 * (perf.c; owner, 2026-11-16: "we are asking them", so a line in the file is enough). */
static const char *const by_hand[] = {"YW4_PERF"};
enum { BY_HAND = sizeof by_hand / sizeof *by_hand };
static char by_hand_value[BY_HAND][64];

void settings_load(void) {
    const char *path = settings_file();
    FILE *f = *path ? fopen(path, "r") : NULL;
    if (!f) {
        first_run = *path != 0;
        return;
    }
    char line[256];
    int n = 0, graphics = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        char *eq = strchr(line, '=');
        if (line[0] == '#' || !eq) continue;
        *eq = 0;
        if (!strcmp(line, "YW4_SHADOW_RES")) graphics = 1;
        char *value = eq + 1;
        value[strcspn(value, "\r\n")] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < NSETTINGS; i++)  /* only the panel's settings, and never over the environment */
            if (!strcmp(line, setting(i)->env) && !getenv(line)) set_env(line, value), n++;
        n += bindings_load_line(line, value);
        if ((!strcmp(line, "YW4_THEME") || !strcmp(line, "YW4_WINDOW_SIZE") || !strcmp(line, "YW4_KEYBOARD")) &&
            !getenv(line))
            set_env(line, value), n++;
        for (int i = 0; i < BY_HAND; i++)
            if (!strcmp(line, by_hand[i])) {
                snprintf(by_hand_value[i], sizeof by_hand_value[i], "%s", value);
                const char *now = getenv(line);  /* set but empty counts as not set (set_env doesn't replace it) */
                if (!now || !*now) {
#ifdef _WIN32
                    _putenv_s(line, value);
#else
                    setenv(line, value, 1);
#endif
                    n++;
                }
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: settings: %s=%s (added by hand)\n", line, value);
            }
    }
    fclose(f);
    first_run = !graphics;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: settings: %d from %s%s\n", n, path, graphics ? "" : " (graphics not picked yet)");
}

void settings_save(void) {
    const char *path = settings_file();
    FILE *f = *path ? fopen(path, "w") : NULL;
    if (!f) return;
    fprintf(f, "# The settings panel's choices (F1), written when one changes. An environment variable of the same\n"
               "# name wins over its line here.\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < NSETTINGS; i++) {
        const Setting *t = setting(i);
        if (!t->noptions) {
            char v[16];
            slider_text(t, NULL, 0, v, sizeof v);
            fprintf(f, "%s=%s\n", t->env, v);
            continue;
        }
        int c = t->current();
        if (c >= 0 && c < t->noptions) fprintf(f, "%s=%s\n", t->env, t->values[c]);
    }
    /* the performance HUD (F3, the in-game overlay's Performance page) */
    fprintf(f, "YW4_HUD=%d\nYW4_HUD_CORNER=%d\nYW4_HUD_PARTS=%u\n", window_hud_mode(), window_hud_corner(),
            window_hud_parts());
    fprintf(f, "YW4_THEME=%s\n", theme_id());  /* the overlay's Look > Theme (theme.h) */
    int ww, wh;
    window_size_kept(&ww, &wh);  /* the size the player left the window at (window.c) */
    if (ww && wh) fprintf(f, "YW4_WINDOW_SIZE=%dx%d\n", ww, wh);
    const char *kb = getenv("YW4_KEYBOARD");  /* the name keyboard's last language (gamemenu.c) */
    if (kb && *kb) fprintf(f, "YW4_KEYBOARD=%s\n", kb);
    for (int i = 0; i < BY_HAND; i++)  /* the lines added by hand, as they were */
        if (by_hand_value[i][0]) fprintf(f, "%s=%s\n", by_hand[i], by_hand_value[i]);
    bindings_save(f);
    fclose(f);
}

int settings_open(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&panel_open, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void settings_toggle(void) {
    bindings_cancel();
    developer_page = 0;
    __atomic_store_n(&panel_open, !settings_open(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

int settings_page(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&page, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void settings_show(int p) {
    bindings_cancel();
    if (settings_open() && settings_page() == p) {
        developer_page = 0;
        __atomic_store_n(&panel_open, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return;
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&page, p, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&panel_open, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static void setting_step(const Setting *s, int dir) {
    if (!s->noptions) {
        slider_step(s, dir > 0 ? 1 : -1);
        return;
    }
    /* anti-aliasing and frame generation skip what this GPU or build can't run, and every change starts a real
     * switch (frame generation's safe frames): they step back themselves, so a step back is one switch */
    if (s->next == gpu_aa_cycle) { gpu_aa_step(dir > 0 ? 1 : -1); return; }
    if (s->next == gpu_fg_cycle) { gpu_fg_step(dir > 0 ? 1 : -1); return; }
    if (dir > 0) { s->next(); return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < s->noptions - 1; i++) s->next();  /* one step back: the other cycles go forward only */
}

void settings_action(int action) {
    if (action == SETTINGS_PAGE) {
        bindings_cancel();
        __atomic_store_n(&page, !settings_page(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return;
    }
    if (action == SETTINGS_CLOSE) {
        bindings_cancel();
        if (!settings_page() && developer_page) {  /* Escape or B on the developer page: back */
            developer_page = 0;
            return;
        }
        __atomic_store_n(&panel_open, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return;
    }
    if (settings_page()) {
        bindings_action(action);
        return;
    }
    /* the player's page has one row more than its settings: DEVELOPER OPTIONS */
    int *sel = &selected[developer_page], nrows = developer_page ? NDEVELOPER : NPLAYER + 1;
    if (!developer_page && *sel == LINK_ROW && (action == SETTINGS_ACCEPT || action == SETTINGS_RIGHT)) {
        developer_page = 1;
        return;
    }
    if (action == SETTINGS_UP || action == SETTINGS_DOWN) {
        *sel = (*sel + (action == SETTINGS_UP ? nrows - 1 : 1)) % nrows;
        return;
    }
    if (!developer_page && *sel == LINK_ROW) return;
    const Setting *s = developer_page ? &developer[*sel] : &player[*sel];
    if ((action == SETTINGS_LEFT || action == SETTINGS_RIGHT) && s->disabled && s->disabled()) return;  /* greyed out */
    switch (action) {
    case SETTINGS_RIGHT: setting_step(s, 1), settings_save(); break;
    case SETTINGS_LEFT:  setting_step(s, -1), settings_save(); break;
    }
}

int settings_developer(void) { return developer_page; }

static int fill_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max, const Setting *list, int count) {
    int n = count < max ? count : max;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        memset(&rows[i], 0, sizeof rows[i]);
        rows[i].category = list[i].category, rows[i].name = list[i].name, rows[i].help = list[i].help;
        memcpy(rows[i].options, list[i].options, sizeof rows[i].options);
        memcpy(rows[i].notes, list[i].notes, sizeof rows[i].notes);
        rows[i].noptions = list[i].noptions;
        /* leave out options this GPU or build can't run, only from the end of the list (FSR, then DLSS): an
         * option in the middle stays listed, as the row's index is the mode (the cycle skips it) */
        if (list[i].next == gpu_aa_cycle || list[i].next == gpu_fg_cycle) {
            int aa = list[i].next == gpu_aa_cycle;
            int dlss_ok = gpu_dlss_built() && (aa ? gpu_dlss_available() : dlssg_available());
            if (!dlss_ok) {
                rows[i].noptions = aa ? 5 : 2;                     /* DLSS is last */
                if (!gpu_fsr_built()) rows[i].noptions = aa ? 4 : 1;  /* and FSR before it */
            }
        }
        if (!list[i].noptions) {  /* a slider: its text, its position, and one note for the description */
            float v = list[i].get();
            rows[i].slider = 1;
            rows[i].frac = v <= 0 ? 0.0f : (v - list[i].lo) / (list[i].hi - list[i].lo);
            slider_text(&list[i], rows[i].value, sizeof rows[i].value, NULL, 0);
            rows[i].options[0] = rows[i].value;
            rows[i].notes[0] = v <= 0 ? list[i].auto_note : "";
            rows[i].current = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS && list[i].marks[k]; k++) rows[i].marks[rows[i].nmarks++] = list[i].marks[k];
        } else {
            rows[i].current = list[i].current();
        }
        rows[i].disabled = list[i].disabled ? list[i].disabled() : NULL;
    }
    return n;
}

int settings_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max, int *sel) {
    int n = fill_rows(rows, max, developer_page ? developer : player, developer_page ? NDEVELOPER : NPLAYER);
    if (!developer_page && n < max) {
        memset(&rows[n], 0, sizeof rows[n]);
        rows[n].category = "ADVANCED", rows[n].name = "DEVELOPER OPTIONS", rows[n].help = link_help;
        rows[n++].link = 1;
    }
    *sel = selected[developer_page];
    return n;
}

/* The in-game overlay's settings page (gamemenu.c): the player's settings, without the developer page's link, and
 * changing one of them by row (as Left / Right on it), whatever the panel shows. */
static int hud_slider_row(const Setting *s) { return s->get == hud_scale_get || s->get == hud_opacity_get; }

/* The HUD's sliders live on the overlay's Overlay page, next to their preview, so its Settings page leaves them out
 * (the old panel keeps them). */
/* The overlay's Look > Theme row (theme.h): after the player's settings, before Advanced, overlay only (the old panel's pixel font has no lower
 * case for the names); its value one theme's name, Left / Right step through them. */
static int theme_row(void) {
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NPLAYER; i++) n += !hud_slider_row(&player[i]);
    return n;
}

static void fill_theme_row(SettingRow *r) {
    static char note[32];
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    r->category = "LOOK", r->name = "THEME", r->verbatim = 1;
    r->help = "THE COLOURS OF THIS MENU AND THE PERFORMANCE HUD: THE SAME THEMES AS THE LAUNCHER'S.";
    snprintf(note, sizeof note, "%d / %d", theme_index() + 1, theme_count());
    r->options[0] = theme_name(theme_index()), r->notes[0] = note, r->noptions = 1, r->current = 0;
}

/* The overlay's rows: the player's settings (General first, then the graphics sections), Look > Theme, then the
 * developer page's settings as ADVANCED (owner, 2026-11-11: the renderer switches and speed-ups were only on the old
 * panel). Every row but General's (Discord status, legacy menus) changes the picture, so Preview can show it (`look`). */
int settings_player_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max) {
    int n = 0, at = theme_row();
    for (int i = 0; i < NPLAYER && n < max; i++)
        if (!hud_slider_row(&player[i])) {
            n += fill_rows(rows + n, 1, &player[i], 1);
            rows[n - 1].look = strcmp(player[i].category, "GENERAL") != 0;
        }
    if (n == at && n < max) fill_theme_row(&rows[n++]), rows[n - 1].look = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < NDEVELOPER && n < max; i++) {
        n += fill_rows(rows + n, 1, &developer[i], 1);
        rows[n - 1].category = "ADVANCED", rows[n - 1].look = 1;
    }
    return n;
}

static const Setting *hud_slider(int opacity) {
    for (int i = 0; i < NPLAYER; i++)
        if (player[i].get == (opacity ? hud_opacity_get : hud_scale_get)) return &player[i];
    return NULL;
}

void settings_hud_slider(int opacity, float *frac, char *text, size_t n) {
    const Setting *s = hud_slider(opacity);
    float v = s ? s->get() : 0;
    *frac = !s || v <= 0 ? 0.0f : (v - s->lo) / (s->hi - s->lo);
    if (opacity) snprintf(text, n, "%d%%", (int)(v * 100 + 0.5f));
    else if (v <= 0) snprintf(text, n, "Auto");
    else snprintf(text, n, "%.2fx", v);
}

void settings_hud_step(int opacity, int dir) {
    const Setting *s = hud_slider(opacity);
    if (s) slider_step(s, dir > 0 ? 1 : -1), settings_save();
}

void settings_hud_set(int opacity, float frac) {
    const Setting *s = hud_slider(opacity);
    if (!s) return;
    if (frac < 0) frac = 0;
    if (frac > 1) frac = 1;
    float v = s->lo + frac * (s->hi - s->lo);
    v = (float)(int)(v / s->step + 0.5f) * s->step;  /* on the steps */
    s->set(v < s->lo ? s->lo : v > s->hi ? s->hi : v);
    settings_save();
}

/* A setting by its variable's name stepped until it shows `value` (as the panel would change it); 0 when found. */
static int set_value(const char *env, const char *value, size_t vlen) {
    for (int i = 0; i < NSETTINGS; i++) {
        const Setting *s = setting(i);
        if (!s->env || strcmp(s->env, env)) continue;
        if (!s->noptions) {  /* a slider: the value as the settings file has it */
            char v[32];
            snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%.*s", (int)(vlen < sizeof v - 1 ? vlen : sizeof v - 1), value);
            s->set(s->parse ? s->parse(v) : (float)atof(v));
            return 0;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < s->noptions; k++) {
            const char *v = s->values[s->current()];
            if (v && strlen(v) == vlen && !strncmp(v, value, vlen)) break;
            setting_step(s, 1);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    return -1;
}

/* First start of a new install (owner, 2026-11-11: integrated GPUs crawled with the high defaults): `low` (an
 * integrated GPU, or under 4 GB of video memory) sets the shadows and effects to the Switch's; else the owner's
 * own high set (below). A variable set in the environment is left alone. The file is written either way,
 * so this runs once. YW4_FIRST_RUN_LEVEL=low|high (tests) overrides the GPU's level. 1 when it ran. */
int settings_first_run(int low) {
    if (!first_run) return 0;
    first_run = 0;
    const char *force = getenv("YW4_FIRST_RUN_LEVEL");
    if (force && *force) low = !strcmp(force, "low");
    static const char *const lowered[][2] = {
        {"YW4_SHADOW_RES", "1024"}, {"YW4_PCSS", "0"}, {"YW4_CONTACT", "0"}, {"YW4_EFFECTS", "0"}};
    /* A dedicated GPU gets the owner's own settings (owner, 2026-11-13), but 1440p, not 4K, and 120 frames/s
     * (owner, 2026-11-13; others start at 60). DLSS and its frame generation and Reflex only where the GPU has them;
     * else FSR anti-aliasing and no frame generation. */
    const char *aa = gpu_dlss_available() ? "5" : "4", *fg = dlssg_available() ? "2" : "0";
    const char *reflex = dlssg_reflex_available() ? "1" : "0";
    const char *const raised[][2] = {
        {"YW4_RES", "1440"}, {"YW4_FPS", "120"}, {"YW4_AA", aa}, {"YW4_UPSCALE", "0"}, {"YW4_FG", fg}, {"YW4_REFLEX", reflex},
        {"YW4_ANISO", "16"}, {"YW4_EFFECTS", "1"}, {"YW4_DOF", "2"}, {"YW4_SHADOW_RES", "4096"}, {"YW4_PCSS", "2"},
        {"YW4_CONTACT", "1"}};
    for (size_t i = 0; low && i < sizeof lowered / sizeof *lowered; i++)
        if (!getenv(lowered[i][0])) set_value(lowered[i][0], lowered[i][1], strlen(lowered[i][1]));
    for (size_t i = 0; !low && i < sizeof raised / sizeof *raised; i++)
        if (!getenv(raised[i][0])) set_value(raised[i][0], raised[i][1], strlen(raised[i][1]));
    settings_save();
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: settings: first start: %s graphics for this GPU, written to %s\n", low ? "lighter" : "high",
            settings_file());
    return 1;
}

/* YW4_SET_AT=<frame>:<NAME>=<value>,... (tests): at those presented frames a setting changes as the panel would change
 * it, one step at a time until it shows that value (not saved), e.g. YW4_SET_AT=3000:YW4_ASPECT=32:9,3300:YW4_UPSCALE=1. */
void settings_test_at(uint64_t frame) {
    static const char *e = (const char *)1;
    if (e == (const char *)1) e = getenv("YW4_SET_AT");
    for (const char *p = e; p && *p;) {
        char *end;
        unsigned long long f = strtoull(p, &end, 10);
        if (*end != ':') return;
        const char *name = end + 1, *eq = strchr(name, '='), *next = strchr(name, ',');
        if (!eq || (next && next < eq)) return;
        size_t vlen = next ? (size_t)(next - eq - 1) : strlen(eq + 1);
        if (f == frame)
            for (int i = 0; i < NSETTINGS; i++) {
                const Setting *s = setting(i);
                if (!s->env || strlen(s->env) != (size_t)(eq - name) || strncmp(s->env, name, (size_t)(eq - name))) continue;
                const char *now;
                char saved[16];
                if (!s->noptions) {  /* a slider (SHARPENING): set straight to the value, as the file has it */
                    set_value(s->env, eq + 1, vlen);
                    slider_text(s, NULL, 0, saved, sizeof saved);
                    now = saved;
                } else {
                    for (int k = 0; k < s->noptions; k++) {
                        const char *v = s->values[s->current()];
                        if (v && strlen(v) == vlen && !strncmp(v, eq + 1, vlen)) break;
                        setting_step(s, 1);
                    }
                    now = s->values[s->current()];
                }
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: settings: %s is %s at frame %llu (YW4_SET_AT)\n", s->env, now, f);
                yw4_event("set", f, "\"name\":\"%s\",\"value\":\"%s\"", s->env, now);
            }
        p = next ? next + 1 : NULL;
    }
}

/* The setting behind an overlay row (settings_player_rows' order, the theme row taken out); NULL for none. */
static const Setting *player_row_setting(int row) {
    int at = theme_row();
    if (row == at) return NULL;
    if (row > at) row--;
    const Setting *s = NULL;
    int seen = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NPLAYER && !s; i++)
        if (!hud_slider_row(&player[i]) && seen++ == row) s = &player[i];
    if (!s && row - seen >= 0 && row - seen < NDEVELOPER) s = &developer[row - seen];  /* Advanced's developer rows */
    return s;
}

void settings_change(int row, int dir) {
    if (row == theme_row()) {  /* Look > Theme */
        theme_step(dir);
        settings_save();
        return;
    }
    const Setting *s = player_row_setting(row);
    if (!s) return;
    if (s->disabled && s->disabled()) return;  /* greyed out */
    setting_step(s, dir);
    settings_save();
}

void settings_slide(int row, float frac) {
    const Setting *s = player_row_setting(row);
    if (!s || s->noptions || (s->disabled && s->disabled())) return;
    if (frac < 0) frac = 0;
    if (frac > 1) frac = 1;
    float v = s->lo + frac * (s->hi - s->lo);
    v = (float)(int)(v / s->step + 0.5f) * s->step;  /* on the steps */
    float d = v - s->get();
    if (d > -s->step * 0.5f && d < s->step * 0.5f) return;  /* a drag within one step: no save per mouse move */
    s->set(v < s->lo ? s->lo : v > s->hi ? s->hi : v);
    settings_save();
}

int settings_cheat_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max) {
    return cheats_allowed() ? fill_rows(rows, max, cheats, NCHEATS) : 0;
}

void settings_cheat_change(int row, int dir) {
    if (!cheats_allowed() || row < 0 || row >= NCHEATS) return;
    setting_step(&cheats[row], dir);
    settings_save();
}

```

`runtime/src/settings.h`:

```h
/* The settings panel (F1, or a gamepad's Home or Minus+Plus): the graphics settings in groups, each with all
 * its options shown and the current one marked, and a description of the chosen setting and option. Up/Down
 * pick a setting, Left/Right change it, F1, Escape or B close the panel. While it is open neither the keyboard
 * nor the gamepad reaches the game. The settings change through their own functions (gpu.c, gpu_draw.c,
 * gpu_aa.c, shadow.c, gbuffer.c). Drawn by hud.c (panel_render), shown by window.c. */
#ifndef YW4_SETTINGS_H
#define YW4_SETTINGS_H

#include <stdint.h>

enum { SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS = 6 };

typedef struct {
    const char *category;  /* the group it is listed under */
    const char *name;
    const char *help;      /* what the setting does */
    const char *options[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];
    const char *notes[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];  /* a few words per option */
    int noptions;
    int current;  /* index into options */
    const char *disabled;  /* not NULL: greyed out, cannot be changed, and why (shown in the description) */
    int link;              /* opens a page (DEVELOPER OPTIONS) instead of having options: Enter or Right */
    int slider;            /* a slider instead of options: frac (0..1) its position, value its text */
    float frac;
    char value[16];
    const char *marks[SETTINGS_MAX_OPTIONS];  /* a slider's named points, evenly spread from end to end (or none) */
    int nmarks;
    int verbatim;  /* options[] are names to show as they are (the overlay's Theme row: "Jibanyan", "YW4 Recomp") */
    int look;      /* changes what's on screen: the overlay's Preview can show it (settings_player_rows) */
} SettingRow;

enum { SETTINGS_UP, SETTINGS_DOWN, SETTINGS_LEFT, SETTINGS_RIGHT, SETTINGS_CLOSE, SETTINGS_ACCEPT, SETTINGS_CLEAR,
       SETTINGS_PAGE };

/* Reads the settings file (settings.ini next to the executable, or YW4_SETTINGS_FILE; "none": no file) into the
 * environment, line by line, where the variable isn't set already, so the environment still wins. Called
 * first thing at start, before anything reads its variable; every change in the panel writes the file. */
void settings_load(void);
int settings_open(void);
void settings_toggle(void);
/* The page shown: 0 the settings (F1), 1 the controls (F2, bindings.h); SETTINGS_PAGE switches (a gamepad's
 * L/R, which has no F keys). */
int settings_page(void);
/* F1/F2: opens the panel on that page, or switches to it; closes the panel if it already shows it. */
void settings_show(int page);
/* Writes the settings file (the settings and the controls); every change calls it. */
void settings_save(void);
/* The settings file's path ("" with YW4_SETTINGS_FILE=none): the bug report copies it. */
const char *settings_file_name(void);
/* One of the actions above, from the window's key presses while the panel is open. */
void settings_action(int action);
/* The rows as they are now, and the selected one; returns the count. */
int settings_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max, int *selected);
/* The in-game overlay's settings page (gamemenu.c): the player's settings (no developer link), and changing row
 * `row` one option forward (dir 1) or back (-1), as Right / Left on it. */
int settings_player_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max);
void settings_change(int row, int dir);
/* A slider row of that page set from a position along its track (0..1, the mouse), on its steps, saved. */
void settings_slide(int row, float frac);
/* The overlay's Cheats page: its rows (none when the launcher turned cheats off, cheats.h), and changing one. */
int settings_cheat_rows(SettingRow *rows, int max);
void settings_cheat_change(int row, int dir);
/* YW4_SET_AT=<frame>:<NAME>=<value>,...: tests change settings at those presented frames (gpu.c calls it). */
void settings_test_at(uint64_t frame);
/* A new install's first start (no settings file yet): picks the graphics for the GPU once (low: an integrated GPU
 * or under 4 GB of video memory) and writes the file. 1 when it ran. */
int settings_first_run(int low);
/* The overlay's Overlay page: the HUD's scale (opacity 0) or opacity (1) slider: its position 0..1 and its text, and
 * one step up (dir 1) or down (-1), saved. */
void settings_hud_slider(int opacity, float *frac, char *text, size_t n);
void settings_hud_step(int opacity, int dir);
/* The same slider set from a position along its track (0..1, the mouse), on its steps, saved. */
void settings_hud_set(int opacity, float frac);
/* The settings page shows its developer page (DEVELOPER OPTIONS, the last row's; Escape or B goes back). */
int settings_developer(void);
/* LEGACY MENUS (YW4_LEGACY_KEYS, default on): 1 if the F1, F2 and F3 keys work. */
int settings_legacy_keys(void);
/* YW4_KEYS_NOTICE: 1 if the corner card that says how to see the controls shows at each start (default: on with a
 * settings file, off without one; the launcher's "Controls hint" setting passes 0). */
int settings_keys_notice(void);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/sha256.c`:

```c
/* SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), for the version lock: the runtime refuses any main that isn't
 * the build in target.toml (CLAUDE.md rule 3); and for the add-on check (svc_misc.c, decision 0049). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "yw4load.h"

static const uint32_t K[64] = {
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
};

static uint32_t rotr(uint32_t x, int n) { return (x >> n) | (x << (32 - n)); }

static void block(uint32_t h[8], const uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t w[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        w[i] = (uint32_t)p[4 * i] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[4 * i + 1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[4 * i + 2] << 8 | p[4 * i + 3];
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t s0 = rotr(w[i - 15], 7) ^ rotr(w[i - 15], 18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
        uint32_t s1 = rotr(w[i - 2], 17) ^ rotr(w[i - 2], 19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
        w[i] = w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1;
    }
    uint32_t a = h[0], b = h[1], c = h[2], d = h[3], e = h[4], f = h[5], g = h[6], k = h[7];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t t1 = k + (rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + K[i] + w[i];
        uint32_t t2 = (rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c));
        k = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + t1; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = t1 + t2;
    }
    h[0] += a; h[1] += b; h[2] += c; h[3] += d; h[4] += e; h[5] += f; h[6] += g; h[7] += k;
}

void yw4_sha256_init(Yw4Sha256 *c) {
    static const uint32_t h0[8] = {0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a,
                                   0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19};
    memcpy(c->h, h0, sizeof h0);
    c->len = 0;
}

void yw4_sha256_update(Yw4Sha256 *c, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
    size_t have = (size_t)(c->len % 64);
    c->len += len;
    if (have) {  /* fill the block left over from the last piece first */
        size_t k = 64 - have < len ? 64 - have : len;
        memcpy(c->buf + have, data, k);
        data += k, len -= k;
        if (have + k < 64) return;
        block(c->h, c->buf);
    }
    for (; len >= 64; data += 64, len -= 64) block(c->h, data);
    memcpy(c->buf, data, len);
}

void yw4_sha256_final_hex(Yw4Sha256 *c, char out[65]) {
    uint8_t tail[128] = {0};
    size_t rest = (size_t)(c->len % 64);
    memcpy(tail, c->buf, rest);
    tail[rest] = 0x80;
    size_t tlen = rest + 1 + 8 <= 64 ? 64 : 128;
    uint64_t bits = c->len * 8;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) tail[tlen - 1 - k] = (uint8_t)(bits >> (8 * k));
    block(c->h, tail);
    if (tlen == 128) block(c->h, tail + 64);
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) sprintf(out + 8 * k, "%08x", c->h[k]);
    out[64] = 0;
}

void yw4_sha256_hex(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, char out[65]) {
    Yw4Sha256 c;
    yw4_sha256_init(&c);
    yw4_sha256_update(&c, data, len);
    yw4_sha256_final_hex(&c, out);
}

```

`runtime/src/shadow.c`:

```c
/* Our shadow-caster pass (decision 0024, docs/frame.md "Shadow maps").
 *
 * The game draws each shadow cascade's casters with its model renderer main+0xa45890
 * (device, draw list, layer item), a layer item of kind 1. Hooks (recomp/overrides.toml) run
 * before it, before its submesh draw main+0xa75e90 and before the job that ends the cascade,
 * main+0x7ed350.
 *
 * YW4_SHADOWS=native: the game still chooses what goes into a cascade (its walk of the draw
 * list, its culling, its sort), but when it is about to draw a submesh our pass can draw (the
 * submesh-draw hook), we skip the game's draw, with its state flush, NVN calls and their
 * translation, and add ours to a pass that is queued right after the game's draws of the
 * layer (in the cascade-end hook), into the layer the game bound and cleared. What we can
 * draw is learned from the game's own draws of that submesh; each object goes back to the
 * game one frame in 32 to check it again. So our shadows are always the game's selection, and
 * the game draws whatever we can't.
 *
 * YW4_SHADOWS=check: gather only, and compare with the submeshes the game drew. Missing ones
 * are bugs in the gather; extra ones are casters the game culled and we don't (instanced).
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "nvn.h"
#include "shadow.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */

enum { LAYER_SHADOW = 1, MAX_CASTERS = 4096 };
enum { MODE_GAME, MODE_CHECK, MODE_NATIVE };

static int mode = -1;

#define U8(a) (*(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define S8(a) (*(const int8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define U16(a) (*(const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define U64(a) (*(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))

typedef struct {
    uint64_t node;       /* the draw-list node */
    uint64_t own;        /* the node's own object: its world matrix (the model renderer reads it there) */
    uint64_t object;     /* the draw object (after its +0x108 redirection) */
    uint64_t geometry;   /* *(object+0x128)[g] */
    uint64_t model;      /* object+0x140 + g*0x240: the geometry's model record (instances) */
    uint64_t submesh;    /* the 0x50-byte submesh record */
} Caster;

typedef struct {
    Caster c[MAX_CASTERS];
    int n, overflow;
} Gathered;

/* The layer item's mask of sort keys, as the model renderer builds it: the item's mask at
 * +0x10 (plus bit 63), limited to keys [lo, hi) from +0xa / +0xc. */
static uint64_t layer_mask(uint64_t item) {
    uint16_t lo = U16(item + 0xa), hi = U16(item + 0xc);
    uint64_t below = lo < 0x3f ? ~0ull << lo : 1ull << 63;
    uint64_t above = hi < 0x40 ? ~(~0ull << hi) : ~0ull;
    return (U64(item + 0x10) | 1ull << 63) & below & above;
}

typedef struct { float m[16]; } Mat4;  /* row-major: out[i] = dot(row i, v), as the game's shaders use them */

static Mat4 mul(const Mat4 *a, const Mat4 *b) {
    Mat4 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            float s = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) s += a->m[i * 4 + k] * b->m[k * 4 + j];
            r.m[i * 4 + j] = s;
        }
    return r;
}

/* 4x4 inverse by cofactors, in double; 0 if singular. */
static int invert(const Mat4 *a, Mat4 *out) {
    double m[16], inv[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) m[i] = a->m[i];
    inv[0] = m[5] * m[10] * m[15] - m[5] * m[11] * m[14] - m[9] * m[6] * m[15] + m[9] * m[7] * m[14] + m[13] * m[6] * m[11] - m[13] * m[7] * m[10];
    inv[4] = -m[4] * m[10] * m[15] + m[4] * m[11] * m[14] + m[8] * m[6] * m[15] - m[8] * m[7] * m[14] - m[12] * m[6] * m[11] + m[12] * m[7] * m[10];
    inv[8] = m[4] * m[9] * m[15] - m[4] * m[11] * m[13] - m[8] * m[5] * m[15] + m[8] * m[7] * m[13] + m[12] * m[5] * m[11] - m[12] * m[7] * m[9];
    inv[12] = -m[4] * m[9] * m[14] + m[4] * m[10] * m[13] + m[8] * m[5] * m[14] - m[8] * m[6] * m[13] - m[12] * m[5] * m[10] + m[12] * m[6] * m[9];
    inv[1] = -m[1] * m[10] * m[15] + m[1] * m[11] * m[14] + m[9] * m[2] * m[15] - m[9] * m[3] * m[14] - m[13] * m[2] * m[11] + m[13] * m[3] * m[10];
    inv[5] = m[0] * m[10] * m[15] - m[0] * m[11] * m[14] - m[8] * m[2] * m[15] + m[8] * m[3] * m[14] + m[12] * m[2] * m[11] - m[12] * m[3] * m[10];
    inv[9] = -m[0] * m[9] * m[15] + m[0] * m[11] * m[13] + m[8] * m[1] * m[15] - m[8] * m[3] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[11] + m[12] * m[3] * m[9];
    inv[13] = m[0] * m[9] * m[14] - m[0] * m[10] * m[13] - m[8] * m[1] * m[14] + m[8] * m[2] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[10] - m[12] * m[2] * m[9];
    inv[2] = m[1] * m[6] * m[15] - m[1] * m[7] * m[14] - m[5] * m[2] * m[15] + m[5] * m[3] * m[14] + m[13] * m[2] * m[7] - m[13] * m[3] * m[6];
    inv[6] = -m[0] * m[6] * m[15] + m[0] * m[7] * m[14] + m[4] * m[2] * m[15] - m[4] * m[3] * m[14] - m[12] * m[2] * m[7] + m[12] * m[3] * m[6];
    inv[10] = m[0] * m[5] * m[15] - m[0] * m[7] * m[13] - m[4] * m[1] * m[15] + m[4] * m[3] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[7] - m[12] * m[3] * m[5];
    inv[14] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[14] + m[0] * m[6] * m[13] + m[4] * m[1] * m[14] - m[4] * m[2] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[6] + m[12] * m[2] * m[5];
    inv[3] = -m[1] * m[6] * m[11] + m[1] * m[7] * m[10] + m[5] * m[2] * m[11] - m[5] * m[3] * m[10] - m[9] * m[2] * m[7] + m[9] * m[3] * m[6];
    inv[7] = m[0] * m[6] * m[11] - m[0] * m[7] * m[10] - m[4] * m[2] * m[11] + m[4] * m[3] * m[10] + m[8] * m[2] * m[7] - m[8] * m[3] * m[6];
    inv[11] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[11] + m[0] * m[7] * m[9] + m[4] * m[1] * m[11] - m[4] * m[3] * m[9] - m[8] * m[1] * m[7] + m[8] * m[3] * m[5];
    inv[15] = m[0] * m[5] * m[10] - m[0] * m[6] * m[9] - m[4] * m[1] * m[10] + m[4] * m[2] * m[9] + m[8] * m[1] * m[6] - m[8] * m[2] * m[5];
    double det = m[0] * inv[0] + m[1] * inv[4] + m[2] * inv[8] + m[3] * inv[12];
    if (det == 0) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) out->m[i] = (float)(inv[i] / det);
    return 1;
}

static Mat4 load(uint64_t addr) {
    Mat4 r;
    memcpy(r.m, (const void *)(uintptr_t)addr, sizeof r.m);
    return r;
}

/* The object's box (object+0x80 min, +0x90 max, local space) through `mvp` (projection ×
 * view × world) is entirely outside one clip plane: it can't reach this cascade. A box
 * with min > max is never culled. */
static int outside(uint64_t obj, const Mat4 *mvp) {
    float lo[3], hi[3];
    memcpy(lo, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(obj + 0x80), 12);
    memcpy(hi, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(obj + 0x90), 12);
    if (lo[0] > hi[0] || lo[1] > hi[1] || lo[2] > hi[2]) return 0;
    /* planes every corner is outside of: x<-w x>w y<-w y>w, behind the projection's eye (w<=0:
     * the cascades' projections are perspective-like, and there the side tests flip), beyond
     * the far plane (z>w). Not the near plane: casters between the light and the cascade still
     * throw shadows into it */
    unsigned all = 0x3F;
    for (int c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
        float v[4] = {c & 1 ? hi[0] : lo[0], c & 2 ? hi[1] : lo[1], c & 4 ? hi[2] : lo[2], 1}, p[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            p[i] = mvp->m[i * 4] * v[0] + mvp->m[i * 4 + 1] * v[1] + mvp->m[i * 4 + 2] * v[2] + mvp->m[i * 4 + 3];
        unsigned out = (p[0] < -p[3]) | (p[0] > p[3]) << 1 | (p[1] < -p[3]) << 2 | (p[1] > p[3]) << 3 |
                       (p[3] <= 0) << 4 | (p[2] > p[3]) << 5;
        all &= out;
        if (!all) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* The model renderer's selection (main+0xa45890, first phase), for one layer: which
 * (object, geometry, submesh) it draws. `vp` (the cascade's projection × view; NULL: none)
 * adds our own culling of whole objects by their box, in place of the renderer's. */
static void gather(uint64_t list, uint64_t item, const Mat4 *vp, Gathered *out) {
    uint8_t kind = U8(item + 8);
    uint16_t lo = U16(item + 0xa), hi = U16(item + 0xc);
    uint64_t mask = layer_mask(item);
    uint8_t skip_bits = kind == 1 ? 8 : 4;  /* submesh +0x3f: not drawn in this kind of layer */
    out->n = out->overflow = 0;
    for (uint64_t node = U64(list + 0x20); node; node = U64(node + 0x30)) {
        uint64_t obj0 = U64(node), obj = U64(obj0 + 0x108) ? U64(obj0 + 0x108) : obj0;
        if (kind == LAYER_SHADOW && !U8(obj + 0x1d1)) continue;  /* casts no shadow */
        if ((1u << (kind & 31)) & U8(node + 0x20)) continue;    /* node hidden from this kind */
        uint64_t mat = U64(obj + 0x120);
        if (mat) {
            if (U8(U64(mat + 0x18) + 0x23) ? kind != 0 : kind != 0 && U16(obj + 0x1b0)) continue;
        }
        int8_t key = S8(obj0 + 0x101), sort = S8(obj0 + 0x103);
        uint8_t ngeo = U8(obj + 0x1c8);
        /* Not instanced objects (an instance array at model+0x80, cbuf 11 of the instanced
         * shaders): their world matrix is the identity, each copy is placed by its own
         * transform. Culling them per copy is for later. */
        if (vp && !U64(U64(obj + 0x140) + 0x80)) {  /* world: the node's own object; box: the redirected one */
            Mat4 world = load(obj0), mvp = mul(vp, &world);
            if (outside(obj, &mvp)) continue;
        }
        uint64_t models = U64(obj + 0x140), geos = U64(obj + 0x128);
        for (uint8_t g = 0; g < ngeo; g++) {
            uint64_t geom = U64(geos + 8ull * g), mdl = models + 0x240ull * g;
            uint16_t nsub = U16(mdl + 0x200);
            if (!geom || !nsub || !U64(mdl + 0x100)) continue;
            /* loaded (stands in for the renderer's virtual "ready" call, vtable +0x18) */
            uint64_t res = U64(geom + 0x38);
            if (!U64(geom + 0x20) || !res || !U64(res) || !(U8(U64(res) + 0x42) & 1)) continue;
            uint64_t m = U64(mdl + 0x1f0);
            int shift = key < 0 ? -key : key;
            uint64_t keys = key < 0 ? m >> (shift & 63) : m << (shift & 63);
            if (!((sort < 0 ? keys : 1ull << (sort & 63)) & mask)) continue;
            uint64_t hdr = U64(geom + 0x18), base = hdr + 4ull * U16(hdr + 0xa);
            uint64_t subs = base + 4ull * U16(hdr + 0x60), ranges = base + 4ull * U16(hdr + 0x64);
            uint64_t inst = g == 0 ? U64(node + 0x10) : 0;
            for (uint16_t i = 0; i < nsub; i++) {
                uint64_t s = subs + 0x50ull * i;
                int k = sort < 0 ? (int8_t)(S8(ranges + 16ull * U8(s + 0x43) + 8) + key) : sort;
                if (k >= hi) break;
                if (k < lo || (k <= 0x3f && !((1ull << k) & mask))) continue;
                if (skip_bits & U8(s + 0x3f)) continue;
                if (inst && ((1u << (kind & 31)) & U8(inst + 0xb0 + 0xb8ull * i))) continue;
                if (!((1u << (U8(obj + 0x1cb) & 31)) & U8(s + 0x34))) continue;
                if (out->n < MAX_CASTERS) out->c[out->n++] = (Caster){node, obj0, obj, geom, mdl, s};
                else out->overflow = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}


/* ---- the layer being drawn on this thread (the shadow layers all run on one render thread) */

enum { PASS_DRAWS = 4096, RING = 64 };

/* The game's programs for static casters: projection x view x world, and a fragment stage
 * that does nothing (the same vertex program also comes with cut-out fragment programs).
 * Instanced casters: projection x view (vs cbuf 1 byte 128) x the copy's 3x4 transform (vs
 * cbuf 11, 48 bytes per copy, counted from the draw's first instance) x world (vs cbuf 2). */
#define STATIC_VS 0xb320bd9159e2fd0aull
#define INSTANCED_VS 0xa748428f2d024ad7ull
#define DEPTH_FS 0x6ead6a69737c52c2ull
/* Cut-out casters: the static or instanced program, plus texture coordinates (attribute 1) and
 * the material's alpha threshold (vs cbuf 3 byte 12) for a fragment stage that drops texels
 * below it (texture: fs slot 0). */
#define CUTOUT_STATIC_VS 0x4cbb8e9627462c17ull
#define CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS 0x744205aaee24163eull
#define CUTOUT_FS 0xdceb89e5f80d79e1ull
/* Skinned casters: up to 8 bones per vertex from a per-submesh palette (vs cbuf 4), then as
 * the static program. Usually with the fade fragment program, which drops pixels by a screen
 * pattern while the object fades out (fs cbuf 3 byte 28 below 1); while it is 1 nothing is
 * dropped and our depth-only draw is the same. */
#define SKINNED_VS 0x71faac9f597b428dull
/* The same with up to 4 bones per vertex: float weights (attribute 1) and bone indices (attribute 2)
 * in the formats the game's vertex layout gives, no 1/65535 scale (shadow_skinned4.vert). */
#define SKINNED4_VS 0x26b7074dd30b03b3ull
static int is_skinned(uint64_t vs) { return vs == SKINNED_VS || vs == SKINNED4_VS; }
#define FADE_FS 0xb7cd6ed8cd28a184ull
/* Fading instanced casters: the instanced programs for copies the callback nudged (flag x 100
 * added to the first value). The vertex program decodes each copy: first value sign x 100 x
 * fract(|v| / 100), fade floor(|v| / 100) / 255; the fragment program drops the fragment where
 * fade x fs cbuf 3 byte 28 is below the 16x16 dither texture (fs slot 18) at the pixel mod 16.
 * The cut-out one first drops texels as the cut-out programs do (dceb89's test in d5f536). */
#define FADE_INSTANCED_VS 0x9904c21a86e1e9f8ull
#define FADE_CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS 0xf8951f14aed20733ull
#define FADE_CUTOUT_FS 0xd5f536a14604f183ull

/* Wind-swayed casters (plants): instanced or not, always with the cut-out fragment program; the
 * vertices move with the wind in world space before projection x view (shadow_wind.vert has the
 * math): vs cbuf 6 rows 36, 47 (wind direction, strength, time; wind map placement), cbuf 7 rows
 * 0, 3 (the material's), vs textures 11 (noise) and 12 (wind map); attribute 1 the vertex's wind
 * weights, attribute 2 its texture coordinates. */
#define WIND_INSTANCED_VS 0xfa9033d5819c7ebbull
#define WIND_VS 0x61ebacf08dbc2b7dull

static int is_instanced(uint64_t vs) {
    return vs == INSTANCED_VS || vs == CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS || vs == FADE_INSTANCED_VS || vs == FADE_CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS ||
           vs == WIND_INSTANCED_VS;
}
static int is_wind(uint64_t vs) { return vs == WIND_INSTANCED_VS || vs == WIND_VS; }
static int is_fading(uint64_t vs) { return vs == FADE_INSTANCED_VS || vs == FADE_CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS; }
/* programs our pass mirrors */
static int mirrored(uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs) {
    return ((vs == STATIC_VS || vs == INSTANCED_VS) && fs == DEPTH_FS) ||
           ((vs == CUTOUT_STATIC_VS || vs == CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS) && fs == CUTOUT_FS) ||
           (is_skinned(vs) && (fs == DEPTH_FS || fs == FADE_FS)) || (vs == FADE_INSTANCED_VS && fs == FADE_FS) ||
           (vs == FADE_CUTOUT_INSTANCED_VS && fs == FADE_CUTOUT_FS) || (is_wind(vs) && fs == CUTOUT_FS);
}

/* An instanced model's copies. The model renderer gets them from the model's callback
 * main+0x5f9420 (model+0xe0), which culls them against the view (box per copy, then an
 * occlusion test) and writes the kept ones into a new buffer each frame, bound as vs cbuf 11.
 * All copies: model+0x214 sets (0 counts as 1; each drawn as its own draw) of [model+0xd0]
 * (0x38 bytes each: first copy +0x30, count +0x32), their transforms at [model+0x168] (48
 * bytes each), a byte per copy at [model+0x170]. */
enum { MAX_SETS = 8 };
typedef struct {
    uint64_t transforms, flags;
    uint16_t first[MAX_SETS], in_set[MAX_SETS];
    uint32_t sets, count;  /* count: of all sets */
    int nudge;  /* model+0x218: the callback adds flag x 100 to each copy's first value */
} Copies;

/* 1: found; 0: not instanced; -1: a layout we don't read (split copies, too many sets). */
static int instances(uint64_t mdl, Copies *out) {
    if (!U64(mdl + 0x80)) return 0;
    uint64_t set = U64(mdl + 0xd0);
    out->sets = U8(mdl + 0x214) ? U8(mdl + 0x214) : 1;
    if (out->sets > MAX_SETS || U8(mdl + 0x216)) return -1;
    if (!set || !U64(mdl + 0x168) || !U64(mdl + 0x170)) return -1;
    out->transforms = U64(mdl + 0x168);
    out->flags = U64(mdl + 0x170);
    out->nudge = U8(mdl + 0x218) != 0;
    out->count = 0;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < out->sets; k++) {
        out->first[k] = U16(set + 0x38ull * k + 0x30);
        out->in_set[k] = U16(set + 0x38ull * k + 0x32);
        out->count += out->in_set[k];
    }
    return out->count ? 1 : -1;
}

/* Copy i (counted over all sets)'s transform as the callback hands it to the shader, as a
 * 4x4 (3 rows, then 0 0 0 1). */
static Mat4 instance_matrix(const Copies *c, uint32_t i) {
    uint32_t k = 0;
    while (k + 1 < c->sets && i >= c->in_set[k]) i -= c->in_set[k++];
    uint64_t at = (uint64_t)c->first[k] + i;
    Mat4 e = {{0}};
    memcpy(e.m, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(c->transforms + 48 * at), 48);
    if (c->nudge && e.m[0] < 100.0f) {
        float add = (float)U8(c->flags + at) * 100.0f;
        e.m[0] += e.m[0] >= 0 ? add : -add;
    }
    e.m[15] = 1;
    return e;
}

typedef struct {
    int active;
    uint64_t device;
    int cascade;           /* 0..2, from the view object the game's job main+0x7ee9a0 set */
    Mat4 vp;               /* the cascade's projection x view */
    Gathered ours;
    /* what the game drew (check mode: compared; native mode: learned) */
    uint64_t drawn[MAX_CASTERS][2];  /* (object, submesh) */
    int ndrawn;
    int pending;           /* a submesh draw was entered; the next recorded draw is its */
    /* native mode */
    int game_drew;         /* the game has drawn in this layer: its first draw binds and clears the layer */
    const float *pending_copies;  /* check: the copies pending when the game's draw began */
    uint32_t pending_count;
    int pending_copies_ok;
    ShadowPass *pass;
    /* the renderer's world for the submesh being drawn ([sp+0x30]+0x40 at the submesh draw, as
     * for the G-buffer): the object's own world is wrong for posed parts (the bamboo forest's
     * stalks: one object, a world per part) */
    Mat4 world;
    int have_world;
    /* YW4_SHADOW_RECHECK_LOG=1: the game's draws in this layer that were rechecks, a few of their objects */
    int nrecheck;
    uint64_t recheck_obj[4], recheck_sub[32];
} Layer;

static _Thread_local Layer *lay;

int shadow_checking;  /* nvn_cmdbuf.c calls shadow_check_draw while this is set */

/* What the game drew each (object, submesh) with, learned from its own draws: a node is ours
 * once all its submeshes are known to be drawn with STATIC_VS or INSTANCED_VS and DEPTH_FS. The model and
 * material are kept to notice an object's memory being reused for another one. */
enum { LEARN_SLOTS = 1 << 16 };
typedef struct {
    uint64_t texture;  /* 0: not a cut-out */
    float threshold;
    uint32_t uv_format, uv_offset;
    uint64_t dither;   /* fading instanced casters: the dither texture (fs slot 18) */
    uint32_t wind_format, wind_offset;  /* wind-swayed casters: attribute 1 */
    const NvnDescPool *pool;  /* the texture pool and the texels at the handle when learned (YW4_SHADOW_HANDLE_LOG) */
    uint64_t tex_addr;
    int has_sampler;          /* the sampler settings the game's draw used (ShadowDraw.sampler) */
    NvnSamplerDesc sampler;
} Cutout;
_Static_assert(sizeof(NvnSamplerDesc) <= sizeof(((ShadowDraw *)0)->sampler), "ShadowDraw.sampler too small");
static struct { uint64_t obj, sub, model, mat, vs, fs; int ok; uint8_t cull, front; Cutout cut; } learned[LEARN_SLOTS];

static uint32_t learn_slot(uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub) {
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)((obj * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ sub * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4Full) >> 48);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < LEARN_SLOTS; i++, h = (h + 1) & (LEARN_SLOTS - 1))
        if (!learned[h].obj || (learned[h].obj == obj && learned[h].sub == sub)) return h;
    return UINT32_MAX;
}

/* Was the submesh last drawn by the game with programs our pass mirrors, and did our draw
 * match it (and the object not reused since)? Its slot in `learned`, or UINT32_MAX. */
static uint32_t learned_ours(uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub) {
    uint32_t h = learn_slot(obj, sub);
    if (h == UINT32_MAX || learned[h].obj != obj) return UINT32_MAX;
    if (learned[h].model != U64(obj + 0x140) || learned[h].mat != U64(obj + 0x120)) return UINT32_MAX;  /* reused */
    return mirrored(learned[h].vs, learned[h].fs) && learned[h].ok ? h : UINT32_MAX;
}

/* ok: our draw of it would equal the game's (same buffers, same matrix: compare_draw) */
static void learn(uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub, uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs, int ok, const uint8_t polygon[4],
                  const Cutout *cut) {
    uint32_t h = learn_slot(obj, sub);
    if (h == UINT32_MAX) return;
    learned[h].obj = obj, learned[h].sub = sub, learned[h].model = U64(obj + 0x140), learned[h].mat = U64(obj + 0x120);
    learned[h].vs = vs, learned[h].fs = fs, learned[h].ok = ok;
    learned[h].cull = polygon[0], learned[h].front = polygon[1];
    /* YW4_SHADOW_HANDLE_LOG=1: a game draw teaching a cut-out caster another texture handle than we had */
    static int hlog = -1;
    if (hlog < 0) hlog = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_HANDLE_LOG") && atoi(getenv("YW4_SHADOW_HANDLE_LOG")) > 0;
    if (hlog && learned[h].obj == obj && learned[h].cut.texture && cut->texture &&
        learned[h].cut.texture != cut->texture) {
        static long n;
        if (n++ < 40)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: handle: frame %" PRIu64 " object %#" PRIx64 " submesh %#" PRIx64 ": cut-out handle %#"
                    PRIx64 " -> %#" PRIx64 " (texels %#" PRIx64 " -> %#" PRIx64 ")\n",
                    __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), obj, sub, learned[h].cut.texture,
                    cut->texture, learned[h].cut.tex_addr, cut->tex_addr);
    }
    learned[h].cut = *cut;
}

/* The shadow map layer each cascade's draws went into, learned from the game's draws. */
static struct { uint64_t addr; uint32_t layer; int known; } cascade_target[3];

/* Statistics since the last report */
static long layers_seen, missing_total, extra_total, ours_total, drawn_total;
static long draws_replaced, draws_native;
static long draws_since_toggle;  /* submeshes drawn by our pass since the last switch */
static long compared, wrong_vb, wrong_ib, wrong_mvp;  /* the game's static and instanced draws vs ours */
static long compared_inst, wrong_inst, pending_checked, pending_wrong;  /* of those, instanced; instance buffer or count different */
static long copies_culled;  /* copies the game drew that our culling drops */
/* since the start, for the run's summary (shadow_summary_text): added at each report */
static long layers_total, replaced_total, game_drew_total, switches;
/* the game's draws our pass can't repeat, by programs and why (reject: not mirrored, then which
 * test of shadow_check_draw / compare_draw turned it down) */
enum { R_PROGRAM, R_CASTER, R_DESCRIBE, R_COPIES, R_VB, R_IB, R_MATRIX, R_LAYOUT, R_FADE, R_SKINNED, R_PALETTE, R_N };
static const char *const reject_name[R_N] = {"other programs", "not gathered", "not described", "copies",
                                             "vertex buffer", "index buffer", "matrix", "vertex layout or texture",
                                             "fade", "skinned vertex layout", "bone palette"};
static _Thread_local int reject;
enum { OTHERS = 24 };
static struct { uint64_t vs, fs; long n[R_N]; } others[OTHERS];

static void note_other(uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs, int why) {
    int i = 0;
    while (i < OTHERS && __atomic_load_n(&others[i].vs, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) &&
           !(others[i].vs == vs && others[i].fs == fs))
        i++;
    if (i == OTHERS) return;
    if (!others[i].vs) others[i].fs = fs, __atomic_store_n(&others[i].vs, vs | !vs, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&others[i].n[why], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static int same(const Caster *c, const uint64_t d[2]) { return c->object == d[0] && c->submesh == d[1]; }

static void compare(Layer *k) {
    long missing = 0, extra = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < k->ndrawn; j++) {
        int found = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < k->ours.n && !found; i++) found = same(&k->ours.c[i], k->drawn[j]);
        if (!found && missing++ < 3)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: check: the game drew object %#" PRIx64 " submesh %#" PRIx64
                    ", the gather missed it\n", k->drawn[j][0], k->drawn[j][1]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k->ours.n; i++) {
        int found = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < k->ndrawn && !found; j++) found = same(&k->ours.c[i], k->drawn[j]);
        extra += !found;
    }
    __atomic_add_fetch(&missing_total, missing, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&extra_total, extra, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static void report(void) {
    static uint64_t reported;
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (f < reported + 600) return;
    reported = f;
    long l = __atomic_exchange_n(&layers_seen, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    long o = __atomic_exchange_n(&ours_total, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), d = __atomic_exchange_n(&drawn_total, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (mode == MODE_CHECK) {
        long m = __atomic_exchange_n(&missing_total, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        long e = __atomic_exchange_n(&extra_total, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: frame %" PRIu64 ": %ld shadow layers; gathered %ld submeshes, the game drew %ld; "
                "missed %ld, extra (culled by the game) %ld\n", f, l, o, d, m, e);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows:   instanced draws: the copies pending at the draw differ from the game's in %ld of %ld\n",
                __atomic_exchange_n(&pending_wrong, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
                __atomic_exchange_n(&pending_checked, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows:   static and instanced draws compared with ours %ld: wrong vertices %ld, indices %ld, "
                "matrix %ld; instanced %ld: wrong copies %ld, drawn copies we cull %ld\n",
                __atomic_exchange_n(&compared, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), __atomic_exchange_n(&wrong_vb, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
                __atomic_exchange_n(&wrong_ib, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), __atomic_exchange_n(&wrong_mvp, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
                __atomic_exchange_n(&compared_inst, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), __atomic_exchange_n(&wrong_inst, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
                __atomic_exchange_n(&copies_culled, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
    } else {
        long ps, ds[SHADOW_SKIP_N], dsum = 0;
        gpu_shadow_counts(&ps, ds);
        for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N; i++) dsum += ds[i];
        long r = __atomic_exchange_n(&draws_replaced, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        long nd = __atomic_exchange_n(&draws_native, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&layers_total, l, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&replaced_total, r, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&game_drew_total, d, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: frame %" PRIu64 ": %s; %ld shadow layers; %ld of the game's submesh draws replaced "
                "by %ld of ours, %ld left to the game; left out of ours: %ld passes, %ld draws", f,
                mode == MODE_NATIVE ? "our pass" : "the game's pass", l, r, nd, d, ps, dsum);
        int listed = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N; i++)  /* why, when any */
            if (ds[i]) fprintf(stderr, "%s%s %ld", listed++ ? ", " : " (", shadow_skip_name[i], ds[i]);
        fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", listed ? ")" : "");
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < OTHERS && others[i].vs; i++) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows:   the game's: vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 ":", others[i].vs, others[i].fs);
        for (int r = 0; r < R_N; r++)
            if (others[i].n[r]) fprintf(stderr, " %s %ld,", reject_name[r], others[i].n[r]);
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
    }
    memset(others, 0, sizeof others);
}

/* nvn_cmdbuf.c: a draw was recorded; if it is the submesh draw noted last on this thread, it
 * is the game's draw of that submesh: learn its program and the cascade's target. */
static int compare_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub, uint64_t index_addr,
                        const ShadowDrawCall *call, int instanced);

/* A skinned submesh's bone palette (3x4 per bone), as the model renderer finds it: the
 * submesh's 0x140-byte record at [model+0xc8] (the size at +0x98) holds at +0x78 the buffer
 * object the engine uploads into vs cbuf 4 right before the draw; its data at [B+0x40] +
 * [B+0x58]. 0 if missing. */
static int palette_of(const Caster *c, uint64_t *data, uint32_t *size) {
    uint64_t recs = U64(c->model + 0xc8), hdr = U64(c->geometry + 0x18);
    if (!recs || !hdr) return 0;
    uint64_t subs = hdr + 4ull * U16(hdr + 0xa) + 4ull * U16(hdr + 0x60);
    if (c->submesh < subs || (c->submesh - subs) % 0x50 || (c->submesh - subs) / 0x50 >= U16(c->model + 0x200)) return 0;
    uint64_t rec = recs + 0x140 * ((c->submesh - subs) / 0x50), b = U64(rec + 0x78);
    if (!b || !U64(b + 0x40)) return 0;
    *data = U64(b + 0x40) + *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(b + 0x58);
    *size = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(rec + 0x98);
    return *size && *size % 48 == 0 && *size <= 3 * 256 * 16;
}

static const Caster *caster_of(uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub) {
    for (int i = 0; i < lay->ours.n; i++)
        if (lay->ours.c[i].object == obj && lay->ours.c[i].submesh == sub) return &lay->ours.c[i];
    return NULL;
}

/* Is our palette the one the game drew with? The game's animation writes the next pose into the
 * same buffer while the render thread draws, so the copy the game made a moment ago can be a
 * little different from what we read now: close (mean difference per value under 0.01) is
 * enough. Another submesh's or another model's palette is far from it. */
static int palette_close(const float *ours, const float *game, uint32_t size) {
    double sum = 0;
    uint32_t n = size / 4;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) sum += fabs((double)ours[i] - game[i]);
    return n && sum / n < 0.01;
}

/* A skinned draw our pass can repeat: the vertex layout our pipeline reads (position at 0,
 * weights 0x2f at 28, bone indices 0x2c at 44, one vertex buffer and stride), our palette
 * the game's cbuf 4 (palette_close), and with the fade program, the fade at 1. */
static int skinned_ok(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub, uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs, Cutout *cut) {
    static const uint32_t want[3] = {0x22, 0x2f | 28u << 13, 0x2c | 44u << 13};
    if (cb->trace_nattribs < 3) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++) {
        uint32_t a = cb->trace_attribs[i], stream = a >> 8 & 0x1F;
        /* the 4-bone program: position at 0, weights and bone indices in any format and place */
        if (vs == SKINNED4_VS ? (i >= 3 ? (a & 0xFF) != 0 : i == 0 ? (a & ~(0x1Fu << 8)) != want[0] : !(a & 0xFF))
                              : (i >= 3 ? (a & 0xFF) != 0 : (a & ~(0x1Fu << 8)) != want[i]))
            return 0;
        if (i < 3 && (stream >= 4 || cb->trace_vb[stream] != cb->trace_vb[0] ||
                      (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[stream] != (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[0]))
            return 0;
    }
    const Caster *c = caster_of(obj, sub);
    uint64_t data;
    uint32_t size;
    reject = R_PALETTE;
    if (!c || !palette_of(c, &data, &size) || !cb->trace_ub[0][4] ||
        !palette_close((const float *)(uintptr_t)data, (const float *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[0][4], size))
        return 0;
    if (fs == FADE_FS) {
        float fade;
        reject = R_FADE;
        if (!cb->trace_ub[1][3]) return 0;
        memcpy(&fade, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(cb->trace_ub[1][3] + 28), 4);
        if (fade != 1.0f) return 0;
    }
    if (vs == SKINNED4_VS) {  /* the weights' and bone indices' formats and offsets, for our draw */
        uint32_t a1 = cb->trace_attribs[1], a2 = cb->trace_attribs[2];
        cut->uv_format = a1 & 0xFF, cut->uv_offset = a1 >> 13;
        cut->wind_format = a2 & 0xFF, cut->wind_offset = a2 >> 13;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* A cut-out draw's texture, threshold and texture coordinates, as the game bound them; 0 if
 * its vertex layout isn't the one our pass reads: position (0x22) at 0 and texture
 * coordinates in attribute 1, both from one vertex buffer and stride. */
/* The guest address of the texels at a texture handle in a texture pool, 0 if none. */
static uint64_t slot_texture(const NvnDescPool *pool, uint64_t handle) {
    uint32_t id = (uint32_t)(handle & 0xFFFFF);
    if (!pool || !pool->entries || (int)id >= pool->count) return 0;
    const NvnTexEntry *e = (const NvnTexEntry *)pool->entries + id;
    return e->tex ? e->tex->addr : 0;
}

static void note_texture(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, Cutout *cut) {
    cut->pool = cb->trace_texpool;
    cut->tex_addr = slot_texture(cut->pool, cut->texture);
    const NvnDescPool *sp = cb->trace_samplerpool;
    uint32_t sid = (uint32_t)(cut->texture >> 20 & 0xFFF);
    cut->has_sampler = sp && sp->entries && (int)sid < sp->count;
    if (cut->has_sampler) cut->sampler = ((const NvnSamplerDesc *)sp->entries)[sid];
}

static int cutout_of(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, Cutout *cut) {
    uint32_t a0 = cb->trace_attribs[0], a1 = cb->trace_attribs[1];
    if (cb->trace_nattribs < 2 || (a0 & 0xFF) != 0x22 || a0 >> 8 & 0x1F || a0 >> 13) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 2; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++)
        if (cb->trace_attribs[i] & 0xFF) return 0;
    uint32_t stream = a1 >> 8 & 0x1F;
    if (!(a1 & 0xFF) || stream >= 4 || cb->trace_vb[stream] != cb->trace_vb[0] ||
        (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[stream] != (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[0])
        return 0;
    if (!cb->trace_tex[1][0] || !cb->trace_ub[0][3]) return 0;
    cut->texture = cb->trace_tex[1][0];
    note_texture(cb, cut);
    memcpy(&cut->threshold, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(cb->trace_ub[0][3] + 12), 4);
    cut->uv_format = a1 & 0xFF;
    cut->uv_offset = a1 >> 13;
    return 1;
}

static uint64_t wind_tex[2];  /* the wind draws' vs textures 11 and 12, learned from them */

/* A wind-swayed draw our pass can repeat: position (0x22) at 0, wind weights in attribute 1 and
 * texture coordinates in attribute 2, all from one vertex buffer and stride; the leaf texture
 * and threshold as for cut-out casters; both wind textures bound (one texture each everywhere,
 * it seems: the latest handles, and a word if another texture turns up). */
static int wind_of(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, Cutout *cut) {
    uint32_t a0 = cb->trace_attribs[0], a1 = cb->trace_attribs[1], a2 = cb->trace_attribs[2];
    if (cb->trace_nattribs < 3 || (a0 & 0xFF) != 0x22 || a0 >> 8 & 0x1F || a0 >> 13) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 3; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++)
        if (cb->trace_attribs[i] & 0xFF) return 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < 3; i++) {
        uint32_t a = cb->trace_attribs[i], stream = a >> 8 & 0x1F;
        if (!(a & 0xFF) || stream >= 4 || cb->trace_vb[stream] != cb->trace_vb[0] ||
            (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[stream] != (uint32_t)cb->trace_streams[0])
            return 0;
    }
    if (!cb->trace_tex[1][0] || !cb->trace_ub[0][3] || !cb->trace_tex[0][11] || !cb->trace_tex[0][12]) return 0;
    cut->texture = cb->trace_tex[1][0];
    note_texture(cb, cut);
    memcpy(&cut->threshold, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(cb->trace_ub[0][3] + 12), 4);
    cut->uv_format = a2 & 0xFF, cut->uv_offset = a2 >> 13;
    cut->wind_format = a1 & 0xFF, cut->wind_offset = a1 >> 13;
    for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
        uint64_t was = __atomic_exchange_n(&wind_tex[t], cb->trace_tex[0][11 + t], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        static int shown;
        if (was && (was & 0xFFFFF) != (cb->trace_tex[0][11 + t] & 0xFFFFF) && shown++ < 5)
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: another wind texture %d: %#" PRIx64 " (was %#" PRIx64 ")\n", 11 + t,
                    cb->trace_tex[0][11 + t], was);
    }
    return 1;
}

static uint64_t fade_dither;  /* the fading draws' dither texture, learned from them */

/* A fading instanced draw our pass can repeat: its dither texture bound (fs slot 18), the
 * material's own fade (fs cbuf 3 byte 28) at 1, so that only the copies' fades remain, and for
 * the cut-out one the cut-out layout and data. */
static int fading_of(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t fs, Cutout *cut) {
    float fade;
    if (!cb->trace_tex[1][18] || !cb->trace_ub[1][3]) return 0;
    memcpy(&fade, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(cb->trace_ub[1][3] + 28), 4);
    if (fade != 1.0f || (fs == FADE_CUTOUT_FS && !cutout_of(cb, cut))) return 0;
    cut->dither = cb->trace_tex[1][18];
    /* one dither texture for every fading draw, it seems (handle: texture id | sampler << 20; the
     * sampler changes, and texelFetch doesn't use it): the latest handle; say so if another
     * texture turns up */
    uint64_t was = __atomic_exchange_n(&fade_dither, cut->dither, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    static int shown;
    if (was && (was & 0xFFFFF) != (cut->dither & 0xFFFFF) && shown++ < 5)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: another dither texture %#" PRIx64 " (was %#" PRIx64 ")\n", cut->dither, was);
    return 1;
}

void shadow_check_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t index_addr, const ShadowDrawCall *call) {
    if (!lay || !lay->active || !lay->pending) return;
    lay->pending = 0;
    uint64_t obj = lay->drawn[lay->ndrawn - 1][0], sub = lay->drawn[lay->ndrawn - 1][1];
    uint64_t vs = cb->program ? cb->program->stages[0].key : 0, fs = cb->program ? cb->program->stages[1].key : 0;
    if (is_instanced(vs) && lay->pending_copies_ok) {  /* the copies ours() takes, as the game then drew */
        __atomic_add_fetch(&pending_checked, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (lay->pending_count != call->instances || !cb->trace_ub[0][11] ||
            memcmp(lay->pending_copies, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cb->trace_ub[0][11], 48ull * lay->pending_count))
            __atomic_add_fetch(&pending_wrong, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    Cutout cut = {0};
    reject = R_PROGRAM;
    int ok = mirrored(vs, fs) &&
             (reject = R_LAYOUT, fs != CUTOUT_FS || (is_wind(vs) ? wind_of(cb, &cut) : cutout_of(cb, &cut))) &&
             (reject = R_FADE, !is_fading(vs) || fading_of(cb, fs, &cut)) &&
             (reject = R_SKINNED, !is_skinned(vs) || skinned_ok(cb, obj, sub, vs, fs, &cut)) &&
             compare_draw(cb, obj, sub, index_addr, call, is_instanced(vs) ? 1 : vs == WIND_VS ? 2 : 0);
    learn(obj, sub, vs, fs, ok, cb->polygon, &cut);
    if (!ok) note_other(vs, fs, reject);
    /* the pass draws where the game's draws in this layer went: a cascade's layers can have
     * different targets (cutscenes: two layers per cascade, two shadow maps) */
    if (lay->pass) {
        lay->pass->depth_addr = cb->depth_addr;
        lay->pass->depth_layer = cb->depth_layer;
    }
    if (lay->cascade >= 0) {
```
