```c
        cascade_target[lay->cascade].addr = cb->depth_addr;
        cascade_target[lay->cascade].layer = cb->depth_layer;
        cascade_target[lay->cascade].known = 1;
    }
}


/* ---- native passes: a ring of pass buffers, reused after RING passes (about 20 frames:
 * long after the GPU has run them) */

static ShadowPass *new_pass(void) {
    static ShadowPass *ring[RING];
    static unsigned next;
    ShadowPass **p = &ring[next++ % RING];
    if (!*p && !(*p = malloc(sizeof **p + PASS_DRAWS * sizeof(ShadowDraw)))) return NULL;
    (*p)->n = 0;
    return *p;
}

/* Index type of a submesh (+0x3f bit 1, through the table at main+0x12c22b0: 16 or 32 bit). */
static uint32_t index_type(uint64_t sub) { return U8(sub + 0x3f) & 2 ? 2 : 1; }

/* How our pass would draw this submesh (0: it can't): a triangle list, from the geometry's
 * buffers, with projection x view x the node's own object's world matrix. */
/* The caster's world: the renderer's for the submesh being drawn, else its object's. */
static Mat4 world_of(const Caster *c) { return lay && lay->have_world ? lay->world : load(c->own); }

static int describe(const Caster *c, const Mat4 *vp, ShadowDraw *d) {
    if (U8(c->submesh + 0x3d) != 1) return 0;  /* primitive table index 1: triangle list */
    uint64_t bufs = U64(c->geometry + 0x20);
    if (!bufs) return 0;
    Mat4 world = world_of(c), mvp = mul(vp, &world);
    d->vertices = U64(bufs) + *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->submesh;
    /* the geometry's index buffer object (+0x28), as the submesh draw finds it: usually the second
     * object of the vertex buffer's record (+0x68 of it), not always */
    uint64_t ib = U64(c->geometry + 0x28);
    d->indices = ib ? U64(ib) + *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(c->submesh + 4) : 0;
    d->vertex_count = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(c->submesh + 8);
    d->index_count = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(c->submesh + 0xc);
    d->stride = U8(c->submesh + 0x3e);
    d->index_type = index_type(c->submesh);
    d->texture = 0, d->threshold = 0, d->uv_format = d->uv_offset = 0;
    d->palette_offset = d->palette_size = 0;
    d->dither = 0, d->first_copy = d->copies = 0, d->skin4 = 0;
    d->wind_tex[0] = d->wind_tex[1] = 0, d->wind_format = d->wind_offset = d->wind_header = 0;
    memcpy(d->mvp, mvp.m, sizeof d->mvp);
    return d->stride && (d->index_count ? d->indices != 0 : d->vertex_count != 0);
}

/* The copies the game's instance callback kept for the draw it is about to make: the model
 * renderer has put the callback's buffer object in vertex constant slot 11 and the count at
 * device+0x45cc before it calls the submesh draw. 0 if there is none. */
static const void *bound_constants(uint64_t device, int slot);
static int pending_copies(uint64_t device, const float **data, uint32_t *count) {
    if (!(*data = bound_constants(device, 11))) return 0;
    *count = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(device + 0x45cc);
    return *count != 0;
}

/* The CPU data of the buffer object bound to vertex constant slot `slot` in the engine state
 * (device+13000, 0x18 bytes per slot; data at [B+0x40] + [B+0x58]); NULL if none. */
static const void *bound_constants(uint64_t device, int slot) {
    uint64_t b = U64(device + 13000 + 0x18ull * slot);
    if (!b || !U64(b + 0x40)) return NULL;
    return (const void *)(uintptr_t)(U64(b + 0x40) + *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(b + 0x58));
}

/* Is the submesh ours (the game drew it with programs we mirror), and how do we draw it?
 * Appends its draw to d (at most `room`; an instanced one with its copies in the copies ring) and returns
 * how many; -1: the game must draw it. */
static int env_on(const char *name) {
    const char *s = getenv(name);
    return s && atoi(s);
}

static uint64_t last_shadow_frame;  /* the last presented frame a shadow layer started in */
static uint64_t game_draws_until;   /* until this frame the game draws every caster (after a gap: a menu) */
/* (Cutscenes were given back to the game's shadows from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-04: our casters were missing from the
 * game's copy of each layer into a second map. shadow_before_targets fixed that; decision 0024.) */

/* The game's draws left to it, for narrowing down a fault by elimination:
 * YW4_SHADOWS_NO_SKINNED=1 (characters), YW4_SHADOWS_NO_CUTOUT=1 (cut-out casters),
 * YW4_SHADOWS_NO_INSTANCED=1 (repeated props), YW4_SHADOWS_NO_WIND=1 (plants). */
static int leave_to_game(uint64_t vs, uint64_t fs) {
    static int no_skinned = -1, no_cutout = -1, no_instanced = -1, no_wind = -1;
    if (no_skinned < 0) no_skinned = env_on("YW4_SHADOWS_NO_SKINNED");
    if (no_cutout < 0) no_cutout = env_on("YW4_SHADOWS_NO_CUTOUT");
    if (no_instanced < 0) no_instanced = env_on("YW4_SHADOWS_NO_INSTANCED");
    if (no_wind < 0) no_wind = env_on("YW4_SHADOWS_NO_WIND");
    return (no_skinned && is_skinned(vs)) || (no_cutout && (fs == CUTOUT_FS || fs == FADE_CUTOUT_FS)) ||
           (no_instanced && is_instanced(vs)) || (no_wind && is_wind(vs));
}

static int copies_known(const Copies *cp, const float *game, uint32_t n);

/* A wind-swayed submesh (one learned as ours, `one` described): one draw, with a header in the
 * copies ring holding the wind constants as bound now (vs cbuf 6 rows 36, 47, cbuf 7 rows 0, 3:
 * equal to the game's draw in all of 50,000 checked), then per copy its copy x world rows (or the
 * world's alone without copies), as shadow_wind.vert reads them; projection x view in mvp. */
static int wind_draw(const Caster *c, const Mat4 *vp, uint64_t device, uint64_t vs, const ShadowDraw *one,
                     ShadowDraw *d, int room) {
    const float *c6 = bound_constants(device, 6), *c7 = bound_constants(device, 7);
    uint64_t t11 = __atomic_load_n(&wind_tex[0], __ATOMIC_RELAXED), t12 = __atomic_load_n(&wind_tex[1], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (room < 1 || !c6 || !c7 || !t11 || !t12 || !one->texture) return -1;
    const float *copies = NULL;
    uint32_t count = 1, first;
    if (vs == WIND_INSTANCED_VS) {  /* the copies the game would draw, as for the other instanced casters */
        Copies cp;
        if (!pending_copies(device, &copies, &count) || instances(c->model, &cp) != 1 || count > cp.count ||
            !copies_known(&cp, copies, 1) || !copies_known(&cp, copies + 12 * (count - 1), 1))
            return -1;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++)  /* no wind program decodes a nudged copy */
            if (copies[12 * i] >= 100.0f || copies[12 * i] <= -100.0f) return -1;
    }
    ShadowCopy *out = gpu_shadow_copies(count + 1, &first);
    if (!out) return -1;
    memcpy(out[0].mvp, c6 + 4 * 36, 16), memcpy(out[0].mvp + 4, c6 + 4 * 47, 16);
    memcpy(out[0].mvp + 8, c7, 16), memcpy(out[0].mvp + 12, c7 + 4 * 3, 16);
    Mat4 world = world_of(c);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        Mat4 m = world;
        if (copies) {
            Mat4 e = {{0}};
            memcpy(e.m, copies + 12 * i, 48);
            e.m[15] = 1;
            m = mul(&e, &world);
        }
        memcpy(out[1 + i].mvp, m.m, sizeof m.m);
        out[1 + i].fade = 1;
    }
    d[0] = *one;
    memcpy(d[0].mvp, vp->m, sizeof d[0].mvp);
    d[0].first_copy = first + 1, d[0].copies = count, d[0].wind_header = first;
    d[0].wind_tex[0] = t11, d[0].wind_tex[1] = t12;
    return 1;
}

static int ours(const Caster *c, const Mat4 *vp, uint64_t device, ShadowDraw *d, int room) {
    uint32_t h = learned_ours(c->object, c->submesh);
    ShadowDraw one;
    if (h == UINT32_MAX || leave_to_game(learned[h].vs, learned[h].fs) || !describe(c, vp, &one)) return -1;
    one.cull = learned[h].cull, one.front = learned[h].front;
    one.texture = learned[h].cut.texture, one.threshold = learned[h].cut.threshold;
    {
        static int use = -1;  /* YW4_SHADOW_KEEP_SAMPLER=0: the sampler the handle's slot names now (tests) */
        if (use < 0) use = !(getenv("YW4_SHADOW_KEEP_SAMPLER") && *getenv("YW4_SHADOW_KEEP_SAMPLER") == '0');
        one.has_sampler = use && learned[h].cut.has_sampler;
        if (one.has_sampler) memcpy(one.sampler, &learned[h].cut.sampler, sizeof learned[h].cut.sampler);
    }
    one.uv_format = learned[h].cut.uv_format, one.uv_offset = learned[h].cut.uv_offset;    if (one.texture && one.uv_offset + 4 > one.stride) return -1;
    if (is_wind(learned[h].vs)) {
        one.wind_format = learned[h].cut.wind_format, one.wind_offset = learned[h].cut.wind_offset;
        if (one.wind_offset + 4 > one.stride) return -1;
        return wind_draw(c, vp, device, learned[h].vs, &one, d, room);
    }
    if (learned[h].vs == SKINNED4_VS) {  /* weights and bone indices as the game's layout had them */
        one.skin4 = 1;
        one.wind_format = learned[h].cut.wind_format, one.wind_offset = learned[h].cut.wind_offset;
        if (one.uv_offset + 4 > one.stride || one.wind_offset + 4 > one.stride) return -1;
    }
    if (is_skinned(learned[h].vs)) {
        /* the palette the game's draw would use, copied for ours: the snapshot the model renderer
         * bound to vs cbuf 4 (equal to the game's draw in every check; the submesh's own buffer
         * that palette_of finds is being written with the next pose and matched about half the
         * time, so the shadow's pose lagged and jumped) */
        uint64_t data;
        const void *pose = bound_constants(device, 4);
        if (room < 1 || !pose || !palette_of(c, &data, &one.palette_size) ||
            !gpu_shadow_palette(pose, one.palette_size, &one.palette_offset))
            return -1;
    }
    if (!is_instanced(learned[h].vs)) {
        if (room < 1) return -1;
        d[0] = one;
        return 1;
    }
    /* exactly the copies the game would draw: its callback culled them (side planes, near and
     * far, occlusion); copies crossing the cascade projection's eye plane would come out as
     * long streaks. They must be the model's own, or the game draws it: checked for the first and
     * the last (every copy was, in 100,000+ checked draws; all of them cost up to 64 x 64
     * compares a draw). One draw for all of them, as the game's. */
    const float *copies;
    uint32_t count, first;
    Copies cp;
    if (room < 1 || !pending_copies(device, &copies, &count) || instances(c->model, &cp) != 1 || count > cp.count ||
        !copies_known(&cp, copies, 1) || !copies_known(&cp, copies + 12 * (count - 1), 1))
        return -1;
    /* a copy the callback nudged (flag x 100 added to its first value: fading) makes the game
     * draw with the fading program, never with the plain instanced ones (drawn raw it stretches
     * across the layer). Learning sees the program change only one frame in 32, so every draw
     * decides as the game does: any nudged copy, and all copies are decoded as the fading vertex
     * program does, in the same float operations, and drawn with the dither. */
    int fading = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) fading |= copies[12 * i] >= 100.0f || copies[12 * i] <= -100.0f;
    uint64_t dither = __atomic_load_n(&fade_dither, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (fading && !dither) return -1;  /* no fading draw learned yet */
    ShadowCopy *out = gpu_shadow_copies(count, &first);
    if (!out) return -1;
    Mat4 world = world_of(c);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        Mat4 e = {{0}};
        memcpy(e.m, copies + 12 * i, 48);
        e.m[15] = 1;
        float fade = 1;
        if (fading) {
            float v = e.m[0] * 0.00999999978f, a = fabsf(v);
            float sign = (float)((e.m[0] < 0.0f ? -1 : 0) - (e.m[0] > 0.0f ? -1 : 0));
            e.m[0] = (a - floorf(a)) * sign * 100.0f;
            fade = floorf(a) * 0.00392156886f;
        }
        Mat4 ew = mul(&e, &world), mvp = mul(vp, &ew);
        memcpy(out[i].mvp, mvp.m, sizeof out[i].mvp);
        out[i].fade = fade;
    }
    d[0] = one;
    d[0].first_copy = first, d[0].copies = count, d[0].dither = fading ? dither : 0;
    return 1;
}

/* Is each of the n copies the game drew (48 bytes each at `game`) one of ours? */
static int copies_known(const Copies *cp, const float *game, uint32_t n) {
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        int found = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cp->count && !found; i++) {
            Mat4 e = instance_matrix(cp, i);
            found = !memcmp(e.m, game + 12 * j, 48);
        }
        if (!found) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static float max_diff(const float *a, const float *b, int n, float *scale) {
    float err = 0;
    *scale = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float e = a[i] - b[i], s = b[i] < 0 ? -b[i] : b[i];
        if ((e < 0 ? -e : e) > err) err = e < 0 ? -e : e;
        if (s > *scale) *scale = s;
    }
    return err;
}

/* Check mode, an instanced object: is its box (local space) one copy's, or does it hold all
 * the copies' positions (the group's)? Decides how to cull copies. Logged for a few objects. */
static void log_instance_box(const Caster *c, const Copies *cp) {
    static int shown;
    if (shown >= 8) return;
    float lo[3], hi[3];
    memcpy(lo, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(c->object + 0x80), 12);
    memcpy(hi, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(c->object + 0x90), 12);
    uint32_t inside = 0, nudged = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cp->count; i++) {
        Mat4 e = instance_matrix(cp, i);
        float t[3] = {e.m[3], e.m[7], e.m[11]};
        inside += t[0] >= lo[0] && t[0] <= hi[0] && t[1] >= lo[1] && t[1] <= hi[1] && t[2] >= lo[2] && t[2] <= hi[2];
        nudged += cp->nudge && (e.m[0] >= 100.0f || e.m[0] <= -100.0f);
    }
    Mat4 e0 = instance_matrix(cp, 0);
    shown++;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: instanced object %#" PRIx64 ": %u copies (%u nudged), %u placed inside its box "
            "(%.2f %.2f %.2f .. %.2f %.2f %.2f); copy 0 at %.2f %.2f %.2f\n", c->object, cp->count, nudged, inside,
            lo[0], lo[1], lo[2], hi[0], hi[1], hi[2], e0.m[3], e0.m[7], e0.m[11]);
}

/* The game drew (obj, sub) with a program our pass mirrors; would our draw be the same? The
 * vertex and index addresses must be equal, and the matrices: static, ours = vs cbuf 2 byte
 * 128; instanced (1), the world = cbuf 2 byte 0, projection x view = cbuf 1 byte 128, the copies
 * = cbuf 11 and the draw's instance count, counted from vertex 0; 2: as instanced, no copies. */
static int compare_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t obj, uint64_t sub, uint64_t index_addr,
                        const ShadowDrawCall *call, int instanced) {
    const Caster *c = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < lay->ours.n && !c; i++)
        if (lay->ours.c[i].object == obj && lay->ours.c[i].submesh == sub) c = &lay->ours.c[i];
    ShadowDraw d;
    uint64_t ub = cb->trace_ub[0][2];
    if (!c) return reject = R_CASTER, 0;
    if (!describe(c, &lay->vp, &d) || !ub) return reject = R_DESCRIBE, 0;
    const float *game = (const float *)(uintptr_t)(ub + 128);
    float err, scale;
    int bad_inst = 0;
    if (!instanced) {
        err = max_diff(d.mvp, game, 16, &scale);
    } else {
        uint64_t vp_ub = cb->trace_ub[0][1], game_copies = cb->trace_ub[0][11];
        Copies cp;
        float s2;
        Mat4 world = world_of(c);
        err = max_diff(world.m, (const float *)(uintptr_t)ub, 16, &scale);
        if (vp_ub) {
            float e2 = max_diff(lay->vp.m, (const float *)(uintptr_t)(vp_ub + 128), 16, &s2);
            if (e2 / (s2 > 1 ? s2 : 1) > err / (scale > 1 ? scale : 1)) err = e2, scale = s2;
        } else {
            err = 1e30f;
        }
        if (instanced == 1) {  /* 2: world and projection x view only (WIND_VS) */
            /* the game drew the copies its callback kept: each must be one of ours */
            bad_inst = instances(c->model, &cp) != 1 || !game_copies || call->base_vertex != 0 ||
                       call->instances > cp.count || !copies_known(&cp, (const float *)(uintptr_t)game_copies, call->instances);
            __atomic_add_fetch(&compared_inst, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            __atomic_add_fetch(&wrong_inst, bad_inst, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            static int shown_inst;
            if (mode == MODE_CHECK && bad_inst && shown_inst++ < 5)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: check: instanced object %#" PRIx64 ": %u copies of ours (found: %d) vs the "
                        "game's %u at %#" PRIx64 " (base vertex %d; model sets %u +0x216 %u +0x218 %u)\n", obj,
                        instances(c->model, &cp) == 1 ? cp.count : 0, instances(c->model, &cp), call->instances,
                        game_copies, call->base_vertex, U8(c->model + 0x214), U8(c->model + 0x216), U8(c->model + 0x218));
            if (!bad_inst) {
                Mat4 world = world_of(c);
                for (uint32_t j = 0; j < call->instances; j++) {
                    Mat4 e, ew, mvp;
                    memcpy(e.m, (const float *)(uintptr_t)game_copies + 12 * j, 48);
                    e.m[12] = e.m[13] = e.m[14] = 0, e.m[15] = 1;
                    ew = mul(&e, &world), mvp = mul(&lay->vp, &ew);
                    if (outside(c->object, &mvp)) __atomic_add_fetch(&copies_culled, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
                }
            }
            if (mode == MODE_CHECK && !bad_inst) log_instance_box(c, &cp);
        }
    }
    int bad_vb = d.vertices != cb->trace_vb0, bad_ib = d.index_count && d.indices != index_addr;
    int bad_mvp = err > 1e-4f * (scale > 1 ? scale : 1);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&compared, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&wrong_vb, bad_vb, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&wrong_ib, bad_ib, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&wrong_mvp, bad_mvp, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    reject = bad_inst ? R_COPIES : bad_vb ? R_VB : bad_ib ? R_IB : R_MATRIX;
    if (bad_inst) return 0;
    static int shown;
    if (mode == MODE_CHECK && !instanced && (bad_vb || bad_ib || bad_mvp) && shown++ < 5) {
        Mat4 w2 = load(c->object), m2 = mul(&lay->vp, &w2);
        float err2 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            float e = m2.m[i] - game[i];
            if ((e < 0 ? -e : e) > err2) err2 = e < 0 ? -e : e;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: check: object %#" PRIx64 " (own %#" PRIx64 ") submesh %#" PRIx64 ": vertices %#"
                PRIx64 " vs the game's %#" PRIx64 ", indices %#" PRIx64 " vs %#" PRIx64 ", matrix off by %g (with the "
                "redirected object's world: %g)\n", obj, c->own, sub, d.vertices, cb->trace_vb0, d.indices, index_addr,
                err, err2);
        /* the world matrix the game used: inverse(projection x view) x its matrix */
        Mat4 g, inv;
        memcpy(g.m, game, sizeof g.m);
        if (invert(&lay->vp, &inv)) {
            Mat4 x = mul(&inv, &g);
            const float *w = (const float *)(uintptr_t)c->own;
            for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows:   world used row %d: %9.4f %9.4f %9.4f %9.4f | object+0: %9.4f %9.4f %9.4f "
                        "%9.4f | +0x40: %9.4f %9.4f %9.4f %9.4f\n", r, x.m[r * 4], x.m[r * 4 + 1], x.m[r * 4 + 2],
                        x.m[r * 4 + 3], w[r * 4], w[r * 4 + 1], w[r * 4 + 2], w[r * 4 + 3], w[16 + r * 4],
                        w[16 + r * 4 + 1], w[16 + r * 4 + 2], w[16 + r * 4 + 3]);
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows:   submesh +0x38 %u +0x42 %u +0x43 %u\n", U8(sub + 0x38), U8(sub + 0x42),
                    U8(sub + 0x43));
        }
    }
    return !bad_vb && !bad_ib && !bad_mvp;
}

/* Native mode: the pass our replaced draws go into, for the cascade's layer. */
static void begin_pass(Layer *k) {
    k->pass = NULL;
    k->game_drew = 0;
    if (k->cascade < 0 || !cascade_target[k->cascade].known) return;  /* the game hasn't shown us the target yet */
    ShadowPass *p = new_pass();
    if (!p) return;
    p->depth_addr = cascade_target[k->cascade].addr;
    p->depth_layer = cascade_target[k->cascade].layer;
    k->pass = p;
}

/* nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets is about to be recorded in cmd (nvn_cmdbuf.c): if the open shadow layer's pass
 * still waits and the game moves to another depth target, our pass goes in now, while its target is bound. In
 * cutscenes the game copies each finished layer into a second map (0x726fe2f000, one full-screen draw, fs
 * 6b4575fb57b97548) before the next layer starts: queued only then, our casters were missing from that copy, and
 * the characters, which read it, were lit (2026-11-04, found with the same-frame A/B; the 2026-11-01 "dark frame
 * every 32" was the one frame the game drew the cut-out caster itself, before the copy). Draws the layer still gets
 * after this are the game's. */
void shadow_before_targets(const CPUState *ctx, uint64_t cmd, uint64_t depth_addr, uint32_t depth_layer) {
    Layer *k = lay;
    if (!k || !k->active || !k->pass || !k->pass->n || mode != MODE_NATIVE) return;
    if (U64(k->device + 0x10d0) + 0xd8 != cmd) return;  /* another thread's command buffer */
    ShadowPass *p = k->pass;
    if (depth_addr == p->depth_addr && depth_layer == p->depth_layer) return;  /* still the layer's target */
    static int off = -1;  /* YW4_SHADOW_EARLY_PASS=0: the old order (tests) */
    if (off < 0) off = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_EARLY_PASS") && *getenv("YW4_SHADOW_EARLY_PASS") == '0';
    if (off) return;
    __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_native, p->n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_since_toggle, p->n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    nvn_record_native(ctx, cmd, gpu_shadow_pass, &p, sizeof p);
    k->pass = NULL;
    static long early;
    if (early++ < 3)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: our pass queued before the game moved to target %#" PRIx64 "/%u (%u draws)\n",
                depth_addr, depth_layer, p->n);
}

/* The layer has been drawn by the game: queue our pass after it. */
static void end_layer(Layer *k, const CPUState *ctx) {
    if (!k->active) return;
    k->active = 0;
    static int recheck_log = -1;
    if (recheck_log < 0) recheck_log = env_on("YW4_SHADOW_RECHECK_LOG");
    if (recheck_log && mode == MODE_NATIVE) {
        uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: recheck: frame %" PRIu64 " cascade %d target %#" PRIx64 "/%u: game drew %d (rechecks %d), ours %u%s",
                f, k->cascade, k->pass ? k->pass->depth_addr : 0, k->pass ? k->pass->depth_layer : 0, k->ndrawn,
                k->nrecheck, k->pass ? k->pass->n : 0, ctx ? "" : " (not queued)");
        for (int i = 0; i < k->nrecheck && i < 4; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %#" PRIx64, k->recheck_obj[i]);
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        /* what was learned of the first rechecked object's submeshes (the game's draw just now) */
        for (int i = 0; i < k->nrecheck && i < 32; i++) {
            uint32_t h = learn_slot(k->recheck_obj[0], k->recheck_sub[i]);
            if (h == UINT32_MAX || learned[h].obj != k->recheck_obj[0]) continue;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: recheck:   submesh %#" PRIx64 ": vs %016" PRIx64 " fs %016" PRIx64 " ok %d cull %u front %u"
                    " texture %#" PRIx64 " threshold %g uv format %#x at %u stride %u caster %d\n", k->recheck_sub[i],
                    learned[h].vs, learned[h].fs, learned[h].ok, learned[h].cull, learned[h].front, learned[h].cut.texture,
                    learned[h].cut.threshold, learned[h].cut.uv_format, learned[h].cut.uv_offset, U8(k->recheck_sub[i] + 0x3e),
                    caster_of(k->recheck_obj[0], k->recheck_sub[i]) != NULL);
        }
    }
    k->nrecheck = 0;
    __atomic_add_fetch(&layers_seen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&ours_total, k->ours.n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&drawn_total, k->ndrawn, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (mode == MODE_CHECK) compare(k);
    if (k->pass && k->pass->n && ctx) {
        ShadowPass *p = k->pass;
        __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_native, p->n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_since_toggle, p->n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        nvn_record_native(ctx, U64(k->device + 0x10d0) + 0xd8, gpu_shadow_pass, &p, sizeof p);
    }
    k->pass = NULL;
}

/* ---- the mode: YW4_SHADOWS at start (default ours since 2026-10-29: about 10 frames/s more with everything else
 * maxed, owner; "game" for the game's), the settings panel (or a replay's "k <tick> F9") switches between the game's
 * shadows and ours while the game runs */

static void init_mode(void) {
    const char *s = getenv("YW4_SHADOWS");
    int m = s && !strcmp(s, "game") ? MODE_GAME : s && !strcmp(s, "check") ? MODE_CHECK : MODE_NATIVE;
    int unset = -1;
    if (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&mode, &unset, m, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    __atomic_store_n(&shadow_checking, m != MODE_GAME, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    /* which pass, and from what (a player's report says which they ran: owner, 2026-11-16) */
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: %s (SHADOW PASS %s; YW4_SHADOWS %s%s)\n",
            m == MODE_CHECK ? "checking the gather" : m == MODE_GAME ? "the game draws every shadow caster itself"
                                                                     : "our pass draws the casters it mirrors",
            m == MODE_GAME ? "GAME" : "CUSTOM", s ? "=" : "not set, the default", s ? s : "");
}

/* Our shadow pass in use, or the one YW4_SHADOWS gives once the first shadows are drawn (the mode is set only
 * then: before it, shadow_mode_name says ORIGINAL). For the log's picture line (gpu.c). */
int shadow_pass_ours(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (m < 0) {
        const char *s = getenv("YW4_SHADOWS");
        m = s && !strcmp(s, "game") ? MODE_GAME : s && !strcmp(s, "check") ? MODE_CHECK : MODE_NATIVE;
    }
    return m == MODE_NATIVE;
}

const char *shadow_mode_name(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    return m == MODE_NATIVE ? "CUSTOM" : m == MODE_CHECK ? "CHECK" : "ORIGINAL";
}

void shadow_toggle(void) {
    init_mode();
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == MODE_GAME ? MODE_NATIVE : MODE_GAME;
    /* a layer already begun keeps what it hid and queued: its cascade-end hook finishes it */
    __atomic_store_n(&shadow_checking, m != MODE_GAME, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&switches, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: switched to %s at frame %" PRIu64 " (SHADOW PASS %s, the settings or F9; %ld submeshes "
            "drawn by our pass since the last switch)\n", m == MODE_NATIVE ? "ours" : "the game's",
            __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), m == MODE_NATIVE ? "CUSTOM" : "GAME",
            __atomic_exchange_n(&draws_since_toggle, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
}

void shadow_summary_text(char *buf, size_t n) {
    long ps, ds[SHADOW_SKIP_N], dsum = 0;
    gpu_shadow_totals(&ps, ds);
    for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N; i++) dsum += ds[i];
    /* the totals added at each report, and what came since the last one */
    long layers = __atomic_load_n(&layers_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + __atomic_load_n(&layers_seen, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    long replaced = __atomic_load_n(&replaced_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + __atomic_load_n(&draws_replaced, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    long game = __atomic_load_n(&game_drew_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + __atomic_load_n(&drawn_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    size_t o = (size_t)snprintf(buf, n, "%s now, switched %ld time%s; with ours: %ld shadow layers, %ld of the game's draws "
                                "replaced, %ld drawn by the game; left out of ours: %ld passes, %ld draws",
                                m < 0 ? "no shadows drawn yet" : m == MODE_GAME ? "the game's pass" : "our pass",
                                __atomic_load_n(&switches, __ATOMIC_RELAXED),
                                __atomic_load_n(&switches, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == 1 ? "" : "s", layers, replaced, game, ps,
                                dsum);
    int listed = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < SHADOW_SKIP_N && o < n; i++)
        if (ds[i]) o += (size_t)snprintf(buf + o, n - o, "%s%s %ld", listed++ ? ", " : " (", shadow_skip_name[i], ds[i]);
    if (listed && o < n) snprintf(buf + o, n - o, ")");
}

/* ---- YW4_TRACE_LAYERS=<frame>: every layer the model renderer draws while presented frames
 * <frame> to <frame>+2 are current, one line each when the next layer starts on that thread: its
 * kind (+8), key range (+0xa, +0xc), mask (+0x10) and how many submeshes it drew. Maps layer kinds
 * to the GPU passes (the main view, docs/frame.md). */
extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */
static _Thread_local uint64_t trace_item;
static _Thread_local long trace_draws;

static int trace_layers_on(void) {
    static int from = -2;
    if (from == -2) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_TRACE_LAYERS");
        from = e && *e ? atoi(e) : -1;
    }
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    return from >= 0 && f >= (uint64_t)from && f < (uint64_t)from + 3;
}

static void trace_layer_start(const CPUState *ctx) {
    if (trace_item)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: layer t%04x item %#" PRIx64 " kind %u keys %u..%u mask %#x: %ld submeshes\n",
                (unsigned)((uintptr_t)ctx >> 4 & 0xFFFF), trace_item, U8(trace_item + 8), U16(trace_item + 0xa),
                U16(trace_item + 0xc), U8(trace_item + 0x10), trace_draws);
    trace_item = trace_layers_on() ? ctx->x[2] : 0;
    trace_draws = 0;
}

/* ---- hooks */

int yw4_hook_model_renderer(CPUState *ctx) {
    trace_layer_start(ctx);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) < 0) init_mode();
    /* A cascade's job list can draw more than one shadow layer (cutscenes: two per cascade) before
     * the cascade-end job: the next layer of the same cascade ends the previous one, which queues its
     * pass here, still inside the cascade's target. Anything else: not ended by its job, no pass.
     * Before the mode check: after switching to the game's shadows the next layer's draws must not be
     * taken for the open one's. */
    if (lay && lay->active) {
        uint64_t v = U64(ctx->x[0] + 0x2780);
        int c = v && U8(v) >= 1 && U8(v) <= 3 ? U8(v) - 1 : -1;
        int second = lay->device == ctx->x[0] && c >= 0 && c == lay->cascade;
        end_layer(lay, second ? ctx : NULL);
    }
    /* the G-buffer pass (decision 0026) shares these hooks. After the open shadow layer has queued its pass: the
     * same-frame A/B's range for that layer ends here, and must hold our pass (2026-11-04: in cutscenes the first
     * layer of a cascade's two was compared without our draws, a whole layer "wrong") */
    gbuffer_layer_start(ctx);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == MODE_GAME) return 0;
    uint64_t list = ctx->x[1], item = ctx->x[2];
    if (!item || U8(item + 8) != LAYER_SHADOW) return 0;
    {   /* after a stretch with no shadow layers (a menu: none while it is open and for the still frames after it),
         * the game draws every caster itself for a while (game_draws_until): with our pass the game's own draws
         * are skipped, and some of a caster's per-draw data is only brought up to date by them, so after a long menu
         * ours drew part of the casters from old data for about 35 frames (2026-11-04: shadow map 79% empty instead
         * of 61% on frames 4325-4340 after closing the Yo-kai Pad, shadows blinking off; each object's one game draw
         * in 32 put it right). Off by default since the cause was found (2026-11-04: the cut-out casters' sampler id
         * named a slot of the game's sampler ring that a menu had refilled; now the settings are learned, note_texture)
         * and the owner confirmed the Mirapo flash gone; YW4_SHADOW_REFRESH=33 brings it back for tests. */
        uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        uint64_t last = __atomic_exchange_n(&last_shadow_frame, f, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        static int refresh = -1;  /* YW4_SHADOW_REFRESH=<frames> (default 0: off) */
        if (refresh < 0) refresh = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_REFRESH") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_SHADOW_REFRESH")) : 0;
        if (last && f > last + 8 && refresh > 0) {
            __atomic_store_n(&game_draws_until, f + (uint64_t)refresh, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadows: refresh after a %" PRIu64 "-frame gap: the game draws every caster in frames %"
                    PRIu64 "-%" PRIu64 "\n", f - last, f, f + (uint64_t)refresh - 1);
        }
    }
    if (!lay && !(lay = calloc(1, sizeof *lay))) return 0;
    Layer *k = lay;
    k->device = ctx->x[0];
    uint64_t view = U64(k->device + 0x2780);
    k->cascade = view && U8(view) >= 1 && U8(view) <= 3 ? U8(view) - 1 : -1;
    /* the cascade's matrices, put in the render state by the game's job main+0x7ee510 */
    Mat4 proj = load(k->device + 0x280), viewm = load(k->device + 0x2c0);
    k->vp = mul(&proj, &viewm);
    gather(list, item, &k->vp, &k->ours);
    k->ndrawn = 0;
    k->pending = 0;
    if (mode == MODE_NATIVE) begin_pass(k);
    k->active = 1;
    report();
    return 0;
}

/* main+0xa75e90 (device, geometry, submesh): the model renderer's submesh draw. Noted (the
 * game's draw that follows is learned from); in native mode replaced by ours when we can. */
int yw4_hook_submesh_draw(CPUState *ctx) {
    trace_draws++;
    if (gbuffer_submesh(ctx)) return 1;  /* the takeover drew it (decision 0030) */
    if (!lay || !lay->active || lay->ndrawn >= MAX_CASTERS) return 0;
    static uint64_t base;
    if (!base)
        for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_ncode; i++)
            if (!strcmp(yw4_code[i].name, "main")) base = *yw4_code[i].base;
    uint64_t ret = ctx->x[30] - base;
    if (ret != 0xa4bf94 && ret != 0xa4c2d0) return 0;  /* from the model renderer */
    /* the object being drawn is in the model renderer's stack slot sp+0x390 */
    uint64_t obj = U64(ctx->sp + 0x390), sub = ctx->x[2];
    Layer *k = lay;
    memset(&k->world, 0, sizeof k->world);
    k->have_world = gbuffer_hook_world(ctx, k->world.m);
    k->world.m[15] = 1;
    ShadowPass *p = k->pass;
    uint64_t frame = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    int refreshing = frame < __atomic_load_n(&game_draws_until, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (mode == MODE_NATIVE && p && k->game_drew && ((frame + (obj >> 4)) & 31) != 0 &&
        !refreshing) {
        const Caster *c = caster_of(obj, sub);
        int n = c ? ours(c, &k->vp, k->device, &p->d[p->n], PASS_DRAWS - (int)p->n) : -1;
        if (n >= 0) {
            uint64_t cond_addr = 0;  /* the game's occlusion condition for this object goes with our draws */
            int cond_mode = nvn_record_condition(U64(k->device + 0x10d0) + 0xd8, &cond_addr);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                p->d[p->n + (uint32_t)i].cond_mode = (uint32_t)cond_mode, p->d[p->n + (uint32_t)i].cond_addr = cond_addr;
            p->n += (uint32_t)n;
            __atomic_add_fetch(&draws_replaced, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            /* YW4_SHADOWS_BOTH=1: the game draws too (ours on top), to tell our draws' errors
             * from the effects of skipping the game's draw */
            static int both = -1;
            if (both < 0) both = env_on("YW4_SHADOWS_BOTH");
            /* same-frame A/B of the shadow pass: the game's draw stays in the command list behind a marker, so
             * the A/B's second run can draw it; every other run skips it (gpu_shadow_game_draw) */
            static int ab = -1;
            if (ab < 0) ab = gpu_ab_wanted("shadow");
            if (ab && !both) {
                uint8_t z = 0;
                nvn_record_native(ctx, U64(k->device + 0x10d0) + 0xd8, gpu_shadow_game_draw, &z, 1);
                return 0;
            }
            if (!both) return gbuffer_disarm(), 1;  /* the game's draw is skipped */
        }
    } else if (mode == MODE_NATIVE && p && k->game_drew) {  /* a recheck: the game draws it */
        if (k->nrecheck < 4) k->recheck_obj[k->nrecheck] = obj;
        if (k->nrecheck < 32) k->recheck_sub[k->nrecheck] = sub;
        k->nrecheck++;
    }
    k->pending_copies_ok = pending_copies(k->device, &k->pending_copies, &k->pending_count);
    k->drawn[k->ndrawn][0] = obj;
    k->drawn[k->ndrawn][1] = sub;
    k->ndrawn++;
    k->pending = 1;
    k->game_drew = 1;
    return 0;
}

/* main+0x7ed350 (device, ...): the job that ends a cascade, right after its layer. */
int yw4_hook_cascade_end(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (lay && lay->active) end_layer(lay, ctx);
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/src/shadow.h`:

```h
/* Our shadow-caster pass (decision 0024): what the render thread gathers (shadow.c) for the
 * executor to draw (gpu_shadow.c). */
#ifndef YW4_SHADOW_H
#define YW4_SHADOW_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    uint64_t vertices, indices;          /* guest addresses (in the imported memory pools) */
    uint32_t vertex_count, index_count;  /* index_count 0: not indexed */
    uint32_t stride, index_type;         /* NVN index type: 1 = 16-bit, 2 = 32-bit */
    uint8_t cull, front;                 /* NVN polygon state bytes 0 and 1, as the game drew it */
    uint8_t skin4, pad;                  /* skinned with up to 4 bones (26b707): the weights' NVN format and
                                          * offset in uv_format/uv_offset, the bone indices' in
                                          * wind_format/wind_offset */
    float mvp[16];                       /* projection x view x world, row-major */
    float threshold;                     /* cut-out casters (texture != 0): the material's alpha threshold, */
    uint64_t texture;                    /* texture handle, and the texture coordinates' NVN format and */
    uint32_t uv_format, uv_offset;       /* offset in the vertex */
    uint32_t palette_offset, palette_size;  /* skinned casters (size != 0): the bones in the palette ring */
    uint32_t first_copy, copies;         /* instanced casters (copies != 0): their copies in the copies ring */
    uint64_t dither;                     /* fading ones (!= 0): the 16x16 dither texture's handle */
    /* wind-swayed casters (wind_tex[0] != 0; always cut-out, texture coordinates from attribute 2):
     * the copies hold copy x world rows (mvp: projection x view), a header entry the constants */
    uint64_t wind_tex[2];                /* vs textures 11 (noise) and 12 (wind map) */
    uint32_t wind_format, wind_offset;   /* the vertex's wind weights: NVN format, offset (attribute 1) */
    uint32_t wind_header;                /* the header's index in the copies ring */
    /* cut-out casters: the sampler settings (an NvnSamplerDesc) the game's draw used, copied when learned. The
     * handle's sampler id names a slot of a ring the game keeps rewriting: a menu fills it with its own samplers,
     * and through the old id the leaves were alpha-tested away for 20 frames after closing the Yo-kai Pad */
    uint32_t has_sampler;
    uint8_t sampler[64];
    /* the condition the game drew this caster under (SetRenderEnableConditional; gpu_query.c): 0 none, else
     * NVN's mode + 1 and the counter address. Ours is skipped on the GPU when the game's would be. */
    uint32_t cond_mode;
    uint64_t cond_addr;
} ShadowDraw;

/* One copy of an instanced caster in the copies ring (shadow_instanced.vert's Copy): projection x
 * view x copy x world, row-major, and its fade (1 when not fading). */
typedef struct {
    float mvp[16];
    float fade, pad[3];
} ShadowCopy;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t depth_addr;   /* the cascade's layer of the shadow map: the executor checks that the */
    uint32_t depth_layer;  /* game's commands left exactly this target bound */
    uint32_t n;
    ShadowDraw d[];
} ShadowPass;

/* A skinned caster's bone palette (size bytes, 3x4 per bone) copied into the executor's ring,
 * on the thread that gathers the pass; its offset there. 0 if it can't be. */
int gpu_shadow_palette(const void *src, uint32_t size, uint32_t *offset);
/* Room for n copies in the executor's copies ring, on the thread that gathers the pass; the
 * index of the first (the draw's first instance). NULL if n is too many. */
ShadowCopy *gpu_shadow_copies(uint32_t n, uint32_t *first);
/* CMD_NATIVE callback: `data` holds a ShadowPass pointer. */
void gpu_shadow_pass(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
void gpu_shadow_game_draw(void *vk_cb, void *gpu_state, const void *data, uint32_t size);
/* nvn_cmdbuf.c, before recording SetRenderTargets: queues the open shadow layer's pass if the target moves away */
void shadow_before_targets(const CPUState *ctx, uint64_t cmd, uint64_t depth_addr, uint32_t depth_layer);
/* Switch between the game's shadow casters and ours (shadow.c; the settings panel, a replay's F9) */
void shadow_toggle(void);
/* Our shadow pass in use, or the one YW4_SHADOWS will give once the first shadows are drawn (for the log). */
int shadow_pass_ours(void);
/* What our pass left out (gpu_shadow.c): whole passes, and single draws by why (shadow_skip_name). counts: since the
 * last call (shadow.c's report); totals: since the start. */
enum { SHADOW_SKIP_N = 7 };
extern const char *const shadow_skip_name[SHADOW_SKIP_N];
void gpu_shadow_counts(long *passes_skipped, long draws_skipped[SHADOW_SKIP_N]);
void gpu_shadow_totals(long *passes_skipped, long draws_skipped[SHADOW_SKIP_N]);
/* The shadow pass in one line for the log (shadow.c): which pass, and since the start how many of the game's draws ours
 * replaced, how many the game still drew, what ours left out, how often it was switched. For the run's summary
 * (perf.c) and a GPU crash's report (gpu.c). */
void shadow_summary_text(char *buf, size_t n);

#endif

```

`runtime/src/shadow_mask.c`:

```c
/* Our shadow mask, the engine side (docs/frame.md "Lighting stage").
 *
 * The engine's shadow mask is main+0x7f3e90(device, renderer): one half-size draw with the program
 * 98c09b/06d03ad7 that works out, per pixel, how much of the sun reaches the surface from the cascaded
 * shadow maps. Our readable version of its fragment program (runtime/shaders/shadow_mask.frag) is used
 * in place of the game's in that draw (gpu_draw.c); everything else (the draw, its inputs, the target)
 * stays the engine's.
 *
 * YW4_SHADOW_MASK=native: ours; YW4_SHADOW_MASK=game: the game's program. Default: ours; the settings panel
 * (F1, DEVELOPER OPTIONS, SHADOW MASK) switches while playing.
 * YW4_AB_AT=<GPU frames> with YW4_AB_PASS=shadowmask: in those frames the engine's pass runs twice from
 * the same images, ours and the game's, and the targets are compared texel by texel (gpu_ab.c): a hook
 * (recomp/overrides.toml) records the range's markers around the engine's function.
 *
 * Not bit-exact (2026-10-30, late-game save, 4K 21:9): the same operations in the same order, yet 2-4 of
 * 2.8 million texels per frame differ by one bit of the 11-bit result with soft shadows off (~130 with them
 * on: a hair's change tips the blocker search). Splicing the game's translated code into ours section by
 * section only moved the differences, with the same compiler and options: the driver optimises the two
 * equivalent programs a little differently. The owner accepted it (not visible).
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "gpu.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

enum { MODE_GAME, MODE_NATIVE };
static int mode = -1;
static _Thread_local int in_original;  /* the hook's own call of the engine's function */

#define U64(a) (*(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))

static int mask_mode(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (m >= 0) return m;
    const char *s = getenv("YW4_SHADOW_MASK");
    m = s && !strcmp(s, "game") ? MODE_GAME : MODE_NATIVE;
    int unset = -1;
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&mode, &unset, m, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && m != MODE_GAME)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadow mask: ours\n");
    return __atomic_load_n(&mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}

int shadow_mask_native(void) { return mask_mode() == MODE_NATIVE; }

void shadow_mask_toggle(void) {
    int m = shadow_mask_native() ? MODE_GAME : MODE_NATIVE;
    __atomic_store_n(&mode, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shadow mask: %s (settings panel)\n", m == MODE_NATIVE ? "ours" : "the game's");
}

int yw4_hook_shadow_mask(CPUState *ctx) {
    if (in_original || !gpu_ab_wanted("shadowmask")) return 0;
    static GuestFn original;
    if (!original) original = yw4_lookup(yw4_image_base + 0x7f3e90);
    if (!original) return 0;
    uint64_t cmd = U64(ctx->x[0] + 0x10d0) + 0xd8;  /* the device's command buffer */
    nvn_record_native(ctx, cmd, gpu_ab_native, "bshadowmask", 11);
    in_original = 1;
    original(ctx);
    in_original = 0;
    nvn_record_native(ctx, cmd, gpu_ab_native, "eshadowmask", 11);
    return 1;
}
```

`runtime/src/shortcutwheel.c`:

```c
/* The shortcut wheel: see shortcutwheel.h and decision 0075. */
#include "shortcutwheel.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "mousemenu.h"
#include "window.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

/* the Switch's button bits (bindings.c's inputs[]) */
#define BIT_L (1ull << 6)
#define BIT_LEFT (1ull << 12)
#define BIT_UP (1ull << 13)
#define BIT_RIGHT (1ull << 14)
#define BIT_DOWN (1ull << 15)
#define DPAD (BIT_LEFT | BIT_UP | BIT_RIGHT | BIT_DOWN)

/* The slots round the ring, clockwise from the top (the angle / 45): the D-pad's four on the straight lines as on
 * the pad (1 up, 2 right, 3 down, 4 left), the hold-L set's on the diagonals after each. The game's own names
 * (the English patch's help and tutorial text) and the D-pad direction each presses. */
typedef struct {
    int slot;
    const char *name;
    uint64_t dir;
    int with_l;
} Slot;
static const Slot ring[8] = {
    {1, "Auto-Navi", BIT_UP, 0},       {5, "Change Watchers", BIT_UP, 1},
    {2, "Diary", BIT_RIGHT, 0},        {6, "Mirapo", BIT_RIGHT, 1},
    {3, "Bike", BIT_DOWN, 0},          {7, "Change Yo-kai Companion", BIT_DOWN, 1},
    {4, "Naviwoof Guide", BIT_LEFT, 0}, {8, "Change Moves and Equipment", BIT_LEFT, 1},
};

static int enabled = 1;
int swheel_enabled(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&enabled, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }
void swheel_set_enabled(int on) { __atomic_store_n(&enabled, on ? 1 : 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

enum { IDLE, OPEN, PASS, FIRE };
static int state;     /* atomic: the drawing reads it */
static int picked;    /* atomic: the ring index pointed at, -1 the middle */
static float vx, vy;  /* the pointer, in mouse pixels from the middle (the window's thread) */
static int fire_ring;
static uint64_t fire_at;
/* for the animations (shortcutwheel.c's drawing): when it opened, when and how it closed (1 used, 2 any other
 * way), and the slot used */
static uint64_t open_ms, close_ms;
static int close_kind, close_ring;
static void closed(int kind, int ring_index) {
    __atomic_store_n(&close_ring, ring_index, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&close_ms, SDL_GetTicks(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&close_kind, kind, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

/* How far the mouse goes before it points at a slot, and how far the pointer can go (so turning back is quick). */
#define DEAD 100.0f  /* was 40: the pointer had to come closer to a slot before it picks (owner, 2026-11-16) */
#define REACH 140.0f

int swheel_open(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == OPEN; }

/* The pointer for the drawing (1/16 mouse pixels from the middle): a dot that follows the mouse from the middle, so
 * it moves before the lens snaps to a slot (owner, 2026-11-16). */
static int ptr_x, ptr_y;  /* atomic */

void swheel_motion(float dx, float dy) {
    vx += dx, vy += dy;
    float len = sqrtf(vx * vx + vy * vy);
    if (len > REACH) vx *= REACH / len, vy *= REACH / len, len = REACH;
    __atomic_store_n(&ptr_x, (int)(vx * 16), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&ptr_y, (int)(vy * 16), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    int p = -1;
    if (len >= DEAD) {
        float a = atan2f(vx, -vy) * (180.0f / 3.14159265f);  /* 0 up, clockwise */
        if (a < 0) a += 360.0f;
        p = (int)floorf((a + 22.5f) / 45.0f) % 8;
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&picked, p, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

/* The presses for a pick, by the game's input reads since it began: the hold-L set holds L first (as a player
 * would), then L and the direction; then all is let go for a few reads before the wheel can open again. The game
 * takes the hold-L four only once its HUD has turned to their page, about a second after L goes down (2026-11-15:
 * 3 and 12 reads did nothing, 60 opened Mirapo's list). L goes on to the game all the time the wheel is open
 * (2026-11-16: so the cross turns its page and 1 + an arrow key still works), so on letting go on one of them only
 * the rest of the second is waited; a D-pad one lets L go PAGE_BACK reads first, the cross back on its page. */
#define HOLD_L 60
#define PAGE_BACK 8
#define PRESS 6
#define GAP 3
static uint64_t l_since;  /* the read L went down (the wheel opened) */
static uint64_t fire_lead;

static void hud_dump(const char *when);  /* below, with the HUD's hook */
static unsigned slot_mask(int what);     /* 0 locked, 1 grey, 2 on */

/* YW4_WHEEL_LOG=1 (and YW4_WHEEL_TEST, window.c): what the wheel does, on stderr */
static void note(const char *what, uint64_t reads) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = (getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") && *getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") != '0') || getenv("YW4_WHEEL_TEST");
    if (on) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shortcut wheel: %s (input read %llu)\n", what, (unsigned long long)reads);
}

static uint64_t update(uint64_t b, int key, int ok, uint64_t reads);

/* The last input read the game got L (atomic): while it has L its cross shows the hold-L page, and its button reports
 * (yw4_hook_field_guide_button) then are the hold-L four's under the same ids, not Bike's or Auto-Navi's. */
static uint64_t l_read;

uint64_t swheel_update(uint64_t b, int key, int ok, uint64_t reads) {
    b = update(b, key, ok, reads);
    if (b & BIT_L) __atomic_store_n(&l_read, reads ? reads : 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return b;
}

static uint64_t update(uint64_t b, int key, int ok, uint64_t reads) {
    static int key_was;
    int down = key && !key_was;
    key_was = key;
    if (!swheel_enabled()) {
        __atomic_store_n(&state, IDLE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return b;
    }
    int st = __atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (down && ok && st != IDLE && st != OPEN)  /* pressed while an earlier use hasn't finished: why it didn't open */
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shortcut wheel: key down, not opened: still %s (since input read %llu, now %llu)\n",
                st == FIRE ? "using the last shortcut" : "waiting for the key to be let go",
                (unsigned long long)fire_at, (unsigned long long)reads);
    switch (st) {
    case IDLE:
        if (down && ok) {
            vx = vy = 0;
            __atomic_store_n(&ptr_x, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE), __atomic_store_n(&ptr_y, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_store_n(&picked, -1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_store_n(&open_ms, SDL_GetTicks(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_store_n(&close_kind, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_store_n(&state, OPEN, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            l_since = reads ? reads : 1;  /* L goes on to the game from now: its cross turns to the hold-L page */
            note("open", reads);
            hud_dump("open");
        }
        return b;
    case OPEN:
        if (!ok || (b & DPAD)) {  /* the old way (L + an arrow key), or the field went away: plain L until let go */
            __atomic_store_n(&state, key ? PASS : IDLE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            closed(2, -1);
            note(b & DPAD ? "closed: L + an arrow key, the old way" : "closed: not exploring any more", reads);
            return b;
        }
        if (key)  /* held: L goes on to the game as without the wheel (owner, 2026-11-16: with it held back, the
                   * game's cross never turned and 1 + an arrow key, the old way, did nothing) */
            return b;
        {
            int p = __atomic_load_n(&picked, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
            if (p < 0 || (slot_mask(0) >> p & 1)) {  /* the middle, or a shortcut not unlocked yet: nothing */
                __atomic_store_n(&state, IDLE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
                closed(2, -1);
                note(p < 0 ? "let go in the middle: nothing used" : "let go on a locked shortcut: nothing used", reads);
                return b & ~BIT_L;
            }
            fire_ring = p, fire_at = reads;
            {
                static int hold_l = -1;  /* YW4_WHEEL_HOLD_L=<reads>: the hold-L time, for tests */
                if (hold_l < 0) hold_l = getenv("YW4_WHEEL_HOLD_L") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_WHEEL_HOLD_L")) : HOLD_L;
                uint64_t held = l_since ? reads - l_since : 0;
                /* a hold-L one: L stays held until the second is full; a D-pad one: L let go for PAGE_BACK reads first,
                 * so the cross is back on the D-pad's page before the arrow */
                fire_lead = ring[p].with_l ? (held < (uint64_t)hold_l ? (uint64_t)hold_l - held : 0) : PAGE_BACK;
                l_since = 0;
            }
            closed(1, p);
            __atomic_store_n(&state, FIRE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            char t[96];
            snprintf(t, sizeof t, "use shortcut %d, %s (after %llu more reads of L)", ring[p].slot, ring[p].name,
                     (unsigned long long)fire_lead);
            note(t, reads);
        }
        /* fall through: the first press now */
    case FIRE: {
        const Slot *s = &ring[fire_ring];
        uint64_t n = reads - fire_at, lead = fire_lead;
        b &= ~(BIT_L | DPAD);
        if (n < lead) b |= s->with_l ? BIT_L : 0;  /* the hold-L one: L; a D-pad one: nothing, the page turns back */
        else if (n < lead + PRESS) b |= s->dir | (s->with_l ? BIT_L : 0);
        else if (n >= lead + PRESS + GAP) __atomic_store_n(&state, key ? PASS : IDLE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return b;
    }
    case PASS:
    default:
        if (!key) __atomic_store_n(&state, IDLE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return b;
    }
}

/* The field HUD's shortcut cross (main+0x755ea0, read with Ghidra 2026-11-15): called with the HUD object in x0
 * whenever the cross is updated. Its bytes: +0x61a the page shown (0 the D-pad's four, 1 the hold-L four);
 * +0x604 + page * 4 + i the shortcut i of that page "on" (its btn0N_on part: the green disc, the bike while riding);
 * +0x5ea..0x5ed (page 0) and +0x600..0x603 (page 1) four parts shown or not. Hooked (recomp/overrides.toml) to keep
 * the object's address; read when the wheel is drawn. */
static uint64_t hud_obj;  /* atomic */
int yw4_hook_field_guide(CPUState *ctx) {
    __atomic_store_n(&hud_obj, ctx->x[0], __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    mousemenu_field_hud_seen();  /* the field is back: a map closed without telling (Mirapo's list) is gone */
    hud_dump("HUD update");
    return 0;
}

/* The cross's button state (main+0x756520, x1 the button 0xc-0x12, w2 and w3 two flags): hooked to keep the last
 * flags of each button (YW4_WHEEL_LOG=1 logs each change). */
static uint8_t button_flags[7];  /* atomic: bit 0 w2, bit 1 w3 */
int yw4_hook_field_guide_button(CPUState *ctx) {
    uint32_t id = (uint32_t)ctx->x[1];
    if (id < 0xc || id > 0x12) return 0;
    /* the reports are by the cross's place, and the hold-L four share them with the D-pad four: while the game has L
     * (the wheel open, a hold-L shortcut being used, L + an arrow key) and for PAGE_BACK reads after, until the cross
     * is back on the D-pad's page, they aren't Bike's or Auto-Navi's (owner, 2026-11-16: opening the wheel turned
     * them off, Change Watchers turned Auto-Navi "on", Change Yo-kai Companion Bike). Kept as they were. */
    uint64_t lr = __atomic_load_n(&l_read, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == OPEN || (lr && window_input_reads() <= lr + PAGE_BACK)) return 0;
    uint8_t f = (uint8_t)((ctx->x[2] & 1) | (ctx->x[3] & 1) << 1);
    uint8_t old = __atomic_exchange_n(&button_flags[id - 0xc], f, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    static int log = -1;
    if (log < 0) log = getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") && *getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") != '0';
    if (log && old != f) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shortcut wheel: HUD button %#x: %u %u\n", id, f & 1, f >> 1);
    return 0;
}

/* The HUD's bytes +0x5e0..0x61f (YW4_WHEEL_LOG=1), to match them to the shortcuts. */
static void hud_dump(const char *when) {
    static int log = -1;
    if (log < 0) log = getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") && *getenv("YW4_WHEEL_LOG") != '0';
    uint64_t o = __atomic_load_n(&hud_obj, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!log || !o) return;
    uint8_t now[0x40];
    memcpy(now, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(o + 0x5e0), sizeof now);
    char t[0x40 * 3 + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i < 0x40; i++) snprintf(t + i * 3, 4, "%02x ", now[i]);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: shortcut wheel: %s, HUD %#llx +0x5e0: %s\n", when, (unsigned long long)o, t);
}

/* The state of each slot from the HUD (bit = ring index), as its cross shows it:
 * - locked: not unlocked yet in the story (the HUD shows an empty plate). The HUD's bytes +0x5ea, +0x5eb, +0x5ed,
 *   +0x5ec (D-pad up, right, down, left; the cross's update turns their icons on by them) and +0x600..0x603 (the
 *   hold-L page, when +0x5ff says the game has it; an early save: 0x5ff 0, the HUD shows no "Hold").
 * - grey: unlocked but not usable here (the HUD's grey-out parts): +0x604 + page * 4 + direction, written by the
 *   cross's check (main+0x758e20).
 * - on: the green disc, the bike being ridden: the last state the game gave the button (main+0x756520): 0xe up
 *   (Auto-Navi), 0x11 down (Bike), seen 2026-11-15 (0x11 went 1 on the bike, 0 off it).
 * No HUD seen yet: all unlocked, none grey or on. */
static int dir_index(uint64_t dir) { return dir == BIT_UP ? 0 : dir == BIT_RIGHT ? 1 : dir == BIT_DOWN ? 2 : 3; }
static unsigned slot_mask(int what) {  /* 0 locked, 1 grey, 2 on */
    uint64_t o = __atomic_load_n(&hud_obj, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    unsigned m = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        int d = dir_index(ring[i].dir), page = ring[i].with_l;
        int bit = 0;
        if (what == 2) {
            static const uint32_t ids[4] = {0xe, 0xf, 0x11, 0x10};
            bit = !page && (__atomic_load_n(&button_flags[ids[d] - 0xc], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & 1) &&
                  (ids[d] == 0xe || ids[d] == 0x11);
        } else if (o) {
            static const uint16_t shown[4] = {0x5ea, 0x5eb, 0x5ed, 0x5ec};
            const uint8_t *hud = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)o;
            /* the hold-L page only once the game has it (+0x5ff: the HUD's hold-L part and its handling, 0 early in
             * the story, where the cross shows no "Hold" at all) */
            bit = what == 0 ? (page ? !hud[0x5ff] || !hud[0x600 + d] : !hud[shown[d]]) : hud[0x604 + page * 4 + d] != 0;
        }
        m |= (unsigned)bit << i;
    }
    return m;
}
static unsigned active_mask(void) { return slot_mask(2); }

int swheel_hud_ready(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&hud_obj, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 0; }


/* ---- drawing: style A "Refined" (the owner's pick, 2026-11-15; work/mockups/shortcut-wheel/styles3.html): a cone of
 * light from the middle to the pick, a scope lens with an inner glow and four corner marks, the rim lit where it
 * points, faint plates under the icons; locked = a dashed outline and a small lock, on = a green ring and dot.
 * In the overlay's design units (a 1600 x 900 artboard); the mockup's 1080-high pixels * 5/6. */

#define CX 800.0f
#define CY 450.0f
#define DISC 245.0f   /* the disc's radius */
#define SLOT_R 167.0f /* the icons' circle */
#define ICON 57.0f
#define ICON_PICKED 84.0f
#define LENS 70.0f

#define DEEP 0x160e26u
#define DISC_FILL 0x1b1230u
#define PLATE 0x2a1b4cu
#define LILAC 0xd9cdeau
#define TEAL 0x5fd6e6u
#define PALE 0xbff4fbu
#define WHITE 0xffffffu
#define GREEN 0x9be83au

/* The animations (ms): opening grows from 85 % and fades in; the lens glides between slots; using one flashes the
 * lens and shrinks it onto the icon, then fades; cancelling (or closing any other way) shrinks to 90 % and fades. */
#define OPEN_MS 120
#define GLIDE_MS 80
#define USE_FLASH_MS 100
#define USE_FADE_MS 80
#define CANCEL_MS 100

void swheel_rect(float r[4]) {
    r[0] = CX - DISC - 30, r[1] = CY - DISC - 30, r[2] = r[3] = (DISC + 30) * 2;
}

static float clamp01(float v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v; }
static float ease_out(float t) { t = clamp01(t); return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t) * (1 - t); }

int swheel_visible(void) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == OPEN) return 1;
    int kind = __atomic_load_n(&close_kind, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    uint64_t t = SDL_GetTicks() - __atomic_load_n(&close_ms, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    return kind && t < (uint64_t)(kind == 1 ? USE_FLASH_MS + USE_FADE_MS : CANCEL_MS);
}

/* The lens's place round the ring (degrees, 0 up, clockwise): it glides to a new pick (the drawing's thread only). */
static float glide_from, glide_to;
static uint64_t glide_at;
static int glide_pick = -1;
static float lens_angle(int p, uint64_t now) {
    if (p < 0) return glide_to;
    float to = (float)p * 45.0f;
    if (p != glide_pick) {
        float cur = glide_pick < 0 ? to : glide_from + (glide_to - glide_from) * ease_out((float)(now - glide_at) / GLIDE_MS);
        float d = fmodf(to - cur + 540.0f, 360.0f) - 180.0f;  /* the short way round */
        glide_from = cur, glide_to = cur + d, glide_at = now, glide_pick = p;
    }
    return glide_from + (glide_to - glide_from) * ease_out((float)(now - glide_at) / GLIDE_MS);
}

uint32_t swheel_look(void) {
    uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
    int icons = yw4_wheel_icon(1, &(int){0}, &(int){0}) != NULL;
    int open = __atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == OPEN;
    uint32_t look = (uint32_t)(__atomic_load_n(&picked, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) + 1) | (uint32_t)icons << 4 |
                    active_mask() << 5 | (uint32_t)open << 13 | slot_mask(0) << 14 | (slot_mask(1) & 0xff) << 22;
    /* the pointer's dot, in 2-pixel steps: a new picture when it moves */
    uint32_t q = (uint32_t)(__atomic_load_n(&ptr_x, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) >> 5 & 0xff) |
                 (uint32_t)(__atomic_load_n(&ptr_y, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) >> 5 & 0xff) << 8;
    look ^= q * 2246822519u;
    /* while something moves, a new picture every frame */
    int moving = !open || now - __atomic_load_n(&open_ms, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) < OPEN_MS + 20 || now - glide_at < GLIDE_MS + 20;
    return moving ? look ^ (uint32_t)(now * 2654435761u) : look;
}

static void at(float angle, float r, float *x, float *y) {
    float a = angle * (3.14159265f / 180.0f);
    *x = CX + r * sinf(a), *y = CY - r * cosf(a);
}
static void circle(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float r, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    ui_box_alpha(c, x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2, r, rgb, a);
}
static void ring_line(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float r, float w, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    ui_card(c, x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2, r, rgb, 0, w, rgb, a);
}
static void dots(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float r, float gap, float size, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    int n = (int)(2 * 3.14159265f * r / gap);
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        float t = (float)k / (float)n * 2 * 3.14159265f;
        circle(c, x + r * sinf(t), y - r * cosf(t), size, rgb, a);
    }
}

/* One pixel of the (premultiplied) canvas: rgb at opacity a over what is there. */
static void put(const UiCanvas *c, int i, int j, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    if (a <= 0.002f) return;
    if (a > 1) a = 1;
    uint8_t *p = c->px + ((size_t)j * (size_t)c->w + (size_t)i) * 4;
    float s[3] = {(float)(rgb >> 16 & 255), (float)(rgb >> 8 & 255), (float)(rgb & 255)};
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) p[k] = (uint8_t)(s[k] * a + p[k] * (1 - a) + 0.5f);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)(255 * a + p[3] * (1 - a) + 0.5f);
}

/* The light: the cone from the middle to the lens, the rim's glow and its bright arc where it points, the lens's
 * inner glow and its soft halo; per pixel, only over the box they cover. */
static void light(const UiCanvas *c, float ang, float lx, float ly, float lens) {
    float xs[5], ys[5];
    at(ang - 22, DISC + 10, &xs[0], &ys[0]);
    at(ang + 22, DISC + 10, &xs[1], &ys[1]);
    at(ang, DISC + 10, &xs[2], &ys[2]);
    xs[3] = CX, ys[3] = CY, xs[4] = lx, ys[4] = ly;
    float x0 = lx - lens - 20, x1 = lx + lens + 20, y0 = ly - lens - 20, y1 = ly + lens + 20;
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        if (xs[k] < x0) x0 = xs[k];
        if (xs[k] > x1) x1 = xs[k];
        if (ys[k] < y0) y0 = ys[k];
        if (ys[k] > y1) y1 = ys[k];
    }
    int i0 = (int)floorf(c->ox + x0 * c->s), i1 = (int)ceilf(c->ox + x1 * c->s);
    int j0 = (int)floorf(c->oy + y0 * c->s), j1 = (int)ceilf(c->oy + y1 * c->s);
    if (i0 < 0) i0 = 0;
    if (j0 < 0) j0 = 0;
    if (i1 > c->w) i1 = c->w;
    if (j1 > c->h) j1 = c->h;
    const float cone_r0 = 14, cone_r1 = SLOT_R + LENS, rim = DISC - 1;
    for (int j = j0; j < j1; j++)
        for (int i = i0; i < i1; i++) {
            float x = ((float)i + 0.5f - c->ox) / c->s, y = ((float)j + 0.5f - c->oy) / c->s;
            float dx = x - CX, dy = y - CY, r = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            float a = atan2f(dx, -dy) * (180.0f / 3.14159265f);
            float da = fabsf(fmodf(a - ang + 540.0f, 360.0f) - 180.0f);
            if (r > cone_r0 && r < cone_r1 && r < DISC) {  /* the cone: brighter toward the lens, soft sides */
                float side = clamp01((17.0f - da) / 2.5f);
                put(c, i, j, TEAL, 0.30f * (r - cone_r0) / (cone_r1 - cone_r0) * side);
            }
            if (da < 24 && fabsf(r - rim) < 14) {  /* the rim: a soft glow and a bright arc */
                float side = clamp01((20.0f - da) / 3.0f), d = (r - rim) / 5.0f;
                put(c, i, j, TEAL, 0.6f * expf(-d * d) * side);
                put(c, i, j, PALE, clamp01(1.6f - fabsf(r - rim)) * side);
            }
            float lr = sqrtf((x - lx) * (x - lx) + (y - ly) * (y - ly)) / lens;
            if (lr < 1) put(c, i, j, TEAL, 0.05f + 0.33f * clamp01((lr - 0.55f) / 0.45f));  /* the lens's inner glow */
            float halo = (lr - 1) * lens / 6.0f;
            if (fabsf(halo) < 3) put(c, i, j, TEAL, 0.35f * expf(-halo * halo));
        }
}

/* A grey copy of a slot's icon, for one the game says can't be used here (made once, kept). */
static const uint8_t *grey_icon(int slot, int w, int h, const uint8_t *px) {
    static uint8_t *copies[9];
    if (slot < 1 || slot > 8) return px;
    if (!copies[slot] && (copies[slot] = malloc((size_t)w * (size_t)h * 4)))
        for (int k = 0; k < w * h; k++) {
            const uint8_t *s = px + k * 4;
            uint8_t g = (uint8_t)((s[0] * 77 + s[1] * 150 + s[2] * 29) >> 8);
            copies[slot][k * 4] = copies[slot][k * 4 + 1] = copies[slot][k * 4 + 2] = g, copies[slot][k * 4 + 3] = s[3];
        }
    return copies[slot] ? copies[slot] : px;
}

/* the small lock on a locked slot */
static void lock_mark(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y) {
    ui_box_alpha(c, x - 7, y - 2, 14, 11, 2, LILAC, 0.5f);
    for (int k = 0; k <= 8; k++) {  /* the shackle, a half circle of short strokes */
        float t0 = 3.14159265f * (float)k / 9, t1 = 3.14159265f * (float)(k + 1) / 9;
        ui_line(c, x - 4 * cosf(t0), y - 2 - 4 * sinf(t0), x - 4 * cosf(t1), y - 2 - 4 * sinf(t1), 2, LILAC, 0.5f);
    }
}

void swheel_draw(const UiCanvas *c0) {
    uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
    int open = __atomic_load_n(&state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == OPEN;
    int kind = open ? 0 : __atomic_load_n(&close_kind, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    float t_open = (float)(now - __atomic_load_n(&open_ms, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE));
    float t_close = (float)(now - __atomic_load_n(&close_ms, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE));
    int p = open ? __atomic_load_n(&picked, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) : kind == 1 ? __atomic_load_n(&close_ring, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) : -1;
    unsigned on = active_mask(), locked = slot_mask(0), grey = slot_mask(1);

    /* the whole wheel's size and opacity for the animations */
    float scale = 1, alpha = 1, flash = 0, shrink = 0;
    if (open) {
        float e = ease_out(t_open / OPEN_MS);
        scale = 0.85f + 0.15f * e, alpha = e;
    } else if (kind == 1) {
        float f = clamp01(t_close / USE_FLASH_MS);
        flash = 1 - f, shrink = ease_out(f);
        alpha = 1 - clamp01((t_close - USE_FLASH_MS) / USE_FADE_MS);
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        float e = ease_out(t_close / CANCEL_MS);
        scale = 1 - 0.1f * e, alpha = 1 - e;
    }
    UiCanvas cv = *c0;  /* grown or shrunk about the middle */
    cv.s = c0->s * scale, cv.ox = c0->ox + CX * c0->s * (1 - scale), cv.oy = c0->oy + CY * c0->s * (1 - scale);
    const UiCanvas *c = &cv;

    /* the disc: dark, a dotted ring inside the rim, the rim */
    circle(c, CX, CY, DISC, DISC_FILL, 0.9f);
    ring_line(c, CX, CY, DISC - 10, 14, DEEP, 0.35f);
    dots(c, CX, CY, DISC - 6, 9, 0.9f, TEAL, 0.25f);
    ring_line(c, CX, CY, DISC, 2, TEAL, 0.35f);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {  /* faint plates under the icons */
        if (locked >> i & 1) continue;
        float x, y;
        at((float)i * 45, SLOT_R, &x, &y);
        circle(c, x, y, ICON * 0.62f, PLATE, 0.55f);
    }

    /* the light and the lens on the pick */
    float ang = lens_angle(p, now), lx = 0, ly = 0, lens = LENS * (1 - 0.35f * shrink);
    if (p >= 0) {
        at(ang, SLOT_R, &lx, &ly);
        light(c, ang, lx, ly, lens);
        ring_line(c, lx, ly, lens, 2.5f, PALE, 1);
        dots(c, lx, ly, lens - 9, 8, 0.8f, PALE, 0.35f);
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            float a = (ang + 45 + (float)k * 90) * (3.14159265f / 180.0f);
            ui_line(c, lx + (lens + 4) * sinf(a), ly - (lens + 4) * cosf(a), lx + (lens + 13) * sinf(a),
                    ly - (lens + 13) * cosf(a), 3, PALE, 1);
        }
    }
    /* the middle (where letting go uses nothing) is the pointer: its circle follows the mouse from the middle
     * (REACH -> PTR_R), so it moves before the lens snaps to a slot (owner, 2026-11-16: the circle itself, no line) */
    if (p < 0) {  /* hidden once a shortcut is picked: the lens shows it (owner, 2026-11-16) */
        const float PTR_R = 110.0f;  /* at the pick distance (DEAD) the circle meets the lens round the slot */
        float mx = CX, my = CY;
        if (open) {
            mx += (float)__atomic_load_n(&ptr_x, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) / 16.0f / REACH * PTR_R;
            my += (float)__atomic_load_n(&ptr_y, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) / 16.0f / REACH * PTR_R;
        }
        circle(c, mx, my, 20, DEEP, 1);  /* full size all along (owner: it shrank once a slot was picked) */
        ring_line(c, mx, my, 20, 2.5f, TEAL, 1);
        circle(c, mx, my, 3.5f, TEAL, 1);
    }

    /* the shortcuts: arriving one after another when it opens (15 ms apart) */
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        float x, y, sz = i == p ? ICON_PICKED : ICON;
        at((float)i * 45, SLOT_R, &x, &y);
        float arrive = open ? ease_out((t_open - 15.0f * (float)i) / 60.0f) : 1;
        sz *= 0.6f + 0.4f * arrive;
        if (locked >> i & 1) {
            dots(c, x, y, sz * 0.5f, 7, 1.2f, LILAC, 0.35f * arrive);
            lock_mark(c, x, y);
            continue;
        }
        if (on >> i & 1) {  /* on: a green ring with a soft glow, and a dot */
            ring_line(c, x, y, sz * 0.6f + 4, 12, GREEN, 0.3f);
            ring_line(c, x, y, sz * 0.6f, 4, GREEN, 1);
            circle(c, x + sz * 0.45f, y - sz * 0.45f, 9.5f, DEEP, 1);
            circle(c, x + sz * 0.45f, y - sz * 0.45f, 7, GREEN, 1);
        }
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        const uint8_t *px = yw4_wheel_icon(ring[i].slot, &w, &h);
        if (px) ui_image(c, grey >> i & 1 ? grey_icon(ring[i].slot, w, h, px) : px, w, h, x - sz / 2, y - sz / 2, sz, sz, 0);
        else {
            char el[160];
            float a = ring[i].dir == BIT_UP ? 0 : ring[i].dir == BIT_RIGHT ? 90 : ring[i].dir == BIT_DOWN ? 180 : 270;
            snprintf(el, sizeof el, "<path fill=\"#000\" transform=\"rotate(%g 12 12)\" d=\"M12 4 L20 17 L4 17 Z\"/>", a);
            ui_shape(c, el, x - sz * 0.3f, y - sz * 0.3f, sz * 0.6f, sz * 0.6f, 24, i == p ? PALE : LILAC);
        }
        if (grey >> i & 1) circle(c, x, y, sz * 0.62f, DEEP, 0.4f);  /* not usable here: grey, darker */
        /* the rest aren't dimmed while one is picked: the pick is already larger (owner, 2026-11-16) */
        if (arrive < 1) circle(c, x, y, sz * 0.62f, DISC_FILL, 0.8f * (1 - arrive));
    }
    if (p >= 0 && flash > 0) circle(c, lx, ly, lens, WHITE, 0.7f * flash);  /* used: the lens flashes */

    /* the pick's name under the middle, "on" under it in green */
    if (p >= 0) {
        int lk = locked >> p & 1;
        const char *name = lk ? "Locked" : ring[p].name;
        /* a long name on two lines, split at the space nearest its middle: on one it ran into the side slots' icons
         * (owner, 2026-11-16: "Change moves and Equipment", "Change Yo-kai Companion") */
        char lines[2][64] = {{0}, {0}};
        snprintf(lines[0], sizeof lines[0], "%s", name);
        if (ui_text_w(UI_ROUNDED_800, 22, name) > 230) {
            int len = (int)strlen(name), best = -1;
            for (int k = 0; k < len; k++)
                if (name[k] == ' ' && (best < 0 || abs(k - len / 2) < abs(best - len / 2))) best = k;
            if (best > 0) {
                snprintf(lines[0], sizeof lines[0], "%.*s", best, name);
                snprintf(lines[1], sizeof lines[1], "%s", name + best + 1);
            }
        }
        float ty = CY + 16;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2 && lines[k][0]; k++, ty += 28) {
            float w = ui_text_w(UI_ROUNDED_800, 22, lines[k]) + 8;
            ui_text_in(c, UI_ROUNDED_800, 22, CX - w / 2, ty + 2, w, 34, 1, lines[k], DEEP);
            ui_text_in(c, UI_ROUNDED_800, 22, CX - w / 2, ty, w, 34, 1, lines[k], lk ? LILAC : PALE);
        }
        ty += 2;  /* the status under the name's last line */
        if (!lk && (on >> p & 1)) ui_text_in(c, UI_ROUNDED_700, 15, CX - 40, ty, 80, 22, 1, "on", GREEN);
        else if (!lk && (grey >> p & 1)) ui_text_in(c, UI_ROUNDED_700, 15, CX - 80, ty, 160, 22, 1, "not usable here", LILAC);
    }

    /* the whole picture's opacity (it is premultiplied: every channel) */
    if (alpha < 1) {
        float r[4];
        swheel_rect(r);
        int i0 = (int)floorf(c0->ox + r[0] * c0->s), i1 = (int)ceilf(c0->ox + (r[0] + r[2]) * c0->s);
        int j0 = (int)floorf(c0->oy + r[1] * c0->s), j1 = (int)ceilf(c0->oy + (r[1] + r[3]) * c0->s);
        if (i0 < 0) i0 = 0;
        if (j0 < 0) j0 = 0;
        if (i1 > c0->w) i1 = c0->w;
        if (j1 > c0->h) j1 = c0->h;
        for (int j = j0; j < j1; j++) {
            uint8_t *row = c0->px + ((size_t)j * (size_t)c0->w + (size_t)i0) * 4;
            for (int k = 0; k < (i1 - i0) * 4; k++) row[k] = (uint8_t)((float)row[k] * alpha + 0.5f);
        }
    }
}
```

```h
/* The shortcut wheel (owner, 2026-11-15; decision 0075): while exploring, holding the key bound to L (1 to start)
 * shows the game's eight field shortcuts in a ring; the mouse points at one and letting go of the key uses it, by
 * pressing the D-pad direction (shortcuts 1-4) or L and the direction (5-8, the game's hold-L set) for the player.
 * Letting go in the middle uses nothing. An arrow key (the D-pad) pressed while the key is held closes it and the
 * old way goes on (L + D-pad). Its look is the "Searchlight" mockup the owner chose (work/mockups/shortcut-wheel):
 * Watch Mode's teal lens over the pick, the rest dimmed, the shortcut's name in the middle. Off (the Controls page,

 * conversation, map, overlay or pause, and the game has the mouse), reads the game's input reads so far. Returns
 * the buttons to give the game. */
```

`runtime/src/svc_acc.c`:

```c
/* acc:u0: user accounts (IAccountServiceForApplication, Switchbrew "Account services").
 *
 * One local user, already selected when the game starts (am's PreselectedUser launch
 * parameter carries the same id). Save data is keyed by this id, so it must never change.
 */
#include <string.h>

#include "ipc_simple.h"

/* Any fixed non-zero 128-bit id ("YW4 RECOMP USER" in ASCII, then 1). */
static const uint8_t user_id[16] = {'Y', 'W', '4', ' ', 'R', 'E', 'C', 'O', 'M', 'P', ' ', 'U', 'S', 'E', 'R', 1};

void yw4_account_user_id(uint8_t out[16]) { memcpy(out, user_id, 16); }

/* IManagerForApplication: the user's Nintendo Account (online), which this user doesn't have */
static void manager(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) { ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp); }

static const SimpleCommand acc_simple[] = {
    {140, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "InitializeApplicationInfo(pid)"},
    {150, SIMPLE_U8, 0, "IsUserAccountSwitchLocked: no"},
};

void svc_acc(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 101) {  /* GetBaasAccountManagerForApplication(uid) -> IManagerForApplication */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("acc:IManagerForApplication", manager, NULL));
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 1) {  /* GetUserExistence(uid) -> bool */
        IPC_OUT(uint8_t, 0) = memcmp(req->data, user_id, 16) == 0;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 1);
        return;
    }
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(acc_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}
```
