`runtime/src/svc_am.c`:

```c
/* appletOE (the applet manager: the game's link to the system), apm (performance mode) and
 * lm (logging) (decision 0014). Commands are added as the game first uses them; every
 * other one stops (ipc_unimplemented). Command ids and names: Switchbrew
 * "Applet_Manager_services", "PPC_services", "Log_services"; LAS Recomp's services/am.c
 * (MIT) as the cross-check. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "savefs.h"
#include "host.h"

/* ---- the message queue the system uses to tell the application things */

static KEvent *message_event;
static uint32_t message_handle;
static uint32_t messages[16];
static int nmessages;

static void am_init(void) {
    if (message_event) return;
    message_event = yw4_event_new(&message_handle);
    messages[nmessages++] = 15;  /* FocusStateChanged: the game starts in focus */
    yw4_event_signal(message_event);
}

#define AM_NO_DATA_IN_CHANNEL 0x480u  /* am (module 128), description 2 */
#define AM_NO_MESSAGE 0x680u          /* am ResultNoMessage (module 128, description 3) */
#define AM_OUT_OF_BOUNDS 0x3EE80u     /* am, description 503 */
#define APPLET_RESOURCE_USER_ID 0x81ull  /* any non-zero id: hid and others key their state on it */

static const SimpleCommand common_state_getter_simple[] = {
    {5, SIMPLE_U8, 1, "GetOperationMode: console (docked), so the game renders for a TV"},
    {9, SIMPLE_U8, 1, "GetCurrentFocusState: in focus"},
};

static void common_state_getter(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  /* GetEventHandle: signalled while messages are queued */
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = message_handle;
        return;
    case 1:  /* ReceiveMessage */
        if (!nmessages) {
            resp->result = AM_NO_MESSAGE;
            return;
        }
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = messages[0];
        memmove(messages, messages + 1, (size_t)--nmessages * sizeof *messages);
        if (!nmessages) yw4_event_clear(message_event);
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    }
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(common_state_getter_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static const SimpleCommand self_controller_simple[] = {
    {11, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetOperationModeChangedNotification"},
    {13, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetFocusHandlingMode"},
    {14, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetPerformanceModeChangedNotification"},
    {16, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetOutOfFocusSuspendingEnabled"},
    {91, SIMPLE_EVENT, 0, "GetAccumulatedSuspendedTickChangedEvent: never suspended"},
};

static void self_controller(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    /* how the game wants to be paused when it loses focus (the Home button on a Switch): logged once each. It
     * asks (0, 0, 1) and not to be suspended, then ignores FocusStateChanged while exploring, so losing focus
     * can't pause it (tried 2026-11-05; the overlay's pause uses the game's own pause instead, pause.c) */
    if (req->cmd == 13)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: am: SetFocusHandlingMode(%u, %u, %u)\n", IPC_IN(uint8_t, 0), IPC_IN(uint8_t, 1),
                IPC_IN(uint8_t, 2));
    if (req->cmd == 16) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: am: SetOutOfFocusSuspendingEnabled(%u)\n", IPC_IN(uint8_t, 0));
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(self_controller_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static const SimpleCommand window_controller_simple[] = {
    {1, SIMPLE_U64, APPLET_RESOURCE_USER_ID, "GetAppletResourceUserId"},
    {10, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "AcquireForegroundRights"},
};

static void window_controller(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(window_controller_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ---- storages: blocks of bytes passed between applets (launch parameters) */

typedef struct {
    uint8_t *data;
    uint64_t size;
} Storage;

static void storage_accessor(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    Storage *st = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  /* GetSize -> i64 */
        IPC_OUT(uint64_t, 0) = st->size;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    case 11: {  /* Read(i64 offset, B buffer) */
        uint64_t off = IPC_IN(uint64_t, 0);
        IpcBuffer out = ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        if (off > st->size || out.size > st->size - off) {
            resp->result = AM_OUT_OF_BOUNDS;
            return;
        }
        memcpy(GPTR(out.addr), st->data + off, out.size);
        return;
    }
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static void storage(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* Open -> IStorageAccessor */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("IStorageAccessor", storage_accessor, s->state));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static Service *storage_new(const void *data, uint64_t size) {
    Storage *st = calloc(1, sizeof *st);
    if (!st || !(st->data = malloc(size))) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    memcpy(st->data, data, size);
    st->size = size;
    return ipc_service_new("IStorage", storage, st);
}

static const SimpleCommand application_functions_simple[] = {
    {21, SIMPLE_U64, 0x616A, "GetDesiredLanguage: \"ja\""},
    {22, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetTerminateResult"},
    {40, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "NotifyRunning / FinishStartupLogo: the boot logo goes away"},
    /* LanguageCode: the language's tag as up to 8 chars in a u64; the game only has Japanese */
};

static void application_functions(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 1) {  /* PopLaunchParameter(u32 kind) -> IStorage */
        uint32_t kind = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 0);
        if (kind != 2) {  /* 1 = user channel: nothing was passed */
            resp->result = AM_NO_DATA_IN_CHANNEL;
            return;
        }
        /* 2 = the user picked at launch (Switchbrew "PreselectedUser"): magic, "selected",
         * the user id; 0x88 bytes */
        uint8_t p[0x88] = {0};
        uint32_t magic = 0xC79497CA;
        memcpy(p, &magic, 4);
        p[4] = 1;
        yw4_account_user_id(p + 8);
        ipc_return_object(resp, storage_new(p, sizeof p));
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 20) {  /* EnsureSaveData(uid) -> u64 size still needed: creates the save if missing */
        resp->result = savefs_open(YW4_PROGRAM_ID, req->data, 1, NULL);
        IPC_OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 0;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 50) {  /* GetPseudoDeviceId -> Uuid: a fixed id stands in for this "console" */
        static const uint8_t id[16] = {'y', 'w', '4', 'r', 'e', 'c', 'o', 'm', 'p', 'd', 'e', 'v', 'i', 'd', 0, 1};
        memcpy(resp->data, id, 16);
        ipc_out_size(resp, 16);
        return;
    }
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(application_functions_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static void application_proxy(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    static const struct {
        uint32_t cmd;
        const char *name;
        ServiceHandler handler;
    } interfaces[] = {
        {0, "ICommonStateGetter", common_state_getter},
        {1, "ISelfController", self_controller},
        {2, "IWindowController", window_controller},
        {3, "IAudioController", ipc_unimplemented},
        {4, "IDisplayController", ipc_unimplemented},
        {10, "IProcessWindingController", ipc_unimplemented},
        {11, "ILibraryAppletCreator", ipc_unimplemented},
        {20, "IApplicationFunctions", application_functions},
        {1000, "IDebugFunctions", ipc_unimplemented},
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof interfaces / sizeof *interfaces; i++)
        if (interfaces[i].cmd == req->cmd) {
            ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new(interfaces[i].name, interfaces[i].handler, NULL));
            return;
        }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

void svc_appletOE(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    am_init();
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* OpenApplicationProxy(pid, process handle) */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("IApplicationProxy", application_proxy, NULL));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ---- apm: performance modes (CPU/GPU clocks), which mean nothing on the host */

static const SimpleCommand apm_session_simple[] = {
    {0, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetPerformanceConfiguration(mode, configuration)"},
};

static void apm_session(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(apm_session_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

void svc_apm(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* OpenSession */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("apm:ISession", apm_session, NULL));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ---- lm: the sdk's log output (nn::diag) */

static void lm_logger(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd != 0) {  /* 0 = Log(A buffer) */
        ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
        return;
    }
    if (!req->na && !req->nx) return;
    const IpcBuffer *b = req->na ? &req->a[0] : &req->x[0];
    /* A log packet: a 0x18-byte header, then (key, length, value) chunks. */
    const uint8_t *p = GPTR(b->addr), *end = p + b->size;
    p += 0x18;
    char line[1024];
    int n = 0;
    while (p + 2 <= end && n < (int)sizeof line) {
        uint8_t key = p[0], len = p[1];
        p += 2;
        if (p + len > end) break;
        if (key == 2)  /* the message text */
            n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - (size_t)n, "%.*s", len, (const char *)p);
        p += len;
    }
    if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[game lm] %s%s", line, line[n - 1] == '\n' ? "" : "\n");
}

void svc_lm(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* OpenLogger(pid) */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("lm:ILogger", lm_logger, NULL));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}
```

`runtime/src/svc_audio.c`:

```c
/* Audio: audren:u (only its audio-device interface) and audout:u (Switchbrew "Audio_services").
 *
 * The game's sound middleware (CRI ADX2) mixes in software and plays plain PCM through
 * AudioOut; the DSP audio renderer is never used. audren:u is opened only for its audio
 * device interface (which output is active, and an event when that changes).
 *
 * AudioOut: a host thread hands each appended buffer's PCM to an SDL3 audio stream once the
 * stream holds less than AUDIO_AHEAD_MS, then releases the buffer and signals the buffer
 * event. So the game's audio thread runs at the rate the host's sound card plays, and the
 * two clocks can't drift apart. Without a sound device (or with YW4_AUDIO=0) the thread
 * "plays" each buffer for as long as its samples last at 48 kHz instead.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

#define SAMPLE_RATE 48000
#define FORMAT_PCM16 2
#define MAX_BUFFERS 32
#define AUDOUT_BUFFER_FULL 0x1029u  /* audio (module 153), description 8 */
#define AUDIO_AHEAD_MS 40           /* PCM kept queued in the host stream: latency vs. gaps */

static const SimpleCommand audio_device_simple[] = {
    {12, SIMPLE_EVENT, 0, "QueryAudioDeviceOutputEvent: the output never changes"},
};

static void audio_device(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(audio_device_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

void svc_audren(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 4) {  /* GetAudioDeviceServiceWithRevisionInfo(aruid, revision) -> IAudioDevice */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("audren:IAudioDevice", audio_device, NULL));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ---- AudioOut. Its state is shared by IPC handlers and the player thread: both hold the
 * kernel lock while touching it. */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t tag;          /* the guest's AudioOutBuffer address: how the game names a buffer */
    uint64_t samples;      /* frames in it */
    void *pcm;             /* a copy of its PCM16 (NULL without a sound device) */
} QueuedBuffer;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t channels;     /* 2 or 6 (5.1), as the game asked; PCM16 interleaved */
    int started;
    KEvent *event;         /* "a buffer was released" */
    uint32_t event_handle;
    QueuedBuffer queue[MAX_BUFFERS];  /* appended, in play order */
    int nqueue;
    uint64_t released[MAX_BUFFERS];
    int nreleased;
    uint64_t played;       /* frames played so far */
    SDL_AudioStream *stream;  /* the host's sound output; NULL: none, time the buffers instead */
    FILE *dump;               /* YW4_AUDIO_DUMP: raw PCM16 at 48 kHz, as played */
} AudioOut;

/* The host's default sound output as a stream of 48 kHz PCM16 with `channels`; NULL if there
 * is none or YW4_AUDIO=0. */
static SDL_AudioStream *open_stream(uint32_t channels) {
    const char *on = getenv("YW4_AUDIO");
    if (on && *on == '0') return NULL;
    if (!SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_AUDIO)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: audout: no sound (%s)\n", SDL_GetError());
        return NULL;
    }
    SDL_AudioSpec spec = {SDL_AUDIO_S16LE, (int)channels, SAMPLE_RATE};  /* 5.1: same channel order as SDL's */
    SDL_AudioStream *s = SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream(SDL_AUDIO_DEVICE_DEFAULT_PLAYBACK, &spec, NULL, NULL);
    if (!s) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: audout: no sound (%s)\n", SDL_GetError());
        return NULL;
    }
    SDL_ResumeAudioStreamDevice(s);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: audout: sound on, %u channels\n", channels);
    return s;
}

static void player_thread(void *arg) {
    AudioOut *o = arg;
    host_thread_set_priority(NULL, 36);
    int64_t next = host_now_ns();
    const int ahead = SAMPLE_RATE / 1000 * AUDIO_AHEAD_MS * (int)o->channels * 2;  /* bytes */
    for (;;) {
        yw4_kernel_lock();
        int64_t wait_ns = 5000000;  /* idle: look again in 5 ms */
        if (o->started && o->nqueue && o->stream && SDL_GetAudioStreamQueued(o->stream) >= ahead) {
            wait_ns = 2000000;  /* the sound card still has enough: look again in 2 ms */
        } else if (o->started && o->nqueue) {
            QueuedBuffer b = o->queue[0];
            memmove(o->queue, o->queue + 1, (size_t)--o->nqueue * sizeof *o->queue);
            if (o->nreleased < MAX_BUFFERS) o->released[o->nreleased++] = b.tag;
            o->played += b.samples;
            yw4_event_signal(o->event);
            if (o->stream) {
                if (b.pcm) SDL_PutAudioStreamData(o->stream, b.pcm, (int)(b.samples * o->channels * 2));
                if (b.pcm && o->dump) fwrite(b.pcm, o->channels * 2, b.samples, o->dump);
                wait_ns = 0;  /* fill up to AUDIO_AHEAD_MS straight away */
            } else {
                int64_t now = host_now_ns();
                if (next < now - 100000000) next = now;  /* fell behind (or was idle): restart the clock */
                next += (int64_t)(b.samples * 1000000000ull / SAMPLE_RATE);
                wait_ns = next - now;
            }
            free(b.pcm);
        } else {
            next = host_now_ns();
        }
        yw4_kernel_unlock();
        if (wait_ns > 0) yw4_host_sleep_ns(wait_ns);
    }
}

static void audio_out(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    AudioOut *o = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  /* GetAudioOutState -> 0 started, 1 stopped */
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = o->started ? 0 : 1;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    case 1:  /* Start */
        o->started = 1;
        return;
    case 2:  /* Stop */
        o->started = 0;
        return;
    case 3: case 7: {  /* AppendAudioOutBuffer(Auto)(u64 tag, buffer: AudioOutBuffer) */
        const IpcBuffer *in = req->cmd == 3 ? &req->a[0] : (req->na && req->a[0].size ? &req->a[0] : &req->x[0]);
        if ((req->cmd == 3 ? req->na : req->na + req->nx) < 1 || in->size < 0x28) break;
        /* AudioOutBuffer: next, sample buffer, capacity, data size, data offset */
        const uint64_t *b = GPTR(in->addr);
        if (o->nqueue == MAX_BUFFERS) {
            resp->result = AUDOUT_BUFFER_FULL;
            return;
        }
        uint64_t samples = b[3] / (o->channels * 2);
        void *pcm = NULL;
        if (o->stream && samples) {  /* copied now: the game may reuse the memory once it is released */
            pcm = malloc(samples * o->channels * 2);
            if (pcm) memcpy(pcm, GPTR(b[1] + b[4]), samples * o->channels * 2);
        }
        o->queue[o->nqueue++] = (QueuedBuffer){IPC_IN(uint64_t, 0), samples, pcm};
        return;
    }
    case 4:  /* RegisterBufferEvent -> event handle */
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = o->event_handle;
        return;
    case 5: case 8: {  /* GetReleasedAudioOutBuffers(Auto)(out: u64 tags[]) -> u32 count */
        IpcBuffer out = req->cmd == 5 ? (req->nb ? req->b[0] : (IpcBuffer){0, 0}) : ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        uint32_t n = 0;
        uint64_t *tags = GPTR(out.addr);
        while (n < out.size / 8 && (int)n < o->nreleased) tags[n] = o->released[n], n++;
        memmove(o->released, o->released + n, (size_t)(o->nreleased - (int)n) * 8);
        o->nreleased -= (int)n;
        if (n < out.size / 8) tags[n] = 0;  /* the list ends with a 0 tag if there is room */
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = n;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    }
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* IAudioOutManager */
void svc_audout(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    static const char name[] = "DeviceOut";
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: case 2: {  /* ListAudioOuts(Auto)(out: names, 0x100 each) -> u32 count */
        IpcBuffer out = req->cmd == 0 ? (req->nb ? req->b[0] : (IpcBuffer){0, 0}) : ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        uint32_t n = out.size >= 0x100;
        if (n) memset(GPTR(out.addr), 0, 0x100), memcpy(GPTR(out.addr), name, sizeof name);
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = n;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    }
    case 1: case 3: {  /* OpenAudioOut(Auto)(u32 rate, u16 channels, u64 aruid, in name, out name, process) */
        uint32_t rate = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 0);
        uint16_t channels = IPC_IN(uint16_t, 4);
        if (!channels) channels = 2;
        if ((rate && rate != SAMPLE_RATE) || (channels != 2 && channels != 6)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: audout: %u Hz, %u channels asked; only %u Hz with 2 or 6 channels exists\n", rate,
                    channels, SAMPLE_RATE);
            yw4_stop();
        }
        IpcBuffer out = req->cmd == 1 ? (req->nb ? req->b[0] : (IpcBuffer){0, 0}) : ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        if (out.size >= sizeof name) memcpy(GPTR(out.addr), name, sizeof name);
        AudioOut *o = calloc(1, sizeof *o);
        if (!o) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        o->channels = channels;
        o->stream = open_stream(channels);
        const char *dump = getenv("YW4_AUDIO_DUMP");
        if (o->stream && dump && *dump) o->dump = fopen(dump, "wb");
        o->event = yw4_event_new(&o->event_handle);
        o->event->host_signalled = 1;
        if (host_thread_start(player_thread, o, 1 << 16)) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = SAMPLE_RATE;
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 4) = channels;
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 8) = FORMAT_PCM16;
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 12) = 1;  /* stopped */
        ipc_out_size(resp, 16);
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("audout:IAudioOut", audio_out, o));
        return;
    }
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}
```

`runtime/src/svc_fs.c`:

```c
/* fsp-srv: the filesystem service (decision 0014). The game's data is the RomFS image
 * (romfs.c); save data lives in host folders (savefs.c); the rest comes as the game first
 * uses it. Command ids:
 * Switchbrew "Filesystem_services"; LAS Recomp's services/fs.c (MIT) as the cross-check. */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "dlc_known.h"
#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "romfs.h"
#include "savefs.h"

#define FS_OUT_OF_RANGE 0x3EA02u      /* fs ResultOutOfRange (module 2, description 3001) */
#define FS_TARGET_NOT_FOUND 0x7D402u  /* fs ResultTargetNotFound (module 2, description 1002) */
#define YW4_ADDON_BASE_ID 0x010086C00AF7D000ull  /* add-on title IDs: this + index (target.toml [title]) */

/* The receive buffer of a Read: a B (or C) descriptor. */
static const IpcBuffer *out_buffer(const IpcRequest *req) {
    if (req->nb && req->b[0].size) return &req->b[0];
    if (req->nc && req->c[0].size) return &req->c[0];
    return req->nb ? &req->b[0] : req->nc ? &req->c[0] : NULL;
}

/* IStorage over the RomFS image: the game's, or an add-on's (s->state, decision 0056) */
static void romfs_storage(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    RomfsImage *addon = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: {  /* Read(offset, size) -> B buffer */
        uint64_t offset = IPC_IN(uint64_t, 0), size = IPC_IN(uint64_t, 8);
        const IpcBuffer *b = out_buffer(req);
        if (!b || size > b->size) size = b ? b->size : 0;
        void *out = GPTR(b ? b->addr : 0);
        /* The read without the kernel lock (romfs.c has a lock of its own): a loading thread's large reads held every
         * other thread's SVCs, the presenting one's too: a 200 ms frame at the Demon Hand's first effect load
         * (2026-11-11, YW4_PROFILE=hitch: the main thread waiting in svc). */
        yw4_kernel_unlock();
        int failed = addon ? romfs_image_read(addon, offset, out, size) : romfs_read(offset, out, size);
        yw4_kernel_lock();
        if (failed) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fs: %sRomFS read [%#" PRIx64 ", +%#" PRIx64 ") failed\n", addon ? "add-on " : "",
                    offset, size);
            resp->result = FS_OUT_OF_RANGE;
        }
        return;
    }
    case 4:  /* GetSize */
        IPC_OUT(uint64_t, 0) = addon ? romfs_image_size(addon) : romfs_size();
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    default:
        ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
    }
}

/* The RomFS of add-on `data_id` (its title ID), from the files the build extracted into YW4_DLCROMFS_DIR/<index>/
 * (tools/yw4/dlc.py, decision 0056); built once, then kept. NULL if the game doesn't own it or it isn't there. */
static RomfsImage *addon_image(uint64_t data_id) {
    static RomfsImage *images[128];
    uint64_t index = data_id - YW4_ADDON_BASE_ID;
    if (data_id < YW4_ADDON_BASE_ID || index >= 128 || !aoc_owned((uint32_t)index)) return NULL;
    if (!images[index]) {
        const char *base = getenv("YW4_DLCROMFS_DIR");
        char dir[1100];
        snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/%u", base && *base ? base : "work/dlc-romfs", (unsigned)index);
        if (!(images[index] = romfs_image_open(dir)))
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fs: add-on %u is owned but its files are not in %s (the build extracts them)\n",
                    (unsigned)index, dir);
    }
    return images[index];
}

static const SimpleCommand fsp_simple[] = {
    {1, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetCurrentProcess"},
    {1005, SIMPLE_U32, 0, "GetGlobalAccessLogMode: off"},
};


/* SaveDataAttribute (0x40): program id, user id, system save id, type, rank, index */
static uint64_t attribute_program(const uint8_t *a) {
    uint64_t id;
    memcpy(&id, a, 8);
    return id ? id : YW4_PROGRAM_ID;  /* 0 means this game */
}

void svc_fsp_srv(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 22:  /* CreateSaveDataFileSystem(attribute, creation info, meta info) */
        resp->result = savefs_open(attribute_program(req->data), req->data + 8, 1, NULL);
        return;
    case 51: {  /* OpenSaveDataFileSystem(u8 space id, attribute at +8) -> IFileSystem */
        Service *fs = NULL;
        resp->result = savefs_open(attribute_program(req->data + 8), req->data + 16, 0, &fs);
        if (fs) ipc_return_object(resp, fs);
        return;
    }
    case 200:  /* OpenDataStorageByCurrentProcess: the game's RomFS */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("IStorage (RomFS)", romfs_storage, NULL));
        return;
    case 202: {  /* OpenDataStorageByDataId(u8 storage id, u64 data id at +8) -> IStorage: an add-on's RomFS */
        uint8_t storage = IPC_IN(uint8_t, 0);
        uint64_t id = IPC_IN(uint64_t, 8);
        RomfsImage *m = addon_image(id);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: fs: OpenDataStorageByDataId(storage %u, data id %016" PRIX64 ") -> %s\n", storage, id,
                m ? "add-on RomFS" : "not found");
        if (m) ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("IStorage (add-on RomFS)", romfs_storage, m));
        else resp->result = FS_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
        return;
    }
    }
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(fsp_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}
```

`runtime/src/svc_hid.c`:

```c
/* hid: controllers (IHidServer, Switchbrew "HID_services"; decision 0014).
 *
 * The sdk's nn::hid reads input from a 0x40000-byte shared memory block the service keeps
 * up to date (Switchbrew "HID_Shared_Memory", the layout before system version 13.0, which
 * this sdk (7.3.2) reads), and sends settings and vibration through IPC.
 *
 * One controller is connected: a Pro Controller as player 1 (npad 0, full-key style). Its
 * state comes from the window (keyboard and gamepad, window_input) and is written by
 * yw4_hid_update, which the 60 Hz vsync thread calls. Each controller style has a LIFO of
 * 17 samples: a header (u64 unused, u64 count of entries 17, u64 tail index, u64 samples
 * stored), then entries {u64 sampling number, state}; the state of a npad is {u64 sampling
 * number, u64 buttons, s32 left x, y, s32 right x, y, u32 attributes, u32 reserved}.
 *
 * YW4_INPUT=<tick>:<buttons hex>:<ticks>,... holds buttons from a vsync tick on (60 per
 * second), for testing without a person at the keyboard.
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gamemenu.h"
#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "savefs.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "textin.h"
#include "window.h"

static uint64_t latest_buttons;
uint64_t hid_current_buttons(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&latest_buttons, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

#define HID_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE 0x40000

/* Offsets in the shared memory (pre-13.0 layout) */
#define NPAD_BASE 0x9A00        /* 10 npad entries of 0x5000: ids 0-7, handheld, other */
#define NPAD_SIZE 0x5000
#define NPAD_STYLE 0x0          /* u32 style set: bit 0 full key (Pro Controller) */
#define NPAD_ASSIGNMENT 0x4     /* u32: 0 dual */
#define NPAD_FULL_KEY_COLOR 0x8 /* u32 attribute (0 ok), u32 main colour, u32 sub colour */
#define NPAD_FULL_KEY_LIFO 0x28
#define NPAD_DEVICE_TYPE 0x4188 /* u32: bit 0 full key */
#define NPAD_SYSTEM_PROPS 0x4190
#define NPAD_BATTERY 0x419C     /* u32 x3 */
#define LIFO_ENTRIES 17
#define LIFO_ENTRY_SIZE 0x30

static uint32_t shared_memory_handle;
static KSharedMemory *shared_memory;

static uint8_t *npad(int i) {
    return (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(shared_memory->guest_addr + NPAD_BASE + (uint64_t)i * NPAD_SIZE);
}

static void on_map(KSharedMemory *m) {
    (void)m;
    uint8_t *p = npad(0);
    *(uint32_t *)(p + NPAD_STYLE) = 1;  /* full key */
    *(uint32_t *)(p + NPAD_ASSIGNMENT) = 0;
    uint32_t color[3] = {0, 0xFF323232, 0xFF0F0F0F};  /* ok, dark grey body, black buttons */
    memcpy(p + NPAD_FULL_KEY_COLOR, color, sizeof color);
    *(uint32_t *)(p + NPAD_DEVICE_TYPE) = 1;  /* full key */
    /* system properties: ABXY oriented (11), Plus (13), Minus (14) and directional buttons (15) available */
    *(uint64_t *)(p + NPAD_SYSTEM_PROPS) = 1u << 11 | 1u << 13 | 1u << 14 | 1u << 15;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) *(uint32_t *)(p + NPAD_BATTERY + 4 * i) = 4;  /* full */
    *(uint64_t *)(p + NPAD_FULL_KEY_LIFO + 8) = LIFO_ENTRIES;
}

/* Scripted presses (YW4_INPUT) */
static uint64_t scripted(uint64_t tick) {
    static const char *spec;
    static int read;
    if (!read) spec = getenv("YW4_INPUT"), read = 1;
    uint64_t b = 0;
    for (const char *s = spec; s && *s;) {
        char *e;
        unsigned long long at = strtoull(s, &e, 10), mask = 0, len = 10;
        if (*e == ':') mask = strtoull(e + 1, &e, 16);
        if (*e == ':') len = strtoull(e + 1, &e, 10);
        if (tick >= at && tick < at + len) b |= mask;
        s = *e == ',' ? e + 1 : e;
        if (e == s && *s) break;
    }
    return b;
}

/* ---- Input recording and replay (YW4_RECORD=0 turns recording off; YW4_REPLAY=<file> plays one)
 *
 * Every change of the physical input (buttons, sticks) and every capture key (F9/F10/F11/F12) is
 * written, with the vsync tick (60 per second since start), to work/inputs/rec_<time>.txt:
 *     s <tick> <buttons hex> <lx> <ly> <rx> <ry>
 *     k <tick> <F9|F10|F11|F12|F6|F1|UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT>  (the last four: the settings panel's keys)
 * A replay feeds the same states back at the same ticks (instead of the keyboard and gamepad)
 * and presses the same capture keys, so a route a person played can be run again by a script.
 * The game's loading times vary a little from run to run, so long routes can drift.
 *     w <tick>   (written by hand) at that tick the replay waits for the 3D world: it presses A every 40 frames
 *                until the world has drawn for 60 frames in a row, then goes on, its later ticks moved by the wait.
 *                Loading a save runs on real time, so at an uncapped frame rate a fixed press can come too early
 *                and the run sits on "Finished loading diary save data!" (2026-11-18). */
#include <time.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#define MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
#endif
#include "host.h"

void gpu_request_trace(int draws);
void gpu_request_dump(void);
void shadow_toggle(void);

static FILE *rec_file;
static uint64_t rec_tick;  /* the tick of the latest update, for key notes from the window thread */
static HostLock rec_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static void rec_open(void) {
    static int tried;
    if (tried) return;
    tried = 1;
    const char *on = getenv("YW4_RECORD");
    if (on && *on == '0') return;
    MKDIR("work");
    MKDIR("work/inputs");
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm tmv;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&tmv, &now);
#else
    localtime_r(&now, &tmv);
#endif
    char when[32], path[256];
    strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", &tmv);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "work/inputs/rec_%s.txt", when);
    rec_file = fopen(path, "w");
    if (rec_file) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: recording input in %s\n", path);
}

void yw4_hid_note_key(const char *name) {
    host_lock(&rec_lock);
    rec_open();
    if (rec_file) {
        fprintf(rec_file, "k %llu %s\n", (unsigned long long)rec_tick, name);
        fflush(rec_file);
    }
    host_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

/* text typed into an overlay field: "t <tick> <text>" (the text to the end of the line) */
void yw4_hid_note_text(const char *utf8) {
    host_lock(&rec_lock);
    rec_open();
    if (rec_file) {
        fprintf(rec_file, "t %llu ", (unsigned long long)rec_tick);
        for (const char *p = utf8; *p; p++) fputc(*p == '\n' || *p == '\r' ? ' ' : *p, rec_file);
        fputc('\n', rec_file);
        fflush(rec_file);
    }
    host_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

typedef struct {
    uint64_t tick, buttons;
    int32_t sticks[4];
} RecState;
typedef struct {
    uint64_t tick;
    char name[16];
    char *text;  /* a "t" line: typed text (name "TEXT") */
} RecKey;
static RecState *replay_states;
static RecKey *replay_keys;
static size_t n_states, n_keys, next_key;
static uint64_t *replay_waits;  /* "w" lines */
static size_t n_waits;
extern uint64_t yw4_world_frames;  /* perf.c */
static int replay_loaded;
int yw4_replay_done;  /* the replay has handed over to the player (its last line): kernel.c's frame clock stops */

static void replay_load(void) {
    replay_loaded = 1;
    const char *path = getenv("YW4_REPLAY");
    if (!path || !*path) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: cannot open %s\n", path);
        return;
    }
    char line[2048];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        unsigned long long tick, buttons;
        int lx, ly, rx, ry, at = 0;
        char name[16];
        if (sscanf(line, "s %llu %llx %d %d %d %d", &tick, &buttons, &lx, &ly, &rx, &ry) == 6) {
            replay_states = realloc(replay_states, (n_states + 1) * sizeof *replay_states);
            replay_states[n_states++] = (RecState){tick, buttons, {lx, ly, rx, ry}};
        } else if (sscanf(line, "k %llu %15s", &tick, name) == 2) {
            replay_keys = realloc(replay_keys, (n_keys + 1) * sizeof *replay_keys);
            replay_keys[n_keys].tick = tick;
            snprintf(replay_keys[n_keys].name, sizeof replay_keys[n_keys].name, "%s", name);
            replay_keys[n_keys].text = NULL;
            n_keys++;
        } else if (sscanf(line, "w %llu", &tick) == 1) {
            replay_waits = realloc(replay_waits, (n_waits + 1) * sizeof *replay_waits);
            replay_waits[n_waits++] = tick;
        } else if (sscanf(line, "t %llu %n", &tick, &at) == 1 && at > 0) {  /* typed text, to the end of the line */
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0;
            replay_keys = realloc(replay_keys, (n_keys + 1) * sizeof *replay_keys);
            replay_keys[n_keys].tick = tick;
            snprintf(replay_keys[n_keys].name, sizeof replay_keys[n_keys].name, "TEXT");
            size_t tl = strlen(line + at) + 1;  /* (strdup isn't C11) */
            if ((replay_keys[n_keys].text = malloc(tl))) memcpy(replay_keys[n_keys].text, line + at, tl);
            n_keys++;
        }
    }
    fclose(f);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: %zu input states and %zu key presses from %s\n", n_states, n_keys, path);
    if (!n_states && !n_keys) __atomic_store_n(&yw4_replay_done, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);  /* an empty file: nothing to time */
}

/* The state a replay gives at `tick`; 0 if there is no replay. */
static int replay_state(uint64_t tick, uint64_t *buttons, int32_t sticks[4]) {
    if (!replay_loaded) replay_load();
    if (!n_states && !n_keys) return 0;
    /* After the last line the player takes over (e.g. a replay that only loads the save), for good: the tick is
     * the presented frame until then and the 60 Hz vsync count after (kernel.c), which is lower when the game ran
     * faster than 60 frames/s, so the test below would hand the input back to the replay (2026-11-04: a replay at
     * 120 frames/s let one live read through, then the replay's last state held the input). */
    static int handed_over;
    if (handed_over) return 0;
    /* a "w" line: hold the replay's ticks there, pressing A, until the world is up (at most 10 minutes of frames) */
    static uint64_t shift, wait_from;
    static size_t next_wait;
    if (next_wait < n_waits && tick - shift >= replay_waits[next_wait]) {
        if (!wait_from) wait_from = tick;
        if (__atomic_load_n(&yw4_world_frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) < 60 && tick - wait_from < 36000) {
            shift = tick - replay_waits[next_wait];
            /* A, but not once the world draws (it would talk to whoever stands there) */
            *buttons = !__atomic_load_n(&yw4_world_frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) && (tick - wait_from) % 40 >= 20 &&
                       (tick - wait_from) % 40 < 26;
            memset(sticks, 0, 4 * sizeof(int32_t));
            return 1;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: waited %llu frames at tick %llu for the world\n",
                (unsigned long long)(tick - wait_from), (unsigned long long)replay_waits[next_wait]);
        next_wait++, wait_from = 0;
    }
    tick -= shift;
    if (next_wait == n_waits && next_key == n_keys && (!n_states || tick > replay_states[n_states - 1].tick)) {
        if (!handed_over) {
            handed_over = 1;
            __atomic_store_n(&yw4_replay_done, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: finished at tick %llu, input is live\n", (unsigned long long)tick);
            /* YW4_REPLAY_EXIT=1: a test run ends with its replay instead of idling */
            const char *e = getenv("YW4_REPLAY_EXIT");
            if (e && atoi(e)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: done, exiting (YW4_REPLAY_EXIT)\n");
                yw4_exit(0, __FILE__, __LINE__);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    static size_t cur;
    while (cur + 1 < n_states && replay_states[cur + 1].tick <= tick) cur++;
    if (n_states && replay_states[cur].tick <= tick) {
        *buttons = replay_states[cur].buttons;
        memcpy(sticks, replay_states[cur].sticks, 4 * sizeof(int32_t));
    } else {
        *buttons = 0;
        memset(sticks, 0, 4 * sizeof(int32_t));
    }
    if (window_paused()) *buttons = 0, memset(sticks, 0, 4 * sizeof(int32_t));  /* as live input: held back */
    *buttons |= window_pause_buttons();  /* the overlay's pause presses Plus and A for the player in replays too */
    for (; next_key < n_keys && replay_keys[next_key].tick <= tick; next_key++) {
        const char *k = replay_keys[next_key].name;
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: replay: key %s at tick %llu\n", k, (unsigned long long)tick);
        if (!strcmp(k, "TEXT")) textin_type(replay_keys[next_key].text ? replay_keys[next_key].text : "");
        else if (!strncmp(k, "T_", 2)) {  /* the typing keys (textin.h) */
            static const char *const ops[] = {
                "T_LEFT", "T_RIGHT", "T_HOME", "T_END", "T_BACK", "T_DEL", "T_DONE", "T_CLEAR",
                "T_SLEFT", "T_SRIGHT", "T_SHOME", "T_SEND", "T_ALL", "T_CUT", "T_COPY"
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof ops / sizeof *ops); i++)
                if (!strcmp(k, ops[i])) textin_edit(i), gamemenu_refresh();
        } else if (!strcmp(k, "F11")) gpu_request_trace(450);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "FULLSCR")) window_fullscreen_cycle();  /* F11 now (names are cut to 7 letters); "F11" in recordings is the trace */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "PAUSE")) window_pause_toggle();  /* the overlay's pause, as F4 */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "MENU")) gamemenu_toggle();  /* the in-game overlay, as Escape */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_SET")) gamemenu_open_page(GM_SETTINGS);  /* F1 with LEGACY MENUS off */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_CTRL")) gamemenu_open_page(GM_CONTROLS);  /* F2 */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_PERF")) gamemenu_open_page(GM_PERF);  /* the overlay's Overlay page (F3 before 2026-11-11) */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "HUDCYC")) window_hud_cycle();  /* F3: the HUD off, compact, detailed */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "KV_PEEK")) gamemenu_peek_toggle();  /* F2 while playing: the keyboard card, not paused */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "KV_PREV")) gamemenu_peek_mode_step(-1);  /* its mode switch, back */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "KV_NEXT")) gamemenu_peek_mode_step(1);   /* on: a short press of View / Create / Minus */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_UP")) gamemenu_action(GM_UP);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_DOWN")) gamemenu_action(GM_DOWN);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_LEFT")) gamemenu_action(GM_LEFT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_RIGHT")) gamemenu_action(GM_RIGHT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_OK")) gamemenu_action(GM_ACCEPT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_BACK")) gamemenu_action(GM_BACK);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_LEAVE")) gamemenu_action(GM_LEAVE);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_PREV")) gamemenu_action(GM_PREV);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_NEXT")) gamemenu_action(GM_NEXT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_CLEAR")) gamemenu_action(GM_CLEAR);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "M_ALT")) gamemenu_action(GM_ALT);  /* Preview (Settings), hide the bar (in it) */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F10")) gpu_request_dump();
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F12")) window_request_screenshot();
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F9")) shadow_toggle();
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F6")) gbuffer_toggle();
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F1")) settings_show(0);  /* the settings panel, and its keys while open */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "F2")) settings_show(1);  /* its controls page */
        else if (!strcmp(k, "UP")) settings_action(SETTINGS_UP);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "DOWN")) settings_action(SETTINGS_DOWN);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "LEFT")) settings_action(SETTINGS_LEFT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "RIGHT")) settings_action(SETTINGS_RIGHT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "ENTER")) settings_action(SETTINGS_ACCEPT);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "DELETE")) settings_action(SETTINGS_CLEAR);
        else if (!strcmp(k, "PAGE")) settings_action(SETTINGS_PAGE);
    }
    return 1;
}

void yw4_hid_update(uint64_t tick) {
    KSharedMemory *m = __atomic_load_n(&shared_memory, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!m || !__atomic_load_n(&m->guest_addr, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    uint64_t buttons;
    int32_t sticks[4];
    rec_tick = tick;
    if (replay_state(tick, &buttons, sticks)) {
        window_input_read_replayed();  /* presses made for the player (pause, mouse menus) end after two reads */
    } else {
        window_input(&buttons, sticks);
        /* record changes of the physical input */
        static uint64_t last_buttons = ~0ull;
        static int32_t last_sticks[4];
        if (buttons != last_buttons || memcmp(sticks, last_sticks, sizeof last_sticks)) {
            host_lock(&rec_lock);
            rec_open();
            if (rec_file) {
                fprintf(rec_file, "s %llu %llx %d %d %d %d\n", (unsigned long long)tick, (unsigned long long)buttons,
                        sticks[0], sticks[1], sticks[2], sticks[3]);
                fflush(rec_file);
            }
            host_unlock(&rec_lock);
            last_buttons = buttons;
            memcpy(last_sticks, sticks, sizeof last_sticks);
        }
    }
    buttons |= scripted(tick);
    /* the sticks' direction bits, as the hardware sets them past about half way */
    static const int dir[4][2] = {{16, 18}, {19, 17}, {20, 22}, {23, 21}};  /* (negative, positive) bits */
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (sticks[i] < -16384) buttons |= 1ull << dir[i][0];
        if (sticks[i] > 16384) buttons |= 1ull << dir[i][1];
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&latest_buttons, buttons, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    buttons = savefs_filter_buttons(buttons);  /* the Diary: no A on an empty save row (savefs.c) */
    uint8_t *lifo = npad(0) + NPAD_FULL_KEY_LIFO;
    uint64_t *head = (uint64_t *)lifo;  /* unused, entries, tail, count */
    static uint64_t sampling;
    sampling++;
    uint64_t tail = (head[2] + 1) % LIFO_ENTRIES;
    uint8_t *entry = lifo + 0x20 + tail * LIFO_ENTRY_SIZE;
    struct {
        uint64_t sampling, buttons;
        int32_t sticks[4];
        uint32_t attributes, reserved;
    } state = {sampling, buttons, {sticks[0], sticks[1], sticks[2], sticks[3]}, 1 /* connected */, 0};
    __atomic_store_n((uint64_t *)entry, sampling, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    memcpy(entry + 8, &state, sizeof state);
    __atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (head[3] < LIFO_ENTRIES) __atomic_store_n(&head[3], head[3] + 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&head[2], tail, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static void applet_resource(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* GetSharedMemoryHandle */
        if (!shared_memory_handle) {
            KSharedMemory *m = yw4_shared_memory_new(HID_SHARED_MEMORY_SIZE, on_map, &shared_memory_handle);
            __atomic_store_n(&shared_memory, m, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        }
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = shared_memory_handle;
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* Vibration: routed to the active host controller (window_vibration, decision 0058). The game sends the Switch's
 * HD rumble values: two bands, each an amplitude and a frequency; window.c turns them into motor speeds. */
typedef struct {
    float amp_low;
    float freq_low;
    float amp_high;
    float freq_high;
} VibrationValue;

static float amp01(float a) { return a > 1.0f ? 1.0f : (a > 0.0f ? a : 0.0f); }  /* NaN -> 0 */

/* Player 1's devices (a pair of Joy-Cons is two): the stronger amplitude per band, and that band's frequency
 * weighted by amplitude. */
typedef struct {
    float al, fl, ah, fh, wl, wh;
} Mix;

static void mix_add(Mix *m, const VibrationValue *v) {
    float al = amp01(v->amp_low), ah = amp01(v->amp_high);
    if (al > m->al) m->al = al;
    if (ah > m->ah) m->ah = ah;
    if (al > 0.0f && v->freq_low > 0.0f) m->fl += al * v->freq_low, m->wl += al;
    if (ah > 0.0f && v->freq_high > 0.0f) m->fh += ah * v->freq_high, m->wh += ah;
}

static void mix_send(const Mix *m) {
    window_vibration(m->al, m->wl > 0.0f ? m->fl / m->wl : 160.0f, m->ah, m->wh > 0.0f ? m->fh / m->wh : 320.0f);
}

static void send_vibration_values(IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    (void)resp;
    const IpcBuffer *b_h = req->nx >= 1 && req->x[0].size ? &req->x[0] : (req->na >= 1 ? &req->a[0] : NULL);
    const IpcBuffer *b_v = req->nx >= 2 && req->x[1].size ? &req->x[1] : (req->na >= 2 ? &req->a[1] : NULL);
    if (!b_h || !b_v || !b_h->addr || !b_v->addr) return;

    uint32_t n_h = (uint32_t)(b_h->size / sizeof(uint32_t));
    uint32_t n_v = (uint32_t)(b_v->size / sizeof(VibrationValue));
    uint32_t count = n_h < n_v ? n_h : n_v;
    if (!count) return;

    const uint32_t *handles = GPTR(b_h->addr);
    const VibrationValue *values = GPTR(b_v->addr);
    Mix m = {0};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++)
        if (((handles[i] >> 8) & 0xFF) == 0) mix_add(&m, &values[i]);  /* Player 1 only */
    mix_send(&m);
}

static void send_vibration_value(IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    (void)resp;
    if (req->data_size < 20) return;
    uint32_t h = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 0);
    if (((h >> 8) & 0xFF) != 0) return;  /* Player 1 only */
    Mix m = {0};
    mix_add(&m, (const VibrationValue *)(req->data + 4));
    mix_send(&m);
}

static const SimpleCommand vibration_list_simple[] = {
    {0, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "ActivateVibrationDevice(handle)"},
};

static void vibration_list(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(vibration_list_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

static const SimpleCommand hid_simple[] = {
    {100, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetSupportedNpadStyleSet(style set, aruid)"},
    {102, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "SetSupportedNpadIdType(aruid, X: ids)"},
    {109, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "ActivateNpadWithRevision(revision, aruid)"},
};

void svc_hid(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  /* CreateAppletResource(aruid) -> IAppletResource */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("hid:IAppletResource", applet_resource, NULL));
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 201) {  /* SendVibrationValue(handle, value, aruid) */
        send_vibration_value(req, resp);
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 203) {  /* CreateActiveVibrationDeviceList -> IActiveVibrationDeviceList */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("hid:IActiveVibrationDeviceList", vibration_list, NULL));
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 206) {  /* SendVibrationValues(aruid, X: handles, X: values) */
        send_vibration_values(req, resp);
        return;
    }
    if (req->cmd == 200) {  /* GetVibrationDeviceInfo(handle) -> {u32 type, u32 position} */
        uint32_t handle = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 0);  /* bytes: style, npad id, device index (0 left, 1 right) */
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1;  /* linear resonant actuator, as in every Joy-Con and Pro Controller */
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 4) = (handle >> 16) & 0xFF;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    }
    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(hid_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

```

`runtime/src/svc_misc.c`:

```c
/* Small services (decision 0014). Commands are added as the game first uses them; Switchbrew
 * has the ids and names. */
#include <ctype.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL_filesystem.h>

#include "dlc_known.h"
#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "yw4load.h"  /* yw4_sha256_hex */

/* ---- aoc:u: add-on content (decision 0049). On boot the game looks in its DLC folder (YW4_DLC_DIR, default
 * work/dlc) for the owner's add-on NSPs and owns an add-on when the SHA-256 of an NSP's content NCA body (past
 * its 0xC00-byte header) is one in target.toml's [dlc] table (dlc_known.c): that is the same for every owner,
 * with or without a ticket, and an empty or home-made file unlocks nothing. YW4_AOC (indices, comma separated) replaces the scan, for tests. */

static uint32_t aoc[64];
static uint32_t naoc = UINT32_MAX;

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <io.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#define seek64(f, o) _fseeki64(f, (long long)(o), SEEK_SET)
#else
#define seek64(f, o) fseeko(f, (off_t)(o), SEEK_SET)
#endif

static void aoc_add(uint32_t index) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < naoc; i++)
        if (aoc[i] == index) return;
    if (naoc < 64) aoc[naoc++] = index;
}

/* An add-on found in the DLC folder: owned only once its files are unpacked into YW4_DLCROMFS_DIR/<index>/ (as
 * svc_fs.c's addon_image reads them). The game opens every owned add-on's data, for instance for the mail
 * delivery, and stops itself (svcBreak) when one isn't there: 2026-11-13, add-on 2 recognised (a ticket-less copy,
 * ace4d79) but never unpacked, the owner's game closed at the mail delivery. Left out, it's just not offered. */
static void aoc_found(long index, const char *name) {
    const char *base = getenv("YW4_DLCROMFS_DIR");
    char dir[1100];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/%ld", base && *base ? base : "work/dlc-romfs", index);
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(dir, &st) || !(st.st_mode & S_IFDIR)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %s: add-on %ld, but its files aren't unpacked in %s (left out; a rebuild unpacks "
                "them, or python -m tools.yw4.extract --dlc-only)\n", name, index, dir);
        return;
    }
    aoc_add((uint32_t)index);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %s: add-on %ld\n", name, index);
}

static int ends_with(const char *s, const char *tail) {
    size_t n = strlen(s), m = strlen(tail);
    if (n < m) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m; i++)
        if (tolower((unsigned char)s[n - m + i]) != tail[i]) return 0;
    return 1;
}

/* The NCA header (0xC00 bytes: the main header and four section headers) is left out of the hash: tools that
 * remove the ticket rewrite its rights ID and key area, and rename the file, while the body stays the same. */
enum { NCA_HEADER = 0xC00 };

/* SHA-256 of `size` bytes at `at`, read in pieces (the 4++ Upgrade Pack's NCA is 222 MiB). 0, or -1 on a short read. */
static int hash_part(FILE *f, uint64_t at, uint64_t size, char hex[65]) {
    enum { CHUNK = 1 << 20 };
    uint8_t *buf = malloc(CHUNK);
    Yw4Sha256 c;
    yw4_sha256_init(&c);
    int ok = buf && !seek64(f, at);
    while (ok && size) {
        size_t k = size < CHUNK ? (size_t)size : CHUNK;
        ok = fread(buf, 1, k, f) == k;
        yw4_sha256_update(&c, buf, k);
        size -= k;
    }
    free(buf);
    yw4_sha256_final_hex(&c, hex);
    return ok ? 0 : -1;
}

/* SHA-256 of a content NCA's body (all but the header). Hashing a 222 MiB NCA in C takes ~1.1 s; once a >1 MiB
 * NCA is hashed, remember `(name, size, first-4-KiB SHA-256) -> body SHA-256` in aoc-body.cache next to yw4.exe
 * so later boots only hash 4 KiB. (aoc.cache, from before 2026-11-12, held whole-file hashes: not read.) */
static int hash_nca(FILE *f, const char *name, uint64_t at, uint64_t size, char hex[65]) {
    if (size <= (1u << 20)) return hash_part(f, at + NCA_HEADER, size - NCA_HEADER, hex);
    char spot[65], path[1100], cname[64], cspot[65], chex[65];
    if (hash_part(f, at, 4096, spot)) return -1;
    const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath();
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%saoc-body.cache", base ? base : "");
    FILE *cf = fopen(path, "r");
    for (unsigned long long csize; cf && fscanf(cf, "%63s %llu %64s %64s", cname, &csize, cspot, chex) == 4;)
        if (!strcmp(cname, name) && csize == size && !strcmp(cspot, spot)) {
            memcpy(hex, chex, 65);
            fclose(cf);
            return 0;
        }
    if (cf) fclose(cf);
    if (hash_part(f, at + NCA_HEADER, size - NCA_HEADER, hex)) return -1;
    if ((cf = fopen(path, "a")) != NULL) {
        fprintf(cf, "%s %llu %s %s\n", name, (unsigned long long)size, spot, hex);
        fclose(cf);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* One NSP (a PFS0 archive): the add-on index of its content NCA, or -1. */
static long aoc_nsp(FILE *f) {
    if (!f) return -1;
    long found = -1;
    uint8_t head[16];
    uint32_t count, strtab;
    if (fread(head, 1, 16, f) == 16 && !memcmp(head, "PFS0", 4) && (memcpy(&count, head + 4, 4), count < 64) &&
        (memcpy(&strtab, head + 8, 4), strtab < 0x10000)) {
        uint8_t *table = malloc((size_t)count * 0x18 + strtab + 1);
        if (table && fread(table, 1, (size_t)count * 0x18 + strtab, f) == (size_t)count * 0x18 + strtab) {
            table[(size_t)count * 0x18 + strtab] = 0;
            const char *names = (const char *)table + (size_t)count * 0x18;
            uint64_t data = 16 + (uint64_t)count * 0x18 + strtab;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count && found < 0; i++) {
                uint64_t off, size;
                uint32_t name_off;
                memcpy(&off, table + i * 0x18, 8), memcpy(&size, table + i * 0x18 + 8, 8);
                memcpy(&name_off, table + i * 0x18 + 16, 4);
                const char *name = name_off < strtab ? names + name_off : "";
                /* Every content NCA up to 256 MiB is hashed: the base game's and update's program NCAs (GiBs, when
                 * they share the folder) are skipped, their small control/manual NCAs cost nothing. */
                if (!ends_with(name, ".nca") || ends_with(name, ".cnmt.nca") || size <= NCA_HEADER ||
                    size > (256u << 20))
                    continue;
                char hex[65];
                if (!hash_nca(f, name, data + off, size, hex))
                    for (size_t k = 0; k < yw4_ndlc_known; k++)
                        if (!strcmp(hex, yw4_dlc_known[k].sha256)) found = yw4_dlc_known[k].index;
            }
        }
        free(table);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return found;
}

static void aoc_load(void) {
    if (naoc != UINT32_MAX) return;
    naoc = 0;
    const char *s = getenv("YW4_AOC");
    if (s && *s) {
        while (*s && naoc < 64) {
            char *e;
            unsigned long v = strtoul(s, &e, 10);
            if (e == s) break;
            aoc_add((uint32_t)v);
            s = *e == ',' ? e + 1 : e;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %u add-on content item(s) from YW4_AOC\n", naoc);
        return;
    }
    const char *dir = getenv("YW4_DLC_DIR");
    if (!dir || !*dir) dir = "work/dlc";
    struct timespec t0, t1;
    timespec_get(&t0, TIME_UTC);
    uint32_t files = 0, unknown = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    /* _wfindfirst64 / _wfopen: add-on NSPs often have Japanese titles in their file names, and UCRT's narrow
     * readdir turns characters outside the active code page into '?' before fopen sees them. */
    wchar_t wdir[1024], pat[1040];
    size_t wn = mbstowcs(wdir, dir, 1024);
    if (wn != (size_t)-1 && wn < 1024) {
        swprintf(pat, 1040, L"%ls\\*", wdir);
        struct _wfinddata64_t fd;
        intptr_t h = _wfindfirst64(pat, &fd);
        for (int more = h != -1; more; more = _wfindnext64(h, &fd) == 0) {
            size_t len = wcslen(fd.name);
            char name[512] = "";
            for (size_t i = 0; i < len && i + 1 < sizeof name; i++)
                name[i] = fd.name[i] < 128 ? (char)fd.name[i] : '?', name[i + 1] = 0;
            if (!ends_with(name, ".nsp")) continue;
            wchar_t wpath[1536];
            swprintf(wpath, 1536, L"%ls\\%ls", wdir, fd.name);
            long index = aoc_nsp(_wfopen(wpath, L"rb"));
            files++;
            if (index >= 0) {
                aoc_found(index, name);
            } else {
                unknown++;
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %s is not a known add-on (left out)\n", name);
            }
        }
        if (h != -1) _findclose(h);
    }
#else
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    for (struct dirent *e; d && (e = readdir(d));) {
        if (!ends_with(e->d_name, ".nsp")) continue;
        char path[1024];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
        long index = aoc_nsp(fopen(path, "rb"));
        files++;
        if (index >= 0) {
            aoc_found(index, e->d_name);
        } else {
            unknown++;
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %s is not a known add-on (left out)\n", e->d_name);
        }
    }
    if (d) closedir(d);
#endif
    timespec_get(&t1, TIME_UTC);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: %u add-on content item(s) from %u file(s) in %s%s (%.0f ms)\n", naoc, files, dir,
            unknown ? "; unknown files left out" : "",
            (double)(t1.tv_sec - t0.tv_sec) * 1e3 + (double)(t1.tv_nsec - t0.tv_nsec) / 1e6);
}

int aoc_owned(uint32_t index) {
    aoc_load();
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < naoc; i++)
        if (aoc[i] == index) return 1;
    return 0;
}

void svc_aoc_u(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    aoc_load();
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 2:  /* CountAddOnContent(pid) -> u32 */
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = naoc;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    case 3: {  /* ListAddOnContent(u32 offset, u32 count, pid, B: u32 indices[]) -> u32 written */
        uint32_t off = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 0), count = IPC_IN(uint32_t, 4), n = 0;
        IpcBuffer out = ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        uint32_t *ids = out.addr ? (uint32_t *)GPTR(out.addr) : NULL;
        for (uint32_t i = off; i < naoc && n < count && ids && (n + 1) * 4 <= out.size; i++) ids[n++] = aoc[i];
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: aoc: ListAddOnContent(offset %u, count %u, buffer %llu bytes) -> %u\n", off, count,
                (unsigned long long)out.size, n);
        IPC_OUT(uint32_t, 0) = n;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 4);
        return;
    }
    case 5:  /* GetAddOnContentBaseId(pid) -> u64: the application's ID + 0x1000 */
        IPC_OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 0x010086C00AF7D000ull;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    case 7:  /* PrepareAddOnContent(u32 index, pid): nothing to mount until the game reads it */
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ---- pctl: parental controls. No restrictions are set. */

static const SimpleCommand pctl_service_simple[] = {
    {1, SIMPLE_OK, 0, "Initialize"},
};

    if (!IPC_SIMPLE(pctl_service_simple, req, resp)) ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

void svc_pctl(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0 || req->cmd == 1) {  /* CreateService / CreateServiceWithoutInitialize */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("IParentalControlService", pctl_service, NULL));
        return;
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}
```

`runtime/src/svc_sm.c`:

```c
/* sm: the service manager (decision 0014). Every other service is reached through it:
 * GetServiceHandle(name) returns a session to that service. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "ipc.h"

void svc_sm(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  /* RegisterClient / Initialize(pid) */
        return;
    case 1: {  /* GetServiceHandle(name: 8 chars, zero padded) -> session */
        char name[9] = {0};
        memcpy(name, req->data, 8);
        Service *svc = ipc_service_lookup(name);
        if (!svc) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: sm: no native service \"%s\" yet\n", name);
            yw4_stop();
        }
        ipc_return_object(resp, svc);
        return;
    }
    default:
        ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
    }
}
```

`runtime/src/svc_time.c`:

```c
/* time:u (and :a, :s): clocks and time zones (decision 0014). The clocks follow the host's.
 * Commands are added as the game first uses them; Switchbrew "Glue_services" / "PSC_services"
 * has the ids, LAS Recomp's services/time.c (MIT) was the cross-check for the shared memory.
 *
 * Time on the Switch: the steady clock counts seconds since boot (here: since the runtime
 * started, from CNTPCT); a system clock is "steady clock + offset", so its context stores
 * the offset and the steady time point it was taken at. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "ipc_simple.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

/* Identifies "this boot's" steady clock; any fixed value works. */
static const uint8_t clock_source[16] = {'y', 'w', '4', 'r', 'e', 'c', 'o', 'm', 'p', 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7};

static int64_t steady_seconds(void) { return (int64_t)(yw4_cntpct() / 19200000u); }

/* The date and time the game is told. YW4_CLOCK=<POSIX seconds> holds it still at that moment (tests: the sun
 * follows the time of day, so two runs of one replay only match on a held clock). */
static int64_t now_seconds(void) {
    static int read;
    static int64_t held = -1;
    if (!read) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_CLOCK");
        if (e && *e) held = atoll(e);
        read = 1;
    }
    return held >= 0 ? held : (int64_t)time(NULL);
}

/* SystemClockContext (0x20): offset, then SteadyClockTimePoint {seconds, source}. */
static void system_clock_context(uint8_t *p) {
    int64_t steady = steady_seconds();
    int64_t offset = now_seconds() - steady;
    memcpy(p, &offset, 8);
    memcpy(p + 8, &steady, 8);
    memcpy(p + 0x10, clock_source, 16);
}

/* The page the time service shares with every process. Each field is a LockFreeAtomicType:
 * a u32 counter, then two copies of the value; readers use copy (counter & 1). */
static void time_shared_memory(KSharedMemory *m) {
    uint8_t *p = GPTR(m->guest_addr);
    memset(p, 0, m->size);
    /* 0x00: SteadyClockContext {u64 internal offset, source}: copy 0 at +0x08 */
    memcpy(p + 0x08 + 8, clock_source, 16);
    /* 0x38: local system clock context, copy 0 at +0x40; 0x80: network system clock, +0x88 */
    system_clock_context(p + 0x40);
    system_clock_context(p + 0x88);
    /* 0xC8: automatic correction enabled (bool at +0xCC): off */
}

static void system_clock(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) { ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp); }
static void steady_clock(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) { ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp); }
/* CalendarTime (8) and CalendarAdditionalInfo (0x18) for a POSIX time in the host's time zone. */
static void calendar(time_t t, uint8_t *cal, uint8_t *info) {
    struct tm local, utc;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&local, &t);
    gmtime_s(&utc, &t);
#else
    localtime_r(&t, &local);
    gmtime_r(&t, &utc);
#endif
    utc.tm_isdst = local.tm_isdst;
    int32_t offset = (int32_t)difftime(mktime(&local), mktime(&utc));  /* seconds east of UTC */
    /* CalendarTime: year u16, month, day, hour, minute, second, pad */
    uint16_t year = (uint16_t)(local.tm_year + 1900);
    memcpy(cal, &year, 2);
    cal[2] = (uint8_t)(local.tm_mon + 1), cal[3] = (uint8_t)local.tm_mday;
    cal[4] = (uint8_t)local.tm_hour, cal[5] = (uint8_t)local.tm_min, cal[6] = (uint8_t)local.tm_sec;
    /* CalendarAdditionalInfo: day of week, day of year, zone name[8], is DST, UTC offset */
    uint32_t wday = (uint32_t)local.tm_wday, yday = (uint32_t)local.tm_yday, dst = local.tm_isdst > 0;
    memcpy(info, &wday, 4);
    memcpy(info + 4, &yday, 4);
    memcpy(info + 8, "LOCAL", 6);
    memcpy(info + 16, &dst, 4);
    memcpy(info + 20, &offset, 4);
}

/* ITimeZoneService: the device's time zone is the host's local one. */
static void time_zone(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 101: {  /* ToCalendarTimeWithMyRule(PosixTime) -> CalendarTime, CalendarAdditionalInfo */
        calendar((time_t)IPC_IN(int64_t, 0), resp->data, resp->data + 8);
        ipc_out_size(resp, 0x20);
        return;
    }
    }
    ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
}

/* ClockSnapshot (0xD0), as in Switchbrew's "PSC services": user and network clock context
 * (0x20 each), POSIX times, calendar times (8) and additional infos (0x18), the steady clock
 * time point (0x18), the location name (0x24), the auto-correction flag and the type. */
static void clock_snapshot(uint8_t *p, uint8_t type) {
    memset(p, 0, 0xD0);
    system_clock_context(p + 0x00);
    system_clock_context(p + 0x20);
    int64_t now = now_seconds();
    memcpy(p + 0x40, &now, 8);
    memcpy(p + 0x48, &now, 8);
    calendar((time_t)now, p + 0x50, p + 0x60);
    calendar((time_t)now, p + 0x58, p + 0x78);
    int64_t steady = steady_seconds();
    memcpy(p + 0x90, &steady, 8);
    memcpy(p + 0x98, clock_source, 16);
    memcpy(p + 0xA8, "LOCAL", 6);
    p[0xCD] = type;
}

static uint32_t shared_memory_handle;

/* IStaticService: hands out the clock interfaces. */
void svc_time(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: case 1: case 4:  /* GetStandardUserSystemClock / NetworkSystemClock / LocalSystemClock */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("ISystemClock", system_clock, NULL));
        return;
    case 2:  /* GetStandardSteadyClock */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("ISteadyClock", steady_clock, NULL));
        return;
    case 3:  /* GetTimeZoneService */
        ipc_return_object(resp, ipc_service_new("ITimeZoneService", time_zone, NULL));
        return;
    case 20:  /* GetSharedMemoryNativeHandle: one page, the same for every caller */
        if (!shared_memory_handle) yw4_shared_memory_new(0x1000, time_shared_memory, &shared_memory_handle);
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = shared_memory_handle;
        return;
    case 500: {  /* CalculateStandardUserSystemClockDifferenceByUser(snapshot a, snapshot b) -> TimeSpan ns */
        /* How far the user moved the console's clock between two snapshots; on a Switch 0 unless they did.
         * The game asks it with the snapshot kept in the save and one of now (main+0x3bd260) and, on anything
         * but 0, warns that the time was changed and counts towards its Crank-a-Kai penalty. A PC has no
         * console clock to set, so: never. (Until 2026-11-11 this returned the time between the snapshots,
         * the real time since the save, and the warning showed on every load.) */
        if (req->nx < 2 || req->x[0].size < 0xD0 || req->x[1].size < 0xD0) break;
        IPC_OUT(int64_t, 0) = 0;
        ipc_out_size(resp, 8);
        return;
    }
    case 400: {  /* GetClockSnapshot(u8 type) -> ClockSnapshot (receive buffer) */
        IpcBuffer out = ipc_out_buffer(req, 0);
        if (out.size < 0xD0) break;
        clock_snapshot(GPTR(out.addr), IPC_IN(uint8_t, 0));
        return;
    }
    default:
        ipc_unimplemented(s, req, resp);
    }
}

/* hook on f_3bd260 (recomp/overrides.toml), instead of its body: the game's "the console's time was changed"
 * check. It answers yes when any of three things differ between the snapshot kept in the save (this + 0x160)
 * and one of now: the clock difference by the user (command 500 above), the time zone's name, or a CRC-32 of
 * the console's pseudo device id (this + 0x230). On yes the game warns and counts towards its Crank-a-Kai
 * penalty. A save brought over from a Switch or an emulator differs in the last two the first time it is
 * loaded, through no doing of the player, and a PC has no console clock to cheat with: the answer is no.
 * The first call logs what the save holds, to tell which of the three it would have been. */
int yw4_hook_time_changed(CPUState *ctx) {
    static int logged;
    if (!logged) {
        const uint8_t *snap = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctx->x[0] + 0x160);
        char zone[0x25];
        uint32_t crc;
        memcpy(zone, snap + 0xA8, 0x24), zone[0x24] = 0;
        memcpy(&crc, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctx->x[0] + 0x230), 4);
        for (char *c = zone; *c; c++)
            if (*c < 0x20 || *c > 0x7E) *c = '?';
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: time: the game's time-change check is answered \"not changed\" (the save's snapshot: "
                        "time zone \"%s\", device id CRC %08x)\n", zone, (unsigned)crc);
        logged = 1;
    }
    ctx->x[0] = 0;
    return 1;
}
```

`runtime/src/swkbd.c`:

```c
/* nn::swkbd, the software keyboard, as an override of the sdk's ShowKeyboard (decision 0022).
 *
 * On the Switch ShowKeyboard launches the keyboard library applet and waits for its answer.
 * We have no applets: the player types the name in the overlay's popup (gamemenu.h), or in replays the call
 * answers at once: YW4_PLAYER_NAME, else the character's default name (below). The game's name entry calls it with String = { buffer; size_t size } (size =
 * GetRequiredStringBufferSize) and its KeyboardConfig asks for UTF-8 (offset 0x3bd) and at most 8 characters
 * (0x3ac); offsets from the sdk's keyboardConfig2kbdConfig, values measured 2026-11-07. Until then the answer was
 * UTF-16, which the game read as one letter: new saves named the boy "N". Typing a name: next (textin.h).
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gamemenu.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "romfs.h"
#include "savefs.h"
#include "textin.h"
#include "window.h"
#include "yw4load.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

#define DEFAULT_NAME "Nate"
#define DEFAULT_GIRL "Katie"  /* the girl's name (the second question of a new game) */

/* Typed text, made full-width (hook on f_9997e0, main+0x9997e0; owner, 2026-11-14). After an OK answer the game's
 * keyboard handler (f_8aa550 / f_8a9xxx, from f_959be0) runs the typed UTF-8 text through f_9997e0(dst, src), which
 * maps each character through a 156-entry table at main+0x12be9d0 (u16 from, u16 to): every ASCII character to its
 * full-width form (A -> Ａ, space -> U+3000) and half-width katakana to normal katakana. Names in English then
 * became Ｎａｔｅ, which the game draws a wide cell per letter ("N a t e"; decision 0066).
 * This does the same, with the game's own table, except that ASCII stays as typed: katakana are still made
 * full-size, so Japanese names are as before. Output as the game's: at most 0x100 bytes with the closing 0. */
int yw4_hook_kbd_fullwidth(CPUState *ctx) {
    /* only the answer the game keeps (f_8aa550 calls it from +0xa4): the game's name check converts too and then
     * allows full-width letters only, so it keeps the game's conversion ("This name cannot be used" otherwise) */
    if (ctx->x[30] != *yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].base + 0x8aa5f8) return 0;
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ctx->x[0], *end = dst + 0x100;
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ctx->x[1];
    const uint16_t *table = (const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(*yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].base + 0x12be9d0);
    enum { ENTRIES = 0x9c };
    while (*src) {
        /* one UTF-8 character */
        uint32_t c = *src;
        int len = c < 0x80 ? 1 : c >= 0xf0 ? 4 : c >= 0xe0 ? 3 : c >= 0xc0 ? 2 : 1;
        if (len > 1) c &= 0x3f >> (len - 1);
        int k = 1;
        for (; k < len && (src[k] & 0xc0) == 0x80; k++) c = c << 6 | (src[k] & 0x3f);
        src += k;
        /* the game's table (sorted by its first column), not for ASCII */
        if (c >= 0x80)
            for (int lo = 0, hi = ENTRIES - 2; lo <= hi;) {  /* the last entry is the 0, 0 end */
                int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
                uint16_t from = table[mid * 2];
                if (from == c) { c = table[mid * 2 + 1]; break; }
                if (from < c) lo = mid + 1;
                else hi = mid - 1;
            }
        uint8_t out[4];
        int n = c < 0x80 ? (out[0] = (uint8_t)c, 1)
              : c < 0x800 ? (out[0] = (uint8_t)(0xc0 | c >> 6), out[1] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)), 2)
              : (out[0] = (uint8_t)(0xe0 | (c >> 12 & 0x0f)), out[1] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c >> 6 & 0x3f)),
                 out[2] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)), 3);
        if (dst + n >= end) break;  /* room for the closing 0 */
        memcpy(dst, out, (size_t)n);
        dst += n;
    }
    *dst = 0;
    ctx->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)dst;
    return 1;  /* done: the game's own conversion is skipped */
}

/* Invokes the game's internal text check callback (SetTextCheckCallback), if registered.
 * Returns 0 if valid (accepted) or if text checking is inactive; non-zero if rejected by the game. */
static int check_name(CPUState *c, const uint8_t *a, const char *name, int utf8, int max) {
    if (!a[0x3d0]) return 0;
    uint64_t cb = *(const uint64_t *)(a + 0x3d8);
    if (!cb) return 0;

    uint16_t *buf = (uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[0];
    uint64_t orig_size = ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1];
    if (!buf || !orig_size) return 0;

    uint64_t chars = 0, n = 0;
    if (utf8) {
        uint8_t *out = (uint8_t *)buf;
        for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; *p && n + 4 < orig_size;) {
            int len = *p < 0x80 ? 1 : *p < 0xE0 ? 2 : *p < 0xF0 ? 3 : 4;
            if (max > 0 && (int)chars >= max) break;
            for (int k = 0; k < len && p[k]; k++) out[n++] = p[k];
            p += len, chars++;
        }
        out[n] = 0;
    } else {
        uint64_t room = orig_size / 2;
        for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; *p && n + 1 < room;) {
            uint32_t cp = *p;
            int len = 1;
            if (cp >= 0xE0) cp = (cp & 15) << 12 | (p[1] & 63) << 6 | (p[2] & 63), len = 3;
            else if (cp >= 0xC0) cp = (cp & 31) << 6 | (p[1] & 63), len = 2;
            if (max > 0 && (int)chars >= max) break;
            buf[n++] = (uint16_t)cp, p += len, chars++;
        }
        buf[n] = 0;
    }

    ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1] = utf8 ? n : n * 2;

    uint64_t out_len = 0;
    CPUState call_ctx = *c;
    call_ctx.x[0] = *(const uint64_t *)(a + 0x4e0);
    call_ctx.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&out_len;
    call_ctx.x[2] = c->x[0];
    call_ctx.x[30] = 0;

    GuestFn fn = yw4_resolve(cb);
    fn(&call_ctx);

    ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1] = orig_size;

    uint32_t result = (uint32_t)call_ctx.x[0];
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: textcheck \"%s\" (callback 0x%llx) -> result %u\n",
            name, (unsigned long long)cb, result);
    return result != 0;
}

/* A main character's default name for the token the game starts name entry with ("<NAME_KETA_8888>"...), in the
 * game's language. The names are in data/common/text/ja/chara_text.cfg.bin, as six names, Neptuna (マグロドン),
 * then the six tokens in the same order (measured in the game's file and the English patch's, 2026-11-13). A
 * translation mod replaces that file with a loose one, read here; the game's own copy is inside text_all.cpk
 * (compressed), so without a mod the game's Japanese names below are used. NULL: not a main character's token. */
static const char *main_name_for(const char *token) {
    static const char *const tokens[] = {"<NAME_TOUMA", "<NAME_NATSUME", "<NAME_AKINORI",
                                         "<NAME_SHIN",  "<NAME_KETA",    "<NAME_FUMI"};
    static const char *const japanese[] = {"トウマ", "ナツメ", "アキノリ", "シン", "ケータ", "フミ"};
    static char from_mod[6][64];
    static int loaded;  /* 0 not yet, 1 from the mod's file, -1 the Japanese names */
    int k = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        if (!strncmp(token, tokens[i], strlen(tokens[i]))) k = i;
    if (k < 0) return NULL;
    if (!loaded) {
        loaded = -1;
        const char *path = romfs_host_path("data/common/text/ja/chara_text.cfg.bin");
        FILE *f = path ? fopen(path, "rb") : NULL;
        char *d = NULL;
        long n = 0;
        if (f && !fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) && (n = ftell(f)) > 0 && !fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) && (d = malloc((size_t)n + 1)) &&
            fread(d, 1, (size_t)n, f) == (size_t)n) {
            d[n] = 0;
            /* the first token, then the strings before it: Neptuna, then the six names, last first */
            const char *t = NULL;
            for (long i = 0; i + 16 <= n && !t; i++)
                if (!memcmp(d + i, "<NAME_TOUMA_888>", 16) && i > 0 && !d[i - 1]) t = d + i;
            const char *starts[7];
            int got = 0;
            for (const char *p = t ? t - 1 : NULL; p && got < 7 && p > d;) {
                const char *q = p - 1;  /* p is the zero that ends the string before */
                while (q > d && q[-1]) q--;
                const char *s = q;  /* the first string follows the table's 0xFF filler (never in UTF-8) */
                while (s < p && (unsigned char)*s == 0xFF) s++;
                if (p - s <= 0 || p - s >= 64) break;
                starts[got++] = s, p = q - 1;
            }
            if (got == 7) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) snprintf(from_mod[i], sizeof from_mod[i], "%s", starts[6 - i]);
                loaded = 1;
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: main characters' names: %s (%s)\n",
                    loaded == 1 ? "the mod's" : "not found in the mod's file, the game's Japanese ones", path);
        }
        if (f) fclose(f);
        free(d);
    }
    return loaded == 1 ? from_mod[k] : japanese[k];
}

/* nn::ngc::ProfanityFilter: accepts names without requiring the Switch NgWord2 system archive */

void yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_GetContentVersion(CPUState *c) { c->x[0] = 1; }
```
