```c
/* ShowKeyboard(String *out, const ShowKeyboardArg &) -> Result */
void yw4_swkbd_ShowKeyboard(CPUState *c) {
    uint16_t *buf = (uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[0];
    uint64_t size = ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1];
    {  /* what the game asks (KeyboardConfig, offsets from the sdk's keyboardConfig2kbdConfig, 2026-11-07) */
        const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1];
        char head[200] = "", guide[200] = "";
        for (int i = 0, n = 0; i < 64 && n < 190; i++) {
            uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x24 + 2 * i);
            if (!ch) break;
            n += snprintf(head + n, sizeof head - n, ch < 128 ? "%c" : "\\u%04x", ch);
        }
        for (int i = 0, n = 0; i < 256 && n < 190; i++) {
            uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x1a8 + 2 * i);
            if (!ch) break;
            n += snprintf(guide + n, sizeof guide - n, ch < 128 ? "%c" : "\\u%04x", ch);
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: mode %u header \"%s\" guide \"%s\" max %d min %d password %u form %u newline %u "
                "utf8 %u initial at %d len %d textcheck %u callback 0x%llx\n",
                *(const uint32_t *)a, head, guide, *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3ac), *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3b0),
                *(const uint32_t *)(a + 0x3b4), *(const uint32_t *)(a + 0x3b8), a[0x3bc], a[0x3bd],
                *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3c0), *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3c4), a[0x3d0],
                (unsigned long long)*(const uint64_t *)(a + 0x3d8));
    }
    const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1];
    int utf8 = a[0x3bd], max = *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3ac);
    /* the game's own starting text: UTF-16 in the work buffer (ShowKeyboardArg + 0x4d0), at the offset 0x3c0 holds */
    char initial[96] = "";
    {
        const uint8_t *work = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)*(const uint64_t *)(a + 0x4d0);
        int off = *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3c0), len = *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3c4), n = 0;
        if (work && off >= 0 && len > 0)
            for (int i = 0; i < len && i < 32; i++) {
                uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(work + off + 2 * i);
                if (!ch) break;
                if (ch < 0x80) initial[n++] = (char)ch;
                else if (ch < 0x800) initial[n++] = (char)(0xC0 | ch >> 6), initial[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch & 63));
                else initial[n++] = (char)(0xE0 | ch >> 12), initial[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch >> 6 & 63)),
                     initial[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch & 63));
                if (n > (int)sizeof initial - 4) break;
            }
        initial[n] = 0;
    }
    const char *name = getenv("YW4_PLAYER_NAME");
    /* the game's starting text is a width placeholder at name entry ("<NAME_KETA_8888>", measured 2026-11-07), not a
     * name: one in <...> is left out */
    char token[96];
    snprintf(token, sizeof token, "%s", initial);  /* as the game gave it, for the log */
    if (initial[0] == '<') {
        /* The game's starting text is a name's token (the one its texts use for that character's name), e.g.
         * "<NAME_KETA_8888>" for the boy: each main character's default name in the English patch (system_text,
         * 2026-11-07); "My name is..." asks three times, so the token, not the question, tells them apart. Other
         * tokens: no default. A Yo-kai's nickname or a My Set's name starts with real text, kept as is. */
        const char *known = main_name_for(initial);
        snprintf(initial, sizeof initial, "%s", known ? known : "");
    }
    /* a new game asks twice: the boy's name, then "the girl he loves" (English header; 女 in Japanese) */
    int girl = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x24 + 2 * i);
        if (!ch) break;
        if (ch == 0x5973 || (ch == 'g' && *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x26 + 2 * i) == 'i' &&
                             *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x28 + 2 * i) == 'r' && *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x2a + 2 * i) == 'l'))
            girl = 1;
    }
    /* the popup's default: only what the game gave (a character's name, a Yo-kai's name...); a password has none.
     * Replays answer at once: there "Nate" (or "Katie") when the game gave nothing. */
    const char *fallback = initial[0] ? initial : girl ? DEFAULT_GIRL : DEFAULT_NAME;
    int min = *(const int32_t *)(a + 0x3b0), main_name = token[0] == '<';
    /* a name the game gave a default for (a download code has none): on the title, the boy's starts a new game, whose
     * Diary slot is picked first (savefs.c, decision 0078) */
    if (token[0]) savefs_new_game_naming(token, girl);
    /* The player types it (board N1): the overlay's popup over the game's last frame, which this thread shows again
     * while it waits (the game waits here too, as on the Switch). Not in replays (their clock counts frames, which
     * stop here) or with YW4_PLAYER_NAME: those answer at once. */
    static char typed[TEXTIN_MAX];
    int checked = 0;
    const char *replay = getenv("YW4_REPLAY"), *force = getenv("YW4_NAME_PROMPT");  /* =1: the popup in replays too */
    if ((!name || !*name) && (!(replay && *replay) || (force && *force == '1')) && window_repaint(1) == 0) {
        char title[200];
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64 && n < (int)sizeof title - 4; i++) {  /* the game's question, UTF-16 to UTF-8 */
            uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(a + 0x24 + 2 * i);
            if (!ch) break;
            if (ch < 0x80) title[n++] = (char)ch;
            else if (ch < 0x800) title[n++] = (char)(0xC0 | ch >> 6), title[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch & 63));
            else title[n++] = (char)(0xE0 | ch >> 12), title[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch >> 6 & 63)),
                 title[n++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch & 63));
        }
        title[n] = 0;
        /* Cancel everywhere but a main character's name (the start of a new game: how the game takes a cancelled
         * name there isn't known, so it isn't offered) */
        for (;;) {
            gamemenu_prompt_options(min, !main_name);
            gamemenu_prompt_begin(title, max, initial);
            int how;
            while (!(how = gamemenu_prompt_take(typed, sizeof typed))) {
                window_repaint(0);
                host_sleep_ns(16 * 1000000LL);
            }
            window_repaint(0);  /* the popup gone before the game goes on */
            if (how == 2) {  /* Cancel: what the sdk returns when the keyboard is closed (nn::swkbd's 0x29f, read from
                              * ShowKeyboard), the string left as it is */
                fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: cancelled\n");
                c->x[0] = 0x29f;
                return;
            }
            const char *cand = typed[0] ? typed : fallback;
            if (!check_name(c, a, cand, utf8, max)) {
                name = cand;
                checked = 1;
                break;
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: name \"%s\" rejected by text check callback\n", cand);
            gamemenu_message_begin(title, "This name cannot be used.");
            char dummy[16];
            while (!gamemenu_prompt_take(dummy, sizeof dummy)) {
                window_repaint(0);
                host_sleep_ns(16 * 1000000LL);
            }
            window_repaint(0);
            snprintf(initial, sizeof initial, "%s", cand);
        }
    }
    if (!name || !*name) name = fallback;
    if (!checked) check_name(c, a, name, utf8, max);
    /* At most `max` characters (0: no limit), and what the game asked for: UTF-8 when the config says so (the game
     * does, 2026-11-07: before, a UTF-16 answer made the name its first letter, "N"), else UTF-16. */
    uint64_t chars = 0, n = 0;
    if (utf8) {
        uint8_t *out = (uint8_t *)buf;
        for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; buf && *p && n + 4 < size;) {
            int len = *p < 0x80 ? 1 : *p < 0xE0 ? 2 : *p < 0xF0 ? 3 : 4;
            if (max > 0 && (int)chars >= max) break;
            for (int k = 0; k < len && p[k]; k++) out[n++] = p[k];
            p += len, chars++;
        }
        if (buf && size) out[n] = 0;
    } else {
        uint64_t room = size / 2;
        for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; buf && *p && n + 1 < room;) {
            uint32_t cp = *p;
            int len = 1;
            if (cp >= 0xE0) cp = (cp & 15) << 12 | (p[1] & 63) << 6 | (p[2] & 63), len = 3;
            else if (cp >= 0xC0) cp = (cp & 31) << 6 | (p[1] & 63), len = 2;
            if (max > 0 && (int)chars >= max) break;
            buf[n++] = (uint16_t)cp, p += len, chars++;
        }
        if (buf && room) buf[n] = 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: swkbd: answered with \"%s\" (%s, %llu characters, buffer %llu bytes; the game's text \"%s\")\n",
            name, utf8 ? "UTF-8" : "UTF-16", (unsigned long long)chars, (unsigned long long)size, token);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/sysinfo.c`:

```c
/* The machine the run is on, printed once at the start of every log: OS, CPU, RAM, the disk the game's folder is on, and
 * the display session. A bug report then says what the player has (issue #14, 2026-11-16: a crash on an Intel HD 520,
 * and the log could not say how much RAM the machine had or how full its disk was). Read once, at start; nothing here
 * is sent anywhere. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/statvfs.h>
#include <sys/utsname.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#define GIB (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0)

#ifndef _WIN32
/* The text after `key` on the first line of `file` that starts with it (spaces, ':', '=' and quotes skipped). */
static int file_value(const char *file, const char *key, char *out, size_t n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(file, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[512];
    int ok = 0;
    size_t klen = strlen(key);
    while (!ok && fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        if (strncmp(line, key, klen) != 0) continue;
        char *v = line + klen;
        while (*v == ' ' || *v == '\t' || *v == ':' || *v == '=' || *v == '"') v++;
        v[strcspn(v, "\r\n")] = 0;
        size_t len = strlen(v);
        while (len && v[len - 1] == '"') v[--len] = 0;
        snprintf(out, n, "%s", v);
        ok = 1;
    }
    fclose(f);
    return ok;
}

/* A /proc/meminfo figure ("MemTotal:   16384 kB") in bytes; 0 when it is not there. */
static uint64_t meminfo_bytes(const char *key) {
    char v[64];
    if (!file_value("/proc/meminfo", key, v, sizeof v)) return 0;
    return strtoull(v, NULL, 10) * 1024;
}
#endif

void yw4_sysinfo_dump(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    OSVERSIONINFOW vi = {.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof vi};
    typedef LONG(WINAPI * RtlGetVersionFn)(OSVERSIONINFOW *);
    RtlGetVersionFn rtl = (RtlGetVersionFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll"), "RtlGetVersion");
    if (rtl && rtl(&vi) == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: OS Windows %lu.%lu build %lu\n", (unsigned long)vi.dwMajorVersion,
                (unsigned long)vi.dwMinorVersion, (unsigned long)vi.dwBuildNumber);
    else
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: OS Windows (version not read)\n");

    SYSTEM_INFO si;
    GetSystemInfo(&si);
    char cpu[128] = "unknown";
    const char *id = getenv("PROCESSOR_IDENTIFIER");
    if (id) snprintf(cpu, sizeof cpu, "%s", id);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: CPU %s, %lu logical processors\n", cpu, (unsigned long)si.dwNumberOfProcessors);

    MEMORYSTATUSEX m = {.dwLength = sizeof m};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&m))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: RAM %.1f GiB total, %.1f GiB available; page file %.1f GiB total, %.1f GiB available\n",
                (double)m.ullTotalPhys / GIB, (double)m.ullAvailPhys / GIB, (double)m.ullTotalPageFile / GIB,
                (double)m.ullAvailPageFile / GIB);

    ULARGE_INTEGER avail, total;
    if (GetDiskFreeSpaceExA(".", &avail, &total, NULL))
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: disk of the game's folder %.1f GiB free of %.1f GiB\n", (double)avail.QuadPart / GIB,
                (double)total.QuadPart / GIB);
#else
    struct utsname u;
    if (uname(&u) == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: kernel %s %s\n", u.release, u.machine);
    char os[160] = "unknown";
    file_value("/etc/os-release", "PRETTY_NAME", os, sizeof os);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: OS %s\n", os);

    char cpu[160] = "unknown";
    file_value("/proc/cpuinfo", "model name", cpu, sizeof cpu);
    long threads = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: CPU %s, %ld logical processors\n", cpu, threads);

    uint64_t total = meminfo_bytes("MemTotal"), avail = meminfo_bytes("MemAvailable");
    uint64_t swap = meminfo_bytes("SwapTotal"), swapfree = meminfo_bytes("SwapFree");
    if (total)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: RAM %.1f GiB total, %.1f GiB available; swap %.1f GiB total, %.1f GiB free\n",
                (double)total / GIB, (double)avail / GIB, (double)swap / GIB, (double)swapfree / GIB);

    struct statvfs sv;
    if (statvfs(".", &sv) == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: disk of the game's folder %.1f GiB free of %.1f GiB\n",
                (double)sv.f_bavail * (double)sv.f_frsize / GIB, (double)sv.f_blocks * (double)sv.f_frsize / GIB);

    const char *session = getenv("XDG_SESSION_TYPE");
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: system: display session %s%s\n", session ? session : "unknown",
            getenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY") ? " (Wayland)" : "");
#endif
}
```

`runtime/src/tegra.c`:

```c
/* Tegra X1 texture layout (tegra.h).
 *
 * Block-linear: a GOB is 64 bytes x 8 rows (512 bytes); a block stacks 2^bh GOBs vertically
 * and 2^bd in depth; a level is whole blocks. Smaller mip levels shrink the block height so
 * a block is never much taller than the level.
 *
 * Adapted from LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/tegra.c, formats.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "tegra.h"

#define C(bpb) {bpb, 1, 1, FMT_COLOR}
#define B(bpb, w, h) {bpb, w, h, FMT_COMPRESSED}

/* NVNformat -> size. Zero entries are formats we don't know (nvn_format_info: NULL). */
static const FormatInfo formats[] = {
    [0x01] = C(1), [0x02] = C(1), [0x03] = C(1), [0x04] = C(1),                 /* R8 */
    [0x05] = C(2), [0x06] = C(2), [0x07] = C(2), [0x08] = C(2), [0x09] = C(2),  /* R16 */
    [0x0A] = C(4), [0x0B] = C(4), [0x0C] = C(4),                                /* R32 */
    [0x0D] = C(2), [0x0E] = C(2), [0x0F] = C(2), [0x10] = C(2),                 /* RG8 */
    [0x11] = C(4), [0x12] = C(4), [0x13] = C(4), [0x14] = C(4), [0x15] = C(4),  /* RG16 */
    [0x16] = C(8), [0x17] = C(8), [0x18] = C(8),                                /* RG32 */
    [0x19] = C(3), [0x1A] = C(3), [0x1B] = C(3), [0x1C] = C(3),                 /* RGB8 */
    [0x1D] = C(6), [0x1E] = C(6), [0x1F] = C(6), [0x20] = C(6), [0x21] = C(6),  /* RGB16 */
    [0x22] = C(12), [0x23] = C(12), [0x24] = C(12),                             /* RGB32 */
    [0x25] = C(4), [0x26] = C(4), [0x27] = C(4), [0x28] = C(4),                 /* RGBA8 */
    [0x29] = C(8), [0x2A] = C(8), [0x2B] = C(8), [0x2C] = C(8), [0x2D] = C(8),  /* RGBA16 */
    [0x2E] = C(16), [0x2F] = C(16), [0x30] = C(16),                             /* RGBA32 */
    [0x31] = {1, 1, 1, FMT_STENCIL},                                            /* STENCIL8 */
    [0x32] = {2, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH}, [0x33] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH}, [0x34] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH},  /* DEPTH16/24/32F */
    [0x35] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL}, [0x36] = {8, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL},  /* DEPTH24_STENCIL8, DEPTH32F_STENCIL8 */
    [0x37] = C(4), [0x38] = C(4),                                               /* RGBX8 / RGBA8 sRGB */
    [0x39] = C(2), [0x3A] = C(2), [0x3B] = C(2), [0x3C] = C(2),                 /* RGBA4, RGB5, RGB5A1, RGB565 */
    [0x3D] = C(4), [0x3E] = C(4), [0x3F] = C(4), [0x40] = C(4),                 /* RGB10A2(UI), R11G11B10F, RGB9E5 */
    [0x41] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x42] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x43] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x44] = B(16, 4, 4),  /* BC1-3 */
    [0x45] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x46] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x47] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x48] = B(16, 4, 4),  /* BC1-3 sRGB */
    [0x49] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x4A] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x4B] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x4C] = B(16, 4, 4),  /* BC4, BC5 */
    [0x4D] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x4E] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x4F] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x50] = B(16, 4, 4),  /* BC6H, BC7 */
    /* vertex formats: integers read as floats */
    [0x51] = C(1), [0x52] = C(1), [0x53] = C(2), [0x54] = C(2), [0x55] = C(4), [0x56] = C(4),
    [0x57] = C(2), [0x58] = C(2), [0x59] = C(4), [0x5A] = C(4), [0x5B] = C(8), [0x5C] = C(8),
    [0x5D] = C(3), [0x5E] = C(3), [0x5F] = C(6), [0x60] = C(6), [0x61] = C(12), [0x62] = C(12),
    [0x63] = C(4), [0x64] = C(4), [0x65] = C(8), [0x66] = C(8), [0x67] = C(16), [0x68] = C(16),
    [0x69] = C(4), [0x6A] = C(4), [0x6B] = C(4), [0x6C] = C(4),
    [0x6D] = C(4), [0x6E] = C(4), [0x6F] = C(4), [0x70] = C(4),                 /* RGBX8 */
    [0x71] = C(8), [0x72] = C(8), [0x73] = C(8), [0x74] = C(8), [0x75] = C(8),  /* RGBX16 */
    [0x76] = C(16), [0x77] = C(16), [0x78] = C(16),                             /* RGBX32 */
    /* ASTC, linear then sRGB */
    [0x79] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x7A] = B(16, 5, 4), [0x7B] = B(16, 5, 5), [0x7C] = B(16, 6, 5),
    [0x7D] = B(16, 6, 6), [0x7E] = B(16, 8, 5), [0x7F] = B(16, 8, 6), [0x80] = B(16, 8, 8),
    [0x81] = B(16, 10, 5), [0x82] = B(16, 10, 6), [0x83] = B(16, 10, 8), [0x84] = B(16, 10, 10),
    [0x85] = B(16, 12, 10), [0x86] = B(16, 12, 12),
    [0x87] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x88] = B(16, 5, 4), [0x89] = B(16, 5, 5), [0x8A] = B(16, 6, 5),
    [0x8B] = B(16, 6, 6), [0x8C] = B(16, 8, 5), [0x8D] = B(16, 8, 6), [0x8E] = B(16, 8, 8),
    [0x8F] = B(16, 10, 5), [0x90] = B(16, 10, 6), [0x91] = B(16, 10, 8), [0x92] = B(16, 10, 10),
    [0x93] = B(16, 12, 10), [0x94] = B(16, 12, 12),
    [0x95] = C(2), [0x96] = C(2), [0x97] = C(2),                                /* BGR5, BGR5A1, A1BGR5 */
    [0x98] = C(4), [0x99] = C(4), [0x9A] = C(4), [0x9B] = C(4),                 /* BGRX8, BGRA8 (+ sRGB) */
};

const FormatInfo *nvn_format_info(uint32_t f) {
    return f < sizeof formats / sizeof *formats && formats[f].bpb ? &formats[f] : NULL;
}

static uint32_t div_up(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) { return (a + b - 1) / b; }
static uint64_t align_up(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (a + b - 1) / b * b; }

void tegra_layout_init(TexLayout *t) {
    uint32_t gobs = div_up(div_up(t->height, t->fmt->bh), 8), bh = 0, bd = 0;
    while ((1u << bh) < gobs && bh < 4) bh++;  /* up to 16 GOBs per block */
    while (t->depth > 1 && (1u << bd) < t->depth && bd < 5) bd++;
    t->block_height_log2 = bh;
    t->block_depth_log2 = bd;
}

static uint64_t level_size(const TexLayout *t, uint32_t level, LevelLayout *out) {
    uint32_t w = t->width >> level, h = t->height >> level, d = t->depth >> level;
    if (!w) w = 1;
    if (!h) h = 1;
    if (!d) d = 1;
    uint32_t wb = div_up(w, t->fmt->bw), hb = div_up(h, t->fmt->bh);
    uint32_t bh = t->block_height_log2, bd = t->block_depth_log2;
    while (bh > 0 && (8u << (bh - 1)) >= hb) bh--;
    while (bd > 0 && (1u << (bd - 1)) >= d) bd--;
    uint64_t width_gobs = div_up(wb * t->fmt->bpb, 64);
    uint64_t size = width_gobs * 512 * (1u << bh) * (1u << bd) * div_up(hb, 8u << bh) * div_up(d, 1u << bd);
    if (out) *out = (LevelLayout){0, w, h, d, wb, hb, bh, bd};
    return size;
}

LevelLayout tegra_level(const TexLayout *t, uint32_t level) {
    LevelLayout l;
    uint64_t off = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < level; i++) off += level_size(t, i, NULL);
    level_size(t, level, &l);
    l.offset = off;
    return l;
}

uint64_t tegra_layer_size(const TexLayout *t) {
    uint64_t layer = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < t->levels; i++) layer += level_size(t, i, NULL);
    if (t->layers > 1) layer = align_up(layer, 512ull << t->block_height_log2);  /* layers start on a block */
    return layer;
}

uint64_t tegra_total_size(const TexLayout *t) { return tegra_layer_size(t) * (t->layers ? t->layers : 1); }

/* Byte offset of (x bytes, row y, slice z) in a block-linear surface. */
static uint64_t gob_offset(uint32_t xb, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t width_gobs, uint32_t bh, uint32_t bd,
                           uint64_t block_rows) {
    uint32_t gob_y = y >> 3;
    uint64_t block_size = 512ull << (bh + bd);
    uint64_t off = ((uint64_t)(z >> bd) * block_rows + (gob_y >> bh)) * width_gobs * block_size;
    off += (uint64_t)(xb >> 6) * block_size;
    off += ((uint64_t)(z & ((1u << bd) - 1)) << bh | (gob_y & ((1u << bh) - 1))) * 512;
    uint32_t xi = xb & 63, yi = y & 7;  /* inside the GOB: 16-byte sectors */
    return off + (((xi >> 5) << 8) | ((yi >> 1) << 6) | (((xi >> 4) & 1) << 5) | ((yi & 1) << 4) | (xi & 15));
}

/* One GOB row's 64 bytes: its four 16-byte pieces lie at +0, +32, +256 and +288 from the row's start in the
 * GOB (gob_offset with the byte offset inside the GOB 0, 16, 32, 48). */
static void copy_gob_row(uint8_t *lin, uint8_t *b, int to_linear) {
    if (to_linear) memcpy(lin, b, 16), memcpy(lin + 16, b + 32, 16), memcpy(lin + 32, b + 256, 16), memcpy(lin + 48, b + 288, 16);
    else memcpy(b, lin, 16), memcpy(b + 32, lin + 16, 16), memcpy(b + 256, lin + 32, 16), memcpy(b + 288, lin + 48, 16);
}

static void copy_region_ref(const TexLayout *t, uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                            uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint8_t *linear, int to_linear);

/* Copies a region between block-linear storage and tightly packed linear rows. Rows that start on a GOB
 * take one address per 64 bytes (copy_gob_row): an area's few hundred new textures took ~0.24 ms each with
 * one per 16 bytes (2026-11-02); anything else goes the general way (copy_region_ref). */
static void copy_region(const TexLayout *t, uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                        uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint8_t *linear, int to_linear) {
    LevelLayout l = tegra_level(t, level);
    uint32_t bpb = t->fmt->bpb, bw = t->fmt->bw, bh = t->fmt->bh;
    uint32_t x0 = x / bw, y0 = y / bh, wb = div_up(w, bw), hb = div_up(h, bh);
    if ((x0 * bpb) % 64 || 16 % bpb) {
        copy_region_ref(t, base, level, layer, x, y, z, w, h, d, linear, to_linear);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t *surface = base + (uint64_t)layer * tegra_layer_size(t) + l.offset;
    uint32_t width_gobs = div_up(l.wb * bpb, 64);
    uint64_t block_rows = div_up(l.hb, 8u << l.block_height_log2);
    uint32_t row = wb * bpb, xs = x0 * bpb;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d; k++)
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < hb; j++) {
            uint8_t *lin = linear + ((uint64_t)k * hb + j) * row;
            uint32_t xb = 0;
            for (; xb + 64 <= row; xb += 64)
                copy_gob_row(lin + xb, surface + gob_offset(xs + xb, y0 + j, z + k, width_gobs, l.block_height_log2,
                                                            l.block_depth_log2, block_rows), to_linear);
            for (; xb < row; xb += 16) {  /* a last part of a GOB: 16 bytes at a time, as before */
                uint8_t *b = surface + gob_offset(xs + xb, y0 + j, z + k, width_gobs, l.block_height_log2,
                                                  l.block_depth_log2, block_rows);
                size_t n = row - xb < 16 ? row - xb : 16;
                if (to_linear) memcpy(lin + xb, b, n);
                else memcpy(b, lin + xb, n);
            }
        }
}

/* The general copy: 16 bytes at a time where they are contiguous in both layouts, else a texel block at a
 * time. Also the reference YW4_TEGRA_CHECK compares copy_region with. */
static void copy_region_ref(const TexLayout *t, uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                            uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint8_t *linear, int to_linear) {
    LevelLayout l = tegra_level(t, level);
    uint8_t *surface = base + (uint64_t)layer * tegra_layer_size(t) + l.offset;
    uint32_t bpb = t->fmt->bpb, bw = t->fmt->bw, bh = t->fmt->bh;
    uint32_t x0 = x / bw, y0 = y / bh, wb = div_up(w, bw), hb = div_up(h, bh);
    uint32_t width_gobs = div_up(l.wb * bpb, 64);
    uint64_t block_rows = div_up(l.hb, 8u << l.block_height_log2);
    if ((x0 * bpb) % 16 == 0 && 16 % bpb == 0) {  /* 16-byte runs are contiguous in both layouts */
        uint32_t row = wb * bpb;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d; k++)
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < hb; j++)
                for (uint32_t xb = 0; xb < row; xb += 16) {
                    uint8_t *b = surface + gob_offset(x0 * bpb + xb, y0 + j, z + k, width_gobs, l.block_height_log2,
                                                      l.block_depth_log2, block_rows);
                    uint8_t *lin = linear + ((uint64_t)k * hb + j) * row + xb;
                    size_t n = row - xb < 16 ? row - xb : 16;
                    if (to_linear) memcpy(lin, b, n);
                    else memcpy(b, lin, n);
                }
        return;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d; k++)
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < hb; j++)
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < wb; i++) {
                uint8_t *b = surface + gob_offset((x0 + i) * bpb, y0 + j, z + k, width_gobs, l.block_height_log2,
                                                  l.block_depth_log2, block_rows);
                uint8_t *lin = linear + (((uint64_t)k * hb + j) * wb + i) * bpb;
                if (to_linear) memcpy(lin, b, bpb);
                else memcpy(b, lin, bpb);
            }
}

void tegra_write_region(const TexLayout *t, uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                        uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, const uint8_t *src) {
    copy_region(t, base, level, layer, x, y, z, w, h, d, (uint8_t *)src, 0);
}

void tegra_read_region(const TexLayout *t, const uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                       uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint8_t *dst) {
    copy_region(t, (uint8_t *)base, level, layer, x, y, z, w, h, d, dst, 1);
    /* YW4_TEGRA_CHECK=1: every read again the general way, compared */
    static int check = -1;
    if (check < 0) check = getenv("YW4_TEGRA_CHECK") && atoi(getenv("YW4_TEGRA_CHECK"));
    if (!check) return;
    static long reads, wrong;
    size_t n = (size_t)div_up(w, t->fmt->bw) * div_up(h, t->fmt->bh) * d * t->fmt->bpb;
    uint8_t *ref = malloc(n);
    if (!ref) return;
    copy_region_ref(t, (uint8_t *)base, level, layer, x, y, z, w, h, d, ref, 1);
    int bad = memcmp(ref, dst, n) != 0;
    free(ref);
    reads++, wrong += bad;
    if (bad || reads % 2000 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: tegra check: %ld reads, %ld differ%s\n", reads, wrong,
                bad ? " (this one: see the texture's layout)" : "");
}

void tegra_swizzle(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, uint32_t wb, uint32_t hb, uint32_t d, uint32_t bpb, uint32_t bh,
                   uint32_t bd) {
    uint32_t row = wb * bpb, width_gobs = div_up(row, 64);
    uint64_t block_rows = div_up(hb, 8u << bh);
    for (uint32_t z = 0; z < d; z++)
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < hb; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < row; x += 16)  /* 16-byte runs are contiguous in both layouts */
                memcpy(dst + gob_offset(x, y, z, width_gobs, bh, bd, block_rows),
                       src + ((uint64_t)z * hb + y) * row + x, row - x < 16 ? row - x : 16);
}
```

`runtime/src/tegra.h`:

```h
/* Tegra X1 texture layout: NVN format sizes and the block-linear (GOB) layout.
 *
 * Adapted from LAS Recomp (runtime/nvn/tegra.h, formats.c; MIT, see third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#ifndef TEGRA_H
#define TEGRA_H

#include <stdint.h>

enum { FMT_COLOR, FMT_DEPTH, FMT_STENCIL, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL, FMT_COMPRESSED };

typedef struct {
    uint8_t bpb;     /* bytes per block (per texel when uncompressed) */
    uint8_t bw, bh;  /* block size in texels */
    uint8_t kind;
} FormatInfo;

/* NULL for a format number we don't know. */
const FormatInfo *nvn_format_info(uint32_t nvn_format);

typedef struct {
    uint32_t width, height, depth, layers, levels;  /* depth: of a 3D texture; layers: array layers or cube faces */
    const FormatInfo *fmt;
    uint32_t block_height_log2;  /* GOBs per block, level 0 */
    uint32_t block_depth_log2;
} TexLayout;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t offset;   /* from the start of the layer */
    uint32_t w, h, d;  /* texels */
    uint32_t wb, hb;   /* blocks */
    uint32_t block_height_log2, block_depth_log2;
} LevelLayout;

/* The block height the NVN driver picks, and the whole storage layout from it. */
void tegra_layout_init(TexLayout *t);
LevelLayout tegra_level(const TexLayout *t, uint32_t level);
uint64_t tegra_total_size(const TexLayout *t);

/* Size of one array layer (or cube face) with all its levels, aligned to a block. */
uint64_t tegra_layer_size(const TexLayout *t);

/* Writes a region of tightly packed linear data (rows of whole blocks) into level `level`
 * of layer `layer` of block-linear storage at `base`. x, y, z, w, h, d are in texels (z, d:
 * slices of a 3D texture). */
void tegra_write_region(const TexLayout *t, uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                        uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, const uint8_t *src);

/* The reverse: a region of block-linear storage into tightly packed linear rows. */
void tegra_read_region(const TexLayout *t, const uint8_t *base, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y,
                       uint32_t z, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint8_t *dst);

/* Linear rows (pitch wb * bpb) into a block-linear level. */
void tegra_swizzle(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, uint32_t wb, uint32_t hb, uint32_t d, uint32_t bpb,
                   uint32_t block_height_log2, uint32_t block_depth_log2);

#endif

```

`runtime/src/textin.c`:

```c
/* Typing text in the overlay (textin.h). The typing comes from the window's thread (keys) or a replay (the game's
 * input thread); the present draws the text: one lock keeps a field whole while either reads or changes it. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "textin.h"

static HostLock lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static TextField *active;
static uint32_t changes;

static void changed(void) { __atomic_add_fetch(&changes, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
uint32_t textin_changes(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&changes, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void textin_focus(TextField *f) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    if (active != f) {
        active = f;
        if (f) f->cursor = f->sel_anchor = f->len;  /* typing goes on at the end */
        changed();
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

int textin_active(void) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    int a = active != NULL;
    host_unlock(&lock);
    return a;
}

int textin_has(const TextField *f) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    int a = f && active == f;
    host_unlock(&lock);
    return a;
}

/* UTF-8: a byte that continues a character (10xxxxxx) */
static int cont(unsigned char b) { return (b & 0xC0) == 0x80; }

static int delete_selection(TextField *f) {
    if (f->sel_anchor < 0 || f->sel_anchor == f->cursor) return 0;
    int s = f->sel_anchor < f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
    int e = f->sel_anchor > f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
    if (s < 0) s = 0;
    if (e > f->len) e = f->len;
    if (e > s) {
        memmove(f->text + s, f->text + e, (size_t)(f->len - e + 1));
        f->len -= (e - s);
        f->cursor = f->sel_anchor = s;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void textin_type(const char *s) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    if (!f) {
        host_unlock(&lock);
        return;
    }
    delete_selection(f);
    char add[TEXTIN_MAX];
    int n = 0;
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)s; *p && n < (int)sizeof add - 1; p++) {
        unsigned char ch = *p;
        if (ch == '\r') continue;
        if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\t') ch = ' ';
        else if (ch < 32 || ch == 127) continue;
        add[n++] = (char)ch;
    }
    int room = TEXTIN_MAX - 1 - f->len;
    if (n > room) {  /* cut at a whole character */
        n = room;
        while (n > 0 && cont((unsigned char)add[n])) n--;
    }
    if (f->max_chars > 0) {  /* a field with a letter limit (a name: 8): what goes past it is left out */
        int have = 0, k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < f->len; i++) have += !cont((unsigned char)f->text[i]);
        for (int left = f->max_chars - have; k < n; k++)
            if (!cont((unsigned char)add[k]) && left-- <= 0) break;
        n = k;
    }
    if (n > 0) {
        memmove(f->text + f->cursor + n, f->text + f->cursor, (size_t)(f->len - f->cursor + 1));
        memcpy(f->text + f->cursor, add, (size_t)n);
        f->len += n, f->cursor += n;
        f->sel_anchor = f->cursor;
        changed();
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

void textin_edit(int op) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    if (!f) {
        host_unlock(&lock);
        return;
    }
    int c = f->cursor;
    int has_sel = f->sel_anchor >= 0 && f->sel_anchor != f->cursor;
    int s = f->sel_anchor < f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
    int e = f->sel_anchor > f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
    switch (op) {
    case TI_LEFT:
        if (has_sel) c = s;
        else if (c > 0) do c--; while (c > 0 && cont((unsigned char)f->text[c]));
        f->sel_anchor = c;
        break;
    case TI_RIGHT:
        if (has_sel) c = e;
        else if (c < f->len) do c++; while (c < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[c]));
        f->sel_anchor = c;
        break;
    case TI_HOME: c = f->sel_anchor = 0; break;
    case TI_END: c = f->sel_anchor = f->len; break;
    case TI_SLEFT:
        if (c > 0) do c--; while (c > 0 && cont((unsigned char)f->text[c]));
        break;
    case TI_SRIGHT:
        if (c < f->len) do c++; while (c < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[c]));
        break;
    case TI_SHOME: c = 0; break;
    case TI_SEND: c = f->len; break;
    case TI_ALL: f->sel_anchor = 0; c = f->len; break;
    case TI_BACK:
        if (has_sel) {
            delete_selection(f);
            c = f->cursor;
        } else if (c > 0) {
            int st = c;
            do st--; while (st > 0 && cont((unsigned char)f->text[st]));
            memmove(f->text + st, f->text + c, (size_t)(f->len - c + 1));
            f->len -= c - st, c = st;
            f->sel_anchor = c;
        }
        break;
    case TI_DEL:
        if (has_sel) {
            delete_selection(f);
            c = f->cursor;
        } else if (c < f->len) {
            int ed = c;
            do ed++; while (ed < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[ed]));
            memmove(f->text + c, f->text + ed, (size_t)(f->len - ed + 1));
            f->len -= ed - c;
            f->sel_anchor = c;
        }
        break;
    case TI_COPY:
        if (has_sel) {
            char buf[TEXTIN_MAX];
            int n = e - s < (int)sizeof buf - 1 ? e - s : (int)sizeof buf - 1;
            memcpy(buf, f->text + s, (size_t)n);
            buf[n] = 0;
            SDL_SetClipboardText(buf);
        }
        break;
    case TI_CUT:
        if (has_sel) {
            char buf[TEXTIN_MAX];
            int n = e - s < (int)sizeof buf - 1 ? e - s : (int)sizeof buf - 1;
            memcpy(buf, f->text + s, (size_t)n);
            buf[n] = 0;
            SDL_SetClipboardText(buf);
            delete_selection(f);
            c = f->cursor;
        }
        break;
    case TI_CLEAR: f->len = 0, f->text[0] = 0, c = f->sel_anchor = 0; break;
    case TI_DONE: active = NULL; break;
    }
    f->cursor = c;
    changed();
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

void textin_set_caret(int pos) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    if (f) {
        if (pos < 0) pos = 0;
        if (pos > f->len) pos = f->len;
        while (pos > 0 && pos < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[pos])) pos++;
        f->cursor = f->sel_anchor = pos;
        changed();
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

void textin_drag(int pos) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    if (f) {
        if (pos < 0) pos = 0;
        if (pos > f->len) pos = f->len;
        while (pos > 0 && pos < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[pos])) pos++;
        if (f->cursor != pos) {
            f->cursor = pos;
            changed();
        }
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

static int is_word_space(const char *text, int i) {
    unsigned char b = (unsigned char)text[i];
    if (b <= ' ' || b == 127) return 1;
    if (b == 0xE3 && (unsigned char)text[i + 1] == 0x80 && (unsigned char)text[i + 2] == 0x80) return 1;
    return 0;
}

void textin_select_word(int pos) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    if (f && f->len > 0) {
        if (pos < 0) pos = 0;
        if (pos >= f->len) pos = f->len - 1;
        while (pos > 0 && cont((unsigned char)f->text[pos])) pos--;
        int space = is_word_space(f->text, pos);
        int w_start = pos;
        while (w_start > 0) {
            int prev = w_start - 1;
            while (prev > 0 && cont((unsigned char)f->text[prev])) prev--;
            if (is_word_space(f->text, prev) != space) break;
            w_start = prev;
        }
        int w_end = pos;
        while (w_end < f->len) {
            int next = w_end + 1;
            while (next < f->len && cont((unsigned char)f->text[next])) next++;
            if (is_word_space(f->text, w_end) != space) break;
            w_end = next;
        }
        f->sel_anchor = w_start;
        f->cursor = w_end;
        changed();
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

int textin_get_selection(char *out, size_t n) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    TextField *f = active;
    int len = 0;
    if (f && f->sel_anchor >= 0 && f->sel_anchor != f->cursor && out && n > 0) {
        int s = f->sel_anchor < f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
        int e = f->sel_anchor > f->cursor ? f->sel_anchor : f->cursor;
        len = e - s < (int)n - 1 ? e - s : (int)n - 1;
        memcpy(out, f->text + s, (size_t)len);
        out[len] = 0;
    } else if (out && n > 0) {
        out[0] = 0;
    }
    host_unlock(&lock);
    return len;
}

void textin_read(const TextField *f, char *out, size_t n, int *cursor, int *sel_anchor) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", f->text);
    if (cursor) *cursor = f->cursor < (int)n ? f->cursor : (int)n - 1;
    if (sel_anchor) *sel_anchor = f->sel_anchor < (int)n ? f->sel_anchor : (int)n - 1;
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

void textin_clear(TextField *f) {
    host_lock(&lock);
    f->len = 0, f->cursor = 0, f->sel_anchor = 0, f->text[0] = 0;
    if (active == f) active = NULL;
    changed();
    host_unlock(&lock);
}

```

`runtime/src/textin.h`:

```h
/* Typing text in the overlay (2026-11-07): the bug report's "What happened?" box first; the game's own name entry
 * (swkbd.c, which still answers a fixed name) can use the same later. One text field at a time has the typing
 * focus. The window (window.c) starts the system's text input while a field has it (SDL_StartTextInput, so a
 * keyboard layout and an IME work), hands it what is typed (textin_type) and the editing keys (textin_edit), and
 * sends every other key nowhere: W A S D type letters instead of moving. Enter, Escape or Tab, or B on a pad, end
 * the typing (TI_DONE). Text is UTF-8, kept as one paragraph (a line break typed or pasted becomes a space).
 * Replays: "t <tick> <text>" types text, the keys T_LEFT... edit (svc_hid.c). */
#ifndef YW4_TEXTIN_H
#define YW4_TEXTIN_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

enum { TEXTIN_MAX = 1024 };  /* bytes, with the ending zero */

typedef struct {
    char text[TEXTIN_MAX];
    int len;        /* bytes */
    int cursor;     /* a byte offset at the start of a character */
    int sel_anchor; /* selection anchor; selection is [min(sel_anchor, cursor), max(sel_anchor, cursor)) */
    int max_chars;  /* at most this many characters (0: no limit beyond TEXTIN_MAX) */
} TextField;

enum {
    TI_LEFT,
    TI_RIGHT,
    TI_HOME,
    TI_END,
    TI_BACK,
    TI_DEL,
    TI_DONE,
    TI_CLEAR,
    TI_SLEFT,
    TI_SRIGHT,
    TI_SHOME,
    TI_SEND,
    TI_ALL,
    TI_CUT,
    TI_COPY
};

/* Gives f the typing focus (NULL: none); textin_active: a field has it. */
void textin_focus(TextField *f);
int textin_active(void);
int textin_has(const TextField *f);
/* Text typed or pasted, at the cursor (control characters dropped, line breaks as spaces; what doesn't fit is
 * cut at a whole character). Replaces any selection. */
void textin_type(const char *utf8);
void textin_edit(int op);
/* Moves caret to pos and collapses selection. */
void textin_set_caret(int pos);
/* Moves cursor to pos, extending selection from sel_anchor. */
void textin_drag(int pos);
/* Selects the word around pos. */
void textin_select_word(int pos);
/* Copies the selected substring into out (up to n bytes, null-terminated); returns length (0 if no selection). */
int textin_get_selection(char *out, size_t n);
/* f's text, cursor, and selection anchor as they are now, for drawing (the typing runs on the window's thread). */
void textin_read(const TextField *f, char *out, size_t n, int *cursor, int *sel_anchor);
/* f emptied (a new report). */
void textin_clear(TextField *f);
/* Changes each time a field's text, cursor or focus changes (the overlay draws again then). */
uint32_t textin_changes(void);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/theme.c`:

```c
/* Themes (theme.h): the built-in look, and the launcher's theme files read into the same roles. */
#include <math.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "theme.h"

/* the built-in look: the overlay's design colours (gamemenu.c's before themes) and the HUD's (hud_style.c) */
static const Theme recomp = {
    .ink = 0x2b2338, .night = 0x2a1b4c, .plum = 0x3e2a6e, .paper = 0xf8f4fc, .gold = 0xe3be5c, .ring = 0xe3be5c, .line = 0xe2d5ef,
    .white = 0xffffff, .snow = 0xfdfcfe, .lilac = 0xd9cdea, .on_dark = 0xd9cdea, .muted = 0x605673, .wine = 0x8c1f3f,
    .shade = 0x160e26, .soft = 0xefe7f7, .edge = 0xc6b2da, .tag = 0xe8dff4, .vsoft = 0x5b4691, .on_gold = 0x2a1b4c,
    .pop_deep = 0x2b1a4d, .pop_gold = 0xe1b75c, .pop_white = 0xfdfcff, .pop_ink = 0x231e33, .pop_lilac = 0xf8f5fd,
    .pop_line = 0xe1d5f1, .pop_border = 0x312451, .pop_shadow = 0x0f0028, .pop_backdrop = 0x1a0a35,
    .hud_text = 0xfdfcfe, .hud_label = 0xd9cdea, .hud_card = 0x2a1b4c, .hud_plot = 0x3e2a6e, .hud_target = 0xc6b2da,
};

/* Which CSS token each role takes (launcher/ui/style.css's names). A theme without the token keeps the built-in
 * colour for that role. */
#define ROLE(field, token) {offsetof(Theme, field), token}
static const struct {
    size_t at;
    const char *token;
} roles[] = {
    ROLE(ink, "--ink"), ROLE(night, "--violet-deep"), ROLE(plum, "--violet"), ROLE(paper, "--lilac-0"),
    ROLE(gold, "--gold"), ROLE(ring, "--select"), ROLE(line, "--lilac-2"), ROLE(white, "--white"), ROLE(snow, "--white"),
    ROLE(lilac, "--lilac-2"), ROLE(on_dark, "--bar-ink"), ROLE(muted, "--ink-2"), ROLE(wine, "--danger"),
    ROLE(soft, "--lilac-1"), ROLE(edge, "--lilac-3"), ROLE(tag, "--lilac-1"), ROLE(vsoft, "--violet-soft"),
    ROLE(on_gold, "--ink"), ROLE(pop_deep, "--violet-deep"), ROLE(pop_gold, "--gold"),
    ROLE(pop_white, "--white"), ROLE(pop_ink, "--ink"), ROLE(pop_lilac, "--lilac-0"), ROLE(pop_line, "--lilac-2"),
    ROLE(pop_border, "--violet"), ROLE(hud_text, "--white"), ROLE(hud_label, "--bar-ink"),
    ROLE(hud_card, "--violet-deep"), ROLE(hud_plot, "--violet"), ROLE(hud_target, "--lilac-3"),
};

/* ---- CSS colours: #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r g b / a) or rgb(r, g, b), oklch(L% C H / a); the alpha is dropped */

static uint8_t to8(double v) { return (uint8_t)(v <= 0 ? 0 : v >= 1 ? 255 : v * 255.0 + 0.5); }
static double encode(double c) { return c <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * c : 1.055 * pow(c, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055; }

/* OKLCH -> sRGB (Björn Ottosson's OKLab matrices) */
static uint32_t oklch(double L, double C, double H) {
    double a = C * cos(H * 3.14159265358979 / 180), b = C * sin(H * 3.14159265358979 / 180);
    double l = L + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b, m = L - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b,
           s = L - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.2914855480 * b;
    l = l * l * l, m = m * m * m, s = s * s * s;
    double r = 4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s;
    double g = -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s;
    double bl = -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.7076147010 * s;
    return (uint32_t)to8(encode(r)) << 16 | (uint32_t)to8(encode(g)) << 8 | to8(encode(bl));
}

/* the numbers in "( ... )": up to 3 before any '/', a percent sign marks one (as 0..1) */
static int numbers(const char *p, double v[3], int pct[3]) {
    int n = 0;
    while (*p && *p != ')' && *p != '/' && n < 3) {
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == ',' || *p == '\t') p++;
        char *e;
        double d = strtod(p, &e);
        if (e == p) break;
        p = e;
        pct[n] = *p == '%';
        if (pct[n]) p++;
        v[n++] = d;
    }
    return n;
}

static int parse_colour(const char *p, uint32_t *out) {
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (*p == '#') {
        unsigned x;
        int len = 0;
        while ((p[1 + len] >= '0' && p[1 + len] <= '9') || ((p[1 + len] | 32) >= 'a' && (p[1 + len] | 32) <= 'f')) len++;
        if (len != 3 && len != 6 && len != 8) return 0;
        char hex[7];
        if (len == 3) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) hex[2 * k] = hex[2 * k + 1] = p[1 + k];
        } else {
            memcpy(hex, p + 1, 6);
        }
        hex[6] = 0;
        if (sscanf(hex, "%x", &x) != 1) return 0;
        *out = x;
        return 1;
    }
    double v[3];
    int pct[3];
    if (!strncmp(p, "rgb(", 4) || !strncmp(p, "rgba(", 5)) {
        if (numbers(strchr(p, '(') + 1, v, pct) != 3) return 0;
        uint32_t c = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) c = c << 8 | to8(pct[k] ? v[k] / 100 : v[k] / 255);
        *out = c;
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strncmp(p, "oklch(", 6)) {
        if (numbers(p + 6, v, pct) != 3) return 0;
        *out = oklch(pct[0] ? v[0] / 100 : v[0], pct[1] ? v[1] * 0.004 : v[1], v[2]);  /* C: 100% = 0.4 */
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;  /* var(...) and the rest: the role keeps its built-in colour */
}

/* ---- the folder */

enum { MAX_THEMES = 32 };
static struct {
    char id[64], name[64];
    Theme colours;
} themes[MAX_THEMES];
static int nthemes = -1, chosen;
static Theme current;  /* what the overlay and the HUD read (a copy: changed on the window's thread, read on the present's) */

/* a theme file into t, over the built-in colours; its name from the "name:" comment */
static int load_file(const char *path, Theme *t, char *name, size_t nn) {
    size_t size = 0;
    char *text = SDL_LoadFile(path, &size);
    if (!text) return 0;
    *t = recomp;
    const char *nm = strstr(text, "name:");
    if (nm) {
        nm += 5;
        while (*nm == ' ') nm++;
        size_t k = 0;
        while (nm[k] && nm[k] != '*' && nm[k] != '\n' && k + 1 < nn) k++;
        while (k && nm[k - 1] == ' ') k--;
        memcpy(name, nm, k), name[k] = 0;
    }
    for (size_t r = 0; r < sizeof roles / sizeof *roles; r++) {
        size_t tl = strlen(roles[r].token);
        for (const char *p = text; (p = strstr(p, roles[r].token)); p += tl) {
            const char *q = p + tl;
            if (*q != ':' && *q != ' ') continue;  /* "--lilac-1" is not "--lilac-10" */
            while (*q == ' ') q++;
            if (*q != ':') continue;
            uint32_t c;
            if (parse_colour(q + 1, &c)) *(uint32_t *)((char *)t + roles[r].at) = c;
            break;
        }
    }
    /* the tint and the popup's shadow: the dark, darker */
    uint32_t n = t->night;
    t->shade = t->pop_shadow = t->pop_backdrop = ((n >> 16 & 255) * 2 / 5) << 16 | ((n >> 8 & 255) * 2 / 5) << 8 | (n & 255) * 2 / 5;
    SDL_free(text);
    return 1;
}

static const char *themes_dir(void) {
    static char dir[1024];
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_THEMES_DIR");
    if (e && *e) {
        snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", e);
        return dir;
    }
    const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath();
    static const char *const tries[] = {"themes", "../../launcher/ui/themes"};  /* next to yw4.exe; the repo's */
    for (size_t i = 0; base && i < sizeof tries / sizeof *tries; i++) {
        snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s%s", base, tries[i]);
        SDL_PathInfo info;
        if (SDL_GetPathInfo(dir, &info) && info.type == SDL_PATHTYPE_DIRECTORY) return dir;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int by_id(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((const char *)a, (const char *)b); }

static void load_all(void) {
    if (nthemes >= 0) return;
    nthemes = 1;
    snprintf(themes[0].id, sizeof themes[0].id, "recomp");
    snprintf(themes[0].name, sizeof themes[0].name, "YW4 Recomp");
    themes[0].colours = recomp;
    const char *dir = themes_dir();
    int count = 0;
    char **files = dir ? SDL_GlobDirectory(dir, "*.css", 0, &count) : NULL;
    for (int i = 0; files && i < count && nthemes < MAX_THEMES; i++) {
        char path[1200];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, files[i]);
        const char *slash = strrchr(files[i], '/');
        const char *file = slash ? slash + 1 : files[i];
        size_t len = strlen(file) - 4;  /* without ".css" */
        if (len == 0 || len >= sizeof themes[0].id) continue;
        memcpy(themes[nthemes].id, file, len), themes[nthemes].id[len] = 0;
        if (!strcmp(themes[nthemes].id, "recomp")) continue;  /* the built-in one has no file */
        snprintf(themes[nthemes].name, sizeof themes[nthemes].name, "%s", themes[nthemes].id);
        if (load_file(path, &themes[nthemes].colours, themes[nthemes].name, sizeof themes[nthemes].name)) nthemes++;
    }
    SDL_free(files);
    qsort(themes + 1, (size_t)(nthemes - 1), sizeof themes[0], by_id);  /* id first in the struct: sorts by id */
    const char *want = getenv("YW4_THEME");
    chosen = 0;
    for (int i = 0; want && i < nthemes; i++)
        if (!strcmp(themes[i].id, want)) chosen = i;
    current = themes[chosen].colours;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: themes: %d (%s), %s\n", nthemes, dir ? dir : "no themes folder", themes[chosen].id);
}

const Theme *theme_colors(void) {
    load_all();
    return &current;
}
int theme_count(void) { return load_all(), nthemes; }
int theme_index(void) { return load_all(), chosen; }
const char *theme_name(int i) { return load_all(), i >= 0 && i < nthemes ? themes[i].name : ""; }
const char *theme_id(void) { return load_all(), themes[chosen].id; }

void theme_step(int dir) {
    load_all();
    chosen = (chosen + (dir < 0 ? nthemes - 1 : 1)) % nthemes;
    current = themes[chosen].colours;
}
```

`runtime/src/theme.h`:

```h
/* Themes for the in-game overlay and the performance HUD (2026-11-06): the launcher's themes, the same files
 * (launcher/ui/themes/<id>.css: a "name: X" comment, then a :root block of CSS colour tokens, launcher/ui/style.css's
 * names), read when the game starts, so a theme dropped in that folder shows up in both. The built-in look
 * ("recomp", the overlay's design colours) needs no file and is what any token a theme leaves out falls back to.
 * The folder: YW4_THEMES_DIR, else "themes" next to yw4.exe, else the repo's launcher/ui/themes (a build in
 * work/build). The choice: YW4_THEME=<id> (settings.ini, the overlay's Settings > Look > Theme row). Why: decision
 * 0055. */
#ifndef YW4_THEME_H
#define YW4_THEME_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* The colours by what they do, 0xRRGGBB. */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t ink;      /* body text */
    uint32_t night;    /* the darkest: the side panel's header, the hint bar, titles, description boxes */
    uint32_t plum;     /* headings, outlines of the chosen, filled chips */
    uint32_t paper;    /* the page and side panel background */
    uint32_t gold;     /* gold fills: the chosen side button, tags, the gold rules */
    uint32_t ring;     /* the focus: the rings and outlines of what is chosen */
    uint32_t line;     /* borders */
    uint32_t white;    /* boxes on the paper */
    uint32_t snow;     /* text and key chips on the dark */
    uint32_t lilac;    /* hover fills */
    uint32_t on_dark;  /* soft text on the dark (descriptions, the version line) */
    uint32_t muted;    /* secondary text, greyed rows */
    uint32_t wine;     /* Exit game, Quit, conflicts */
    uint32_t shade;    /* the tint over the game */
    uint32_t soft;     /* soft fills: arrow boxes, the table's header, strips */
    uint32_t edge;     /* a darker edge: hover borders, check boxes */
    uint32_t tag;      /* the Switch default tag */
    uint32_t vsoft;    /* a lighter dark: hover on dark pills */
    uint32_t on_gold;  /* text on gold */
    uint32_t pop_deep, pop_gold, pop_white, pop_ink, pop_lilac, pop_line, pop_border, pop_shadow, pop_backdrop;
    uint32_t hud_text, hud_label, hud_card, hud_plot, hud_target;  /* the HUD's see-through card */
} Theme;

const Theme *theme_colors(void);  /* the chosen theme's */
int theme_count(void);            /* the built-in one, then the folder's, by id */
int theme_index(void);            /* the chosen one */
const char *theme_name(int i);    /* "YW4 Recomp", "Jibanyan" */
void theme_step(int dir);         /* the next (1) or the one before (-1), wrapping (settings.c saves it) */
const char *theme_id(void);       /* the chosen one's id, for settings.ini ("recomp") */

#endif
```

`runtime/src/trace_drawlist.c`:

```c
/* YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST=<frame>: how the engine's draw list reaches the draws (docs/frame.md).
 *
 * From presented frame <frame> on, each entry of the submesh draw main+0xa75e90
 * (device, geometry, primitive) called by the model renderer main+0xa45890 notes the object
 * being drawn. The next draw recorded on that thread is
 * printed with what was bound for it (program, vertex buffer 0, index buffer, uniform
 * buffers), and each bound address and the first 16 bytes of each bound uniform buffer are
 * searched for in the object, the geometry and the primitive records, following pointers
 * two levels: the paths found are where the engine keeps that draw's data.
 * YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_MAX (default 24) limits the draws printed.
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "nvn.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

extern void (*yw4_entry_hook)(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t addr);  /* dispatch.c */
extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;

static int from = -2, printed, max_printed = 24;
static uint64_t main_base;
static _Thread_local struct { uint64_t node, obj, geom, prim, dev; int armed; } cur;

static long calls, arms;  /* entries of the submesh draw in the traced frames: all, from the model renderer */

/* From frame <from> until enough draws are printed (the searches are slow: the frame moves on) */
static int in_frame(void) {
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    return from >= 0 && f >= (uint64_t)from && __atomic_load_n(&printed, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) < max_printed;
}

static int guest_ptr(uint64_t p) { return p >= 0x7000000000ull && p < 0x7800000000ull && !(p & 7); }

/* host_readable is a system call: remember the answer per 64 KiB block (blocks the game
 * maps or unmaps meanwhile may be answered wrongly; good enough for a trace) */
static int readable(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    enum { SLOTS = 1 << 14 };
    static uint64_t key[SLOTS];
    static uint8_t val[SLOTS];
    for (uint64_t b = addr >> 16; b <= (addr + size - 1) >> 16; b++) {
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(b * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 50);
        while (key[h] && key[h] != b) h = (h + 1) & (SLOTS - 1);
        if (!key[h]) val[h] = (uint8_t)(host_readable(b << 16, 1 << 16) ? 1 : 2), key[h] = b;
        if (val[h] != 1) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static void entry(CPUState *ctx, uint64_t addr) {
    if (addr != main_base + 0xa75e90 || !in_frame()) return;
    __atomic_add_fetch(&calls, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    uint64_t ret = ctx->x[30] - main_base;
    if (ret != 0xa4bf94 && ret != 0xa4c2d0) return;  /* only the model renderer's two call sites */
    __atomic_add_fetch(&arms, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    /* the model renderer draws in a second phase, from sorted 0x48-byte draw items; there the
     * object being drawn is in its stack slot sp+0x390 (sp is still the caller's at entry) */
    cur.node = 0;
    cur.obj = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(ctx->sp + 0x390);
    cur.geom = ctx->x[1], cur.prim = ctx->x[2], cur.dev = ctx->x[0], cur.armed = 1;
}

int trace_drawlist_on(void) {
    if (from == -2) {
        const char *s = getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST");
        from = s && *s ? atoi(s) : -1;
        if (getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_MAX")) max_printed = atoi(getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_MAX"));
        if (from >= 0) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < yw4_ncode; i++)
                if (!strcmp(yw4_code[i].name, "main")) main_base = *yw4_code[i].base;
            yw4_entry_hook = entry;
        }
    }
    return from >= 0;
}


typedef struct {
    const char *what;
    uint64_t value;      /* an address to find (0: none) */
    uint8_t bytes[16];   /* or 16 bytes of content to find */
    int has_bytes, inside;  /* inside: also report pointers up to 16 MiB below the address */
    int hits;
    uint32_t v32;        /* or a 32-bit value to find (0: none) */
} Want;

enum { SPAN = 0x400, MAX_HITS = 6 };  /* bytes searched in each structure (default); reports per wanted value */

typedef struct { char *buf; size_t len, cap; } Out;

static void out(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void out(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(o->buf + o->len, o->cap - o->len, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (n > 0) o->len = o->len + (size_t)n < o->cap ? o->len + (size_t)n : o->cap - 1;
}

/* 16 bytes worth searching for: not all zero, not one 32-bit value repeated */
static int distinctive(const uint8_t b[16]) {
    uint32_t w[4];
    memcpy(w, b, 16);
    return !(w[0] == w[1] && w[1] == w[2] && w[2] == w[3]);
}

static void search(Out *o, const char *root, uint64_t at, int depth, int span, char *path, size_t plen, Want *w, int nw) {
    if (!guest_ptr(at) || !readable(at, span)) return;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)at;
    for (int off = 0; off < span; off += 4) {
        for (int i = 0; i < nw; i++) {
            if (w[i].hits >= MAX_HITS) continue;
            if (w[i].v32 && *(const uint32_t *)(p + off) == w[i].v32) {
                w[i].hits++, out(o, "yw4: drawlist:     %s = %s%s+%#x\n", w[i].what, root, path, off);
                continue;
            }
            if (off + 8 > span) continue;
            uint64_t v = *(const uint64_t *)(p + off);
            if (w[i].value && !(off & 7) && v == w[i].value)
                w[i].hits++, out(o, "yw4: drawlist:     %s = %s%s+%#x\n", w[i].what, root, path, off);
            else if (w[i].inside && !(off & 7) && guest_ptr(v) && v < w[i].value && w[i].value - v < (w[i].inside == 2 ? 0x10000u : 16u << 20))
                w[i].hits++, out(o, "yw4: drawlist:     %s = %s%s+%#x + %#" PRIx64 "\n", w[i].what, root, path, off,
                                 w[i].value - v);
            if (w[i].has_bytes && off + 16 <= span && !memcmp(p + off, w[i].bytes, 16))
                w[i].hits++, out(o, "yw4: drawlist:     %s contents = %s%s+%#x\n", w[i].what, root, path, off);
        }
    }
    if (!depth) return;
    for (int off = 0; off < span; off += 8) {
        uint64_t q = *(const uint64_t *)(p + off);
        if (!guest_ptr(q) || q == at) continue;
        int n = snprintf(path + plen, 96 - plen, "+%#x*", off);
        if (n > 0 && plen + (size_t)n < 96) search(o, root, q, depth - 1, span, path, plen + (size_t)n, w, nw);
        path[plen] = 0;
    }
}

void trace_drawlist_draw(const NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t index_addr) {
    if (!cur.armed) return;
    cur.armed = 0;
    /* YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_COLOURS=<n>: only draws into n colour targets (3: the G-buffer) */
    static int colours = -2;
    if (colours == -2) colours = getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_COLOURS") ? atoi(getenv("YW4_TRACE_DRAWLIST_COLOURS")) : -1;
    if (colours >= 0 && cb->target_colors != (uint32_t)colours) return;
    if (!in_frame() || __atomic_fetch_add(&printed, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) >= max_printed) return;
    static _Thread_local char storage[1 << 16];  /* one draw's report, written out in one go */
    Out o = {storage, 0, sizeof storage};
    const NvnProgram *pr = cb->program;
    out(&o, "yw4: drawlist: (submesh draws so far %ld, from the model renderer %ld)\n", calls, arms);
    out(&o, "yw4: drawlist: draw vs %016llx fs %016llx target %ux%u: node %#" PRIx64 " object %#" PRIx64
        " geometry %#" PRIx64 " primitive %#" PRIx64 "\n",
        pr ? (unsigned long long)pr->stages[0].key : 0ull, pr ? (unsigned long long)pr->stages[1].key : 0ull,
        cb->target_w, cb->target_h, cur.node, cur.obj, cur.geom, cur.prim);
    Want w[3 + 2 * 16 + 2 + TRACE_TEXTURES + 20];
    char names[2 * 16 + 3][24], tnames[TRACE_TEXTURES][24], snames[20][24];
    int nw = 0;
    /* the engine's texture slots (f_974cd0 binds from [device+0x10d0]+0x780 + slot*16: the texture
     * object, whose +8 is the NVN texture id): print them, and look for where the objects come from */
    uint64_t state = guest_ptr(cur.dev) && readable(cur.dev + 0x10d0, 8) ? *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.dev + 0x10d0) : 0;
    if (guest_ptr(state) && readable(state + 0x780, 20 * 16)) {
        out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   engine texture slots at %#" PRIx64 " (object, id):", state + 0x780);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            uint64_t t = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(state + 0x780 + 16ull * i);
            if (!guest_ptr(t) || !readable(t + 8, 4)) continue;
            out(&o, " %d:%#" PRIx64 "/%#x", i, t, *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(t + 8));
            snprintf(snames[i], sizeof snames[0], "texture slot %d object", i);
            w[nw++] = (Want){snames[i], t, {0}, 0, 2, 0, 0};  /* also array bases up to 64 KiB below it */
        }
        out(&o, "\n");
    }
    /* the object's texture table (f_a45890's material binding): 16-byte entries {texture
     * resource, index}; a resource keeps 0x50-byte records at [+0x30], counted from the
     * header's (+0x18) byte +0x20 */
    /* ... of the model record (object+0x140, 0x240 bytes per geometry) of the geometry drawn */
    uint64_t mdl = 0;
    if (guest_ptr(cur.obj) && readable(cur.obj + 0x120, 0x40)) {
        uint64_t geos = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.obj + 0x128), models = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.obj + 0x140);
        unsigned ngeo = *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.obj + 0x1c8);
        for (unsigned g = 0; g < ngeo && g < 16 && guest_ptr(geos) && readable(geos + 8ull * g, 8); g++)
            if (*(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(geos + 8ull * g) == cur.geom) mdl = models + 0x240ull * g;
    }
    out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   model record %#" PRIx64 "\n", mdl);
    if (guest_ptr(state) && readable(state + 0x790, 8)) {  /* texture slot 1's object, as 64-bit words */
        uint64_t t1 = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(state + 0x790);
        if (guest_ptr(t1) && readable(t1, 0x50)) {
            out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   slot 1 object words:");
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) out(&o, " %" PRIx64, *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(t1 + 8ull * i));
            out(&o, "\n");
        }
    }
    /* object+0x3f0 -> +0x60: a table of 0x18-byte entries pointing at texture objects: which
     * entries the bound slots are */
    if (guest_ptr(cur.obj) && readable(cur.obj + 0x3f0, 8) && guest_ptr(state) && readable(state + 0x780, 20 * 16)) {
        uint64_t a = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.obj + 0x3f0);
        uint64_t t = guest_ptr(a) && readable(a + 0x60, 8) ? *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(a + 0x60) : 0;
        out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   object+0x3f0 = %#" PRIx64 ", its +0x60 table %#" PRIx64 ":", a, t);
        for (int sl = 0; sl < 20 && guest_ptr(t); sl++) {
            uint64_t want = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(state + 0x780 + 16ull * sl);
            if (!guest_ptr(want)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 512 && readable(t + 0x18ull * k, 0x18); k++)
                if (*(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(t + 0x18ull * k) == want) {
                    out(&o, " slot %d = entry %d", sl, k);
                    break;
                }
        }
        out(&o, "\n");
    }
    for (int which = 0; which < 2; which++) {
        uint64_t tt = guest_ptr(mdl) && readable(mdl + 0xf0, 16) ? *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(mdl + (which ? 0xf0 : 0xf8)) : 0;
        if (!guest_ptr(tt) || !readable(tt, 8 * 16)) continue;
        out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   model+%#x texture table:", which ? 0xf0 : 0xf8);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            uint64_t res = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(tt + 16ull * i);
            uint16_t idx = *(const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(tt + 16ull * i + 8);
            if (!guest_ptr(res) || !readable(res + 0x18, 0x20)) continue;
            uint64_t hdr = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(res + 0x18), arr = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(res + 0x30);
            unsigned base = guest_ptr(hdr) && readable(hdr + 0x20, 4) ? *(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(hdr + 0x20) : 0;
            uint64_t recd = guest_ptr(arr) && idx >= base ? arr + 0x50ull * (idx - base) : 0;
            uint64_t p20 = guest_ptr(recd) && readable(recd + 0x20, 8) ? *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(recd + 0x20) : 0;
            out(&o, " [%d] res %#" PRIx64 " idx %u base %u -> record %#" PRIx64 " (+0x20 %#" PRIx64 ")", i, res, idx,
                base, recd, p20);
        }
        out(&o, "\n");
    }
    /* the fragment textures' handles (id | sampler << 20): the engine's texture object keeps its
     * handle at +0xf8, so a hit at "...+0xf8" is the path to the texture object */
    for (int i = 0; i < TRACE_TEXTURES; i++)
        if (cb->trace_tex[1][i] && (uint32_t)cb->trace_tex[1][i]) {
            snprintf(tnames[i], sizeof tnames[0], "fs texture %d", i);
            w[nw++] = (Want){tnames[i], 0, {0}, 0, 0, 0, (uint32_t)cb->trace_tex[1][i]};
        }
    w[nw++] = (Want){"vertex buffer 0", cb->trace_vb0, {0}, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    w[nw++] = (Want){"program", cb->program_guest, {0}, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    if (index_addr) w[nw++] = (Want){"index buffer", index_addr, {0}, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   vertex buffer 0 at %#" PRIx64 ", index buffer at %#" PRIx64 "\n", cb->trace_vb0,
        index_addr);
    out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   attributes (format/stream/offset):");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cb->trace_nattribs; i++) {
        uint32_t a = cb->trace_attribs[i];
        if (a & 0xFF) out(&o, " %u:%#x/%u/%u", i, a & 0xFF, a >> 8 & 0x1F, a >> 13);
    }
    out(&o, "\n");
    for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)  /* texture handles: id | sampler << 20 */
        for (int i = 0; i < TRACE_TEXTURES; i++)
            if (cb->trace_tex[s][i])
                out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   %s texture %d handle %#" PRIx64 "\n", s ? "fs" : "vs", i, cb->trace_tex[s][i]);
    if (guest_ptr(cur.prim) && readable(cur.prim, 0x50)) {  /* the primitive (submesh) record, as 32-bit words */
        const uint32_t *pw = (const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)cur.prim;
        out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   primitive words:");
        for (int i = 0; i < 0x50 / 4; i++) out(&o, " %x", pw[i]);
        out(&o, "\n");
    }
    for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            uint64_t a = cb->trace_ub[s][i];
            if (!a) continue;
            snprintf(names[s * 16 + i], sizeof names[0], "%s cbuf %d", s ? "fs" : "vs", i);
            Want x = {names[s * 16 + i], a, {0}, 0, 0, 0, 0};
            if (readable(a, 16)) {
                memcpy(x.bytes, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, 16);
                x.has_bytes = distinctive(x.bytes);
            }
            w[nw++] = x;
            out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   %s at %#" PRIx64 "\n", x.what, a);
            if (s == 0 && i == 1 && readable(a + 128, 64)) {  /* the view's matrix, as numbers */
                const float *m = (const float *)(uintptr_t)(a + 128);
                out(&o, "yw4: drawlist:   vs cbuf 1 @128:");
                for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) out(&o, " %.4g", m[k]);
                out(&o, "\n");
            }
            if (s == 0 && (i == 1 || i == 2) && readable(a + 128, 16)) {  /* the shaders' matrices at byte 128 */
                snprintf(names[32 + i], sizeof names[0], "vs cbuf %d @128", i);
                Want y = {names[32 + i], 0, {0}, 0, 0, 0, 0};
                memcpy(y.bytes, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(a + 128), 16);
                y.has_bytes = distinctive(y.bytes);
                w[nw++] = y;
            }
        }
    char path[96] = "";
    search(&o, "object", cur.obj, 2, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);
    search(&o, "geometry", cur.geom, 2, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);
    search(&o, "primitive", cur.prim, 1, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);
    if (guest_ptr(cur.obj) && readable(cur.obj + 0x120, 8))  /* the material set, deeper but narrower */
        search(&o, "material", *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cur.obj + 0x120), 3, 0x100, path, 0, w, nw);
    if (guest_ptr(mdl) && readable(mdl + 0xf8, 8)) {  /* the model's first texture resource */
        uint64_t tt = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(mdl + 0xf8);
        if (guest_ptr(tt) && readable(tt, 8)) search(&o, "texture resource", *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)tt, 3, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);
        search(&o, "model", mdl, 2, 0x240, path, 0, w, nw);
    }
    search(&o, "renderer", main_base + 0x56ab1b0, 0, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);  /* the static renderer object */
    search(&o, "device", cur.dev, 0, SPAN, path, 0, w, nw);
    fwrite(o.buf, 1, o.len, stderr);
}
```

`runtime/src/ui.c`:
