```c
/* The overlay's 2D drawing kit (ui.h). Shapes are drawn by coverage: each image pixel's centre measured against
 * the shape (a rounded box's signed distance), so edges are smooth at any scale. Text through stb_truetype (its
 * implementation is in hud.c), icons through nanosvg. */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "stb_truetype.h"
#include "ui.h"

#if defined(__clang__)
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wc23-extensions"
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wunused-function"
#elif defined(__GNUC__)
#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wpedantic"
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wunused-function"
#endif
#define NANOSVG_IMPLEMENTATION
#define NANOSVGRAST_IMPLEMENTATION
#include "../../third_party/nanosvg/nanosvg.h"
#include "../../third_party/nanosvg/nanosvgrast.h"

/* The fonts, built into the program (third_party/fonts/README.md) */
static const unsigned char font_r500[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/MPLUSRounded1c-Medium.ttf"
};
static const unsigned char font_r700[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/MPLUSRounded1c-Bold.ttf"
};
static const unsigned char font_r800[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/MPLUSRounded1c-ExtraBold.ttf"
};
static const unsigned char font_g400[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/ZenKakuGothicNew-Regular.ttf"
};
static const unsigned char font_g500[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/ZenKakuGothicNew-Medium.ttf"
};
static const unsigned char font_g700[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/ZenKakuGothicNew-Bold.ttf"
};
/* Chinese and Japanese letters: Noto Sans SC cut down (tools/yw4/cjkfont.py), the first fallback below */
static const unsigned char font_cjk[] = {
#embed "../../third_party/fonts/NotoSansSC-SemiBold-yw4.ttf"
};
#if defined(__clang__)
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#elif defined(__GNUC__)
#pragma GCC diagnostic pop
#endif

static stbtt_fontinfo fonts[UI_FONTS];
static int fonts_state;  /* 0 not loaded, 1 loaded, -1 failed */

/* Letters the Latin fonts don't have: Japanese and Chinese in the game's prompts and names. A chain tried in
 * order for each letter: first the built-in CJK font (font_cjk: ~11,600 letters, the same on every PC), then the
 * system's fonts for the rare ones it leaves out (one system font rarely has them all: Yu Gothic has no
 * simplified-only Chinese like 给 or 个, DejaVu no CJK at all). Japanese first (the game's own language), then
 * simplified and traditional Chinese, then a general font. On Linux fontconfig names the fonts installed for each
 * language (a fixed path list missed distributions' layouts: issue #3), the fixed paths after it. Loaded on the
 * first letter that needs them. */
enum { UI_FALLBACK_FONT = UI_FONTS, FALLBACK_MAX = 8 };
static stbtt_fontinfo fallback_fonts[FALLBACK_MAX];
static int nfallback;
static int fallback_state;  /* 0 not tried, 1 at least one loaded, -1 none */
static char fallback_paths[FALLBACK_MAX][512];

static void fallback_add(const char *path, int index) {
    if (!path || !*path || nfallback >= FALLBACK_MAX) return;
    for (int k = 0; k < nfallback; k++)
        if (!strcmp(fallback_paths[k], path)) return;  /* fontconfig and the list can name the same file */
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    unsigned char *d = n > 0 ? malloc((size_t)n) : NULL;
    int ok = d && fread(d, 1, (size_t)n, f) == (size_t)n;
    fclose(f);
    int offset = ok ? stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(d, index) : -1;
    if (offset < 0) offset = ok ? stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(d, 0) : -1;
    /* stb_truetype reads TrueType and CFF outlines; a variable CFF2 font (some Noto CJK packages) fails here */
    if (offset >= 0 && stbtt_InitFont(&fallback_fonts[nfallback], d, offset)) {
        snprintf(fallback_paths[nfallback], sizeof fallback_paths[nfallback], "%s", path);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ui: fallback font %d: %s (face %d)\n", nfallback, path, index);
        nfallback++;
        return;
    }
    free(d);
}

#ifndef _WIN32
/* fontconfig's best font for a language (`fc-match :lang=zh-cn`), its file and face index. */
static void fallback_fc(const char *lang) {
    char cmd[128], line[600];
    snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "fc-match -f '%%{file}|%%{index}' ':lang=%s' 2>/dev/null", lang);
    FILE *p = popen(cmd, "r");
    if (!p) return;
    if (fgets(line, sizeof line, p)) {
        char *bar = strrchr(line, '|');
        int index = 0;
        if (bar) *bar = 0, index = atoi(bar + 1);
        fallback_add(line, index);
    }
    pclose(p);
}
#endif

/* The built-in CJK font: fallback 0. */
static int fallback_builtin(void) {
    if (fallback_state) return fallback_state > 0;
    fallback_state = -1;
    if (stbtt_InitFont(&fallback_fonts[0], font_cjk, stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(font_cjk, 0))) {
        snprintf(fallback_paths[0], sizeof fallback_paths[0], "(built in)");
        nfallback = 1;
        fallback_state = 1;
    } else fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ui: built-in CJK font unreadable\n");
    return fallback_state > 0;
}

/* The system's fonts, after it: read (tens of MB) only when a letter isn't in the built-in one. */
static int system_state;  /* 0 not tried, 1 tried */

static void fallback_system(void) {
    if (system_state) return;
    system_state = 1;
    int before = nfallback;
#ifdef _WIN32
    static const char *const paths[] = {
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/YuGothM.ttc",  "C:/Windows/Fonts/meiryo.ttc", "C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc",
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/msjh.ttc",     "C:/Windows/Fonts/msgothic.ttc", "C:/Windows/Fonts/simsun.ttc",
        "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf",
    };
#else
    fallback_fc("ja");
    fallback_fc("zh-cn");
    fallback_fc("zh-tw");
    static const char *const paths[] = {
        "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/noto-cjk/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/google-noto-cjk/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/adobe-source-han-sans/SourceHanSans.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/wenquanyi/wqy-microhei/wqy-microhei.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-microhei.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/wenquanyi/wqy-zenhei/wqy-zenhei.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/droid/DroidSansFallbackFull.ttf",
        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
        "/usr/share/fonts/TTF/DejaVuSans.ttf",
        "/usr/share/fonts/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
    };
#endif
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof paths / sizeof *paths; i++) fallback_add(paths[i], 0);
    if (nfallback == before) fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ui: no system font found for letters outside the built-in ones\n");
}

/* The first fallback font that has cp, or -1. */
static int fallback_for(int cp) {
    fallback_builtin();
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < nfallback; k++)
            if (stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(&fallback_fonts[k], cp)) return k;
        if (system_state) break;
        fallback_system();
    }
    return -1;
}

static int fonts_ready(void) {
    if (fonts_state) return fonts_state > 0;
    const unsigned char *data[UI_FONTS] = {font_r500, font_r700, font_r800, font_g400, font_g500, font_g700};
    fonts_state = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < UI_FONTS; i++)
        if (!stbtt_InitFont(&fonts[i], data[i], stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(data[i], 0))) {
            fprintf(stderr, "yw4: ui: built-in font %d unreadable\n", i);
            fonts_state = -1;
        }
    return fonts_state > 0;
}

/* ---- pixels */

static void blend(const UiCanvas *c, int x, int y, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= c->w || y >= c->h || a <= 0.0f) return;
    if (a > 1.0f) a = 1.0f;
    uint8_t *p = c->px + ((size_t)y * (size_t)c->w + (size_t)x) * 4;
    const int src[3] = {(int)(rgb >> 16 & 255), (int)(rgb >> 8 & 255), (int)(rgb & 255)};
    /* "over", kept premultiplied: on an opaque picture the same as before (alpha stays 255); on a see-through one
     * (the HUD) the alpha builds up as layers are drawn */
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) p[k] = (uint8_t)((float)p[k] + ((float)src[k] - (float)p[k]) * a + 0.5f);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)(a * 255.0f + (float)p[3] * (1.0f - a) + 0.5f);
}

/* the signed distance from (px, py) to a rounded box (image pixels), negative inside */
static float box_dist(float px, float py, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float r) {
    float cx = (x0 + x1) * 0.5f, cy = (y0 + y1) * 0.5f;
    float hx = (x1 - x0) * 0.5f - r, hy = (y1 - y0) * 0.5f - r;
    float qx = fabsf(px - cx) - hx, qy = fabsf(py - cy) - hy;
    float ox = qx > 0 ? qx : 0, oy = qy > 0 ? qy : 0;
    float in = qx > qy ? qx : qy;
    return sqrtf(ox * ox + oy * oy) + (in < 0 ? in : 0) - r;
}

static float cover(float d) { return d <= -0.5f ? 1.0f : d >= 0.5f ? 0.0f : 0.5f - d; }

static void box_a(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float fa, float bw,
                  uint32_t border, float ba);

void ui_rect(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    box_a(c, x, y, w, h, 0, rgb, a, 0, 0, 1);
}

static void box_a(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float fa, float bw,
                  uint32_t border, float ba) {
    float s = c->s;
    float x0 = c->ox + x * s, y0 = c->oy + y * s, x1 = x0 + w * s, y1 = y0 + h * s, R = r * s, B = bw * s;
    float mr = (x1 - x0 < y1 - y0 ? x1 - x0 : y1 - y0) * 0.5f;
    if (R > mr) R = mr;
    float iR = R - B > 0 ? R - B : 0;
    int ix0 = (int)floorf(x0), iy0 = (int)floorf(y0), ix1 = (int)ceilf(x1), iy1 = (int)ceilf(y1);
    if (ix0 < 0) ix0 = 0;
    if (iy0 < 0) iy0 = 0;
    if (ix1 > c->w) ix1 = c->w;
    if (iy1 > c->h) iy1 = c->h;
    /* the solid inside: where the fill alone shows, fully (the box, or with a border the box inside it), away from
     * the rounded corners, at least half a pixel in from every edge. There the distance is the plain box's and
     * covers the pixel: no distance needed (two square roots a pixel with a border). The same pixels as before. */
    int inner = B <= 0 || (x1 - x0 > 2 * B && y1 - y0 > 2 * B);
    float sx0 = B > 0 ? x0 + B : x0, sy0 = B > 0 ? y0 + B : y0, sx1 = B > 0 ? x1 - B : x1, sy1 = B > 0 ? y1 - B : y1;
    float sR = B > 0 ? iR : R;
    for (int j = iy0; j < iy1; j++) {
        float py = (float)j + 0.5f, lo = 1, hi = 0;
        if (inner && py - sy0 >= 0.5f && sy1 - py >= 0.5f) {
            int straight = py >= sy0 + sR && py <= sy1 - sR;
            lo = straight || sR < 0.5f ? sx0 + 0.5f : sx0 + sR;
            hi = straight || sR < 0.5f ? sx1 - 0.5f : sx1 - sR;
        }
        for (int i = ix0; i < ix1; i++) {
            float px = (float)i + 0.5f;
            if (px >= lo && px <= hi) {
                blend(c, i, j, fill, fa);
                continue;
            }
            float co = cover(box_dist(px, py, x0, y0, x1, y1, R));
            if (co <= 0) continue;
            if (B <= 0) {
                blend(c, i, j, fill, co * fa);
                continue;
            }
            float ci = x1 - x0 > 2 * B && y1 - y0 > 2 * B ? cover(box_dist(px, py, x0 + B, y0 + B, x1 - B, y1 - B, iR)) : 0;
            /* the border where the inner box isn't, the fill inside it */
            if (ci < 1.0f) blend(c, i, j, border, co * (1.0f - ci) * ba);
            if (ci > 0.0f) blend(c, i, j, fill, co * ci * fa);
        }
    }
}

void ui_box(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float bw, uint32_t border) {
    box_a(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill, 1.0f, bw, border, 1.0f);
}

void ui_card(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float fa, float bw,
             uint32_t border, float ba) {
    box_a(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill, fa, bw, border, ba);
}

void ui_box_alpha(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    box_a(c, x, y, w, h, r, rgb, a, 0, 0, 1);
}

void ui_shadow(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float blur, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    enum { STEPS = 12 };  /* layers from the widest to the box itself: a soft edge like CSS box-shadow */
    /* The layers are the box grown by e with its corners' radius grown by e too, so a pixel's distance to layer i
     * is its distance to the box minus e_i: one distance a pixel (one square root) gives all twelve, and their
     * "over"s of one colour are one blend with the combined alpha. Inside the box's straight parts every layer
     * covers the pixel: a constant, no distance at all. As twelve box_a calls this was most of a popup's redraw
     * (12 passes over the whole box, each pixel's distance with a square root: 230 ms for the 4K Diary page,
     * owner 2026-11-17). Where the radius would be clamped (a box smaller than its corners) the grown boxes are
     * not offsets of it: the layers are drawn one by one there, as before. */
    float s = c->s, bx0 = c->ox + x * s, by0 = c->oy + y * s, bx1 = bx0 + w * s, by1 = by0 + h * s, R = r * s;
    float la = a / STEPS * 1.6f;
    if (la > 1.0f) la = 1.0f;
    if (blur > 0 && la > 0 && w > 0 && h > 0 && R <= (bx1 - bx0 < by1 - by0 ? bx1 - bx0 : by1 - by0) * 0.5f) {
        float E[STEPS], emax = blur * 0.5f * s;
        for (int i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) E[i] = emax * (float)(i + 1) / STEPS;
        float full = 1.0f;  /* what is left of the picture under all twelve */
        for (int i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) full *= 1.0f - la;
        int ix0 = (int)floorf(bx0 - emax), iy0 = (int)floorf(by0 - emax), ix1 = (int)ceilf(bx1 + emax),
            iy1 = (int)ceilf(by1 + emax);
        if (ix0 < 0) ix0 = 0;
        if (iy0 < 0) iy0 = 0;
        if (ix1 > c->w) ix1 = c->w;
        if (iy1 > c->h) iy1 = c->h;
        for (int j = iy0; j < iy1; j++) {
            float py = (float)j + 0.5f;
            /* the row's part inside the box away from its corners: distance <= 0 there, inside every layer
             * (the smallest grows the box by E[0]: covered when distance - E[0] <= -0.5) */
            float lo = 1, hi = 0;
            if (E[0] >= 0.5f && py >= by0 && py <= by1) {
                if (py >= by0 + R && py <= by1 - R) lo = bx0, hi = bx1;
                else lo = bx0 + R, hi = bx1 - R;
            }
            for (int i = ix0; i < ix1; i++) {
                float px = (float)i + 0.5f;
                if (px >= lo && px <= hi) {
                    blend(c, i, j, rgb, 1.0f - full);
                    continue;
                }
                float d = box_dist(px, py, bx0, by0, bx1, by1, R), keep = 1.0f;
                if (d - E[STEPS - 1] >= 0.5f) continue;  /* outside the widest */
                for (int k = 0; k < STEPS; k++) keep *= 1.0f - la * cover(d - E[k]);
                blend(c, i, j, rgb, 1.0f - keep);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    for (int i = STEPS; i >= 1; i--) {
        float e = blur * 0.5f * (float)i / STEPS;
        box_a(c, x - e, y - e, w + 2 * e, h + 2 * e, r + e, rgb, a / STEPS * 1.6f, 0, 0, 1);
    }
}

/* ---- text */

static int utf8_next(const char **s) {
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)*s;
    int cp = *p++;
    if (cp >= 0xF0 && p[0] && p[1] && p[2]) cp = (cp & 7) << 18 | (p[0] & 63) << 12 | (p[1] & 63) << 6 | (p[2] & 63), p += 3;
    else if (cp >= 0xE0 && p[0] && p[1]) cp = (cp & 15) << 12 | (p[0] & 63) << 6 | (p[1] & 63), p += 2;
    else if (cp >= 0xC0 && p[0]) cp = (cp & 31) << 6 | (p[0] & 63), p += 1;
    *s = (const char *)p;
    return cp;
}

/* Letters drawn once and kept: the HUD redraws its numbers several times a second and the overlay its pages, and
 * making a letter from the font's outlines is most of what text costs. A letter is kept per font, size, character
 * and a quarter-pixel position (where it starts between two pixels: drawn at the nearest quarter, as font
 * renderers do). Only the present thread draws text (window.c: the HUD and the overlay), so there is no lock. When
 * the table fills (sizes change with the window), it is emptied and fills again. */
enum { GLYPH_SLOTS = 4096, GLYPH_SUBPIXELS = 4 };
typedef struct {
    float px;
    int cp;
    uint8_t font, sub, used;
    int16_t x0, y0, w, h;  /* the letter's box from the pen on the baseline; w or h 0: nothing to draw */
    uint8_t *bm;
} Glyph;
static Glyph glyphs[GLYPH_SLOTS];
static int glyphs_used;

static const Glyph *glyph_get(const stbtt_fontinfo *fi, int f, float px, float sc, int cp, int sub) {
    uint32_t bits;
    memcpy(&bits, &px, sizeof bits);
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)cp * 2654435761u ^ bits * 40503u ^ (uint32_t)(f * GLYPH_SUBPIXELS + sub) * 2246822519u;
    for (;;) {
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < GLYPH_SLOTS; k++) {
            Glyph *g = &glyphs[(h + k) & (GLYPH_SLOTS - 1)];
            if (g->used && g->cp == cp && g->px == px && g->font == f && g->sub == sub) return g;
            if (g->used) continue;
            if (glyphs_used >= GLYPH_SLOTS * 3 / 4) break;  /* full enough: empty it below */
            float sx = (float)sub / GLYPH_SUBPIXELS;
            int x0, y0, x1, y1;
            stbtt_GetCodepointBitmapBoxSubpixel(fi, cp, sc, sc, sx, 0, &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
            int gw = x1 - x0, gh = y1 - y0;
            *g = (Glyph){.px = px, .cp = cp, .font = (uint8_t)f, .sub = (uint8_t)sub, .used = 1,
                         .x0 = (int16_t)x0, .y0 = (int16_t)y0};
            if (gw > 0 && gh > 0 && gw <= 512 && gh <= 512 && (g->bm = malloc((size_t)gw * (size_t)gh))) {
                stbtt_MakeCodepointBitmapSubpixel(fi, g->bm, gw, gh, gw, sc, sc, sx, 0, cp);
                g->w = (int16_t)gw, g->h = (int16_t)gh;
            }
            glyphs_used++;
            return g;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < GLYPH_SLOTS; i++) free(glyphs[i].bm);
        memset(glyphs, 0, sizeof glyphs);
        glyphs_used = 0;
    }
}

/* draws (c not NULL) or measures str from x on baseline base, image pixels; track: extra space after each letter */
static float text_run(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float base, const char *str, uint32_t rgb,
                      float track) {
    if (!fonts_ready() || f < 0 || f >= UI_FONTS) return 0;
    const stbtt_fontinfo *fi = &fonts[f];
    float sc = stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(fi, px);
    float pen = x;
    int prev = 0;
    for (const char *p = str; *p;) {
        int cp = utf8_next(&p);
        if (prev) pen += (float)stbtt_GetCodepointKernAdvance(fi, prev, cp) * sc;
        int adv, lsb;
        stbtt_GetCodepointHMetrics(fi, cp, &adv, &lsb);
        int fb;
        if (cp > 32 && !stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(fi, cp)) {
            if ((fb = fallback_for(cp)) >= 0) {
                const stbtt_fontinfo *ff = &fallback_fonts[fb];
                float fsc = stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(ff, px);
                int fadv, flsb;
                stbtt_GetCodepointHMetrics(ff, cp, &fadv, &flsb);
                if (c) {
                    float fx = floorf(pen);
                    int sub = (int)((pen - fx) * GLYPH_SUBPIXELS + 0.5f);
                    if (sub == GLYPH_SUBPIXELS) sub = 0, fx += 1;  /* rounds up to the next whole pixel */
                    const Glyph *g = glyph_get(ff, UI_FALLBACK_FONT + fb, px, fsc, cp, sub);
                    if (g->w > 0) {
                        int gx = (int)fx + g->x0, gy = (int)floorf(base + 0.5f) + g->y0;
                        for (int j = 0; j < g->h; j++)
                            for (int i = 0; i < g->w; i++) {
                                uint8_t a = g->bm[j * g->w + i];
                                if (a) blend(c, gx + i, gy + j, rgb, (float)a / 255.0f);
                            }
                    }
                }
                pen += (float)fadv * fsc + track;
                prev = 0;
                continue;
            }
            /* a letter the built-in fonts don't have (they hold Western letters only, third_party/fonts): a small
             * box in its place, so typed text never turns into blank space. */
            float bw = px * 0.55f;
            if (c) {
                float bx0 = floorf(pen + px * 0.08f), by0 = floorf(base - px * 0.68f + 0.5f), bh = px * 0.68f;
                float t = px * 0.07f > 1 ? px * 0.07f : 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < (int)bh; j++)
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)bw; i++)
                        if (i < t || j < t || i >= (int)bw - t || j >= (int)bh - t) blend(c, (int)bx0 + i, (int)by0 + j, rgb, 0.7f);
            }
            pen += bw + px * 0.16f + track;
            prev = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (c && cp > 32) {
            float fx = floorf(pen);
            int sub = (int)((pen - fx) * GLYPH_SUBPIXELS + 0.5f);
            if (sub == GLYPH_SUBPIXELS) sub = 0, fx += 1;  /* rounds up to the next whole pixel */
            const Glyph *g = glyph_get(fi, f, px, sc, cp, sub);
            if (g->w > 0) {
                int gx = (int)fx + g->x0, gy = (int)floorf(base + 0.5f) + g->y0;
                for (int j = 0; j < g->h; j++)
                    for (int i = 0; i < g->w; i++) {
                        uint8_t a = g->bm[j * g->w + i];
                        if (a) blend(c, gx + i, gy + j, rgb, (float)a / 255.0f);
                    }
            }
        }
        pen += (float)adv * sc + track;
        prev = cp;
    }
    return pen - x;
}

float ui_text_w(int f, float px, const char *str) { return text_run(NULL, f, px, 0, 0, str, 0, 0); }

float ui_baseline(int f, float px, float lh) {
    if (!fonts_ready()) return 0;
    int asc, desc, gap;
    stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(&fonts[f], &asc, &desc, &gap);
    float sc = stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(&fonts[f], px);
    return (lh - (float)(asc - desc) * sc) * 0.5f + (float)asc * sc;
}

float ui_text(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float lh, const char *str, uint32_t rgb) {
    if (!fonts_ready()) return 0;
    const stbtt_fontinfo *fi = &fonts[f];
    int asc, desc, gap;
    stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(fi, &asc, &desc, &gap);
    float sc = stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(fi, px);
    float content = (float)(asc - desc) * sc;  /* in design units */
    if (lh <= 0) lh = content + (float)gap * sc;  /* "normal" */
    float base = y + (lh - content) * 0.5f + (float)asc * sc;
    float S = c->s;
    float w = text_run(c, f, px * S, c->ox + x * S, c->oy + base * S, str, rgb, 0);
    return w / S;
}

void ui_text_in(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float h, int align, const char *str,
                uint32_t rgb) {
    float tw = align ? ui_text_w(f, px, str) : 0;
    float tx = align == 1 ? x + (w - tw) * 0.5f : align == 2 ? x + w - tw : x;
    ui_text(c, f, px, tx, y, h, str, rgb);
}

/* text broken into lines at spaces to fit w; track_em: letter spacing in ems (CSS letter-spacing) */
float ui_text_wrap(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float track_em, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int align,
                   const char *str, uint32_t rgb) {
    if (!fonts_ready()) return 0;
    const stbtt_fontinfo *fi = &fonts[f];
    int asc, desc, gap;
    stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(fi, &asc, &desc, &gap);
    float sc = stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(fi, px), track = track_em * px;
    float content = (float)(asc - desc) * sc;
    if (lh <= 0) lh = content + (float)gap * sc;
    char line[512];
    float ty = y;
    const char *p = str;
    while (*p) {
        while (*p == ' ') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        /* the longest run of words that fits */
        size_t best = 0, n = 0;
        for (;;) {
            size_t e = n;
            while (p[e] && p[e] != ' ') e++;
            if (e >= sizeof line) break;
            memcpy(line, p, e), line[e] = 0;
            if (best && text_run(NULL, f, px, 0, 0, line, 0, track) > w) break;
            best = e;
            if (!p[e]) break;
            n = e + 1;
        }
        if (!best) best = strlen(p) < sizeof line - 1 ? strlen(p) : sizeof line - 1;
        memcpy(line, p, best), line[best] = 0;
        if (c) {
            float lw = text_run(NULL, f, px, 0, 0, line, 0, track) - track;
            float lx = align == 1 ? x + (w - lw) * 0.5f : align == 2 ? x + w - lw : x;
            float base = ty + (lh - content) * 0.5f + (float)asc * sc;
            text_run(c, f, px * c->s, c->ox + lx * c->s, c->oy + base * c->s, line, rgb, track * c->s);
        }
        ty += lh, p += best;
    }
    return ty - y;
}

/* the width of str[from, to) */
static float span_w(int f, float px, const char *str, int from, int to) {
    char buf[1024];
    int n = to - from < (int)sizeof buf - 1 ? to - from : (int)sizeof buf - 1;
    memcpy(buf, str + from, (size_t)n), buf[n] = 0;
    return text_run(NULL, f, px, 0, 0, buf, 0, 0);
}

static float last_caret_x;

float ui_text_caret_x(void) { return last_caret_x; }

float ui_text_edit(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int max_lines,
                   const char *str, int cursor, int sel_anchor, uint32_t rgb, uint32_t caret, uint32_t sel_color) {
    if (cursor >= 0) last_caret_x = x;
    else last_caret_x = 0;
    enum { MAXL = 64 };
    int start[MAXL], end[MAXL], n = 0, len = (int)strlen(str);
    /* lines: words (with the spaces after them) while they fit; a word wider than the box breaks between letters */
    int ls = 0, i = 0;
    while (n < MAXL) {
        int le = ls;  /* the line so far: [ls, le) */
        i = ls;
        while (i < len) {
            int we = i;
            while (we < len && str[we] != ' ') we++;
            while (we < len && str[we] == ' ') we++;
            if (span_w(f, px, str, ls, we) <= w || le == ls) {
                if (le == ls && span_w(f, px, str, ls, we) > w) {  /* one long word: as many letters as fit */
                    int k = ls;
                    while (k < we) {
                        int nk = k + 1;
                        while (nk < we && (str[nk] & 0xC0) == 0x80) nk++;
                        if (k > ls && span_w(f, px, str, ls, nk) > w) break;
                        k = nk;
                    }
                    le = k;
                    break;
                }
                le = we, i = we;
            } else break;
        }
        start[n] = ls, end[n] = le, n++;
        if (le >= len) break;
        ls = le;
    }
    /* the caret's line: the last whose range holds it (at a break, the next line's start) */
    int cl = n - 1;
    if (cursor >= 0)
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
            if (cursor >= start[k] && (cursor < end[k] || k == n - 1)) {
                cl = k;
                break;
            }
    int first = 0;  /* the lines shown: the caret's always among them */
    if (max_lines > 0 && cl >= max_lines) first = cl - max_lines + 1;
    int shown = 0;
    int has_sel = sel_anchor >= 0 && cursor >= 0 && sel_anchor != cursor;
    int sel_min = sel_anchor < cursor ? sel_anchor : cursor;
    int sel_max = sel_anchor > cursor ? sel_anchor : cursor;
    for (int k = first; k < n && (max_lines <= 0 || shown < max_lines); k++, shown++) {
        float ly = y + (float)shown * lh;
        if (c) {
            if (has_sel) {
                int o_start = start[k] > sel_min ? start[k] : sel_min;
                int o_end = end[k] < sel_max ? end[k] : sel_max;
                if (o_end > o_start) {
                    float sx0 = x + span_w(f, px, str, start[k], o_start);
                    float sx1 = x + span_w(f, px, str, start[k], o_end);
                    ui_rect(c, sx0, ly, sx1 - sx0, lh, sel_color, 0.35f);
                }
            }
            char buf[1024];
            int m = end[k] - start[k] < (int)sizeof buf - 1 ? end[k] - start[k] : (int)sizeof buf - 1;
            memcpy(buf, str + start[k], (size_t)m), buf[m] = 0;
            ui_text(c, f, px, x, ly, lh, buf, rgb);
            if (cursor >= 0 && k == cl) {
                float cx = x + span_w(f, px, str, start[k], cursor);
                last_caret_x = cx;
                ui_rect(c, cx, ly + lh * 0.15f, 2, lh * 0.7f, caret, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return (float)(shown ? shown : 1) * lh;
}

int ui_text_offset_at(int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int max_lines,
                      const char *str, int cursor, float mx, float my) {
    enum { MAXL = 64 };
    int start[MAXL], end[MAXL], n = 0, len = (int)strlen(str);
    int ls = 0, i = 0;
    while (n < MAXL) {
        int le = ls;
        i = ls;
        while (i < len) {
            int we = i;
            while (we < len && str[we] != ' ') we++;
            while (we < len && str[we] == ' ') we++;
            if (span_w(f, px, str, ls, we) <= w || le == ls) {
                if (le == ls && span_w(f, px, str, ls, we) > w) {
                    int k = ls;
                    while (k < we) {
                        int nk = k + 1;
                        while (nk < we && (str[nk] & 0xC0) == 0x80) nk++;
                        if (k > ls && span_w(f, px, str, ls, nk) > w) break;
                        k = nk;
                    }
                    le = k;
                    break;
                }
                le = we, i = we;
            } else break;
        }
        start[n] = ls, end[n] = le, n++;
        if (le >= len) break;
        ls = le;
    }
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    int cl = n - 1;
    if (cursor >= 0)
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
            if (cursor >= start[k] && (cursor < end[k] || k == n - 1)) {
                cl = k;
                break;
            }
    int first = 0;
    if (max_lines > 0 && cl >= max_lines) first = cl - max_lines + 1;
    int visible = max_lines > 0 && n - first > max_lines ? max_lines : n - first;
    if (visible <= 0) visible = 1;

    int line_idx = (int)floorf((my - y) / lh);
    if (line_idx < 0) line_idx = 0;
    if (line_idx >= visible) line_idx = visible - 1;
    int k = first + line_idx;
    if (k >= n) k = n - 1;

    float rel_x = mx - x;
    if (rel_x <= 0) return start[k];
    int line_start = start[k], line_end = end[k];
    if (rel_x >= span_w(f, px, str, line_start, line_end)) return line_end;

    int cur_p = line_start;
    while (cur_p < line_end) {
        int next_p = cur_p + 1;
        while (next_p < line_end && (str[next_p] & 0xC0) == 0x80) next_p++;
        float x0 = span_w(f, px, str, line_start, cur_p);
        float x1 = span_w(f, px, str, line_start, next_p);
        if (rel_x < (x0 + x1) * 0.5f) return cur_p;
        cur_p = next_p;
    }
    return line_end;
}

/* ---- images */

void ui_image(const UiCanvas *c, const uint8_t *rgba, int iw, int ih, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r) {
    float s = c->s;
    float x0 = c->ox + x * s, y0 = c->oy + y * s, x1 = x0 + w * s, y1 = y0 + h * s, R = r * s;
    int ix0 = (int)floorf(x0), iy0 = (int)floorf(y0), ix1 = (int)ceilf(x1), iy1 = (int)ceilf(y1);
    for (int j = iy0 < 0 ? 0 : iy0; j < iy1 && j < c->h; j++)
        for (int i = ix0 < 0 ? 0 : ix0; i < ix1 && i < c->w; i++) {
            float px = (float)i + 0.5f, py = (float)j + 0.5f;
            float co = cover(box_dist(px, py, x0, y0, x1, y1, R));
            if (co <= 0) continue;
            /* bilinear */
            float u = (px - x0) / (x1 - x0) * (float)iw - 0.5f, v = (py - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (float)ih - 0.5f;
            int u0 = u < 0 ? 0 : (int)u, v0 = v < 0 ? 0 : (int)v;
            int u1 = u0 + 1 < iw ? u0 + 1 : u0, v1 = v0 + 1 < ih ? v0 + 1 : v0;
            float fu = u < 0 ? 0 : u - (float)u0, fv = v < 0 ? 0 : v - (float)v0;
            const uint8_t *a = rgba + ((size_t)v0 * iw + u0) * 4, *b = rgba + ((size_t)v0 * iw + u1) * 4;
            const uint8_t *cc = rgba + ((size_t)v1 * iw + u0) * 4, *d = rgba + ((size_t)v1 * iw + u1) * 4;
            float col[4];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
                col[k] = (a[k] * (1 - fu) + b[k] * fu) * (1 - fv) + (cc[k] * (1 - fu) + d[k] * fu) * fv;
            uint32_t rgb = (uint32_t)(col[0] + 0.5f) << 16 | (uint32_t)(col[1] + 0.5f) << 8 | (uint32_t)(col[2] + 0.5f);
            blend(c, i, j, rgb, co * col[3] / 255.0f);
        }
}

/* ---- icons */

void ui_icon(const UiCanvas *c, const char *elements, float x, float y, float size, float stroke, uint32_t rgb) {
    char svg[2048];
    snprintf(svg, sizeof svg,
             "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\">"
             "<g fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#000000\" stroke-width=\"%g\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\">"
             "%s</g></svg>",
             (double)stroke, elements);
    NSVGimage *im = nsvgParse(svg, "px", 96.0f);
    if (!im) return;
    static NSVGrasterizer *rast;
    if (!rast) rast = nsvgCreateRasterizer();
    int n = (int)ceilf(size * c->s) + 2;
    unsigned char *buf = rast && n > 0 && n < 1024 ? calloc((size_t)n * (size_t)n, 4) : NULL;
    if (buf) {
        float fx = c->ox + x * c->s, fy = c->oy + y * c->s;
        int ix = (int)floorf(fx), iy = (int)floorf(fy);
        nsvgRasterize(rast, im, fx - (float)ix, fy - (float)iy, size * c->s / 24.0f, buf, n, n, n * 4);
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int a = buf[((size_t)j * (size_t)n + (size_t)i) * 4 + 3];
                if (a) blend(c, ix + i, iy + j, rgb, (float)a / 255.0f);
            }
        free(buf);
    }
    nsvgDelete(im);
}

/* A straight line with round ends: every pixel by its distance to the segment, so only the line's own box is
 * touched (the controller view's lines from a button to its name). */
void ui_line(const UiCanvas *c, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float w, uint32_t rgb, float a) {
    float ax = c->ox + x0 * c->s, ay = c->oy + y0 * c->s, bx = c->ox + x1 * c->s, by = c->oy + y1 * c->s;
    float hw = w * c->s * 0.5f, dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    int ix0 = (int)floorf((ax < bx ? ax : bx) - hw - 1), ix1 = (int)ceilf((ax > bx ? ax : bx) + hw + 1);
    int iy0 = (int)floorf((ay < by ? ay : by) - hw - 1), iy1 = (int)ceilf((ay > by ? ay : by) + hw + 1);
    if (ix0 < 0) ix0 = 0;
    if (iy0 < 0) iy0 = 0;
    if (ix1 > c->w) ix1 = c->w;
    if (iy1 > c->h) iy1 = c->h;
    for (int j = iy0; j < iy1; j++)
        for (int i = ix0; i < ix1; i++) {
            float px = (float)i + 0.5f - ax, py = (float)j + 0.5f - ay;
            float t = len2 > 0 ? (px * dx + py * dy) / len2 : 0;
            t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
            float qx = px - dx * t, qy = py - dy * t;
            float co = cover(sqrtf(qx * qx + qy * qy) - hw);
            if (co > 0) blend(c, i, j, rgb, co * a);
        }
}

/* A shape from SVG elements, as ui_icon but any size and filled or stroked as each element says (fill="#000", or
 * stroke="#000" with a stroke-width): the view box is vw wide and drawn over the box (x, y, w, h). */
void ui_shape(const UiCanvas *c, const char *elements, float x, float y, float w, float h, float vw, uint32_t rgb) {
    char svg[2048];
    float vh = vw * h / w;
    snprintf(svg, sizeof svg,
             "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"%g\" height=\"%g\" viewBox=\"0 0 %g %g\">"
             "<g fill=\"none\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\">%s</g></svg>",
             (double)vw, (double)vh, (double)vw, (double)vh, elements);
    NSVGimage *im = nsvgParse(svg, "px", 96.0f);
    if (!im) return;
    static NSVGrasterizer *rast;
    if (!rast) rast = nsvgCreateRasterizer();
    int nx = (int)ceilf(w * c->s) + 2, ny = (int)ceilf(h * c->s) + 2;
    unsigned char *buf = rast && nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx < 8192 && ny < 8192 ? calloc((size_t)nx * (size_t)ny, 4) : NULL;
    if (buf) {
        float fx = c->ox + x * c->s, fy = c->oy + y * c->s;
        int ix = (int)floorf(fx), iy = (int)floorf(fy);
        nsvgRasterize(rast, im, fx - (float)ix, fy - (float)iy, w * c->s / vw, buf, nx, ny, nx * 4);
        for (int j = 0; j < ny; j++)
            for (int i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
                int a = buf[((size_t)j * (size_t)nx + (size_t)i) * 4 + 3];
                if (a) blend(c, ix + i, iy + j, rgb, (float)a / 255.0f);
            }
        free(buf);
    }
    nsvgDelete(im);
}
```

`runtime/src/ui.h`:

```h
/* A small 2D drawing kit for the in-game overlay (gamemenu.h), on the CPU into an RGBA image: rectangles and
 * rounded boxes with smooth edges and borders, text in the overlay design's fonts (built into the program, see
 * third_party/fonts), and line icons from SVG path data (nanosvg). Everything is placed in the design's own units
 * (CSS pixels of its 1600 x 900 artboard) and drawn at `s` image pixels per unit, so the overlay keeps the design's
 * proportions at any window size and stays sharp. Colours are 0xRRGGBB, drawn over what is there with opacity
 * `a` (0..1), blended as browsers do (on the stored values). The image is kept premultiplied: drawn on a
 * transparent image (alpha 0) the result is a see-through picture to blend onto another (the HUD). */
#ifndef YW4_UI_H
#define YW4_UI_H

#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    uint8_t *px;  /* RGBA, rows of w */
    int w, h;
    float s;      /* image pixels per design unit */
    float ox, oy; /* where the design's (0, 0) is, in image pixels */
} UiCanvas;

enum {
    UI_ROUNDED_500, UI_ROUNDED_700, UI_ROUNDED_800,  /* M PLUS Rounded 1c: titles, buttons */
    UI_GOTHIC_400, UI_GOTHIC_500, UI_GOTHIC_700,     /* Zen Kaku Gothic New: body text */
    UI_FONTS
};

/* A rectangle, and a rounded box (radius r) with a border of width bw (inside the box, as CSS's border-box;
 * bw 0: none). */
void ui_rect(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, uint32_t rgb, float a);
void ui_box(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float bw, uint32_t border);
/* A rounded box of colour rgb at opacity a (no border), and a soft shadow around a box: CSS
 * box-shadow 0 0 <blur> rgb/a, drawn as layers (offset it by moving y). */
/* A rounded box whose fill and border have their own opacity (the HUD's see-through card). */
void ui_card(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t fill, float fa, float bw,
             uint32_t border, float ba);
void ui_box_alpha(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, uint32_t rgb, float a);
void ui_shadow(const UiCanvas *c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float blur, uint32_t rgb, float a);
/* Text in font f at size px (the CSS font-size), its line box of height lh (0: the font's normal height) with its
 * top at y, starting at x; returns its width. ui_text_w measures without drawing. */
float ui_text(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float lh, const char *str, uint32_t rgb);
float ui_text_w(int f, float px, const char *str);
/* Where ui_text puts the baseline, from the top of a line box lh high: to line up texts of different sizes. */
float ui_baseline(int f, float px, float lh);
/* Text centred vertically in [y, y + h], from x (align 0), centred in [x, x + w] (1) or ending at x + w (2). */
void ui_text_in(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float h, int align, const char *str,
                uint32_t rgb);
/* Text broken into lines at spaces to fit w (design units), each lh high, with letter spacing track_em (CSS
 * letter-spacing in ems), aligned as ui_text_in; returns its height. c NULL: only measures. */
float ui_text_wrap(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float track_em, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int align,
                   const char *str, uint32_t rgb);
/* Text being typed (textin.h): broken into lines to fit w (at spaces, a long word between letters), each lh high,
 * at most max_lines (0: all; more: the ones round the caret), with a caret (2 units wide, colour caret) before the
 * byte `cursor` (-1: none) and selection [min(sel_anchor, cursor), max(sel_anchor, cursor)) highlighted in sel_color.
 * Returns its height. c NULL: only measures. */
float ui_text_edit(const UiCanvas *c, int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int max_lines,
                   const char *str, int cursor, int sel_anchor, uint32_t rgb, uint32_t caret, uint32_t sel_color);
/* Where ui_text_edit last placed the caret, in design units (0 if no caret was drawn). */
float ui_text_caret_x(void);
/* Returns character byte offset into str closest to design point (mx, my) in the text box. */
int ui_text_offset_at(int f, float px, float x, float y, float w, float lh, int max_lines,
                      const char *str, int cursor, float mx, float my);
/* An RGBA image (iw x ih) drawn into the box at (x, y), w x h units, its corners rounded by r. */
void ui_image(const UiCanvas *c, const uint8_t *rgba, int iw, int ih, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r);
/* A line icon: SVG elements (path, circle...) of a 24 x 24 view box drawn `size` units square at (x, y), stroked
 * with width `stroke` (in the view box's units), round caps and joins, in rgb. */
void ui_icon(const UiCanvas *c, const char *svg_elements, float x, float y, float size, float stroke, uint32_t rgb);

/* A straight line w units wide with round ends, and a shape from SVG elements in a view box vw wide drawn over the
 * box (x, y, w, h): each element says whether it is filled (fill="#000") or stroked (stroke="#000" stroke-width). */
void ui_line(const UiCanvas *c, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float w, uint32_t rgb, float a);
void ui_shape(const UiCanvas *c, const char *elements, float x, float y, float w, float h, float vw, uint32_t rgb);

#endif
```

`runtime/src/vi.c`:

```c
/* nn::vi, the display, as overrides of the sdk's functions (recomp/overrides.toml, decision 0017).
 *
 * On the Switch, NVN's window presents through a vi layer and the binder buffer queue
 * behind it. Our NVN presents itself, so the display and layer here are just objects to
 * hand back, and the native window is a token nvnWindowBuilderSetNativeWindow receives and
 * ignores. What matters is the vsync event: a host thread signals it at 60 Hz, and the
 * game paces its frames on it. Approach as in LAS Recomp's hle/vi.c (MIT, third_party/lasrecomp).
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

extern uint64_t yw4_frames_presented;  /* dispatch.c */
int yw4_replay_frame_clock(void);      /* kernel.c */

#define VSYNC_PERIOD_NS 16666667  /* 60 Hz */

static void *token(void) {
    void *p = calloc(1, 0x100);
    if (!p) yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    return p;
}

void yw4_vi_Initialize(CPUState *c) { (void)c; }
void yw4_vi_Finalize(CPUState *c) { (void)c; }

/* OpenDefaultDisplay(Display **out) -> Result */
void yw4_vi_OpenDefaultDisplay(CPUState *c) {
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)token();
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
void yw4_vi_CloseDisplay(CPUState *c) { (void)c; }

/* CreateLayer(Layer **out, Display *, int width, int height) -> Result */
void yw4_vi_CreateLayer(CPUState *c) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: vi: layer %dx%d\n", (int)c->x[2], (int)c->x[3]);
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)token();
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
void yw4_vi_DestroyLayer(CPUState *c) { (void)c; }

/* GetNativeWindow(void **out, Layer *) -> Result */
void yw4_vi_GetNativeWindow(CPUState *c) {
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)token();
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

/* ---- vsync */

static KEvent *vsync;
static uint64_t vsync_count;   /* vsyncs so far */
static int64_t vsync_time;     /* host time of the last one */

uint64_t yw4_vsync_count(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&vsync_count, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

/* Waits until vsync number n has happened (the display's next flip, for NVN's present). */
void yw4_wait_vsync(uint64_t n) {
    while (yw4_vsync_count() < n) {
        int64_t due = __atomic_load_n(&vsync_time, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) + VSYNC_PERIOD_NS - host_now_ns();
        yw4_host_sleep_ns(due > 100000 ? due : 100000);
    }
}

static void vsync_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    host_thread_set_priority(NULL, 36);
    int64_t next = host_now_ns();
    for (;;) {
        next += VSYNC_PERIOD_NS;
        int64_t now = host_now_ns();
        if (next > now) yw4_host_sleep_ns(next - now);
        else if (now - next > 3 * VSYNC_PERIOD_NS) next = now;  /* fell far behind: don't burst to catch up */
        __atomic_store_n(&vsync_time, host_now_ns(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        uint64_t tick = __atomic_add_fetch(&vsync_count, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        /* YW4_REPLAY_CLOCK=frame (kernel.c): the replay and the recording go by presented frame instead */
        yw4_hid_update(yw4_replay_frame_clock() ? __atomic_load_n(&yw4_frames_presented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1 : tick);
        KEvent *e = __atomic_load_n(&vsync, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if (e) yw4_event_signal_from_host(e);
    }
}

/* The vsync thread runs from the first of: the game asking for the vsync event, NVN presenting. */
void yw4_vsync_start(void) {
    static int started;
    if (__atomic_exchange_n(&started, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL)) return;
    if (host_thread_start(vsync_thread, NULL, 1 << 16)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: vi: cannot start the vsync thread\n");
        yw4_exit(3, __FILE__, __LINE__);
    }
}

/* GetDisplayVsyncEvent(nn::os::SystemEventType *event, Display *) -> Result. The sdk's
 * version attaches a readable event handle to the game's SystemEventType; so does this one,
 * by calling nn::os::AttachReadableHandleToSystemEvent(event, handle, managed = false,
 * clear mode = auto clear). */
void yw4_vi_GetDisplayVsyncEvent(CPUState *c) {
    uint32_t handle;
    yw4_kernel_lock();
    KEvent *e = __atomic_load_n(&vsync, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!e) {
        e = yw4_event_new(&handle);
        e->host_signalled = 1;
        __atomic_store_n(&vsync, e, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);  /* the vsync thread signals it from now on */
    } else {
        handle = yw4_handle_new(&e->obj);
    }
    yw4_kernel_unlock();
    yw4_vsync_start();
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    c->x[1] = handle, c->x[2] = 0, c->x[3] = 1;  /* x0 is already the event */
    yw4_resolve(yw4_guest_symbol("_ZN2nn2os33AttachReadableHandleToSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeEjbNS0_14EventClearModeE"))(c);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
```

`runtime/src/vk.h`:

```h
/* Vulkan, loaded at run time through SDL (decision 0019), shared by the window (window.c)
 * and the draw path (gpu.c, decision 0021).
 *
 * Functions are global pointers named like the Vulkan functions (VK_NO_PROTOTYPES, so they
 * don't clash); window.c defines and loads them. One queue for everything; vkQueueSubmit
 * and vkQueuePresentKHR are called with vk.queue_lock held.
 */
#ifndef YW4_VK_H
#define YW4_VK_H

#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#include "host.h"

#define VK_GLOBAL_FNS(X) X(vkCreateInstance) X(vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties)
#define VK_INSTANCE_FNS(X)                                                                                      \
    X(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR)                       \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties) X(vkCreateDevice)          \
    X(vkGetDeviceProcAddr) X(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2)            \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties)                                  \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties2)

    X(vkGetDeviceQueue) X(vkCreateSwapchainKHR) X(vkDestroySwapchainKHR) X(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR)          \
    X(vkAcquireNextImageKHR) X(vkQueuePresentKHR) X(vkCreateCommandPool) X(vkAllocateCommandBuffers)         \
    X(vkBeginCommandBuffer) X(vkEndCommandBuffer) X(vkQueueSubmit) X(vkCreateFence) X(vkWaitForFences)       \
    X(vkResetFences) X(vkCreateSemaphore) X(vkDestroySemaphore) X(vkCreateBuffer) X(vkDestroyBuffer)         \
    X(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements) X(vkAllocateMemory) X(vkFreeMemory) X(vkBindBufferMemory) X(vkMapMemory) \
    X(vkCreateImage) X(vkDestroyImage) X(vkGetImageMemoryRequirements) X(vkBindImageMemory)                  \
    X(vkCmdPipelineBarrier) X(vkCmdCopyBufferToImage) X(vkCmdCopyBuffer) X(vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer) X(vkCmdBlitImage) X(vkCmdCopyImage) X(vkUnmapMemory)          \
    X(vkCmdClearColorImage) X(vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage) X(vkCmdClearAttachments) X(vkDeviceWaitIdle)       \
    X(vkResetCommandBuffer)                                                                                   \
    X(vkWaitSemaphores) X(vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue) X(vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT)                 \
    X(vkCreateImageView) X(vkDestroyImageView) X(vkCreateSampler) X(vkCreateShaderModule)                   \
    X(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout) X(vkCreatePipelineLayout) X(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines)                     \
    X(vkCreateDescriptorPool) X(vkResetDescriptorPool) X(vkAllocateDescriptorSets) X(vkUpdateDescriptorSets) \
```

`runtime/src/widescreen.c`:

```c
/* Widescreen (decision 0033): the 3D view in another shape than the game's 16:9, with the UI kept 16:9 in the
 * middle.
 *
 * The camera: every frame f_97f510 walks the engine's cameras (array at [main+0x5865720], count at
 * main+0x5865728) and copies each one's settings into its working fields: +0x2e4 field of view (vertical, 45
 * degrees in town) to +0x1a4, +0x2e8 aspect (16/9) to +0x1a8, near and far. The projection is built from the
 * setting (+0x2e8: changing only +0x1a8 changed nothing), so the hook sets +0x2e8 before the copy. The
 * vertical view stays the same and the sides grow; the game's culling follows the camera's projection.
 *
 * The images (gpu.c): every screen-sized target is made wider (or narrower) by the factor below on top of the
 * resolution's; viewports and scissors follow, the UI draws keep the game's width in the middle (gpu_draw.c).
 * YW4_ASPECT=16:9 / 16:10 / 21:9 / 32:9 at start; the settings panel changes it. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gpu.h"
#include "yw4load.h"
#include "yw4rt.h"

static const struct {
    const char *name;
    float aspect;
    uint32_t num, den;  /* the width factor against 16:9 */
} shapes[] = {{"16:9", 16.0f / 9.0f, 1, 1}, {"16:10", 1.6f, 9, 10}, {"21:9", 64.0f / 27.0f, 4, 3}, {"32:9", 32.0f / 9.0f, 2, 1}};
enum { SHAPES = sizeof shapes / sizeof *shapes };

static int shape = -1, shape_used = -1;  /* the choice, and the one the images and cameras use (gpu_sizes_settle) */

int gpu_wide(void) {
    int s = __atomic_load_n(&shape_used, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (s < 0) __atomic_store_n(&shape_used, s = gpu_wide_choice(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return s;
}

void gpu_wide_settle(void) { __atomic_store_n(&shape_used, gpu_wide_choice(), __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

int gpu_wide_choice(void) {
    int s = __atomic_load_n(&shape, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (s < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("YW4_ASPECT");
        s = 0;
        for (int i = 0; e && i < SHAPES; i++)
            if (!strcmp(e, shapes[i].name)) s = i;
        __atomic_store_n(&shape, s, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return s;
}

void gpu_wide_cycle(void) {
    int s = (gpu_wide_choice() + 1) % SHAPES;
    __atomic_store_n(&shape, s, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: gpu: aspect ratio %s\n", shapes[s].name);
}

void gpu_wide_factor(uint32_t *num, uint32_t *den) {
    int s = gpu_wide();
    *num = shapes[s].num, *den = shapes[s].den;
}

/* Is v one of the shapes' aspects (the game's 16:9, or one we set)? */
static int ours(float v) {
    for (int i = 0; i < SHAPES; i++)
        if (v > shapes[i].aspect - 0.0005f && v < shapes[i].aspect + 0.0005f) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* hook on f_97f510 (recomp/overrides.toml), before its body: the cameras whose aspect setting is 16:9 or one
 * of ours get the chosen one (so going back to 16:9 restores them); other aspects are the game's own. */
int yw4_hook_camera_update(CPUState *ctx) {
    (void)ctx;
    uint64_t main_base = *yw4_modules[YW4_MAIN].base;
    uint64_t list = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(main_base + 0x5865720);
    uint32_t n = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(main_base + 0x5865728);
    float aspect = shapes[gpu_wide()].aspect;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; list && i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t cam = *(const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(list + 8ull * i);
        float *set = cam ? (float *)(uintptr_t)(cam + 0x2e8) : NULL;
        if (set && *set != aspect && ours(*set)) *set = aspect;
    }
    return 0;  /* the body copies it into the camera's projection fields */
}

```

`runtime/src/window.c`:

```c
/* The game's window (decision 0019): SDL3 for the window and its events, Vulkan to show frames.
 *
 * For now a frame arrives as RGBA8 pixels from the CPU (NVN's present reads the window
 * texture back from the game's memory): it is copied to a Vulkan image and scaled into the
 * window, letterboxed to keep 16:9. Vulkan is loaded at run time through SDL
 * (SDL_Vulkan_GetVkGetInstanceProcAddr), so nothing is linked against vulkan-1.
 * YW4_VULKAN_VALIDATION=1 turns on the Khronos validation layer if it is installed.
 *
 * Threads: the process's main thread owns the window and pumps its events; the guest runs on
 * its own host thread and presents from there (Vulkan only needs one thread at a time per
 * queue and swapchain, which present_lock gives).
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#define MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0777)
#endif

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_vulkan.h>

#include "events.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "bindings.h"
#include "framerate.h"
#include "gpu_dlss.h"
#include "gpu_dlssg.h"
#include "gpu_fg.h"
#include "gbuffer.h"
#include "gpu.h"
#include "hud.h"
#include "gamemenu.h"
#include "pause.h"
#include "mousemenu.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "shortcutwheel.h"
#include "textin.h"
#include "theme.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "version.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "window.h"

#define GUEST_HOST_STACK (64u << 20)  /* the guest main thread's host stack: reserved, not committed */

/* ---- Vulkan functions (vk.h), loaded at run time */

#define DEFINE(f) PFN_##f f;
VK_GLOBAL_FNS(DEFINE)
VK_INSTANCE_FNS(DEFINE)
VK_DEVICE_FNS(DEFINE)
VkContext vk = {.queue_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT};

/* ---- state */

static SDL_Window *window;
static int64_t refresh_mhz;  /* the display's refresh in millihertz, 0 unknown (window_refresh_hz) */

double window_refresh_hz(void) { return (double)__atomic_load_n(&refresh_mhz, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) / 1000.0; }
static int have_vulkan;
static HostLock present_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;

static VkSurfaceKHR surface;
static VkCommandPool pool;
static VkCommandBuffer cmd;
static void window_notice(int high, const char *title, const char *fmt, ...);  /* a fading card (below, with the HUD) */
static void window_notice_keys(void);  /* the same card for the controls, after the one showing (if any) */
static VkFence fence;
static VkSemaphore acquired;

static VkSwapchainKHR swapchain;
static VkExtent2D swap_extent;
static VkImage swap_images[8];
static VkImageView swap_views[8];  /* to draw into (the HUD, blended) */
static VkSemaphore rendered[8];  /* one per swapchain image: reused only after that image is presented */
static uint32_t nswap;
static VkFormat swap_format;
static int swap_readable;  /* the window's images can be copied from (the quick look's blur) */
static int swapchain_stale = 1;  /* (re)create before the next present: first use, resize */
/* the last presented picture's place in the window, as fractions (x, y, width, height): the present fits it
 * with black bars when the window's shape differs. Written by the present, read by the window's thread. */
static float picture_rect[4] = {0, 0, 1, 1};
static int swap_free;            /* the swapchain doesn't wait for the monitor (MAILBOX / IMMEDIATE wanted) */
static int swap_dlssg; /* made while DLSS frame generation was chosen: made again when the player switches it (NVIDIA),
                       * not when a menu pauses it (that rebuild was a 13-43 ms hitch per menu) */

static int free_running(void) {
    int hz = framerate_hz();
    return !hz || hz > 60 || gpu_fg_active() || dlssg_chosen();  /* frame generation paces its frames itself; vsync (-1): FIFO */
}

static VkBuffer staging;
static VkDeviceMemory staging_mem, frame_mem;
static void *staging_ptr;
static VkImage frame;
static uint32_t frame_w, frame_h;

/* Overlays drawn by the presenting thread on the CPU (hud.c) and copied onto the window: the performance
 * HUD (hud.h: F3 or YW4_HUD=1) and the settings panel (settings.h: F1). */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t w, h;  /* the image's size; what is drawn is at its top-left */
    VkImage image;
    VkBuffer buffer;  /* mapped staging copy (ptr) */
    VkDeviceMemory image_mem, buffer_mem;
    void *ptr;
} Overlay;
enum { HUD_W = 256 * 4, HUD_H = 128 * 4 };  /* the HUD drawn at its scale: up to 4x its 1x size */
/* (the "SWITCHING FRAME GENERATION..." notice is gone: owner, 2026-11-11; the switch's safe frames still run) */
static Overlay panel = {480, 480};
/* The performance HUD (F3; the in-game overlay's Performance page): hud_on 0 off, 1 detailed, 2 compact (-1:
 * not read yet, YW4_HUD); its corner (0 top left, 1 top right, 2 bottom left, 3 bottom right, YW4_HUD_CORNER)
 * and in the detailed one its parts (HUD_PART_*, YW4_HUD_PARTS). Saved with the settings. */
static int hud_on = -1, hud_last = 1, hud_corner = -1, hud_parts = -1;

void gpu_request_trace(int draws);  /* gpu_draw.c */
void gpu_request_dump(void);        /* gpu.c */
void shadow_toggle(void);           /* shadow.c */
static int screenshot_requested;  /* F12 */
static char screenshot_dir[512] = "work/screenshots";

static int vk_fail(const char *what, VkResult r) {
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: %s failed (VkResult %d)\n", what, (int)r);
    return -1;
}

uint32_t vk_memory_type(uint32_t bits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags want) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(vk.gpu, &p);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.memoryTypeCount; i++)
        if (bits & (1u << i) && (p.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want) return i;
    return UINT32_MAX;
}

static int create_swapchain(uint64_t frame) {  /* frame: the game frame being presented, for the log */
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(vk.device);
    VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR caps;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(vk.gpu, surface, &caps);
    VkExtent2D extent = caps.currentExtent;
    if (extent.width == UINT32_MAX) {
        int w, h;
        SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels(window, &w, &h);
        extent = (VkExtent2D){(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h};
    }
    if (!extent.width || !extent.height) return -1;  /* minimised: try again later */
    uint32_t nfmt = 0;
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR fmts[64];
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(vk.gpu, surface, &nfmt, NULL);
    if (nfmt > 64) nfmt = 64;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(vk.gpu, surface, &nfmt, fmts);
    /* UNORM in the plain sRGB colour space: the game's bytes are shown as they are, as on the Switch. The same
     * UNORM format can be listed again with other colour spaces (HDR, extended or linear ones: Linux compositors
     * with colour management); those make the screen read the bytes differently, and an _SRGB format would encode
     * them a second time: both look pale (issue #3). So the colour space must be SRGB_NONLINEAR too. */
    int pick = -1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nfmt && pick < 0; i++)
        if ((fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) &&
            fmts[i].colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR)
            pick = (int)i;
    int second = 0;  /* without one: a UNORM format in any colour space, else the driver's first */
    for (uint32_t i = nfmt; i-- > 0;)
        if (fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) second = (int)i;
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR fmt = fmts[pick < 0 ? second : pick];
    static int fmt_logged;
    if (!fmt_logged || pick < 0) {  /* once (the swapchain is made again on every resize), or each time it's wrong */
        fmt_logged = 1;
        char list[64 * 24] = "", *p = list;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nfmt && p < list + sizeof list - 24; i++)
            p += snprintf(p, (size_t)(list + sizeof list - p), "%s%d/%d", i ? " " : "", (int)fmts[i].format,
                          (int)fmts[i].colorSpace);
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: screen formats (format/colour space) %s; using %d/%d%s\n", list,
                (int)fmt.format, (int)fmt.colorSpace,
                pick < 0 ? ": WARNING no 8-bit UNORM in sRGB colour space, colours may look wrong" : "");
    }
    uint32_t count = caps.minImageCount + 1;
    if (caps.maxImageCount && count > caps.maxImageCount) count = caps.maxImageCount;
    /* FIFO waits for the monitor's refresh. Above 60 frames/s or with no limit (framerate.c) MAILBOX, else
     * IMMEDIATE, when the driver has them, so the frame rate isn't capped at the refresh rate. */
    VkPresentModeKHR mode = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    swap_free = free_running();
    swap_dlssg = dlssg_chosen();
    if (swap_free) {
        uint32_t nmodes = 0;
        VkPresentModeKHR modes[16];
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(vk.gpu, surface, &nmodes, NULL);
        if (nmodes > 16) nmodes = 16;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(vk.gpu, surface, &nmodes, modes);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nmodes; i++)
            if (modes[i] == VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR && mode == VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR) mode = modes[i];
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nmodes; i++)
            if (modes[i] == VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR) mode = modes[i];
    }
    swap_readable = (caps.supportedUsageFlags & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT) != 0;
    VkSwapchainKHR old = swapchain;
    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR ci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR,
        .surface = surface,
        .minImageCount = count,
        .imageFormat = fmt.format,
        .imageColorSpace = fmt.colorSpace,
        .imageExtent = extent,
        .imageArrayLayers = 1,
        /* copies; the HUD drawn; read back where it can be (F2's quick look blurs the picture behind its card) */
        .imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT |
                      (caps.supportedUsageFlags & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT),
        .imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE,
        .preTransform = caps.currentTransform,
        .compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR,
        .presentMode = mode,  /* FIFO is always available; the game paces itself to 30 */
        .clipped = VK_TRUE,
        .oldSwapchain = old,
    };
    VkResult r = vkCreateSwapchainKHR(vk.device, &ci, NULL, &swapchain);
    if (old) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(vk.device, old, NULL);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        swapchain = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return vk_fail("vkCreateSwapchainKHR", r);
    }
    /* the count first, then the images (Streamline's version, DLSS frame generation, wants it this way) */
    nswap = 0;
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(vk.device, swapchain, &nswap, NULL);
    if (nswap > 8) nswap = 8;
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(vk.device, swapchain, &nswap, swap_images);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {  /* the views of the images, made again with them */
        if (swap_views[i]) vkDestroyImageView(vk.device, swap_views[i], NULL), swap_views[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        if (i >= nswap) continue;
        VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = swap_images[i],
                                    .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = fmt.format,
                                    .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
        vkCreateImageView(vk.device, &vi, NULL, &swap_views[i]);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nswap; i++) {
        if (rendered[i]) vkDestroySemaphore(vk.device, rendered[i], NULL);
        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
        vkCreateSemaphore(vk.device, &si, NULL, &rendered[i]);
    }
    swap_extent = extent;
    swap_format = fmt.format;
    swapchain_stale = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: swapchain %ux%u, %u images, %s%s, frame %" PRIu64 ", %.1f ms\n", extent.width,
            extent.height, nswap,
            mode == VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR ? "FIFO (waits for the refresh)" : mode == VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR ? "MAILBOX"
                                                                                                        : "IMMEDIATE",
            old ? " (made again)" : "", frame, (double)(host_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6);
    return 0;
}

/* Start-up order (2026-11-11). Streamline's start (slInit, ~1.4 s) needs nothing of ours, so it runs on a thread
 * of its own from the beginning of main(), beside the loading of the game's code, the RomFS scan and SDL's start;
 * vk_init waits for it. And the guest's thread starts as soon as the window exists, beside vk_init: the game boots
 * for ~2 s before its first command list (gpu.c, gpu_ready). YW4_BOOT_PARALLEL=0: one after the other, as before. */
static HostLock sl_lock = HOST_LOCK_INIT;
static HostCond sl_cond = HOST_COND_INIT;
static int sl_state;  /* 0 not on a thread, 1 starting, 2 done */

static int boot_parallel(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("YW4_BOOT_PARALLEL");
    return !(e && *e == '0');
}

static void sl_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    dlssg_start();
    host_lock(&sl_lock);
    sl_state = 2;
    host_cond_broadcast(&sl_cond);
    host_unlock(&sl_lock);
}

void window_prestart(void) {
    const char *headless = getenv("YW4_HEADLESS");
    if ((headless && *headless && *headless != '0') || !boot_parallel()) return;
    sl_state = 1;
    if (host_thread_start(sl_thread, NULL, 4 << 20)) sl_state = 0;
}

static int vk_init(void) {
    /* DLSS frame generation (gpu_dlssg.cpp): Vulkan through Streamline, which adds what it needs */
    yw4_boot_mark("SDL and the window ready");
    host_lock(&sl_lock);  /* Streamline is starting on its own thread since main() (window_prestart) */
    while (sl_state == 1) host_cond_wait(&sl_cond, &sl_lock, -1);
    host_unlock(&sl_lock);
    int sl = dlssg_start();
    yw4_boot_mark("Streamline started (or left out)");
    PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa =
        sl ? dlssg_loader() : (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)SDL_Vulkan_GetVkGetInstanceProcAddr();
    if (!gipa) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: no Vulkan loader (%s)\n", SDL_GetError());
        return -1;
    }
#define LOAD_GLOBAL(f) f = (PFN_##f)gipa(NULL, #f);
    VK_GLOBAL_FNS(LOAD_GLOBAL)
    Uint32 next = 0;
    const char *const *exts = SDL_Vulkan_GetInstanceExtensions(&next);
    const char *layers[1];
    uint32_t nlayers = 0;
    const char *v = getenv("YW4_VULKAN_VALIDATION");
    if (v && *v && *v != '0') {
        uint32_t n = 0;
        VkLayerProperties props[128];
        vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, NULL);
        if (n > 128) n = 128;
        vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, props);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (!strcmp(props[i].layerName, "VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation")) layers[nlayers++] = "VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation";
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: Vulkan validation %s\n", nlayers ? "on" : "asked for, but the layer isn't installed");
    }
    VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "yw4",
                             .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app,
                                .enabledExtensionCount = next, .ppEnabledExtensionNames = exts,
                                .enabledLayerCount = nlayers, .ppEnabledLayerNames = layers};
    VkResult r = vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &vk.instance);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return vk_fail("vkCreateInstance", r);
    yw4_boot_mark("Vulkan instance");
#define LOAD_INSTANCE(f) f = (PFN_##f)gipa(vk.instance, #f);
    VK_INSTANCE_FNS(LOAD_INSTANCE)
    if (sl)  /* the surface through Streamline too (SDL would make it with its own loader) */
        surface = dlssg_create_surface(
            SDL_GetPointerProperty(SDL_GetWindowProperties(window), SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER, NULL));
    if (!surface && !SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface(window, vk.instance, NULL, &surface)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return -1;
    }

    /* A GPU with a queue that draws and presents to this window; a discrete one if there is one. */
    uint32_t ngpu = 16;
    VkPhysicalDevice gpus[16];
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(vk.instance, &ngpu, gpus);
    int best = -1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ngpu; i++) {
        uint32_t nq = 32;
        VkQueueFamilyProperties qs[32];
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(gpus[i], &nq, qs);
        for (uint32_t q = 0; q < nq; q++) {
            VkBool32 present = 0;
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR(gpus[i], q, surface, &present);
            if (!(qs[q].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) || !present) continue;
            VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(gpus[i], &p);
            int score = p.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU ? 2 : 1;
            if (score > best) best = score, vk.gpu = gpus[i], vk.queue_family = q;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (best < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: no Vulkan GPU can draw to this window\n");
        return -1;
    }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(vk.gpu, &props);
    vk.props = props;
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: Vulkan on %s (API %u.%u.%u)\n", props.deviceName, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(props.apiVersion),
            VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(props.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(props.apiVersion));
    if (props.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3) {
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: the draw path needs Vulkan 1.3 (decision 0021)\n");
        return -1;
    }
    {  /* the driver and the window system, for reports from other PCs (issue #3: RADV on Linux) */
        VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties dp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &dp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(vk.gpu, &p2);
        const char *wsys = SDL_GetCurrentVideoDriver();
        fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: driver %s, %s (id %d), window system %s\n", dp.driverName, dp.driverInfo,
                (int)dp.driverID, wsys ? wsys : "?");
    }
    static const char *dexts[24] = {VK_KHR_SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSION_NAME};  /* kept: vk.device_exts */
    uint32_t ndexts = 1;
    /* NVIDIA DLSS's device extensions (gpu_dlss.c, decision 0040), those the GPU has */
    const char **dlss_exts;
    unsigned ndlss = 0;
    gpu_dlss_device_extensions(props.vendorID, &dlss_exts, &ndlss);
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features q12 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 q = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, .pNext = &q12};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(vk.gpu, &q);
    int core_bda = q12.bufferDeviceAddress;
    /* DLSS lists the old VK_EXT_buffer_device_address, but allocates with the core feature's flag (validation,
     * 2026-10-29): the core feature is kept where the GPU has it (Vulkan 1.2), the EXT only without it */
    int bda_ext = 0, has_present_id = 0, has_derivatives = 0, has_conditional = 0, has_push = 0;
    {
        uint32_t n = 0;
        vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(vk.gpu, NULL, &n, NULL);
        VkExtensionProperties *e = calloc(n, sizeof *e);
        vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(vk.gpu, NULL, &n, e);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_EXT_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_EXTENSION_NAME)) vk.host_import = 1;
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME)) vk.memory_budget = 1;
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_KHR_PRESENT_ID_EXTENSION_NAME)) has_present_id = 1;
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_KHR_COMPUTE_SHADER_DERIVATIVES_EXTENSION_NAME)) has_derivatives = 1;
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_EXT_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_EXTENSION_NAME)) has_conditional = 1;
            if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, VK_KHR_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_EXTENSION_NAME)) has_push = 1;
        }
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < ndlss && ndexts < 20; k++)
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
                if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, dlss_exts[k])) {
                    int bda = !strcmp(dlss_exts[k], "VK_EXT_buffer_device_address");
                    if (bda && core_bda) break;
                    dexts[ndexts++] = dlss_exts[k];
                    bda_ext |= bda;
                    break;
                }
        free(e);
    }
    if (vk.host_import) {
        dexts[ndexts++] = VK_EXT_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_EXTENSION_NAME;
        VkPhysicalDeviceExternalMemoryHostPropertiesEXT hp = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_PROPERTIES_EXT};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &hp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(vk.gpu, &p2);
        vk.host_import_align = hp.minImportedHostPointerAlignment;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: host memory import: %s\n", vk.host_import ? "yes" : "no (no draw path)");
    if (vk.memory_budget && ndexts < 24) dexts[ndexts++] = VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME;  /* gpu_vram */
    else vk.memory_budget = 0;
    /* push descriptors (gpu_draw.c, bind_stage_set): a draw's fragment bindings go into the command buffer, with no
     * descriptor set allocated and written for each draw (that was ~18% of the GPU worker's time, 2026-11-17).
     * YW4_PUSH_DESC=0: sets as before. */
    if (has_push && ndexts < 24 && !(getenv("YW4_PUSH_DESC") && getenv("YW4_PUSH_DESC")[0] == '0')) {
        VkPhysicalDevicePushDescriptorPropertiesKHR pp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTIES_KHR};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &pp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(vk.gpu, &p2);
        if (pp.maxPushDescriptors) {
            dexts[ndexts++] = VK_KHR_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_EXTENSION_NAME;
            vk.push_descriptor = 1, vk.max_push_descriptors = pp.maxPushDescriptors;
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "yw4: window: push descriptors: %s (up to %u)\n", vk.push_descriptor ? "yes" : "no",
            vk.max_push_descriptors);

    /* Features: what the translated shaders (0020) and NVN's state use, where the GPU has it. */
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES, .pNext = &f13};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features f11 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES, .pNext = &f12};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 have = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, .pNext = &f11};
    /* the extensions' own feature structs, asked about only where the GPU has the extension */
    VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR fpid = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR};
    VkPhysicalDeviceComputeShaderDerivativesFeaturesKHR fder = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_COMPUTE_SHADER_DERIVATIVES_FEATURES_KHR};
    VkPhysicalDeviceConditionalRenderingFeaturesEXT fcond = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_FEATURES_EXT};
    if (has_conditional) fcond.pNext = have.pNext, have.pNext = &fcond;
    if (has_present_id) fpid.pNext = have.pNext, have.pNext = &fpid;
    if (has_derivatives) fder.pNext = have.pNext, have.pNext = &fder;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(vk.gpu, &have);
    const VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures *h = &have.features;
    vk.sampler_anisotropy = h->samplerAnisotropy;
    /* 16-bit floats and subgroup sizes: not ours, AMD FSR's fast shader variants (gpu_fsr.c, decision 0039) */
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features e13 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES,
                                            .dynamicRendering = f13.dynamicRendering,
                                            .synchronization2 = f13.synchronization2,
                                            .subgroupSizeControl = f13.subgroupSizeControl,
                                            .computeFullSubgroups = f13.computeFullSubgroups,
                                            /* shaders compiled for Vulkan 1.3 turn discard into demote */
                                            .shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation = f13.shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features e12 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES, .pNext = &e13,
                                            .timelineSemaphore = f12.timelineSemaphore,
                                            .shaderFloat16 = f12.shaderFloat16, .shaderInt8 = f12.shaderInt8,
                                            .bufferDeviceAddress = f12.bufferDeviceAddress};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features e11 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES, .pNext = &e12,
                                            .shaderDrawParameters = f11.shaderDrawParameters,
                                            .storageBuffer16BitAccess = f11.storageBuffer16BitAccess,
                                            .uniformAndStorageBuffer16BitAccess = f11.uniformAndStorageBuffer16BitAccess};
    /* the old EXT buffer-address extension (DLSS asks for it) may not be enabled alongside the core feature: its own
     * feature struct then */
    VkPhysicalDeviceBufferDeviceAddressFeaturesEXT ebda = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_BUFFER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_FEATURES_EXT, .pNext = &e11,
        .bufferDeviceAddress = VK_TRUE};
    if (bda_ext) e12.bufferDeviceAddress = VK_FALSE;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 enable = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, .pNext = bda_ext ? (void *)&ebda : (void *)&e11,
        .features = {.geometryShader = h->geometryShader, .independentBlend = h->independentBlend,
                     .depthClamp = h->depthClamp, .depthBiasClamp = h->depthBiasClamp,
                     .fillModeNonSolid = h->fillModeNonSolid, .samplerAnisotropy = h->samplerAnisotropy,
                     .fragmentStoresAndAtomics = h->fragmentStoresAndAtomics,
                     .vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics = h->vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics,
                     .shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat = h->shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat,
                     .imageCubeArray = h->imageCubeArray, .dualSrcBlend = h->dualSrcBlend, .logicOp = h->logicOp,
                     .multiDrawIndirect = h->multiDrawIndirect, .textureCompressionBC = h->textureCompressionBC,
                     .occlusionQueryPrecise = h->occlusionQueryPrecise}};
```
