`tests/test_kernel.py`:

```py
"""Guest threads on the runtime's kernel (runtime/src/kernel.c, decision 0015), without the game.

The "guest" code is C calling yw4_svc the way the sdk does; its mutex and condition variable
follow nn::os / libnx. The exclusive-increment loop is the recompiler's own output
(lift.lift), so decision 0009's atomics get tested between real threads.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from recomp import check, lift

RUNTIME = check.REPO / "runtime"

DRIVER = r"""
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "host.h"
#include "ipc.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "yw4load.h"

/* What the kernel links against, with no game: no modules, no services. */
void yw4_profile_thread(int role, uint64_t frame) { (void)role, (void)frame; }  /* profile.c: no profiler here */
const Yw4Module yw4_modules[1];
const size_t yw4_nmodules = 0;
const uint64_t yw4_entry_init_start = 0, yw4_main_stack_size = 0x1000;
const uint32_t yw4_main_priority = 44;
const Yw4CodeModule yw4_code[1];
const size_t yw4_ncode = 0;
const Yw4GuestSymbol yw4_guest_symbols[1];
const size_t yw4_nguest_symbols = 0;
uint32_t ipc_connect_named_port(const char *name, uint32_t *h) { (void)name, (void)h; return 1; }
uint32_t ipc_send_request(uint32_t h, uint64_t m) { (void)h, (void)m; return 1; }
int ipc_close_handle(uint32_t h) { (void)h; return 0; }
int yw4_replay_done;  /* svc_hid.c's: no input replay here */

#define FAIL(...) do { printf(__VA_ARGS__); puts(""); fflush(stdout); exit(1); } while (0)
#define W 0x40000000u
#define TIMEOUT 0xEA01u
#define FOREVER ((uint64_t)-1)
#define A(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))

static uint64_t sv(CPUState *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d, uint64_t e) {
    c->x[0] = a, c->x[1] = b, c->x[2] = d, c->x[3] = e;
    yw4_svc(c, imm);
    return c->x[0];
}

/* nn::os / libnx mutex: 0 = free, else the owner's handle, W = someone waits. Each test
 * thread keeps its own handle in x28. */
static int arbitrations;
static uint32_t self_tag(CPUState *c) { return (uint32_t)c->x[28]; }
static void lock(CPUState *c, uint32_t *m) {
    uint32_t self = self_tag(c), v = __atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (;;) {
        if (v == 0) {
            if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(m, &v, self, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
            continue;
        }
        if ((v & ~W) == self) FAIL("thread %#x: the mutex is already mine", self);
        if (!(v & W) && !__atomic_compare_exchange_n(m, &v, v | W, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) continue;
        __atomic_add_fetch(&arbitrations, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x1A, v & ~W, A(m), self, 0);
        if (r) FAIL("ArbitrateLock failed: %#x", r);
        v = __atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if ((v & ~W) == self) return;
    }
}
static void unlock(CPUState *c, uint32_t *m) {
    uint32_t self = self_tag(c), v = self;
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(m, &v, 0, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    if ((v & ~W) != self) FAIL("unlock of a mutex that isn't mine: %#x", v);
    sv(c, 0x1B, A(m), 0, 0, 0);
}
static uint32_t cv_wait(CPUState *c, uint32_t *m, uint32_t *cv, int64_t timeout) {
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x1C, A(m), A(cv), self_tag(c), (uint64_t)timeout);
    if (r == TIMEOUT) {  /* the kernel does not take the mutex back on a timeout */
        if ((__atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & ~W) == self_tag(c)) FAIL("timed-out wait came back holding the mutex");
        lock(c, m);
    } else if (r) {
        FAIL("WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic: %#x", r);
    } else if ((__atomic_load_n(m, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) & ~W) != self_tag(c)) {
        FAIL("woken without the mutex");
    }
    return r;
}
static void cv_signal(CPUState *c, uint32_t *cv, int32_t n) { sv(c, 0x1D, A(cv), (uint64_t)(uint32_t)n, 0, 0); }

/* ---- the tests' guest threads: x0 = index */

static uint32_t handles[64];
static CPUState main_ctx;
static int which;

static uint32_t mtx, counter;
static uint32_t qm, not_empty, not_full, queue[4], qhead, qcount;
static uint64_t consumed_sum, consumed_n;
static uint32_t ev_w, ev_r, word, excl_word;
static volatile uint32_t sink;

static void lifted_increment(CPUState *ctx) {  /* again: ldaxr w1,[x0]; add w1,w1,#1; stlxr w2,w1,[x0]; cbnz w2, again */
again:
    LDAXR
    ADD
    STLXR
    if ((uint32_t)ctx->x[2]) goto again;
}

static void entry(CPUState *c) {
    int i = (int)c->x[0];
    c->x[28] = handles[i];
    switch (which) {
    case 1:  /* mutex: a non-atomic counter, with a slow critical section */
        for (int k = 0; k < 20000; k++) {
            lock(c, &mtx);
            uint32_t v = counter;
            for (int s = 0; s < 20; s++) sink = sink + 1;
            counter = v + 1;
            unlock(c, &mtx);
        }
        break;
    case 2:  /* bounded queue: even threads produce, odd ones consume */
        for (int k = 0; k < 5000; k++) {
            lock(c, &qm);
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                while (qcount == 4) cv_wait(c, &qm, &not_full, -1);
                queue[(qhead + qcount++) % 4] = (uint32_t)(i * 100000 + k);
                cv_signal(c, &not_empty, 1);
            } else {
                while (qcount == 0) cv_wait(c, &qm, &not_empty, -1);
                consumed_sum += queue[qhead];
                consumed_n++;
                qhead = (qhead + 1) % 4, qcount--;
                cv_signal(c, &not_full, 1);
            }
            unlock(c, &qm);
        }
        break;
    case 3: {  /* wait for the event; the outcome goes in counter */
        uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x18, 0, A(&ev_r), 1, FOREVER);
        __atomic_store_n(&counter, r == 0 && c->x[1] == 0 ? 1 : 0x10000 | r, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        break;
    }
    case 4: {  /* address arbiter: wait while word == 0 */
        uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x34, A(&word), 2, 0, FOREVER);
        __atomic_store_n(&counter, r == 0 ? 1 : 0x10000 | r, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        break;
    }
    case 5:  /* exclusives under contention */
        for (int k = 0; k < 100000; k++) {
            c->x[0] = A(&excl_word);
            lifted_increment(c);
        }
        break;
    }
    if (i % 2) sv(c, 0x0A, 0, 0, 0, 0);  /* odd threads end with ExitThread, even ones by returning */
}

static void start(int n) {
    uint64_t fn = yw4_host_function(entry);
    CPUState *c = &main_ctx;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (sv(c, 0x08, 0, fn, (uint64_t)i, 0x7000100000ull) != 0) FAIL("CreateThread");
        handles[i] = (uint32_t)c->x[1];
        if (sv(c, 0x09, handles[i], 0, 0, 0) != 0) FAIL("StartThread");
    }
}
static void join(int n) {
    CPUState *c = &main_ctx;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x18, 0, A(&handles[i]), 1, FOREVER);
        if (r != 0 || c->x[1] != 0) FAIL("join thread %d: %#x", i, r);
        sv(c, 0x16, handles[i], 0, 0, 0);
    }
}
static void settle(void) { sv(&main_ctx, 0x0B, 20000000, 0, 0, 0); }  /* 20 ms for a thread to reach its wait */
static void wait_counter(uint32_t want) {
    for (int k = 0; k < 2000 && __atomic_load_n(&counter, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) != want; k++) sv(&main_ctx, 0x0B, 1000000, 0, 0, 0);
}

/* setjmp/longjmp as generated code does them (decision 0018): the caller of setjmp has a
 * big frame (on Windows x64 that puts rbp above rsp, which broke __builtin_setjmp); the
 * "guest longjmp" restores sp and branches to the setjmp's return address from deep down. */
#define SETJMP_RET 0x7100001234ull  /* no translated function there */
static uint64_t saved_sp;
static void guest_longjmp(CPUState *c) {
    c->sp = saved_sp;
    c->x[0] = 7;  /* longjmp's value */
    yw4_resolve(SETJMP_RET)(c);
    FAIL("the jump back to the setjmp point returned");
}
static void deep(CPUState *c, int n) {
    volatile char frame[300];
    frame[0] = (char)n;
    c->sp -= 0x40;  /* the guest stack grows as the calls nest */
    if (n) deep(c, n - 1);
    else guest_longjmp(c);
    FAIL("deep returned %d", frame[0]);
}
static void protected_call(CPUState *ctx) {
    volatile uint64_t locals[40];
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) locals[i] = (uint64_t)i * 3 + 1;
    jmp_buf jb;
    saved_sp = ctx->sp;
    ctx->x[30] = SETJMP_RET;
    if (!setjmp(jb)) {
        yw4_setjmp_register(ctx, SETJMP_RET, jb);
        ctx->x[0] = 0;
        deep(ctx, 6);
    }
    if (ctx->x[0] != 7 || ctx->sp != saved_sp) FAIL("after longjmp: x0 %llu sp %llx", (unsigned long long)ctx->x[0], (unsigned long long)ctx->sp);
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
        if (locals[i] != (uint64_t)i * 3 + 1) FAIL("local %d lost across longjmp", i);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    CPUState *c = &main_ctx;
    /* as main.c: reserve the guest ranges before anything else maps memory, and when the process's layout
       already has something there, once more in a fresh process (new ASLR layout) */
    if (yw4_guest_memory_init()) {
        const char *retried = getenv("YW4_ASLR_RETRY");
        if (!retried || !*retried) host_respawn(argc, argv);
        FAIL("cannot reserve the guest ranges, even in a fresh process");
    }
    c->x[28] = yw4_kernel_init(c, 0x7000000000ull, 0x1000);
    sv(c, 0x45, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    ev_w = (uint32_t)c->x[1], ev_r = (uint32_t)c->x[2];

    c->sp = 0x7000000f00ull;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) protected_call(c);  /* again and again: points are reused, not piled up */

    if (argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "deadlock")) {  /* nobody can signal this: must stop, not hang */
        which = 3, start(1);
        sv(c, 0x18, 0, A(&ev_r), 1, FOREVER);
        FAIL("a wait nobody can end returned");
    }

    which = 1, start(8), join(8);
    if (counter != 8 * 20000) FAIL("mutex: counter %u, want %u", counter, 8 * 20000);
    if (!arbitrations) FAIL("mutex: never contended, so the kernel path wasn't tested");
    if (mtx != 0) FAIL("mutex word left at %#x", mtx);

    which = 2, start(8), join(8);
    uint64_t want = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i += 2)
        for (int k = 0; k < 5000; k++) want += (uint64_t)(i * 100000 + k);
    if (consumed_n != 4 * 5000 || consumed_sum != want) FAIL("queue: %" PRIu64 " items, sum %" PRIu64, consumed_n, consumed_sum);

    /* timeouts */
    int64_t t0 = host_now_ns();
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)sv(c, 0x18, 0, A(&ev_r), 1, 20000000);
    if (r != TIMEOUT) FAIL("event wait with a timeout: %#x", r);
    if (host_now_ns() - t0 < 20000000) FAIL("the timeout came early");
    lock(c, &mtx);
    if (cv_wait(c, &mtx, &not_empty, 10000000) != TIMEOUT) FAIL("condition variable timeout");
    unlock(c, &mtx);
    lock(c, &mtx);
    if (sv(c, 0x1C, A(&mtx), A(&not_empty), self_tag(c), 0) != TIMEOUT) FAIL("condition variable timeout 0");
    if (mtx != 0) FAIL("timeout 0 kept the mutex");

    /* events */
    which = 3, counter = 0, start(1), settle();
    if (counter) FAIL("event wait ended before the signal");
    sv(c, 0x11, ev_w, 0, 0, 0);
    wait_counter(1);
    if (counter != 1) FAIL("event wait: %#x", counter);
    join(1);
    sv(c, 0x12, ev_w, 0, 0, 0);

    /* CancelSynchronization: of a waiting thread, then one pending before the wait */
    which = 3, counter = 0, start(1), settle();
    sv(c, 0x19, handles[0], 0, 0, 0);
    wait_counter(0x10000 | 0xEC01);
    if (counter != (0x10000 | 0xEC01)) FAIL("cancel: %#x", counter);
    join(1);
    sv(c, 0x19, 0xFFFF8000u, 0, 0, 0);  /* pending, through the current-thread pseudo-handle */
    if (sv(c, 0x18, 0, A(&ev_r), 1, FOREVER) != 0xEC01) FAIL("pending cancel");

    /* address arbiter */
    word = 1;
    if (sv(c, 0x34, A(&word), 2, 0, FOREVER) != 0xFA01) FAIL("WaitIfEqual on another value");
    word = 0, which = 4, counter = 0, start(1), settle();
    if (counter) FAIL("address wait ended before the signal");
    if (sv(c, 0x35, A(&word), 1, 0, 1) != 0 || word != 1) FAIL("SignalAndIncrementIfEqual");
    wait_counter(1);
    if (counter != 1) FAIL("address wait: %#x", counter);
    join(1);

    which = 5, start(8), join(8);
    if (excl_word != 8 * 100000) FAIL("exclusives: %u increments, want %u", excl_word, 8 * 100000);

    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}
"""


class KernelThreadTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """Guest threads as host threads: blocking, waking, timeouts, exclusives (decision 0015)."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        t = Path(cls.tmp.name)
        src = (DRIVER.replace("LDAXR", lift.lift(0x885FFC01)).replace("ADD", lift.lift(0x11000421))
               .replace("STLXR", lift.lift(0x8802FC01)))
        (t / "drv.c").write_text(src)
        cls.exe = t / "kernel.exe"
        rt = RUNTIME / "src"
        files = [rt / f for f in ("kernel.c", "host.c", "loader.c", "dispatch.c", "setjmp.c", "sha256.c")]
        subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Werror", f"-I{RUNTIME / 'include'}", f"-I{rt}",
                        "-o", str(cls.exe), str(t / "drv.c"), *map(str, files), "-pthread",
                        *(["-lwinmm"] if sys.platform == "win32" else [])], check=True)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.tmp.cleanup()

    def test_threads(self):
        got = subprocess.run([str(self.exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        self.assertEqual(got.stdout.strip(), "ok", got.stderr[-2000:])

    def test_deadlock_stops(self):
        got = subprocess.run([str(self.exe), "deadlock"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        self.assertEqual(got.returncode, 3, got.stdout + got.stderr[-2000:])
        self.assertIn("every guest thread waits forever", got.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_lift.py`:

```py
"""Unit tests for the lifter that don't need the Pi (hardware checks: python -m recomp.check)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from recomp import lift


class BitMaskTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_known_immediates(self):
        # Values from the Arm ARM logical-immediate encoding (N, imms, immr) -> wmask
        cases = [
            ((0, 0b111100, 0), 32, 0x55555555),          # 01 repeated (2-bit element)
            ((0, 0b000111, 0), 32, 0xFF),                # 8 ones in a 32-bit element
            ((1, 0b000000, 0), 64, 0x1),                 # 1 one in a 64-bit element
            ((1, 0b111110, 1), 64, 0xBFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF),  # 63 ones rotated right by 1
        ]
        for (n, imms, immr), width, want in cases:
            self.assertEqual(lift.decode_bit_masks(n, imms, immr, True, width)[0], want)

    def test_reserved(self):
        self.assertIsNone(lift.decode_bit_masks(0, 0b111111, 0, True, 32))  # all-ones element
        self.assertIsNone(lift.decode_bit_masks(1, 0, 0, True, 32))         # 64-bit element in 32-bit op


class FormLookupTest(unittest.TestCase):
    KNOWN = {
        0x8B020020: "addsub_shift",   # add x0, x1, x2
        0xEB02003F: "addsub_shift",   # cmp x1, x2
        0x91000420: "addsub_imm",     # add x0, x1, #1
        0xD2800020: "movewide",       # mov x0, #1
        0xAA0103E0: "logical_shift",  # mov x0, x1
        0x9AC20C20: "dp2",            # sdiv x0, x1, x2
        0x9B027C20: "dp3",            # mul x0, x1, x2
        0x9A821020: "csel",           # csel x0, x1, x2, ne
        0xD3401C20: "bitfield",       # ubfx x0, x1, #0, #8 (uxtb)
        0xF9400420: "ldst_uimm",      # ldr x0, [x1, #8]
        0xB8404C20: "ldst_imm9",      # ldr w0, [x1, #4]!
        0xF8617820: "ldst_regoff",    # ldr x0, [x1, x1, lsl #3]
        0xA9BF7BFD: "ldst_pair",      # stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    }

    def test_known_encodings(self):
        for enc, name in self.KNOWN.items():
            f = lift.find_form(enc)
            self.assertIsNotNone(f, hex(enc))
            self.assertEqual(f.name, name, hex(enc))
            self.assertTrue(f.valid(enc), hex(enc))

    def test_write_to_zero_register_is_dropped(self):
        # cmp x1, x2 writes only flags
        self.assertNotIn("ctx->x[31]", lift.lift(0xEB02003F))
        self.assertIn("ctx->nzcv", lift.lift(0xEB02003F))

    def test_unpredictable_loads_are_rejected(self):
        for enc in (0x29400441,   # ldp w1, w1, [x2]
                    0xF8408421):  # ldr x1, [x1], #8 (writeback into the loaded register)
            self.assertFalse(lift.find_form(enc).valid(enc), hex(enc))

    def test_prefetch_is_a_no_op(self):
        self.assertEqual(lift.lift(0xF98003E0), ";")  # prfm pldl1keep, [sp]

    def test_unknown(self):
        with self.assertRaises(lift.LiftError):
            lift.lift(0x14000000)  # b . (branches are not single-instruction forms)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_nso.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the LZ4 decoder and NSO parser, on synthetic data only (no game files).

Run from the repo root:  python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
The optional `lz4` package, if installed, is used only to make test input.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
import struct
import unittest

from tools.yw4 import lz4_block, nso

try:
    import lz4.block as lz4ref
except ImportError:
    lz4ref = None


class Lz4BlockTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_literals_only(self):
        # token 0x50: 5 literals, no match (last sequence)
        self.assertEqual(lz4_block.decompress(b"\x50hello", 5), b"hello")

    def test_overlapping_match(self):
        # 1 literal 'a', then match offset 1 length 4+3=7 -> 'a' * 8
        self.assertEqual(lz4_block.decompress(b"\x13a\x01\x00", 8), b"a" * 8)

    def test_extended_lengths(self):
        # 15 + 5 = 20 literals
        src = b"\xf0\x05" + b"x" * 20
        self.assertEqual(lz4_block.decompress(src, 20), b"x" * 20)

    def test_bad_offset(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            lz4_block.decompress(b"\x10a\x05\x00", 5)

    def test_truncated(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            lz4_block.decompress(b"\x50hel", 5)

    @unittest.skipIf(lz4ref is None, "lz4 package not installed")
    def test_matches_reference(self):
        rng = os.urandom(4096)
        data = rng + b"ABCD" * 5000 + rng[:100] + bytes(3000) + rng
        comp = lz4ref.compress(data, store_size=False)
        self.assertEqual(lz4_block.decompress(comp, len(data)), data)


def make_nso(text: bytes, ro: bytes, data: bytes, compress: bool) -> bytes:
    segs = [text, ro, data]
    payloads = [lz4ref.compress(s, store_size=False) if compress else s for s in segs]
    mem = [0, 0x1000, 0x2000]
    header = bytearray(nso.HEADER_SIZE)
    header[:4] = b"NSO0"
    flags = 0b111000 | (0b111 if compress else 0)
    struct.pack_into("<I", header, 0x0C, flags)
    off = nso.HEADER_SIZE
    for i, (seg, payload) in enumerate(zip(segs, payloads)):
        struct.pack_into("<3I", header, 0x10 + i * 0x10, off, mem[i], len(seg))
        struct.pack_into("<I", header, 0x60 + i * 4, len(payload))
        header[0xA0 + i * 0x20:0xC0 + i * 0x20] = hashlib.sha256(seg).digest()
        off += len(payload)
    header[0x40:0x54] = bytes(range(1, 21))
    return bytes(header) + b"".join(payloads)


class NsoTest(unittest.TestCase):
    TEXT, RO, DATA = b"\x1f\x20\x03\xd5" * 64, b"rodata" * 10, b"\x01\x02"

    def check_image(self, blob: bytes):
        img = nso.flat_image(blob)
        self.assertEqual(len(img), 0x2000 + len(self.DATA))
        self.assertEqual(img[:len(self.TEXT)], self.TEXT)
        self.assertEqual(img[0x1000:0x1000 + len(self.RO)], self.RO)
        self.assertEqual(img[len(self.TEXT):0x1000], bytes(0x1000 - len(self.TEXT)))

    def test_uncompressed(self):
        self.check_image(make_nso(self.TEXT, self.RO, self.DATA, compress=False))

    @unittest.skipIf(lz4ref is None, "lz4 package not installed")
    def test_compressed_same_image(self):
        a = nso.flat_image(make_nso(self.TEXT, self.RO, self.DATA, compress=False))
        b = nso.flat_image(make_nso(self.TEXT, self.RO, self.DATA, compress=True))
        self.assertEqual(a, b)

    def test_build_id(self):
        h = nso.parse_header(make_nso(self.TEXT, self.RO, self.DATA, compress=False))
        self.assertEqual(nso.build_id_hex(h.build_id), bytes(range(1, 21)).hex().upper())

    def test_hash_mismatch(self):
        blob = bytearray(make_nso(self.TEXT, self.RO, self.DATA, compress=False))
        blob[nso.HEADER_SIZE] ^= 0xFF
        with self.assertRaises(nso.NsoError):
            nso.flat_image(bytes(blob))

    def test_bad_magic(self):
        with self.assertRaises(nso.NsoError):
            nso.parse_header(b"XXXX" + bytes(0xFC))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

`tests/test_nvn.py`:

```py
"""The Tegra texture layout behind NVN storage sizes and WriteTexels (runtime/src/tegra.c, decision 0017).

The game sizes its texture memory from nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize, so a wrong size
silently overlaps textures. Checked against an independent Python model of the
block-linear layout and against sizes worked out by hand.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import random
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from recomp import check

RUNTIME = check.REPO / "runtime"

DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "tegra.h"
/* region <format> <width> <height>: tegra_write_region of a whole level must equal
 * tegra_swizzle; then regions read back must equal the source, at aligned and unaligned x */
static int region_test(uint32_t fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    TexLayout t = {0};
    t.fmt = nvn_format_info(fmt), t.width = w, t.height = h, t.depth = 1, t.layers = 1, t.levels = 1;
    tegra_layout_init(&t);
    uint32_t bpb = t.fmt->bpb;
    size_t n = (size_t)w * h * bpb, size = (size_t)tegra_total_size(&t);
    unsigned char *src = malloc(n), *a = calloc(1, size), *b = calloc(1, size), *back = malloc(n);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) src[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 13 + 5);
    tegra_swizzle(src, a, w, h, 1, bpb, t.block_height_log2, 0);
    tegra_write_region(&t, b, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, w, h, 1, src);
    if (memcmp(a, b, size)) { puts("write_region differs from swizzle"); return 1; }
    tegra_read_region(&t, b, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, w, h, 1, back);
    if (memcmp(back, src, n)) { puts("read_region of the whole level differs"); return 1; }
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < 9 && x < w; x++) {  /* parts starting at aligned and unaligned x */
        uint32_t rw = w - x, rh = h > 3 ? h - 3 : h;
        tegra_read_region(&t, b, 0, 0, x, 1 % h, 0, rw, rh - 1 % h, 1, back);
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < rh - 1 % h; j++)
            if (memcmp(back + (size_t)j * rw * bpb, src + (((size_t)(j + 1 % h)) * w + x) * bpb, (size_t)rw * bpb)) {
                printf("read_region at x %u, row %u differs\n", x, j);
                return 1;
            }
    }
    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc == 5 && !strcmp(argv[1], "region"))
        return region_test((uint32_t)strtoul(argv[2], 0, 0), (uint32_t)atoi(argv[3]), (uint32_t)atoi(argv[4]));
    if (argc == 7) {  /* size <format> <width> <height> <depth> <layers> <levels> */
        TexLayout t = {0};
        t.fmt = nvn_format_info((uint32_t)strtoul(argv[1], 0, 0));
        t.width = atoi(argv[2]), t.height = atoi(argv[3]), t.depth = atoi(argv[4]);
        t.layers = atoi(argv[5]), t.levels = atoi(argv[6]);
        tegra_layout_init(&t);
        printf("%llu %u\n", (unsigned long long)tegra_total_size(&t), t.block_height_log2);
        return 0;
    }
    /* swizzle <wb> <hb> <bpb> <bh>: linear bytes 0,1,2... -> block-linear, printed as hex */
    uint32_t wb = atoi(argv[1]), hb = atoi(argv[2]), bpb = atoi(argv[3]), bh = atoi(argv[4]);
    size_t n = (size_t)wb * hb * bpb, out = 1 << 20;
    unsigned char *src = malloc(n), *dst = calloc(1, out);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) src[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 7 + 3);
    tegra_swizzle(src, dst, wb, hb, 1, bpb, bh, 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out; i++) printf("%02x", dst[i]);
    return 0;
}
"""


def gob_offset(x: int, y: int, width_bytes: int, bh: int) -> int:
    """Byte (x, y) of a 2D block-linear surface, from the Tegra X1 layout: 64x8-byte GOBs of
    four 16x2 sectors pairs, 2^bh GOBs stacked per block, blocks in rows."""
    gobs_wide = (width_bytes + 63) // 64
    block_rows = 8 << bh
    block = (y // block_rows) * gobs_wide + x // 64
    gob_in_block = (y % block_rows) // 8
    xi, yi = x % 64, y % 8
    in_gob = (xi // 32) * 256 + (yi // 2) * 64 + ((xi % 32) // 16) * 32 + (yi % 2) * 16 + xi % 16
    return block * (512 << bh) + gob_in_block * 512 + in_gob


class TegraTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        t = Path(cls.tmp.name)
        (t / "drv.c").write_text(DRIVER)
        cls.exe = t / "tegra.exe"
        subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Werror", f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}", "-o",
                        str(cls.exe), str(t / "drv.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "tegra.c")], check=True)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.tmp.cleanup()

    def size(self, fmt: int, w: int, h: int, d: int = 1, layers: int = 1, levels: int = 1) -> tuple[int, int]:
        out = subprocess.run([str(self.exe), hex(fmt), str(w), str(h), str(d), str(layers), str(levels)],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
        return int(out[0]), int(out[1])

    def test_sizes_by_hand(self):
        RGBA8, BC1 = 0x25, 0x41
        # 1920x1080 RGBA8: 7680 bytes = 120 GOBs wide; 135 GOBs high -> 16-GOB blocks, 9 block rows
        self.assertEqual(self.size(RGBA8, 1920, 1080), (120 * 512 * 16 * 9, 4))
        # 1x1 RGBA8: one GOB
        self.assertEqual(self.size(RGBA8, 1, 1), (512, 0))
        # 256x256 BC1: 64x64 blocks of 8 bytes = 512 bytes = 8 GOBs wide, 8 GOBs high -> one 8-GOB block row
        self.assertEqual(self.size(BC1, 256, 256), (8 * 512 * 8, 3))
        # mip chain 64x64 RGBA8, levels 64..1: each level is whole GOBs wide and whole blocks
        # high, and a level's block height shrinks while half a block still covers it
        lv = [(64, 64), (32, 32), (16, 16), (8, 8), (4, 4), (2, 2), (1, 1)]
        want = 0
        for w, h in lv:
            gw = (w * 4 + 63) // 64
            gh = (h + 7) // 8
            bh = 3  # level 0's block height, shrunk while a half-block still covers the level
            while bh > 0 and (8 << (bh - 1)) >= h:
                bh -= 1
            want += gw * 512 * (1 << bh) * -(-gh // (1 << bh))
        self.assertEqual(self.size(RGBA8, 64, 64, levels=7)[0], want)
        # 2D array: layers start on a block boundary
        single = self.size(RGBA8, 100, 20)[0]
        bh = self.size(RGBA8, 100, 20)[1]
        block = 512 << bh
        self.assertEqual(self.size(RGBA8, 100, 20, layers=3)[0], 3 * (-(-single // block) * block))

    def test_regions(self):
        for fmt, w, h in [(0x25, 100, 37), (0x25, 1920, 1080), (0x01, 77, 20), (0x29, 33, 17), (0x2E, 9, 9)]:
            got = subprocess.run([str(self.exe), "region", hex(fmt), str(w), str(h)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(got.stdout.strip(), "ok", f"format {fmt:#x} {w}x{h}")

    def test_swizzle_matches_layout(self):
        rng = random.Random(4)
        for _ in range(12):
            wb, hb, bpb = rng.randint(1, 90), rng.randint(1, 70), rng.choice([1, 2, 4, 8, 16])
            if wb * bpb > 1000:
                continue
            bh = rng.randint(0, 4)
            out = bytes.fromhex(subprocess.run([str(self.exe), str(wb), str(hb), str(bpb), str(bh)],
                                               capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
            for y in range(hb):
                for xb in range(wb * bpb):
                    i = y * wb * bpb + xb
                    self.assertEqual(out[gob_offset(xb, y, wb * bpb, bh)], (i * 7 + 3) & 0xFF,
                                     f"wb {wb} hb {hb} bpb {bpb} bh {bh} at ({xb}, {y})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_pfs0.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the PFS0 reader on a synthetic archive (no game files)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from tools.yw4 import pfs0


def make_pfs0(files: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:
    names = b""
    entries = b""
    data = b""
    for name, body in files.items():
        entries += struct.pack("<QQII", len(data), len(body), len(names), 0)
        names += name.encode() + b"\0"
        data += body
    names += b"\0" * (-len(names) % 0x20)  # real archives pad the string table
    return b"PFS0" + struct.pack("<III", len(files), len(names), 0) + entries + names + data


class Pfs0Test(unittest.TestCase):
    FILES = {"a.nca": b"hello", "abc.tik": b"\x01" * 0x40, "x.cnmt.nca": b""}

    def test_entries_and_extract(self):
        f = io.BytesIO(make_pfs0(self.FILES))
        entries = pfs0.read_entries(f)
        self.assertEqual([e.name for e in entries], list(self.FILES))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            for e in entries:
                dest = Path(tmp) / e.name
                pfs0.extract(f, e, dest)
                self.assertEqual(dest.read_bytes(), self.FILES[e.name])

    def test_bad_magic(self):
        with self.assertRaises(pfs0.Pfs0Error):
            pfs0.read_entries(io.BytesIO(b"HFS0" + bytes(12)))

    def test_truncated_data(self):
        blob = make_pfs0({"a.nca": b"hello"})[:-2]
        f = io.BytesIO(blob)
        (entry,) = pfs0.read_entries(f)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, self.assertRaises(pfs0.Pfs0Error):
            pfs0.extract(f, entry, Path(tmp) / "a.nca")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_runtime.py`:

```py
"""Tests for runtime C code that don't need the game: compiled with the host compiler."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
import random
import subprocess
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from recomp import check

RUNTIME = check.REPO / "runtime"
# glibc hides the POSIX names the runtime uses under -std=c11 (recomp/build.py passes the same off Windows)
POSIX = [] if sys.platform == "win32" else ["-D_GNU_SOURCE"]


def sdl3(folder: Path) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]] | None:
    """SDL3 for a test program built in `folder`: (compiler flags, what to link), or None when this system has
    none (the test is skipped). Windows: the pinned package recomp.build uses, in the owner's work folder when
    there is a config, else a folder of its own under the temp folder (GitHub has no config); its DLL is copied
    next to the program. Elsewhere: the system's, by pkg-config."""
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        try:
            pc = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["pkg-config", *a, "sdl3"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                           check=True).stdout.split()
            return pc("--cflags"), pc("--libs")
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
            return None
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from tools.yw4 import config, deps
    try:
        cfg = config.load(require_exefs=False)
    except config.ConfigError:
        cfg = SimpleNamespace(work_dir=Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "yw4_test_deps")
    sdl = deps.fetch_sdl(cfg)
    shutil.copy2(sdl / "bin" / "SDL3.dll", folder / "SDL3.dll")
    return [f"-I{sdl / 'include'}"], [str(sdl / "lib" / "libSDL3.dll.a")]

SHA_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "yw4load.h"
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long n = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    unsigned char *b = malloc(n + 1);
    if (fread(b, 1, n, f) != (size_t)n) return 1;
    char out[65];
    yw4_sha256_hex(b, (size_t)n, out);
    puts(out);
    return 0;
}
"""


class Sha256Test(unittest.TestCase):
    """The runtime's version lock hashes main.bin itself; it must agree with hashlib."""

    def test_matches_hashlib(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            (t / "drv.c").write_text(SHA_DRIVER)
            exe = t / "sha.exe"
            subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", f"-I{RUNTIME / 'include'}", "-o", str(exe),
                            str(t / "drv.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "sha256.c")], check=True, capture_output=True)
            rng = random.Random(1)
            # lengths around the 55/56/64-byte padding boundaries, plus a big one
            for n in (0, 1, 55, 56, 57, 63, 64, 65, 119, 120, 127, 128, 1000, 100_003):
                data = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))
                (t / "in.bin").write_bytes(data)
                got = subprocess.run([str(exe), str(t / "in.bin")], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
                self.assertEqual(got.stdout.strip(), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), f"length {n}")


HEAP_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "hle.h"
#define REGION (64u << 20)
#define SLOTS 4000
static unsigned long long rng = 88172645463325252ull;
static unsigned rnd(void) { rng ^= rng << 13; rng ^= rng >> 7; rng ^= rng << 17; return (unsigned)rng; }
static struct { unsigned char *p; size_t n; unsigned char fill; } s[SLOTS];
#define FAIL(...) do { printf(__VA_ARGS__); puts(""); return 1; } while (0)
static int check_live(void) {  /* contents intact, no overlaps (sorted sweep) */
    static int idx[SLOTS]; int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (s[i].p) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < s[i].n; j++) if (s[i].p[j] != s[i].fill) return -1;
        idx[k++] = i;
    }
    for (int a = 1; a < k; a++) for (int b = a; b > 0 && s[idx[b-1]].p > s[idx[b]].p; b--) { int t = idx[b]; idx[b] = idx[b-1]; idx[b-1] = t; }
    for (int a = 1; a < k; a++) if (s[idx[a-1]].p + s[idx[a-1]].n > s[idx[a]].p) return -2;
    return 0;
}
int main(void) {
    unsigned char *region = malloc(REGION + 64);
    Yw4Heap *h = yw4_heap_create(region + 3, REGION);  /* unaligned on purpose */
    if (!h) FAIL("create failed");
    size_t empty = yw4_heap_total_free(h);
    if (yw4_heap_largest_free(h) != empty) FAIL("fresh heap: largest %zu != free %zu", yw4_heap_largest_free(h), empty);
    for (int step = 0; step < 300000; step++) {
        int i = rnd() % SLOTS;
        unsigned op = rnd() % 8;
        size_t n = (rnd() % 4 == 0) ? rnd() % 200000 : rnd() % 300;
        if (!s[i].p && op < 6) {
            size_t align = (op == 5) ? (size_t)1 << (rnd() % 13) : 16;
            unsigned char *q = yw4_heap_alloc(h, n, align);
            if (!q) continue;
            if ((size_t)q % (align < 16 ? 16 : align)) FAIL("misaligned %p align %zu", (void *)q, align);
            s[i].p = q; s[i].n = n; s[i].fill = (unsigned char)rnd();
            memset(q, s[i].fill, n);
        } else if (s[i].p && op < 4) {
            if (yw4_heap_free(h, s[i].p)) FAIL("free of live block refused");
            if (yw4_heap_free(h, s[i].p) == 0) FAIL("double free accepted");
            s[i].p = NULL;
        } else if (s[i].p) {
            unsigned char *q = yw4_heap_realloc(h, s[i].p, n);
            if (!q) continue;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < (n < s[i].n ? n : s[i].n); j++) if (q[j] != s[i].fill) FAIL("realloc lost data");
            s[i].p = q; s[i].n = n; memset(q, s[i].fill, n);
        }
        if (step % 20000 == 0) {
            int r = check_live();
            if (r) FAIL("step %d: %s", step, r == -1 ? "contents corrupted" : "blocks overlap");
            if (yw4_heap_largest_free(h) > yw4_heap_total_free(h)) FAIL("largest > total free");
        }
    }
    if (check_live()) FAIL("final check failed");
    if (yw4_heap_free(h, region + 4096 + 16) == 0) FAIL("stray pointer accepted");
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (s[i].p && yw4_heap_free(h, s[i].p)) FAIL("final free refused");
    if (yw4_heap_total_free(h) != empty || yw4_heap_largest_free(h) != empty)
        FAIL("not fully merged: free %zu largest %zu, expected %zu", yw4_heap_total_free(h), yw4_heap_largest_free(h), empty);
    if (yw4_heap_alloc(h, empty, 16) == NULL) FAIL("whole heap not allocatable");
    if (yw4_heap_alloc(h, 1, 16) != NULL) FAIL("allocation from a full heap");
    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}
"""


class HeapTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The allocator behind nn::mem::StandardAllocator (runtime/src/heap.c, decision 0011)."""

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:

                            f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}", "-o", str(exe), str(t / "drv.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "heap.c")],
                           check=True, capture_output=True)

            self.assertEqual(got.stdout.strip(), "ok")


STRING_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "hle.h"
static CPUState c;
static long long call(GuestFn f, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t n) {
    c.x[0] = a; c.x[1] = b; c.x[2] = n; f(&c); return (long long)c.x[0];
}
#define S(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))
#define EXPECT(e, want) do { long long g_ = (e); if (g_ != (want)) { printf("%s = %lld, want %lld\n", #e, g_, (long long)(want)); return 1; } } while (0)
int main(void) {
    /* musl returns the byte difference, as unsigned chars */
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strcmp, S("abc"), S("abd"), 0), 'c' - 'd');
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strcmp, S("\xff"), S("a"), 0), 0xff - 'a');
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strcmp, S("ab"), S("abc"), 0), -'c');
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_memcmp, S("a\x80"), S("a\x01"), 2), 0x7f);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_memcmp, S("xyz"), S("abc"), 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strncmp, S("abcx"), S("abcy"), 3), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strncmp, S("abcx"), S("abcy"), 4), 'x' - 'y');
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strncmp, S("a"), S("b"), 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strcasecmp, S("HeLLo"), S("hello"), 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strcasecmp, S("A"), S("b"), 0), 'a' - 'b');
    /* "C" locale ctype: nothing above 127, EOF in no class */
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isspace, 0xa0, 0, 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isspace, '\v', 0, 0), 1);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isalnum, '@', 0, 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isalnum, 'Z', 0, 0), 1);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_ispunct, '~', 0, 0), 1);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_ispunct, ' ', 0, 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isxdigit, 'g', 0, 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_isdigit, (uint32_t)-1, 0, 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_toupper, 0xe9, 0, 0), 0xe9);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_tolower, 'Q', 0, 0), 'q');
    /* integers: guest long is 64-bit; atoi wraps like musl */
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_atoi, S("  -42z"), 0, 0), -42);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_atoi, S("2147483648"), 0, 0), -2147483647 - 1);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_abs, (uint32_t)-7, 0, 0), 7);
    char *end = 0;
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtol, S("0x7fffffffff!"), S(&end), 0), 0x7fffffffffLL);
    EXPECT(*end, '!');
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtoul, S("-1"), 0, 10), -1);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtol, S("99999999999999999999"), 0, 10), 0x7fffffffffffffffLL);
    call(hle_libc_errno_location, 0, 0, 0);
    EXPECT(*(int *)(uintptr_t)c.x[0], 34);
    char buf[] = "a,,b;c";
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtok, S(buf), S(",;"), 0), S(buf));
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtok, 0, S(",;"), 0), S(buf + 3));
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtok, 0, S(",;"), 0), S(buf + 5));
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strtok, 0, S(",;"), 0), 0);
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_strnlen, S("abcdef"), 4, 0), 4);
    unsigned char m[8] = {0};
    EXPECT(call(hle_libc_memset_s, S(m), 4, 0x55) , 0);  /* x3 = 0 here: n = 0 */
    c.x[0] = S(m); c.x[1] = 4; c.x[2] = 0x55; c.x[3] = 8; hle_libc_memset_s(&c);
    EXPECT((long long)c.x[0], 22);
    EXPECT(m[3] == 0x55 && m[4] == 0, 1);
    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}
"""


class StringTest(unittest.TestCase):

ROMFS_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "romfs.h"
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (romfs_open(argv[1])) return 1;
    uint64_t n = romfs_size();
    unsigned char *img = malloc(n);
    /* read in odd-sized pieces, so reads cross file and padding boundaries */
    for (uint64_t at = 0; at < n;) {
        uint64_t k = n - at < 37 ? n - at : 37;
        if (romfs_read(at, img + at, k)) return 2;
        at += k;
    }
    FILE *out = fopen(argv[2], "wb");  /* not stdout: Windows text mode would change the bytes */
    if (!out || fwrite(img, 1, n, out) != n) return 3;
    fclose(out);
    return 0;
}
"""


def romfs_lookup(img: bytes, path: str) -> bytes | None:
    """Finds a file the way the game does: through the RomFS hash tables (independent of romfs.c)."""
    import struct as st
    hv = st.unpack_from("<10Q", img, 0)
    dhash, dhash_size, dmeta, _, fhash, fhash_size, fmeta, _, data = hv[1], hv[2], hv[3], hv[4], hv[5], hv[6], hv[7], hv[8], hv[9]

    def h(parent: int, name: bytes) -> int:
        x = parent ^ 123456789
        for c in name:
            x = (((x >> 5) | (x << 27)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) ^ c
        return x

    def find(table, nbuckets, meta, parent, name, entry_size):
        e = st.unpack_from("<I", img, table + 4 * (h(parent, name) % nbuckets))[0]
        while e != 0xFFFFFFFF:
            off = meta + e
            p = st.unpack_from("<I", img, off)[0]
            next_ = st.unpack_from("<I", img, off + entry_size - 8)[0]
            nl = st.unpack_from("<I", img, off + entry_size - 4)[0]
            if p == parent and img[off + entry_size:off + entry_size + nl] == name:
                return e, off
            e = next_
        return None

    parts = path.encode().split(b"/")
    parent = 0
    for d in parts[:-1]:
        r = find(dhash, dhash_size // 4, dmeta, parent, d, 0x18)
        if not r:
            return None
        parent = r[0]
    r = find(fhash, fhash_size // 4, fmeta, parent, parts[-1], 0x20)
    if not r:
        return None
    doff, size = st.unpack_from("<QQ", img, r[1] + 8)
    return img[data + doff:data + doff + size]


class RomfsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The virtual RomFS image (runtime/src/romfs.c): what the game's RomFS code would find."""

    def test_files_found_through_hash_tables(self):
        rng = random.Random(7)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            root = t / "romfs"
            want = {}
            for path, size in [("a.bin", 0), ("b.txt", 1), ("dir1/x", 17), ("dir1/sub/deep/file.dat", 100),
                               ("dir1/sub/y", 4096 + 3), ("dir2/abcdefghijklm.n", 33), ("z/1", 15), ("z/2", 16)]:
                p = root / path
                p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                data = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(size))
                p.write_bytes(data)
                want[path] = data
            (root / "emptydir").mkdir()
            (t / "drv.c").write_text(ROMFS_DRIVER)
            exe = t / "romfs.exe"
            # host.c: romfs.c's own lock around file reads and yw4_exit (every exit names its source line)
            subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", *POSIX, f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}", "-o", str(exe),
                            str(t / "drv.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "romfs.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "modmerge.c"),
                            str(RUNTIME / "src" / "diaryrows.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "host.c"),
                            "-pthread", *(["-lwinmm"] if sys.platform == "win32" else [])],
                           check=True, capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run([str(exe), str(root), str(t / "image.bin")], capture_output=True, check=True)
            img = (t / "image.bin").read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(int.from_bytes(img[:8], "little"), 0x50)
            for path, data in want.items():
                self.assertEqual(romfs_lookup(img, path), data, path)
            self.assertIsNone(romfs_lookup(img, "dir1/missing"))
            self.assertIsNone(romfs_lookup(img, "nodir/x"))

    def test_mods_cpk_lists_merged(self):
        """Two mods each free their own files in a copy of data/cpk_list.cfg.bin: the game sees both sets freed
        (decision 0067). One mod uses the data/-only layout; one file is listed in two archives."""
        import struct as st

        def cfg(entries):  # Level-5 cfg.bin: (path, archive or None for 0xFFFFFFFF or "" for an empty string, size)
            strs, offs = bytearray(), {}

            def s(x):
                if x not in offs:
                    offs[x] = len(strs)
                    strs.extend(x.encode() + b"\0")
                return offs[x]
            body = bytearray()
            for path, arch, size in entries:
                body += st.pack("<IB", 0x36F3E0D3, 3) + bytes([0b010000]) + b"\0\0"  # types: string, string, int
                body += st.pack("<III", s(path), 0xFFFFFFFF if arch is None else s(arch), size)
            st_off = 0x10 + len(body)
            return st.pack("<4I", len(entries), st_off, len(strs), len(offs)) + body + bytes(strs)

        def archives(b):
            n, st_off, _, _ = st.unpack_from("<4I", b)
            out, p = [], 0x10
            for _ in range(n):
                path, arch, _ = st.unpack_from("<III", b, p + 8)
                name = lambda o: b[st_off + o:b.index(b"\0", st_off + o)].decode()
                out.append((name(path), None if arch == 0xFFFFFFFF else name(arch) or None))
                p += 20
            return out

        game = [("data/a", "x.cpk", 4), ("data/b", "x.cpk", 4), ("data/b", "y.cpk", 4), ("data/c", "x.cpk", 4),
                ("data/d", "x.cpk", 4)]
        free = lambda names: [(p, "" if p in names else a, n) for p, a, n in game]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            files = {"romfs/data/cpk_list.cfg.bin": cfg(game),
                     "mods/A mod/romfs/data/cpk_list.cfg.bin": cfg(free({"data/a", "data/b"})),
                     "mods/A mod/romfs/data/a": b"modA-longer", "mods/A mod/romfs/data/b": b"modB",
                     "mods/b_mod/data/cpk_list.cfg.bin": cfg(free({"data/c"})), "mods/b_mod/data/c": b"modC"}
            for path, data in files.items():
                (t / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (t / path).write_bytes(data)
            (t / "drv.c").write_text(ROMFS_DRIVER)
            exe = t / "romfs.exe"
            subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", *POSIX, f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}", "-o", str(exe),
                            str(t / "drv.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "romfs.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "modmerge.c"),
                            str(RUNTIME / "src" / "diaryrows.c"), str(RUNTIME / "src" / "host.c"),
                            "-pthread", *(["-lwinmm"] if sys.platform == "win32" else [])],
                           check=True, capture_output=True)
            r = subprocess.run([str(exe), str(t / "romfs"), str(t / "image.bin")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                               env={**os.environ, "YW4_MODS": str(t / "mods")})
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            self.assertIn("b_mod: 1 files replaced, 1 added", r.stderr)  # the data/-only layout is found
            self.assertIn("2 mods' lists merged, 3 entries freed", r.stderr)
            # a loose file's listed size is the file read (A's data/a is 11 bytes, every list says 4): the game reads a
            # loose file by its entry's size (2026-11-14: a wrong one blanked the English patch's item names)
            self.assertIn("cpk_list: 1 loose files' sizes set to the files read", r.stderr)
            img = (t / "image.bin").read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(romfs_lookup(img, "data/c"), b"modC")
            lst = romfs_lookup(img, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin")
            sizes = {name: st.unpack_from("<I", lst, 16 + 20 * i + 16)[0]
                     for i, (name, _) in enumerate(archives(lst))}
            self.assertEqual(sizes, {"data/a": 11, "data/b": 4, "data/c": 4, "data/d": 4})
            self.assertEqual(archives(romfs_lookup(img, "data/cpk_list.cfg.bin")),
                             [("data/a", None), ("data/b", None), ("data/b", None), ("data/c", None),
                              ("data/d", "x.cpk")])

    def test_mods_data_files_merged(self):
        """Mods changing different entries of one .cfg.bin all keep their changes; two changing the same entry
        clash, the later mod's copy is used, and `--mod-clashes` names them (decision 0068)."""
        import struct as st

        def cfg(vals):  # entries of one int each: (crc, value)
            body = b"".join(st.pack("<IB", crc, 1) + bytes([0b01]) + b"\xff\xff" + st.pack("<I", v) for crc, v in vals)
            return st.pack("<4I", len(vals), 16 + len(body), 0, 0) + body

        def entries(b):
            n = st.unpack_from("<I", b)[0]
            return [st.unpack_from("<I", b, 16 + 12 * i)[0:1] + st.unpack_from("<I", b, 16 + 12 * i + 8) for i in range(n)]

        base = [(i, 100 + i) for i in range(1, 9)]
        items_a = [(c, 999 if c == 2 else v) for c, v in base]                       # A changes entry 2
        items_b = [(c, 555 if c == 6 else v) for c, v in base[:7]] + [(77, 7)] + base[7:]  # B: entry 6, adds one
        shop_a = [(c, 1 if c == 3 else v) for c, v in base]                          # A and C: both entry 3
        shop_c = [(c, 2 if c == 3 else v) for c, v in base]
        drv_clash = '#include <stdio.h>\n#include "romfs.h"\nint main(int c, char **v) { return romfs_mod_clashes(v[1], stdout); }\n'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            files = {"romfs/data/items.cfg.bin": cfg(base), "romfs/data/shop.cfg.bin": cfg(base),
                     "romfs/data/pic.bin": b"game",
                     "mods/A/romfs/data/items.cfg.bin": cfg(items_a), "mods/A/romfs/data/shop.cfg.bin": cfg(shop_a),
                     "mods/A/romfs/data/pic.bin": b"A",
                     "mods/B/romfs/data/items.cfg.bin": cfg(items_b),
                     "mods/C/romfs/data/shop.cfg.bin": cfg(shop_c), "mods/C/romfs/data/pic.bin": b"C"}
            for path, data in files.items():
                (t / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (t / path).write_bytes(data)
            (t / "drv.c").write_text(ROMFS_DRIVER)
            (t / "clash.c").write_text(drv_clash)
            srcs = [str(RUNTIME / "src" / n) for n in ("romfs.c", "modmerge.c", "diaryrows.c", "host.c")]
            libs = ["-pthread", *(["-lwinmm"] if sys.platform == "win32" else [])]
            for drv, exe in (("drv.c", "romfs.exe"), ("clash.c", "clash.exe")):
                subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", *POSIX, f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}", "-o",
                                str(t / exe), str(t / drv), *srcs, *libs], check=True, capture_output=True)
            env = {**os.environ, "YW4_MODS": str(t / "mods")}
            r = subprocess.run([str(t / "romfs.exe"), str(t / "romfs"), str(t / "image.bin")], capture_output=True,
                               text=True, env=env)
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            self.assertIn("data/items.cfg.bin: merged from 2 mods", r.stderr)
            self.assertIn("data/shop.cfg.bin: A and C change the same entries, C's copy is used", r.stderr)
            img = (t / "image.bin").read_bytes()
            want = [(c, 999 if c == 2 else 555 if c == 6 else v) for c, v in base[:7]] + [(77, 7)] + base[7:]
            self.assertEqual(entries(romfs_lookup(img, "data/items.cfg.bin")), want)
            self.assertEqual(entries(romfs_lookup(img, "data/shop.cfg.bin")), shop_c)
            r = subprocess.run([str(t / "clash.exe"), str(t / "romfs")], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(sorted(r.stdout.splitlines()),
                             ["clash\tdata/pic.bin\tA\tC", "clash\tdata/shop.cfg.bin\tA\tC"])


SWKBD_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "yw4cpu.h"

typedef void (*GuestFn)(CPUState *ctx);

static int prompt_step = 0;
static char last_message_title[128];
static char last_message_body[128];
static int message_shown = 0;

void gamemenu_prompt_options(int min_chars, int cancel) {}
void gamemenu_prompt_begin(const char *title, int max_chars, const char *fallback) {}
int gamemenu_prompt_take(char *out, size_t n) {
    if (message_shown) {
        message_shown = 0;
        return 1; /* message dismissed */
    }
    if (prompt_step == 0) {
        prompt_step++;
        if (out) snprintf(out, n, "BadName");
        return 1;
    }
    if (prompt_step == 1) {
        prompt_step++;
        if (out) snprintf(out, n, "GoodName");
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
void gamemenu_message_begin(const char *title, const char *body) {
    message_shown = 1;
    strncpy(last_message_title, title, sizeof(last_message_title) - 1);
    strncpy(last_message_body, body, sizeof(last_message_body) - 1);
}
int window_repaint(int force) { return 0; }
void host_sleep_ns(int64_t ns) {}
/* the main characters' default names (main_name_for): a translation mod's chara_text, or none */
static const char *mod_chara_text;
const char *romfs_host_path(const char *path) {
    return mod_chara_text && !strcmp(path, "data/common/text/ja/chara_text.cfg.bin") ? mod_chara_text : NULL;
}

static uint64_t last_user_arg;
static char last_checked_text[128];
static uint64_t last_string_size;

static void mock_callback(CPUState *ctx) {
    last_user_arg = ctx->x[0];
    void *str_ptr = *(void **)ctx->x[2];
    last_string_size = *(uint64_t *)((uintptr_t)ctx->x[2] + 8);
    strncpy(last_checked_text, (const char *)str_ptr, sizeof(last_checked_text) - 1);
    if (strcmp(last_checked_text, "BadName") == 0) {
        ctx->x[0] = 1; /* rejected */
    } else {
        ctx->x[0] = 0; /* accepted */
    }
}

GuestFn yw4_resolve(uint64_t target) {
    if (target == 0x12345678) return mock_callback;
    return NULL;
}
/* the Diary's New Game slot picker (savefs.c): not tested here */
void savefs_new_game_naming(const char *token, int girl) { (void)token; (void)girl; }

#include "swkbd.c"

/* the loader's module table: the typed-name hook (decision 0066) reads main's base from it */
static uint64_t main_base;
const Yw4Module yw4_modules[] = { { .name = "main", .base = &main_base } };

/* main_name_for reads its names once per run, so each case is its own run: argv[1] "mod" (argv[2] a file laid
 * out as the English patch's: 0xFF filler, six names, Neptuna, the six tokens) or "none" (the Japanese names). */
static int names_test(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "mod")) {
        if (argc < 3) return 30;
        mod_chara_text = argv[2];
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_KETA_8888>") ?: "", "Nate")) return 31;
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_NATSUME_8>") ?: "", "Summer")) return 32;
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_TOUMA_888>") ?: "", "Touma")) return 33;  /* the first, after the filler */
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_FUMI_8888>") ?: "", "Katie")) return 34;
    } else {
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_KETA_8888>") ?: "", "ケータ")) return 35;
        if (strcmp(main_name_for("<NAME_FUMI_8888>") ?: "", "フミ")) return 36;
    }
    if (main_name_for("<ITEM_NAME>")) return 37;  /* not a main character's token */
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc > 1) return names_test(argc, argv);
    CPUState c = {0};
    uint8_t a[0x500] = {0};
    char buf[256] = {0};
    uint64_t out_struct[2] = { (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf, sizeof(buf) };

    c.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)out_struct;
    c.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)a;

    /* 1. With textcheck disabled */
    a[0x3d0] = 0;
    *(uint64_t *)(a + 0x3d8) = 0x12345678;
    if (check_name(&c, a, "BadName", 1, 8) != 0) return 1;

    /* 2. With textcheck enabled, valid name */
    a[0x3d0] = 1;
    *(uint64_t *)(a + 0x4e0) = 0xbeefcafe;
    a[0x3bd] = 1;
    if (check_name(&c, a, "GoodName", 1, 8) != 0) return 2;
    if (last_user_arg != 0xbeefcafe) return 3;
    if (strcmp(last_checked_text, "GoodName") != 0) return 4;
    if (last_string_size != 8) return 5;
    if (out_struct[1] != sizeof(buf)) return 6;

    /* 3. With textcheck enabled, rejected name */
    if (check_name(&c, a, "BadName", 1, 8) != 1) return 7;
    if (strcmp(last_checked_text, "BadName") != 0) return 8;
    if (out_struct[1] != sizeof(buf)) return 9;

    /* 4. Full interactive ShowKeyboard flow with initial rejection and retry */
    prompt_step = 0;
    memset(buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
    *(int32_t *)(a + 0x3ac) = 8; /* max */
    yw4_swkbd_ShowKeyboard(&c);
    if (c.x[0] != 0) return 10; /* ShowKeyboard should succeed after retry */
    if (strcmp(buf, "GoodName") != 0) return 11;
    if (strcmp(last_message_body, "This name cannot be used.") != 0) return 12;

    /* 5. Profanity filter native overrides */
    CPUState pf_ctx = {0};
    yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_Initialize(&pf_ctx);
    if (pf_ctx.x[0] != 0) return 13;
    yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_GetContentVersion(&pf_ctx);
    if (pf_ctx.x[0] != 1) return 14;
    int words_masked = -1;
    pf_ctx.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&words_masked;
    yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_MaskProfanityWordsInText_c(&pf_ctx);
    if (pf_ctx.x[0] != 0 || words_masked != 0) return 15;
    uint32_t check_res[2] = {99, 99};
    pf_ctx.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)check_res;
    pf_ctx.x[4] = 2;
    yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_CheckProfanityWords_c(&pf_ctx);
    if (pf_ctx.x[0] != 0 || check_res[0] != 0 || check_res[1] != 0) return 16;
    yw4_ngc_ProfanityFilter_Finalize(&pf_ctx);
    if (pf_ctx.x[0] != 0) return 17;

    return 0;
}
"""


class SwkbdCheckTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The software keyboard text check callback (runtime/src/swkbd.c)."""

    def test_text_check_callback(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            (t / "drv.c").write_text(SWKBD_DRIVER, encoding="utf-8")
            exe = t / "swkbd_test.exe"
            subprocess.run([check.host_cc(), "-std=gnu17", "-O1", "-Wall",
                            f"-I{RUNTIME / 'include'}", f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}",
                            f"-I{check.REPO / 'third_party' / 'vulkan' / 'include'}",
                            *POSIX,
                            "-o", str(exe), str(t / "drv.c")], check=True, capture_output=True)
            got = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            self.assertEqual(got.returncode, 0)
            # the default names: a translation mod's file (the English patch's layout, made up here), then none
            names = [b"Touma", b"Summer", b"Akinori", b"Shin", b"Nate", b"Katie", b"Neptuna"]
            tokens = [b"<NAME_TOUMA_888>", b"<NAME_NATSUME_8>", b"<NAME_AKINORI_8>", b"<NAME_SHIN_8888>",
                      b"<NAME_KETA_8888>", b"<NAME_FUMI_8888>"]
            chara = t / "chara_text.cfg.bin"
            chara.write_bytes(b"\x00" * 16 + b"\xff\xff\xff" + b"\x00".join(names + tokens) + b"\x00Dad\x00")
            for args in (["mod", str(chara)], ["none"]):
                got = subprocess.run([str(exe), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertEqual(got.returncode, 0, f"{args[0]}: {got.stderr}")


HID_VIBRATION_DRIVER = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <math.h>

#include "ipc.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"

/* what svc_hid.c hands the window (decision 0058): each band's amplitude (0..1) and frequency */
static float last_low, last_freq_low, last_high, last_freq_high;
static int rumble_calls;

void window_vibration(float amp_low, float freq_low, float amp_high, float freq_high) {
    last_low = amp_low, last_freq_low = freq_low;
    last_high = amp_high, last_freq_high = freq_high;
    rumble_calls++;
}
static int near(float a, float b) { return fabsf(a - b) < 1e-4f; }

void window_input(uint64_t *buttons, int32_t sticks[4]) {}
void host_lock(HostLock *l) {}
void host_unlock(HostLock *l) {}
uint64_t window_input_reads(void) { return 0; }
void window_input_read_replayed(void) {}
int window_paused(void) { return 0; }
uint64_t window_pause_buttons(void) { return 0; }
void settings_action(int a) {}
int settings_open(void) { return 0; }
int gamemenu_open(void) { return 0; }
void textin_type(const char *t) {}
int bindings_capture_axis(int axis, int16_t val) { return 0; }
void used_pad(int p) {}
void panel_pad_stick(void) {}
void panel_pad_triggers(void) {}
KSharedMemory *yw4_shared_memory_new(size_t size, void (*on_map)(KSharedMemory *), uint32_t *handle) { return NULL; }
void yw4_handle_close(uint32_t handle) {}
KEvent *yw4_event_new(uint32_t *handle) { return NULL; }
void gpu_request_trace(int draws) {}
void gpu_request_dump(void) {}
void shadow_toggle(void) {}

Service *ipc_service_new(const char *name, ServiceHandler handler, void *state) { return NULL; }
void ipc_unimplemented(Service *s, IpcRequest *req, IpcResponse *resp) {}
void ipc_return_object(IpcResponse *resp, Service *s) {}

#include "svc_hid.c"

int main(void) {
    Service s = {"hid", svc_hid, NULL, 1};
    IpcResponse resp = {0};

    /* 1. Test SendVibrationValues (cmd 206) with stereo left/right actuators */
    uint32_t handles[2] = {
        0x00010001, /* style 1, npad 0 (player 1), device 1 (left) */
        0x00020001  /* style 1, npad 0 (player 1), device 2 (right) */
    };
    VibrationValue vals[2] = {
        { 0.5f, 160.0f, 0.2f, 320.0f },
        { 0.8f, 160.0f, 0.4f, 320.0f }
    };
    IpcRequest req206 = {0};
    req206.cmd = 206;
    req206.nx = 2;
    req206.x[0].addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)handles;
    req206.x[0].size = sizeof(handles);
    req206.x[1].addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)vals;
    req206.x[1].size = sizeof(vals);

    rumble_calls = 0;
    svc_hid(&s, &req206, &resp);

    /* the stronger amplitude of the two devices per band, the bands' frequencies as sent */
    if (rumble_calls != 1) return 1;
    if (!near(last_low, 0.8f)) return 2;
    if (!near(last_high, 0.4f)) return 3;
    if (!near(last_freq_low, 160.0f) || !near(last_freq_high, 320.0f)) return 4;

    /* 2. Test stopping vibration (zero amplitude) */
    vals[0].amp_low = 0.0f; vals[0].amp_high = 0.0f;
    vals[1].amp_low = 0.0f; vals[1].amp_high = 0.0f;
    svc_hid(&s, &req206, &resp);
    if (last_low != 0 || last_high != 0) return 5;

    /* 3. Test player 2 handle ignored */
    uint32_t p2_handle = 0x00010101; /* npad 1 (player 2) */
    VibrationValue p2_val = { 1.0f, 160.0f, 1.0f, 320.0f };
    req206.x[0].addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&p2_handle;
    req206.x[0].size = sizeof(p2_handle);
    req206.x[1].addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&p2_val;
    req206.x[1].size = sizeof(p2_val);
    svc_hid(&s, &req206, &resp);
    if (last_low != 0 || last_high != 0) return 6;

    /* 4. Test SendVibrationValue (cmd 201, singular) */
    uint8_t raw201[32] = {0};
    *(uint32_t *)(raw201 + 0) = 0x00010001; /* player 1, device 1 */
    VibrationValue *v201 = (VibrationValue *)(raw201 + 4);
    v201->amp_low = 0.6f;
    v201->amp_high = 0.3f;
    IpcRequest req201 = {0};
    req201.cmd = 201;
    req201.data = raw201;
    req201.data_size = 28;
    svc_hid(&s, &req201, &resp);
    if (!near(last_low, 0.6f)) return 7;
    if (!near(last_high, 0.3f)) return 8;

    return 0;
}
"""

/* the menu and scene checks that switch the mouse's buttons (mousemenu.c, pause.c): never on here */

int main(void) {
    uint64_t b = 0;
    int32_t s[4] = {0};

    /* 1. Exploring: wheel up/down does NOT press D-pad up (bit 13) or down (bit 15) */
    battle_state = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 1, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (b & (1ull << 13)) return 1;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 0, 1, NULL, &b, s);
    if (b & (1ull << 15)) return 2;

    /* 2. In battle: wheel up presses D-pad up (bit 13) */
    battle_state = 1;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 1, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 13))) return 3;
    if (b & (1ull << 15)) return 4;

    /* 3. In battle: wheel down presses D-pad down (bit 15) */
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 0, 1, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 15))) return 5;
    if (b & (1ull << 13)) return 6;

    bindings_load_line("BATTLE_KEY1_DPAD_DOWN", "Down");
    bindings_load_line("BATTLE_KEY2_DPAD_DOWN", "-");

    b = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 1, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 13))) return 7;

    b = 0;
    bindings_read(NULL, 0, 0, 1, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 15))) return 8;

    bool kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT] = {0};
    battle_state = 1;
    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_UP] = true;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(kbd, 0, 0, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 13))) return 9;
    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_UP] = false;

    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN] = true;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(kbd, 0, 0, 0, NULL, &b, s);

    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN] = false;

    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_UP] = true;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(kbd, 0, 0, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 13))) return 11;
    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_UP] = false;

    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN] = true;
    b = 0;
    bindings_read(kbd, 0, 0, 0, NULL, &b, s);
    if (!(b & (1ull << 15))) return 12;
    kbd[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN] = false;

    return 0;
}

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:

            self.assertEqual(got.returncode, 0)


class CxxHeadersTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The runtime's headers compile as C++ (issue #12): gpu_dlssg.cpp includes some, and g++ stopped on C11's
    `_Noreturn` there. Every header with a function that never returns or a thread-local, with each C++ compiler at
    hand: g++ as it is, clang++ with C11 keywords made errors (it takes them as extensions otherwise)."""

    HEADERS = ("host.h", "kernel.h", "hle.h", "nvn.h", "gpu_internal.h")

    def compilers(self) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
        cc = check.host_cc()
        name = Path(cc).name
        found = []
        for c, cxx in (("clang", "clang++"), ("gcc", "g++")):
            if name.startswith(c):
                sibling = str(Path(cc).with_name(name.replace(c, cxx, 1))) if os.sep in cc or "/" in cc else name.replace(c, cxx, 1)
                if shutil.which(sibling):
                    found.append(sibling)
        if shutil.which("g++") and "g++" not in found:
            found.append("g++")
        return [(c, ["-Werror=c11-extensions"] if "clang" in Path(c).name else []) for c in found]

    def test_headers_as_cxx(self):
        compilers = self.compilers()
        if not compilers:
            self.skipTest("no C++ compiler")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            src = Path(t) / "headers.cpp"
            src.write_text("".join(f'#include "{h}"\n' for h in self.HEADERS) + "int main() { return 0; }\n")
            for cxx, flags in compilers:
                with self.subTest(compiler=cxx):
                    r = subprocess.run([cxx, "-std=c++17", "-fsyntax-only", *flags, f"-I{RUNTIME / 'src'}",
                                        f"-I{RUNTIME / 'include'}",
                                        f"-I{check.REPO / 'third_party' / 'vulkan' / 'include'}", str(src)],
                                       capture_output=True, text=True)
                    self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr[-2000:])
```

`tests/test_settings_texts.py`:

```py
"""The settings panel's texts (runtime/src/settings.c): every setting has a description, every option a note,
and every character of them exists in the panel's font (runtime/src/hud.c), so nothing shows up blank."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def c_strings(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """The string literals in a piece of C, adjacent literals joined (as the compiler does)."""
    out: list[str] = []
    joined = False
    for m in re.finditer(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"|(\s+)|(.)', text, re.S):
        if m.group(1) is not None:
            s = m.group(1).replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\"', '"')
            if joined and out:
                out[-1] += s
            else:
                out.append(s)
            joined = True
        elif m.group(2) is None:
            joined = False
    return out


def settings() -> list[dict]:
    src = (ROOT / "runtime/src/settings.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    entries = []
    for var, end in (("player", "/* The developer page"), ("developer", "enum { NPLAYER")):
        body = src[src.index(f"static const Setting {var}[] = {{"):src.index(end)]
        body = body[body.index("{") + 1:]
        depth, start = 0, None
        for i, ch in enumerate(body):  # the top-level { ... } of each setting
            if ch == "{":
                if depth == 0:
                    start = i
                depth += 1
            elif ch == "}":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0 and start is not None:
                    entries.append(body[start + 1:i])
    out = []
    for e in entries:
        lists = re.findall(r"\{([^{}]*)\}", e)
        head = e[:e.index("{")]
        category, name, *help_parts = c_strings(head)
        count = int(re.search(r"\}\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,", e).group(1))  # the number after the notes
        out.append({"category": category, "name": name, "help": "".join(help_parts),
                    "options": c_strings(lists[0]), "notes": c_strings(lists[1]), "count": count,
                    "values": c_strings(lists[2]) if len(lists) > 2 else []})
    return out


def font() -> set[str]:
    src = (ROOT / "runtime/src/hud.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    chars = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r"\{'(\\.|[^'\\])', \{", src):
        c = m.group(1)
        chars.add(c[1] if c.startswith("\\") else c)
    return chars | {" "}


class SettingsTexts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_setting_explained(self):
        rows = settings()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(rows), 9)
        for r in rows:
            with self.subTest(setting=r["name"]):
                self.assertGreater(len(r["help"]), 20, "no description")
                self.assertEqual(len(r["options"]), r["count"], "option count")
                self.assertEqual(len(r["notes"]), len(r["options"]), "a note per option")
                self.assertEqual(len(r["values"]), len(r["options"]), "a settings-file value per option")
                for opt, note in zip(r["options"], r["notes"]):
                    self.assertGreater(len(note.strip()), 2, f"no note for {opt}")

    def test_texts_in_the_font(self):
        glyphs = font()
        for r in settings():
            for text in [r["category"], r["name"], r["help"], *r["options"], *r["notes"]]:
                with self.subTest(text=text):
                    missing = {c for c in text.upper() if c not in glyphs}
                    self.assertFalse(missing, f"characters without a glyph: {sorted(missing)}")

    def test_sharpening_row(self):
        """SHARPENING (decision 0076, a slider since issue #11): 0..1 stopping at its five levels (steps of 0.25),
        shown by name, never greyed out (it works with every anti-aliasing), the default MEDIUM (0.5), and settings
        files from before the slider (0..4) read as those levels."""
        src = (ROOT / "runtime/src/settings.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        row = next(r for r in settings() if r["name"] == "SHARPENING")
        self.assertEqual(row["count"], 0, "a slider has no options")
        entry = src[src.index('"SHARPENING",'):]
        entry = entry[:entry.index("}},") + 3]
        self.assertIn('"YW4_SHARPEN", {NULL}, NULL, gpu_sharpen_get, gpu_sharpen_set, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.25f,', entry,
                      "no greyed-out reason, 0..1 stopping at the five levels")
        self.assertRegex(entry, r'1, sharpen_parse, \{"OFF", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "MAX"\}\}')
        aa = (ROOT / "runtime/src/gpu_aa.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('if (!e || !*e) return 50;', aa)
        self.assertIn("else if ((p = atoi(e)) >= 1 && p <= 4) p *= 25;", aa)

    def test_sharpen_text_row(self):
        """SHARPEN TEXT AND MENUS: right under SHARPENING, OFF / ON saved as 0 / 1, off unless YW4_SHARPEN_UI=1."""
        rows = settings()
        names = [r["name"] for r in rows]
        i = names.index("SHARPEN TEXT AND MENUS")
        self.assertEqual(names[i - 1], "SHARPENING")
        self.assertEqual(rows[i]["options"], ["OFF", "ON"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[i]["values"], ["0", "1"])
        aa = (ROOT / "runtime/src/gpu_aa.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertRegex(aa, r'getenv\("YW4_SHARPEN_UI"\);\s*on = e && atoi\(e\) == 1;')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_shaders.py`:

```py
"""The HBH1 shader container parser (tools/yw4/shaders.py).

Built from a synthetic container with the layout measured on the game's files, so no
game data is needed. The shader key (FNV-1a 64 of the assembly) must match the runtime's.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import unittest

from tools.yw4 import shaders

ASM = (b"!!NVfp5.0\nOPTION NV_bindless_texture;\nTEMP R0;\nMOV.U.CC R0.x, {1, 0, 0, 0};\n"
       b"IF NE.x;\nMOV.F result.color, {1, 0, 0, 1};\nENDIF;\nREP.S ;\nBRK (NE.x);\nENDREP;\nEND")


def container() -> bytes:
    strings = b"in_POSITION0\0t_color\0u_rate\0"
    inputs = struct.pack("<IIII", 0, 0x1234, 2, 0)
    resources = struct.pack("<IIHH", 13, 0x5678, 3, 0).ljust(0x20, b"\0")
    members = struct.pack("<IIHHHH", 21, 0x9ABC, 2, 1, 4, 8)
    unknown = b"\0" * 0x10
    code = b"\x11" * 0x40
    control = b"\0" * 0x20 + ASM + b"\n\0\0\0"
    nxgl = b"NXGL" + struct.pack("<5I", 1, 0x20, len(code), 0x20 + len(code), len(control)).ljust(0x1C, b"\0")
    nxgl += code + control
    body = [inputs, resources, members, unknown, nxgl, strings]
    off, table, blob = 4 + 8 * 6, b"", b""
    for part in body:
        table += struct.pack("<II", off + len(blob), len(part))
        blob += part
    return b"HBH1" + table + blob


class ShaderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fnv1a64(self):
        # Published FNV-1a 64 test vectors.
        self.assertEqual(shaders.fnv1a64(b""), 0xCBF29CE484222325)
        self.assertEqual(shaders.fnv1a64(b"a"), 0xAF63DC4C8601EC8C)
        self.assertEqual(shaders.fnv1a64(b"foobar"), 0x85944171F73967E8)

    def test_parse(self):
        s = shaders.parse(container())
        self.assertEqual(s["stage"], "frag")
        self.assertEqual(s["text"], ASM)
        self.assertEqual(s["code_size"], 0x40)
        self.assertEqual(s["inputs"], [{"name": "in_POSITION0", "location": 2}])
        self.assertEqual(s["resources"], [{"name": "t_color", "kind": "texture", "slot": 0}])
        self.assertEqual(s["members"], [{"name": "u_rate", "type": 2, "count": 1, "size": 4, "offset": 8}])

    def test_rejects(self):
        with self.assertRaises(shaders.ShaderError):
            shaders.parse(b"XXXX" + container()[4:])
        with self.assertRaises(shaders.ShaderError):
            shaders.assembly(b"!!NVfp5.0\nMOV.F result.color, 0;\n")


FRAG = """!!NVfp5.0
OPTION NV_internal;
OPTION NV_bindless_texture;
CBUFFER buf2[] = { program.buffer[2] };
CBUFFER buf14[] = { program.buffer[14] };
ATTRIB fragment_attrib[] = { fragment.attrib[0..3] };
TEMP R0, R1;
LONG TEMP D0;
OUTPUT result_color0 = result.color;
LDC.U64 D0.x, buf14[16];
TEX.F R0, fragment.attrib[3], handle(D0.x), 2D;
LDC.F32X4 R1, buf2[R0.x + 32];
MAD.F32.SAT R1, R0, -R1.x, |R1|;
TRUNC.U.CC R0.x, R1.y;
IF NE.x;
MOV.F R1.y (EQ.x), {0.5, 0, 0, 0}.x;
ELSE;
KIL NE.x;
ENDIF;
SGE.S R0.z, R0.x, {0xffffffff, 0, 0, 0}.x;
MOV.F result_color0, R1;
END"""


class TranslatorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fragment(self):
        from recomp import shader
        glsl, iface = shader.translate("k", "frag", FRAG)
        for line in (
            "layout(set = 1, binding = 2, std140) uniform CB2 { uvec4 d[4096]; } cb2;",
            "layout(set = 1, binding = 18) uniform sampler2D tex2;",       # buf14[16] -> slot 2
            "layout(location = 3) in vec4 i_attr3;",
            "R0 = floatBitsToUint(texture(tex2, i_attr3.xy));",
            "R1 = cb2.d[(R0.x + 32u) >> 4];",
            "R1 = floatBitsToUint(clamp(fma(uintBitsToFloat(R0), (-uintBitsToFloat(R1.xxxx)), "
            "abs(uintBitsToFloat(R1))), 0.0, 1.0));",
            "tu = uvec4(max(trunc(uintBitsToFloat(R1.yyyy)), 0.0));",
            "cc.x = notEqual(tu, uvec4(0u)).x;",
            "if (cc.x) {",
            "R1.y = mix(R1, floatBitsToUint(vec4(0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).xxxx), not(cc.xxxx)).y;",
            "if (cc.x) discard;",
            "R0.z = mix(uvec4(0u), uvec4(0xFFFFFFFFu), greaterThanEqual(ivec4(R0.xxxx), ivec4(-1, 0, 0, 0).xxxx)).z;",
            "o_color0 = uintBitsToFloat(R1);",
        ):
            self.assertIn(line, glsl)
        self.assertEqual(iface["textures"], {"2": "2D"})
        self.assertEqual(iface["cbuffers"], [2])
        self.assertEqual(iface["colors"], [0])

    def test_position_source(self):
        from recomp import shader
        head = ("!!NVvp5.0\nOPTION NV_internal;\nCBUFFER buf2[] = { program.buffer[2] };\n"
                "ATTRIB vertex_attrib[] = { vertex.attrib[0..1] };\nTEMP R0, R1, R2;\n")
        # straight into the position, and through a register with a moved component
        direct = ("LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[48];\nDP4.F32 result.position.w, R0, vertex.attrib[0];\n"
                  "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[0];\nDP4.F32 result.position.x, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n"
                  "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[16];\nDP4.F32 result.position.y, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n"
                  "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[32];\nDP4.F32 result.position.z, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n")
        moved = ("LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[128];\nDP4.F32 R2.x, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n"
                 "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[176];\nDP4.F32 R1.x, R0, vertex.attrib[0];\n"
                 "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[144];\nDP4.F32 R2.y, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n"
                 "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[160];\nDP4.F32 R2.z, vertex.attrib[0], R0;\n"
                 "MOV.F R2.w, R1.x;\nMOV.F result.position, R2;\n")
        self.assertEqual(shader.position_source(head + direct + "END"), "2 0 1 2 3")
        self.assertEqual(shader.position_source(head + moved + "END"), "2 8 9 10 11")
        # anything else on the way: not a plain matrix
        for bad in ("ADD.F32 R2.x, R2, R1;\n", "LDC.F32X4 R0, buf2[64];\nMOV.F R2.w, R0.x;\n"):
            self.assertIsNone(shader.position_source(head + moved.replace("MOV.F result", bad + "MOV.F result") + "END"))
        self.assertIsNone(shader.position_source(head + direct.replace("vertex.attrib[0]", "vertex.attrib[1]") + "END"))
        # a full-screen pass: the input as it is (a moved component is not)
        self.assertEqual(shader.position_source(head + "MOV.F result.position, vertex.attrib[0];\nEND"), "in")
        self.assertIsNone(shader.position_source(head + "MOV.F result.position, vertex.attrib[0].yxzw;\nEND"))
        self.assertIn("m 2 0 1 2 3", shader.iface_text(shader.translate("k", "vert", head + direct + "END")[1]))

    def test_rejects(self):
        from recomp import shader
        for bad in ("LDC.U64 D0.x, buf14[R0.x];", "LDC.F32 R0.x, buf14[0];", "FOO.F R0, R1;",
                    "IF GT.x;", "TEX.F R0, R1, handle(D9.x), 2D;"):
            with self.assertRaises(shader.ShaderError, msg=bad):
                shader.translate("k", "frag", f"!!NVfp5.0\nCBUFFER buf14[] = {{ program.buffer[14] }};\n"
                                              f"TEMP R0, R1;\n{bad}\nEND")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
